So I put on something else and I crank it up a little louder, and they still just like kind of “duhhhhh,” like they don’t even hear it. And I can’t remember what I did, but I think I just was totally not ready and my system was cuckooing out on me and stuff, and it was just a real bummer of a party.

092 I am on a combat assault. Only a few of us ride in the chopper. We carry full combat gear: pack, weapon, helmet, ammo. We fly toward the Ivy Hill Apartments. From high up I see buildings which appear like photographs. We land on a rooftop. I see my brother. At the same time I see a horrible sight. I walk toward it. The intact body of an American soldier glows like fireplace embers. His internal organs have hardened to stone and are clearly visible. I shout to my brother, “How did this happen?” He says he doesn’t know. I am standing over the corpse. I can tell my brother is lying.

(171) I dreamt that I was at Tyme Gardens with Crystal and Stacy and their gang, except one girl was named Jenn, another girl was named Bush and we were with our kids too. And we stayed on one side of the park that looked like Crescent Lake and then we were at this petting zoo section, but we didn’t go in the section where all the rides and the show and stuff are that I’m familiar with. We mostly just stayed at one end of the park and walked around and stuff. And then we met up with Dad over at the petting zoo section and all the girls went on to do something else, and I was stopping and talking, and I was standing under the post of the fence of the petting zoo and I was talking and she said that there’s this, he was glad we stayed on this side and all. And I was thinking, “Yeah, of course she would be.” And there was this person that was going to do a concert show that was a guitarist from the ‘50’s, and I didn’t know the difference in my dream between a gunner and a guitarist, so I kind of thought that guns were like guitars and guitars were like guns. I don’t know why I would think something so whacko. I mean, they’re, I don’t know, they don’t even make a similar sound. Well anyway, and then I dreamt that we were home and I was looking around the house as if it were Tyme Gardens, trying to find stuff, and then I realized I was at home and I shouldn’t even be looking. Then I dreamt that Sheryl, Sandra and Sam were in town, which they were because they were at Tyme Gardens with us. And they were, I mean, I was laying in bed and Sam was like in the shower and he had this tube and he was spraying water at me and stuff. And so I closed the door. Then he came in with a cup of water and I thought he was going to pour it on my head, but instead I like got him in a wrestling hold, and he was like, “Ahhh, you gave me snake bite.” And I was thinking, “What in the world is a snake bite?” And we started like kind of wrestling and the cup of water just kind of went away, and he kept saying, “Ah, you gave me a snake bite!” And then I dreamt that that all went away and I was kind of snuggling with Sandra the way I snuggle with Mom and I was telling, I felt comfortable enough to tell her the story of way we found the keyboard, and I started asking her if she remembered when we had it, and she said, “Yeah, I know. Your mom kept asking us to take it each time we came, and I didn’t want to take it because Dawn [their real mother] said don’t take stuff from you.” And I was just like, “Okay,” I wasn’t hurt or anything, I mean, I was just sort of like, “Okay.” And I was drawing little bitty pictures in this notebook while I was talking to her. Somehow And I didn’t tell her the rest of the story; I never did. And then I woke up. Oh, and I dreamt that the time said like 10:35 and when I woke up it was 7:30.

(172) Okay, this is sometime in the middle of July, 2002. Last night I dreamt that I was at Bancroft, but I was in Devil Vision from my high school, and I was sitting there at their board and it had a blue faders except they weren’t uniform all the way across. The mono-mike channels were pots and the rest were blue faders, and I was trying to work this board and we were under a lot of stress to try and get this show done right now, and the librarian was trying to get us to do something. And then the bell rang and Elizabeth came over to me and said that Mrs. H.’s class was going to be in the auditorium. And then all of a sudden the halls and stuff were like at Bancroft, and Mrs. H.’s class was up on this other floor and I had to run up to her room and get my stuff. And then I was like running through the halls to get to the auditorium on time. I had books in my arm, but no bag, and I was running through the halls and I was coming down a stair thing and I fell face first, I was like falling down the stairs and then I woke, and my books went everywhere and I woke up.

(173) Last night I had a dream, like Martin Luther King. Well, I’m expecting a surprise visit from my sister Sandra tomorrow, but I don’t know what in the world or when in the world because they won’t tell me. So anyway, I had this dream that Sandra was here and I was telling her the story of we set up the keyboard on the kitchen counter, of all things, and it was white, the body was white and it was twice the size. I put my two hands on it. There was enough span for the bass clef and the treble clef, and I started playing the accompaniment for Easy Like Sunday morning. And Sandra was like, “Wow, girl!” And Dad was out in the yard and he could hear it, and then here comes the really bizarre part. We were getting ready to go to this thing at the city Performing Arts Center and Sandra and Dad wanted to go with us, but I guess they weren’t ready. I was just like in the car in the passenger seat, and the car was just going where I needed it to go. And it was just going on the interstate, 70 mph and it got off the exit at the right exit, and the only problem I had that it needed to be driven was when it came time to park, and since I wasn’t steering it, it parked kind of cockeyed across three other spaces. And it was twirling around a little tiny bit. And I shut off the ignition just in time before it crashed into something. And oh, when I was on the interstate, I could see around me, everybody in the truck behind me. I could see Mom and Sandra in the truck behind me, and so when I got parked, shortly after that Mom pulled up in the truck. And I had to tell her how cockeyed the car parked, and Sandra was there and I didn’t want Dad to know that I “drove” even though I didn’t drive all by myself. And we were going to race home and get him, but we decided, “Nah,” and I don’t remember too much after that, but I do remember that we were all at this like camp fire celebration with these fireworks going off later on. And then I woke up.

(174) Last night I had a bizarre dream . First of all, this was after everybody left and after all the dust settled and I could start remembering my dreams again and I wouldn’t get so tired. I dreamt that I was getting ready for school and I was all dressed and ready to go, and I had my book bag and my books and stuff. It was going to be my first day. And I went in the bathroom to go to the bathroom and there was this faucet on the wall, like opposite the toilet, and there were two of them and they were just spraying water out of control. And I went in there and I got myself all wet. They were spraying after me as I went and I just closed the door and I said, “Alright.” And then I got my shoes and stuff and told Mom about it, and I don’t remember what she said. But that was short-lived. The other weird dream I had was I dreamt that Sheryl and Sandra and I were going through my magic show stuff. And there was this recording of me doing a magic show a long time ago and people cheering and clapping, playing even one of the magic show things. And then I said, “Where is that coming from?” and Sheryl pulled out this mechanical chickie and she said, “This is a magic chick; now watch it.” And it had like a little heart thing on its hand; you know how mechanical things do. And when you would press it, it would say, “Hi, I’m a magic chick. If you want to play magic,” something about the something blue. You’d have to activate a blue king or blue foot thing or something. And then it would say, “Hi, I’m a magic chick, if you want to play magic,” something like that, and then it would start to play this recording of when I would do magic shows. That was like weird.

(175) Last night I had a dream that my birthday was fast approaching. I was at the fire station and they were making me this birthday cake. They like putting roses and stuff and sprinkles and I would go over and snitch some. And they were gearing up for a birthday party for me, but then I remembered that my birthday wasn’t until March, and then what in the world were they doing, getting ready for a birthday for me? And as I was getting my stuff ready to go out the door, the parrot started singing, “Happy birthday,” to me. That was kind of weird. Then I dreamt that I was taking a music class in college, and that this kind of Spanish lady was teaching it. And we were going over some theory and stuff, and she was surprised at how much I knew. And she was saying how she’s going to have to catch me up a little on what I missed. Then I dreamt that there was this battery charger thing that was supposed to absorb the acid if they corroded. It was like a traveling duffel bag, and it was for the keyboard. It was like put the batteries in all in series, and Mom said that it reminded her of cow poop, the way you put them in. And then they would gather (?) they would provide 9 volts and then you would plug it into the adapter. And I don’t know, somehow we had the notion that that would make it work. And I woke up before we could test it out.

(176) Last night I had kind of a weird, but predictable dream. I dreamt that I was starting school and that things had really, really changed. We were in this auditorium that kind of put me in mind of a cross between Dexter Hampton’s auditorium and the gym at Bancroft. The seats were not just slanted a little bit, but they were like way slanted like bleachers are. And they were different colors like in the Dexter Hampton auditorium, but there was this big, wide open space down in front of the seats that they said for assemblies and stuff they set up a stage. And I had the notion that for chorus class there was going to be this male performer opera singer going to teach it, and for some reason I had the notion that he wasn’t as good, that he was very basic. And I reasoned in my head that the more advanced classes were going to be taught by Mrs. Dougherty, but that this man was going to teach kind of the introductory and beginning and basic classes. And I can’t remember too much, so I woke up.

(177) Last night I dreamt that the kids were still in town, and that Sheryl and Sandra I was having such a good time with, and I was really sad about them leaving. But for some reason I was remembering a lot of things in my childhood to do like with Blue Bird and stuff, and I was pacing around upstairs, and I was really nervous. And it seemed that all the girls were taking a shower and Sam was reading, but I came downstairs and I thought I heard Sam playing the keyboard in the bedroom. And I know this is really stupid, but I’m going to have to say it anyway in order so that I can analyze my thoughts later. I dreamt that in order for the keyboard to work, we had to bake a cake, and there was this cake. And everybody would eat a piece of the cake, and when it was all gone, it wouldn’t work any more. And I don’t know what the connection was or why that happened like that, but it was weird. And it wasn’t anything wild like he used to do. He was really sincerely trying to learn a song, and it was the Entertainer song that the ice cream truck plays all the time. And let’s see, I dreamt that we also had a pineapple cake and a pear cake that I really wanted a piece of, but apparently Mom said they had containers that snapped shut and she couldn’t get them open without making a whole bunch of noise. But she wanted to save them for when it was just us, so when I wanted a piece of cake, I had to have the other cake that made the thing work. That is so bizarre. How bizarre; how bizarre. And I also remember that later on I got my school schedule, and we had to whip up this like cake mix in order for my schedule to coincide. And it was this like real powdery, awful-tasting cake mix we just had to whip up, and we had to spread it all over everywhere. And I dreamt that I was going around on my first school schedule and that I stayed back and was talking and talking with Mrs. Dougherty with Mom, and that I missed Math completely, and there was an absence on my first day. And Dad was complaining about it, and we said, “What’s he complaining about now?” And there were these pictures, and there was one of Mrs. Gresham, there was one of Mrs. Hammondand there was one of Mrs. Dougherty. There were these pictures that were like photo pictures, I guess. And Mrs. H.’s was bigger than life, and it was like almost poster size except it was just the head. And she had a blue background, like she had this beaver outfit on like she was this beaver on stage, and her hand was extending off to the side into the next picture. And her hand was extending like almost over the top of the Mrs. Dougherty picture, except you could still see her. It was just that the hand was in the way of the picture. And I dreamt that I was going to enlarge the other one and fix it up and get rid of Mrs. H.’s hand and all, so that hers would be bigger than life. Now I think that could have some meaning to it because Mrs. Hammondis pretty vain and stuff, I think, and [sigh] so, I think, and that’s it. That was bizarre, huh?

Ok this one was weird. I only remember a couple small bits. I am in a city bus and I look out the back of the bus and i see the 747 flying very low to the ground coming towards us. (178) Last night I had one of those stupid dreams I could have sworn I’ve had before. Has anybody ever had some of those? (179) Last night I dreamt that we were having a little picnic in the back yard, and we were playing the “Snake Bite” song, and we had this birthday cake that we were lighting candles on. And apparently a fire got started, a little fire with some of the matches, and Dad was showing me how to put out the fire that distracted me from being scared of the voodoo in the “Snake Bite” song. (180) A new tape. Let’s see how good this works. Anyway, I had a dream last night that I was still in Spain. For some reason I’m stuck on a broken record of having dreams about being still in Spain. But anyway, we were still in Spain and we were all roller blading down the street, and then we were going to go see a show of somebody rollerblading. So we got in these escalators and held onto the railings. They went twice as fast as normal ones do. I think maybe even three times faster. We went up four or five of them until we got to like this place where there were chairs for everybody and a little road thing. And I sat on a ramp right in the front, and my feet like dangled into the middle of the road thing, and then Mrs. Hammondtold us that we were too early and we have to come back in a half an hour. And then I had another dream that we were at dinner, and we were eating and eating these things. And I had already had a course, and this Spanish waiter came by with this tray with six compartments in it and gave me two spoonfuls from each compartment, and it was like, “Oh gosh, more to eat?” And I had some water that I was drinking, and then I was offered some vanilla ice cream and it turned out to be milk. And then I had another dream that we were walking around we went in this church. Let me think a minute. I remember more to it now. Some of our group was performing up there and going to sing and play their band instruments, and Chris and Michelle and Lee Hanks were sitting by the sound board, and Michelle was going to run it. And she was showing it to me and showing me all the things about it. And it was silvery with white faders, and it had these little white levers that you could make it say certain words, so you could just like make them say these words. And then the preacher came up and was preaching about these boys that all they wanted to do was fight and broke things up. And there was an image of some men up on the wall and the priest asked, “What would you do if this image wasn’t there?) and these wives would stand up and say, “You stole our husbands’ image.” And then I woke up.

(181) Last night I had a dream that I was taking a music theory course with Mr. Hartley and that it was the first day and he wanted us to, I thought that it was kind of near the end of the period and so I got up and I was starting to follow Elizabeth out the door and he’s like, “Hey, where are you going?” And so we sat back down. He put this like practice thing up on the overhead, he gave us each a little notebook about the size of a, about four times the size of a matchbook, and it had little tiny shapes of staff paper in it. And he was going to collect them, like writing a sharp on this line and putting this something-or-other on that space, and what does this mean, what does that mean and stuff like that. That was kind of dumb, huh?

(182) Last night I dreamt that I was in this store called Anderson Audio, like Sam works at, and it had audio stuff in it. First she showed me a porcelain music box rocking horse with this saddle that was made out of this really, really soft material, and it was ornate and stuff. And then she showed me this snow globe that was in the shape of a Santa face. It was flat and it was plastic, and when you tip it upside down, the lyrics to “Santa Claus is Coming to Town” – each word was on a little black piece of plastic and they would all just kind of fall into place and be suspended in the water, and you’d tip it upright again. (183) Last night I dreamt that I was going to be the prom DJ, the DJ for the high school prom. And it’s not anywhere near prom time. I don’t know where this came from, but I did participate in a wedding and was the DJ, so maybe that’s it. But anyway, I dreamt that our foyer was like four or five times as big as it really is, and I had my equipment set up and I was lining up CD’s and getting ready because I had the notion that the prom people were going to just start filling up, coming in the house and filling up our foyer. And so I’m getting ready, getting techno stuff together and all, and next thing I know, my equipment won’t work right and I have to have like a long time to like, I’m looking for this certain connector that I need and I can’t find it. For some reason I need a 8” mini connection, and I usually don’t use that unless I’m using my boom box, but I wasn’t this time, so I don’t know. Then I suddenly dreamt that – this must have been another one of those dreams that you have that feel like they’re connected – I dreamt that we were at Elizabeth’s house and we were in this small, tiny little kitchen that led out into this grand foyer with this staircase and everything. And it was pouring down rain outside. And I think it was Elizabeth’s cousin or brother-in-law – some relative of hers that was kind of a young man in his 20s. And he was telling me about how he likes to play the trumpet. And I guess it was Thomas, because Thomas plays the trumpet. And he was saying how a keyboard is such a great thing because you can make it make all kinds of different sounds. And if you don’t really play a certain instrument, but you want it in your song, you can make it make that sound if it’s the right kind of synthesizer. And by this time I was like swinging on a swing, hanging from one of these stairwell things, and I think Mom comes in from the pouring rain and we go in that small little kitchen, and Elizabeth’s asking about a mini disc. She thinks she wants to have something in the mini disc format. And so I told her I would show her my recorder from WM&F and then I woke up.

(184) Last night I had kind of a bizarre dream. I dreamt that I was at Elizabeth’s house and we were having a big party, and we were trying to cram all these people into this small little house. And there was like this carport thing in the front, and there was this blonde lady that was about 25 who was trying to tell me how to set up the sound system and what to do. And I don’t remember if I set it up or not, and I don’t even remember what she was telling me, but I do remember going in the bathroom and seeing this huge like garbage disposal like type thing. And they would like flush this _____ handle that would be like flushing a toilet. And for some reason I had the notion that it was getting plugged up and stuff and we were going to have to take some of the dirty laundry out of there. That was cuckoo, man!

Ok i remember just one part of this dream. We are leaving to go somewhere and we are in the car. I do not remember who i was with but get the feeling it was my family. Anyway I was up from Friday morning at 9am until 1am Sunday morning. So close to 48 hours. I went to bed knowing I would probably have a sleep paralysis episode upon falling asleep because I was so sleep deprived (I only have them when I am really tired, now). How it would work was they would only run their lights and sirens when they were moving, so when they stopped at a red light, they wouldn’t run them. And so it seemed that they would always be an intersection ahead of us, and when we would catch up to them and stop at their intersection, we would all go at the same time. And then when their lights and sirens would race past us and I would hear them real loud for minutes and then they’d be like past us. And then they would wait at the next intersection until we got there, and they wouldn’t go until we got there. And then they ran their lights and sirens real loud in our faces again. And they did that like three times and I was like terrified when we got to the park. But fortunately, when we got to the park, they turned down another street and were gone. And then I woke up.

I think that’s symbolic. And this time I was leading Astrid through it, and I lead her, she wasn’t scared at all, of course. Man, that was something. And, you know, it’s evening time and it stayed with me the whole day. Isn’t that amazing! But I think this is kind of symbolic. In the past I have had a few dreams about a roundy-roundy-round circle that just is continuous, like, for example, I had a dream one time that a cellar went down into a sub-cellar that led out into a, like a netting tube that you would go up and get in the attic. Now this circle had a dark and scary place, but it was only one, and it involved sound, which makes me think about life when I analyze this. The fact that the tunnel seemed lighter and safer each time I went through it, I think has to do with experiences that are new and odd and scary. They seem easier each time I have the same experience, and I think the first time that I went in there when I was so scared and petrified and I waiting for Dad, I think some experiences are like that. I am afraid to do them on my own, and even though he’s more critical and slower and harder, I want to have somebody help me through them. And I think the lady’s shop symbolizes like a house, like almost being in a home-like environment. I don’t know, I’m drawing a blank there. But the fact that I had Astrid on this round circle thing with me, I think is that I think I’ve had enough in the sound industry that I can start leading Astrid through it. And that’s all I have to say for now. My throat is dry and I’ve used up enough tape. Another thing I thought of, I think the fact that we started out that an event at Beeker Park or the Grays Point and going in that VIP section and people not minding us just barging in there has to do with the fact that coming into the sound industry in all this stuff, I started not knowing a darned thing and being at events like that, at public places, and wanting to go behind and wanting to just jump over those stupid fence things, and wanting to go talk to the people and they never really minded it. And that, inside the VIP fence is like inside another world. And I think – I don’t know if this circle was about life, or if it was about the other world contained in the sound industry, or whether it’s about both. I don’t know, but that’s that.

“Telepathic” I am with Dan, daytime, in Phoenix; we are looking at houses to buy. I get separated from him in a huge crowd. When Dan awoke, I was writing this dream, right at the end. I’m in the office at a therapist I saw when I was sixteen. He’s having me stare at a portrait of the ocean. I’m being put under hypnosis. I feel my eyes begin to close anyway. I fade out.

But I’m so afraid that I’m yelling for Mary Lou to come. And I got up and I ran down the aisle and Mary Lou ran after me and we ran outside before the rest of the school alarms went off. Now I wonder where in the world all of this is coming from. I think the part about being back at my high school and stuff is the fact that I’ve been going through and putting all of my other dreams into mp3 files and Audio Audition, and, you know, I’ve been hearing my voice evolve sort of, and, you know, I’ve had lots of dreams about my high school and fire drills and stuff, and I think that might just be coming back to me. And, of course, Jim had me practice on his big acoustic one yesterday, so I had that exposure. But I can’t help thinking there’s a little more to do this, and it’s sad. But that’s the gist of it.

70. I go to my dad's house. I'm helping someone with something, so I go to the store for Scotch tape. I drive east on Sunset - there are no stores. I stop at a hotel and fall in the pool. They have a whale or weird Noriland creature living in the pool. But it's friendly. The pool water is very nice so I swim around. I meet some nice people by the pool and make friends with them and give them my card. I try to go back to Dad's house but don't have a car. I try walking up the hill on a trail, but call the house on my cell phone and ask my mom to pick me up. I have to go wait for her on the street.

A bunch of us are enclosed in a high fenced-in area. For some reason, the inmates start writing on each other’s jackets. I don’t care much for this game and resist participating. Actually, I become quite forceful in my avoidance tactics. I wake up.

I dreamt that I acquired angel wings. It was all so normal, as if we are all angels. I was doing everyday things on this Earth, but had huge beautiful muscular wings. The color took most of my attention: they were golden orange streaked, like a rose that has the petal tips stained white or pearl and streaked with golden orange which laced through the huge massive feathers. I remember looking over my shoulder and noting how massive and strong they were.

H.I. again however it was more academic and serious this time. I spent most of the dream in lecture halls learning about dreams and art history. Feelings revolved around different viewpoints; sitting in steep chair arrangements, seeing at diagonal range. There was a flyer passed around showing a new retreat about woven dress patterns in ancient or Celtic civilizations (Roman?). I realized when I asked someone about it that I had already taken it. Another scene where I had previously painted many rooms of a big house we were in. One room I considered repainting but a woman tells me no, it’s a fine red color (but she used a different shade referring to red). Close friends and family were there…at least it felt like it.

I am with Dan at a vacation place: small and gated. One night I get drunk (but more like drugged without intent). I walk down steps, very dark, to a pier-like landing where many people are swimming in very dark, unknown water: it’s a lake but I would never get in: too scary and dark. Everyone is drunk or drugged, mostly women, taking their clothes off and acting slutty with the guys in the water. A car drives by and a guy (in a convertible) is holding up a naked woman into the air-horizontal. They are all having a blast. I’m shocked. I go back to another room; a girl and guy have been staying there. She leaves her turquoise and silver necklace (Navaho squash blossom at end) and some other items. I put them in a glass vase to give to lost and found. Dan is also drunk or drugged in dream and acting funny. We try to find alone time but keep getting interrupted.

(553) Last night I dreamt that Allison was joining the United Nations ________ Center, and I think Allison turned into Cassandra later in this dream, but one of the ladies convinced Mom that I should join too, and they were going to this major convention at this hotel. And somehow I got separated from Mom and that neighbor, and I’m wandering around and I’m wandering around, and there’s this big lobby with lots of stairs and lots of little side rooms and lots of people milling around. Everybody spoke English, but there were a lot of ethnic accents. And they were going to have this big banquet and the end goal of the whole dream was to get to the big banquet and meet up with Mom and Cassandra. So I went to the registration desk and I showed them my ID, and they said, “Who did you come with?” and I said, “Evelyn.” And they looked in their data base and they said, “Oh yes, we have you.” And they gave me four choices of ______ to pay _____: fifty, twenty-five, fifteen or ten. So, of course, I paid the $10 because I didn’t know what it was for. And then I went down this little hall, thinking I might find the banquet hall. And there was this room. By this time I met up with this lady who was helping kind of guide me along, and she was big and fat and a little rough, but she was kind and she sort of grabbed me by the arm and we were like walking around. She told me there was this private party going on in that room and I could hear an Irish jig going on. And then we went up a little couple of stairs and through a back hallway and go to this banquet hall that looked more like a restaurant. It had square wooden tables and we were sitting in wooden chairs. And there were no table cloths or anything on these tables, and Mom and Cassandra were sitting at a regular table, and they put Courtney and me at a little kids’ table across the way. And it turns out that Mom and Cassandra and Courtney and everybody were getting fish fillets and vegetables, and all I got was a little piece of bread and half a cup of Shirley Temple in a Styrofoam cup. And I had only paid $10 to register, I was a junior member. And so then I woke up.
71. dream fragment - I have business cards covered with 3D material. Like the Zillow Website - things are 3D. I offer clients 3D comps. My co-workers doubt me, but I'm sure what I'm doing.

Dream revolved around excavating an Anasazi Indian site. I’ve read “Thunderhead” which has a plot line revolving around this. I am looking at a long row of houses that border the “unknown forest”: virgin, uninhabited land; unexplored. I watch as the second to the last house on the left or East side becomes only a frame, as if it is now being rebuilt. Now the view into the unknown is more visible: I can see more. Then I watch as a long line of generations is shown to me: the first is an English man, famous, named Kay. Then it goes down the line of descendants all from this one house being rebuilt. [The Grail Legend!]

I’m in Fredonia, it’s autumn. Christina and I are pulling out a canoe from behind her sorority house. She’s talking about the Gin Blossom’s concert that she went to this past summer at U.B. Performing Arts Center. We’re in the boat now. We’re passing a bridge, over which runs the main drag through town. She’s writing one of her stories now. It’s about a woman who’s in her fifties and destitute having given up everything to pursue her dreams. They never come true, but Christina beautifully details paradoxically the misery and fulfillment in all her failed attempts. Her character, Alexandra, writes a novel, learns the guitar and plays in a band, solves the Navier-Stokes Equations. None of it ever pans out. As she reads aloud I listen and look around. Autumn consumes us as we drift into the woods. Leaves burn red, orange and yellow on sky blue. We stop to eat, she smuggled some salad, pizza fingers and pineapple out of the cafeteria. We put a blanket out after docking the canoe. She’s asking if I finished chapter one of my book. “Not yet.” It’s so peaceful here. She ends up falling asleep on my chest. I’m looking through the canopy of the sky and I fade away.

(554) Last night I was having a whole string of little sort of vaguely connected scenes that I don’t remember too much about the main point. But what I do remember is that apparently I was coming home from my relative’s home town and I had ordered some kind of book online. And for some reason they shipped a live puppy with the book and I kept thinking, “What in the world am I going to do with this puppy?” It arrived at home while we were in my relative’s home town for another week. And somebody up in my relative’s home town had a green bird that was dying. I think it was Christine. And Cassandra’s Eloise was dead because she was sick or something, and it seemed so real. Everybody over there was so sad, and I was too. And this puppy that was supposed to have come with the book was alive barely, and I was giving her sugary cereal to eat until we get her some other food. Oh, what else? I know there was a lot more to do. Oh, and I think my Archie had just died too, as he really did a week or two ago, and we were wondering what to do with him and stuff. And that’s about it, all about being dream, was this dream.
72. first dream 4 a.m. - I end up hiding out from someone who screams a lot. I close the door and pretend not to hear.

73. second dream 8:30 a.m. - People come over to see me - Srimad, other friends. Mike Sanford. I must get my work done and pay attention to them. I realize that I have an art class at 11 a.m., but it's already 11:20 - I rush around to get paper, charcoal, and the schedule. Can't find the schedule. Someone offers me a ride to school, we get in the car, then I say, "Let me out I have to go to the bathroom," but I run into a building and can't find a restroom. In another part I have an open house. Mike Sanford comes to it and flirts with me. He puts his head in my lap, etc. I worry because he's married but he says not to worry. I have to belong to a trade association he runs. Something like that - like the Realtors, but different. A beautiful house. I show him and other people around.

Scene takes place in a church. It seems that some persons are being accused of being pedophiles. I seem to be included among the accused. The way the community wants to deal with the pedophiles is to make them all sit in a special section of the church. I wake up.

I am in a strange school where there are 4 classrooms on one wing: like a hospital floor. I spend a lot of time in class but can’t remember specifics. We all live there; each morning we use one of two bathrooms to take a shower to get ready. One morning I pick the wrong bathroom and realize I am in a hospital wing: there is a patient on a bed, surgical stuff, oxygen, curtains. I leave and realize I’ve gone down the wrong hall. I make a right down another hall and see two doorways. I go into one: it is one of ours, but another student has also just entered. I apologize and move to the next door. This time the shower is directly to my right: huge shower curtain with blues and whites like flowers. I see it’s down, the sun is rising and the back wall has the most gorgeous view of an Arizona landscape: like Monument Valley with a huge rock spire and one huge mesa. The colors of orange, rust, deep brown ochre, with the sun coming up were absolutely gorgeous! I praised my good luck and jumped in the shower, where I can still see the view. When I get out, a woman emerges from the very corner chair, from the left. I had not seen her. I apologize and realize, this must be a hotel (vacation) room. I ask her why she didn’t say anything and that I never saw her. She says she learned from an Indian medicine man how to do that (look invisible?). I leave.  Next scene a guy has brought a bomb out of a teddy bear to school. I have been given the task to set it off, to get rid of it. We are on a huge coastline with miles of beach: rocks and vegetation between the beach and water. I go out to the beach and notice tons of people playing golf in the sand dunes. There are thousands of different colored tees in the sand. I know it’s not safe so I move out farther. There is a friend with me to help. I go way out. The bomb has a 10 mile range so I can’t point it towards an Island or peninsula. The place almost reminds me of the San Juan Isles in Washington. I have to read 6 directions on the back of the bear. Three are obsolete; I am frustrated. I also have to search for a lighter or match. I get taken away from the teddy a couple of times: one instance a huge wave comes out of nowhere and I know it’s going to land on us. I put my hand on the teddy bomb but know it would be dangerous to get thrown around on the ocean floor with a bomb. I try to get as close to the dune, thinking as long as I am tight against the swell, I will miss the impact. We lay there for a couple of minutes and I take huge deep breaths anticipating. Nothing happens. Now I try again with the bomb but my direction is bad, I see an island with lights (it’s now dusk). I have to change direction again. The dream ends with me never able to get it off. I have visions of it going off and us having to run: anticipating…

I remember going to see my high school English teacher Ms. Droit. I met her on the stairwell. Later, I recall trying to read a poem. It was so smudged; I could barely make it out. I felt angry. I fade out here then I meet up with Joy Riley and Mary Jones. I stayed outside the door for awhile. For some reason this fancy candle they had, perched on a dresser keeps coming to mind. After this, I faded out. Then I’m in class with Dan Krawczyk and Dr. Nancy Gee. I made a comment and Don ridiculed it. There was no reason for it and later he apologized for it. I fade out.

I’m dreaming of colors, colors of flowers in my backyard-reds, yellows, blues, oranges and violet. Then I go into a room. All four walls are different colors; vibrant yellow, orange, red and purple. I feel very excited and can’t wait until the next sequence starts. Then I wake up.

74. Lots of dreams, but in one part I go take a test. The teacher is Kent Adams from Adams [real estate] School. Other students are there, taking the test. I sit down and he sets the time, but I don't have a questions sheet. Everyone laughs at me. I get mad. The teacher can't find a question sheet. Finally he does and I sit down, then I have to go pee - I get mad. He says he can't reset the timer, but go ahead. He says he can't reset the timer.
I’m in the Army and I’m talking about my term in the army. The topic we are talking about is prayer. I am saying, “ when I was in the service prayer was important.” I wake up.

I was at a house with many others. There are rows of shoes in an upper level. It’s night; they are giving away shoes as a party favor of sorts. I am sitting in back of a nice sports car and find two pairs of gorgeous geometrical, classic, tan-colored Ugg boots. One pair had a star or pentagon shape; very different: fit perfectly but I gave them to a friend sitting next to me instead out of kindness. The 2nd pair had more sides: like an octagon but they were a couple sizes too big. I was disappointed that I gave the other pair away.
75. Fragment - getting my mailing list ready.

I find myself in a family home and everyone has just gone to bed. It’s a quiet, calm evening. Everyone knows I had open heart surgery and there is some concern for my well-being. As I am getting into bed, I accidentally knock over the alarm clock. A resounding crash echoes through the house. Within seconds, everyone converges on my room thinking I have collapsed on to the floor. Quickly everyone realizes that I am Okay and expressing words of relief all the return to bed. One lady does not leave but remains to make sure I am okay. Rejoicing that I am safe, we begin hugging. This hugging quickly advances from friendly affection to sexuality. Before any real sexuality takes place, I wake up.

I am traveling, daytime, with many people. We are in the desert, moving down a narrow road in single file through a very tight red rock crevice. There are flash flood warnings and people (guides?) are trying to educate all of us. I am aware of the floods, how to detect and be safe. I am desert-wise. This tight narrow crevice widens at the waist so you have to move sideways with arms above waist to get through. I am told to go to back of the line: at beginning of the descent (zigzag, switchback pattern) and there is a red-headed tall guy that I am told to stand directly in front of. He gets too fresh with me, pulling me close to his body and picking me up. I get annoyed. Another younger Hispanic guy is in front of me; he turns and puts out his hands, asking if I need help from the red-head. I decline, thanking him and move farther up the line, getting away. I am a fast mover through the crevice and am able to get a huge distance between us. I have images of a flash flood but nothing happens.

I am at my oldest sons school. I am going from classroom to classroom trying to get help for him. I’m pleading with the teachers to help. Can’t they see there is a problem with him? His grades have gone from 95 to 70’s and 60’s. No one wants to help me. As I go down the hall further, the doors are locked. I am angry and frustrated.

Only remember an evil angry female face; raging and ugly: white hair, mad look, very evil. Lot’s of anger in dream: the woman was mad, angry and vile. [This dream was the deciding factor to start serious therapy, Jungian]

(555) I’ve been having some really weird dreams lately, but I’ve been really lazy about recording them. I notice that I’m also starting to write in my journal less and less, and I really have no excuse because I don’t have a job yet. I’m just surfing the net all the time, either that or I’m just practicing. Anyway, last night I had kind of a vague dream that there was a man with two big dogs in front of Pete’s house. They were totally black on top and their legs and their stomachs and their faces were tan. And they were growling at me. And one came real close to taking a big bite out of my chin. And the guy said that – I can’t remember what we did to calm him down, but the guy said that there was a trick to it, that I think they didn’t mean any harm, but they were just hungry or something dumb like that. But I think the one actually did bite me after a while, and I was running away, trying to get away from him, and I ran down the alley into our back yard and Eloise showed up. And apparently she needed something too. She needed a new collar or something, and I got the feeling like she was thirsty. And she came up and just laid on my shoulder and kind of licked me, like she does to Cassandra. And I thought that was sweet, and I held her and petted her, and then I sort of woke up. And let’s see, last night I had a dream that I was back at my high school, but that I was staying with Jill and this other girl she knew. I think this other girl was acting kind of like Courtney and Andrea into one person. And Rianne ditched me for a roommate and this other girl took her place, that used to room with Jill, I guess. And so Jill had somebody else that was with her that was rooming with her. Well, we were out in the bus circle at Bancroft, but the inside looked like my high school. And Jill knocked me down on the ground and took off my clothes, so I was running around buck naked. And I was wearing a really pretty orange dress, and Jill just knocked me down and took it off off me. And she put it on. And she was walking around school in this orange dress that was mine, and I was walking around naked. And we were doing into this auditorium, I thought, and I had the feeling like it was okay to go to class naked, but it wasn’t going to be okay to go to this party naked that we were going to go to. And so we’re sitting in this auditorium waiting for this concert or play to begin, and we’re right in the front row. And I’m naked and Jill is in my pretty orange dress, and the other two girls were in sloppy clothes. And then I woke up. That was funny.
76. A house we live in - people want to move in with us.

I was with Dan, Leah, Candy, and others in a small college town; campus setting. The town is much like G. where old brick buildings are lined down a main street and the local church at corner, but more city or “crazy” atmosphere. It was dusky out. Leah and Dan are whispering about something. Leah was asking Dan questions like: “Have you ever slept with her, or have you committed adultery?” Little whispers. He was smiling at the questions but shaking his head no. I got IRATE at this, screaming: “What are you talking about? Why are you asking these personal questions in such a light-hearted way?” Leah says something like “Candy told me you ____ “(can’t remember), and I exploded: “I don’t’ care WHAT Candy says, don’t listen to her, she’s wrong!” I took off running, pushing everyone away, violently. I pushed Leah into something, kicked away Dan. People were trying to find me. I remember jumping atop a huge burgundy van/RV and sliding off the side to get down (gently to not scratch it), and running down a side street. This street was not familiar to any of us; I knew they wouldn’t find me. I was looking down most of the time, intent on getting away and not allowing anyone to touch me. I finally went down a street I remembered. A child came up to me asking for directions or recognizing me. I was not mad or mean, but indifferent to stay or keep myself from being mean. I told her the way and told her I was by myself. Eventually I made it back to my group but it was evident that I was not right: I needed [and was getting in the dream] professional help; I was scarred and under going therapy. I was still emotionally not engaged or okay.

I remember thinking that I awoke suddenly and I was on a raft out in the middle of the lake. I can sense the smells and can hear the birds. I can see the sun peering through the cirrus-touched sky. I’m so tired I can barely move. Time seems to move quickly here in what I perceive as an hour, the sun visibly sinks and I’m under a glass moon. The water is completely calm now and I can feel myself fading out. The moonlight sounds like wind chimes on the water. That’s what I remember last.
Dreamed about being on a beach with waves. It was day time. Surfing or boogey-boarding was involved.

77. A couple of fragments - in a house. I tell someone I was married to Dave Schiller, but they don't believe me. So I say, "ask my mother" and show her the photos. She tries to remember it. I'm sitting with a friend, with no clothes on. I want to get up and put on my clothes, but people will see me naked. A devotee comes by on a scooter and teases me - to stand up. I don't want to. Then I see my bird is loose in the front room, so I jump up to catch him. It's okay I have enough clothes. The bird is all frantic - his feathers ruffled. I catch him to put him back in the cage.
I am in a hospital. As far as I can tell, there is nothing wrong with me. However, for some reason I don’t understand, I am being held there under restraint. I wake up.

Nap dream: dream surrounded two friends of mine here in Fayetteville that were being selfish and uncaring. Another nap dream that my turquoise necklace broke on one strand. The pieces fell to the floor; I was able to save ¾ of the strand and was not too upset. I picked up the pieces I could find.
78. I go to a place where they do medical tests on me. In one, they jam a needle into my shoulder to remove my blood. A friend drove me up there. She wants to go along because it's taking so long.

I am a naval officer aboard an aircraft carrier. On this day, we are celebrating an historic naval holiday and I have been selected to deliver the address to honor the occasion before the assembled crew. I have prepared for this presentation and deliver the address. I wake up.

We are in a foreign city at night; there is chaos all around, like a war is going on. I am with Dan when I see a boy maybe 8 years old that I recognize. He is dressed in Argentinean soldier clothes; pants, shirt, hat. It is the enemy dress, but he is only a very loyal boy. I take him to Dan and plead his case for us to keep him. Dan points out his enemy dress. I say, on bended knee, that he can change; he is a loyal boy and would do anything if asked. He will change for us and as I looked at him, his clothes changed to a dark blue jogging suit (Navy). He had already shed his enemy clothes. Then we are back at home except it is my late Aunt M.’s house. I recognize the front room. It is late at night, the lights are on and we are all in the room together. We have visitors… [I didn’t finish recording dream]

In my dream, I am aware of a crime taking place. It happens on a lake. A person enters a small boat and proceeds to row out into the lake. However, the boat has been tampered with and slowly begins to sink. As my dream continues, I find myself getting into a small boat and as I begin rowing, across the water, I notice the boat is beginning to sink. I wake up.

We (many people) were asked/ordered/volunteered to clean up a huge long narrow strip of famous beach line. It was somewhere in Thailand or Malaysia and the beach was famous for its spirituality or something close to that nature. All I remember was the sand, no horizon or water, just sand with lots of trash we had to pick up. I had one block (of space to clean). Off the beach was a long building that allowed access to the beach; in it were rows of lockers: orange and red colors with white floors. Also bed bunks at the very end. We cleaned our strips and moved into sleeping area to the North of the beach. Can’t remember any more of dream.

Leah, Shelby and I were all together but we were much younger. There was a guy who I wanted to sleep with; we all had different colored sheets on our beds. I followed him to different places, driving but never got to be alone with him. Apparently he did this often, sleeping around, and it was normal. Next scene Leah and I take her car for a drive; as we go down to the parking garage or lower level, we notice the baby waiting for us. She was staying close to her ___? (Bed, sheets, car, can’t remember) and a guy found her and put her atop the car. She could talk, but was 3 or four years old. We got in and drove. We wanted to go to the beach house but Leah said N. (our Aunt) had been using it; she caught her there earlier in her glider (rocking chair) showing the house to people. Leah told me to get my own glider and not use hers. Another part of the dream: we all had colored sheets and I imagined a beautiful shade of blue that I could slip under and just BE.

(556) Last night I had a vague yet stupid dream. I dreamt that I was in some kind of grassy, open space. I felt like it was near my school, but I kind of felt like it was in my old apartment complex from Weir (?) Park and I was sitting there on a picnic blanket with a boyfriend that I had. I’m not sure who it was. It could have been Chad or Gerald, or it could have been a younger version of Jim. And he was talking about Andre Vicelli and how he had apparently started a charity and he was helping manage Andre Vicelli’s charity. And he was putting all kind of money in it, all kinds of jobs and donations and stuff. And we started talking about getting a drink of water, and Jill comes by and she’s talking to us a little bit about different things about school, and then this boy says, “I’m going to go in and get some water. I’m going to get some ice from the ice box in your refrigerator, okay?” And I say, “Okay, that’s fine,” and Jill goes, “Oh no, I took a lot of time to fill up that ice tray, and I just don’t feel it’s right for somebody else to go in and get my ice.” And they kind of argued a little about it, and in the end it turned out that he was going to take some of the Andre Vicelli money to go buy his own ice. And then I woke up.

I am in a huge multi-storied building; it is a school but also a home. I am looking for a cup of coffee; there are people, peers, everywhere. I am pissy: not happy. I state “I know I’m pregnant, but if I don’t have coffee it could be worse for the baby”. I go into a large room to the right of a huge concrete staircase and I see 2 bats lying on the floor: they feel from the ceiling. I put gloves on and ask for help. One is black with white markings, very fluffy and sweet: large mouth. The other was more aggressive. I picked this one up in my right hand: he fought some and clung on with his tiny fingers. The other I picked up with a gloved hand (left) and it attached to the back of my land [rehabbed a bat that would do just this]. This left one dropped: a friend came to pick him up and she did without gloves. There was no threat of biting from this one, very passive and sweet demeanor but I warned her and she complied. There had been two other downed bats somewhere else that someone was caring for. The aggressive bat had latched onto my hand and I pulled him off: this drew a ton of blood and the bat was not happy. I put on a glove and held him again. Rest of dream was trying to find homes for the bats. Looking for rehabbers or trying to decide if I wanted to keep them.  One scene I am in a building, huge, maybe the same one as before with a concrete wide staircase that my mom had put blankets and towels on each step. The covers were all blue in color, but tons of animal hair, dust, and dirt had collected there. I picked up all the towels and Mikes collected them to put and shake outside. I was frustrated going up and down: all the dirt, etc. and I still had my bats.

79. I'm at the Watseka temple, but it's all different. Kyle is there and other people I have to work with. It's a project to clean out the old stuff - throw out junk from the corners. Stuff I thought about sorting out - I just throw it away. I see Kyle get in my car and drive it across the street and get mad. I think he's going off with someone else and get jealous. Some of the old matrons are there - I must check in with them or get their help to do my work.

I am as tiny as a water droplet I recall. First, I’m brushed along the currents of Lake Superior. I can see tall cliffs. I feel the cold deep, dark oligotrophic cold. In Michigan, I pass the dunes and am sucked into space by a large wave. The wave begins (similar to my recurring dream) by spinning me in an orbital. But I’m smaller, I’m a droplet, and I’m being shot into space: the troposphere, the Stratosphere, the Ionosphere. I feel the cold, the heat, and then the cold. I see a whiting event over lake Michigan. I feel a sense of isolation, a drop of earth in a sea of universe traveling along the ecliptic. Past Centaurs and Virgo I can barely make out our sun, then I evaporate as I am thrown into Antares (a star about as big I think). I feel disassociated, my consciousness at different points in time and space. Then I wake.
80. Giving listing presentations, sending out notes.

There is a man in my dreams named Mr. Bielane. He is a powerful man. Most people are afraid of him but many go to him for favors. I desperately need a favor but I’m reluctant to visit him. Finally, I go and find him to be a gentle giant with a kind heart. We talk about his reputation and life in general. I realize he is not the person I thought he was and I did not ask him for the favor. Instead, I looked inside my heart to the higher power for advice.
Dreamed about my Grandmother’s house and all her possessions: who was getting what, all the stress and anger involved with my mom and her brother. Lots of anxiety.

There are 3 or four dogs but in the dream we called them snakes. They were tan and brown, very furry and soft. I don’t remember tails. I kept warning a friend of mine to stay clear of them because they will probably strike and bite. I felt that they were being sly, trying to lure us and then wrap around our legs to strike. The snake/dog would rub up against our legs and go through and around; acting very friendly. They never struck but I was very leery throughout dream.

81. In a play with some friends. It starts with a several page monologue and the woman who does it wants to run through it at every rehearsal, even though she knows it by heart. I want to ship it and just do the dialogue. I get mad and walk out - it burns everyone out because then we can't rehearse.

I am with Mandy and another family, like my sister’s and all her kids; lots of kids in the dream, everywhere. We are in an outdoor festival type place where masses of people are everywhere. It is night time. There is a scene where I am outside a multi-movie plex and there is a kid’s movie like a ballet with classical music but for kids. I get asked to go by another woman and I take Mandy in with me: we go through a back door, it is packed with people. I am looking for Leah and our friends/family. We are also with two other men: one is obese and named Ernie, his ear falls off twice in dream and I hand it to him when it happens (like clay). And another tall man that I end up interested in, in the end. Ernie is jolly, a nice guy. Another scene, we are in a street, lots of people around, cars parked. We have a pick-up truck. Suddenly many helicopters hover over the street and drop people onto the street. They are not good (this is blurry part). Another scene directly after this one: there is our truck, filled with babies wrapped in blankets. We are making runs to get the babies and bring them back to a safer place. I get one baby and look at the others, knowing I can only handle (literally) one and I would drop or not be able to fully grasp another if I tried. So I run back, drop off the baby and come back. When I get there, a camera crew if filming a red haired Irish actor; he is acting like he is having sex inside the truck with one of the babies! It is all for fun but I am appalled. I scream and yell, get him out of there. There are 5 or six year old boys sitting against the tail-gate giggling. They know it’s for fun (but too young to know better). We get more babies out of the truck to safety. The other guy holds my hand and I realize I am interested in him, I feel at peace and happy. There are still people everywhere and I realize Mandy is with Leah’s kids at the house left alone. We race to the house and realize they are just fine; all playing nicely together.

I’m on a lawn chair on Chilton Avenue. My grandmother, Norma, and I are drinking milk shakes while watching a sunset. She’s reading me one of her poems, “Little Miss Nobody.” As she reads, I shift time and space to the church where I’m eulogizing her. I can see the faces of my extended family- she’s reading again “Grandma, Grandma…” I look over at her chair; she’s not there. I’m crying…The sun burns out over the gorge….I wake up.

I am with six or seven guys. We have a friend who has a cottage on top of the hill and we decide to climb the hill and drop in on him. There are a few other houses on this hill. We begin the climb. Halfway up, I get separated from the group. I approach a house but become apprehensive and decide to retrace my steps. I wake up.

Dreams of sagas or movies/epics. One scene: I am living with others in a stone mansion, high up somewhere; very wealthy, family situation. There is an Olympic game going on and a friend is competing. Her husband and I are also helping in the game which is moving a huge concrete slab “Tee” down a hill and to another spot. I personally am able to get it started moving. She and all of us move it to the spot. The last few meters are done by her spouse who picks it up and throws/heaves it to the spot (which I hope that no-one sees because it would disqualify her). I find out that she’s won a silver medal; she is in shock. We all can’t believe it. Then I am at a beach town. A friend of mine owns a vintage VW van painted blue and white with chrome: very antique and beautiful. At one point I take it out for a drive, along with a man whom I think is related to the friend/owner of the van. We end up at this beach place; lots of sand and I can’t get us out. I drive down a one-way street in this maze of parking lots and end up in a small beach front cul-de-sac that I had not known existed. The man is falling asleep, the van keeps tipping over (but it’s easy to right up) and I finally stop because each time I try to drive straight back up this small incline, the way I came, I get bogged down in sand. I wake the guy and give up saying “Bob/Don can you please drive? I don’t want to drive”. I hated saying it, like out of pure exhaustion and defeat. He says to just leave it, and starts waking back. I refuse knowing my friend would be mad. He is able to drive it straight back up. The van’s doors opened weird: they had panels that flapped back first in order to get to the true door: like a dually (?) truck that has passenger doors that open from right to left instead of usual manner. We get the van back in the end. Another scene in dream: I am in the woods with Dan and Mandy; we are walking a path and see a wolf. The wolf does not seem aggressive yet, but timid. Across the path I see a large round outcropping of something like a hole piled high and see a wolf emerge with 3 small cubs. Now they begin to chase Mandy; she had gone straight for the cubs upon seeing them and I shout “NO!” Dan follows down further into the path to get her; I get chased back the way we came and wait for them to reappear. Dream ends.

82. At Watseka, but not the temple, I fix dinner for a friend but she never comes home to eat. Later she comes home and I tell her there's some dinner. Later, time to go home from school, I get on a bus - it is actually a plane and flies. It does not go to Mulholland and Woodcliff though. The driver tells me which bus to take next time.

I’m in a classroom setting with desks, etc. lined up. I am in the back row. The teacher is the Human Resource Manager from my old job (Mindy). She is handing out paychecks. I get six envelopes: one paycheck and the others filled with cash from my retirement account (403B). I leave my desk and go to the teacher’s desk and tell Mindy I wanted to rollover my account and did not want to cash it in. She gives me the numbers of the bank and I call and try to get some answers. Then, I go to the bank and there are about five tellers and two cats at the teller station. I ask for the manager. She meets with me and I explain that I wanted to roll this money over not cash it in. Furthermore, why did she put cash in such an excessive amount and not in a check? I’m worried that I’m going to take a twenty percent hit from it. I assured her I completed the proper paperwork. She left and I walked by and petted one of the cats. The teller who took care of the transaction came back from lunch. She was dressed like a hooker. The manager took care of all of my 403B, rolled it over to an IRA. She proceeded to terminate the teller.
I am in a classroom with a group of religious education children. There are about twelve students in the group. The student seems to be a very vocal group which is getting on my nerves. I wake up.
83. something about being at a school, driving a car.
This is a pretty good size group and for such a sensitive issue (partial birth abortion). I didn’t notice the discussion getting out of hand or contentious. I wake up.

I am in a car with mom, Leah, and a small baby. We escaped somewhere; ended up at a hotel: very nice but extremely cramped, as if we drove right into the room due to traffic jams. I was more passive observer along for the ride. I took care of the baby in dream. We were leaving someone; Leah and mom threatened to never return. We learned Shelby left her husband as well. Dan was in dream but was another roommate; not husband. Leah wrote symbols on his back in pink frosting-like color. I helped him lift his shirt while he swiveled around to find the symbol, write it down and translate. After each symbol was written, he’d wipe it off. Leah was more of a friend than sister in dream; same as mom. We were making this trip together; sticking together. Then I am in a huge field during daytime, very green lush grass. I watch as strange planes fly over in intervals. At one point this helicopter-like plane (half plane with blades like a Miyazaki film “Hawl’s Moving Castle” or “Castle in the Sky”) dump piles of brown stuff in the field. There are puzzles that can be turned over, like a two sided puzzle that I have to accomplish in dream. Someone gets dumped by the brown stuff and we run out to help her. Dan is in dream as well.
This dream was between myself and another person. We were writing poetry. I thought we were doing a rather good job. The poetry of my partner was quite picturesque and colorful. I wake up.

I wanted to go climbing at local gym. I get there and the guy asks if I have my gear. I can’t find anything; I look for my punch card so I won’t have to pay but can’t find that either. There are others with me, and I know I’ll have to pay for them all. He is doing my paperwork and getting rental gear when I notice my climbing shoes in bottom of huge duffle bad. I start finding everything and am relieved, thinking: I had it all along-thank goodness!

(557) I had a lot of catching up to do, and I cannot believe how much I just whizzed through this tape. I must be the master at wasting it. Well, anyway, last night I had a dream that I was watching Celine Dion on DVD for some reason again. I hadn’t dreamt about Celine for a long time, and then she showed up again last night. I can’t remember what she was singing, but I know she was singing something that I didn’t know. I had the feeling like she might have sung two or three songs that I almost knew and then some that I just didn’t. And she was in a red outfit, but it was more conservative than the one she wears for the Las Vegas show. And I don’t remember what the other outfit was; I think the other one was all black. And it was supposed to be the Las Vegas show, I think, but there was this grayish background, and I think that was just sort of a transient dream that just sort of happened. Oh, and earlier this week I had a long epic dream with many dumb, little scenes in it, and I don’t remember any of them now, of course. But one of the scenes I do remember was that Mom and I were at the South Bend Park, the place where you go before you come to the beach. And she was riding her bike and I was walking, and I had the feeling like we were coming home from the pier, because we had just been there. And I was ahead of her, and she was riding her bike trying to catch up to me. And I decided I was going to walk back to her on the bike, I mean walk back to her and her bike, and so that I could walk alongside her and talk and stuff like that. So I’m going back to her and all of a sudden a couple of sprinklers turn on and they’re spraying right at the sidewalk like the ones at my tech school used to do. And I decided, “Whoops – I don’t think I could go that way.” And I was really afraid of these sprinklers in my dream. And so I turned around and kept going my own way, and I was going along my own way and going along and saying, “Okay, she’s just going to have to go through the sprinklers and get wet.” And so I’m a ways down the road, and then all of a sudden all the sprinklers turn on and they’re all spraying right at the sidewalk and they’re in the grass too. There’s more in the grass spraying all over the grass. So it’s sprinkle city as far as I can see, and this park as far as I can see, which probably isn’t that far. But anyway, I’m standing there surrounded by sprinklers, getting soaking wet, and yelling for help, except I can’t really yell. You know how it is in a dream. And then I find a little place where there’s an intersection of a sidewalk where I can stand right in the middle of the intersection and not get too wet, but I’m still surrounded by all these sprinklers and I’m scared to death for whatever reason it is. And eventually Mom comes on the bike and her big back basket is as big as her front basket, and she puts me in her back basket and rides off, and I’m not getting wet any more once I’m on the bike, and I’m not even really afraid of the sprinklers any more. And then I faded into some other stupid thing. I thought this was just something dumb that occurred in my mind, but when I told Mom about it, she said that the sprinklers represent the circumstances of my life right now, I think, because I feel like I’m being surrounded and sort of led astray to some degree by going back to school, and I’m being kind of wrestled down and – what should I say? – closed in and trapped by all of that stuff. And I kind of tend to agree, I think. And, you know, she always tries to rescue me from bad emotional situations. So I guess that’s what that is.

I’m in a car with my parents, mother-in-law, husband, and Uncle Alan. There are taking me to Rochester because I have a class scheduled. They are afraid I will get lost. We go in circles until we find the hotel. It is a swanky place, very expensive. I have reservations for Thursday night. The class starts on Thursday morning. They all want me to stay the night. I tell them I don’t have my suitcase. My father says I brought it from the car. I said, “no dad, that’s my briefcase with my laptop. I have no clothes.” We go back to the car which is parked in an alley. They all look in the car. We go back into the hotel and my mother says, “just wear the clothes you have on.” I said, “not for two days!” We argue and I am really getting pissed off. I said I’m going home. My mother goes to the desk to get me a room. The price is two hundred fifty nine dollars per night. I said, “Mom, I’m not putting it on my regular expense account. No way!” She pulls out her credit card and tries to pay for it. Now I’m really mad. I just want to go home. I pack my things and take off first thing in the morning. No one will listen to me. We all head back to the alley and I wake up.

I am in a house; feeling very depressed, when I hear a knock on the door. I realize Dan has bought me flowers and balloons because I had not been feeling well; to cheer me up. I was very happy and relieved.

I’m arguing with Hannah and Alec over an extension of a difficult puzzle. We’re locked in a room at an old Japanese feudal castle. There’s a monitor in the room. A voice cracks over an intercom. It’s the voice of my elementary school principle. We have to solve a dozen problems if we ever want to leave the room. The room is bare white with one window and a couch. Several obis are strewn across it, the room has no door. Hannah and I walk to the window. It’s more than a thousand feet to the ground. She’s crying. Two right circular cones and one right cylinder mutually inter-penetrate. What is the maximum number of completely bound volumes that can be formed? We all agree that the answer is eleven. I notice they are all wearing black. The voice (Sr. Caroll chimes in). Imagine these three shapes and let them mutually interpenetrate with two icosahedra and chiliagan. I can feel my own seat. This is insane. We figure the angles of the cones need to be adjusted to sixty degrees from forty-five to coincide with the triangular forces at the icosobrdra. We can get one hundred eighty volumes. The chiliegan is impossible to figure out. It has a thousand sides. Finally, I think I have the answer, twenty two thousand, eight hundred sixty. After what I perceive to e three hours, I can’t get them to see my logic. Sister Caroll claims I’m wrong. I wake up realizing that Sister Caroll wouldn’t have known what a right circular cone is let alone a chiliagon.

84. At a college - two colleges next door to each other. In the auditorium of the girls' college they do some ceremonies, then send us to the auditorium next door for the boys' ceremonies. They want us to not do anything - let them do the things. They have special chants, etc. In another part, putting things in the MLS - the subscription is $$ very expensive.

A large number of people are in a very large room. I become aware of many high level government officials. We had been asked to dress appropriately. For some reason, I had locked the doors to the hall so when the attendees began to arrive, I had to rush to unlock the doors.

I dreamed about the CIA. I am with friends outside a huge shopping mall area. There is a building farther East that has an obscure office inside. We go inside and are introduced to people working for the CIA. I know a man working there and he gives me a job (as if I was recruited). I then help 3 other women who are with us, get jobs there. We are all excited. I am astonished by the open but secret nature of the building and that they hired ME! I think to myself, I can’t wait to tell D. Next scene: we are now in a different building and I am shown to my work area. There are groups of people around who form small projects, for example: a woman gathered others to start an aerobics lesson. I am hoping to join these women, who are all dressed to the nines in their glam workout clothes. There are also puzzles to do around our desks to stimulate IQ or brain activity. I have work to do, but the environment is such that you can choose what you want and are not fixed to a single task. I do some wandering and it feels like the place is a moving ship. I talk to other fellow employees. I spend a lot of time trying to get in with an exercise group and once I find the women, I am a little intimidated and think I have nothing to wear. I also keep thinking I need to do my real work instead of puzzles and group projects. There is a real need to accomplish something in the dream. My work space is closed off, in the middle of a thoroughfare but has doors on either side that stay shut; to get somewhere people have to come in and out of my space. This does not happen often, just more of a feeling of un-feng shui: blockage of energy.

I’m standing outside a brightly lit apartment complex, a great red brick building. The environment looks so familiar, like the building across the street from my childhood home. The second story, a room rather in the second story, is alive with voices. I sift through the laughter and general din, and find that I recognize them all. Norma, my paternal grandmother, Rick Reagan (my dead childhood friend), Liette Labelle (a friend from a long time ago) Rob Buchholtz, and Christina Gruber. Norma says something about going to look at the water. I hear Liette rattle off something in French (Je sues fatigue) or “I’m tired”. I look around and realize my surrounding; the brick building has given way to my maternal grandparent’s old home on Lake Ontario. Making sure not to be seen, I peer into the picture window. My grandmother is talking to Rich, sitting in the old burgundy colored rocker. Rich is no older than fifteen---the year he died. His voice shouldn’t be so clear, I think. Liette is playing cars wit Marc, Christina and my Uncle Jim. I turn; the moonlight is so pure, so synthetic. It rings in my ears. There is something so pristine about this room and the people therein. I don’t wish to disturb them. The rug is still orange. I can barely make out the north west corner of the room, but there, near the window, sits my grandfather’s old hourglass. The tiny sands trickle to its bottom. I don’t want to leave, I think. I wake up.
85. Walking around, taking listings in neighborhoods.

I am at my old house in my family room. I am standing in the doorway from the dining room to the family room. There are two steps down, going into the family room. Sitting in the family room are about five people (I don’t remember who they were) and the CRO of the previous company I worked for. I ask him what he is doing in my house. He just grins and says nothing. I am furious. I try to convince the other people in the room what a snake he is and he is not welcome in my house. It is now Christmas time and it’s storming outside. The people and CRO are still in my family room. The doorbell rings, I answer it and it’s the CEO of the company I left. He barges through the door and I say Merry Christmas. No response from the jerk. He sits down with the others. I am in a rage because he did not even acknowledge me. I confront him and still no response. I continue to make my point with the people in the room with no effect. Again, I confront him and still no response. I send them all out in the winter storm and shut the door behind them.

I am with my mom and stepfather. We are at our old house in F. It’s late at night and very windy. My step-dad gives me a strange looking candle, it’s not regular wax but a fatty-almost lard or greasy substance with a wick. He gives me a strange lighter with a tongue like stick that heats up when lit. I had a hard time lighting the candle; it would light and then go out. I tried many times to light it. The house was huge and dark, we all had candles.

The dream above morphs: my stepbrother Stan is there and the house is full of people. There is a carnival like feel. There are huge tables and hallways into different rooms where some are lit up like cosmetic areas in a rich department store. There is a long hall dedicated to Chanel with black and white décor and a huge long table with neutral colors of beautiful makeup and glosses. There is one gloss with bronze sparkles that I reach out to apply on my own lips. I also see an area for Estee Lauder or another cosmetic. I wander through tons of people. I see Stan and we order a huge pizza that has to be made at a large stand. Many others are also waiting for food. I wander off; talk to different people while waiting. There are people talking to me about my dreamwork and I try to explain. Everyone seems to be around 30yrs old, glamorous, rich, and young stylish types. All have beautiful bodies and expensive clothes. I go back to get my pizza but it was ruined: it had been flipped over and fell on the floor. They said they had to make a new one. I was mad and hungry.

I’m at a playhouse (Shaw Festival) by Lake Ontario in Canada. I’m watching Oscar Wilde’s “Lady Windermere’s Fan” Rows of well-dressed couples clap at appropriate places in the play. There are a number of crystalline chandeliers on stage. I find myself fixating upon them now and again. Lord Darlington is now giving his soliloquy. Although he is in the midst of several other characters, he is addressing the audience professing his love for Lady Windermere. “All of us do time in the darkness, dreamers learn to steer by the stars, No hero in your tragedy, no daring in your escape, no salutes to your surrender, nothing noble in your fate.” He begins with this initial bit of original text and then grades into Rush’s “The Pass” from their 1989 Presto album. I listen to Darlington as he finishes the song. The audience is silent. It’s 1996 and I’m crying. I’m nineteen years old. I fade out.

86. Really long, vivid dreams. (Maybe has something to do with my listing presentation I practiced last night.) Involved labeling things in a house.
