Some things are dangerous - a hybrid ape/human in a tank. He's very dangerous like an ape. I give him a deck of cards and warn the owner. I ride a bicycle home, and a car. I must drive a car straight up a driveway. Like driving up a wall.

My dream start out at my high school. I am going down the hall and everyone has their sweatshirts with the logo on, ready to go out and cheer the team on. I forgot mine and run back to my locker to get my shirt. By the time I get back, everyone is gone. Then my dream goes to my 30th class reunion. We are all at the event. It’s crowded and everyone shows up. I make sure everyone gets tier stuff and are okay. Kevin and I go to our table. Someone took our spot. I tell them it’s okay. We find another spot. I look around and there is limited seating. My old neighbor, Eileen who didn’t graduate with me, is at a table with her son (who is really twenty one now, but about seven in my dream), a mentally retarded girl who hugged me, and her husband (who passed away last year). We say hello, hug and Kevin and I go to the bar. I’m trying to decide what to drink. I order a whiskey. Behind there are a bunch of guy classmates who cheer and are astonished that I order a whiskey (cause I was quiet in school and a goody two-shoes). Kevin tells them they are so wrong!
87. vague now - I go visit a family that needs to move.

I am at some sort of mansion. My old boss (from my teen years) is in the dream. I am looking for something. I don’t remember what it is but I am searching for something in closets, drawers, and cupboards, anywhere! Mike, my old boss is there. We are wearing togas. He keeps saying I will never find it. I say “Yes I will, I just need time.” He sits back and watches me search. I am getting frustrated with him and being unsuccessful in my search. I never find what I’m looking for. As I open a closet door, I wake up.
I am with a group of students. We are on a winding country road and are supposed to take a test. Each of us find a comfortable spot on the side of the road and we take our test. I wake up.

I am living with two other girls; both are old friends from 6th and 7th grade in Tucson (one Maureen and another I cannot remember name). We live in a dorm room (upstairs apartment) and there is a whole campus community around us with tons of people. The two roommates are closer as friends; I am a little left out of the loop. I find out that they have been going out naked with a bunch of people. One of my old friends, Maya, was in one of the groups. All the women in this “naked” group I knew as friends. The boys/guys would pick them up at night; tons of milling people everywhere. They would make a huge ruckus coming out of the house nude and going down the street together. I did not join, nor did I judge or think them wrong. In fact I thought they were daring, having fun, the latest fad. Being naked didn’t carry the illegal/risky/negative stigma at all. It was different, risky yes, something I wouldn’t do or perhaps wasn’t asked to do. This goes on; lost of running around and me going upstairs and downstairs a lot: crazy party-like atmosphere. Then the scene changes: Dan comes to live with us and it doesn’t work out. The girls feel cramped. He moved out and now it’s time for all of us to move out: end of term/season or something ending. I look everywhere for my big suitcase and can’t find it. One girl has already packed and left. Maureen is packing with me. There are a million white pull-out drawers and cabinets, closets, everywhere with stuff in all of them. I look in my closet and realize all the crammed heavy jackets and sweaters are not mine. I think I must have cleaned all the winter clothes out, took some home earlier and forgot. Maureen leaves but I find in a skinny, long drawer that she has left her toiletries/makeup bags, toothbrush, etc. (all in a light blue case/s). I wonder if she’ll return for them. I start looking for my suitcase again and find it in a huge white pull-out drawer. I open it to start packing and realize most of my clothes are gone. I had anticipated going up and down stairs with loads of clothes and was wrong. In my bathroom I start looking for my toiletries and find tons of old holiday linens (Christmas) and white napkins: all sorts of paraphernalia that has accumulated at this “camp” over the years. The drawers remind me of my grandmother’s house, the stuff is not mine and I’m supposed to leave it. Dan is still waiting for me but now it seems that I am staying longer. I look for a toothbrush, I can’t find mine. This is when I notice my friend has left her stuff. There are new tubes of toothpaste: 3 or so stacked in a cabinet but the brushes I find are old and gross. I think to myself, I could have saved a lot of money by using the paste already here. In the bathroom there is a small radio which, to my surprise, is on and playing a song. There is a TV on downstairs, it’s loud; I turn up the little radio. I realize as Maureen and other roomies are packing that they had orgies in their room together with all the other naked women and their dates. Maureen says something like: “we all piled into the bath tub”…she is talking in confidence; I overhear. I am shocked at being so out of the loop; they didn’t tell me. I realize: I am past that and I would not have participated; I would have disapproved.

88. Living in an apartment complex of little places. We had a few wild birds - doves - They are unhappy living inside the apartment - flying into things. I decide to release the birds - not take them to Desconso Gardens like the last time - just let them go right there. I catch the first bird and let it go out the front door. It flies to a tree and then flies away. The other bird is in the "tent," a caravan on the property. When I go in to get the bird, I find two little girls fighting. I make them stop and tell me where the bird is. It's in a cage in a compartment in the floor. I take it to the porch and open the cage. It flies out. Later, Walt and Julia are going back to the n.e. for the summer. I will miss them. I say bye. Then we eat flood from a buffet with a bunch of other people. My roommate and I got the idea that I could sublet their place while they're gone. (May 5, 2006 - The dream I had last night came true. I released the birds and that was like meeting these people today. Also, like letting go of my fear that getting listings would be impossible.)
I am in the army, state side. We have been assigned to meet as a group to discuss some major army issues. I wake up.
Dreamed of people made of lead or another metal/gemstone: colors were all the same, either of red or dark brown.

I remember swimming somewhere ensconced by fog. There are no stars in the night sky. I can’t get my bearings. I can feel the aching in my chest from all the exertion. Wherever I swim, everything looks the same. I just tread water. I can smell the briny saltiness and the carrion. I’m so tired, but I can see a faint yellow and blue in the horizon; like a hallucination, the sun speeds into what must be the eastern sky. The coast must be a mile away. The tall cliffs remind me of an aerial photograph of Nova Scotia. I’m too exhausted to move. I float on my back. Early morning sun glistens on the water. I’m falling asleep.

Leah and I were doing dangerous follow-up type missions for our husbands: basically we were in serious danger, doing scary things (dangerous car chases, etc.). After we were done, an FBI agent (in some books I’ve been reading) gave us each 3 or four wads of money. We each felt we should be paid generously for our work and the risks involved. It took me a long time to unroll the money and try to count: lots of ones mixed with 20’s and 10’s. The FBI agent was happy with our work but I still felt underpaid. Next scene Leah and I are sitting outside a mall like area thinking about getting coffee. All of the sudden a tall man walks directly up to me and hands me a huge stuffed animal: a white teddy bear. Then he walks in the coffee shop directly in front of us; it’s night/dusk and I tell Leah: “I think that was Rusty” and look at her. She says: “are you sure, you really think so?” and I say yes. I was sitting comfortably on a bench, leaning forward. I ask her “should I go and say Hi or thank you?” and then I decide to go. I walk in; it is Rusty (old boyfriend from end of senior year, beginning of college). He’s extremely tall and big. I have to crane my neck to see him. I say “Hi! Thank you. What are you doing here?” We start talking. He says “maybe we can go out? I live in Bell too; on Pearl Street.” I tell him I’m married and at that point Dan shows up right next to us. Dan says: “And I’m her husband” and smiles right at him in a smart-ass way. Rusty apologizes and leaves. Next scene, I’ve been looking for everyone having gotten separated. All the stores are closing; its’ almost 2 am. I finally find Leah and mom sitting on a kiosk outside a department store. My mom had bought panties from The Gap and other clothes. I get frustrated because I need new panties and comfortable clothes (due to pregnancy). I say “I wish I could have gone to The Gap, too!” I notice they are size 8 and not for me (I’m 6).
89. I move back to L.A. near Kyle. We talk on the phone a lot but he won't see me. He's afraid we'll fight. I divide Phoenix up into districts.

I am dying. I have Hodgkin’s Lymphoma. I came home from the MD’s and tell Kevin the news. He starts yelling and screaming at me saying, “you always wait until you are so sick you can’t stand before you’ll go to the doctors!” You had the lump in neck, the night sweats for a long time. What is wrong with you? You had a scare ten years ago with your thyroid.” He just yells and yells. I said to him, “I can’t believe you’re yelling at me!” I ask him if that’s the way to treat me since I don’t have much time. I try to talk to him and tell him it’s okay. He says it’s not okay. I tell him I’m ready to go and he says he’s not ready to let me go. He continues to yell and yell. I am calm and almost distant.

I am walking by myself around the community. As I pass one house, I notice a little girl about six or seven, sitting on the bottom step of the front porch. She asks me if I want to sit with her. As I sat down next to her we started talking about angels. She told me she missed her mom. At this time, a police car pulled up. The police came toward me and I stood up. At this time I noticed the little girl was not with me anymore. I figured she had gone into the house. As the police questioned me a lady came out of the house. I told the police how I had been talking to a little girl who I assume was this lady’s child. The lady says that her only daughter died a year ago.

I think I had a past-life dream: woke up with the strange feeling but could be wrong. I am in a huge cave and discovering ruins of some sort, with a group of students outside in the snow (as a young child) and asking teachers why we can’t go to the library; then finding the dark cave. Also remember driving with Dan after the cave finding and trying to take him back to the scene but he didn’t take advice and would go down wrong path; because we are so respectful of each other, I didn’t nag but we ended up back tracking to my directions.

I am walking outside. Dogs are barking. They are getting closer. One of the dogs comes after me. I take off one of my shoes and tried to keep the dog at bay by swinging my shoe at the animal. I wake up.

I am in a huge high-rise that housed a college/museum and classy mall/department store. I had taken a class or been taking a class every day. After the class we (Leah and I with others) would go to a house giveaway or raffle that occurred every night around a stadium-like structure at the top of the high-rise. One day the school/museum closed the wings for a reconstruction. There was confusion: where is my class, what is my class…? Then I realize the school’s closed, I can’t go into the school section, so I decide to go to the house raffle. This time there are tons of people, huge seating area that is much more elaborate due to all the students being closed from classes. I get lost looking for a guy who I think is Dan but in dream he’s someone I’m not married to but seeking affection from nonetheless. We never win a house.

I am on a huge beach; can’t remember specifics, tons of people walking. I end up walking along a boardwalk, the tide’s up, the water’s to the concrete edge. You can’t walk on the sand: it’s under water. Suddenly a wave comes up along the walk and I fall in, carrying Mandy. We keep our heads above water until the huge waves rise up over our heads (no breakers, only swells); they get larger and longer. I cover Mandy’s mouth until the wave passes and we crest. The last wave is too large, she can’t hold her breath and bites my hand to let go. I can’t rise to the surface; the dream ends. Also in the water are huge strangely shaped turtles, like Galapagos, with mushroom like shells: white, gray and unnatural. I point them out to Mandy just before we fall into the water.

I’m looking through Alicia’s door on Queen Street. Her hair is braided and she’s wishing her mom goodbye. She’s twelve years old and I’m twenty-one. She’s outside with me as I teach her how to work out a problem in electrical engineering. The scene changes and she’s nineteen. I see her on stage at a strip bar. Her mother died, and that was it I think. Somewhere, a woman screams profanity and a fight breaks out. I’m staring at a little girl who is destroying her life. I order another drink. Goodbye Alicia, goodbye forever. Fade out.
90. Vague now, but I remember showing listings to people..
Dreamed about my step-brother Jason; something about needing help and having a huge, black, futuristic, muscle truck.
91. Showing homes to prospects, including Lorrie.

I am in a house with other friends. It is pouring rain outside. I have a task but can’t remember. There’s a circular motion, like chasing or tag that is repeated over and over again, up and back down staircases: like a ritual needing performed and all inside a house. One of these friends is trying to find ways to make money; like selling cosmetics on the side but it’s not a cheap line, it’s classy like Chanel or Origins or Calvin Kline. She is pressuring me to start it, put the risk first: I am hesitant knowing it could fall apart easily. It all depends on motivation: I am not motivated to sell cosmetics for money. The rain becomes a hazard. There are animals in houses as well.

92. More real estate dreams - showing houses, listings, people. I have some things to take along or return. I have a few ceramic items I will keep because the clay cracked - a large glass face, or something. We must go on busses.

I am at my grandmother’s house. I’m downstairs waiting. I go up stairs to one of the bedrooms. In the bedroom is a bed which looks like a cradle- a very large one. Inside the cradles, is an elderly woman from my old job. She is very frail in her deathbed. In the bed is her daughter who is cradling her mother. I go over and check out Dorothy. She is still breathing. I tell the doctor it won’t be long till the end is here. She tells me to keep checking on them. I go downstairs and check on them again. She is still breathing. I tell the doctor not to be afraid. She will be gone from here in body but not in spirit. I lean over Dorothy and whisper in her ear to not be afraid. Then I woke up.

I am making a presentation to a group of army personnel. Since this presentation was developed and written by someone else, I had never seen it before. Since this is the first time I am seeing the script, I am not familiar with the material. Once I have finished the group and I decide to review the script and come up with some themes to vote on at a later meeting.

I am at a beach house [am at one now, at my sister-in-law’s wedding], there are tons of people going in and out. It is early morning, before sunrise; I am up and have chores to run. I meet the couple who got in late (in reality, we were waiting for them the night before). One is a young “Goth” girl: dressed in all black, with a pierced nose and short black hair; very skinny. She came up to me, very sexy like but not sexy to me; way too affectionate in a sneaky, promiscuous way. She gave me a big huge hug; I was shocked and “weirded” out. I left with another woman to do chores; we were in a donut van: there were donuts stacked on the roof and I crashed into another car: the donut boxes flew off and made a huge mess. We enter into a building, still in our van and there is a check point with a dog search going on for drugs. I am nervous but know I have done nothing wrong. They have opened the van doors: cops and dogs everywhere. The dogs are searching the van, jumping all over Mandy. This scares me: I don’t fully trust them even though nothing happens. Mandy is not scared. I am outside the van watching. There is a huge Mastiff, black, almost looks like a Portuguese water-dog but in dream he’s a Mastiff. He has a low grow and I know he is in charge of the dogs. He is on a leash, being held by a cop but I know he’s in charge. They let us pass after inspection.
93. Showing houses. In one part I see old friends and we make up nicknames for each other. I see one woman and tell her we want to call her Auntie Ann.

A bunch of adults are standing in a line. I’m not sure what we are doing there, but it seems to me we are being treated like school children: if we talk, we will be kept after school. Which is what happens to me. I kept talking to my friend who was behind me. Eventually, I was caught and punished.

First dream of night revolved around horses but they were mutilated or quartered somehow. Then I am mad at my sister Leah for some reason; I wanted to sleep outside and do my own thing. I found an outside drawer full of wet inner tube mattresses: like for the pool. Some were blown up. I took 2 that were the correct size and a ton of blankets. Next scene I am watching movie clips of Gary Sinese kissing another woman, floating while on a raft in a lake. It was like they just consummated their relationship; then the scene changes to Gary with another man who is on top; same situation. I wonder how that could work being 2 men face to face instead of (forgive me, this is all I can come up with) Doggie Style.

94. I'm in a big warehouse with lots of old junk. Some is for sale. I see Kerry and some other people I know. I tell Kerry that if she decides to have a yard sale, I can help her look for people stealing stuff. She stops to talk to our old friend Wendy. I stop to say goodbye. I hug Kerry, then Wendy. Her hair is very stiff with hairspray. She says she's been staying in Brentwood where people take care of her.

Dreamed about the wedding all night long; had epic after epic but cannot remember specifics. Dreamed three different books, like a trilogy of Pendergast (Preston/Childs’ books); each book was a vivid dream and long; each led to the next. Pendergast is an FBI, Louisiana agent; cultured and very strange. The books are good. Then I dream of reruns of the wedding.
95. Setting up MLS searches. There's a big white limo parked at the airport every day. I met the man who owns it. He drives up there every day along a route that takes him through Papago Park.
An old girl friend of Matt’s drops by. Matt is not here. Delene has been in the army and is home on vacation. We chit chat a bit and then she leaves.

I am riding in a wooded setting on a bike with my brother; following a specific route on a paved road. It is daytime. There are others also riding (my brother and I must catch up and give them something or accomplish a task). It was a good dream. Then I am driving at a big beach house but down the road is another small studio, also owned by the same people who own the beach house, where we have a get together of some sort. There are 2 huge plastic flat see-through bins (like for shoes but square) and I use one to fill with things to take back to beach house and home (we are renting the beach house). Then I find out I must return the bin, it belongs to the studio house and I spend rest of dream thinking about mailing it; but will someone be there to accept it or bring it in the house? Then I am in a school of some sort, very irregular: no stress regarding the class itself, just the people. I am sitting next to a socially challenged (intelligent, just not socially) woman; ugly but smart. First an old schoolmate comes up to her; he asks about her dream she had. After she tells him, she asks: “what do you think?” He says: “I think you got it right” and congratulated her then leaves. I have the feeling that he’s just blowing smoke because she’s responsible for something and I can’t figure it out. I say to her: “We can talk about your dream later and see.” She starts crying, very hurt that I said that and I say: “why are these people doing this? Are you grading them or something?” [I allude to her that they are lying to make her feel better] She stops and agrees. Earlier several female movie stars came up to her as well to give her something or congratulate her, etc. Next scene she and 2 other women are with me; it is getting dark and we are outside in the woods by my car (which I just drove to a special spot where we will be walking back to another class). One of my boots is unlaced and I spend the remainder of dream trying to lace them. I am well-known for this trail/hike/passage and for doing it fast.

My grandmother (paternal grandmother) is reading a poem she wrote “Halfway to Heaven”. As she reads, I look through the sunlit porch wishing I could believe what she believes. When she’s done, I’m thinking that she’ll never get there (to heaven). We drink our tea and talk. It’s nice. I fade out.

96. The MLS takes me right into people's back yards. I go see Ron Dragin again and get him to sign with me. Kyle and I live together and want a child. We go talk to a surrogate. Then I decide to have the baby myself.
I am at a reunion of my ordination class. This seems to e a rather fancy affair. I come across a couple friars I haven’t seen in a long time: Blaise and Colin. We have a great time.

I am in a strange, foreign place. There are houses everywhere: shops and people. I know a select few but feel like I don’t speak the native language (Russian?). I am following around, inconspicuously, a man similar to Dan, but he’s not my husband in dream. I am in love with him but he is being evasive: others are also advancing on him and he has many suitors. I am quiet and submissive in dream; taking orders from other women. There are gutted out houses, some burnt down, crazy area. There is another man in dream who is attractive (image: his hand waving) but he’s like a decoy; trying to get me away from Dan.

I am at a friend’s house (Lou). I ask her how her mom is doing (she is very old and very in need of skilled care in real life). Lou says she is not good. She asks me to help her find a place. The first nursing home we go to is dark, smelly, and terrible. Lou tells me there is not way she is putting her mother in that place. We go to the next place and it is a plush palace for the elderly. We are truly awestruck. There is a beautiful tapestry on all of the walls, elegant furnishings, even the elevator was beautiful…..drapery fabric on the walls and ceilings. We take the elevator up to a conservatory. There are beautiful plants and glass everywhere. This is where the residents eat and socialize. Lou turns to me and says, “I’m going to put my mother here. Just because I don’t like her, doesn’t mean I don’t want the best for her.” I tell Lou she is a good daughter. She reminds me she is adopted.
I am with a group of people. It seems to be a group on tour. Anyway, I end up being the caretaker of everybody’s money.

There was a huge earthquake outside; lots of sand colored mountains: like mesas but closer together. Dan was in the dream but I don’t remember specifics. I remembered the earthquake in the above dream; I am in a high-ceilinged, post and lintel, open-roomed building, like a church and library together. It’s a school campus and we are studying on the campus. An old friend from fourth grade is there. I feel uneasy, expecting a huge earthquake. I travel from building to building on this campus; not knowing where the safest spot would be. I tell my friend that I had a dream about an earthquake and I know it will happen soon. She doesn’t believe me. I end up back in the high beamed room. There are many of us there. Suddenly the earthquake comes: I am standing next to this nerdy guy. He does not look up at the ceiling but I do. I look at the doors wondering if I should be outside or in. Suddenly the beams start to fall and I grab him, showing him the steel beams and telling him to watch out. I take his hand and run for a corner of the building. I wake up breathing hard; shaking.
Somehow, I got the job of calling up parents and enrolling their children in CCD. The family that sticks in my memory is Pally and Russ. What doesn’t make sense is their children are all in college.

Full of dreams last night; all very disturbing and nightmarish. I woke up at 1:45 to nightmare. I am with my sister out in cold weather climate. There is a big lake, foreign area to us. Dan is there too but he is more observer than “hero” or helper. I have been taking photos for Leah with a camera she gave me. We are in a huge multi-roomed house and we take pictures of bunny rabbits: all in a row. Then we take of friends. At end I show her my pictures: they are not great, all off center on all of them: heads cut off but not too bad. She goes crazy and tells me to give her back her $10 camera and to get out! She kicks me out of the house and I am so upset, shocked and hurt that I grab whatever clothes (jackets, sweaters) I can find to keep me warm and I leave or at least I go outside house to another smaller house. She soon calms down and wants to talk but I am too full of pride.

This dream is like a sequel to a thriller where we went through the first and now living the second action thriller. A young black boy and a hero fight enemies but the young boy gets killed: very tragic. I end up going to his family’s place: a strange single story apartment complex with a garage inside: orange doors, tan walls. I ask to fix my car there, they are all big black men, younger, very nice but skeptical. I find playback recorder under the car and listen to the boy’s escapades. I cared a lot about this boy in the dream. The family is distant but sympathetic with glances my way. Then my own family appears and I need to shower. I end up in a long hall, down from the garage and get showed into a shower. I take the shower, nude, but don’t have a towel. Anther black woman shows up; she’s another family member and I ask her, with the clear curtain wrapped around my body, if she could get me a towel. She agrees and finds one. Next scene I go into my family’s room and they tell me my suitcase is in the next room. I go there and it’s totally empty. I recognize it as my Aunt M.’s old room before she died. My suitcase is full of towels and linens: all old and the mattresses are off the bed. I wake up.
I seem to be in a crowd but what doesn’t make sense is that we are involved in sexual activity by way of fondling. I wake up.

I was at my old place of work and I came back for the day to surprise everyone. S. was there and my dad (who doesn’t work there). Saw M. and T. and warehouse guys. Woven images of a Greek figure of a horse with woman’s head; like a centaur and a Kore figure (Greek funerary or dedication statue) with specific features.

I am participating in a huge political rally. What is different about this rally is that it is made up of both democrats and republicans and this is what is most unusual; everyone is getting along and agreeing with each other.

Again dreamed of a Kore figure: Greek female statues. I dreamed about waiting in line at a huge buffet, watching the food being replaced and not able to get to the salads. I find a rolled up turkey wrap that looked good but still waiting for salad.

We are part of a good size parish picnic. There is much talking and eating going on. Finally, people leave. I am the last one left (at least so I thought) when I spot a boy’s hat on the table. As I start looking around , a little boy comes out of the men’s room I realize after talking to him , he does not know how to get home. So, I call the police but they can’t help me. So, I take the boy home

My mother and I are in Akron, NY. It is present time. I am so excited because we are at my great uncle’s house (he died when I was sixteen-we were very close. At the time of his death, my mother inherited his estate. She sold his house which I loved) We are in the house and my mother is going to buy me the house. We start to go through the house. The front is the same but the inside is different. The previous owners have changed it. They have knocked down walls, etc. We go into what was once the kitchen. There is nothing there, just an empty shop was. That too has changed some. I start looking around and my mother asks me what I’m looking for. I say, “don’t you remember that little door Uncle Maynard has down here?” My mother says I’m imagining it. I say, “No, I’m not. We were never allowed in there.” She tells me I’m being ridiculous. I start knocking on walls. There is a hollow sound. I tell her “it’s here.” I take a hammer and beat the plasterboard off and there is a little door. We open it and step into an underground tomb. In the tomb, which is the size of a basement, are all the items that my aunt ever owned. Uncle Maynard set up a shrine here for her. I know why we weren’t allowed in there as kids. There are beautiful dresses, dishes, etc. in the room. I am struck by the love my uncle had for his wife. I felt funny/weird invading his space. I tell my mom she has to buy the house for sure.

I am at a long (rather than deep or wide) theatre/stage with red curtains. My mom is there with other family members and I am forced to be there; my date is an old man like Papa B. There is another older couple: a wife named Emily and her husband, blondish gray hair who talks with me in theatre. He looks at me longingly like he wished I was with him. We’ve seen this movie before, but mom makes me go again or be there. It’s a children’s movie like 101 Dalmatians. Then the scene changes and everyone’s gone. I’m now in theatre alone and trying to stay awake. I turn off the movie playing and turn on radio. I keep pouring myself large cups (soup bowls) of cold coffee and sugar. I notice the coffee has spilt on the floor: a waste. I think of putting movie back on and then I’m woken up by my dog barking.

I am with Leah, staying at her and Mark’s new house. It’s on the outskirts, like frontier, of where I know. Mark has built the house. There are many other people there, with kids staying as well as Mandy and myself. There is a big weather change; it is early morning and they (Leah and Friends) were already prepared. It turns cold and starts snowing very lightly. One friend says tomorrow a cold front comes in, bringing double zeros. I am amazed and shocked: it is summertime! The day progresses and different scenes happen: I watch as a dozen rabbits emerge from a wood pile in middle of their yard; then I see baby chicks, fowls, and horses. I ask Leah about it: she says yes, they have animals and are very excited. There are kids everywhere running around in costumes; different cartoon (bizarre, Cartoon Express/Boomerang-like) outfits. There are little boys in pink and red felt-like, girls’ outfits and such. There is a pool and kids are swimming. Mandy takes to a young Mediterranean boy with curly hair and accent. He is keeping an eye on her for me. I worry a moment, but Leah say’s he’s Mediterranean and is very sweet with kids. She is on a raft playing with a ring he is wearing. He smiles and say’s he enjoys watching her. Leah follows me to a prayer house or meditation house they have built out back. I recognize it as non-traditional (non-Catholic); you light incense as you go in, thinking negative things you are worried about. Then you go in and smudge yourself of all the bad thoughts. You pray for long time and come out. Leah is right on my heels; we try to enter once but I worry about Mandy and find her with the boy: thought she had drowned in pool. Then second time Leah comes to porch of the house. I take incense stick, thinking I haven’t the chance to do this right (alone with my prayers). She says the place is just like a chapel; I see images of vines on a tree. Leah has a ton of these white makeup applicators that she takes. I know, in dream, what their used for: applying Holy water, but I don’t think in this context of meditation house that it works. I get woken up by my dog again.

I am with a group of people/friends, living all in the same complex: a spiraling apartment complex or dorm house. The dream starts with us going out to eat at a local restaurant. My friend Kristin has a husband, Army, named Josh who starts acting differently. We all notice this. He’s got an attitude and is cynical. One day he just never comes back home. His wife is thunderstruck; she can’t understand and mourns for him. I feel horrible and all kinds of scenarios enter: died in war, took off, or killed in an accident along the road…? Was he alive or dead? I go out to eat with her and ask her many questions: did he pack his computer, or any of his Army stuff? She says he put all his stuff away; packed it away. She and I lie down and rest in restaurant seats; close our eyes and just think for a longtime. There are others in the restaurant. I order soup, but it’s terrible so I change to something else. The next scene I am trying to find L. to ask him if he knows what happened to Josh. They were good friends and he was with him the last night he left. I run through tons of people, see him leaving school/campus and call his name (he’s with friends). He comes running right over and he has a little girl, same age as Mandy. I ask him what happened to that guy. I forget his name, he looks confused. I say his last name then remember his first: Josh, Joshua! He looks at me and understands. He says “let me think about it for awhile” we embrace for a long time and I give him a kiss and tell him I love him. He is like a brother to me. His little girl sits in my lap and snuggles. When I take her off, she cries. He says “you’re acting up now” and points. I take her back in my arms and say “we need to get our girls together, she is exactly like Mandy”. This girl had huge circular freckles on both sides of her face, in a half-moon circle. The right side had a strip of fuchsia down the same path as the freckles: very unusual. He promises to let me know. I head back to room and get on a bus to go home. As we leave someone remarks that I am having girl twins and L. is having boy twins. I get on the bus and notice it is Friday and all the girls are gussied up, all dressed to kill and planning to go out. I am pregnant; they all laugh and think “Is she coming with us?” I say no, that I have someone else to take care of and get off on my stop. There are people everywhere doing different things. At this point the dream changes: I decide I want to go to Indian/Native ways. I find a Native skirt to put on; it’s too short; like a mini-skirt and I think “you’re too old to wear that”. It’s then I see Josh; he has left his old life behind and become a full Native. I have done the same in dream and I wonder do I tell Kristin; how do I tell Kristin. We live in a big tribe, nomads or Plains-style.

I’m traveling down an old country road somewhere. The terrain reminds me of Pennsylvania. I’m in the back of a station wagon with my friend Bob. His girlfriend Ryann is driving and their daughter, Trinity, is in the back seat. Bob and Ryann are shouting at each other. I’m holding the littlie girl; trying to shield her from the violence. Suddenly, Ryann pulls out a gun and starts to fire off into the back seat. I shield Trinity with my body, kick the car door open as it crashes into a farmhouse. I feel the pain in my back, like I ruptured a disc or something. I find strength enough to pull the little girl from the back seat, as she was jarred from my hands during the accident. The sun is full west; Trinity is still alive. The police have surrounded the farmhouse. They shoot at us. The little girl is lifeless in my arms. Fade out.

I am at some sort of religious seminar. We are discussing topics like celibacy and abortion. My attitude about celibacy is that this commitment is very effective in freeing up the clergy to pursue their vocation. However, I do believe the commitment should be freely chose rather than imposed as a condition for ministry.

Kevin and I are shopping. I get a phone call. I leave Kevin at the store and go to his mom’s. She is dead. She has fallen and had a stroke. I go back to the store. Kevin asks where I was. I tell him I’ll tell him later. He keeps asking me what’s going on. I keep putting him off. Finally, he starts yelling at me. I tell him his mother has passed, “She is with your dad and I’m sure she is happy.” He yells and says, “How do you know that for sure?” I tell him because they missed each other. He asks me if I’m sad and I say, “Not really because I know how much she missed your father.” Kevin calls me a cold-hearted bitch. I tell him I’m not cold hearted, I just know they are both fine. He is uncontrollable with his grief. I try to console him, but he pushes me away. I am sad for him.

97. At my house - clients come over to be talked down. Connie Fisher comes over and talks to us. I get ready to fall asleep but the alarm goes off. My back yard has a new fence. Townhouses are stacked along a hillside so each can have a view.

I’m just waking and I’m fixated on my curtain. In the patterns, I envisage cabins following one and other deep into the forest. The perception of depth seems boundless. One of the tiny cabins, beyond all other perceptibles is red. There is something off about; as if the firmament upon which all my beliefs happen to rest is faulty. Then my mind zooms out, and the curtain and room are distant. I have soft eyes now, and I begin to examine some bizarre markings on the wall. The words are incomprehensible. I hear a muffled sound and my father is shouting that I’ve been asleep for two decades.

I had an awful dream last night that I was supposed to go on a plane with Elizabeth. Apparently, we were skipping school for a few days and just going somewhere fun. But we weren’t really sure if we’d actually go or not. In this dream I was deathly afraid of flying. Apparently, on the day of September 11th, 2001, I was scheduled to travel on one of those ill-fated planes. I was destined to Texas or something weird like that. But for some reason I missed the flight, and therefore was still alive. So I wasn’t really sure if I wanted to fly this time. That was brief and fleeting, yet perplexing.

I wake up in a strange place, I don’t recognize the room. I suddenly feel a pain rip through my chest upon realizing that my father died eighteen years ago, and that my mother passed away last month. I run through the door of the washroom and turn to the mirror. I haven’t aged a day but I should be sixty. I run down a staircase. This house is massive, I must be very wealthy. I see pictures arranged along an ornate mantel. There’s pictures of Nick, Milo, Alex, Megan, Bob, Alec, and Brian. They’re all old. A woman about twenty, comes in the room. She’s Asian; she has fair skin with long dark hair. I don’t recognize her at all. I ask her where I am. She’s my wife; her name is Xianghua. She’s freaked out by my memory loss. I tell her I need to clear my head. I walk outside. I’m on the water. Tall poplars line the Cliffside. I shudder again. My brother Christian and my friend Nick are both dead. I fall to the ground. The sun blinds me. I wish to wake up. I slap my face and pull my hair. I jump up in bed.

I had a really crazy dream last night. I was in this hotel with Mom and Dad, and we were all staying in the same room in the same bed (kind of like when they’d come to see me in Union City). Apparently they had some kind of little argument, about what time to go to bed or something. So Mom and I went out these French doors onto a patio with a pool, and into another set that led to another similar empty room. Mom and I sat on that bed and talked and talked. Then we went to this store like Walgreens. There was a whole aisle full of chocolate figures. There were these chocolate Barbie dolls that were solid dark chocolate, although their skin was dyed white. I really wanted one in a red dress. Mom suggested that I take a chocolate pair of slippers instead. They were twice the size of the doll figure, and hollow. But I wanted the doll instead. She showed me several other hollow chocolate articles that I couldn’t identify and said that I could have any of the hollow ones but I couldn’t have the solid one that I really wanted.
The only thing I remember is the smell of flowers; very sweet, very strong.
Family/Children- I am having a get-together with my children. All I remember is that we are having tons of fun.

The first dream of the night revolved around a dragon and the great goddess. I am in a boat with a friend who lives in this other country (Iraq?). We are being attacked by a dragon. I can’t remember much; we escaped and went back home. This friend was more like an acquaintance. She was wild, in a sense that she would put herself in danger to get in contact with this dragon/goddess. The dream morphs into a school setting where I have to blend in and take a class. I think it’s Spanish or something to do with SW (?). The text books are ½ wrong; I have to check a certain page to see if an answer to a quiz question is “reply” or “no reply”: if it says “no reply” than it’s the wrong book. I can’t find a right book; they all get taken from the desk and I look for more. There are also work books. The teacher is the same dragon woman: very short, comes to my chest. She has short butch hair and is very emotional. She starts laughing and I give her a hug and it turns to sobs. This happens twice. I tell her it’s a wonder after what she’ been through and if it were me I would have stayed home and lay in bed for three days to recuperate. The dream morphs into a huge gorgeous house overlooking a lake owned by the same short woman. Now I am with different friends; most are acquaintances: long haired hippy man and short haired nice, but dorky guy, other women friends. We are staying at a house for a party; we bring a ton of food: mostly pastries cinnamon/pecan rolls, Danishes, etc.). We all pick and eat. The owner has put my backpack in a front bedroom: very plain with a bathroom that has stalls. I walk around the house and use the master bathroom which has an exercise bike and stereo system installed through the house. It’s huge and circular. When I come out I find that the short-haired man has made a comment about liking me; got embarrassed and left. I go into the huge long living room. There are curtains against the back windows revealing swimmers out in the lake. I sit on the far end, leather, and burgundy couch. It’s not as comfy as it looks. The long haired hippy runs and slides up to me, being funny. He sits next to me and tries to kiss me. I push back and say I’m married. He puts his arm under my legs (as if to pick me up if he wanted) and I stand saying “why do you think I’d fool around when I’m married?” He says why were you all alone, waiting for it or something? He gets mad; I apologize as I walk away. I decide to leave. I know it will make the hostess upset but I feel horrible. I go to get my backpack in the front bathroom and notice little baby/toddler feet under a stall. I say “Is someone there?” and a woman, Spanish/Cuban answers: “Yes, It’s just me.” She has been taken in by this hostess and I realize there are huge bedrooms off the bath that I didn’t notice. She has girls lying in one room and off to the left: rows and rows of antique, skinny little beds with more kids on those. There are adults too and it seems everyone has a cold or is sick. The woman shoos me away and gets me to leave. I help her put a shirt on as I walk around her and back out the bathroom door, to my plain room. I wonder why they are being helped: the hostess has a big heart.

I can hear an intercom. I’ve been out a long time. I must be dying; I can’t move. The voices of people are distinct. Something about ballooning up my left lung. I can breathe fine. I’m one hundred years old, I remember, and everyone’s gone. I remember going to visit Lisa’s daughter, Brittany. She would have been eighty-one. Her granddaughter tells me that she passed away a decade ago from spinal cancer; what a way to go I think. I remember reading stories to her before bed. She had the most impish little visage. We would sing songs in French. I imagine the room still then spinning. Then all I can see is sky- stretching out to the infinite. I’m too tired to fight the sleep, I fade off.

Mafia- This has to be one of my most bizarre of all my dreams. I am not even sure I have ever know a mafia member. Anyway, I am part of a mob and I am living at the house of a mafia leader. I also seem to have a girlfriend since I am sleeping with her. My predominant emotion is confusion (maybe fear). I wake up.

I am at my grandmother’s house but it’s very different. I am outside the house most of the dream; Dan is there and other family members including Aunt M.’s son (he is like an uncle). I roll cigarettes to smoke but they don’t roll very well or they burn right up. I talk with people outside the house; it’s dark, nighttime. Dan and I go inside and find a room to be alone in. He realizes there is a lock and locks the door. We have problems trying to keep others out or away to be together. We spend half the dream trying to be alone.
98. A friend comes over and shows me another friend's baby. It's so small it fits in her hand. It looks like a little wax Buddha.

There is snow on the ground. It is not easy getting around. I am on foot. As I try to get through the snow, I notice three men coming towards me that I don’t know. They seem to be upset that I am in the area. They begin making snowballs and throwing them. I wake up.

I am in my mountain house: Dan and Mandy are there too. There are next-door neighbors right across the street from us who come to introduce themselves. The husband is blonde, a doctor of some sort and slimy: he cheats on his wife. His wife is also named Sophia; she is heavier, reddish blonde hair and doesn’t really know what’s going on: her husband say’s “I put a little booze in her drink every night to keep her from coming over here to talk with you.” It’s supposed to be a joke but I know it’s true. She drinks to stay “numb or unaware” and he cheats. They leave and I’m relieved. I go back to work cleaning the house and ask Dan what he thinks. Then they come right back over again, this time they bring loads of furniture, food and guests. They are having a Christmas party at our house and didn’t even ask! I know no one; there are people everywhere, each are talking, gossiping, etc. I finally say: “So why are you all here? I didn’t even know there was a party?” The couple of female guests I asked looked shocked and embarrassed; they felt horrible they were there but knew it wasn’t their fault. The guests finally started leaving and taking everything with them: furniture, crock-pots (dark green), and all 70’s style. I tell Dan that the neighbor kept going/coming over to the backyard and Dan says he’s going back there to cheat. Suddenly my house changes and I don’t recognize it at all. I start panicking: the kitchen looks completely different, old green appliances, etc. The dream morphs and we have traveled back to our Fayetteville home. Dan’s been given new clothes; he now works for the FBI. They give him pinstripe shorts that he doesn’t like because they go past the knee; he changes into the same-style of pants.

I’m half awake and I sense that I’m floating. I seem to be on my bed but there’s something off- a certain groundlessness. I turn and look up. I can hear Dream Theater’s “Space Dye Vest” playing somewhere in limbo. Enter vision and floating through a sky of relentless blue, wafts of cumulus clouds brush up against my face, almost palpable, then dissipate. With no sense of time or ground, I survey the world below; the insignificant humdrum of day-to-day goings on, the world of sensate thing- is nothing save for a tiny glimmer in my memory. There’s a certain synesthetic harmony in all this. I fade off after holding Antores in the palm of my hand.

I’m in a long hallway with doors on both sides (similar to my new position). I’m walking and just looking. I’m calm and confident. All of a sudden, an old woman comes out of her apartment. She is very mean looking. I smile and say “hi”. She just stares at me then she starts to come after me with her walker. I speed up. She speeds up. I start to run. Her walker turns into a wheeled walker in which she climbs on and adjusts the speed. I am now running and very afraid. She is still coming closer and closer. I go around the corner and then I wake up.

I am an officer in the Navy. I am in the search for a radio studio and am with a friend. We are going to make a recording. I remember singing a song and feeling pretty glad about my performance. I wake up.

I’m wandering a downtown area that reminds me of my hometown but it’s much more “Key West” style: macabre stores, lots of people, gay transvestites: very non-G. The streets were alike however [to G.]. I wandered for a long time, past tons of people, ones I knew and didn’t. I have to stop three times to get a pap smear/check-up by a gay doctor, very cute, very nice. I am always on a messed up bed: lots of sheets and blankets. The third visit is more crumpled (sheets) and his hand gets caught up in sheets before he can examine me. There is also a black and white kitten that comes into the open window. It is nighttime and I try to get the cat off the bed; his leg pops off like a stuffed animal. I show it to the doctor, worried, and he just snaps the leg back on. Then he goes back to examining me. He finds a green growth at the back of my cervix and says I need to see a urologist. She happens to be there in his office and he calls her in. I am very upset and nervous now: she looks, describes the crocodile skin around it. I can visualize it. Then I wake up. [note to self: Great Mother aspects]

99. I am in school. Supposed to leave for class but a bunch of stuff prevents me from going. Blake Griffin helps me by offering to watch for thieves. Someone keeps stealing the iron gate and something inside I get for the tenants. he is going to sleep in front of the door and catch them. But he won't stop talking and I'm late. Finally I make it to class and the teacher is nice and gives me a make-up assignment. It's a writing class.

I am in a facility that reminds me of the airport at August, Georgia. I am with a group of people who are attending a retreat. We will be walking to the retreat residence. For some reason, I miss the group as they leave. Somehow I find my way to the residence. I am joking around (making fun of myself) and Joanne gives me the thumbs-up. I don’t get a chance to talk with Joanne. I wake up.

I am at my grandmother’s house, outside in her yard and it is summer time: very green. My father is there and Mandy is Shelby (my younger sister); their personalities have merged. Others are there as well. It is day time and I am sitting under a tree when I look up and see a beautiful owl. The wing tips are grayish white and the ears and back of neck are reddish orange and stick up. The eyes are beautiful. He sees me but stays put. I do not bother him but am so excited to see an owl up close. I’ve yet to do that in person. Shelby/Mandy goes up to her and puts her finger under its legs to try to hold it. I scold her. The owl leaves to another spot and does this a couple of times; never leaving but relocating to another branch. My father comes into the picture; we talk for awhile. I stay with him and step-mother for a night. I have to sleep on a horrible spring bed that moves and creaks: no support, like a waterbed. I beg them to change the bed.

I am with Dan, he asks me to get a list of items from Home Depot; he drops me off and waits. It is nighttime. The place is being completely remodeled: they’ve taken out all their merchandize in the “front” warehouse and put it in a Cinnabon coffee shop-like store. I walk around to find someone who’ll help. I run into a man who has been dating my friend Kathy (only in dream, in reality he was dating another woman and I met him at my sister’s wedding: very nice, older, but alcoholic). He’s a contractor in dream and asks where Kathy is: he had spent a few days with her (in dream) and she disappeared. I knew she was dodging him but told him I didn’t know. I see him a couple more times in dream, whining about how he was really getting attached and now she’s nowhere. I wander through a different warehouse. They are remodeling, making a huge stage: all beautiful stone rock foundation work. It’s Christmas time or something and there’s to be a play. I find someone to help, she looks at the first item on the list, takes off, and say’s they don’t have it (it’s mostly fabrics and strange stuff) but they might have the other stuff. I put my list in my pocket; she leaves. I do more wandering, getting lost and starting to worry about Dan: he’s still waiting and it’s been over an hour and I have nothing to show yet. I want to forget the whole thing; I find an exit and the cars are lined up outside running, all slowly moving around Home Depot, like moms picking up kids at school. There’s no way to find him. I go back inside, talk with other employees, recognize a few and try to find my list again and realize my pockets are full of “stuff”. I bring out loads of receipts, wads of junk. One pocket has gum gluing it together. I am so frustrated. Another employee comes to help but now I can’t find the paper. Work is going on around me. Then I find 2 sweaters that were my grandmother’s one is a Peruvian (expensive!) knit that was given to Shelby (after the funeral, in reality) but in dream I have it. Someone see’s it, eyes widen, and say’s “if you ever want to let us borrow those for our show, we’d be most happy” or something like that. I realize the worth, say: “okay and I’ll let you know”. Dream continues with me worrying about Dan, not wanting to do this chore, failing at finding anything, but marveling at the rocks.

Dreamed about a weird wedding ritual: helping in the wedding, attending to the bride. I watch a woman come out into the waves, at the beach, bringing arm full’s of blood: menstrual blood to be washed in the sea as a ritual for the wedding. It was a very strange dream with lots of people, dark rooms, low ceilings, lots of activity, people doing tasks all around me and preparing. [This dream was very powerful, vivid and still fresh a year later: I am in a dark, stone walled, low ceiling building or structure: very old, very medieval or primitive. There are many rooms that are like mazes, opening up into other rooms, and solemn people milling about everywhere. There are mostly women, in fact I don’t remember seeing any men in the dream at all but I know there was a marriage ceremony going on. Next scene is at the beach, watching this woman with long white skirts enter the water with arm loads of menstrual blood. Her skirts get wet, they look heavy; it is overcast outside and I feel like it’s on European soil, England isles or Ireland. I think of the wet, dampness of the dream and the solemn ceremony that must be done for the preparation or consummation of the marriage.]

I’m back at Fort Niagara and I’m playing soccer. This was one of the last games I played. I think this as I receive a pass from Marc Buckholtz. It’s me, Marc, has brother Rob, Kirsten Hanson, Jen Knapp, Shane, Derek Kopacz, and Alex Narrow. We’re playing the best players from the Lewport Varsity team. I kick the ball to Shane, he kicks it back. I dribble it down the North side of the field, step-over, then a Marseille’s roulette and I burn Albright back to Kopacz, back to me. I’m ten yards before midfield. I chip it forty-five yards to Kirsten on the left about fifteen yards from the net. She shields it from Leardini, giving me a chance to sprint half the distance of the field. She heel chips the ball over his head into the center, and I finish it off into the corner of the net. We celebrate and I look up into the maples some twenty yards past the net. I feel sad. The wind sifts through the silver leaves.
In this dream, I am a whale tamer. This is about all I remember because this is such a strange place for me to be in.

I am with two other women; we are given motorcycles. Mine is great: I love it and drive it very well, surprisingly in the dream. We are on a hunt of sorts, trying to trace a former trail to find the person we are looking for. I remember going down a road, running a long a coast line, cliffs to one side, rock face to another. Going around a sharp switchback that was a huge carved stone pillar with strange designs engraved in relief on the stone. I stopped to feel the texture.
The only thing I remember is when I wake up, I kept saying we have to de-bug the system. I kept saying it over and over. I was very anxious when I woke up.

Mandy and other little kids are running away from me; it is night time and they are crossing busy intersections, dodging cars. I follow but lose them. I had to go back home to wait for word on where they were. I found out they stopped at an elementary school and are waiting to be picked up. I woke up (from in the dream) and there is a man sleeping beside me; he was huge (7’ tall at least, a former husband of the owner of the house). He smiled at me and said I was a firecracker (?). I was still worried about Mandy, wanting to get out of there but a little shocked at his expression. Did I sleep with him…no way! But why did he say that?

I find myself back home in Old Orchard Beach, Maine. A person who plays a part in this dream is a man who owned half of Old Orchard Beach. This man also was a friend of my family. There were two brothers and a sister. One of the brothers would visit us a lot. We were next door neighbors.

The dream: I am trying to get a statue of an ancient goddess, like a Greek goddess, marble, very tall and thin, across an ocean or body of water. She was strapped, standing upright on a makeshift raft. White strips of cloth or strap wrapped to keep her stable. Several women are holding her up. I remember washing ashore, on a beach. It was hard work carrying her.

I’m on a run through a very rough part of Montreal-La Salle. I remember going up to the water’s edge. I’m surrounded on all sides by hints of the late nineteenth century Parisian architecture. About a kilometer down the street I descry the distinctive glare of neon lights. I grab the cold rail near the water. Somewhere a car backfires, a woman yells profanity. I recognize the bridge…I’m by the River Rouge. Diane is there and she’s in a blue evening dress. Now I’m looking down from the bridge and Diane and her mom are having tea and bagels. I smile and fade off.

100. I go to 1515 Skylark Lane and see people. I'm supposed to drive somewhere and ask directions - go down Sunset to La Brea, go south. Change clothes - meet people (wake up very upset and angry about net neutrality - worried the goons will run in the Internet).

I am at a meeting of some sort. There are several residents of The Village (where I used to work). It is all women. We are discussing women in church and how they do not have the same responsibilities as men. One woman says, “at least we can say the collect (this is from the Buffalo Professional Woman’s Association). The rest shout, “It’s not enough! We need to be equal with men.” One woman slams her fist on the table. My alarm goes off.

I am at a wedding shower at an expensive hotel which lasted several days. Everyone is very wealthy, bride including, who had a brother. We stayed at the hotel for a few days. One scene: I was late to a luncheon and there were 2 booths for everyone. They had coffee and pastries being served. I got extremely tired and asked for coffee, poured a cup. The women were all in a much richer, higher social class which I was aware. Next scene: I am with the bride, her friend, the bride’s bother (English accent, very charming but unassuming, also rich), another man interested in the bride’s friend, the father, and others. First we are driving, I with the brother following in small convertibles (like cut-off fold bars, very tiny). We stop to find the bride. The bother pulls out a black briefcase, with a computer key pad build into the leather, like a security device with white and red buttons. He says: “That’s Gucci.” I say: “It’s a very nice bad, I assumed it must be.” Next scene: I am at my mountain house and we are all there: the men drank all the beer, and are laughing. The house is much different: more central, larger living room. I am feeling like a hostess or outsider. I am connected with the bride in some way and watch other couples get together (flirt and so forth). I give the bother a thought but quickly remember I am seeing Alan (old, drug-addict boyfriend in reality) and that would never work. I worry about Alan showing up with his drug and alcohol problem: being around so many wealthy people. Someone goes through our old vinyl record collection (we have no such thing) and puts on a record. The same guy finds a tape that needs to be fixed (tape cassette, the tape is coming out). We both fix at the same time. I am aware that no one is flirting with me. I ask the bride when the wedding will be, she says September (that is when Dan and I married); I had thought it would be on Christmas which other’s had alluded to and that everyone would be at our house for it. Something about getting bouquets from our garden…

Dan and I are planning a trip through Montana to get to another state. I get out a map, which seems to be central in this dream because I can never find the right map; there are several and I get them mixed up. We drive to a city and stay at a hotel but realize we are not going in a direct route. There is question about our route. More map checking and we end up going south then east and backtrack to get further south. On each stop is a particular hotel. They all have different characteristics: one is militant: squat and green in color. The others farther South are where we need to go. Mostly confusion, compromise and guesswork reign in the dream but we are in Montana for sure.

I’m at my old friend’s house in Hamburg, NY. (Nancy’s). We are catching up on what’s transpired since we got together. We get in her car to go for an appointment. She has an appointment with a massage therapist down the back road. We get there and the therapist tells her there is someone ahead of her. We are waiting on benches outside. Nancy says to the therapist after waiting a half hour, “it’ doesn’t look like she is going to show up” The therapist says we have to wait. I’m getting nervous because it’s now, 7pm. I have to leave. Nancy gives me her keys and I go back to her house. I’m upstairs in a costume (black maternity- like dress) I put a dog bed under the costume to make me look pregnant. I go into Nancy’s backyard and they put up a break wall along the lake and then enclosed an area with a built in pool. Mar, her husband, is swimming in the pool. He asks about Nancy. I say I will go get her. He invites me to stay and swim and I tell him I am in no condition to swim. I pick up Nancy and we go back to her house. Mark opens the door to let us in and tells me to give back the dog bed. I reach under and pull it out. Nancy goes into the house and Mark shuts the door in my face after I give him the dog bed.

Kevin and I are at the huge house which we bought to rehab (Kevin’s not handy at all!) Kevin and I and a friend, Joann, are at the house in a room. Kevin is having difficulty getting an erection. I try everything, nothing works. Joann watches. She asks if she could try. Kevin says no. We try to convince him and I ask, “What is your problem?” (Art, Joann’s husband) Kevin says, “No, it’s Ryan.” Joann says, “Art would trade places with you in a minute to have two women at one time and Ryan never needs to know.” (Ryan is their grandson who worships Kevin). So, Joann and I start with Kevin. Our group effort is working. In comes Art. Kevin’s face turns white. We explain to Art about what is happening. He is cool and said he’ll do a foursome. We begin. Joann puts on a pair of baby dolls. Her daughter Chris is in the room (Chris does my hair in real life) she claims how cute they are and she has pair in gray. I have on a black long negligee. We go into the room and the guys are waiting. Next thing, someone bangs on our door. I open it and Cindy (My ex-sister-in-law) is in the hall. I tell her she is not welcome her and to leave. She argues and says she is asking for help and money. I tell her again that if she doesn’t leave, there will be trouble. We go back into the room to begin our foursome. All of a sudden, we hear a bang. We go to unlock the door and it’s bolted from the outside. I feel the door and find out it’s hot. I yell, “fire!” We are trapped. Kevin and Art go in one direction, Jo and I in another. They go into the closet to try to get into the next room. I start trying to break the window. Jo is not helping. She is in shock and crying, “We are going to die!” I slap her and say, “No, we are not. Help me!” The window is lead glass. We finally break it and it leads to another room. We yell for people to leave the house, that there will be a fire (It’s sort of like a boarding house) We break through a wall, which has a window behind it. We break the window and start yelling for help. We can see the house in engulfed in flames. We are rescued as neighbors come running. We are asking about Kevin, Art and the rest of the people in the house. The chief tells us four people died. Cindy comes in the scene with a smirk on her face. She says she is sorry for our trouble. Kevin ells me my brother David, died in the fire. I go after Cindy. The Police stop me, and say they will take care of the investigation and me. It is arson. Cindy tells me she has an airtight alibi. Four people died in the fire: David, my brother; Marissa, one of my kid’s friends from sixteen years ago, a two others. The dream ends at a parade where I am tasting desserts with a bunch of girl friends who are trying to cheer me up.

I’m on my bed at Fredonia State College and I’m staring at the snow falling through the blackness. It’s so quiet and I’m so at peace. I’m going to lunch in an hour with Christine, then I’ll go to dinner with John. I’m staring at my roommate Mike’s picture of our galaxy, and I watch the ecliptic run past Gemini. The winter solstice seems to throw all planets into alignment. AS I stare closer and closer at each individual flake, I notice their fractal arrangements. I fade off.

I am going to my dentist’s office; I drop off Mandy and head to his office. I am back in Tucson and the office is in a strip mall with Foothills in the distance. In the dream the office is next to a big deli: beautiful. I park and say to myself, I know exactly where it is, but when I get to the shops I realize it has grown tremendously: I park in a spot, lower than the shops, (I have to go up some steps to get into the complex) that overlooks a huge, four-sided, enclosed, but open aired complex. There are lots of gorgeous boutiques, art galleries, a vacuum shop, delis on every side, chocolatier’s, two storied. I realize I am lost. I think I see the Deli and but it’s not. I ask directions and get pointed to right direction: I continue to get lost and become more anxious knowing my appt. has probably been cancelled because I’m late. I remind myself that I’m only in Tucson very so often and I need to go, I need this appt. I walk past a nature art gallery: inside I see a huge round rendition or recreation of waves hitting a rocky cliff. It’s gorgeous. I pass a vacuum shop and the man outside tells me to go through the back of the shop and Dr. Lewis’s office will be right next door. Apparently he moved. But I end up in an alley, outside of the periphery of the complex, still lost. I get back to mall and sit down on a bench. A woman on a cell phone (20-something, snobby, trendy) walks past me and says into her phone: “This woman just got too close to me…” and she looks at me sideways, very rude. I get up and realize it has to be 30 minutes past my appt. time already. I give up and decide to go aback to my car.
I am waiting for my son to come home. I understood that he was going to drive up from Washington to be here for Father’s Day. Anyway, these plans do not materialize.
This dream takes place in a basement. I’m sure it is not my basement because this one is clean, almost like a place of business. I don’t know I was doing there. I wake up.

I am at my grandfather’s and grandmother’s house and helping my siblings pack all of their tings because (in dream) they had both died. One scene: my mom and I find a huge make-up cart that swivels. It has multi-faceted sides, each having a different shade of red and the same lipstick, applicators, etc. It was cheaper stuff but still nice. My mom asked if I wanted it, I said yes but later noticed little name taps above three of the different colors. My grandmother had planned to take apart these sections and give them to her salon girls for a holiday/birthday. I decided to do the same: what she would have wanted. Next scene my little sister Shelby is there helping me. It is crazy going back and forth between huge rooms: massive house, multiple stored. At one point Dan jumped form a balcony to another landing and I scolded him because I didn’t want someone mimicking him and getting hurt. Another scene where Leah is going to make dinner and I am eating peanut butter and jelly sandwich by dipping bread into the smooth peanut butter. Shelby’s husband makes a comment while he is packing piles and piles of clothes into a carrier: “Fucking Grandfather!” I assumed he was referring to all the stuff that needed packing. There were too many people in this dream, it was hectic and unorganized.

I’m in three different class rooms. Sister Mary Wolz, Mr. Szafron, and Angela Letchedtz. I’m in a room coated with sky-blue paint. Sister Mary Wolz is extolling the virtues of Jefferson and Hamilton as her great booming voice projects out over us. I listen to her talk and realize what a supreme imbecile she is. I was right back in grade four. Suddenly, I’m in grade eight at Grand Island High school. Mr. Szafron is teaching us chemistry. I’m next to Jim Engelman my old best friend. Szafron is a pretty bright guy. He’s talking about oxidation-reduction reactions. The room is awfully hot. Eric Hardman is behind us with my neighbor Nicole Calamito. I’m in another room now of Abbot School. Angela Letchedtz is talking about applications of an area of math called Group Theory. She’s so brilliant. She’s showing the geometric representation of this structure. The complex symmetries can be used to create cipher text. Angela is talking with me later and I’m sitting next to her brilliant daughter Alex. I fade off as I listen to her.

Bob and I are at the coffee shop in Clarence Center. We are talking and laughing. He wants to know if I want to go to the Ice Capades. I say, “sure, when?” He says Thursday night. He picks me up at my present home. I’m wearing an aqua colored sweater and jeans and boots. I am at the same house I currently live in. We go to the HSBC arena and it’s packed. He grabs my hand as we go up the escalator. We both feel the shock and I pull away. He looks down at me with a smile. We watch the Ice Capades. During intermission, we go to get a beer. He says we have to talk. I say no, I want to remain friends. He says we can’t because we both feel the emotion between us. We stand in line to get our beer. He puts his hands on my shoulders. The feeling is almost too much to bear. I look up and he is still smiling. We go to walk and drink our beers during intermission. We finish. He grabs me and kisses me passionately while backed up against the wall. My knees are weak; my heart is pounding. I’m melting. He just smiles and says, “We’ll see.” We go back to our sears in silence and watch the show.
This dream had something to do with music. As if I was auditioning at a music study. It wasn’t very clear what I was dong there. I don’t remember a lot of people being there.

I am attending a math seminar which seems to e a continuing dream through wake and sleep. First part of the dream was an interrogation which evaluated participants. Second part, was breaking up the discussion groups to consider why students have difficulty learning math. Third part was our departure which seemed to focus on my taking a shower. I was attracted to a younger lady who was quite verbal and intelligent.

I am with a group of women friends and we got or were honored to get an interview with a special man who will show us this Egyptian tomb. We must travel to Russia and only have a small block of time. I create problems throughout the dream, like a little sister or nuisance. We stop to get food after we arrive in Russia, at a food mart: very small. I wait in line for coffee but the pot is so weak when finished that it looks like water. I go to the cashier and ask if they have Starbucks bottled coffee, she says yes and agrees to give me one for everyone at the same price as regular cup of coffee. However, I realize the one she’s referring to is decaf and I end up taking too long and buying a load of sweatshirts for all of us. When I get to the waiting carload, everyone is quietly pissed off and anxious. We only have one shot to talk with this curator guy. We get on a huge boat and cross choppy seas to get there. We end up missing the appointment; the man waitied for awhile but we were too late. It was my fault. I wake up feeling anxious.

This dream morphed into three different parts: first part myself and other college friends have to complete a research assignment; it’s like a play. My old roommate J.C. is in dream, she is having trouble with the assignment. I want to help her but encounter obstacles during my quest. We live in a communal dorm type setting. The next part of dream we (J.C. and another friend) and I take a drive to my old apartment I used to live in. The place looks deserted but I knew there are caged birds in the back bedroom and I can’t, in good conscious, leave them. We enter and go into back bedroom; I start seeing clothes and lived-in things. Someone does live here. I still get the birds, with help (one is a big green parrot, the other a tiny moth-sized yellow parrot). They both come to us but we have trouble with the tiny yellow one. As we ready to leave, the owner shows up. We meet at the door; he is a young college guy, very quiet with longish brown hair. He is surprised. I say “you must be wondering…?” He smiles and say’s: “you’re the culprit”. Apparently I had done this before. I explain that I used to live there and thought it deserted. We all give back the birds but have to search for the little one. We find it and leave. Third part of dream: we end up leaving and getting terribly lost in this maze of concrete walkways that line the apartments. It’s a huge complex with paved sidewalks leading to different area: dorms, exercise spas, bars, pools (outdoor and in). It’s a crazy mess. I keep taking my shoes off (good tennis shoes) and leaving them in different places. I go through pools and take short cuts around sunbathing college students. I jump paths and am constantly backtracking. I loose J.C. and the other friend. One scene: I go through a huge pool and 2 big football players grab my back and hop on for a piggy back ride. I yell to them to let go and keep walking, trying to shake them. I remember going through a busy sports bar, people everywhere. I try to get back to the parrot house to ask directions but can’t find it. I notice a group of dorms that are different colored: more ruddy red and are The Woodland Dorms. They are nicer and quieter, more mature or for the adult, farther along college student. I never find the way out: I loose my friends and my shoes.

My recurring dream- I’m on a beach. There’s mostly quiet, save for the gentle chatter of the gulls and kingfishers. Suddenly, I look up, see the rising of a great swell and feel water beneath me. White foam is all about me and there’s that sinking feeling in my stomach. I look down and balance myself as the forward movement of the wave send winds ripping past my ears. I am a great lake, an ocean. In the periphery, I sense my childhood home; my parent’s cottage on Lake Erie. The ground becomes more and more distant. The ocean surface a distant blue. Through the troposphere, stratosphere, ionosphere, the tsunami juts out from our tiny blue sphere. Faster and faster, the distance and velocity are relentless. I fade off; I can see Gemini and Draco.

Very jumbled-My old boss DSR is picking up some people in a limo. There is Lynn, Mindy, Angie, Toni, Pudge, Loree, Louise, and Muriel. He is taking them on an afternoon cruise to shmooze them. I am on this ship too. I am elated to see everyone, but warn them about DSR. He is trying to get my attention. I ignore him. Lynn says, “Just talk to him.” I say, “No way, after how he treated me and how evil he is?” Lynn says he’s not that bad. I am mortified that she disregards his behavior. I tell them all he is as sly as a fox and to be very careful. They assure me they are along for the ride only. He (DRS) comes up to me and whispers in my ear (with a fake smile on his face), “I’ve got them and you’ll never get them back.” I said, “Don’t count on it.” The trip is over. The limo pulls up and the girls get in. They wave to me. I am sad for all of them.

I am driving in a car, on a college campus, sitting in the very back of a convertible (longer, older model), blue in color. The driver does not know I have “hitched” a ride. She stops for gas and I hop out. She says something like “I saw you in the mirror and thought you must be a young one.” She was not mad. I pulled out a wad of money, old twenties, and newer tens and fives. I gave her a crisp $5 bill for gas and thanked her for the ride. It was daytime; there was more before: being on a campus. Dreamed about the different working parts to the brain and all the operating functions. The use of bungee-cords were shown to me and I remember thinking how complex yet how small the brain is and that there is no way to show all working functions on a diagram.

I had a pretty goofy dream last night. Mom says I should draw a picture with one scene fading into the next, but I don’t know how on earth I’d ever do that. But anyway, here’s how it unfolded. First, I was walking with Jack down the winding path on 26th Ave. We were talking about trees and houses and stuff. His voice was weaker and more frail than in reality, and it grew weaker as we walked. I remember we were contented, just strolling along. I felt at peace just being with him, but I kept thinking, “We’ve got to get back to his house and let him rest.” Then, next thing I knew, I was with Dad, in this old dilapidated house.
