It belonged to someone on the Neighborhood board who’s close to Dad, but I wasn’t sure who. They’d gone off for the summer and asked Dad to babysit the house in the meantime. Dad was there to fix a refrigerator, of all things! I felt that I remembered an upright piano in this house. Although it would most likely be beat-up and out-of-tune, I was anxious to practice on it while Dad fixed the fridge. I believe he was looking forward to hearing me too. So I began to look for it. In the place where I remembered it being, there was instead a computer workstation on top of a small chest of drawers. For some reason, I sat down before the equipment thinking that somehow I could try to play anyway! But instead of the keys, my hands touched a covered printer. On top of the printer I found a toilet brush! So I looked all over the house for that mysterious upright, even behind the couches in the living room which were pulled away from the wall!! (The living room looked a lot like Linda’s). I began to give up hope, standing in the middle of the living room. But then I remembered that the house owners had donated it to the hotel across the street from us, that was about to be demolished. (Really, it was demolished 3 years ago and is now townhomes.) Since the building was coming down in a matter of weeks, Dad and I felt we had the right to snoop through it. (Dad really did snoop through the real building, retrieving armfuls of useful stuff, especially good lumber from the floors!!) So I felt that after he fixed the fridge, we could go over to the hotel building and I could practice on it anyway. I even thought that we could just retrieve it altogether the way Dad did the wood from the floors! Then, I slowly woke up.

Our cousin Tina drove up from S.C. with her husband (who in the dream, is a different man- Russell Swatworth-someone I grew up with). They were coming and I wanted to make sure I had enough food. I was debating on ham or chicken or turkey. Kevin’s mom is there. She starts preparing the food. We are at my grandmother’s house. I have to pee in a box. The basement is completely empty except for this box. I make several trips downstairs to pee in this box. Tina and Russell’s car is acting up. We take our car and look for a restaurant where a family gathering was being held. We got lost. The road leads nowhere. It just stops. I want to go one way and Kevin wants to go another. There are three options. We take Kevin’s and it’s wrong. We circle back and find the restaurant. It’s a run down place. Kevin’s mom said it was very regal. We go in and at first, we can’t find anyone. There are shower curtains to close off rooms. We find the kitchen and realize that we forgot the ham. I send Kevin back home and in the meantime, Verna arrives. The place is full of relatives from Germany. I have to go to the bathroom. Tina and both the girls, who are wearing prom dresses, go with me. People keep coming in while I’m trying to go to the bathroom. I get some toilet paper. As I unwind some paper, a curtain closes around the toilet for privacy. Now I am in the kitchen with a few relatives from Germany along with Kevin and his mom. One gal is talking to Kevin about living his whole life on a boat in Germany and never receiving any mail. Mom says, “You know who’s missing here?” The gal says, “Hans. He couldn’t make it.” Kevin’s mom screams, “Les! Les is dead!”

I see a baby’s arm reach out from my tummy, stretching. I can clearly make out the arm and I am amazed at how far it stretches: like she’s reaching out and showing herself to me. Then I am with many others and there are 5 brothers and one is evil. The evil or suspicious one has made a huge puzzle/train contraption. It looks like a huge model set: long table that water flows through and over; the table has high sides. You have to get onto the table and play the game. We find out there is a leak, it’s a big deal: where is the water running out, what is it affecting, and who did it? The evil brother lives underneath the table and controls the puzzle. He is or has caused the leak and is using the water to gain somehow. One scene: I have longer, curly hair and it is down (I always wear my hair up, most of the time). It looks good and I get several compliments. There is some kind of relationship between me and the bad brother but can’t put my finger on it. [Note: beg. of recurring hair dreams and creation myth theme of the quintessence, alchemy, see Von Franz]
Dreamed about bats: people using bats for different purposes. There were 2 separate groups of bats and each had an evil or sinister side; like the bats were evil but not outwardly.

I’m in some classroom and the teacher is talking but I’m not listening. The teacher’s hand begins to whiz by. Looking at the face, I realize I don’t recognize him/her; I’m just sitting there in a daze. My legs feel like jello, like I’ve been sitting here forever. There’s a nearby window, it’s quite nondescript. The grass turns from a lush green to a desiccated brown. I try to listen but I can’t. I’m so out of it, so punch drunk. I fade off.
101. Selling homes, I set up a clothing rack in the vacant houses, with credit cards that start with the word "vacant."

102. I want to move my parents’ boat(?) to a new place with beach access or at least a good pool. Every time we move it, I leave it plugged in, but it just unplugs itself without breaking. At one point I’m going to buy the house up on the hill(?).

Bob and I are at a party at his house. Bob is playing the piano and in a tux. I do not know anyone at the party. Bob introduces me and I feel very comfortable. Everyone is dressed to the nine’s; tuxes, cocktail dresses, etc. It’s me, but not physically. I’m different. Taller, older (55?) and fit. Bob is tall, lanky, with an easy smile. There are waiters at the party and one old woman named Mrs. Goldstien. Her husband (who is deceased) was a hot shot where Bob works at the firm. No one is sitting by her so I go over to visit. We have a lovely chat and she is charming, but very direct. She tells me, “They are all afraid of me.” We laugh and I see Bob watching from a distance. He just smiles. Mrs. Goldstien says it’s time for her to go. I walk her to the door and she says goodbye with a hug and kiss. She tells Bob that I’m a keeper. He smiles and says he’s trying. The rest of the guests leave. It’s just Bob and me. We go out on the deck. The stars and scenery are beautiful. I am very anxious. He puts his arms around me from behind. I rest my head on his chest. He tells me he loves me. He says he didn’t know when it happened since we had been friends for quite sometime, but he is. He tells me he know I’m scared but to please trust him. I relax and am not saying anything. He starts kissing my head, then my neck. His embrace gets tighter. He turns me around and kisses me. I am melting. I kiss him back and almost pass out. We are locked together. He unzips my dress. I take off his tie and shirt. We are on the deck. I am in my black bra and panties. He is shirtless. The emotions are heavy. He unsnaps my bra. I wake up! I’m just about overheated. I get a drink and wash my face.
I am a football coach and I have called a get-together for all the coaches. We need to brain storm how we can improve team performance.

Dream revolved around Dan: Leah was taking me out to dinner at a very expensive fine dining restaurant. She orders a full meal and desert: chocolate mousse/truffles or something like that. She eats her dinner way too fast and leaves me: I feel lost, upset, why did she set this up if she wasn’t going to stay? I realize it’s Feb. 13th, my birthday, and Dan is due to show. The time rolls by, but he never shows. I am extremely upset and cry, sob, wondering why he forgot. All of this is happening while I sit at this beautiful restaurant alone with my favorite desert in front of me.

I am in Italy, staying at a hotel with my sister Leah, although she doesn’t seem prominent in dream. We are visiting or are visitors; Dan owns a restaurant and hotel there. I stay one night in hotel room, I remember the furniture and how I had messed things up or dirtied in some way. Dan works every day at the restaurant and we are not married but it feels similar to last dream: unable to capture his attention, not on his mind, unloved in a way. On the second night we meet up and spend all night awake in same hotel room. I get his undivided attention; we talk and enjoy our company. At sunrise we lie on the couch together and look out window: I see mountains, beautiful colors: blue, green, and other shades. I am content. Then I ask if he has to work the next day. I never knew he had days off. He says yes but then looks for his cell phone thinking he might get a call from the man who was replacing his shift. He can’t find it. I remember seeing it in a chair and look every where. He becomes more and more agitated as we look. Dream ends. I woke thinking we had another telepathic dream…he said no but he had been looking for his cell all the day before and I was not aware of it.

103. I go outside for something and see some people walk by. I tell them I'm a real estate agent and they come back. I collect their info., what they're looking for, the man wants a house all updated. I tell him we can look for a house a little below his budget and hire painters. I skip away on my tiptoes.
I am a school principal and I have called a faculty meeting. Purpose is how we can improve student performance.

I am waiting in line to buy tickets to a rock concert (old band like The Rolling Stones). It’s close to midnight and I get to counter, buy tickets and notice the music has stopped. The ticket counter person tells me the show will start up much later; they are taking a break. So I wait, not wanting to enter the stadium but feeling lost. I meet up with a beautiful woman. Next scene I am putting on makeup to make me look pretty, but I am or look like a man: large, taller, with blondish, short, curly, and shaggy at the ears hair (40-something). I put on makeup and it looks fake, terrible. I am able to make it blend finally but there’s no denying the short manly hair, etc. The woman makes me feel okay and I follow her around; she’s part of the tour or something.

I am at a huge school, mostly in gym area (like a HS) with huge stairways leading to the locker rooms and basketball court. I am new, don’t really fit in well and can sense animosity among the other girls. One scene: I find a bat in one of the offices; I put out my hand so he will fly to me, thinking he’s smart enough to know I’m there to rescue him. He does, right on my hand. I take him to a lower level and let him rest. Next scene: co-ed, we are told there’s a dance and boys are to select which girls. There is a boy I really like: he reminds me of the first real (5th grade) boyfriend I had named Scott. There is another, popular, cocky boy that all the girls like (blonde). Another girl and I are sitting with him; my legs are upon a couch and he sits opposite and wraps one leg under mine while talking to us. I figure he’ll ask the other girl. I really don’t care about him. Then he starts talking: “we are total opposites and I think it would be good for both of us, I think it would work.” He looks at me and I look quizzical: the other girl asks: “What do you mean? Who are you talking about?” He looks at me and says: “You; what do you think, will you go with me and try?” The other girl screams; she is very mad, jumps off the couch. Other girls are heard yelling and screaming. I sit and think for awhile trying to make sense of his words and meaning. Yes, we are opposites. That would be very interesting and we could bring some challenges and learn a lot from each other. I forget about the other guy: he’s too predictable and easy. Next scene I realize the bat needs to be let out. I go and get him and this time notice his wings are tagged. He’s got a medical tag with a positive (+) sign, like for blood type and other info about the handler. I wonder about where he came from. I run up and down stairways, into offices, to find an open window but to no avail. I find an emergency exit but don’t want to bring notice to myself as I pass it up. I finally find a window and let him fly. Next scene I find the blonde, walk up to him real close and say: “Ok, I’ll try.” I realize I had been chosen four times by the other boys, which is announced on the loud speaker in gym area. Girls are mad again. Next scene is a physical exam or test. I do everything except for one more move but I really didn’t need to: I felt like I needed to prove myself. The blonde has same issues: one more move left. We both come together and the coach takes us aside. We try to do the moves. He assures us it’s not really needed.

It’s winter and my dad is there. He brings three snowmobiles that are yellow. We are going on a ride. There is a young couple with two kids. We have a crib to pull with the snowmobile for the kids. The one girl doesn’t want to wear her helmet. Her father says she can’t go. She cries and carries on and he sticks to his guns. She puts the helmet on and then won’t put her snowsuit on. Dad and I leave and tell them to catch up. Now the snowmobiles wont’ start. Dad fiddles with them and off we go. We can hear the girl screaming as we leave.

There has been a terrible rain storm and I am returning to my home to clean up the area. When I get there, I see that the house is pretty much destroyed. We clean up what we can. The scene is very discouraging.

104. I go in the car with my parents. We get a late start, go to the beach. I might get back together with Dave Schiller, but he has lots of stuff. Also, he might inherit all his brother's stuff. We go through it. I spend most of the time in the car. There's a pool that needs hand rails, Instead of one in the middle, it needs two - one on each side of the steps.

I am a truck driver and the trick is trying to negotiate the roads under construction especially in the cities. One situation was very difficult because the street was very narrow and at the end of the street, there was a very sharp curve.

This dream seems to be a mixture of skiing and Muslims. In some confusing way, the Muslims help me with my skiing and I in turn, am required to bring peace and understanding to the Muslim people. I become very good friends with five Muslim men. Reconnecting with the rest of the Muslim people is much more complicated. Dream ends.
105. dream one - I go around looking at houses. There's another woman doing the same thing. I might be able to sell her a house too.

106. dream two - I go to a house where I live and work with other people. One man comes in to use the bathroom. I take him to show him some empty rooms and bathrooms. Outside the back door some people are taking care of an aviary. We say hi to them.

I find myself in an undefined time. Skies are always dark. I’m visiting my friend Bob in prison. Outside the barred windows, great rundown industrial complexes stretch out to the horizon. I’m outside his cell, pleading with him, trying to get him to let me spring him. I suddenly remember the year is 2030. Earlier in the morning, I had heard that the avian flu had swept the west coast. I hear the new age intercoms, a picture of a dead child and her mother after a train-ride from Pittsburgh to Detroit. I watched the wind outside the prison and was reminded of their subsequent cremation in Windsor. Now he’s out and I’m covered in blood. We’re in a friend of mine’s basement in Thunder Bay. I sit there – a realization so visceral and uncontainable bursts out and chills me to my very center. Everyone is gone, everyone but me.

107. I go to see a listing and the owner is an artist - she gives me some artwork. I want to go back and get another copy, but she charges $42. In another part, I go to a gathering. Steve Hulberg is supposed to get some pot. I see him roll a joint but then he disappears. Someone passes me a roach and I take a hit from it. Another woman and I walk to the car, which is parked outside in the parking lot. Some ex-ISKCON people are there.

108. I live in a big apartment complex. Lots of parts to the dream where I go to a party, see my grandmother, etc. Later I come home and the apartment manager offers me apartment seven if I want it. I go see it - the apartment is right on one of the pools. Lots of people. I pick up my mail - books, etc.

I’m back in my clerical life. I may be in a monastery. I’m dressed in my Franciscan brown habit and we are praying in common. The breviary is our prayer book which is a very tricky prayer book to negotiate. I am next to an old friar friend, Claude. Since I am not really confident in using the prayer book, I am depending on Claude to help me. I wake up

I awake and I’m somewhere in a great body of water. Breakers that mimic great seiches move me fifty-some yards. Looking out over the endless dark water I descry nothing that resembles land. However far I swim, like the universe, everything is symmetrical. It’s like I’ve been treading water. I turn on my back and float, looking up at all the nothingness.

109. I'm at a temple and write a large manuscript. The leaders tell me they reviewed it and it can't be published/written. Too many plot points, too much liability. I want to write it anyway at my own risk. After everyone leaves, I scramble to try to find the manuscript. The other women keep it for me and I pick it up. It's a huge stack of papers with notes and tags and paper clips.

I’m in a garden with beautiful flowers. All colors and sizes. It is so peaceful and smells are soothing to me. I am in awe of the vibrant colors and the care and love that went into this garden. I wander around and admire the flowers. It is just the flowers and me and I am in a very peaceful state.

We’re sitting in an old wine cellar and I’m holding a conversation with a video game character, Kos-mos. She speaks in an aloof monotone. Now and then, however, there is a bit of feeling. “Galen, do you need to feel pain to be complete?” We sit there. In this dimly lit basement, her blue hair gives off an almost ethereal quality. “Will we ever get out of here?” I ask. She answers, “99.9998 probability no”. She’s almost motionless now, as if the fuel of her being is gone. “Goodbye Galen, shutting down.” I’m all-alone now.

110. I go visit some people who have dogs for sale. The dogs are very nice and well trained. In one part I go to a school with my mom and we get separated. Then I can't find her. I find the car. Then I find my cell phone and try to call her.

Linda Taylor, a former co-worker, her daughter Jen, and her husband Bill and I are looking for a car for Jen. Jen wants a brand new sports car; Bill wants to buy a Jetta. Linda Taylor wants her to get an SUV. I tell them my first car cost me a hundred dollars and it was used. They are going to buy Jen a brand new car. I can’t believe a girl in school is getting a new car. I’m feeling jealous and slighted.

I am heading home alone. I have two choices: I can go through the woods or I can take a winding road. Because I have a wheel barrel, I decide going through the woods would be difficult to manage. So, I end up taking the winding road. This is a good choice and I get home in record time, where I am very happy to be.

My most recent absurd dream was the other night. During the day, Jack was talking about how unruly middle school kids are, so that may be why I dreamt about being back at my middle school. In my dream, I needed to return to my middle school to take one class that I had failed, and nobody brought it to my attention while I moved on to high school. In the building, the floors, walls and ceiling were carpeted with thick, dark carpet. There were little lanterns at the ends of the halls. The stairwells were more like ladders. The former principal was leading me by the arm, giving me a tour. Another lady had hold of my other arm. They were very friendly and glad to have me back, but they were very protective. They guided me as though I were very delicate and weak, physically. Just as I was about to settle into some classroom, I realized that I didn’t have anything I needed. Furthermore, I realized that the school was about to conduct a fire drill, and so I was running to the back of the building. I think I was suddenly juxtaposed to the high school’s bus circle before awakening.

111. First, looking at listings with clients. It all becomes confusing, who is who, what listing is for what, etc. Then Steve Gelberg, Gina Catena, and I receive our Ph.D.s and then go to a house where there are a lot of people. A lot of people are swimming in a big pool, so I go in. I am swimming around with a big log, but it sinks. I get out and go back to find they drained the whole pool to get the log out.
112. I go to visit some people and must hurry and get ready. I one part, a monster comes, determined to destroy people. Scary.

I’m in our screen room watching the neighbors. Brent, the dad is in the yard under a car working. Arianna his daughter, gets in his work truck and starts it up and puts it in reverse. She starts to back out. I jump up and yell for Brent. We move-run to the truck. Brent pulls Arianna out and shuts the truck off. Her mother, Deb, comes out of the house and grabs Ari and hugs her. I am very upset. I grab Ari and giver her a spanking. She is mortified that I spanked her. She is crying so hard. Both Deb and Brent are looking at me because I spanked her. I tell them both that she should have gotten a spanking. I wake up just as I go to hug Ari.

I am a guest at a family dinner. This dinner is under the supervision of a family patriarch. What is strange about this situation is that every time something disruptive happens, the patriarch breaks a glass on the table. This happens a couple of times and I wake up.

I’m with my brother Ethan and we’re at my maternal grandparent’s old house on Lake Ontario. We’re playing on the neighbor’s bluff when we both recognize what appears to be an opening in the side of a nearby embankment. Upon nearing it, Ethan decides he doesn’t want to go inside. It’s a tunnel and I head in. I crawl along some way emerging in my grandfather’s study. He’s alive. He’s watching a football game and I sit there happily watching with him. I fade off.

I see myself as a Franciscan and a doctor. I am in a hospital trying to find a resident who is giving a lecture in his room. It seems like I spend the whole dream walking the corridors, trying to find the doctor’s room. Eventually I spot someone who directs me to the room. I wake up.
113. A listing is calling me, like I get my first listing. It's near one of the houses we saw at the caravan.

I’m on vacation. It’s fall, and I’m looking out over the dying fire of autumn. I’m in Allegheny on Summit Trail. The Stiller’s are here. Keith is chopping wood with Nick, and Tahnee and Josh cook hobo sandwiches over the fire. It must be nearly six; all the green that summer burned to red over the hills to the east is nearly out. It’s nice being here. My parent’s are inside with Joanne. It was such a nice trip, such a nice place. Why does it feel like the saddest time of year? Because it’s twilight and all the happiness is just gonna burn out soon? Campfire songs- I can hear them. Spring’s first green is gold, her hardest hue to hold. I’m falling asleep. I’m in an office, not mine, but an office. There is a large copy machine. It is very large and spits out copies at a very fast rate. I am standing , watching the machine work. I am mesmerized by the machine. It goes faster and faster. I go into the machine and come out as paper.

I’m laying on a sofa in one of the sitting rooms at Fredonia. It’s past midnight and I’m trying to keep calm. 153. I was working backstage for a play and Mrs. Benncort kept getting mad.

I am in a room with kittens. The room is big and bright with kittens crying, playing, and sleeping. I close my eyes and they are now grown cats. The cats are meowing and playing. I turn my back and when I turn around, they are kittens again. This scene repeats several times.

This scene is a school. I am attending a sporting activity, a hockey game. For some reason, I left the game early. As I was walking out , I passed a long table. Sitting on one side of the table were people manning telephones- fundraising, I believe. One of those persons was a priest friend of mine (Fr. Butch) who winked at me as I passed by. I wake up.

Alex and I are on the QEW going through Toronto. It’s 2001, Summer. We’re heading toward the Garden Expressway toward Dufferin. I believe the scene of this dream is a minor seminary. What is strange about this episode is that this is an Anglican Seminary. I am assuming I have been loaned out to the Anglicans by my diocese as a theology teacher. This is a beautiful building- hallways, chapel, classrooms are almost majestic. I recall three incidences: One, I am arriving at the seminary, walking up a magnificent staircase singing a song with a friend (who also has been loaned to the Seminary); Two, I am walking into a classroom in which a number of Seminarians are waiting for me; Three, I am getting ready to participate in a liturgical service. I wake up.

I have been recruited by the FBI for some kind of a project. I don’t know what this project is. What I do know is that I’m going to be taken by car to some location where I will be transferred to a sailboat. The transfer is somewhat exciting. Our station wagon stalls and we are forced to abandon it. As we leave the car, we see a sailboat heading for us. Once the sailboat reaches us, I climb aboard with a few others. This next part takes place in a bar (I hate bars). I seem to be waiting for someone. Some patrons are singing jazz tunes, so I decide to play some jazz tunes on the piano. I wake up.

I’m at my class reunion. I am dressed in jeans getting the room ready. The other committee members are helping me but they’re dressed in their party clothes. We are in a carnival-like setting. They asked about the centerpieces. I said they never came to my house and I forgot to call them. They said to forget it. I go into the hotel to talk tot the banquet manager. I go into one of the rooms. They have the names on the door. Our class is not listed. I ask the manager what is going on. He says, “Don’t worry, this party will be over soon and we can eat the leftovers.” I say, “No way! We want fresh food, linens, etc.” He says to me , “Where are the centerpieces?” I respond, “I don’t have them.” He tells me the tables will be bare. I go into the bathroom to change into my good clothes. All the stalls are full. I am so frustrated at this point. I start talking to a few people from my class. They tell me not to worry about changing my clothes that I looked fine. I wake up frustrated and angry.
134. Lots of dreams - lots of people - a class (?) a big house - can't remember now.

I am really happy with myself. I have just finished polishing my kitchen floor and hallway. This is something I have been wanting to do for weeks. Meanwhile, someone has brought me a cookie baking sheet full of baked cherries. For some reason I keep shaking the cookie sheet and the syrup from the cherries drips off the counter onto my clean floor. When I realize this, I get very aggravated. I wake up.

I awake next to Lisa; it’s all real to me but there’s a sense of de-realization about this moment. I walk downstairs as she continues to sleep. The curtains are drawn; still tiny distillations of light pry their way through. I feel stressed. We’re buying a house next week, getting married next month. God, I think, I need to get out of this. This relationship is gonna ruin my life. I sit there, my heart pounding. I feel bad for thinking this way. She’s just trying to be happy. There’s a clock on the south wall, it registers five thirty in the morning. I’ll stay down her for awhile. I go and pull back the curtains. The early morning light greets me. It warms my chest. It burns my eyes. I’m falling to pieces here.

135. I'm on an SATW trip. First they take us out to breakfast, then drop us at the hotel. I get the key and wait at the elevator. No elevator comes for a long time. One stops half way between floors and one of the men says not to get on because it could be a drug deal. I go down a floor and wait there for the elevator. When it finally comes, I get on but panic because I can't remember my floor. I get the key and see my room is 602. One of the men tells me that men like to talk to me more than their own wives.

I had quite a dream last night. I would have said fantastic, but I’m not so sure that’s what it is. I’m not so sure what to call it. In my dream, Sheryl, Sandra and Sam were all staying with us again, but they were all out somewhere. Sam had a harmonica and a small accordion that I thought that he played regularly when I was little. (Both the harmonica and the accordion have timbres that remind me of the color orange. In the wrong context they could fringe on the scary side.) So he had them in a small case in the bathroom closet. I had a very strong feeling that I wanted to take them out, study them, try to play them, etc, but I also was a bit afraid to try. When I opened the case, I found a card, which I couldn’t read, but I felt that it contained the words to M. C. Hammer’s “Have You Seen Her.” There was a small orbital sander stored with these instruments, which I felt could be used to add to the orange timbre. Promptly, I put the case away. I feared the sander more than either of the instruments. (In this dream, my room had the twin beds of my childhood). Mom and I were laying on one of the beds. She had found the Music Major keyboard’s manual which I had written in. I can’t remember, but it seemed like she’d found a sketch pad I’d kept in the box with the manual. The sketch pad, dedicated to the frail little machine, contained a few stories that I wrote and illustrated, depicting how I’d found it in some dark hiding place, brought it out and dusted it off, and then connected it to the sound system in the living room and gave some little concert where fairies gathered to listen! (In reality, it had no audio outputs.) There were stories about other things too, for instance, a bunny turned into a prince and tended stray chickens in the woods! I even drew and told of the harmonica and the accordion. My pictures were happy and giddy, like the ones I drew for the receiver and all. As she thumbed through it, I was very embarrassed, but she valued this work very much. I began to slowly awaken.

136. Something about traveling with a bunch of people. Trying to find food, trying to get a bathroom, not sleeping enough. Looking at houses, talking to the people who want to buy a home with RV gate.

Kevin and I are traveling in a very different way. We are traveling by water; no boats, but slides and our own bodies. We are going over mountains, hills and flat lands. I don’t remember where we are going, but it is by water. Sometimes we are on an open water-type slide where we can see the scenery, other times it is closed like at a water park. There is always a gate-keeper at each section. Some are friendly, some are not. We are waiting our turn at this one section. The current is very strong. I am telling Kevin it will be alright, not to worry. We go to the top and the gate keeper says that I have to remove my sneakers. They are red. I say no way. I will never see them again. He stays calm and tells me no red sneakers are to be worn in this part of the journey. I tell him that is ridiculous. He says “that’s the rule”. He will send them through the journey after we get to the end. I am very sad and Kevin yells and tells me to quit arguing and get going. I tell Kevin , “You don’t understand what these red sneakers mean to me.” I am very sad and angry. We go on our journey. I am having a blast. Kevin is not having as much fun. We get to the end of this part of the journey and I wait for my red sneakers. They don’t come. I wait very patiently. Finally, they come down the chute. I am so happy.

I can even discern the tiny orbitals of water spinning like tops in these vast stretches of water. Then I’m flung immeasurably far and fast. I’m barely aware of my body, just the rising swell that lurches forward and up. The spray whitens, water eddies twirl, polar jet stream mistrals collide, oscillate and whirl; higher and higher. I’m no longer human; like a great telescope or satellite and survey a tiny blue sphere wreathed in white. A wave carries a powerful lens on into the infinite.

I think I am walking through a college campus with a friend. As we walk, we become aware that someone is following us on a skateboard. Both of us are concerned that this person means to harm us. I am at a hotel and my mother and I are planning a baby shower for a daughter of a girl she graduated with (I don’t know this person). I am now in a musical play. The girls hold up signs which have red and white lettering that spell out “WINSTON”. The guy laughs and says, “Welcome to the show.”

I am going to a meeting at BPW. I am feeling slightly nervous about going to the meeting due to the fact that I never returned several phone calls to a former BPW member regarding LTC insurance. I’m thirty- two now, two years has passed, and all I’ve been doing is studying theoretical and engineering physics. I lose time. Milo is trying to convince me to detonate an Improvised Nuclear Device in Hamilton. I remember being filled with such hate that we did it. Watching from some anonymous ranger tower in Grimsby, we watch the light taking all the citizenry to pieces and despite all the quiet of this particular twilight, I can hear the wretching up of blood, the impact on lungs that will never heal and the cancer that you don’t recover from. In an instant, tin the quiet of this wood, I shudder and curse this reality.

In this dream, I am in a Pre-Vatican II chapel. This means the altar is facing the wall and the priest says the liturgy with his back to the people. In post Vatican II chapel, the liturgy is said at a table and the priest faces the people. The irony of this dream is that I was saying mass with my back to the people which I hated.

I am at a school on a huge campus. It’s cold and snowy outside. I park my car and start walking to my next class. I’m nervous because I think today’s class is the final since I have missed the last two classes. I’m running late so I decide to take a short cut. There is a fence with broken slots and barbed wire. If I go around, I will be late. If I go through it, I’ll be on time. I decide to go through it. I get stuck. There is a huge farmhouse on the property and a smaller house. The folks in the big house come, but with a camera to take my picture. They are angry that I broke the fence. I said, “No, I didn’t break the slats. They were already broken.” They help me with my book bag to get out of the fence. We go into the house and they agree that I didn’t that I didn’t break the fence. They said, “I’m sure you can understand our position.” There is a wife, husband and father. The wife asked me if I take medication. I said yes and told her the two pills I take. She asked if I took vitamins. I said I take Mega-woman in the fall through winter and spring months. She brings out a pill box with two sides; one side had two compartments with my two pills in it for a week’s supply. The other side had seven compartments with a variety of vitamins. I wrote her a check for ten dollars. She asked me if I have seen Ray Fry lately. I said no and she said he owes me tons of money. I go into the small house and my friend Beth is there with her boyfriend. He is a slob. The house is a mess and dirty ( Beth is a neat freak). There are kids everywhere and a few people in with us. Beth says money is tight so I’m babysitting. There is a bed in the dining room where we are sitting. Her boyfriend Rich, is in the bed eating and making a mess. Beth goes to get my Tupperware container. She brings it back and it is not clean. I take it anyway. I go to leave and a jeep pulls up. Beth asks me to help her with two of the folks in w/c. We get them down the stairs, all the while, Rich is yelling at us how to do it while he continues to stuff his face in bed and make a mess. We get them out to the jeep. The driver pushes a button and the front and back open up from inside the jeep. Both w/c fit in the space and he pushes the button and they get folded into the jeep. I wave and continue on my way to school.

I am at a party. Seems to be a family affair. I am sitting with Priscilla, my ex-wife. For some reason, Priscilla leaves and her twin sister sits down in her place. I get the idea that she doesn’t want Priscilla to sit next to me. Eventually, I walk away with someone I don’t know.

It’s late summer and I’m swimming in the Niagara River; I’m going to cross it. I can hear the distant roar of an outboard motor; the sun is heavy in the west. The clouds seem to coalesce in the deep red sky. I’m dong the sidestroke. Unlike the common perception, the sky appears to be as a great dome; a half-sphere. It’s like I’m not swimming anywhere. Then there’s rain, out of nowhere it comes and I head for the shore. I’m being swept dangerously close to the North Grand Island Bridge. I see hotel lights by the shoreline and make my way closer and closer. I can feel my body now, the burning in my lungs, but I can’t make it. Past the point of no return and I fade off.

Last night I had a dream that the three of us, and Cassie and Penny were going to High Springs for Mom’s birthday. We were driving around in the car, and all of the colors were bright and fake and I was thinking now this has got to be a dream. So all of a sudden, it was evening time, and I was riding on the tandem with Dad, and I couldn’t stay on. I kept falling off. Finally, we arrived at this festival where a band was playing. The band was really good, somebody was playing a B3 in a really cool funky way! Cassie said, “Follow me,” and led me all through all kinds of obstacles, like craft booths, little aisles and bushes. I thought she was leading me to the FOH booth, but instead, I realized we were in some kind of a physical therapy booth, showcasing equipment! Next thing I knew, I couldn’t find my way out of this booth. I’d lost sight of Mom and Dad, and Cassie had run off and left me there. I started making my way toward the band shell, when suddenly the scene changed. I was then in Edith’s cellar, falling asleep while watching this Creation movie where there were all kinds of extra lights that go with it. Before any of this though, there was a scene that disturbed me very much. Mom and I were sitting at the kitchen table, and she stepped on my foot, unintentionally. She apparently gave me an affectionate touch, but she didn’t realize that there were thousands of tiny needles on the bottom of her foot! They protruded from her skin as she tensed her muscle. This was brief and bizarre, but it shocked me because it’s totally foreign. I think it came from that crazy NPR story about research monkeys with artificial mothers.

I am at my grandparents house. I am at the bottom of the stairs in their house. The stairs are worn. The paint is rubbed off in spots from years of use. The stairs are much larger in my dream than they were in real life. I am at the bottom of the stairs just looking up. I can’t seem to bring myself to take the first step to climb them. I continue to stare at the steps without moving.

Paul, my eldest son, is teaching religion. Paul is now 29 and a resident doctor at Walter Reed Hospital. As a teenager he taught religion for about four years. Anyway, he thinks that teaching religion now as a doctor is really cool.

I’m ten years old. My family has just moved from Niagara Falls to Grand Island. I’m sitting behind the old shed. Anne and Kate McGarrigle are singing; my mom is playing their French record. Twenty minutes from now, I think, I’ll get up and walk to my new room. “La Jean ille et lo du soleil” The girl and the sun thirty-seven days from now and I’ll be on the bus and heading to my new school. I’m thinking there behind the garage; it’s the summer of ’86. A scarlet tanager lands beside me looking pensively at several tall blades of grass. The lights are all dying around me, the music is still playing but now it’s Harry Chapin, “Flowers are red young man, and green leaves are green”. Fourteen years from now I’ll be in a hospital room with my dying grandmother. I look up into the night sky at Virgo- of light intended for the trilobites. I’m getting tired…falling away.

A group of teachers and I have opened a school. As we approach opening day, we realize that we are not ready or sufficiently organized for teaching a student body. So, I have the responsibility to call the faculty to come together and develop a curriculum and program strategies to meet the educational requirements of the state. So, I call together all the heads of departments along with teachers to meet our responsibilities.

144. - I only remember part of it - an illustration of how someone went down in an airplane. His wife saw it - he climbed up above a pointed cloud and then dove. This might have something to do with the long political discussion Sallie and I had last night. In the dream, the cloud was illustrated like this.

Very weird and scary. I’m in a graveyard on top of a hill. I am trying to catch my cousin’s daughter, Mendre. She keeps running away from me. I finally catch her and put her in a coffin. She is paralyzed and cannot move, but knows what is happening. I tell her I am sorry but this has to be done. I put her in the coffin and she falls through five coffins and into the ground. I feel terrible. I can’t believe I’m doing this. I’m evil. I go to a green house and everyone there is asking if I have seen Mendre. I lie and tell them I haven’t seen her. I still can’t believe how evil I am. I go to the cemetery to release Mendre and the people in the green house show up. They start chasing me. I am crying and telling them I am so sorry for what I have done. I wake up crying. My throat is dry and I can’t get back to sleep.

I don’t remember this dream too clearly. It seems to have involved a romantic episode with a woman that I’m not sure I knew. This fact of not knowing the person always amuses me. I always believe (at this time in my life), that having a romantic relation with someone I knew would be difficult enough, but with someone I didn’t know, would be a miracle!

I’m on a beach in Newfane on Lake Ontario. I’m skipping rocks with my brother Ethan. We’re talking about taking the canoe down Eighteen Mile Creek. I’m going to watch the Chargers play the Dolphins at four with my grandfather. Ethan pulls out a map that I made of the surrounding area. There’s a small stream just east of here. I can smell the mixture of seaweed and decomposing fish. There’s something deeply nostalgic about this scene. As we near the canoe, I fade away.
145. Slept a lot and had some important dreams I can't remember now.

Bob and I are at the coffee shop where we have been meeting as friends for a short time. He asks me to go to the Ice Capades. I tell him okay so we plan to go Friday night. He said he would pick me up. We go to the arena and it’s packed. We are both dressed in jeans and sweaters. I almost get lost in the crowd. Bob grabs my hand. We both are shocked at the feeling we both get from contact. I pull away. We go to our seats to watch the show. At intermission, we go to get a beer. I’m in front and he casually puts his hands on my shoulders and I sort of lean back into him. I think to myself, “What are we doing? I don’t want a relationship, just friendship”. I turn to him to tell him that and he says, “I know what you are going to say. Let’s just enjoy the show.” We head back to our seats and he pulls me aside and kisses me. I am over the moon, my heart is racing. I’m feeling giddy. He smiles and we head back to our seats. I say nothing, just stare ahead. WE come back to my house and I start to tell him how I feel and I wake up.

There see to be a number of people in this dream. We are in a room just hanging out. Then, the dream changes to a group of people doing relaxing exercises. I end up with my son’s girlfriend who is very stressed out. ( She is a Buffalo State student who is compulsive about getting a 4.0). I remember she was having difficulty standing up, so I tried to help her maintain her balance. My efforts work. I wake up.

146. I want to get a condo and it will become part of the steamboat world. The building is stationary but several boats could advertise - "Come on down to the river," etc. I start to talk to a man who works there. He knows everything. I start to explain to him who my family is.

It seems that I have been employed along with Priscilla, my ex-wife, by the Episcopal Church to start up a pre-school. So much of my dream is occupied with getting the endeavor off the ground. An interesting part of the dream was the fact that Priscilla’s dad was also helping us. He is ninety-one.

I’m in a house with lots of windows. The house is beautiful. The scenery is breathtaking. There is the ocean, fall leaves, beautiful flowers, mountains, etc. It is so beautiful it takes my breath away. I try to go outside and I can’t. I go to the window and look out, yearning to touch the leaves, run into the water, climb the mountains and smell the flowers. I am so sad that I can’t do this. I press my face against the window and blow my breath to fog it up. I wipe the steam/fog away and the beautiful scenery is still there. The ache in my heart is almost too much to handle. I can feel the warmth of the sun on the window. I take a chair to break the window. It is like rubber…it doesn’t break. I am so sad. I lay my forehead on the glass and close my eyes. Inside my head/heart a small voice says, “be grateful that you can see the things.” I wake up feeling better.

I am visiting Paul (my oldest son who is 29), in D. C. As we meet, I notice something that I had never seen before. He has a very large birthmark that runs from his forehead down to his chin. This upsets me. I wake up.

147. A kind of nightmare (maybe from watching Desperate Housewives last night). I go with some friends to a big house. One of the kids with us dies and crumples up in a heap. I found around telling people - his survivors - and calling off a hundred bags of lettuce he ordered. I go all over, then come back to take pictures of the dramatic way his dead body was left, but he has moved.
