In that case, you’d have to wear a mask and touch it very gently. But he was relieved when I told him that either the receiver or the mixing console was already giving it a line signal. He then seemed irritated that I just came in to ask him a question and didn’t intend to buy anything. So I was deserted in this big store that resembled GFS because Mom scooted off to do some other shopping. I walked over to a blue plastic control surface that had at least 24 faders. (I think it really was a mixing console for live sound, despite its color). I was touching its rear panel, in the main out section and considering the two main ways of handling the mixed signal. The first is to patch the main outs into your drive rack and let your crossover, etc. do its thing. Then, you’d just use the return lines of your snake to send it up to each of the amps. The second way was just to take your main L R and feed them into a single stereo musician-style amp cabinet and set it up on the stage somewhere and let ‘er rip! I was trying to decide which way was best, when some old fat lady walked up and said in a frail voice, “Can I help you?” So I started spouting off my thoughts to her about signal flow, gain staging and the best way to cover the audience. Before I got too far, she disappeared, and reappeared with this former buddy of mine. (He didn’t resemble anyone in my class that I resemble). She walked away and let him listen to the rest of my monologue. He didn’t really seem too interested, or to have an opinion one way or another. I thanked him and walked out to sit on a bench in front. I was carrying a cloth bag with a square tin filled with pie! I had the notion that I had to give it back to somebody in the store before Mom came, but I didn’t know who. I felt this guilt that I had taken it from the store although I had no memory of grabbing it. Just then, I realized that I had no pants on!! And I had walked through the store that way!

175. At an SATW convention. I go off and get in a sauna with some people. I go under the water and fell like I'm drowning. I can't touch the bottom or swim up. Later, I go in a sauna that is set up not to go under. In another part I hug a dog and talk to it. I let it go.

I am a Bishop celebrating mass in Latin in a cathedral. As this is happening, my mind is trying to process what is happening. How come I’m a Bishop and why am I saying mass in Latin? (I couldn’t stand saying liturgies in Latin thirty years ago and I feel the same way today)

176. I go to a house where people are and it's near a mall. I want to go to the movies and see Pirates of the Caribbean. Kyle waits in the line but when he gets up there he only buys tickets for himself. Other people are in the line and want me to go to the end of the line to get my tickets. So Kyle goes with me. The line goes very quickly. When I get to the front I ask for my tickets but there are two different Pirates movies. The man writes my ticket on a piece of paper, not a ready-made ticket.

In this dream, I have a very young girlfriend (19 years old). What is weird about this relationship is that the girl is my youngest son’s girlfriend. In my dream, we don’t date or do anything together. We are simply boyfriend and girlfriend. (I am 81)

177. In one part I'm at school, but am missing classes. School just started. I can't make it to the classes and don't have a schedule. I see one of my teachers and he says, "Who are you?" I explain that I am enrolled in the class but just haven't been there yet. Next dream - I'm at a convention. A girl disappears and I suspect she was murdered by her boyfriend. It's like Olson from Desperate Housewives - a scary guy. I talk to the girl's father about my suspicions. We see the girl but it is just her ghost. I ask her if she was murdered, she says yes. I ask if she was tortured, she says yes. I straighten her out like a little doll and her soul is at rest. A wooden grave marker grows out of her. I take pictures. Her father also takes pictures. I tell him we should try to convict the guy for murder. A friend (Jim Mortenson) walks up and I try to show him the photo on my camera, but I can't find it. There are too many pictures including from last summer. A bus comes but it's a ghost bus. I want a real bus. We're staying at a house. I tell someone that I would like to be at a house where they share everything lots of clothes around that you can wear. This house is small, but it has four bathrooms upstairs - we count them. Altogether a creepy dream, especially missing class and the dead girl. It was like a Hare Krishna murder thing.

I’m playing this very primitive video game with my eighth grade friend, Jim Engelman. We’re at his apartment on Grand Island. He’s all grown up but it’s like we’re both trapped in a time warp. We’re talking about our chemistry projects. I want to catch up with him but it’s like he jumped ahead sixteen years without any intervening life content. I remember having to leave the apartment. He tells me he’ll see me in due time. That’s about it.

I had a dream last night that I was returning to school after a leave of absence. I felt as if I were walking into a world where I didn’t really belong. There wasn’t really any equipment anywhere, but somehow I thought there would be later. There were wooden tables that hadn’t been finished or painted, and goofy toys for kids. The students around me were quite dysfunctional and immature. I felt that maybe 4 of us might actually graduate. We had to march down to the counselor’s office to schedule our classes for the next month, and then when we were done in there, we could go watch the talent show. I felt funny because I actually wanted to be in the talent show, but hadn’t been given advanced notice so I could register or anything.

178. At some place with acupuncture needles stuck in my arm. The receptionist ran off to find out something for me. Lots of people are milling around waiting for the receptionist. I ask my friend, maybe we could help them set appointments, or whatever. Meanwhile, the needles start to hurt so my friend suggests taking them out. I pull them out one by one. Earlier some parts about animals (?) pets (?).

I’m in our house in the Rapids. Adam is there and is waiting for a ride (similar to how he used to wait for the school bus) in the family room. He is standing at the door and dressed in drag; a black party dress, high heels, stockings, the whole outfit. He keeps adjusting his bra. I tell him he has the wrong bra on for the outfit. I go into my room and get a smooth cup bra and he changes into it. He looks great. I am laughing in my dream because I never thought I would be sharing my undergarments with my son.

179. Something about a house with windows and several stories at the end of a bluff. Also, something about picking out a vacation. I pick one to a resort in Arkansas, but not sure if I want to go. Kyle is there.

My son Tom and his girlfriend Sophie were at my home visiting. As they were leaving, Sophie and I kissed. This was a little strange because I never kiss her. We will hug, but not kiss. Also, what was different about his kiss was that is was quite affectionate and I couldn’t really figure it out. How bizarre these last two dreams!

I hear my alarm. I had just been thinking about some professional school, but it was my alarm for high school. I’m in eleventh grade again. I keep telling myself that yesterday I was thirty. It’s weird the way everything looks; like nothing’s changed. Now I’m treading through the snow on the way to the bus stop. I notice the tracks from a previous walk that a new snow has covered. I’m staring at a wooded thicket where my childhood friends and I used to dress up and play capture-the-flag. The air is crisp and biting, but it’s good to be outside; it’s good to be alive. I walk to a nearby park having decided to skip school and look out over the Niagara River. The water appears motionless as if the wind had struck it to submission. I spend some time on the docks, it’s getting dark, the days are shorter now. That’s all

I’m with my friend Karen. We are driving to see her son Charlie Jr. We get to Charlie Jr.’s house and go inside. Charlie and his girlfriend Amy are at their kitchen table. We sit down to visit and the phone rings. Charlie asks me to answer it. The caller tells me that Charlie’s father died and could I pleas tell him. Everyone is staring at me when I hang up the phone. I look at each one and then proceed to tell Charlie. I am crying and give him the sad news. I wake up crying.

I am in a car garage with my dad. This has to be gong back sixty-five years. (When I was a teenager I worked for my dad in his garage. I did things like wash cars, change oil and batteries and fill gas tanks). In my dream, I was helping him out. I

180. In this dream I decide that for a good career move I could invest in a Persian cat and breed it. I write a note guaranteeing that I will invest the money. My brother is also involved. (In real life my brother bought a Persian cat - Alison - to breed, but she only had one kitten.)

It’s Christmas Eve and I’m at my Aunt Anne’s house. Everyone is in such a good mood; it feels good as the place is so alive. Kathy, Mary, and Matt are talking in a corner. Annie’s girls have beautifully decorated this place. My brother Ethan is sitting at the piano playing Christmas cards with my mom. I’m just sitting on the couch and smiling. I’m really full, happy, and tired now. I fall away. That’s it.

I am driving a pick-up truck along a very narrow road that is in the process of being paved. I am moving along at a good clip when the traffic ahead of me brakes quite suddenly. In an effort to avoid a collision, I lose control of the truck and run into the ditch on the side of the road. I wake up trying to get out of the ditch.

(Kevin applied for a transfer to Florida) Kevin and I are house hunting in the dream. We come to a large house. Inside, the house is functional but dated. On the back of the house is an in-law apartment with a walk-in shower. There’s old wallpaper and the electric is outdated. The owner says he will fix up the apartment and put in new wiring if we buy the house. I tell Kevin to not get excited, that we need to explore all our options. I am frustrated that he wants to jump into things so quickly.

181. A long one. All I remember is at the end. I'm in a night club with friends. Kyle is there but he has a jealous girlfriend. I want to talk to him, tell him that I love him and drop the other woman. He dances on the dance floor for a while, then he leaves with her.

My maternal grandmother is on the phone with me. She’s asking me to meet her on Goat Island. She’s written a new poem and wants me to hear it. The scene suddenly changes. It’s so good to hear her voice for some reason. We’re on the island we’re sitting on a park bench overlooking the water. I’ve really honed my craft and I want her to hear my new poem too. I turn to look at her again and she’s gone. I’m alone there on the bench by the water.

Kevin, me and our kids, Adam and Bryan are looking at houses. We go into a house in Middleport, which is for sale. The cost of the house is $141,000. It is well below the assessed value. No one is home, but the door is unlocked. The house has been completely renovated. It is huge. It has a great big country kitchen with a pantry, five bedrooms, a great room, enclosed porch…the ideal house. The owner comes in and wants to know what we are doing. I tell him the door was open and ask why they are selling. He says he can’t afford the house because he lost his job. It is worth $300,000. The lot is small and it is smack dab in the middle of the village. Kevin says it’s perfect. I say we need to investigate further. We go to the town hall to inquire about the house. The taxes are $15,000. a year. I turn to Kevin and say, “I told you it was too good to be true!”

This is a good example of a dream that has me guessing. I am in a large house with a lot of women. For some reason, I believe they are all prostitutes. I am the only man. I don’t have the impression that I know any of the women. All I remember is that I am there not really sure what I am doing there.

I’ve been having some weird dreams lately, but I haven’t remembered all of them. I’m actually a little ashamed that instruments have been steadily working their way into my dreams more and more lately. Last night, for instance, I dreamed that I was staying at some strange little house that was somebody else’s home. Mom and Dad were staying there too, but they had their own room. Mine was full of junk, and I had a single bed with stuffed animals, clothes and shoes all over everywhere. There was an organ like Jack’s right beside my bed that I hadn’t played in weeks. I had forgotten all about it. (Apparently I’d been here for an extended period of time). In order to get to it, I had to clear away a bunch of junk off of the bench and away from the front of it. It had two manuals that were quite fragile, and the pedal board was very tiny. There was only about an octave down there, accessible with only the tips of your toes because they were so short. I never did get to sit down and turn it on because someone came and interrupted me. Next thing I knew I was showing my sketch pad to Kevin and Harriet. They were quite upset that Shadow wasn’t in it. Then, I woke up! The other night, I dreamed that I was sitting on the couch with Jack, in our living room. He had brought me a book of children’s stories written in German. Colorful pictures of angels and teddy bears ornamented the pages, but of course I couldn’t understand a word of the text. He said he had a whole set of them to show me eventually. Apparently, there were supposed to be madrigal scores at the very end that you were supposed to sing after reading the story. I never did find them though. Next, he presented me with a Braille book! It was in German as well, so I couldn’t read a word of it, combined with the fact that my Braille reading is very rusty after not using it for so many years. When touching the page, I don’t think I really felt anything, because I just don’t in dreams. It was a thin, foggy touch. I did recognize the form of some random letters and contractions though. There were pictures on the non-embossed pages. As you flipped through it, you saw teddy bears, dolls and flowers. Then, almost at the end, there was a blurry, close up photo of a grand piano. Only the side and the lid were visible because it was so large. Next, there was an even larger and blurrier photo of the same position. I wanted to know what the text was, but before I could ask him the meaning of such an enigmatic presentation, I woke up.

I’m in a car traveling. We stop at my friend’s house (old friend) who I have not visited in years. She recently lost her husband. She still has the house but is not staying in it. She has turned the barn into a house because she cant’ bear to live in the house without her husband. Her two sons, Josh and Sane come in. They say hello. Kevin is home with me and Eileen tells me to change into a pair of pj’s. She gives me some and I do it. Bill McKeon, a guy I graduated with comes in. Kevin is in the back talking to Josh and Sane. Bill sits down and I proceed to give him a massage. He is telling me what a great job I do and asks me if I am happily married. I say yes and he says I would have to be to do what I am doing with my hands to him. I finish the massage and change back into my clothes. Kevin and I leave the barn.

182. I'm just getting home from a trip. Srimad is there. I had left him my rent check and wanted him to pay the landlords on the first of the month. Instead of paying them, he cashed the check and spent most of the money. I ask him where the money is and he says it's in the psychic book. He has some money - small bills. He gave the landlord about $380. I ask him why he did that and they said "so he could eat?" I get angry at everyone and scream at everyone - "I've been up for an hour and haven't had a chance to pee."

(very jumbled- probably from the wine!) I’m traveling with a child and we are in a van going to Florida. We have Lucky (our male cat) and Emmy Lou (our female cat) with us. The water is everywhere and there seems to have been a flood. We stop at my parents to see how they are doing. They are fine. Lucky and Emmy are very happy in the van, although Lucky seems to be getting bigger and bigger in the belly and more lethargic. I want to get a haircut and get Lucky to the vet. We come to a little town and there is a general store/restaurant. We go in and there is a beauty shop in the corner that is run by a midget. She explains to me that there is no water in the sink to shampoo my hair, but she can cut it. I say fine, but you need to tell me where a vet is and I explain to her how worried I am about Lucky. She proceeds to tell me where the vet’s office is in the back of the building. I go back and find the vet who looks just like my dentist. He asks me what the problem is with Lucky and I give him his symptoms. He says he will look at both of them while I get my haircut. So now me and the kid go to the midget and she starts cutting my hair and babbling about the flood, storm, etc. I tell the little girl/kid we need to get supplies. After the haircut, we shop. The storeowner tells me we can put everything on one bill including the vet bill. I tell him that’s amazing and different. He says they are all in the business together. Now we go to the vet office and Emmy and Lucky are in cages. Lucky is in a cage with seven baby kittens and his stomach is stitched up and the babies are nursing on him. I said to the vet, “What the hell is going on? Lucky is a male!” He tells me that I should sue the last vet because he turned Emmy into a male and Lucky into a female. Emmy is the father. Lucky is lying on his back as content as he can be, playing with mother. The entire bill came to $101.01.

Fr. Mark and I are together in a church. I am not aware of people around us. We are saying mass. He is the celebrant and I am a co-celebrant. This was another way of us praying together and I woke up.

It’s sometime in late summer and it looks like I’m about a mile out from shore. I can’t tell where I am, but I’m trying to swim to shore. It seems that hours pass and the hot sun hammers the back of my head. The shore is so far away. I can make out the figures of everyone who was ever in my life on that shore, yet somewhere in my head, I know I’ll never get there. I’m floating now; the sun is setting. Lights out.

I am at a beach resort. Someone has been hurt and it seems that One of the life guards knows something about the mishap or may be responsible for it. Since I know the man, I volunteer to go on the beach and find the lifeguard. I go to the area where he is usually stationed but he is not there. I also ask some people if they have seen him. No success. I stroll along the beach, pick up rocks. I wake up.

My pen pal has sent me this video game that was never released in the United States. You play as Kos-mos, the main character from a game called Xenasaga – and you’re forced to negotiate these brutal moral dilemmas. Do you obliterate this town filled with women and children as they may be harboring a terrorist cell? The game is so life-like that it’s disturbing. You can see the dirt being kicked from under Kos-mos’ boots. That’s it.

I had a strange dream last night. It was more thoughts than anything. I was standing in the parking lot of Wilson High School (a place I have never been, or even heard about) and the surroundings looked very much like School. I was hearing Jimmy Buffett’s “Off to See the Lizard” more in my head than in the world, and thinking up how I might play this song with a band on some imaginary keyboard where anything was possible. I would need to make a split in 3 different sections so that I could play this meaty synth pad that underscores the chord changes to the song, a kettle drum sound that is a trademark of the tropical sound and a Hammond organ sound. Then, I would have to transpose the left and right sections to match the middle so that when you played the first C in each, they would sound in unison. That way, your left and right-most sections wouldn’t sound extremely high or low! So all of this thought process is going on in my dream. Then, I was with 4 other kids my age who were supposed to be my bandmates, and we were all standing on this curb without instruments, but somehow we were playing the song. I was moving my fingers in mid-air and somehow making sound with them! But I felt that we weren’t actually playing, only acting. Then, I was without them again, wandering aimlessly around getting sprayed by sprinklers waiting for my cab. It finally came, and I rode home, but I didn’t have any money! I’m surprised that I would have such accurate technical thoughts in my dream that I’d never really thought through beforehand. Usually, I don’t have notions like that. I’m kind of a little embarrassed that all of my “really good” dreams lately have had instruments involved somewhere.

183. I'm at someplace with a big bunch of people, including my family and our cat, Rocky. We get on a big elevator and Rocky won't fit. So we leave him. Then I go back down and make a special trip to pick him up and bring him along.

184. Some fragments - I'm going to the bus stop, but must cross through traffic against the light. Someone says "Hey - you're jay walking" (something like that). I say, "I have to catch the bus! Wait!"

185. Fragment: I'm lying in bed. I want to stretch my shoulder but the people around me tell me to rest, then watch my tai chi tape and stretch out with the video. (I often feel some pulling in my shoulder and stretch out after I wake up.)

I wake up and lift the top off my hamster Foustas’ shelter. He must have died in the early hours of morning. He’s just laying there lifeless. I hang my head; the room feels empty, all the academic awards on the wall seem meaningless. I feel that I’d rather not ever have anything for myself in life if he could just live on. I cradle his little body and say goodbye. The scene moves to my backyard. My family is burying Faustus. How ironic, I think, that he cheated death for so long. It’s very sad here. There’s a certain undefined quality about the yard. Fog touches every fencepost and leaf cuticle. I feel dizzy and pass out. This is about all I can remember.

I’m in a tavern; it’s different from any place I’ve ever seen. Candles illumine a tiny place filled with must, ale and revelry. Suddenly, there are shouts. I’m in a corner of the bar and it’s as if no one can see me. Three men at a plain wood table drink. Women scout around in garb seemingly out of the Middle Ages. There are these three men just standing near the entrance; their presence bothers me. Something in me wants to go and warn the men at the table, but I’m invisible. I’m in corporeal with respect to this room, this world. The men at the table are rushed by the men by the door. A knife is plunged into one man’s eye. As he dies, I’m struck by a sense of waste: the line perfuses my awareness. “Cut is the branch that might have grown full straight and burned is Apollo’s laurel bough.”

Let me just start off by saying that last night, I had a wacky dream that I actually remember. The sequence isn’t clear to me because it was a total jumble of thoughts and ideas. I think it started where a combination of Sam and Jimmy was sitting on our couch with a little Christmas decoration that looked like a picture frame. It had a top like a Christmas village house, and it belonged under a tree, but you loaded a picture slide show or video file into it via USB and then it would show up on its LCD and play continuously under the tree in your village!!! What a cool marketing idea! So Sam/Jimmy was messing with this thing and Dad was butting in politely, telling his version of how it was supposed to work. Then, I was reading The Iliad. I don’t really know how it begins, but in my dream, all of the Greek men under Agamemnon were laughing, drinking, joking and believing that they weren’t really going to war. There was something else about a Trojan princess that wasn’t really Helen, but I don’t know where she came in. She was more like an Egyptian or something. Then, after my concert, Dad suddenly wanted to put all of the Christmas things away. So he went around collecting them and shoving them into boxes. Some of the bulb ornaments broke as they fell into their boxes, but Mom was more worried about the boxes being cut than the ornaments breaking. Then, I woke up. There was something about a baby too, but that part escapes me.

I’m forty years old. I’m living in this beautiful home on the water. My childhood friend Milo is living there as well. Several others sit in my vicinity, are walking around. Others are there somewhere. I’m reading while I watch the sky from the window. I vaguely sense that people around me are partying; liquor, cake, etc. Drinking and getting is high is so tedious. I feel an inexhaustible sense of waste; at least I can be alone, I think. This is a pleasant thought.

I had a really crazy dream last night! I was in a school, probably elementary or middle, as a student or maybe an assistant to the teacher. I was at a table with my partner. The assignment was that me and my partner were each given the name of a fictitious company, and we each had to think of a list of potential environmental hazards posed by this company. Then, I had to pass the list to my partner and she had to come up with a speech to me about how to avoid those hazards. I had to do the same for her. Then, each of us had to write a song about how to avoid our hazards, and the tune had to be arranged in 4-part harmony!!! I can’t remember my company or its hazards, but I do remember receiving the teacher’s little book of staff paper and turning to a blank page. I placed the treble and bass clefs and had placed the F key signature on both staves when the fire alarm went off!! I stood up, covered my ears and jumped up and down with my partner for some reason. The sprinkler system even sprayed us as if we were in the shower, and I thrashed my limbs about and screamed! I wasn’t really frightened by the sound or the cold shower, but something was grasping at my limbs, some kind of internal pain or Charlie horse that I was trying to free myself of so that I could finally run out of the room. Then, I was in the living room with Janice, who gave me two Mariah Carey CDs. And that was all, I think.

186. In this dream people are trying to develop a Hummer - Jeep-type vehicle that can be thrown off a tall building like the World Trade Center. They throw it from the top of the building and it has giant tractor tires that hold it to the side of the building as it plummets to the ground. It lands okay. In the other dream we are trying to sell or buy a house for someone.
I am in a karate school. We are going through our routines. After the lesson is over, a few of us get together and we discuss the great job our teacher does. I wake up.

187. I have lots of work to do and am traveling. I stay in a vacant apartment up on a hill. There I can do my work. Later I try to go look for Pat Stanley / Kay Lancaster (both old friends). In a dorm, the other people are not much help in finding me a place to sit down and work, but then I find Pat/Kay and she helps me.

I’m in the Baten Kaitos world; the island of Diadem. Long streets of cobblestone, sprawl along the walls of a castle, all of which are steeped in thick billowy mist. Kalas and Savyna We’re talking about how best to enter the castle; I can hear the video game score playing as we talk. I suggest that we search for a path under the fountain near one of the bakeries. As we lift a statue from the fountain, I can sense the grain of the metal, the dirtiness of waters that appear pristine. I’m helping Savyna lower Kalas into the tunnel just as he disappears. I awake.

My dream continued from last night. I’m with Kolos and Souyna in this tunnel. Clads seem to percolate the very earth. A mélange of motifs seem to follow. We emerge into a courtyard. I’m lucid dreaming and I’m telling Kolos and Souna that she’ll find redemption for all those who died in Azah. She looks upset. We sit in the courtyard and talk for a while. Kolos is detailing one of his grandfather’s inventions to me in detail. Sauyno tells me about being the daughter of a hunter and mercenary. Finally we climb the stairs to find Giacomo. Before going, we make a blood pact not to forget this moment. During the battle, I hit my head and awake.
I only remember a woman being in this dream with whom I am having a very intimate encounter. She is not anyone in my real life.

I’m on a rather large boat; bound to the shore. There are as many as six other people with me; a woman of about say thirty, and her child, another guy is about forty. Her name is Sofia and his is Alyasha. There are others too. Shane, an old friend, is there. We’re stranded here; at least this is what I’m told. The current is supernaturally quick. A rock skipped by Alyasha, is carried more than a half mile in an instant. People seemingly in the power of Alyasha, engage in prayer on the rocky shoreline. All one can see when one looks out is blue; perhaps the mist of a great waterfall some ten miles west. Alyasha talks to me about my faith for a short while. I smile. I know he means well and the camp is quite peaceful. Shane talks of swimming out of here. I warn against this; I tell him flatly that the current appears too fast and strong. He dives in and is hurled a few hundred yards in an instant. The camp is distraught. I should have physically stopped him, I think. A cold wind blows south- winter-still born child of autumn brings a uniform silence to the camp. It really is getting cold. I turn leeward (south) toward the shore and observe several barbed wire fences just past this towering dune. I run to it and climb, cutting myself just a little. “Why hasn’t anyone thought of this?” I think after a few fences and cuts, there is civilization. We are saved I think, at least for now. The world at large seems little bothered by the tiny group barely subsisting on that shoreline.

I had two crazy dreams last night. The first was about a math class that I was in. It was a college class, but it was in a portable room like at my high school. The Math class was relaxed and laid back, not scary as my classes in high school sometimes were. The teacher was in his 20s. He didn’t require that we do hours and hours of homework, he left the process up to us. Only about 4 other students were in this class, and I was finishing a test at a CCTV in the corner. (It was black and white, like the ones at my high school.) I took my good ol’ time, having reasonable confidence in my ability to solve the problems. I doodled a half-octave’s worth of keys and bunches of floating music notes and symbols on my test paper and didn’t feel the least bit ashamed. In fact, I sort of had the notion that this teacher was giving me music lessons too, right after the math class adjourned. He had a keen desire for me to do well and be versed in both subjects. But that was brief and fleeting, and very little actually happened. It’s funny how so many details seem to just be innately known in dreams.

The second dream was similar in that very little actually happened. I was upstairs sitting with Mom. She was sitting in my chair typing a letter. I just knew that she had won either an essay or a recipe contest sponsored by Kraft foods, that Kraft called the “Thousand Sugars Contest”. The prize was a 6-foot Baldwin parlor grand, similar to Jack’s, but it had a dark green finish and some carving in the case. This piano had an analog clock built into the music desk. It had the 3 usual expression pedals, but there was also this thing next to them, kind of like a gear shifter on a manual transmission, called a Wifflaire, which was used to set the time on the clock!! How weird. Mom didn’t tell me that she’d won it because she wanted it to be the biggest surprise. I think I had seen the details on some statement that came in the mail. But it wouldn’t be completed until April! The people needed time to refinish the case, I think. Mom didn’t know how or where we would put it, it was almost as if I could hear her thoughts rambling and babbling out loud. She “talked” of getting rid of the coffee table, or the couch, or both. Believe it or not, I was actually quite scared by the thought of owning it; not for the childish fears of the instrument itself, but because of complicated interpersonal issues. Sure, I would give anything to be able to practice on such a fine instrument, and sure, it was an exciting windfall on Mom’s part, but what would Dad think? I had the feeling that he knew nothing yet. What would he have to say about rearranging the furniture? What would he have to say about me practicing as much as I really would like to? What would he say about Mom entering the contest without “consulting the family first?” Overall, I felt very sad and afraid, and I just wanted to run and hide, pretending that I wanted no part of the whole thing. I walked aimlessly from room to room in my dream, thinking these thoughts. And that is the last thought I can remember before awakening and breathing a sigh of relief!

I had some very colorful imaginative dreams last night. In the first one, I was with Sandra, Sheryl and Levy in our living room. (For some reason I dream of Sandra and Sheryl only lately). So Sandra had a dog with her, and she gave me this toy barn that has real live miniature horses and sheep in it. They were the kind of thing that you’d find in The Borrowers, The Castle in the Attic or The Indian in the Cupboard. (Those books were a main subject of my imagination with my barn as a child). So these 4 horses and 4 sheep would run around the room, oblivious to the play scenario going on in your mind, just like animals do. You had to feed them and make sure they wouldn’t get hurt. Apparently, the barn was adequate living space for them, but you could let them out at will. I don’t remember anything about these animals going to the bathroom though. So after inspecting this incredible gift, I let the animals roam about the living room. The dog looked a lot like Emmy, but she belonged to Sandra. So here’s this life-sized dog following these tiny animals around, but she didn’t hurt them. Levy was running around too. Sandra also gave me a cockatiel whose feathers were all black and whose head was dark blue. He was the size of the late Birdy with the coloring of a pigeon. This bird was flitting and flying about the room as well, tweeting Birdy’s happy tweet. He came to rest near me and I said to Sandra, “Well, I like his personality”. Dad was nearby and he said, “Well, I don’t like his personality. He’s too flighty.” Sandra also gave me a very colorful set of balloons, the simple kind that you blow up with your mouth. They were tied to a single weight with different lengths of string. When she gave me this, she said, “I’m giving you your childhood back.” I felt that that statement applied to all of the gifts, and to her presence with Levy. For all of that detail, the scene sure was brief.

Next, I was with Mom in bed in the middle of the night. I was holding her and telling her that “A Tisket A Tasket” was scary since it is structured so similar to Bluebird. I was also telling her that bells, just unto themselves, were scary because they had the implication of “Bluebells Cockleshells” and other minor-third passages. (I sure wish I knew what they were really singing in “Bluebells Cockle Shells Evie I’ll be over!”). There was a strange light in the bedroom during that scene, like that when there’s a full moon. I wasn’t too afraid because she was there in my dream. She was telling me that I needed to retrieve a bag in my closet that contained some sort of goofy instrument like a zeauner or maybe even a Music Major in order to remedy those fears.

I was in the gym of Bancroft, and two ladies almost in royal dress were doing a presentation involving a real rattle snake. I felt that the ladies were somehow related to Princess Diana. The snake coiled up and inched across the floor in a coil with his head held high and proud. The snake had a little bell hanging from his neck. He didn’t rattle, only dinged his bell as he inched along. Since I was sitting in the front, the ladies asked me to volunteer. I stepped out onto the floor and the snake inched toward me. When he got within a fearful closeness, I talked to him, saying something like, “Go away, don’t hurt me.” The snake turned around and started inching around to the other side of their table. The ladies said, “See, that’s all you have to do.”
And then, I dreamed I was awake and didn’t know what time it was.

I don’t remember much more than this dream was involved with school and education. I was much younger, probably High school. The issues were related to the educational process and how we grow as a result of this process. Something I have my doubts about.

I’m in a doctor’s office and all I can feel is the sensation of falling. I’ve just been diagnosed with liver cancer by Mark Kozim, M.D. I’m just sitting there and time seems like it’s moving so slowly. My parents and friends pretend like it’s not even happening. I’m just sitting; I won’t say anything. I really feel hatred for my family, for the world, for being born.

I am working for a company that is restructuring. Myself and another man have been brought in to assist with developing our more effective paradigm. In the meantime, a crime has been committed and we all are being questioned. During my questioning, I am concerned about losing my keys. They interrupt my questioning to audition a singer. He is very good. I wake up.

188. The best part of the dream was finding jewelry in the ocean. I'm staying at a place with a little beach. I run my hands through the water and pick up jewelry. Some of it is mine. I think my jewelry box fell in the ocean so I become frantic to find my earrings. I go to my room and empty my pockets, then go back. The tide has gone out so I can see the sand under the water. Some people have thrown a canvas out over the beach and set up a table. The house in this dream is a beautiful spacious one. I have my own apartment in an upper floor. Kyle lives there too. I think I must be dreaming. The people who own the house want to sell it to me along with the furniture.

I am involved with a family who is trying to eliminate drug activities in their community. The real danger is the drug lord is aware of their intentions. A friend and myself are making small bombs, two of them. We hope to scare the drug dealers with these bombs. We live in an apartment in a wealthy section of the city. There is also an attractive woman who lives with us which tends to e a distraction. Nothing comes of our war against drug people.

I had another typical bad dream last night, the kind that are unique to me, yet so mundane, that I really get tired of them! I was at my high school, yet I was doing college coursework. I had taken a cab, which dropped me off at the back of the Media Center, and I met up outside with Ms. Fletcher who was to proctor my last final exam for Government class. So we opened the door, the infamous door at the back, which sounded a 2-tone back-up alarm very loudly. I clasped my hands over my ears and ran through behind Ms. Fletcher. The librarian appeared and indicated with her gestures that we should just go to our testing spot and not worry about a thing while she silenced the errant door. But as the exam began, I realized that this was not my government test, but a pre-test arranged by my Earth Science test. The purpose was to intimidate us and make it clear that studying in his course was an absolute must. There were all kinds of goofy questions about geology, weather and minerals that I felt I should know but I didn’t. (I had a large-print page, not a CCTV). There was this one question that read something like, “What color tape do you use to mark off a specimen; red, black or orange?” Then, I felt that we couldn’t do two tests in one day, so I’d have to come back Thursday morning for my government final. Well, Thursday morning came in my dream, and I doodled the day away. When the scene appeared again, I was standing in front of the CCTV talking on the kitchen phone to a woman who sounded like Gigi, but said her name was Peggy. She was very upset that I didn’t keep my appointment with her and Virgil Fox! In this dream, Virgil Fox was not an organist, but a newspaper columnist who was supposed to have an interview with me! Not only did I mourn the loss of that appointment, but the one for my Government test as well.

158. [Okay, this dream is pretty fucked up.] Two other girls I don't know and I were trying to sneak into Walmart by hopping this tall wooden fence. But on the other side was a huge dog. One girl fell on the dog and it killed her. So the other girl and I were trying to hurry up. We got over the fence and were running towards Walmart in the parking lot. We tried to kill the dog by running towards the wall hoping it would run into it. But it didn’t and it turned out to be a little poodle, then Kaylee drove me home in Ashley's car. Then I was in a hot tub and the dog was there with me and hitting on me, but then its mom and brother came in and were like happy birthday! And started giving her all these gifts from Bed Bath and Beyond. I can’t remember the rest. I went to bed High this night.

I am in a dormitory or barracks. I think it is a school. The place is very clean and my job is to do laundry and I am pushing around a cart full of cloths. I am on my way to pick up more laundry and then I wake up.

I am entirely of ice atop an enormous fountain; water spills in, what I can discern twelve different directions, streaming out into the void. I can barely describe their distant contours. Beneath everything is a great tree of immeasurable height and breadth, it just up from the infinite. Little bits of my world seem to meander by in self-contained bubbles. It is so damn cold, and I can’t feel my legs.

189. At a place - a town or large resort or some friends' house - we have a big party. Also, we take a train. We run to catch the train - I think Dave Schiller takes us. We try to get on this particular train. Later, a snake comes up and tries to bite someone. He catches it. I say "Hold it by the neck so it won't bite. They try that, but the snake is like a guide. A woman takes it while we go look for a place for it. We find a spot near a lake but the woman with the snake is gone. I walk around saying "Has anyone seen a snake?" But it's gone - I imagine that it's a good place. Someone wants me to go back to school, but I don't want to.

I had a goofy dream last night. I was in my bedroom packing up my older keyboard to prepare to deliver it to Curt’s house. Actually, I had the older one and the newer one both laid out on my bed which was made, and their boxes stood up in front of my dresser. I was deciding which box to deliver the old one in, making sure that the accessories like the music stand and AC wallwart went with it. I also had wrapping paper and gift bows laying around, deciding whether or not to wrap it. The newer, longer Privia was balanced precariously across a blue plastic tub filled with gift wrap and stuff. I found a cassette tape in the old box, and I found a different cassette in the new box. They apparently contained opera arias, musical show tunes, 1930s swing numbers and other culturally significant things, and a narrator to tell about them and how to imitate their style. In this dream, both keyboards had a cassette deck, the slim style like you find in a car, or in Big Bird. It was located in the front to the right, kind of where you’d find a floppy drive on a digital mixing console. You were supposed to put in the tape, listen to the narrator and the songs, and try to play along when you could. There was some way to adjust the balance of the sound from the tape and from the keys. I fiddled with both units trying to make them work. The transport controls were on the console surface rather than down by the deck. The deck on the old one wouldn’t work very well at all, so I decided not to give Curt the tape that came with it. The deck on the newer one worked beautifully and sounded nice. I packed the older one in its case, because the box really got beat up at the store and then laid the newer, longer one in a more stable position. I was interested to hear what was on the tape. I faded into consciousness. I awakened realizing that neither one actually had a built-in deck, nor did it come with a “cultural awareness” tape.

I recall having borrowed three hundred dollars from this Hispanic girl. Approximately two months later, I’m in the hospital with Milo and his sick father when she appears with three other “workers”. She wants her money. I had every intention of paying it back. Her name is Claire. I tell her that I’ll get it for her tonight. She wants it immediately. Milo grabs one of her guys as he moves towards me and kicks him to the floor. The disinfectant in this room is so pungent that it’s nauseating. I run out of the room and knock the other guy down. I call hospital security and tell Milo to stay with his father. I finally find a place to hide here; a supply closet, way in the back. In my head, I realize, I’m to have to kill these people. I feel sad. I don’t want to. I liked Claire; she said she didn’t need the money right away. She must’ve got pinched; must be desperate. I slip out the back entrance and jump on a bike. Suddenly I’m heading down Niagara Falls Blvd. and a black guy in a box truck cuts me off. I nimbly avoid him and head through all the side streets (which I knew at age four). I’m looking for a place to withdraw money. There’s a structure by the Niagara River. I get in, get the money and get out. I call Claire and tell her I’m leaving the money under her door. She’s quiet on the phone. Bye Claire.

I am living in a black ghetto area. I am a little apprehensive , yet I seem to be getting along with everyone. I am having a conversation with a black man when we notice a very large blanket suspended over our backyard. Then I’m in a truck that I am driving. As I back it into a garage, I meet a man who wants to come to Buffalo and direct a play for high school students. I offer to help him. (We used to have plays at the high school I taught at)

I had a goofy dream last night. It had several little scenes featuring the common theme of sirens and other fire truck/emergency vehicle sounds, but they were quite unrelated. First, Dad and I were riding in the car. We were supposedly coming home from APC, but we were on the interstate coming out of Wilsonville and preparing to go on the Main Street Bridge, more like returning from WMNF. There were two rescue trucks and an ambulance riding alongside of us, and we kept trying to let them pass us as we are supposed to, but they kept getting held up anyway. So, we’d let them pass, and then they’d get into an area where we would have to pass them and then we’d let them pass us again, and then we’d have to pass them again. They were all blaring their sirens and horns intermittently, and the volume was deafening. They terrified me as if I was still a child. The car radio was playing softly, and each time the rescue trucks passed us, I would be happy to hear its soft, reassuring sound after the big scare, so to speak. Well, after a while, the sirens were so loud that Dad just turned it off. This scene ended when we were stopped under an echoey overpass at a red light and the ambulance was trying to maneuver through the stopped traffic going whoop, whoop, whoop! Next, I was back at the house, and for some reason, Dad owned a ladder truck along with our other vehicles. In this dream, he was going to move the ladder truck and his green truck from the front yard to the back so that some visiting guests would have room to park. I was scared to death to be anywhere close by while the ladder truck was being maneuvered because of the dreaded back-up alarm sound. I hid myself in my bedroom closet and covered my ears, but I could still hear the sound as plain as day. It wasn’t the scary minor-third sound, but it was a series of rhythmic beeps, almost like a tune. This was still just as scary. I wasn’t relieved because I knew that if the vehicle moved faster, I would hear the minor-third sound. To add insult to injury, our private green ’64 truck had a similar system. I had the feeling that since it parked in the station lot while Dad was on duty, it had to have that system. Lastly, Mom and I were in the living room goofing around with the Privia keyboard. Mom let her fingers splatter out handfuls of dissonant notes like she does sometimes. (I never mind when she does this. I’m grateful that she thinks it’s cool!) But get this: the first preset “demo song” was titled “fire truck parade.” It was a steady parade of wailing sirens, ancient car horn thingies, whooping warble sirens, minor-third backup alarms, regular beeps, branching air horns and stuff like that panning slowly across the soundstage drowning out a brass band that marched along to the beat of the percussion section. (Sounds like something Sam would sequence.) So Mom was investigating some of the other more pleasant songs that it had onboard, but I warned her not to play the first one unless the volume was quite low. (In reality, it doesn’t have anything preset like that. You have to record a sequence to its user memory.)

189. I'm at my dad's house with a few friends. Paul McCartney comes in and talks to us all. Before he leaves he lets each of us kiss him. I kiss him three times and follow him outside. He asks how much my dad's house sold for and I say $11 million - he says, "Oh that's about what mine is worth." Then I say, "I, I mean $1 million." Then tell him I'm a real estate agent. He is surprised.

I dreamed that my maternal grandmother, Norma, took me to a supermarket; she told me that she could operate here and make me a new hand. The din from the store seemed like a mixture of supermarket and hospital. I was a small child. She had a difficult time working with the anesthetic and I would just get woozy. I remember being fixated on the anesthetic. It looked like Vaseline. I became so ill that I left the table and quit the project. She was furious.

Kevin (a guy I work with), his wife, Doreen, and I are trying to cross a bridge. We are on a flat cart with no sides (sort of like a carpet ride). The three of us are zooming very fast on a path (similar to the log ride but not in a car). We go up a big hill of water, down, and up and over. We come to a bridge that is being built. There are men everywhere with weapons. We try to reason with them to let us cross. They take Doreen away. Kevin and I are locked up in an open cage overlooking the construction of the bridge. The men are ogling Doreen. Kevin is getting crazy. I tell him to keep his cool, that is the only way we are going to escape. I look out and see a woman in the distance. She is winking at me and motions for me to look down. I see a way to escape. I tell Kevin. He jumps up to go. I tell him we must wait until the right moment, and then we’ll grab Doreen and go. Hours pass and he is getting impatient. A guard walks by us and Kevin reaches out and strangles him. We crawl through a window and down an old rickety ladder. We find Doreen and the woman in the distance winks at us to go. We are back on the cart again on a wild ride. Up and over we go. Kevin and Doreen are hanging on to one another. Then the three of us are hanging on to each other. We see a big crowd ahead. It is a stadium and President Bush is there speaking. We glide right up to him and tell him he must pull the troops out of Iraq because we have our own war going on right here. We tell him about the men at the bridge that we just escaped. He tells us not to worry; he will take care of it.

At some point, early in this dream, I’m looking out over crystalline waters. The air is so cold and I’m on a great bluff. The waters north of me surge moving from west to east. I am reminded of the hyperboreans looking out to the river ocean. I am thinking of an hourglass; now I’m holding one. I think that every crystal therein holds a million memories of the earth; the universe. The wind is colder now. Perhaps I am the great avatar of the cessation of being. These weird thoughts cloud the end of this dream. The only thing constant is the wind I hear.

I’m with two other people. I don’t know or remember who they are. We are at a place where we hear water. We go into a building that looks like a mountain. Inside there is a big bully man. He points to the right. We go to the right and step onto a water slide. All three of us fall and we are on the slide. Up and down, twists and turns. It’s a blast! I’m laughing and having a great time. We land in the bottom of a pool. The other guy with us shushes me. We climb over a small hill and are spying on enemy agents. They are marching and protecting a beautiful pool of water with a beautiful falls. It’s breathtaking. I want to dive off the falls into the pool, as do the others. We lure the guards away and trap them and lock them up in a cave, which has been turned into a prison. I go to the top of the waterfalls and dive in. The water is just the right temperature. I come to the surface laughing. I wake up laughing. Great dream! Lots of fun!
I am mowing the lawn of my home as a teenager. What is strange about this dream is that the lawn becomes the lawn of the high school where I taught for fifteen years of my life. I wake up.

I am participating in a political rally. I am not sure of my status here, but I seem to know a lot of people. We seem to be crowded in a large auditorium. Some friend s notice me manipulating my way through the crowd and are impressed. The keynote speaker is Robin Williams. Strangely, he has only a few people attending his address. Dream ends.

I’m in the center of this gargantuan old wooden house. For some reason my point of view keeps shifting with this spec of dust on the floor. There are all types of wooden antiques strewn about a tiny rocking horse. As dust, I feel this sense of permanence, like that part of existence that forever stays preserved; that clue to a fourteen billion year old puzzle. The house fades and I’m watching the universe burgeoning all around me. Somewhere along the ecliptic, Virgo seems to rise, soar, and swallow up Antares.

This dream takes me back about ten or twelve years ago when I was a 4-H Leader and the boys were young. We are all at a big fair. The boys have brought their animals to the fair. There are kids from all over the county at this fair. We watch some judging and there are kids everywhere. In front of us, there are two boys about seventeen years old. Tuck is one of them and Oscar is the other. Both are a long way from home. Tuck is from Texas and Oscar from Arizona. Both have animals entered in the fair. They are talking to each other about how it took all their money to get to the fair and they didn’t have anyplace to sleep except in the barn. An announcement just came over the loud speaker for host parents for some of these kids. Oscar says, “Let’s go” and Tuck says, “Go ahead but none of them will give us a room. Look at us. I ‘m tall and look well over seventeen and Oscar, you don’t have any clean clothes left and no money.” I lean forward and apologize for eaves dropping and explain that my young boys are in the 4-H program. I don’t have a room for them, but I could put them up in a tent with cots and sleeping bags in the back yard and feed them. They could shower, do their laundry and eat with us. I should have to check with my mother because she holds our mortgage. I told them I would meet them back at the barn at around nine at night to pick them up. Me and the boys walk around the fair and find my mother who is in a golf cart with a broken leg. I tell her about Tuck and Oscar and she asks if the boys (my boys) will be safe with the. I said my gut is telling me these are fine boys. We are late getting back to the barn. I borrowed the golf cart to get them. They are both playing pool when I pull up and tell them to get in. Tuck says, “See Oscar, I told you she would be back. Both have huge smiles on their faces.

Kevin and I are moving. I don’t know where the house is, but it is my Great Uncle’s house, which was originally in Akron. I am thrilled to be moving into his house. It’s a cute bungalow now in a bad neighborhood. The house is exactly as it was in the dream. It has been abandoned for many years. The furniture and everything is the same. I start to clean every thing…the walls, windows, pictures, furniture, etc. so we can live there. Kevin brings loads over and says, “Where are we going to put our stuff?” I tell him, “Let’s put our stuff in the garage and we can incorporate other things with these things.” He continues to move our things into the garage which is huge. He comes in to get ready for work. I hug him and say, “I am so happy to be here as I always wanted a home just like this. He goes to work. I continue to clean.

There are a number of ill persons in what must be a great shelter. It smells really good. Diana Singh fills hot cups of soup to people in a line that starts by the door. In the back kitchen, her stew simmers. Children with dirt all over their faces, roughhouse and banter in French. It’s cold in LaSalle, in Montreal at Christmas. She’s wearing a blue summer dress, the same one she wore on our first date. She’s talking and joking with this older woman. All the time in this new year for laughter, I think. Everything starts to fade.
190. House hunting - all the people I'm working with - I help them get their houses. One neighborhood everything but a few homes burned down. I try to smooth things out so everyone is happy.
I am in a small town visiting when the entire area becomes flooded. Everywhere there is about five or six inches of water. No one really knows what to do.

I’m not sure if I am at a party or a social gathering however, I am relating to five or six women (age 40-50) when I become especially attracted to one of them. Actually, I don’t know any of these ladies. As the night progresses, I become more friendly and we embrace one another . The next recollection is that we are on the ground (the floor) in a full body embrace with her being on top of me. This is not a sexual activity as much as a very intimate, quiet and comforting embrace. We are just lying there without talking and happy to be together, fully conscious of the other’s body.

We are looking for a new house to buy. Somehow we end up in our old neighborhood, but it is different. It is very swampy. We stop at a house with a pond in the back yard. We go into the house and see gators in the pond. We are both terrified. We run to the car and Delaney, my eight-year-old goddaughter, is in the car. She tells us not to be afraid and tells us to go back in the house. We go in and sit at the dining room table. The gators, four of them, come in. Delaney tells us to be very still because the gators are just curious and want to check us out. I am petrified and shaking like a leaf. The gators go around the room and smell us. Delaney jumps from her chair onto the back of one of the gators. I am screaming at her to get off. She is laughing and having a grand time. She rides the gator out to the pond and is swimming with them. I am frantic telling Kevin to do something. Delaney comes out of the water to tell us the gators say we can live in the house. They will be our protectors while we are living here and not to be afraid of them. We all will be a family.

I had a crazy dream last night. I was with Astrid in her bedroom and she was showing me a few mermaid dolls. They were very nice. One was a mechanical display figure with a shiny plastic fin. In my dream, I secretly wished that she would give me that one so that I could perch it on top of the cabinet lid of a grand piano someday. Then, she showed me an angel doll with a big fat butt. She had a pinkish-red toy keyboard that sounded much like a powerful organ. It even had a few stop tabs like Jack’s. It only had one manual though. She was trying to play the Nameless Tune, but she wasn’t getting too far.

Next, I was in a grocery store with Mom and we were shopping and diddling. I felt that I had to go see Pete and Genevieve that day, and didn’t want to dawdle too long. When I asked Mom what time it was, she said 3:05!! We had been in the store for several hours, totally beyond 1:00 when I usually see them. I was totally beside myself. I ran after Mom yelling and crying as she raced around grabbing more groceries. I called them on my cell phone and talked to Janet. She didn’t seem mad at me, but sort of said, “Oh well, we’ll just do it next time.”
The only thing I remember is running. I am running and my shoelace becomes untied. It’s my right sneaker. I can’t stop running to tie it and I am so afraid that I will trip and fall.

191. Just a few fragments - I’m at someplace. I have a cat with me and it keeps getting away. I stop into the ashram - I guess on Watseka. There's a woman lounging around there. I need to wash some spilled food off my sari - I use the kitchen. Ask her if I can use the bathroom. She says no, but I find one in another building. My family was waiting for me. I find the cat.

Last night I dreamed that I was back at school, but it was a combination of my high school and my college . I was having my English seminar with Clark, but James and Ed were there. Then I was naked, but I had to go to philosophy where we were reading Wittgenstein. I was horrified that I was naked, but no one seemed to notice. Then it got dark and I couldn't find my way back to the dorm. Then I woke up.
192. A house where I’m staying - they send a shower over to replace the one in the hall bathroom, but they install it in one of the bedrooms bathrooms.
193. There are books that represent each client on a bookshelf. They're stacked on a pile instead of vertical as a row of books.

This dream has something to do with football. It starts out at a training camp. This seems to have something to do with the Super Bowl. Only the teams that are playing are the Giants and the Bears. The major incident of the Super Bowl game is the last play which will determine the winner. All the players (including me) are lined up at mid field. The team that is able to push the other team across the goal line wins. Here I wake up.

I remember that it’s 2020, Christmas. I’m helping out at a soup kitchen in Timmens, Ontario. Theresa LaBelle is sitting next to me. She’s still a little girl of no more than seven. Her face is dirty; she’s telling me about how her mom died in a car accident. She’s seven, maybe eight, like she was twenty years ago. I’m forty-three, she should be twenty- seven. She tells me that she wants me to teach her about “thermo” and “hydrological” engineering. She laughs at her own mispronunciation of the terms. I take a warm towel and wash the earth from her face. She’s a beautiful child, as she greatly resembles her mother Liette. I can tell Theresa is perturbed by all the clamor. I bring her into on e of the back rooms and fetch her a bowl of hot pasta, some bread, and milk. She eats; she must have been starving. “What happened Theresa? Weren’t you living with Luke, your father?” I ask. She tells me they were living in a small apartment in Peterburough. One day she woke up and he was gone. “I’m so glad I found you Galen.” She sobs as she hugs me. I wake up before I can assure her that I’ll take care of her.
I didn’t sleep that well last night. Sometimes when I

Next, I had a very brief dream that my math class was held in a fictitious building called the MA building at APC. It was upstairs, but the steps were so very steep, that I couldn’t climb them. I am traveling with my mother-in-law and other people to England. We arrive at the airport to pick up our luggage. The conveyor belt is very fast as is marked with each seat. There are shelves designated for laptops, purses, back packs. It is a very organized process. We get our luggage and board a bus. My mother-in-law takes the first seat available, but I go to the back of the bus and find a seat by myself. We travel through the country and end up at an open theater (almost like a drive-in with no cars) We sit on the grass and watch movies. There are people on the bus that I went to school with. The movie is extremely funny. We are all laughing like crazy and we are all naked! Hot dogs are cooking in the grill somewhere. I can smell them cooking. We now board another bus to watch a hockey game. We are all clothed now. We go to an arena to watch the game and a butler comes up to me and says, “Your Highness, they would like you to skate during intermission.” I tell them it’s been years and I don’t have my skates. The butler tells me he kept them all these years. I try them on and they fit. I tell him I need “the star” to tighten them. The butler goes to look for “the star” and I say to my mother –in –law, “I should’ve eaten a hot dog cause I’m starving. She said they threw the remaining hot dogs out. I go to the bathroom, which is a Johnny on the spot, to pee. In the next outhouse is Maureen, from high school, saying that she can’t believe we are in England. We talk briefly. I sanitize my hands and throw two dishtowels down the toilet and go back to my seat to lace up my skates. I wake up and have to pee!

I am in South Dakota (I think) with my friend Karen and her family. I have not seen Karen in over twenty years in real life, but we exchange Christmas cards and letters at Holiday time. Karen’s husband Dave is a Pharmacy Exec. And they have six kids. I called them the Brady Bunch and Karen, Flo (Florence Henderson). They are very Catholic. It is very rural and we are at a hotel. Dave’s new boss is there and he is very controlling. I don’t like the man, neither does Karen. But it is a wonderful opportunity for him. The scenery is beautiful: hills, greenery, mountains, etc. The boss and Dave are trying to convince Karen that this is a good move. Karen asks me to check the hospital and she will check out the stores. We go in separate cars. I drive to the hospital and go in. I ask where the school is. The girl looks like Debbie Oppee who I went to school with. It is her! We hug and go to the cafeteria. She asks what I am doing here and I tell her I am with my friends who are trying to decide to move her. She said Dave’s boss’ name and I said yes. She went on to tell me he owns the hospital, mall, and all the stores. Just about everything I ask about the school and she said they are all excellent, but there are no buses. The boss expects the parents-mothers to drive the kids to school. I look at her attire. She is not dressed in business wear even though she works at the hospital. She said she is administration and the boss sets the dress code. She is extremely happy to see and hopes I make the move here. I tell her, “No, it’s my friend Karen, but I will make sure to do introductions.” I tell her my mother-in-law knows her mom. They go on senior trips together. I also tell her we missed her at the reunion. She said the boss frowns on that kid of stuff. I raise my eyebrows and she says “don’t ask”….she tells me she is married and her husband works at the hospital and they have one daughter. I go back to the ………. About the whole situation. Dave and the boss tell her they found the house and bought it. Both Karen and I yell without me (her) looking at it? Dave runs to her and hugs her and says, “Honey, it’s perfect.” We pack up the kids and the boss who rides with me to got to the office. I can feel him looking at me. The view is spectacular. There is a lake, mountains, stream, etc. It’s picture perfect. I can tell Karen is very pissed off. We go into the house. It has eight bedrooms and the kitchen is to die for: red cabinets, stainless steel appliances, pantry with a walk-in, …a cook’s dream! The kids are running through the house and are exited. I’m even getting excited. Dave and Karen are upstairs arguing. I take the kids on a walk with the boss. It is so beautiful it takes your breath away. The boss says to me, “I want what’s best for my employees. I say I’m sure you do. I want what’s best fro my friends. He tells me he will make sure the Zune family has everything they desire. I ask for what price? He says Dave is brilliant and will make his company grow. I tell him that Karen is my dear friend and I want what’s best for her and you’ll have to deal with me if she’s not happy. He agrees, but has a very sly smile. We go back to the house and Karen and Dave are in the kitchen with their arms around each other. Karen tells the boss they will stay if Katie (her oldest daughter) and her husband and baby can come live with them and he works for the boss’s company. The boss says no problem. She comes over to me and hugs me and says also that all of her dear friends are welcome to visit in the community. The boss and I share a look. He tells her yes, but his eyes tell me don’t come back. I hug Karen, Dave and the kids, as I get ready to leave. Karen walks me to the car and says it’ll be okay. I give her another hug and kiss and tell her to keep in touch. I drive away from this beautiful perfect community knowing I will never see my friend again. I am very sad when I wake up.

I dreamed of being in Neverland with Peter Pan. Several other super villains from other comics and cartoon were also there. Hydroman was there with this other guy who could turn to ice and water. Hydroman was more powerful. I dream of this great fight on the Jolly Roger. I’m watching the torn sails white on sky blue then red. Peter flies into an incredible back flip and falling on his back. Wendy readied a large net to try and stop the villains.

I am at a house with my hairdresser’s sister, Amy. I have known both these girls for over twenty-five years. Amy and I are dusting a clock with shelves. We are using a vacuum with a brush. Amy is telling me about her boyfriend, Kevin. She is going on and on saying what a wonderful guy he is, how handy he is and how handsome he is. She just doesn’t stop. Amy tells me he is going to be stopping over to meet me. We continue to dust the clock, which is very delicate. We are ever so careful as to not break any of the parts. It is a beautiful piece of artistry. Very old, worth lots of money and very sentimental. There is a knock at the door. Amy goes to the door and Kevin is at the door. She brings him in and I turn and find that it is Kevin, the maintenance tech from work. I am shocked. I keep saying over and over, “I can’t believe you are dating Kevin. I know he is a great guy. Amy you are so lucky!” I am in awe then I remember that Kevin is married to Doreen, just as he is about to answer me, I wake up.

(A continuation of last week’s dream) Theresa LaBelle sits eating in the back of a soup kitchen in LaSalle, a Burroughs of Montreal. She’s been abandoned by her biological father Luke and her mother and stepfather have died in a car accident. I tell her that she can move into a house that I’ve bought. Her face lights up. Outside the room, the din of voices and kitchen were continuing like a great backdrop of sound to our poignant little scene. We decide to go to a movie later. The movie is “Heavenly Creatures” and in the middle of it, I’m wondering why I’ve taken this feral child to it. Near the end of the film, as Juliet is taken away from Pauline, Theresa disappears from my side. I wake up.
I’m on a cruise ship in which we are participating in a huge dinner party.
I am involved with two women sexually, although I wake up before anything really happens beyond hugging one another.

195. Two dreams about friends dying in front of me. First, Laurie Pepper. Kyle and I are sitting there talking to Laurie and she has a giant seizure and dies in front of us. We set her up in a chair. Next, in another dream, Trina dies in front of me as she's walking up to the house. I think, Oh well, that's the end of Trina. (Not sure why two people died in front of me in my dream. Both Laurie and Trina once tried to become real estate agents, but didn't like it.)

I dreamed I was driving Christina down some residential road. It seemed like middle or late fall. As we drove, the houses on each side of the road became more widely spaced until we reached her place. It was utterly destroyed. Sideboards were strewn all over the lawn; windows were missing. I asked if she wanted my help in restoring it. She answered. It was like “no”, but I can’t discern what exactly it was she said. She just walked into this rundown old mess.
196. Packing, having to go to a class then the airport. I'm afraid that I'm late but people help me and I find some friends and get to the class right on time.
197. I order a custom made dress but then worry how much it will cost $200-300k? So I find out I don't have to buy it but I can order a plant instead. Maybe something to put on my patio.
198. A lot of dreams about buying a house. There are two houses - the second one is better.

I had a weird dream last night. In my dream, I was at Jack’s house, sitting at the organ bench with a fat girl in sloppy clothes. This girl seemed to be Susan, my note-taker from math class, even though she’s not fat in real life. The organ console was in the middle of a living room that looked more like Grandma and Grandpa’s house, and Jack was a young teacher in his 30s or 40s. In a room that would be Grandpa’s bedroom, in front of the organ console (audience perspective), young Jack had a CD boom box where he was playing a Christmas carol that he wrote. He had recorded it with a band. He wanted us to take turns doing the thing where we play the melody, the chords and the bass. On this crazy console in my dream, the pedals were up very high, so much so that I had to fold my legs back under the bench and rest my knees on them when I wasn’t playing. The stop tabs were so loose, I felt like they might fall off into my hand. Some of the keys felt that way too. I was almost falling off of the bench trying not to crowd this big fat girl next to me!! Jack played the CD for us several times. This carol began like “Silent Night”, but then went totally off the wall. I couldn’t play it right no matter what. (When I was ready to play, I’d have to squish my knees up under the console so that my feet would be in their usual position.) Jack would pause the CD, then stride over to stand in front of us while I tried in vain to play it right. I kept asking this girl if she wanted to take a turn, but she kept saying, Naah, that’s alright Jasmine, I can’t really do this.” Each time I would try to play this carol, it would come out sounding more like “Silent Night” than his off-the-wall spin-off. He was starting to get a little frustrated, but not really wanting to take it out on us.
And then I had another brief, stupid dream about a fire drill during math class.
199. Buying houses - we look at two. The second one they're having a party. We want to look under the house, so we come back later. Lots of other parts that are vague now.

Bob and I are at the Ice Capades. We go to get a beer. He kisses me and I pull back and look at him. I feel fluttery and laugh. After the Ice Capades, he drops me off and says, “ I know you felt something too.” I tell him I don’t want to jeopardize our friendship. He tells me he wants more than a friendship. He says he will pick me up Saturday night for a party. Dress is semi-formal and to be ready at 8pm. He smiles and goes out the door. As the door shuts, I wake up.
200. More houses. Animals too. Vague now.

The dream leaves me in want of description. There is no doubt that nature has her dark surfaces and her recesses. In this dream, I visited a world where all human thought, experience, and emotion were laid bare. All I could see was a large oak, branching higher and higher; like some spreading decision free of predetermined human imperative. As I followed my own life path, this wholly unpleasant feeling in my gut let me know all the true motivations of myself and everyone else, about all they had ever done. It’s hard to explain but it was just this visceral feeling of meaninglessness, nausea as it were. To quote Oscar Wilde, “Try as we may, we cannot get behind the appearance of things to reality; and the terrible reason may be that there is no reality apart from appearances.”
201. Showing homes. Looking out for west facing windows.
202. Buying, selling homes - Listing appointment - traveling - lots of people.

I recall emailing several of my professors for recommendations. I’m standing in this cafeteria, but it’s not the university of Buffalo; it’s somewhere else. A teacher from several years ago, Erwin Segal, one that I knew quite well, approaches me. He greets me, shakes my hand. He mentions that he received my request, but acts rather discouraging about my going to this particular graduate program. I’m devastated and very depressed. I go to check my email and awake.
203. Helping someone decide between two houses.
