I am in France visiting a school. I am mostly roaming the corridors. Eventually, someone starts following me and interrogating me. We speak French. The conversation is somewhat aimless and I wake up.

I see myself about twenty years old and I’m visiting a relative in Maine. The experience takes place at night. I’m trying to retrieve some papers that are somewhat sensitive and had been left outside the house. AS I am taking off with the papers, three men try to apprehend me. Somehow, I manage to escape. I wake up.

I had a most bizarre dream last night. All of us were supposed to ride in a space ship along with several astronauts. They had something to look for in Space, and, well, we were just along for the ride. It worked like this: The space shuttle rocket was about 10 stories tall, and it ambled through city streets with a large diesel engine. All 9 of us sat in regular truck-like seats about the 4th or 5th story up. It was supposed to roll through the streets until it got to the North Pole, and then it would be easier to blast off from there! But somehow we had to stop at the Farm in my relative’s home town first, in order to fix something on the space ship. The thought of going to Space scared me somewhat, but I couldn’t imagine what we might see out there. I was eager to find out. As soon as we began riding again, I woke up.
205. Helping Tim(?) look at property. A school or place I'm in - no privacy. I need to find a bathroom but can't pee.

I’m in this room where I kept all my writing and musical compositions. My brothers Ethan and Christian are there with Nick and my friends Alec and Alex. They’re talking about me and are going through my journals. I finally comprehend that I must have died. They seem quite upset; it’s quite touching actually. I never knew any of them cared that much, except for Alex I guess. I always was a loyal and devoted friend and brother. Alex, I have made executor of my will it seems. Further, I have instructed that all my writing be burned along with my compositions unless the provision states (or reads rather) they can be of any use to the present company. It’s nice watching Alex and Alec meet Nick; he didn’t now them. My friends are getting along famously with my brothers. It seems that I have left them quite a lot of money. Alec, of course, doesn’t need it. This is so strange. I very much want to read one of my journals but my hand passes through it. I think of all the nice memories I have with each person in this room. I’ve always treasured them, I think. I fade away as Alex decides not to honor my wishes and burn my work.

The Lakes HOA comes in and [the directors] sit in a circle to start their meeting. They pass around an agenda and ask me to write something on the agenda, so I write, Let's do something good for the people and do it in an honorable way.

I am in a religious community of men and women: three men(maybe four) and four women. I am in my forties. A couple of us are discussing man/woman relationships in the community. We moved on to the situation where two persons (a man and a woman) become attracted to one another. How does the community deal with this situation? I wake up.

I am navigating my way through this foreign-looking city. I recall this great stretching industrial quarter: factories, grain silos, and barges near the wharfs. The sky is so gray, so endless. I’m driving under the bridge of a canal; the road climbs through an enormous junkyard, hedging the late afternoon water. I had a removed feeling here, a little touch of de-realization. Through a serpentine woodland along a promontory, I recognize none of it. The road ends on some big open space of grass. I get out and it’s as if I’d been driving for years. My legs, having worked there way to numbness, my eyes, soft for having watched the road for so long. I feel stuck in this moment, like all my memories hitherto, and her to fare are somehow tied to this moment, like the great breakers that bruise the Cliffside, have been at it since time immemorial like Zeus’ great bird to the torso of Prometheus, day after day, year after year. Like this moment is all that’s ever been. This instant of sensory interface with the world is all there’s ever been and all that ever will be. No Siva or Atropos to tie things up, I think. I fall asleep on the grass.

208. The first dream there are two properties. One is mine and one is Pam's listing. I buy new light bulbs and fix mine up, then I go over to hers to look at it. I notice her stuff there. She is there. I leave with her.
209. Next some people come by and want to see a beachfront listing. I want to stay there in their extra room.

210. In another dream the Kautz's have a big house. I go to see them. Like the Alameda house. I have my stuff there. Steve Kautz says it took him a while to get used to my stuff being there but he moved it out.

We (Kevin and I) are at a resort on an island. We look up and there’s a beautiful mansion up a mountain. We decide to climb up to see the mansion. It is a breathtaking hike and a beautiful place. A man (the owner) comes out of the front door to greet us. He invites us in and says he is watching his baby daughter while his wife is home. Both Kevin and I can tell how much he adores his daughter. He takes us into the nursery and his baby is awake. She is just precious and the room looks like something out of Ethan Allen. He asks us if we want a tour of the house. We both say yes. He hands the baby to me and we walk in each room. He tells us the mansion used to be a house for the Japanese during WWII. He bought it for a steal and fixed it up. He is a very nice man. His wife comes home and he asks us if we ant to go on a plane trip to view the island. We say yes. We go to the airport but by –pass the security and go in the back way to where there is a shuttle-like vessel, which we board. This shoots over to the boarding area. We board the plane and the baby is wrapped in a beautiful afghan, which is pink. We are in the plane and it looks like a submarine. We take off and the view is spectacular; hot color of the water is a blue/aqua. The couple invites us to stay at their place while we are on vacation.

I had a semi-bad dream last night. I say that because I wasn’t afraid, just sad and in a pickle. I was supposed to play at an important dinner at a rather up-scale restaurant. Mom and Janet were with me. (Where was Jim? I sort of had the notion he wasn’t feeling well). I wouldn’t need the Privia since the restaurant was supposed to have a piano. But when I got there, I was presented with this little octagon table with pegs and strings forming an intricate web. There were no keys or hammers, and somehow, I was supposed to pluck this thing like a guitar. I was puzzled and mystified. Somehow, I was able to get the opening phrase to one of my Bach minuets out of this thing, and could even make it sound just like a real piano. But when I got to the development section, I lost any mastery of it that I ever had. I couldn’t make a sound with it. I sat, stood, bent over it, walked around behind it, to no avail. Then Janet said, “Don’t worry Jasmine, I’ve got an accordion that you might be able to play.” This was encouraging. I walked over to a table where she was sitting with Mom. She pulled this little coffee bag out of her purse and gave it to me. I opened it with much excitement, expecting a miniature typical accordion inside. Instead, I pulled out a red, hard plastic upside-down hat. It had no keys, strings or moving parts for that matter. How could any human be expected to get a tune out of this thing? I tried stringing a rubber band over it, but that was futile. I also noticed a hard-plastic purple party hat on the table. At this time, Mom and Janet both disappeared. I felt that they were mingling on the other side of the room. I sat there at this table surrounded by elderly strangers sobbing, howling and whimpering like a retard. I could barely control myself. Here I was, supposed to be entertaining this crowd and utterly unable to. I wanted to find Mom immediately, race home in the car and be back with the Privia in no time. But where was she in this sea of strangers? Just then, I heard an organ in novice hands. My heart leaped into the air, feeling that the evening had been saved. I followed my ears into a bar area, only to find that the instrument was being played on TV! At halftime of a football game, they were showing a special on the history of the university’s chapel (whatever university was playing). The big TV showed a man sitting on the bench trying to convince a toddler to sit on the bench and play a little tune. She kept running away. Then suddenly Mom and Cassandra were there. I laughed and said, “Does that look familiar?” And then I woke up. When I awoke, I had real tears in my eyes. I hope I wasn’t really sobbing in my sleep.

211. I'm staying at a friend's house - a big family. They want to cook dinner. Janette is there, coaching me. Someone brings some fresh organic lettuce. At the end I start to wash it off to make myself a salad. They already have some salads made, but I want the organic lettuce. Lots of other parts, vague now. Kyle was also in this dream - sleeping in the back room. I see him there and cover him up with a blanket. That woke him up and he ducked in the bathroom to take a shower. I think that's okay because he takes fast showers. I need to take one too. It was the Longbow house.

I remember having someone chasing me in the dream. I was running and looking back to try to find out who it was but could not. My legs were so tired I thought they were going to give out, but they didn’t.

I am in the Army. A number of soldiers and myself are patrolling the area around the base. I am using a dirt bike and getting the job done much more quickly. When I get back to the base, I find myself in a facility which resembles a house and a lady is there preparing a meal . She is naked. I wake up.

My maternal grandmother had decided to enroll (at the age of 77) in Physics at the University of Buffalo. I went with her to a four hundred level class titled “Modern Physics.” I have to say; she’s quite come into her own on the subject. The teacher, who seems a composite of Conrad Kabza and Bill Rittel, dispenses with an amusing presentation. While his manner of address has all the charisma of Kobz, his lessons are as vacuous as Rittle’s were, albeit this teacher is importing significantly more complex material. Dorothy, my grandmother, is explicating the “double slit” experiment., fixing the premise nicely in the firmament of statistical mechanics. Prof seems to believe that position and velocity should be cognizable with equivalent certainty. Not so says Dorothy. Now Dorothy has literally taken command of the class. Her paper: To Fix Shrodinger’s Equations With a Hint of Entropy: An Exercise in Clarity.” I’m at my seat half greatly impressed, half greatly diverted. My grandmother and I are discussing the subject in her sitting room, as I grow tired. I fall asleep in one of her recliners.

212. I'm at some big public place and a riot starts where people with big yellow Ayatollah heads try to storm into the buildings. Everyone is afraid of Iran, but I'm not. I run outside and take a walk. In another part, I try to program an exercise machine for a five and a half minute walk, but it programs for a table soccer game instead. I want to get a refund.

This dream is extremely brief or at least what I remember is brief. The lady who was cooking for me on the previous night is doing my laundry tonight. She is still naked. I do not know her. I wake up.

She’s had two children with her husband, she has three now. There’s quite a lot I can’t recall here. I feel sad watching her, like she’s lived a lifetime already. She looked so tired. I’m at a beach, Long Beach. Nick, Ethan, and I are playing songs together as enormous breakers smack the shoreline. I can’t recall the name of the song, but it has quite an intensity to it. “In this world I never see the sun,” Nick sings. “And planets in their orbits sweep, like pebbles to some great ocean’s deep. I don’t recall the rest, but I do recall the melody and finger-style of the verse scene change. Now I’m sitting with Liette and we’re eating poutiness. It’s like old times..we just chat. A nice summer breeze sifts through the west window. I feel relaxed.

213. I see some dead bodies and call the police. I get so scared I can't talk. One is a woman stuffed in a washing machine. One is when the old guy stuffs bodies into suitcases. I push him down a flight of stairs. I get so frightened a dead body in the washing machine I show the cops.
214. In another dream I'm visiting my parents' house on Longbow. There are a lot of little things to fix. I want to bring a handyman over to fix things.
215. The only part I remember is walking around with a blanket that drags on the ground. Someone was with me who picked up the ends for me. I didn't care if it got dirty.

I’m playing this weird board game with my friend Alec. It involves the movement of these chess-like insect-like pieces along the edges of this great cube. I remember there being a number of rules for moving pieces. Pieces were red in the shape of ants, white in the shape of scorpions, anteaters were in black. You had to play as either Albedo or Ruhedo. I played with Alec and Hannah for a number of hours, ‘twas quite exhausting.

We are at a wedding. My cousin Doug and his wife are at the wedding. I think it’s their daughter, Danica, who is getting married. The church is outdoors with an altar. It is so hot and humid that we could hardly breathe. Pattie is in tears because of the weather. I get up out of my seat and tell her it will be fine since the weather will be changing in a few hours. She cries and says, “The reception is outside.” I tell her I will take care of it. I see Danica who is drenched in seat and tears. I go to the main desk and tell them we have to move everything inside. The cook says it’s impossible. I tell them it’s not and we need to move quickly and tell them to leave it to me. I make an announcement to everyone to grab their chair and move inside. The wedding party grabs the flowers from the altar. We all go inside to set up the service, then I tell everyone to go outside and grab a table and bring it in. We get it all set up and Danica and Pattie are just so happy. It’s so nice and cool in the hall. The ceremony takes place and everyone is happy.

This dream takes place at the parish mission (a weeklong parish retreat activity). As I look around at the participants, I find myself very happy to see a lady making the mission, for some reason I didn’t expect her to be there.

216. Hanging around with friends Jeanne and Janet - also some doggies. Then I am to go travel in India. I am going alone but they say I can bring someone if I want. It's kinda late to invite someone, but I run into Pat Thomas and she says she's going. I kinda don't want to go.

217. dreamed I was listening to the Stephanie Miller Show in a van - sleeping in the front seat. Some other people got in the van and I woke up and left (Then I woke up and listened to the last fifteen minutes of the show.

218. In this dream I am in my home office with some people. It's almost time to close, I want to walk up the street to see some of the homes. There are several that are special - owned by someone and special architecture. I walk up the street and look. Suddenly I'm wearing no clothes and it's very difficult to walk. I strain to walk, as if fighting a strong wind or my muscles are failing. I'm naked and people stare at me. When I get back inside I feel okay and my clothes are back. I ask them to lock up and leave. Lots of other parts to this dream, can't remember now.

I’m in this therapist’s office again; the one I first saw at sixteen. Yet, I’m observing him talking to this guy (around fifty years old). I’m looking at this same painting of the ocean. It’s calm today, save for the few reeds by its edge that shudder with the tiny little breezes. The doctor is talking. The guy is really depressed. He’s talking about how his wife has left him, how he’s never really had a close relationship with anyone before. My eyes are fixed on the painting. I’m just so tired and it’s so peaceful to watch. The doctor tells the man that he should go to the theater tonight, the great Pagliacci is in town. “Doctor”, the man begins to cry. The doctor says that this should cheer him up. “But I am Pagliacci”, the man says. Suddenly, it’s quiet, and I think I see a curtain fall. There are drum rolls. I can’t see the painting anymore.

219. A contest. They ask what the prez will be eating and Jolie guessed it. She gets $350 cash and I'm a little jealous. But then I think - 'I'm very fortunate. I'm about to make a lot of money." They take a photo of the winners with their checks. It's up in a tall Building on Hollywood Boulevard. Someone in the class runs back to look out the window. It's a lot of stuff about our evil leaders - making fun of them.

I am buying bran flakes and when I get to the check out counter, I start fumbling around for change which I’m having trouble finding. This is an issue that drives me nuts especially when women are having trouble searching through their humongous pocket books for four pennies.

220. In one part I live in a house where one of the rooms is rented to a man. I meet him and ask how he likes living there. He says he likes it. In another part I go to the morning program at the temple. Mukunda is there - he has to move up to the front to give class. I run out to get a drink of water and run back to my apartment. I’m terribly ill, my body aches, my head throbs. I’m in this jail cell; my only window to the outside world is this tiny barred window. Little welters of sound smack me in the temple, cast through the bars by someone or a bunch of someones. The fever rages in me for hours. I perceive a slow ticking in my head, slow like the molecule of water that suddenly expands into ice, too quick to quantify, but ever so slow. The voices; there are a pattern of streams. I see the blue. I’m delirious. The ocean, I see it, tossing little sailboats about in it turn. Days turn to nights, then into weeks, finally it abates. I’m back down on this tiny bed in this prison, the fever is gone. Outside, I can hear families picnicking, children playing. It’s calming. I don’t mind being here, I think. Prison is okay. I can’t remember why I’m even here. I remember only this one letter I received, delivered by this guard from a woman. She had written that I had done something unavoidable. I’m falling asleep. Less light from my window, less laughter, the stream bubbles on and I fall asleep.
222. An apartment complex - one of the units was painted up like a sixties place. I say Joey lived in several of the units before he died.

In this dream, I am saying goodbye to Priscilla (my ex wife) and her husband is standing there with her. We give each other a very meaningful kiss. As I am leaving, I find myself feeling guilty that Priscilla’s husband witnessed the kiss.

I had a dumb dream last night. I was with Mom, some teachers and about 25 college students, and we were all going on some organized Spring Break trip to an island or theme park. (I felt that it was Hawaii, where Cassandra went with Penny). First, I was riding an elevator trying to figure out where I was going. Once I got on the right plane, I found everybody that I was supposed to find. We flew like usual. But then, suddenly I realized that there were no windows or top to the plane, and it was floating in shallow water like a boat. Nobody was alarmed, for the pilot did this on purpose. Apparently, we were very close to our destination. Next thing I knew, we were all swimming rather than walking as we went about our actions and conversations. Our setting was similar to the water-playground at Adventure Island, except that the water was much deeper. Beforehand, a survey was taken from all of the traveling students with the question “Which celebrity guest would you most like to accompany us on our trip? The top three most selected people would be invited to go with us. I put Bruce Hornsby, and he was one of the top three, so he got invited, and he came. So as we were all swimming through this little playground and back to the boat like little mermaids, I was asking about where he was, and when he’d be coming to join us. Somehow, I entered this dark little room underneath the playground equipment because I got lost. There was sufficient room for my head to be above the water without bumping the ceiling, and light was coming in, so it wasn’t really all that scary. I felt afraid though because there were big doors, like you’d see in any modern building today, where a push-bar lets you out. I didn’t know if they’d sound any alarms. I called for help from the top of my lungs for a while, but nobody seemed to be hearing me or caring about my plight. Finally, some sympathetic college girl opened one of the doors for me and let me swim out. I found Mom in ankle-deep water conversing with some teacher. She was right outside the door, almost. I was disturbed and a little slighted that she was too busy talking to hear me calling. Then, when she was done, we set off together to go find Bruce Hornsby. The two of us walked down this little boardwalk through this nature-trail area. There was a Muscovy duck in the pond. Mom said that the duck was Bruce Hornsby’s embodiment, and that he was no longer walking around as a human. Therefore, I would just have to talk to the duck. I felt that she was saying this just to keep me from looking for the man further, so I was pretty upset. I stamped on the hollow wood as we turned around. Next thing I knew, we were on grounds that looked like Macadams, but it was right at the water’s edge rather than at the top of the pier. We had rejoined the group, which was bustling around, ordering food and talking while Bruce Hornsby the man was setting up for a concert. I had found him at last. He had an audio mixer instead of a keyboard, balanced on top of two huge speakers. Come to think of it, I believe he had an acoustic piano mic’d up going into that mixer. I didn’t converse with him at all. I woke up before I could.

I think I had another little post-script dream that something was wrong with the car. It was something with the electrical system, preventing it from starting. From now on, we would have to take the Grandpa truck when we went driving around town.
Very vague…I remember lying in water, very warm water like a pool that was covering me. When I woke up, I thought I had wet the bed, but I didn’t. I had to pee like crazy!
I had a very descriptive dream but when I woke up, it was almost gone. The dream involved: dice, alligators and boats.

There are some legal issues that need to be resolved between the government and some lawyers. I am on the side of the government . Involved in this controversy is an older lady who is being interrogated in a private situation. She is dressed in a bathrobe. She has an illness of some sort. The dream ends with my willingness to agree to whatever a couple are willing to agree to. I don’t know any of these people. So many of the people in my dreams are strangers.

I’m in a house on a hill. There are two kids in the house with me. I don’t know who they are. The doorbell rings and it’s Tom Cruise at the door. He smiles and asks to come in. The three of us are in the living room talking to Tom. The boy asks to go for a ride on his bike down the road. I tell him that’s fine. The girl and I continue to talk to Tom. I go into the kitchen to get drinks and I come back and the girl is gone. I ask Tom “Where did she go?” He smiles and comes at me. He grabs me and we wrestle to the floor. He is trying to kill me. I grab a vase and hit him in the head. I find the girl tied up. I untie her and run to get help. Tom comes into the bedroom with a look to kill on his face. He tackles me. I scream to the girl to run because she is just frozen in the doorway. I grab a pair of scissors from the dresser and try to stab him. He just laughs and takes them from me. He opens the scissors and slices my left forearm. The pain is unbearable. He continues to laugh, throwing his head back. I grab a perfume bottle off the dresser and spray it in his eyes. I escape and run down the road. I am just about to get to the top of a hill and I wake up.

I am driving along a city street when the traffic comes to a halt. Eventually, I realize there is an unmarked toll gate ahead of me. I have to get out of the car to pay the toll. The toll taker tells me the toll is five dollars. I don’t know what to do because I don’t have five dollars. I had forgotten my wallet. (I often do this) The guard then tells me he was kidding. The toll is really twenty eight cents. This is all I had. I paid my toll and took off.

I had a dumb birthday dream last night… already! I dreamed that it was my birthday, and we were having a party. At least 10 couples and some other people filled our house. We planned to have cake, presents, a concert by Yours Truly and some other fun activities. Well, I was sitting on the porch with a number of them, and Dad was in the living room exercising. Some neighborhood activist began to read her legal dissertation report that she had prepared. (It was long, boring and not the thing to leave people in a very fun mood.) After she had finished, everyone applauded sincerely. Then, Mom stood up from the swing next to me and began reading a children’s storybook to our guests. They seemed to enjoy this too. But I realized that many of them were beginning to trickle out the door. Before I knew it, I was left with Mom, Dad and Bailey Morgan, a former neighborhood board member. There had been no cake or presents, and I hadn’t played for anyone! The party was a total dud! As I began to awaken, I was thinking how it was the week before my birthday and that there was still time to stage another party on the actual day.

I’m at my old job in Lockport. It’s about twenty-five years ago. I’m working but I’m so sad, very sad. I’m just gong through the motions at work. Angie, a co-worker, asks me what is the matter. I tell her my brother died last night then the tears came. I cried and cried. I told Angie they don’t know whether it was a heart attack or an aneurysm. I’m devastated. I tell her the calling days will be Saturday and Sunday and the funeral Monday morning. He was thirty-one years old! She asks about his kids, Charity and Aaron. I say I will take them and will make sure that bitch (his ex-wife) doesn’t get them. We are now at my old house and people are coming in. My parents are there and old neighbors and friends. The ex walks in and takes Charity from her nip-nap. Shelly, the ex, sits down with her and tells her not to worry, that she will take care of her and her brother. I burst in to the room and tell her she will not have the kids. She left them for her life of drugs and drinking and David made arrangements for me to bring them up if anything happened to him. She just smiles at me. I am enraged and sad at the same time. My Godfather takes my hand and leads me into another room. He tells me this is not the time or place for this. It’s time to grieve David. I fall into his arms crying. I wake up crying.
223. In a house or someplace with a bunch of people. There is a man there who is a combination of Kyle and Tim. He kisses me.

I’m on a team with the girls. It’s a baseball team. I’m new and the oldest player. The girls are all seniors in high school. I’m at least ten years older. I tell them I used to play in high school. The bus driver tells them to get dressed or they will be off the bus. They don’t listen and he throws them off the bus. They both hang on naked to the front of the bus as we travel to the next game.

I am at an airport. Security is extremely tight. Accidentally I enter a section of the airport which is off-limits to passengers and a variety of alarms are immediately triggered. Men with guns surround me and take me to an interrogation center. They let me go as soon as they realize it was a mistake.

I had a dumb dream last night. In my dream, I was in Haley Springs, but somehow wandered away from Mom and Dad, and whoever else we were with. I went to this school complex where this state-wide musical competition was taking place. Mrs. Dougherty and her class would be there, and I wanted to watch them perform. I also wanted to wander into one of the rooms and play for the judges. After all, I felt that large concert grands would be all over, and that there was even a category for student pianists. I could pretend to be in Mrs. Dougherty’s class! In the lobby, I was relishing the thought of playing my sonatinas and receiving feedback from the judges. But when I walked into the little classroom, I realized that I’d walked into the wrong room. I’d walked into the solo singing room instead! I sang a bit for this big, fat woman, and my song was thin, lame and pukey. I was so disappointed that I’d wasted my one shot in the wrong room doing what I was not cut out to do in the first place! Next, I found myself in the small auditorium where the chorus was going to sing. Mom and Dad had caught up with me somehow, and would wait outside until I had seen their show. Something was really going wrong with the lights. It was totally dark in there except for some colored lights that were being shined on the chorus. People were misbehaving onstage, and someone kept climbing on a ladder messing with the lights while the show was in progress. Then, I woke up.

Last night, I had a confusing and vague dream that I was attending this big convention/party all by myself. Mom was around somewhere, but she was busy doing her own thing. This had something to do with opera, the orchestra guild and something to do with ATOS all at the same time, set at a school complex kind of like my high school and School. . I was going around doing these different little things that weren’t really that taxing by themselves, but on the whole, it was very commotiony. I have no taste in dreams, so I can’t tell you what it was like. I have vague memories of riding elevators, but I can’t quite tell where I was going. I remember seeing a vague image of a Wurlitzer in a hotel banquet hall that had somehow lost most of its stop tabs. We both had clothes on. I had my head on his shoulder, kind of like I’m used to laying with Mom. We talked a little, but I can’t remember what we were saying. He was just feeling awful when all of this partying was going on, and I wanted to keep him company because I felt that I really couldn’t party either. Shortly thereafter, I woke up.

I am at some kind of a religious convocation. I am not sure what is going on. It seems to be a gathering of a variety of religious. It seems we have met to consider if we can find a common ground for us to agree on. As we debate some initial issue, the governing committee elects me to be in charge of the convocation. I am in a room, which is like a gym. There are people everywhere. All of them seniors. I am trying to see what they all want on their pizza. The people are all dressed in street clothes with various colors. The faces are blacked out. I can see their hair, but no face, it is completely black. I ask, “What do you want on your pizza.” No one answers me; they just talk among themselves about the pizza. I keep asking, “Pepperoni? Mushrooms? Onions? Is that what you want? Still no one answers me. I am getting very frustrated. I scream at the top of my lungs, “Just make a fucking decision people! This is not rocket science, it’s a simple task.” Still, no one answers me. I tell them I do not want to hear one bitch after the pizza comes.

I’m on a ferry with my father and several uncles. My father is Tony Soprano. He tells me I am too opaque and not to show everything on my face. If I am gong to be in the “business”, I have to learn how to have a blank face. The uncles agree with him. We get off the ferry and go to a restaurant. We have stuffed scallops with shrimp. It is delicious. Tony says this is going to be my new life now. After dinner, we go to a hotel. It is a beautiful place with water everywhere. All of a sudden, gunfire stars. The setting of the dream is at our cabin in the Southern Tier. Jane, my friend and her entire family are there (they have never been to the cabin in reality) along with Kevin. The family consists of Jane, her husband Pete, their son Brian, Lisa and Chris their daughter and son –in-law, Delaney Lisa and Chris’ daughter and my goddaughter, and her friend Jane and Spencer (Chris and Lisa’s son). Delaney and Jane are eight, and Spencer is five. We are in the cabin having a great time playing cards and games because it’s raining outside. I get up to start dinner. I get a sharp paring knife out to cut up vegetables and Delaney and Jane (the friend) come over to help. I tell them the knife is very sharp and I don’t want them to get hurt. I can cut the vegetables and they can help with something else. Big Jane says, “Let them cut them up and help at home.” I turn to Jane and say, “The knife is too sharp.” She says, “They’ll have to learn.” I tell her I don’t want them to learn the hard way, especially since we are out in the boondocks with no phone or near-by hospital. She tells the girls to cut up the veggies. I scream at Big Jane saying, “You have to control everything don’t you? Just leave me alone, you are not going to control me like you do your family!” Everyone is looking at me. I run outside and Kevin runs after me. We go for a walk in the woods and I am crying like crazy. I tell Kevin I love Jane, but I can’t stand her controlling ways. He understands. We get back to the cabin and it has stopped raining. The little girls are at a pond with an older gentleman. The water is as clear as can be. The girls are under water, talking and playing. They come to the surface and I bend down to apologize for my outburst. I tell them that I’m sorry I lost my temper and it had nothing to do with them. I just didn’t want them to get cut from the very sharp knife. I asked them if they understood and they said yes. They went back under the water to play. On the way to the cabin, Lisa, Chris and Spencer are playing catch. I apologize to them. Lisa tells me no apologies are necessary; “I have lived with her controlling ways my entire life. I don’t really have a choice because she is my mother. But you do. You don’t have to put up with her ways. The choice is yours.” Kevin and I get to the cabin, we step up onto the porch. Jane is at the door looking out. As she opens the door, I wake up.

236. I go to a place with a big reservoir - like The Lakes - It has a ledge and no boats will float past the ledge. Also, another big lake with some other problem. (Woke up working about 1. My tooth, 2. Money, 3. My plane ticket, 4. Everything else.)

Bob has dropped me off at my house after our “friends only” coffee date. He asks me if I want to go see the Ice Capades. I say yes. He says he will pick me up and I say no, I will meet him there. I laugh and say picking me up is too much like a date and we are just friends. He says it’s dumb to take two cars downtown and asks to meet at the mall and drive together. I agree. We get to the HSBC Center and the place is packed!! We go up the escalator and the crowd is so thick. Bob grabs my hand so we don’t get lost from each other and I feel a tingle, almost like a shock. I look at him and I can see he feels it too. As we enter the hall to get to our seats, we let go of hands. We sit down and neither one of us says anything. We watch the show. At intermission, we go out to the concession stand. He asks me if I want a beer. I say yes. Again, it is very crowded. I stand in front of him at the concession stand and he puts his hands on my shoulders. I feel the tingle again. I lean very gently back, sort of resting on him, thinking, “what the hell am I doing?” We get our beers and go over to a hallway to drink them. We are chatting and laughing and all of a sudden, Bob leans down and kisses me right no the lips. Talk about a tingle, it is more like an electrical current going through my body! I pull away and ask, "What the hell are you doing?” He just smiles and says “It’s time to go back to watch the show.” We go back and neither one of us talks the entire time. After the show, I invite him in for coffee. He follows me to my house (which is where I live now). We are in the foyer and Lucky, my cat, is on the steps watching us. I am on the bottom step, Bob is by the door. He says, “I’m not coming up for coffee tonight, but we need to talk about what happened tonight” I tell him I just want to be friends, he says “It’s too late for that now. Our friendship has evolved into more. I felt it tonight and so did you. You can’t deny it.” He invites me to a party at his house on Saturday night. He is having some of his friends and colleagues from work over. I ask him what the attire is and he says semi-formal. I agree and he tells me to be ready at 7pm to be picked up. I agree. He comes over to the stairs and I am waiting for him to kiss me. I want him to kiss me. He hugs me and kisses me on the cheeks and says, “I will see you on Saturday.” He turns and walks out the door.

Charity (my niece) and I are going to the drive-in. She is driving my beetle-bug that has no back seat. She is driving because I am trying to teach her how to drive a stick shift. She is doing very well. We get to the drive-in, park and are ready to see two movies. I decide I have to go to the bathroom before the movie starts. I did not wear shoes, just in my stocking feet. I ask her if his drinking is a problem? She bows her head and says yes. I hug her and tell her I love her and to get some professional help. We discuss work and I say I have to get back to the car with my niece. Charity and I start walking back and time has turned back for me only. I am in my twenties. We come across a bunch of people watching the movie on the back of a pickup truck. Kevin is one of them. He jumps down and says hi. There is another guy who also comes over. He is oriental. The people are all laughing, drinking, and having a grand time. One guy tells a joke and everyone laughs. Another guy pretends he is going to kiss another guy. This part is very weird. We walk back to the bug, Kevin comes with us and so does the oriental guy. We get back to the bug and the car is filled with illegal aliens and one older woman with white hair. There is now a backseat in the bug and about twenty people in it. They will not get out. I tell them I am going to call INS on them if they don’t get out of the car. They get out and sit on a bleacher next to us, watching the second movie. Kevin and I crawl into the backseat and Charity and the oriental in the front. We watch the movie and Kevin turns to me and says, “I have been waiting wall my life for you.” I turn to him and say…….then I wake up!

Last night I had a dream that I was lying face-down in the living room, hand-copying “I’m In the Mood For Love” from A-flat minor to F-major. (I was transposing it onto a new staff paper.) I know it’s really not in that key, and it’s not even in a minor key at all, but for some reason, it was in this dream. I felt that it sounded eerie in A-flat minor, and wanted to break it free of that business and get it back into a major key where it belongs! Jack was there coaching me along a bit from the couch. I was having the toughest time. I didn’t know how many flats A-flat minor really had, or which ones they were, so I placed some kind of hieroglyphic symbol in place of the key signature. I struggled along counting the lines and spaces and trying to measure out the intervals, and then I brought the first half-finished page to Jack to inspect. He could see how much weight I placed on it and how hard I tried, but the piece was still an utter mess, so he said, “Well now, I don’t wanna’ put too much stress on my little pooka girl.” (This is a little Polish name that Mom used to call me when I was little.) And then I was in St. Peter’s Church before the mass. Ellen and Rosalyn were there, and so was Peter Dalton from APC. I felt like he was going to play the mass for us today. (Guess I was getting my stuff all mixed up.) We were all sitting on couches in the back of the sanctuary facing each other rather than in the pews. The pews were for the good little Catholics who did all of the right stuff. I stepped out into the middle of the floor and craned my neck up to the choir loft trying to see the pipes. There were these decorative metal hangy-down things that almost tripped me up. And then I returned to sit on the couches with everyone. And then I woke up.
240. A woman asks me to look up some property for her, then wants to buy. I'm surprised, but I'm selling property again - a good dream.

241. At a pool or pond, I swim with a big friendly turtle and a man who is a combination of Dave and Tim. The turtle is soft like the sting rays at the zoo. 242. I go to an award presentation. On the stage, all the women on the stage hold hands and stand up for truth. They try to sit down, but I'm one of them and I say stand up. Later, I find out my boss won a big award before I got there. I apologize for missing it. Sherri wins for Loyal; Carol wins for friendly. I say if I won, it would have been for "new." I talk further with Dr. Langone. He leans toward me as we talk.
243. Writing up ideas for the anti-cult people. On the Delta King. Lots more dreams - vague now.
244. Another similar dream - doing things for the ICSA. This time in a big house. Very comfortable, peaceful. Easy to get things.

I had a really strange dream last night. I was back in Bancroft’s main building, but it was an airport that was 4 stories high; and yet it was still a school in some respects. I had classes there, but I had to meet Mom at a particular gate because we were supposed to get on a plane together. I don’t recall where we were going, but I knew that it wasn’t to my relative’s home town as usual. On the return flight, we were supposed to bring home a piano from some distant city, and apparently there was a special section of the plane that would accommodate this. We had to sit there on the first flight, just so they could keep track of everyone. Ha, ha, that is so funny! So the actual action began when I was coming out of class looking for this gate. I needed to be on the 3rd floor, and I was on the 4th. The building was designed in a really strange way. The 3rd floor had a balcony at one end that overlooked the second floor. This was the end where the elevator was, so the elevator wouldn’t stop at the 3rd floor. (It came to a dead end and a balcony before coming anywhere near the side of the building where the elevator was. The opposite end of the building didn’t really appear to have a stairwell. As I frantically went from one little gate desk to the next, I was asking the people where I needed to go. The ladies at the closest little desk told me that the stairwell was located through the set of doors which they pointed to. When I opened them, it wasn’t like a real stairwell though. It was like a pipe chamber with little narrow ladders connecting different levels, and it was totally dark. Aside from small platforms at the base of the ladders, there were no real divisions between the building’s levels. There was no notion that this place had a big organ, but to me, this area looked like a pipe chamber. It could have been anything. There were obtrusive things all around, filling the empty space in there. It was this no-man’s land that ran the entire height of the building in place of a stairwell. I debated how on earth I was going to get myself and my book bag down 3 of these little ladders to the next story, afraid of the dark and afraid of slipping and falling into oblivion. After climbing halfway down one ladder, I decided that I couldn’t go any further. After all, the ladies at the gate said to come back to them if I had trouble. (Meanwhile, I worried about missing the plane.) When I came back into the building, the ladies asked me, “Did you find it?” I nodded and said, “I’m… I’m…” not really wanting to say, “I’m afraid of the dark.” They seemed to get the message just the same, and they both volunteered to help me down. At that point, I began to wake up, beginning to feel satisfied that I’d eventually reach Mom and that plane.

245. packing to go home. I have a large suitcase but have room for lots of things. (Long time no remember dreams . . . Too work hard . . .. dream fragments are of travel, packing, visiting houses - dreams feel instructive like they have something to teach me.)

I dreamed that I had the sheet music for “As Time Goes By” in one of those little folder things like our chorus scores would come in. It had this really ornate drawing on the front. It was too hard for me to play, and I wanted to give it to somebody. I can’t remember if it was Jean or Cassandra, but it was one of them. We had an upright piano in place of the loveseat that had carving to match the ornate drawing on the cover. I felt that the two belonged together, and that the recipient of the score would be resentful not to get the upright to go with it! But I didn’t have a mind to give it away too! And that was all there was to that one.

I dreamed that I was back in Winter Park with the Hammond. I was in my old apartment, and the organ set in the place of my little bedroom sink counter that I never used. (I had two sinks in my room, one in the bathroom and the other outside). There was ample space to either side and I was thinking, “Gee, I really could have fit a console the size of Jack’s in here.” I felt relieved and peaceful that Jill was outa’ my hair, but had the feeling she might be back someday. And that was really all there was to it.
246. A party is planned for a politician. I come over to see what it is and tell him.
247. I work at a place where I have all sorts of piles of work to do. Typing, sorting, editing, etc.

159. There was a baby around the age of 1 and there was another baby with me and we were running through a parking garage and came outside to the end and it was raining. And sitting there was a green taxi cab with some guy in it and we kept on running. Next thing I remember, all of a sudden I was in the middle of a road in a bathtub with two other girls and a floating poster comes up and his arm pops out of the poster and points a gun at us, and one girl was like, “Do it, shoot us!” But I was freaking out and the poster floated away.

Lately, I’ve been having some very funny little dreams. I haven’t been recounting most of them because they’re usually extremely short and fleeting, and don’t really mean much in the long run. A handful of them have stuck with me thus far, so I figured I ought to let you in on them. Well, last night, I had two. The first was a little longer and more involved. Dad and I were picking through a deserted house that was about to be demolished. There was a little bit of haphazard, nonsensical furniture here and there that we had to climb over. We were finding dolls, hair decorations, empty book bags and other little things. There were mostly toys actually. There was a broken pony that I sort of wanted, and a fake ice cream cone. We were standing in a broken bird bath / people bath tub when Dana from CFTOS showed up. She and Dick had bought the house and intended to turn it into a haven for ancient instruments to belong to our chapter. It would be like a museum of sorts. Then, I felt very guilty that we were there taking stuff from this place. She had every right to keep those diddley things, and we had no business taking them, but I had the feeling that we were actually helping her clean. Then suddenly we were in the living room of this empty place, and we were having our chapter meeting. They managed to move quite a nice grand piano into the foyer, and I was sitting on the bench next to someone who was playing. (I was watching). Then, someone else took his place, and I felt that I was in his way. I stood up, looked for a chair and then was on to the next little dream.

In my dream, I heard a story on TV about a teenage boy who had killed himself, but beforehand, had poisoned a cow along with him. He gave the cow a deadly mixture of some kind of poison and street drugs mixed in yogurt. I actually had far more sympathy for the cow than for the boy. I cried for her, and had real tears in my eyes when I woke up. I felt that the boy was a senseless sick-minded creep who couldn’t really garner much of my sympathy, and that the cow was a poor, innocent creature who suffered as she left this world. Fortunately, I woke up. I don’t know why I’d dream something so horrible.
248. A man - I fall in love with a man who has a large bat. (Vague now. . .. )

249. I'm putting together a book that will be the highlights of positive thinking. Each aspect of my life has a person who makes it positive. In another part, I'm going to the airport. This time we go immediately and a plane picks us up right away and we go fast. In another part, I'm riding in a car with Mukunda. First he's driving and I'm in the back, then while we're waiting, he climbs in the back too. In another part, I draw up plans to remodel and decorate someone's house. They have a baby, so I remodel their upstairs to give the baby it's own room. Later I come back and ask my parents where my notes are, so I can work on them some more. They have already sent the plans to the people. I get very upset because it wasn't ready to send. To make it up, I make a smoothly and want to freeze it and take it to the people (or to Mary Gaillard?). I look for a glass to freeze it - from my mom's kitchen in the Longbow house.
250. Getting some work done on the house. The girl Tim knows as me has a history as a real estate agent here, but they're using me to do the real estate work.
251. I go to someone's house to fix something. I get upgraded stuff to replace what we change. (I wake up thinking about the wall that's leaning, that we share with the Arrowsmiths.)

I am in a haunted house with haunted grounds. In the dream I am going around the house and grounds, knowing how dangerous the area is. Candy is also in the dream, she tried to get close to me and I keep backing away, annoyed. It was a long dream; a lot of moving in a circular direction around the house and grounds. Later in the dream we realize the house is not haunted after all and there is a big party there (or dance) where everyone dances in and outside.
252. A dream about a house that I own (or have listed) that I stay in while it's for sale. It's very comfortable and easy.
253. another dream earlier - woke up at 3 a.m. - The dream seems so obvious, so easy to remember, that I didn't write it down. Now I forgot it.
254. Long vivid dreams about doing things for people - can't remember now.
255. All night showing real estate - Janette was here and I took her to see several large buildings. The last one was a big hotel - about fifteen stories high. Lots of work when I should be sleeping!

I had a mixed-up, nonsense dream last night. First, I dreamed that we were having Baxter stay overnight with us, since Rennie gave him far too much alcohol for his little body and made him very sick. Apparently, he’d had two little glasses of wine, a shot of whiskey and some beer too. We were driving him in the car for some reason at night, but I don’t know where we were going. We also had Cassandra and her girls with us, and they were staying overnight too. Then, Dad and Baxter were in the bedroom sleeping, Cassandra and her girls were in my bed, and Mom and I were sleeping together on the couch. Dad was still working and had come home for a few hours to stay with Baxter. His rescue truck was parked in our driveway. At certain times during the night, it would spontaneously make its sounds that I don’t like. It would go BRAAAANCH BRANCH, blare its siren or run its back-up alarm, even flash its lights, all without anyone even being near it. In fact, we were all sleeping inside the house!! The first time it did this, I clung to Mom and sort of felt frightened, but satisfied that she was there. We were under a blanket. The second time it did this during the night, I decided that the best way to deal with it was to go to the organ and imitate it! I made it go woowoowoowoo with its vibrato, then set the drawbars to sound like a flute stop and played the minor 3rd for the back-up alarm. I think I even used a reed preset to go BRAAANCH BRAAANCH! And before I knew it, I was playing “Amazing Grace” in broad daylight. Next, I was in a Spanish class watching little movies. One movie was about somebody skinny-dipping in a swamp like Huckleberry Finn. Then, we were given a little story to read. I drew King Triton in my sketch pad, and the teacher called him Beowulf. I reasoned that in Nordic mythology, maybe Beowulf was a similar sea god to the Greek Poseidon, who I believe Triton was modeled after. The object of this assignment was to write complex Spanish sentences translated from the English content and weave our Spanish sentences into a song which we wrote out on staff paper. I was having trouble drawing the beams on my 16th notes straight and clear, and wondering if I’d even understood the directions clearly. And then I began to wake up, realizing that I wouldn’t have to worry about following this through anyway.

256. I help people look for property and write a book. The book includes one adult and a child he has abused. At first I want that to be in the book but everyone says no, but then it is true and in the book. The perpetrator realizes that what he does to the children is wrong. The child sees it too.

I had a rather disturbing dream last night. I dreamed I was witnessing a fire between Megan and Suzy’s houses, more on Megan’s property. This was in the daytime. I couldn’t really see a lot, but I saw this rather abstract, cartoonie heap of orange and yellow flames rising into the air, slowly taking the place of everything in its path. It was daytime. I couldn’t feel the heat or smell the smoke, because that’s rather vague in dreams. The scene cut to the middle of the night in my bedroom. In my dream, I called 911 on my red telephone on my dresser, frantic that the fire would slowly move in our direction. The address that I gave was 617 24th Ave. N, but somehow, this was supposed to be two doors away from our house. Next thing I knew, it was daylight again, I was out behind School’s Building 2, and there was no fire at all. The department had responded, however, and I felt awful that they’d come for nothing. Fear of the trucks and their noises was the last thing on my mind in this dream. The guys seemed cold to me, and I didn’t seem to know any of them. (Dad’s buddies are always very warm and friendly whenever I see them). The lieutenant presiding over the call was actually a little old lady dressed in a long robe uniform and a babushka, like the dress of a pope. Someone led her to my side, and she sat down in a white plastic chair next to mine, prepared to give me a little lecture. By this time, I was in tears. I clasped her hand and something to the effect that I really believed that there was a very dangerous situation at hand, but that I didn’t take the time to investigate it first-hand. I can’t remember what she said to me, but she had a voice a lot like Ellen. She was more self-assured however. She consoled me a little saying that they were here for just such situations, but her voice didn’t really soften. As I let go of her hand and was preparing to get up from my chair, I said, “It won’t happen again.” I walked aimlessly as I began to awaken, thinking that I’d never call them in the future, no matter what I thought I saw going on. When I woke up, I was relieved, and doubted just a little if I could discern a true emergency from a delusional hoax.

I had a dream that I was at the Caan dining hall, which was actually my high school's dining hall. I don't remember why I was there. Aaron was there to see Britta. I saw Britta and kept trying to get a better look at her. I remember being disappointed by the cereal selection. I called Tyler to help me with the cereal. And then I saw Aaron again right before I woke up.

I had a dream that I was a senior at my high school again. Newsom, Ben, Lee, Sue, everyone was there. It was the last few days before we were about to graduate. Lou, Adam, and Julian showed up. I think Pauline was there too and we all had lunch. Before that I had a dream that I had missed all my math classes and also didn't have the textbook, so I couldn't even catch up. I went to the dance studio, where there was a soundproof room, so I could blast whatever music I wanted. I wanted it as loud as it went. I started listening to AC/DC and pretended to play the air guitar. And then I got an email from Aaron, in my dream, which I thought I had gotten in real life.

I was having a really crazy dream last night that some dumb guy wanted me to run for President. He was a cross between Bart Schneider and Shawn, who I met at the party last night. (More about that later.) He seemed to overflow with the best of intentions, but was extremely out of touch with reality, a little like Astrid’s grandpa. In the dream, it seemed totally plausible: I would register to become a candidate for the highest office in the country and win voters’ hearts and minds based on my personality, and the fact that I was a star pianist. (In this dream, I must have been famous already.) I had nothing to say to people regarding the country’s political issues, and I had absolutely zilch in terms of political experience. I didn’t have a cent in terms of campaign funds, but according to this guy, I wouldn’t need any. I’d travel around in a bus like Johnson did for a while there, staging these people-drawing events around the country where I’d just stand up on a stage and talk about myself, beguiling the crowds with my egotistical charisma. The action in this dream takes place when this guy and I were setting up this stage-like thing behind some big building in a huge field. We were debating where to put the stage so that it wouldn’t wreck any sprinkler heads or other strange covers sticking out of the ground. They were going to erect a huge movie screen behind me to show pictures while I talked. Where was the PA? I don’t know. Anyway, I was standing on a little dirt path while they were messing with the platform, and we were beginning to think that we couldn’t stage our little rally here because of the strange things in the field. At first there were only one or two, but more appeared by the minute. Just then, I became very, very frightened of those things, realizing that I was standing very close to many of them. Some were sprinklers, some were raised manhole covers, some were littler covers with holes in them, some were little boingy spiral tube thingies mounted on little covers and some were soft, rubbery covers that have a funny vibrating quality because of a sound coming from down in a tube beneath the ground. I called out for the man, not by name, not even with a voice, and he picked me up and carried me back onto the bus. Then I woke up.

I was part of a team searching for terrorists who were plotting to destroy a Portuguese replica of a great city. The plot I helped foil previously involved the Brandenburg gate type columns being blown up and falling onto a nationalist shrine. This next clue was much harder. Something to do with the beach. There were hostages who knew, but couldn't or wouldn't talk. They were being systematically killed. We guessed the wrong one who would be killed, but I saw the gunman walk up, take aim and shoot a dart into the neck of one of them. He was a tall, bald Asian man in a suit. Young, with purple accents. I was wearing my pumas, so I didn't make much noise. I saw he was heading to a run-down house in the Arab sector. I ran up to him, watching my shadow as I sprinted. Then I put him in a headlock and attempted to drag him into traffic. He was strong, and when cars were about to hit him, he bended and leapt away. The people inside the house, a family of freedom fighters, ran out. They didn't want to blow their cover. The dad ran out to help the comrade and was killed. Splattered. I was dragged inside. They were old and young, men and women. A regular extended family -- people who did not look at all like terrorists. The police came and they convinced the overly soft officers that it was just a domestic disturbance and the officers left their house. They would do anything to get the attention away from them. Instead of exacting revenge, they scooped me in on their plan. I assume the result ended up in my above condition. I remember bits from the shootout, including one of their badly injured having a gun near their heart to be blasted because they were not well liked.

I dreamed that I had just woken up in a hospital room. I remember snippets of the surgery. I had been badly hurt. A bullet, perhaps. It was in the same place where my appendix scar is. It didn't hurt yet, but I knew and wanted and was looking forward to painkillers. At my bedside was my-mother. And in my bed was a girl who was beautiful, who said she loved me and that her name was Kimmi. A tooth of mine was loose also. I looked around. All kinds of stuff was strewn about the room. Spoils of some kind. The thing is, I didn't remember a single thing. I knew who my mother was, and later, who my friends and brother were when they came in, but the past -- I don't know how long -- was gone. I told Kimmi that I didn't know who she was and if I loved her. We snuggled close. I put my hand on her pajama-clad leg. I felt bad that I couldn't remember her. My mother accepted her, so I assumed they had met previously. Marvin, Kareem (friends from college), someone I didn't know and my brother Gerald came in. They were congratulatory. They were also giddy and laughed the laugh of someone who knows something that you should know but don't. Apparently, I did something completely badass and somehow got away with it. Kimmi was having a hard time coming to terms with my memory loss. My friends were making sexist remarks. I didn't know her, but I felt strongly for her and sorry for her. Her parents had warned her to stay away from people like me who would break her heart. She went to the bathroom to freshen up. She was strong, though. And pushed through the crap.  I also had a loose tooth. When it came out, it had a metal root, very futuristic. Like an implant.  I yelled because I wanted to share this with Kimmi. I feel like I am 10 or 12. I tried to remember when my teeth last came out.

Last night I dreamed I was holding Fluffy and she had all sorts of things inside her, like a stuffed mouse that I had to keep track of. It was my high school graduation again but everyone was running around somewhere, like a street in Spain. Then there were these huge...pods, or something in the sky where we had to sleep, like out of The Matrix or something. I went up to one with a guy Martin, who looked like someone from The O.C. We were up there trying to sleep and it started raining. Martin wanted to have sex, but I didn't, but I was afraid to say no. I left the pod, but he followed me, and I became really afraid. But then he left and I woke up.

Two days ago, I had a brief dream that I was in the upstairs bathroom sitting in front of the sink and the towel rack. (What is it with bathrooms these days?) I had some crazy little keyboard instrument about the size of the Music Major, bright red and all of the keys were black. (They felt usual though.) It sounded like a harmonica. In this dream, I could remember Jack having asked me to see how many songs I could come up with that had the “Mi fa sol” pattern in them, just like la la loo. He said that I had an affinity for “fa” and that “fa” would offset my aversion to the “Mi-sol” minor 3rd. So there I sat playing some familiar melodies, sitting on the bathroom floor trying to hide this thing under the towel!!

Last night I dreamed that I was at some kind of venue with Mom (probably the Santana Theater since we were there yesterday). We had called Dad on my cell phone to tell him that we were leaving the place, but when we finished, some gentleman said that I should come backstage so that he could hear me play the piano. Mom had left me a while ago and was already back there waiting for me. This man first escorted me into a bathroom similar to an airplane bathroom because I had to go. Aunt Deidre suddenly appeared, crammed inside with me and was helping me figure out how to work that strange, strange toilet. You had to pump a pump in order to flush it, and was very loud! Then, there were lots of different rooms on either side of a hallway backstage. I heard some clinking of the upper register of the piano, and followed my ears into the correct room where three officials, my mom, Aunt Lizzy and Aunt Deidre were waiting for me. I could see several couches and a TV that was flickering, but muted. Some guy was flipping through channels on the other couch. I couldn’t see any instruments in this room, and when I had come in, I could hear nothing more either. They had an upright piano who they called Cleopatra for some reason. The two other officials had taken her off to another room because she needed tuning and regulation. According to the third official, it wouldn’t take long. I appreciated the courtesy to offer me the opportunity to sound my best, but I felt strange that they’d waited until now to take care of this. Meanwhile, I sat in this room with the others. Backstory: it was Thanksgiving Day in this dream, and back home, Dad and the kids (Sheryl, Sandra and Sam) were waiting for us, along with John and some other people. It was around 5 PM when I’d first been summoned backstage, and I suddenly realized that it was close to 8:30 and the technicians still hadn’t returned yet. I felt that these people were important, and that I needed to wait as long as it took, but nobody at home would understand the situation. Thinking of the turkey dinner at home, I began to feel hungry, something I’ve never experienced in a dream before. My body began to feel weak, and I wondered if my forearms and fingers could still supply the coordination necessary to impress these high-powered show people. And this was all in my head. I stood up and gave one heck of a lecture about the fact that I’m sick and tired of people waiting at home for me when I need to be free of all that business now. I didn’t really care that the third official was still on the other couch watching TV. Then suddenly, I was in another scene. I was back home on Thanksgiving day. I was bored out of my mind with all the senseless blabber about politics, the weather and everything else, and had wandered into the bathroom. In the medicine cabinet, somehow, I thought that a toothpaste tube reminded me of Bluebells Cockle Shells in some weird way! Then, under that, I found a folded-up page that I’d written some years ago about our old Forbes upright that we used to have. In this dream, I couldn’t read my own writing, but I sort of felt that was what it was about. As I gradually began to wake up, I was thinking that somehow the Hammond was like an upright piano, in that if it isn’t played very often, it could be construed as a nice piece of furniture. And of course that it has keys laid out the same way.

Last night I dreamed that I was at some combination of my high school and my college and there was an end of the year spring dance. I was hanging out with Kim, Jessica, and Julian beforehand. My date was someone from my high school, but I can't remember who it was. Some boys from my high school were there. I was really anxious because I thought I was being stood up. I had bought a really flashy, silver dress that was really low cut, and I guess I only just realized that it was too low cut. Then I woke up.

I had the worst dream last night. First it started out OK: Aaron and I were fooling around somewhere, and I was really happy and excited. Then I went home and in the guest room was my brother and Lauren. They had been playing some game with a baby, but they accidentally dropped her when I came in. The baby started bleeding everywhere and it was really scary. I was trying to keep her alive with ice and by holding her upright, and my brother and Lauren were really scared. The baby was OK, so I went downstairs to the kitchen to hang out with Judith and my father before prom. I was really happy because Aaron was taking me. So then right before I was about to leave, I asked where my mother was so I could say goodbye to her. My brother looked at me very pityingly and said that our mother had died last night. I laughed because I thought he was joking but he was serious and I demanded why no one had told me. He said because there hadn't been a good time. I started crying so hard and was hugging Aaron really tightly. He kept saying, "I'm really sorry, but if it came down to your mother or your sister, aren't you glad your sister's alive?" I guess he was referring to the baby who was OK after all the bleeding. All I could think was, She's not my sister! It was horrible.

My dream was really weird last night. First I was living in an apartment with 4 other girls and 5 other guys. I was trying to make everyone go to sleep, but Jessica had a tennis match and was making a lot of noise. Then there was another guy with long dirty blonde hair, sort of like a California surfer. I guess we had been dating for a while. He was hugging me and saying, "I'm surprised I haven't broken you yet." And I got really scared because I did not want to be with him. I suggested we make oatmeal (in order to distract him). He poured his down the sink, which hurt my feelings for some reason. Finally, my father, my mother, and I were all driving in New Haven, but my father couldn't drive properly, so my mother had to take over. Weird.

I haven’t written in a while, have I? Last night, I had a goofy dream. I don’t know how or why, but I found myself participating in a school band with other people my age. I didn’t have an instrument in front of me at the time, and I can’t remember what my part would be. Oh yes, I do remember! I was supposed to play the clarinet, since I had the notion that I possessed one. It came with the Hammond Organ somehow. (In this dream, a clarinet was not a manageable, thin licorice stick, but a huge, bright-gold metal thing that I could barely pick up.) But I didn’t have it with me on that first day. Somebody had begun to pass out sheet music, and I somehow had the notion that I’d be able to follow along without a problem. But they were passing out different scores to different people. They were all from the “golden era” that fascinates me more and more these days, and the composers were all distinctly pianists: Fatts Waller, Jellyroll Morton, Scott Joplin, etc. But we had not a pianist’s position in this band. The covers were all very decorative like I’ve been seeing on the old-time website, and they all had wacky titles, unlike any real compositions I can think of. Mine was titled something like “The Boddidzel March.” (More on that word later). I realized that they were passing out different scores to different people because the people were supposed to make arrangements for the band and pretend they were George Kates (from Lawrence Welk). We would all get practice conducting our arrangements too. I was thrilled about all of this, but then was remembering all of my visual limitations and wondering how I was going to deal with them. I was on an island. This place was fairly bare, but there was a local encampment funded by the island's far-off government on the mainland. They came down one day and decided to raid the station in two waves. The hills were green and rolling, but difficult to scale--and deeper in, there were ravines and forested ridges. The first was terror. I didn't know quite why. But they came in waving AK-47s and roughed us all up. It was almost as if it was a rogue band that went in ahead of the serious group to have a little fun. I ducked out of the back patio and behind one of the three-story house's pillars. They left, and I ran to notify the headmaster we were under attack. Just as I was getting her to understand -- she was saying we should just let them run their course -- there's not much we can do. Bull shit. The second wave came in. I went out to fight them. But the second wave was by far more serious. The point man had what I can only describe as a brute shot. It launched these explosive shells at low velocity. I dodged them. And when the dozen more marauders came over the hill, I evacuated. The second man in the bar I fought was a slightly pudgy, but muscular black guy. He was solid, and fast for his relative size. I told my mother he's stronger than me, but I was still faster.
