She sighed as I waited patiently to be served, obviously not really interested in serving anyone. I kept going down the corridor trying to find the guy inspecting the meat and found myself in a dress shop. I told one lady what she was trying on looked nice, faffed around holding some tops up to my frame and left the shop. I was opposite the glass window sausage inspector again and the couple were standing up peering anxiously out the window looking for me. I went back inside and thanked them and gathering my paper bag in my arms walked back to the young girl’s counter. She ignored me and when I turned around I noticed what I thought were bread sticks stuck in buckets but which in fact were the sausages I was searching for. I picked some up and bought them. When I got home I didn’t have enough food and rushed back as they were closing. The sausage guy lived in the posh units upstairs and when I explained to him why I needed to buy some more food he said he’d remotely open the door but by the time I got to the shop it was closing. He came puffing round the corner and told me I was lucky if I’d been inside when it closed it would have filled with water and drowned me. He took me upstairs to plan our how we’d break into Shop 12, 17a, 24b etc to get what I needed.

I’m in the middle of a gathering of black women towards the end of the meeting. It seems to be a time of teaching and praying, support after some kind of tragedy. Somehow, MLK was involved…perhaps reflecting on his experience/teaching/ spirit. I awoke with a very positive feeling of unity.

I'm looking out from the backyard deck....The clouds look weird....Whoa, it's like two huge cloud creatures are fighting....Wrestling in the sky, long arms and other appendages grappling with each other....it's very cool to watch....I run to tell Ronald to watch, too....Bud sees it as well?....At another point, Ronald's team is playing a lacrosse or football game....He hasn't gotten in to play yet....I think hmm, maybe the coach doesn't think he's that good....Then one kid tackles another....Both are hurt....I think, this is too rough....It's a green grass field, a sunny day....Then I see a young woman doing an ad....She is very sexy and arousing....I wonder, is this an unrated version of the ad?....She has a beautiful body, but so small, like a girl compared to the other people around....

1. I am looking at three different condos. I’m shopping for one, but don’t buy it. I awoke feeling a sense of frustration ---not getting the task done. 2. I am on top of an old street car with all the wires. It’s racing down line towards the old Auditorium. It ends up in some different building, not the aud, but one that is familiar to me….like a former school that has been closed and is being used for something else.

I am meeting a new Hospice patient/family in an old, rather run down farm house. The patient is the father of the family. There are something like 14 children and multiple grandchildren and great grandchildren. Not all of them are present. A few of the children do most of the talking. It is the initial visit and I’m trying to get the lay of the land and a read on the patient/ family. They are very religious/fundamentalists. They named a church that rang a bell with this chaplain having heard of it from another chaplain who said their pastor didn’t want Hospice chaplains in his congregant’s home because he would take care of them! So when I hear the name of the church, I am surprised that I am allowed in. Part of the dynamic is that the patient doesn’t really know he is in Hospice….he doesn’t think anything is wrong! The family wants to keep it like that somehow. A bottle of booze is involved…..maybe I brought it as a gift? I remember being a bit disoriented when leaving the house and not being able to find my motorcycle.

431. * Key points * First I need to update but last night I had so many vivid dreams I will leave out the details- living situation with many other boys and girls, brothers and sisters. Some like the father and ugly person with a beautiful mother. I was one son like mother having to live in a space sharing with everyone who did not fit in. My brother and I are in some sort of muddy landfill dumpster type place, we notice strange activity. People thought we were crazy, especially me. The second time a rubber looking moon, but much smaller, floating in the sky above a muddy pond during the day time. Very fast. Until it came crashing down and bouncing back up. Justin and I looked for an imprint in the sand. No one believed me and put me in a hospital, thinking I was crazy. And something about 27 days. I rode a train when I got out. I was going to my mom’s house (looked the same but was different). She was throwing some party wanting me to act a certain way, but I did not. Then it turns into a church playing amazing jazz music. Then I get up to everyone saying it’s okay to not believe or agree with everything in the bible to just go home and reflect on what you think is right in your heart. Everyone loved this and all went out to eat. I had gone to a children’s puppet show and really enjoyed it. I wanted to go back. Katy F. and some girl with red hair were there. It was a very big stadium. The show starts out alright but then just drags out. People end up not liking it. But it had good morals to the story. Being in old classroom with test.

I'm helping a guy in a wheelchair be a leader of some kind....he's training as a person in charge of a house?....At one point some guys who have been with us for a while try to flee, they shoot guns at us....I say wait, we've done so well together....Let's stick together....Then at one point there are lots of law and business people around....Introducing themselves....They call on my wife right after starting with the lower-level people, and she's angry....Why did they call on her so soon?....She wasn't ready, and it wasn't appropriate in the order of things....She pauses for a long time to gather her thoughts and get ready for whatever she's going to say....

The setting was at house. There was a woman in the dream that I knew was conniving and dishonest, along with a man in a wheelchair. Sometimes in the dream I was the man and sometimes I was almost like the narrator. Very strange. We are packing up the household to move. I know that the woman is using the man and he knows it as well. She wants him to go and rent a van to move. He is leery and he knows if he leaves her to get the van, when he returns she and the kids will be gone. She is very nasty to the man and insists that he leave to go get the van. I say to myself (now I am the man) that I know that she is taking advantage of me and the situation, but I cannot do anything about it. I say to the man (now I am the narrator) that you are the only one that can change your situation and she is not the person you want her to be. I want the man to stand up and make a change in his life for the better, but I know how difficult it will be for him.

My dream has something to do with cars in the family. I am trying to get one fixed for one of my sisters and they are giving me a hard time about getting it to the repair place. It is screwing up my schedule and I’m furious. I am swearing and saying things in front of my mother who is present. I feel both guilt for doing it, but so mad that I don’t care! I wake up pissed off.

432. I had got a job working at a baseball field selling tickets and ciggs. It’s all mostly women and everyone is very nice. I go through training. It was a huge building that also did other things. I was vacuuming when Owen, Chris and Drew came in. Before that- I was crying because the company had just laid off a bunch of workers. So I see them come in and get cleaned up. Owen is there to see a lawyer about getting in a fight over a surfboard. Chris and Drew are in the waiting room. We talk, then I am doing more training. Putting wine in our own bottle and putting rocks by the gutters. Hazy. Then I am inside a building again and Tino had her kittens but they were older and all very different and cute. I looked for a gate to put around them. With a group of friends skateboarding in neighborhood. I kept wanting to go downhill but kept getting stopped or distracted. We went to some foreign people’s house, front porch, and talk and pet their pig; it’s small black and cute. We are all talking and notice that Chad is gone [Chad was representing y someone else], so we wander back to go look for him. We stop at the corner. Austin and Justin are roller blading. I said I would go. Back at my place there is a huge party going on with a pool and tons of food and alcohol, drunk people wandering around everywhere. I was not really mad, just glad he was okay. He said he was going to get a peach and never came back. Then eventually other people came and went and I was over it, so I left and across the street was a motor home. I knocked on the door and asked if I could look inside. The man with 4 sons was more than happy to let me.

I go down a street in a residential area....I have spare time to kill before meeting people in the area above....I follow the street downhill, no one seems to be around, just nice suburban houses, rather densely packed together....too close for my taste....Then I have to go back up to the other people....Now it's like I'm going up stairs, on a bike....But I can't ride the bike up the stairs, have to walk it....Was I riding the bike when I came down?....I'm not sure....At the same time as I'm on the street, it's like I'm seeing this area on a map....it's an obscure place, I can see little roads and large patches of green where it's just forest....you have to take a plane to get there....Beautiful nature, but I wonder what you would do if you had a medical emergency?....I figure you would have to hope the doctor there could help you....There are lots of forests, lakes, rivers on this map, in and around this area....

My niece, my uncle who is deceased, my cousin, and a man (don’t know who he was) sitting on my left are in a fifties like diner sitting (the setting was very metallic with swivel stools, shiny counter tops, just like something out of the 1950’s) on stools with a person behind the counter (where the waitress would be) giving a presentation on attendance. During the presentation, a car is shown on the power point presentation. My uncle says that’s the car that I let my cousin drive in California. I look at him in amazement at that comment. The presentation continued and I reiterated to the speaker that our family has had perfect attendance. The speaker acknowledged my response and kept talking about attendance. Later on my cousin told the speaker the same thing that our family had perfect attendance, and then my cousin turned around and winked at me.

Lots of things about helping Fern with some project, an online computer activity of some kind in which many other people can contribute....Maybe there's a guy around too?....At another point I'm flying in an airplane, and twice the pilot has to climb up and over a house, barely making it each time....I'm looking out the window to my right and I can see the roof of the house below....The second time in particular, I'm worried, sure we're going to hit it....But somehow we don't....

1. I am talking to my mother’s doctor about her health and some issues. 2. This dream involved another doctor at work who is explaining a difficult point to some family. She is doing it quite gracefully and I am praising her for it to some of the people around me.

433. (1) I was in a river having the current take me. It would keep going faster and faster, taking me down paths eventually to get to a waterfall. I was very nervous at first, reaching the end and going off, but I just let go. I hit the bottom that was very shallow and rocky and hurt my ankle, but then the river continues, but this time with many more people. I am not nervous for the second waterfall and the water is deeper but still shallow. It continues with even more people and an even bigger fall. I have no fear. One of the first to jump this time. Water was very deep, but then I kept going with the river until it ended and got off on a dirt path. I had to wait in line with a lot of other people. Then I was with a mom helping her with her kids, watching them while they swam in the pool. The rest is hazy. I know that I kept helping the woman with a dozen kids.

434. (2) Second dream was being with Jeff and Richard going out and being us. Details are hazy. But something with watches, all of us getting similar ones. Then we all wanted to pass out. My parents were there and I was telling them about my Arizona trip.

435. (3) I am with my parents at a huge, fancy dance show product convention. We are unable to get good seats and go to the back. Sitting with an older big woman who was so familiar, walking around it outside at night with all sorts of things going on like practicing. I stop at the station and get little cans of beer with my dad. Something about getting a free cookie. It all gets hazy.

I am in bed with Tom Cruise in an apartment on a pull out sofa bed. We make love and I wake up to find not only Tom in bed with me, but his brother is sleeping on the other side of me and his mother is in the kitchen making breakfast as if us being there is normal. Tom yells at his brother to get the hell out of the bed and his mother yells at Tom to lay off his brother. She then yells to all of us to see what we want for breakfast. I am looking at Tom with bewilderment and he just shrugs his shoulders, get out of bed, pulls on his pants and joins his mother in the kitchen. I am very uncomfortable with the brother in bed. I pull the covers over my head and ask the brother to please get out of the bed. The brother gets up, doesn’t put on his pants, just goes into the kitchen in his tightie whities, white underwear. I get dressed under the covers and then go into the kitchen. The mother is making breakfast as if nothing is wrong. We eat breakfast and leave the apartment. A guy tries to kill Tom and he takes chase after him and I chase after Tom. We are running by farm houses and through fields. As we are running we see an Amish girl trying to run in the field with a limp from a built up shoe on one foot (like an orthotics shoe for someone who has one leg shorter than the other, but carved out of wood). I am so worried for the Amish girl with the limp as I am terrified that the man is going to go after her and hurt her. Tom yells for her to get under cover. The guy almost gets the Amish girl, but she goes in a different direction. The path weaves in and out of the field. Tom is gaining on the bad guy and he tackles him to the ground. The police come and take the guy away. Tom turns around and smiles that great smile of his.

I’d lost my engagement ring, which I actually wear on the middle finger of my right hand, and I was devastated. From somewhere I had a new one, it was a perfect tiny cube with a tiny protuberance, kind of looked like a mini camera. It sat proud on my finger and I admired it from a lot of angles. For some reason I was no longer wearing any of the other rings I normally wear on that hand. I took it to the jeweller to get it examined and he was mystified. He shined a bright light into the stone and it seemed to suck the light inside and began to glow, almost the colour of the blue in paua shell. As he went to show me the phenomenon a tiny blue beam came out of the camera lens section of the stone and hit the webbing between the fingers of my right hand. It made my hand glow that eerie red like when you shine a torch up through your fingers. It didn’t hurt. He looked up in amazement at me and asked Where did you get this? I didn’t know but it was awfully pretty.

My wife B. and I are in Toronto or some other major city in S. America on vacation. I’m not sure if this is one or two dreams conflated. A part of the dream involves us being in a red car and I am driving around. I have the sense I have been there before and a general sense of knowing where I’ve been and wanted to go, and knowing how to get back. This part of the dream feels like it is a South American capital city. I decide not to do that. A major part of the dream involves me standing at the door to a small business where they sell food/takeout and souvenirs. Only a couple of people can go in at a time because it’s so small. We seem to be standing and waiting and waiting. Then other people come and are waiting to get in. Finally, we just go in. Next, I remember we are in a much larger building/room that has the feel of a library, but very large, busy and commercial. We are sitting at a table looking at a newspaper, trying to decide what to do. A guy comes up to us and asks if we have our tickets/box lunches and if we are ready to go (presumably on a tour of the city). Now it feels like we’re in Toronto. We don’t have tickets and we’re unsure of whether we want to go or not. We ask how much it is…. $60. Then we ask where it goes and what it covers. A guy gives us a brief overview. The year 16 comes up as the starting place of where the city was started. I’m not sure if we make it on the tour.

G. and I were driving in the car in P. and were stopped in traffic next to a big shopfront. In the front window were wedding dresses. I bit my lip and felt the urge to try them on. The next thing I was standing in the little showroom and one of the assistants asked me what I wanted. I said I would like to try on some wedding dresses, then realised I still had my opal on my wedding finger. She seemed to notice it and looked a little non-plussed and I said Please, just that cream lace gown over there, I’m engaged but I like to wear this ring on this finger. With bad grace she took me down a set of stair to a concrete cavern filled with wedding dresses and couches where couples and groups of women were sitting. She pointed to several large open areas and said they were the 4 VIP dressing rooms, there were several other smaller cubicles with short bat wing doors where I sought of thought you could be seen getting changed. No one appeared to be in them. The sales lady disdainfully told me someone would help me shortly. I sat down on a couch next to a young couple, the girl had a short blond bob and was very cute as was the scrawny shy guy who was her fiancé. We got up and browsed through the racks for a while then went and sat down to wait for assistance, occasionally a salesperson would walk past, one handed the blond girl a bridal magazine to flip through. There was a commotion through the glass near the couches and we wandered across to sit on the bolsters and looked down into a marble floored showroom where a gaggle of assistants and an entourage of some sort were all clustered around a girl in a heavy golden bridal dress. They were making a HUGE fuss over this princess. It was a bit ostentatious for my taste and I wrinkled my nose and said Gold, hmmph, to the blonde bob girl. She agreed and we went back to our couch. After a while we got to talking and she commented on the fact that I was wearing a ring on my wedding finger. I told her that I wasn’t really married, just terminally engaged with no hope of ever getting married and that I was really on there to try on a dress, just to see what it looked like because I’d never get to wear one. She sighed with pity and after a while a salesgirl finally came over the help the blond girl. I got a bit fed up and went to talk to a guy who obviously worked there and was talking with some other men. I told him I had been waiting a fair while to get served. He gave me a scathing look and said Well obviously I’m rich enough. I felt belittled and humiliated and nearly burst into tears. The blond girl who was still nearby was appalled and I heard her rebuking the man for his callousness as I fled the shop. I paused outside and thought what a long way I had to go home and how despondent I felt at catching a bus.

I am being tested ..almost like a lie detector type situation for loyalty to some group. I have the feeling of a cat and mouse type situation. In the end, I feel sure of my position and not afraid. There are people in the dream that are familiar, but not in real life.

I see a place where water is coming out of a little chute at the bottom of a stone or dirt grid....The water is flowing strongly but in an orderly manner, away from this place....Later I'm climbing up a creek, with big rocks covered with rushing water ahead of me....I almost put my hand on a submerged rock to steady myself for a climb onward....But I decide it's too dangerous, my hand might slip....I'm relieved when I don't go, that was the right thing to do....Someone else is there who agrees with my decision?....

For some reason, I'm with a bunch of people are on the ground or floor....Then we can get up to go get something....I'm the quickest to get up, but I struggle to fully stand; it's like gravity is holding me down somewhat....Someone says hey, he (me) already has a lacrosse ball in his hand....I realize, to my surprise, I do, and this somehow gives me an advantage?....I go into another room to get some clothes....Earlier, I'm going over to a neighbor's house to get a television they're giving me....I knock on the door and go in, but the place seems empty, recently cleaned out....The cleaners just came?....I worry the couple might be there having sex, with their baby napping and a quiet afternoon....But then they come out and say sorry, they already gave the television away....I say that's ok....I had walked into the house, then I tried to go back out so I wouldn't seem so presumptuous to the people....At another point, there's a table of young women at a restaurant....I'm the waiter or maitre'd?....I start to say something to a woman I know, but then realize I would be interrupting their conversation, so I say sorry and back away....

There is a bicycle. It isn’t mine. I’m not sure if I’m going to use it or if I did use it. I am trying to lock it up securely somewhere so the owner will get it when he arrives. I notice that the brake or gear cable has been sliced/disconnected from the handle you squeeze. Part of the dream was about talking to someone about fixing it. I remember feeling pressured to get this done.

I'm at an airport....The Black Keys band need me as a back-up guitarist for their concerts....I'm excited but don't know how I'll play....In the airport, lots of people are around, luggage on the ground....I see a black cat walk out the door of the terminal....I'm not sure whose it is, and I'm worried the cat might get lost, so I persuade it to go back inside....Then I see the two guys from the band in a little dark corner in the terminal, with some blue lights around them?....They're playing music, recording it....As a joke I say, is this a private concert?....They say they're laying down tracks to use for later....Then they mention I'll need to play an instrument other than the guitar....Hmmm, I wonder what that could be?....Piano?....if the parts aren't too hard....Then I start to wonder, how can I play other shows with them?....If I leave home, who will deal with Ronald?....Maybe I can't do this, I'm worried now....But I don't want to quit....

I am driving a big steel street sweeper cleaning the street, the same street over and over again, up and down. I look over at the woods and see papa bear, mama bear, and baby bear come out of the woods (not fairy tale, real bears). I am excited to see them. They walk along the street and leave and I continue to clean the street up and down, back and forth, over and over again.

President Obama is on the Air Force One airplane....For some reason it needs to be re-bolted in the middle....The two parts of the plane, the front and back, need to be reattached with bolts all around the fuselage....later: An older woman is sitting in a race car, smiling, triumphant....There's a crowd in the stands, cheering for her?....

I’m not sure where I was. My friend Evy called, irate, and asked why I didn’t go to the interview she had set up for me. I had no idea what she meant, but tried to think of an excuse (lie) why I didn’t show. I felt frustration, confusion.

There are a man and woman in helicopters with the clear bubbles on top of them, which land in the jungle who are trying to diffuse a bomb that is in camouflage enclosure. The man and woman are now me and my husband who diffuse the bomb and then realize that the cartel is after us. We take off in the bubble helicopters. We are then on a yacht with photos on the wall. I say to my husband shouldn’t we take down our son’s picture if the thugs come on the yacht, they will know that he is connected to us. My husband replaces my son’s picture with a voodoo doll. We continue to coast down the canal.

1. I am in the water hanging on to a deck. There is a pretty good current. At one point, something floats by at a good clip. I think it’s either some kind of water animal or one of those Daniel Boone hats floating. I am in the water because I have to do some kind of swimming test and am waiting (or getting psyched up) to start. There are other people around, no one I remember knowing directly. Perhaps other people are there for the same reason. 2. I am with my wife on vacation in some large city. I’m not with her at this time of the dream. She must be back at the hotel and I must be on my way back because we’re leaving today. The hotel building is large and there are three sets of elevators in it. I have the feeling that this is a dream I’ve had before—at least the elevator part. There seems to be a sense of urgency about getting back to the room. Two sets of elevators go to every floor; the one in the middle skips some floors. I am not sure which one skips the floors. I remember asking someone else who was getting on at the same time, but they didn’t know either. Of course I get on the wrong one that goes up flour floors above where I need to get off. It opens to a large open area/concourse with shops, etc. Everyone starts running and yelling. That’s when it is revealed to me that there is a terrorist threat going on and people are panicking. I remember feeling it is only a rumor and people are getting worked up for nothing. I am getting nervous about not being able to get out of where we are and catching our flight at the airport. I start frantically looking for stairs to run to the apartment and get our things and get to the airport.

I’m on the beach on the television show Two and a Half Men set in Malibu. It was a beautiful day and I was so relaxed. My cousin showed up with her born again entourage. She is a first cousin, close and a pastor who is always trying to save me. She and her coven began to pray over me and it was so disturbing that I woke up. I felt annoyed!
The only thing I really remember is that the dream was about school and graduates. In the dream there were 9896 graduates.

I am in what turns out to be a predominantly Puerto Rican neighborhood in Boston, MA. I am with other people, something like a church group and we’re at a Catholic church. Part of the dream involved walking through the rectory with the pastor. He is leading us to the dining room to have breakfast. I remember being overwhelmed with how large and elaborate it is and feeling both a bit put off by it and amazed. I wondered How could a minority parish operate something like this? The other part of the dream centers on waiting to go to mass and wondering when it is going to start. We are mostly outside the church in the front. A lot of people are standing around talking. I am getting frustrated and go to look at a sign that lists the times of mass and find out that the mass isn’t until very late in the morning. I am kind of incredulous about it and someone tells me it’s a cultural thing.

I'm with our family and cats, and I see an orange cat or rabbit (?) has joined us....it's friendly, wants to play with us....I pet it, while our cat T watches warily....Then, different scene, I'm working with a girl on solving a crime....She goes off, then I realize we have found a new piece of evidence: a razor blade, piece of metal, that was part of the crime scene not left by the police, as others had assumed....I go running after the girl to come back?....But she goes down a long hall....She's going to watch some event on tv?....I run after her....Then I'm eating a hunk of bread and butter....I try to put the bread in my jacket pocket as I turn down a dark alley....Suddenly a group of guys attack me, knock me down and grab my genitals, I'm very scared....Earlier, my wife is nice to some people....Then later, we need their help, and they're totally ready to help us....

I’m in a conference room for a radio board meeting, which segued to a medical staff meeting at a hospital. I spoke with Dr. G., the deceased chairman of my university department, about seeing a former member of the department of whom I had heard but never met. Dr. G. made a knowing comment alluding to the fact that the other doctor I had met had a bad reputation for some reason.

I’m backstage at some theater with people that in the dream were my friends, but I really didn’t know them and then my deceased father appeared. We had just finished some performance and I awarded all with individual canes all different colors. My dad came back stage to see me, he looked heavier than he ever was. I then shared one giant piece of key lime pie with al land woke up. I was feeling happiness!

Dream 1. I was making my lunch on the wall of a parking lot and having a bit of a dance to music from across the road. I looked over and a builder was aping my dance moves – he was pretty good too. I put my lunch in a paper bag and went back to the house and asked my house mates who owned the burgers. They said a name (can’t recall what it was) and I said I’d been using them as a board to make my lunch and put them back in the fridge. Dream 2. The letter came from P.’s (next door to my office) and had a bag of M&M’s attached the sweeten the punch. It claimed I owed $22,148.52 for rent and repairs at C. St. I rang Mum and asked her if she remembered what date I’d moved out of C. St as they were trying to claim a full 12 months rent and I didn’t believe that was realistic. She couldn’t remember but said she’d look it up. I said I’d have to move out of the place from dream 1 as I didn’t have that sort of money and no real way to make it up. I received a revised letter asking for $6,510.00 which was about $1500 rent and $6k for some big job (can’t remember what it was). Dream 3. I was holding up the mailbox queue as I was opening the mail at their window. I got sick of that and just grabbed it all but I dropped several newspaper clippings as I walked through a café. A guy picked them up for me and handed them back. I was wheeling some sort of trolley. I stopped in a large concrete garage to sort them into a manageable pile and a salesman offered his elderly clerk to help me get them back to the office. He took the pathway and I took a shortcut through the hedges but he was still in front of me and I was puffing because the garden beds had been elevated.
It was the Atlanta airport at night. It was very dark and I was outside the building. I was waiting for a plane but began to think I was in the wrong airport.

Not sure where it started, but I went shopping for a birthday gift for an eighty eight year old friend. All I found were two purses, one was only nineteen dollars and the other was two thousand dollars! Frustrated, I left and ended up on a bicycle. I was lost and found myself in a huge church. I rode for quite a long time…never found my way. I was feeling lost!

The cat followed me to the train and hopped on board. He sat quietly beside me hunched in a corner but then ran off the train at the next stop, crossed the platform and hopped on the alternate train. We were going the wrong way, heading towards L. rather than S. I coaxed him off at the next stop and walked down a tar rail level path to get to the platform across a level rail crossing. He kept hiding in the scrubby grass at the side of the path as people thundered past us to get on the train that was pulling in. The train looked a bit odd, kind of high tech. We made it to the platform and he was running in front of me, he bolted into the 2nd last carriage and I had to struggle to get into the last before the doors shut. I was worried that he would be panicking because I wasn’t with him. It was an odd carriage, reminded me of the inside of a hydrofoil. An old lady looked up from her knitting and said You’ll have to wait till we take off before you can move dear. I paced back and forth in front of the door until it was safe to go through. I opened the connecting door – from the outside they were strange white bubble like carriages with flimsy looked plastic disc steps that seemed so far apart that I couldn’t possibly make the jump. I was scared to cross. A girl came out of the carriage I wanted to be in and jumped neatly to my tiny platform and slapped a button on the side of the carriage. As she went inside I looked down and there was a flimsy plywood sheet between carriages. I took a deep breath and hoped to hell it would support my weight. I was terrified but in dire need to get to my cat. The plywood supported me and I slapped the button. The inside of the pod had steel grating floors, plain off white smooth walls and a central core tube which was the bathroom. Dog sat hunched on the far side of the room all by himself. I ran across to him, his fur looked odd and as I got closer I saw dozens of tiny needles buried in his fur. I looked around and a dark haired girl of around twelve had a case full of needles which she was packing away. I was outraged and shocked and abused her and her mother. What were they thinking? I bent down and started plucking needles from his fur. She told me there were some buried deeper as he’d lay down as she was putting them in. She also told me we were heading for a planet called Pamplona. I didn’t care, everywhere I touched Dog had a needle in his skin. I was pulling and pulling and pulling and still there were more to be found. Some of them came out covered in blood and I wanted to cry. Throughout it all he sat there letting me pick them out of his fur. There was some turbulence and the mother fell down among them on the floor and I picked up some of the blood covered ones and screamed at her that How could she say it was painless look at the blood. When we got to Pamplona we disembarked to wait for the next train home. Dog didn’t seem any the worse for wear although he never left my side. It was a strange landscape; purple sky, blue trees, pods flying around the streets. Very Dr. Seuss sort of place. We loitered for a few days, it was pleasantly warm and comfortable and caught the next train home. When I got home I hired 2 DVD’s, watched one and put it on for W. when he came home. A friend came over and bludged my last two cigarettes. W. had come in but gone back out to the bank. I left to buy smokes and saw W standing at the bank counter. I suddenly remembered that I hadn’t paused the DVD and W. would miss the bit where the girl acupunctured the cat. Was it all a dream or a DVD I’d watched? It felt so real. I met W. out the front of the bank.

In most of the dream, I am in the apartment building of some guy who is a mid level type player in some kind of racket. I think he is involved in gambling/numbers. 436. First part of the dream, Chad and I are together, hard to know or describe where but we are having sex. But then Chad gives me money to go get condoms, body wash and something else. I do. It was a lot further than I remembered or thought and farther from the shoreline that I needed to be. So I keep running through the sand. I think I make it back to put on a dress. Then it is Richard and me in some little “rack” like to sleep in right by the water. Then I wake up next to the water, a shark is trying to attack me. I am not scared. I had grabbed it by its face and started to punch it. Richard helps me get away. Then it gets hazy how far we get to this point, but we are now lost far way going along the shoreline, very high cliffs and rocky shore. We can see the tide changing. We have to cross while it is low, about half way through it. Goes back up (this part is still very vivid) in my head, all very colorful and bright. There are all sorts of plants below in the water we can see. I am afraid something might get me. Then there is a black and white striped plastic/fabric thing floating in the water. We get to lay on it and twist in circles. During this I see all sorts of crazy colors, designs and patterns, almost like I am tripping. We make it back to the shore, we continue down. We remember from the past that is there is some sort of door close by, like an old little pathway to an old wooden red door, something to do with boy scouts. We go inside it. It is a dark tunnel. We come to a hallway with restrooms. I go look in them. I think there was a girl sitting in there (the whole time we were thinking that we need to go back to feed the cats), then there are 3 cats in the hallway. We stop and pet them, continue down to what seemed like some secret underground doctor’s office. We are surprised that we were able to continue walking. Some people stopped to help direct us, then it seems as if it turns into a government place were officials point us to an elevator portal type thing, telling us to leave. I tell them that we are so close and all we want to do is make it to town, we have to feed our cats. They decided to help us open a door that took us down a hallway to another door that ended up at Food for Less where our friends and lots of people were there waiting for us, lifting us up in happiness and I was throwing blue beads. Our cats were there and we fed them cat food and strawberries. I start to see old people from high school around. Then we all leave outside. I am talking to some man, bragging about various things, then I felt lame.

Something about visiting Whitworth's school....I or someone else has been visiting there since the 1970's....I think about how we could write a history about it....I see doors and buildings with plaques saying something like, Since 197_....I also see a dog, like a big golden retriever, climbing along a fence near a building across the street....The dog is trying to get out?....

I'm in a minivan on Shattuck Avenue in south Berkeley, right near the split with Adeline street....We stop in the street, and my wife gets out of the drivers seat and goes out to look for someone or something....Some people are on the side of the street, hitchhiking....One has a sign saying Farther Down Shattuck/Adeline, the direction the person wants to go....Another person's sign says 25th, that being the Avenue they want to reach further to the south....I think we shouldn't pick up any of them, but my wife motions to one of them to get in the car....A black guy, who climbs into the front drivers seat....OK, I can deal with that....I reach over and press the hazard lights by the steering wheel....Lots of cars are backing up behind us....I'm getting nervous, we can't stay here like this for much longer....

One of our client’s (who will remain unnamed) asked if I wanted a glass of red wine. I said I don’t usually drink red as it stains my teeth but relented as he was a client. We all sat down at a wooden dining table – me, D., George and the client – and were celebrating and eating steak. I borrowed D.’s mobile to check on my daughter. I told the client I was a single Mum and wanted to make sure she was okay. I flipped the graphic vertical to horizontal – as you can on phones these days – and a man answered. I dropped the phone and a garage remote key fell onto the floor of the screen. D. swore and said not sure how we could pick them up now. He told me not to touch the screen or he’d never get them back. I gave him back his phone and worried about the man who answered – it was G.. D. had generously paid my house out as I was a single Mum and struggling. How could I tell him G. was there. I was pretty tipsy after lunch and we all climbed into some kind of 4WD to go home – no one was visibly driving but it wasn’t the lunchers. When we pulled up at my place I looked at a lovely narrow wooden A-frame house with wild gardens. Someone was banging around. I hastily got out of the car and G. looked up from repairing the front step and introduced his Mother. I was pleasant and walked inside. The house had a lot of glass and was perched on the side of a cliff, a lot of rooms were devoid of furniture. Some of G.’s mates were constructing a steep set of switchback stairs down the cliff face. In one of the empty rooms someone had turned the gas heater on and when I went to turn it off I couldn’t.

I am going on a bus trip excursion. I seem to think it is to Cleveland for a baseball game. My mother is driving the bus. I remember being nervous about it and wanting to drive, but my mother and some other person were the only ones licensed to drive it. At one point, I get off the bus and I’m in some apartment building. I’m not sure exactly why. When I come out to catch up with the bus, it has already gone by and then I look down the street and see it at the corner passing by. I start to run to catch up with it. I am running and have to run through some light brush. I have stuff on my shirt. I am trying to brush off as I’m running. I catch up with the bus. I remember being nervous again with my mother driving, not knowing that she knows where she is going, nor with her ability to drive it at her age. For a while, I am standing next to some big guy who I know in the dream. He gets up and m youngest brother Dennis sits down next to me and starts talking. I’m not sure what he’s talking about, but I am conscious of him having taken the seat and thinking the other guy might be upset. I have a feeling of nervousness over my mother’s competence to be doing that task.

I'm at a formal party with Jack White and other people....He brings a date, and as she steps up to a table of food and drinks I see she's wearing a black bikini, riding very high up her thighs....I'm not quite sure, it's hard to see with everything else going on, but it seems to be a very risque and inappropriate outfit....Surprisingly and attractively so....

It was at the overgrown ruins of the hospital where I worked, as seen from the back. I recall 1-3 other characters there but don’t recall who they were or having any interactions with them. The dream was set at night, in the dark, and the hospital had outside sections which don’t exist in reality. The building was overgrown like a Buddhist temple ruin in a Cambodian jungle. I never went in the building. The dream took place outside.

I am sitting around a long rectangular conference table with Dr. M., an old classmate and colleague. In the dream, she was sitting to my left on the same side of the conference table. One other woman (who I thought might also have been a doctor) sat across the table from me. In the dream, I seemed to have known her from the past. I knew her birthday was the same as Dr. M.’s, a date that is exactly one week after my own. The other woman seemed surprised that I remembered HER birthday as she didn’t seem to recall that I had even known her before meeting her at this conference table. I have no awareness of where the conference table was or the context of why the three of us were together (no one else was in the room).

I was in a house with G. and went out a old style dodgy screen door to the front porch where there was a piano. Sitting down I played half a dozen bars of a concerto then decided to see if I could find the music in the seat. I lifted up the seat and came across Fleur de Lise but dug deeper. In the seat was a old enamelled battered brown wooden box with a rippled top piece inlaid mostly with black enamel with a faded golden outline of a butterfly, the hinges were bent but not broken and the key was lost a long long time ago. Inside was a wealth of my treasures, old dress jewellery rings missing their stones, 1960’s earrings, pictures, birthday cards, the feet of a crystal bunny – all my treasured memories. Three people walked up the concrete pathway and said You found treasure.

I'm with someone in a car, they're driving....We parked in the garage at a pier, pulled up at the edge facing out toward the water, next to other cars lined up the same way....The guy says, you have to be careful not to accidentally go forward rather than reverse, you'll fall into the water....He pulls back and out, though I can imagine what it would be like to go forward and fall....Later, I'm walking on the pier....Something big falls from the sky, lands on the pier....like a washing machine?....a big white metal cube....A woman on the pier is scared?....

Davey (from Davey and Goliath) was in my dream telling me to get down on my knees and pray. I look at him in disbelief, wondering what have I don’t that is so bad that I need to pray. But I get down on my knees. I look up and Davey is now Bob Barker from the Price is Rite television show and he is trying to get me to run in competition. He keeps me saying you can compete two for the price of one, over and over again. I tell him I don’t want to compete, just want to run to be healthy.

I'm practicing shooting a gun into a cardboard box....Getting ready for bad guys to come after me?....It's hard to make it work right....At the end I get a little bullet and put it on a table....Then the bad guys come....I call outside to Ronald, get ready....he's under a structure, like a bridge?...There's ice on it, or under him?....Can the bad guys see him? I'm not sure, worried....I see Al on a faraway mountain, with a bell....The ringing of the bell will start it, the interactions with the bad guys....I open the door to listen for it....Earlier, perhaps, I'm sitting outside, when a deer suddenly comes over to me, rubs against me, and lays down....Surprised, I pet it and wonder why it's behaving so nicely....Other animals around, all in a friendly mood....

It’s a warm night, I’m sneaking in my friend’s home. I get in and find my friends Bob and Andy talking in their living room. I waited and after a few minutes of listening to their conversation, which was about socks, my presence known. They were shocked and then asked my opinion on socks.

Dream 1. It was late and G. and I were watching movies. I said to him I feel like I’m on drugs. The world was out of focus and sort of spinney. I heard a noise outside and when I opened the door a gaggle of animals were in the garden; birds, dogs, bunnies, goats. I tried to shoo them away but when I went back inside two rabbits, a duck, a dog and a goat were in the hallway causing chaos. The cat peeped out from the corner of a wall with a non-plussed look. When I finally got them back out there was pee all down the hallway, thankfully on the tiles. As I mopped and got to the kitchen there were jelly like blobs on the floor, huge chunks that looked like aspic. What the hell was that I called and went to get the dustpan. Was that real or are we on drugs. Did you see them or did I imagine it? G. replied that he had saw them too. Dream 2. I was at a formal dinner and C. and W. were sitting opposite me at the table. C. looked awkward in a new dress and there were ten people at the table. They all started playing a hand game like rock, scissors, paper only different. I didn’t know the game so I gave them the power bird, slap one arm at the elbow and bird, and asked if that counted and was told no. W. and I went to buy smokes and as we went down a big hill the guy in front of us grabbed W. by the hand and started running lifting his feet off the ground, I grabbed onto W.’s feet and we were flying like the string on a kite. The stairs went up not down and I wrapped myself in a blanket and lay down on the stairs to watch quietly. I giggled now and then and the actress shushed me. I heard a click and swivelled my eyes to see a reporter hiding behind a pot plant. He grinned and said You just made the daily ….. We went back to their onsite caravan for a glass of wine and a gossip and I apologised to the other 2 actresses for not being able to attend. The oldest of the 3 said she was retiring and I told her is she needed anything to give me a call. I still didn’t remember their names but they were Aussie actresses. Something about SDDb searches....There's a plant that crowds into or around the results?....Bushy green sprouts, like a thick, delicate ground cover....I gently lift part of the growth and move it so it grows in a better direction, around some rocks....

I’m in a boat (a small one like a rowboat but I don’t remember paddling) on a river emptying into a lake. I think it was Boston, I guess I had an apartment there and I found others, two other men, living there. I walked in and one man ran out. The other, a large black man, attacked me. I’m in the hospital laboratory, at the blood draw station. My friend A. was the only character. I was hooking up A. to an IV of amber colored fluid. I see Nelly go across the street with a black guy wearing a cool fur jacket, with white and tan sleeves....He'll be the painter at their house?....They go across the street to the Olson's house....A few moments later a guy comes out on their porch and calls down to ask if Ronald and I will come over to help them set up, move furniture, etc.?....I have a sense he thinks we owe it to him, we have some kind of obligation in the painting process, though I don't know about it....Earlier, I'm at a beach along the coast, preparing for an attack....Other people are there, I say shall we set up defenses?....We try to do so, but an artillery shell from distant ships zooms in across the water and explodes in the sand right near us....Oh oh, I'm scared, and realize my initial plan isn't going to work....I ask Ronald to put in stealth defenses, which he knows how to do....He says of course he can, he's been telling me about exactly that for some time....It's like he's annoyed at me for not remembering....Then someone calls....Will we help introduce a speaker at Stanford?....Could Ronald do it?....I say hmm, I don't know, he's quite young....At another point I'm leading a guy back from the beach, through green trees, down a trail....We have to cross a place where several logs have fallen and are blocking the path....I carefully step over the logs and keep moving forward....

I’m in a large open upper story corridor inside an early twentieth century style public building (lots of marble and ornate brass railings). I was naked except for a pair of flannel boxer shorts I was holding in front of me but NOT wearing. P.K. (my five foot tall lesbian divorce attorney) was sitting at a small desk or table, against a balcony railing which ran the length of a long, wide corridor which overlooked lower levels of the building. I went with Gene (one of my bosses) to a strange townhouse. There was a table in the middle of the main room and he was served some sort of risotto. A man with an apron told me there was some for me as well but at that time I was more interested in the video games that were sitting in an alcove off to the side. I went and ate my risotto next to Gene and the waiter made a compliment and I beamed but as he finished I realised it was about the chef. I felt pretty stupid and blushed. I heard some whispers from people standing in various alcoves about girlfriend and got embarrassed and wandered off along a corridor. I came to a group of youngish people playing basketball, as I walked past they threw the ball at me and as I aimed for the hoop, doing a lot of posturing and thinking I’ve got this, the ball slipped through my hands and rolled along the ground towards it. My embarrassment got worse. Everyone was upstairs and getting ready for bed and I was so embarrassed by this time that I said I wasn’t staying. The owner in the apron said I had to and I said I didn’t and bolted out the front door. I ran away from the townhouse and started noticing strange things going on – there were people; one walking like a dog and barking with the other holding the lead, people screaming like madmen in hospital garments. I turned around and ran into one of the screamers and backed off. I saw everyone from the townhouse standing in the doorway watching me and off to the side two women pretending to play invisible castinets and stamping their feet like Spanish dancers. I decided that I would join them rather than go back into the house so I stepped up on the curb and raised me hands snapping my fingers and copied their foot stomping. Woke up sweating. Must have been hot.

Some people are running a race around a house....As a joke I go and hide along the route, on the side of the house behind a plant container....I have a rake, and I plan to hold it out to block them....But then I reconsider....hmm, maybe not, I realize that's maybe not a good idea....Then I'm in the driveway and I see two cars come up, looking for our house....Repair people?....To help fix the computer?....They pull into the driveway, and I show them where to go....I point to the top room of the house, that's where the cables from their car batteries will have to reach....I tell one of them, a young woman, they could go to the parking lot on the other side of the house and it might be easier for them....She says no thanks, this will be fine....

Myself and five others parachuted into a remote jungle in South America, landing very precisely on a brick platform at the edge of a river which passed through a canyon. After a short walk we came to a very large hollow enclosure (like an airplane hangar or empty factory building) which was lined with wooden pallets for sleeping on (keeping your bed or sleeping bag off the ground). This was a vacation club of sorts where you spent a week or two roughing it in the jungle. I seemed to be following the five people who jumped out of the plane ahead of me. Their parachutes were all black and they were strung together somehow. I stayed above them as we parachuted and I may have been filming them. When we landed, I interacted with some of the people in this compound and learned there was a gym for working out but it was only open on Friday afternoons. I saw a man and woman who had just met there the previous week passionately kissing as the man told the woman he had fallen in love with her. She seemed surprised but happy, though she was about to leave for home (presumably somewhere far away from him in the real world) and all she could awkwardly say was that she guessed now she’d have to come back here next year. I then interacted with a thin woman with short dark hair but soon after I directed my attention to reading something on an electronic tablet in my hand (cell phone, Kindle, etc.). She resented that.

We were walking in hallways, after a wake or funeral, checking out different rooms with all kinds of merchandise. I was with people I didn’t know but helped them look at articles to buy. The surroundings seemed familiar. I checked out one room for a gift for my wife. I found a top, tie-dyed and bought it for her.

I'm with some people at a school event for Ronald's class....People are milling around....The principal, a young guy, thanks me for my help....I'm a little self-conscious as other parents look on....I try to step closer to the principal so our talk isn't so public, but I lose a bit of balance and fall in fear, and have to push off a wooden bench to keep from falling all the way down....I say to him, all I want the students to know is, dreams are worth listening to and sleep is important....That's it....a mother, Jae perhaps, is surprised and happy to hear such a short clear message....At another point, water is draining out of an dark enclosure, like a sink or basin....I reach the ice cream scoop down into the drain, and it gets caught in the swirl....I have to hold it tight, but not too tight; I don't have enough of a hold to pull it out from the downward pulling of the watery vortex, and I'm worried I'll lose my grip and it will go down and block the drain, which will burn out a motor that's involved in the process....

I think we were in our backyard having cocktails. It was myself, my wife, some friends, and my cousin C. It was a warm sunny afternoon. There were several conversations going on at once and I couldn’t concentrate on any of them. I became fixated on my cousin and suddenly he said do you want to see it? He was referring to his leg. He showed me his right leg and it looked normal from the front, but when he turned it around, it looked like a horror show. The flesh was missing and bones and veins were hanging out. The shock woke me up!

I'm playing lacrosse against another guy....He's got the ball, I'm on defense....Playing center middie....Our heads are right next to each other....I realize we have no helmets on, which is against the rules....I say let's stop and we can both say to the referee we forgot, so there won't be a penalty....Even though this is a reasonable suggestion, he says no way, he won't get a penalty....He's playing on....
I’m in a house with the parents of a scout two years behind my son R. I was just talking to the scout’s attractive mother about an upcoming fishing trip for the scout pack.

It appeared as if someone had drugged me. I was having a hard time seeing, my vision was going in and out and my head was all fuzzy. I remember being with a couple of people who were being held captive by someone else. At one point, I escaped and was trying to get to a safe place, but it was difficult because I could not see well.

I was at a large venue, maybe a church hall. There were long tables covered in white clothes. None of the settings were complete. Some were missing a plate, some a fork, some a napkin. Not one of the at least 40-50 place settings were complete. I mentioned it to the help but they were indifferent. I complained to the hostess, my dear friend’s mother and she was already quite upset. I felt really sorry for her, she’s eighty four and I wondered why she was having this party. I never found out what or who the party was for. I just felt really sorry for the hostess and woke up confused.

I was with my mom and we were walking through water. It was crystal clear and there was sand on the bottom. I remember feeling some sort of creature wiggling near my toes. This freaked me out so I picked up my feet and began hovering over the water. It appeared as if we were inside even though it looked like the ocean. I felt as if we were in some type of enclosure. As we were hovering I saw a few weird looking sea creatures. One looked like a star fish but only had 3 legs instead of 5. It was hovering over a hole in the sand creating some kind of vortex. As we hovered further I saw these 2 seahorses. They were huge, probably 4 feet high. They looked at me as I passed. While we were hovering I was discussing with my mom that I never got to pursue acting because of something that happened when I was a child.Then we're somewhere else, maybe a theater. It seems to be a theater that I've seen in dreams before. I'm suddenly watching a trailer for some movie, in the movie there is a girl who kills all these people. Then the brother of one of the victims comes back to kill the girl. I can hear the moving announcer narrating the plot. It goes from blood and gore to almost a disney like movie. Then Alex walks in the room and we all start talking about something else.

My ex-wife and I are walking into a store (could be a drugstore, grocery store or even a K-mart since it all took place just inside the entryway). It was night. I see Dr. N. and her husband Dr. H. right ahead of us. I am aware of the possible tension but I rush ahead to say hello and I introduce my ex-wife to them.

My father in law’s house on a sunny afternoon was the setting. My father in law was replacing his baseboard heating and I was helping him. I told him we should discard the old units and he disagreed. He insisted on saving everything. I was very aggravated but went along with him as I always do, but had to complain to my wife.

I'm driving down a street and at an intersection, while I'm stopped, I see a big car, like a little palace on wheels, turn from the left and drive ahead of me....It's like a big cube, with gold and red trim, no windows that I can see....several black motorcycles accompany it in front and behind....I wonder who is in it, where they are going....I follow, but not too close....At another point, I'm going to a special event, like in an auditorium....I know I'm on the VIP list, but I don't have a ticket....A woman is letting people in, and as I get ready to speak to her and explain my situation, I'm nervous she won't let me in....At another point, I'm sitting at a beach at night....Couples of people are on either side of me, being romantic?....I'm alone, waiting to meet someone....It's not a safe area, I'm worried about my wallet sitting out, someone might steal it....I move to hide it....

A dark night on a street I didn’t recognize. A dark man suddenly stops a car and attempts to hijack it. People come to the driver’s aid and the man gets out of the car and runs. I join the people in chasing the man. We can’t catch him and someone says it’s my fault because I didn’t spend enough money. I was offended and came home frustrated because I wondered what money had to do with the whole premise.

It was Friday afternoon drinks and Nick and I were playing a coin game. Stacks of $1 coins were placed on the top edge of the microwave door and when it went Bing whoever had the most coins left on top won. On Nick’s go he had $1 left on top. For some reason when it was my turn I stuck my foot inside the microwave and turned it on until my foot grew hot but didn’t burn. Nick complained that I always had to leave early and I contemplated having another Strongbow and catching the 4.45pm train but decided against it and grabbed my stuff. I'm going into the military for some reason....Like a camp....I suddenly realize I'm going to have to cut all my hair....I hadn't thought of that before....I'm surprised and alarmed for a moment, then decide it's ok....My hair will grow back after Christmas and the new year....I could quit the program to avoid it, but it's awfully late now, and the people have done so much to set things up for me....
All I can say is it involved George and G..
I just remember having a dream with W. (my old boss) in it.

I was expecting G. to get his licence back on the 14th and was surprised when a new one turned up in the mail marked the 18th. An unexplained 4 day discrepancy which meant he couldn’t go to work. It was a very good picture of him on the licence.

I'm in some sort of crowd, and a young black guy walks by and taps on my computer in a mean, disrespectful way.....I glare at him hard as he walks away, making clear I'm mad at him....Lizeta sees me as I do this, and I can tell she's unsure what's going on....she doesn't know the context of why this guy was mean to me....At another point some guys go past in a car....I know they're trouble, so I think of how I can tell the police or fire department to catch them....

I’m at my old house in the 1990’s. It’s summertime. A huge tornado is coming through my neighborhood. I woke up from a nap and went and sat on the couch to watch TV. I was drinking spirits from a round bottom flask similar to a flask you would see in a scientific lab, basically a round based clear glass narrow necked bottle. I'm driving up a road, I go past an accident site....A police officer has set up signs to stop traffic....I'm lucky, I got past the accident before they shut down the road....If I had been any later, I would have been stuck for hours....At another point I'm with the kids, in the wilds like a forest....we're camping?....I decide to put a couple of books by Nietzsche in the back of our car, they're too heavy to carry on this trip....I keep a book of art, paintings, so I have something to look at in the tent at night?....Then I'm in the backyard of my old home town, but it's weirdly distorted, no fence....I step across a patch of green ivy and accidentally roust a cat who was sleeping in there....the cat runs away, startled....Then, in a crowded airport, my wife and I bump into Hart....We would like to say hello to him, but there are too many people, we can't go back to him....

J., an old friend is standing in the middle of the road blocking me from driving into a gas station. There is a very controlling man at the station who wants us both there, but he mainly wants J. J. won’t let me drive in. The area is very “country” with a lot of woods. This is the only road that leads out of the woods. I wake up annoyed that J. won’t let me by, and feeling uneasy about the man at the gas station.

I am in a unique store; everything was covered in slatted, warm color wood, vaulted ceilings, and lots of triangular shapes in the architecture. Part of the dream was at my apartment too, but it still looked similar to the store. J., my best friend and K., a friend from high school that I had lost touch with and recently started hanging out with again were there. We were shopping around the store, I was moving out of town and it was our going away hang out day. I was trying on patchwork ponchos and cool jewelry and thinking about how I didn’t want to like anything because I couldn’t buy it. K. and J. wee walking around together laughing and I felt alone. Then I was cutting a cake by myself and they had just left without telling me anything. Then the store turned into our apartment (mine and my husband S.’s). The floor was rotting out from under the hardwood and when I stepped, my foot would go through. I was screaming that we can’t live here, it’s not safe for L., my infant son, he will go through the floor and drown.

I go into a rocky area of a beach, moving away from the water, which I know is coming in....A big wave is crashing against the outer rocks and pushing its way into this semi-enclosed area....I see it coming towards me, fast....I'm worried, will it smash me against the rocks?....I don't think so, but it's going to be close....I run to a place where I hope I can climb to safety....Then, something about a woman professional who is so good at using influence that she could get a kid into a public school that wasn't his....This is a rare and extremely difficult thing to pull off successfully, and she did....

I’m outside somewhere, a big field with random pine tree seedlings everywhere and a small wooden house to my right. I vaguely remember several of my family members in the dream such as my nephew H., my step sister L., stepbrother L., and my brothers N. and J. All I remember is standing facing the field with my older brother N., and there were small tornadoes coming at us, hundreds of them. We were working as a team to dodge them. Then I was in the wood house and I was nursing all the kids. I woke up and thought how interesting the dream was.

I’m at Sister’s Hospital on the floor that I actually work on. I’m with T. and C., both co-workers, nurses that I work with. The patients (there are 32 of them) keep pressing their call bells. By the time we get to their rooms, they are sleeping. This keeps happening over and over again. I wake up frustrated.

I’m at a place that resembles a truck stop. I was standing naked in a big community shower talking to a boy I used to go to high school with. I don’t remember who this boy is. We were done talking and he left and I remember thinking for a minute that I wanted him to leave the door open so people walking by could see me showering. Then I saw M., my college roommate in a big semi-truck pulling into the parking lot. As I was walking over to her, there was a radio station playing in my head, recapping M.’s life since college and talking about her husband W. I remember thinking, How could I forget that her husband’s name was W. too, just like my son! As I’m on my way to her, I see a group of people from the Big Pine Restaurant. They are standing around an old muscle car, drinking Budweiser and talking. I go up to say hello and they are all talking about how glad they are to be out of the Big Pine Restaurant (not working there anymore). The one girl, a waitress, seems to be a mix of S. T. and J.R….people who have worked there or still do. I stood there laughing and talking with them, but in my head, not really agreeing. Then I continued across the parking lot to M. She was standing in a cement bathroom that looked like it belonged at a State Park. It was open on both sides and in front, like the building was shaped in a T. So I’m talking to her and she is offering to pay for a book I need for school. I play it off like I always do and wait till after the first class to buy my books because I don’t want to tell her I have no money and I don’t want to borrow it. Then I’m walking into a class at my high school that is triple the size that any of my classes really would have been. I recognize a couple of faces and I am walking in with L., a girl I went to high school with. We are laughing about something and making fun of it. Then I’m in a car on a highway in Florida but it looks more like Buffalo. I am the passenger, a woman I know is driving, but I don’t remember who. She is managing Bahia Honda State Park and she is showing me the fence she put up along the perimeter. I see holes in the fence along the way and then it just stops. I ask her what happened and she says she is waiting for funding. I remember thinking I would show my husband S. where we could sneak in later. I sneak into the park by myself and I’m walking through the grass in a huge open field that goes on forever. The grass keeps getting taller and taller and wetter until I’m knee deep in water. I realize that there could be alligators in there and I panic and start running for the car. The weather was cold like Buffalo on a fall day. I remember thinking that maybe the alligators were gone. I get back to the car and my baby L. is screaming (I had forgotten him in the car.) Whhhhyyy….whyyyyy? which is weird because he is too young to talk. Then I wake up thinking that money issues and moving back home is bringing back old memories, regrets, to the forefront of my mind.
I am in a forest in the middle of the night. I’m just walking through the fog.

I drive up to the top of a ramp or a hill, and bump into a row boat or canoe sitting there....It starts to slide down the other side, which would be bad....Surprised and alarmed, I reach out and grab it in time....I'm relieved....Then, something about other people in this area, annoying me....They think they can do things, talk to me, but I don't want to....At another point, I'm giving away to someone the two gold colored chairs in my study....I suddenly realize wait, if I really give those away, I won't be able to recover them like I eventually plan on doing....

I’m in an unknown kitchen with about 25 people who are not familiar to me. The kitchen is new and it’s all stainless steel and has a cold feel to it. It has granite counter tops with peppercorn grinders that are filled with cinnamon. It’s about 5pm. Everybody is dressed in white pajamas. No one speaks. We are just putting what we think is pepper on our salads, but it turns out to be cinnamon. We all laugh to ourselves.

It was just after financial year end and D. called me into his office. He said we had to do an evaluation of one of my client contacts along with a reference. I said she was fine but D. had a different opinion based on how much work they shovelled my way and said he was only going to rate her 6 out of 10. I strongly disagreed and said that in some respects it made my job easier because I knew what they were asking for. My back started to ache in the lower regions and I started rubbing it. I tried to talk D. out of giving such a low mark but he was not to be swayed. My back started hurting more so I left his office. I was on a coach on the way home and three guys were talking about their job. We sat in the inside seats and had a general conversation. I realised they were all in property management same as me although I only did the accounts.

I’m in Ithaca at my grandparent’s house. It’s 1993. It’s a fall day. The air is cool and the leaves falling from the trees. I’m sitting in the sunroom in the backyard. The door is open and birds are chirping. There are cups of hot chocolate and tea with some coffee cake on the table. There is a cool breeze throughout the room. The radio is on in the kitchen, but I can hear the radio in the sunroom. There are orange and green fresh flowers with a fake American flag in the flower pot on the table. There are shelves with National Geographic magazines and books on them. I’m playing Twister with my brothers F. and M. The adults are talking and laughing at the table. Grandpa’s laugh echoes throughout the room. Grandma yells at him for being so loud. I can’t hear the conversations. Hank, the dog, is lying besides the table sleeping. I’m laughing with my brothers. I wake up sad, missing those days.

I am outside in the woods with strangers. It feels like I’m a part of the Hunger Games. We are on a circular spinning amusement park ride, each in our own individual compartment-like cages. The ride starts on the ground spinning slowly and then turning sideways, still spinning. We each have a different type of food labeled outside of our cage and it had something to do with the game. Then we are in a gymnasium and I don’t know what we are supposed to do, but I feel threatened. I start backing up and trying to get behind the other people who are in line with me. Then I start trying to defend myself and I wake up.

G. dropped me off at Guildford Swimming Pool at 6.30am where I had every intention of having a one hour swim before getting ready to go to work. When I got to the gate the attendant asked if I had an appointment to which I replied no, she then asked me for the entry fee of $2.20 but I only had $1.00. I was angry and frustrated, they weren’t going to let me in and I had no way of contacting G. so I was stuck for an hour. I saw a bookshelf and went to examine the titles but as nothing caught my fancy I reached into my dilly bag for the book I’d brought with me only to find it was half a book, like I had guillotined it and brought the bottom half of the book. Bemused and again frustrated because there was no use reading the bottom half of each page I turned my attention to the trophy cabinet. It was filled with ceramic dolphins and whales and a good array of trophies. A commotion behind me heralded the entrance of an old couple and my mouth dropped as I recognised W.’s swimming coach from many years ago. She gave me a puzzled look when I stepped up and said Excuse me Mrs Howell, do you remember me, Megan … Megan Fox. A delighted smile crossed her face, a disgruntled frown crossed the pool workers, and we reminisced about W. and his swimming. She opened the trophy cabinet door and added a leather whale to a shelf. I touched it and it felt kind of squishy. I walked her and her husband (Ian) outside and we were talking when a handsome middle aged man dressed in jeans and t-shirt stopped beside them. They asked if I remembered their son Donald and although I didn’t really I just nodded. Donald and I sat at a picnic table and he said that his Mother had now trained four Olympic gold medallists and I remarked that W. had been quite good at Butterfly in his time. He asked me what I’d been doing and was I married. I admitted I was long term partnered but was not always happy. I could feel a vibrant attraction between us. I think he was going to kiss me as G. drove up in the coupe, with the bonnet up for some reason. I said goodbye and jumped in the car. Why is the bonnet up? Because the frame is drying. Isn’t that dangerous? Nah she’ll be right. We drove off.

I'm inside a tree, going down a steep path behind another taller redwood tree....The taller tree ahead of me slips, topples forward, falls, and crashes to the ground....oh oh, I'm worried about the people inside....I hurry down to help them....Two boys in the back are ok....But what about the three people I know are in front?....they're kids....This is tragic!....I think of how sad and shocking this will be when other people find out about it....But then I see two girls, they're all right....One of them actually got bored and went to do some homework....The other kid isn't there, but I know he or she isn't dead but got away safely....

I saw a news report on TV showing a fat man with a purple ring around his mouth and the caption “death by berry”. Police were looking for D. and a photo of Avery was shown.
