The next report showed the same picture but said death by fresh air and again showed D.’s Avery’s picture wanted in connection.

Something about a woman....And going down a short tunnel, maybe twenty feet long, at about a 45 degree angle....The ceiling of the tunnel seems to be dark fabric, black....I come out in an area with other people behind me....They are nervous, but I am confident....At some other point, I look at Ronald's report card from school....I read the report, and it shows he got an F in one class and C's in two other classes....I'm surprised, that's much worse than I thought....

Amy and I were at a wedding sitting opposite sides of the table. Tony was sitting next to her. There was too much food and Annette was sticking doggy bags in her handbag. We left just as cake was served and took the afternoon off several days later to eat the leftovers. The prawns tasted funny and looked a little strange, kind of pinkish but we ate them anyway. We decided we’d had enough and went to the supermarket. We picked up some cat food and were in the cold section but the clerks were giving us funny looks. We tried to dip out through some batwing doors but they barred our way. Amy said she had an access card but she couldn’t find it amongst the cards in her wallet. We went through the checkout and left.

I'm with a couple of people....teachers?....We get a call to come to Phoenix, students need help there....We take a plane and fly there....But when we get there, it's a big asphalt desert, no people around....We go inside a building like an airport terminal, looking for people....Then I'm with a couple of kids, in a restaurant in Texas....A couple of other people are talking about politics....They say Governor Perry has done something to fight a bad law....He has complained to the Federal government about it, urging the Feds to get involved....I move to their table, with our two kids, to join the conversation....This is why we're here, to talk with local people....I'm thinking of saying, that's hypocritical of Perry, Mr. States Rights, to call for help from the Feds....But I say nothing, and just eat my salad....I want to wait for them to say more....One of the two people is a big fat white guy, sitting to my right....

K. (my husband’s friend’s wife), J. (my best friend) and I are on a beach during a high school reunion. We are just lying out and talking. I feel very comfortable. I like everyone, which is rare. Then the scene changed to a steep rolling hill. I am walking and someone in a small go cart type vehicle is trying to run over me. I cross to avoid being hit and they followed. Then, we are in a big house with a bunch of families, but also strangers and my old boss J. We are cooking and my husband and I have a 4 wheeler we are trying to sell before we move. People keep trying to rip us off.

I'm driving down the 80 freeway, west toward the 580 interchange in El Cerrito....I'm in the fast lane, to the left....I see Peter Drinkage (sp?) setting himself up in the shoulder area by the median, to my left, on a skateboard to ride down the curving hill....I'm shocked, what a crazy and dangerous thing to do....I keep driving, and get going too fast....Scared, I cut past trucks to my right, swerving under one of them somehow and getting over to the side frontage road to slow down....Then, there's some kind of violent free-for-all....My sister is in there fighting, others all in a room trying to kill one another?....I have a stick, I join with someone else, my sister maybe, who is attacking....I'm trying to poke the person with a sharp stick around the face and neck....It's not a very effective weapon....

A young woman has peed on a couple of barbells, then she is going to drop them from a plane onto some bad guys below....I congratulate her on her good idea....Now she's going up flying in the plane?....At another point I'm running down the ramps of a parking garage....I'm about to turn around, since I'm at the bottom of my run and now it's time to go back up....I see some police cars going by....They're going to catch someone....But I don't want to have any connection with them....I'm scared, upset the police might have seen me in the vicinity....I quickly turn around and go back up....

My husband S. and I are hanging out on the 4th of July. We leave our son L. with two kids we know are drunk so that we could go get something to eat. When we come back, L. is standing up sleeping leaning on a metal railing. L. fell over and hit his head on cement. I run over and pick him up. He doesn’t cry, but he looks stunned. Afraid he wasn’t breathing, I yell at the kid and tell him how I could give two shits about him compared to my baby. Now I’m in a newscast for another state. It’s about how much They have reduced their accidents from a new form of snow removal. It’s like I’m living In the newscast and watching happen what people are watching on T.V. Just then, a car hits a snow bank that goes across the whole road and hits cars one after the other. They are giving an example of what used to happen. I’m laughing to myself because 2 weeks before it was 80 degrees and I was telling my husband S. Isn’t it weird, 2 weeks from now it could be covered in snow. Then I realize one of the banked cars is mine.

I was in Perth staying at a long low flat for some sort of course that I was teaching. I was worried that my work pile was nearing 1 foot tall and that I’d never get it done. When I’d finished the course and the flat was inspected I had a heap of washing up that I decided to leave. Dog and I caught the underground tube that went past a concentration camp. I felt like I should help the people inside so I smuggled 2 of them out into the community.

We're just back from the movies....my wife asks how it was, the kids say great....I'm surprised, I wasn't sure if they liked it....A guy is standing close behind me, I'm nervous he'll try to steal my wallet....Earlier, a couple of people and I explore some kind of large underground cave or enclosure or warehouse....There's a sense of mystery, excitement....I'm happy to go down and look around....Then I go with someone into another secret enclosure, smaller, on our level....They go in first....I see a raccoon come out....I'm surprised, and get out of its way....It goes out, no problem between us...

G. and I were walking the cat up M. Road. When we got to the top near the halfway shops we saw an open wooden fence gate and a fluffy brown and ginger cat. G. stepped inside to give it a pat. The courtyard it was sitting in was paved in dirt covered beige pavers and there were ferns in pots dangling from the patio beams covered in green shade cloth. More plants in dirty beige concrete planters were on the pavers. It was quite cool underneath with all the plants. G. spotted a tennis ball and tossed it lightly. Both Dog and the other cat took of scrambling after it. The fluffy cat was audibly growling Mine mine mine mine mine. He got to it first but lost it as he trotted closer to G.. Dog tried to pick it up but the brown cat knocked him over and latched his teeth onto his spine. I was horrified as he bit deeper and prized his jaws apart to make him let go. Dog appeared fine and gave me a bewildered look. We started towards home but I was nervy now and we stopped at a corner for two petrol powered pushbikes with passenger trays (like Chinese bike taxis) go past. G. ran across between the two but I waited. I could see Dog thinking about it but bade him to wait. A yellow dog with a harness but no lead and no visible owner was on the diagonal (opposite) side of the road and looked like he was going to run across but too many cars were coming. We caught up with G. and continued on until we hit a tarmac playground. It had the usual hop scotch and basketball lines painted on the concrete. G. stopped to drink from a bubbler and a young boy pinned a girl face down on one of the bars of a climbing set shaped like an arch. Her teeth were pushed against the metal and he’d only have to move slightly or lift her head up and push it to smash them. He pulled her back by her hair…
Joseph Gordon-Levitt is helping me with a project....I have to help him figure out how to do so....It's hard to figure out how best to do it, I'm not sure what to do right away....

I’m on Main Street in Williamsville on Memorial Day. It is the 1990’s. I’m sitting on the sidewalk in front of Ed Young’s Hardware store. It’s a sunny, cool day. My mom, dad and brothers are sitting and watching the parade and running to the street for candy every time it’s thrown. We’re laughing. I wake up sad, missing those days.

I am in a big tank with metal sides, water dripping down and slowly filling it up. I am frantically trying to figure out how to climb out of the tank. The metal walls are totally smooth and the top looks like a black hole. I feel stressed and tired. Once awake I relate the dream to my stress about finances and not being able to see a clear way out of this situation.
I am wading through a river, winding through canyons. I have the feeling of having no direction.

437. Being in a house of my own, small and quaint and had a big tub in the living room. I had filled it up with suds and candles, about to smoke pot and soak when I saw a barbecue roll by the window. I throw on clothes and bring it inside, excited to show Chad. He later comes over and likes it, but it had fallen in my bath water. I was sad because I wanted us to take one together. I am with my brother who was telling us how he fell down and passed out before, that happened again, someone saved him. I stopped to cry and hug him telling him how that made me feel. He wants to get better. His stomach and ribs were so tiny and enclosed, like he had an eating disorder, but I could feel his love. Chad and I are in the van when some fat black man tries to steal the van and us. He was very slow and made the mistake of leaving and I was able to lock him out, ended up we were in Hollywood and some producer wanted me to be in a show. It is known that I have a lot of money, I am way up in the hills and there are trees all around with hiking paths. It was very beautiful. Justin and I are talking to a real estate agent person, saying how we wanted to build big hotels and make it a party scene. We say no. it’s for our dad and we want a little log cabin by the water source. As we finish I slide down a steep ground path back down, my purse is there filled with pot. I am back in my parents’ kitchen talking to them about Justin and how I will do whatever he wants, but somehow along the way it turns out to be Richard. He and navy buddies are in town getting a nice hotel room on the top floor with a view, Spoon will be there. So I go with him ($35 a night each). He and I start to drive through the desert, it is strange and deserted. We go the wrong way and turn around. We make it to the hotel and meet up with his buddies. Spoon had grown up a lot. We end up getting in an airplane or helicopter. I remember the view was incredible! It was an abstract interpretation of a western city, you could see whales in the water (this made me tell everyone how I saw a dolphin out surfing). Then I started to get really nervous about being up high in a plane, but then I just told myself, “Stay calm, there is no need to panic, what will happen, will happen and take responsibility for your actions.” We get to the room and there is some sort of secret headquarters. An older woman is trying to hide it. Behind our room was one filled with mattresses you could buy. Some girl was telling me how worthy it was to buy one there, laying on one that was made up of shredded newspaper (amazing). I was going to make my own bed out of pillows, so I did not have to sleep next to anyone else.

I only remember bits and pieces of the dream. At one point, I’m driving in a big black truck with and boyfriend, J. We have been out at a party. He is dropping me off at the B. Road house I where I used to live. While I was at the party, I realized that I left my baby L. at home, sleeping alone. I’m freaking out in my head thinking, Please still be sleeping! Please still be sleeping! I step out of the car and I hear him screaming. I run inside to get him. C., an old boyfriend of mine also, is in there and he surprises me. Next thing I know, we are in the bathroom at the B. house and he is pushing me up against the bathroom wall backwards. He is telling me he wants to do something really erotic. He is acting as if we are dating and this is normal behavior. I am thinking how weird it is since we never see or talk to each other anymore. I also remember thinking to myself, Oh yeah C. …..this is REALLY erotic! (Sarcastically)

I am in a random house that I’ve never seen before but in the dream, it’s mine. L. (an old college friend’s B. brother) and I are dating. He is breaking up with me because his mom doesn’t like me and she doesn’t approve of our relationship. B. is trying to smooth things out and explains to me why L. and I can’t be together. I’m feeling rejected and sad.

Earlier in the night: I'm with some women and children, in a dangerous situation....We help them get safe enough, but then another guy and I have to leave....We are going to do more things against the bad guys....But I feel sad leaving the women and children....It's the right thing for me to do, but it's difficult....They are anxious....Then, a woman says to me, now you have to deal with my breasts....I'm not sure what she means, it's almost a joke, but some serious talk too?....part of the overall sense of intrigue....

I was at Mum and Dad’s although the house layout was different and my shower tiles were covered in slippery green moss. Dad started to clean them and I said I hadn’t done it in five years and Oh were they cream underneath the green. I told him not to worry that I’d do it. They had guests so I vanished every now and then to give the tiles a rub. The moss was fairly soft and luxuriant and it was almost a shame to clean it off. When I came out of the shower a very tiny paper butterfly rustled nest to my ear and I shooed it away. It landed gently on a shelf and I picket it up, tiny slivers of paper flew like dust motes through the air to drop onto the shelf. With a crinkle one turned into a sailboat and another into a flower. I shooed the butterfly again and more slivers dropped off and came to life like tiny origami figures. I picked up the flower and it started to bloom and grow. I took it out to Mum to show her and she said we must be growing another tree and there in a pot in the middle of the lounge room was a beautiful paper tree that was bursting with life. The visitors didn’t see anything unusual about this.I left for my high school formal, it was the afternoon of New Year’s Eve. The teacher let us go a little early because we’d been good. Me and A. walked to the pub and I grabbed a six pack of Strongbows and two to drink there and I bought him a beer. He bought a cask of wine. We went back to school and the principal and our teacher gave us and another girl a lift. I was in the middle at the back and we were all trying to decide where aech of us were going for midnight. I said I could have gone home but I would have had to be on the 4.00pm train to get to Barrington by 9.40pm. the trip took a couple of hours and I said I had to stop at the school again a I had forgotten my strongbows and A. had forgotten his wine. We found them in a bin in the quadrangle and Dog’s kitty litter trays had been emptied. I refilled one and we set off again. When next I looked up we were in Merrylands and we let J. out who was walking the rest of the way. We went into a cake store and I was looking at the prices; $29.95 for a big pretzel doll. $299 for a spider web ginger string. A. asked did I want to swap for a Strongbow and as we left I realised I was carrying a large box but no booze. A. said Oh they’re mine, we ate most of them already, cost me about $249. Further down the road some of the earthworks were on the surface and at a fairly lovely townhouse the owner had incorporated them in the foot of his driveway, near the garage door, although it looked like he’d shellacked them to bring out the rich slate greys and earthy beiges and browns on the stones. I bent down to run my fingers over them and breathed out Beautiful. My male companion (unknown) and I went back to view our wall. There was something vaguely different, slightly discordant and slightly askew with what we had done. Our peat bog seemed to ooze more out of the cracks and it seemed too orderly but the reason why eluded me. We were entered in a competition with other students of the walls with the task of creating one. What was wrong with ours – we were running out of time. I plucked at our bog and took a few grains from the old stuff. They felt slightly different, ours more sandy with not enough rich earthy peat but it wasn’t that. I stared at the ancient wall, what was different? I ran my fingers along it’s smooth cool lines. There was something vaguely different in our stones. Ours seemed too symmetrical, too organised. I delved into the ancient wall – seeing, feeling, touching and then it struck me. Their stones weren’t perfect tiles, some weren’t even regular shaped. Here and there thicknesses and shape and bog gaps differed to add texture to the wall. We went to the competition and while other students chipped away at their rocks to make them conform, we cemented ours in place as we’d received them. Our wall stood the test of time.

I’m waiting outside a house with my family….It’s a doctor’s house….We are waiting for him to see us….We have a baby who needs attention?....But he won’t answer the door, even though we know he’s in there….I put a piece of paper with my spit on it under the door, I’m mad….Then we go into the house and look around….I see a set up for a baby chair, like doing therapy with a very little kid….Hmmm, I think to myself, that’s not such a bad thing, maybe I have to change my mind about him….We go out, and I pick up the piece of paper with my name and spit on it and put it into my pocket….Then the doctor is with us outside the house, a pleasant guy with light brown hair….He says he was busy, and he’ll see us later?....Then, right before waking up: I see a long green snake moving fast through the garden toward one of our cats, Strauss perhaps….I’m alarmed….

Something about a woman in an underground enclosure, it’s round….And me driving a big truck of some kind?....

I’m with someone, maybe dad….Playing Frisbee in a long narrow street or alley….People, restaurants are on either side….A difficult situation, I need to throw it straight….I try a couple of throws, they aren’t so good….They curve off to either side, though not horribly….Then, I’m doing something with a young blond woman….Like a gym or dance routine….I hold, caress her body from behind….As my hands pass over her breasts, her shirt comes down a little, revealing her nipples….That was an accident, but neither of us care too much….I pull up her shirt, as aroused as she is….We’re in a room, maybe a library, with tall shelves of books….

I’m in some kind of flying car or van….Sitting in the back, looking out over the San Francisco Bay….It’s a great, open view, like I’m sitting on an outside chair….I see people below in a stadium, like we’ve gone back in time to see the opening of Chavez Ravine stadium in Los Angeles?....But it’s definitely San Francisco, which seems less developed than I expected, more open green space….And Marin, with the coast and mountains….I see surfers in the water below, and I yell Jake! in case my nephew is down there among them….But there’s no way they can hear me from way up here….As we go, my knee bumps a pole on top of a roof as we pass it….Hmm, I think to myself, that was too close, rather dangerous….Then we land, and it seems the ride was very short….I go to say hi to mom, who was driving the car, and she goes around the other side of the car looking for me too….Earlier, I’m trying to find guys to play in a band….We have three core players, need a fourth and possibly fifth?....But one guy is mean, he threatens me with a shotgun….We have a standoff in a house, me with a machine gun?....Then he leaves….I take his shotgun and shoot one round in the sink?....Then I’m outside and I show the gun to a woman….There’s one shell left in the barrel, I carefully take it out….Earlier, I’m in the ocean, and I catch a wave to ride into shore….As I dive forward, I put my cell phone in my pocket to protect it….I’m nervous, though, about the phone getting wet, which I’m pretty sure will happen….Earlier, a snake gets into an apartment room….A big one, a rattler….Then I see our little snake slip away and go over the edge of the roof of the tall building we’re in….I grab the snake just as it goes over….

I’m talking to a woman and a guy about the dream collection of Lucrecia….What do they know about it….A few dreams have been translated, but not all….I wonder if political issues are making it difficult?....They tell me no….At another point I’m talking to the woman about a past conference….She pulls out an envelope, it has my name written on it?....We both realize with surprise that we know each other, met each other back then….Where was I sitting? Ronald is storing something, more than we expected….Talk of downloading whole big sets of dreams?....later, I come upstairs from a shower, carrying an iPad and some pieces of soap….I didn’t mean to bring the soap with me, so I drop it down the stairs….It bounces past a towel on the stairs and also Strauss our cat, who’s sitting there too….The soap bounces down to the square white tile of the floor, where it ricochets back and forth, zipping fast, hitting the sides of the shower stall, and shooting off at different angles….I watch it for a while, it’s cool, makes me happy….I’m aware the wet, slippery quality of the soap is helping it keep going, with barely any friction to slow it down….Strauss is watching, unperturbed….The walls around are green?....

I am editing lots of papers….I am trying to get the files, writings, and formats all in line….The main chapters by our biggest people (including me?) are especially hard to get right….It’s a pain to do all this, and I feel mildly frustrated by it, but I am also confident it will work out in the end….

I see Strauss the cat chasing a raccoon….At another point, we all go into a restaurant….A big party or even is going on, with lots of people, a band, music….We have to go around them….As we turn to go down a side hallway, we get behind a man and woman from the party who are dancing together….They move very slowly down the hall, we have to wait for them….eventually we get past them, and my wife finally gets to her seat….She’s tired, it’s tough to be on her feet so much with her injured leg….Then a woman is writing….I’m helping but it’s turning into more of a story for another woman who’s sitting nearby, not for me….I am surprised but say that’s okay, just let the writing develop as it will, I’m sure I’ll be interested in it, too….The writer says her professor thinks this project is a waste of time, she should be focusing more on her dissertation….Like she’s a grad student?....At some point I’m flying in the air….I get up to a perch on top of a chain link metal fence, high above a city….I put my arms up, happy with my power….

I am trying to properly dispose of a woman’s papers and writings….lots of files, diaries?....But every time I try, something goes wrong, I can’t get rid of them….it is a mildly frustrating situation that seems to recur time after time….I have to keep thinking of ways to do this, it seems confusing….

Something about my helping guys with immigration papers….somehow hooking up a computer cable….Lots of hassles, but a jovial attitude through it….it’s like Vinnie Chase and his brother from Entourage?....

I am in some place with lots of people….Inside a house, there are other cats around….I am holding a kitten, and it gets out of my arms and starts running around on the floor….I carefully go to pick it up again so it won’t get in trouble….At another point I am outside on a street, laying down on some kind of small low cart next to a car….I am talking to someone, and other people are around….Suddenly a truck, or maybe a bus or train, comes hurtling past, curving by the parked car….As the end of the truck whips around toward the car, I’m startled and worried it will hit me, and I can tell other people are also concerned….The truck does hit the car at the end, but luckily because I’m so low down it doesn’t hit me….I’m relieved when it is past, and everyone else is relieved too….Later: something about vacuuming a house to get ready for a visit….Liz Lemon is pushing the vacuum?....At another point people are coming into a room where I am, but I do not have any clothes?....I look quickly for clothes to put on….

Bud and I and other people are on a long gray steel girder, held up by a metal cable high in the sky….The girder is moving fast, carrying us somewhere….We are very scared, Bud especially, we do not want to fall….I say hold on, it will be okay….I know it is going to be a long journey on this thing, but if we can manage our fears we will eventually get there and this will be over….At another point, before maybe, I see a car going out of our driveway here at our house….It’s like I’m outside on the other side of the house….For some reason I want to throw tomatoes at the car….It takes me a while to find them, and I don’t want to run, just walking fast to get in position….I have a chance to throw only one tomato of the three I have, and it seems to hit the back window of the car….

I am in a big room, with a couple of women to the left of me, sitting in chairs or a couch….I see a big platter of food on a table in the room between us, lots of fruit, etc….I am unsure why we are there….I’m supposed to help with something, but there is not much to do….Earlier, wispy images of helping Tracy Jordan, of black eggplant ashes, and of bits of metal….

Some bad guys take over my computer database….They cut it into pieces….I have a long ordeal of gathering the pieces and putting them back together….It is all taking place in a house or building, with other people around….At some point I see little chunks of aluminum foil, like someone cut a blue box of foil into several pieces….

Something about sentences being translated into Spanish, changes to a piece of writing that surprise me….I have to fix it?....People are there, and they leave our house, but they forgot a kitten….I go pick it up, to care for it….It is incredibly small and cute….a little black and white fuzzy kitten….

It’s like Nike is making big changes to its headquarters….Changing the words, or the title of the men’s room?....in the executive building….Guys keep hitting on me romantically….A guy in a bar leans in very close, I avoid him….By accident I almost go into a men’s room, a guy is waiting for me, but I go the other way….Then outside, I am walking near a weird creek, water and debris and a difficult trail….At one point I am inside, and see a bag of something that everyone wants?....I grab it and go around a corner as some guy is chasing me, and quickly hide in a closet, scared….I close the door, but he knows I’m in there….I see his eyes looking in at the floor….
I am doing something to help my wife….She is standing in front of me, up on a table….She has no clothes on?....I suddenly start having sex with her….

my wife and I are fooling around on a big bed with a headboard, I’m very aroused….But then she stops….Why?....I’m unsure, I don’t know….She seems to have gone momentarily blank, like her attention is no longer there, she’s just staring into space….I am surprised and frustrated….What should I do now?....At another point, I see a guy having explicit sex with another guy….It’s like on television, and Ronald is watching, too….I disapprove, and think this is way too explicit to be on tv….

It's early morning and I'm asleep on couch in family room, facing out, facing tv. I hear sounds which eventually filter thru into my sleep. What is it? Could it be a mouse? No. Jeff enters quietly, sneakily, sits beside me and kisses me on the mouth. Hey! He wakes me up. One or more kids including a very tiny baby is there. Abby, I guess. She's naked, wild. She presses phone's buttons ~ I can't stop her for anything. She possibly dials Emergency or operator. Jeff wildly calls for how to shut off our security alarm and starts banging on walls with a hammer. I'm afraid a neighbor'll hear it and he'd wake them. I see little baby crawling. See her from above and behind. See her little *-shaped asshole. But don't see genitalia. Nor do I see a head, just a long pink, bald body like a skinned chicken or rabbit, arms & legs spread out, extended front and back. I say aloud how she looks like a chicken, and/ or tell someone: I think I could cook her!

I leave room or apartment, walking out to a place like a ramp garage. I go to explore and get food. I find a man on one of the floors in garage, grilling & selling meat like gyros but larger triangles plus much smaller pieces of different grilled meat. It appeals to me. Ask for 1 big triangle but say how I like the other stuff. Guy sticks a few pcs into bigger hunk. Ok! Says it'll be around $7. Dollars ~ or 7 something? Could be foreign currency. I find a $5 and a $1 but not 2 singles. Or I can break a $20. But NO! He only takes like Russian money and will not make exchange. Nor will he let me ask other people to exchange $ for me. Must leave the food and go back to apartment. As I climb up the steps of a narrowing vertical tunnel or stairwell, the steps and railings end. It becomes more difficult and challenging. The stairs disappear as the smooth, wavy surface flattens out less like a rock climbing wall. Now it's just slippery and tight. I make it up last 10' to top by sheer will and pressure against the sides. At the end is a railing under which I could climb through an opening to get to unknown floor. But what good would it be? I don't know if it'd take me to right place. Probably closed or no exit. No guarantee I'd be on correct floor. So I go back down and try to find correct entrance/ramp.

At a big gathering of kids and some parents, like in a huge auditorium/ school/ gym. Basically it's a birthday party and/or a Halloween party for Abby who's around 6 years old. She's a very special child, Abby ~ or a special needs little girl. Dream goes on and on with different interactions involving girl and her friends, with me as Observer. Interactions are not all appropriate. Possibly a few know her, and each other. I take pictures with camera because I can't locate my iPhone. I'd put it down and lost or broken it. It has a pink plastic case or bumper which I see is cracked along side and/ or front. What should I do? I take lots of candids, random pictures of young and old. Later, as people leave, I mingle and go about with my tot asking her who she wants a playdate with. And she takes me to a few people and points out who. Knows more folks than I, but not a lot. She goes to Hebrew school with this girl and knows another's first name. I chase after to catch the 1-2 kids, with their parents, and to quickly write down their phone #s. Possibly enough information to track down, set up play-date.

It’s like I am Will McAvoy (?) from the television show The Newsroom, but also me….Some kind of device helps me double my writing?....It’s a machine of some sort, and I am pleased by its potential….Then later, two women are competing over who gets to put lotion on me….I have some kind of injury, perhaps, and they are tending to it?....

Something about three things in the future….Like all the various things going on in the present day will eventually resolve into three basic things….Dream energy, material things or machines like drones, and humans….We humans will serve the dream energy with advanced technology….This notion of how the future will sort out feels like a big revelation….

I am in a gymnasium of some kind, playing a basketball game….I shoot the ball, a long shot with a high arc, and it swishes through the hoop….It is good!....I am happy and pleased at my own skill….Later, something about space….different people are talking about the stars, maps of them….We are unsure, trying to figure out which map is better?....

I go into the mud room in our house, from the kitchen, and I see a bad guy coming inside….He has a gun….Tony Soprano is with me, he is like my dad?....He rushes at the bad guy and grabs his gun hand before he can shoot….They struggle, and I tell my wife and Ronald to get away to safety….I look around the kitchen, confused, trying to think of something to get or do to help Tony….I grab a big kitchen knife, and as Tony holds the bad guy by the arms I hold the knife poised against his chest, ready to plunge it in….We tell the other bad guys not to move or I will stab him….I am totally ready to do so….

I am with a lot of people, at a big event….It is hard to organize, I have some role in the process and I find it difficult….At one point a bad guy is being led through an office, in custody….He is going to be punished for something he did….But I see another guy sitting in a chair in a cubicle, seemingly not looking but secretly watching them bring the bad guy closer….he’s looking at the reflection in a silver metal table knife….Then he gets up suddenly and shoots the bad guy with a gun several times in the back….The bad guy goes down to the ground with a cry of pain….At another point, I get in a car with my wife's sister driving….We are going down Canyon road….She goes too fast, recklessly….I am nervous….

I see an old guy, like at a rest home….He is sitting down, and I notice he has a couple of bite marks, one on his arm, one on his neck….I wonder, have kids been abusing him?....He does not want me to say anything, and I am unsure what to do….

It is pouring rain outside….An amazing cloud burst….I go out the front door and look at the front yard, which is somewhat different than usual, more paving stones, now under a couple inches of water….I walk around and look at it coming down….Someone is visiting our house, and wants me to go down in the basement to show them the heater is working?....I go downstairs and find a bunch of weird stuff inside the metal cylinder, which I suppose is the furnace…I take the old junk out, bottles, etc. …Then I go outside the other side of our house, and it’s like I am coming out of a hotel in Union Square in San Francisco….It’s raining on this side, too, but not as hard, which I find surprising….I look up at the tall, tall building soaring into the gray sky….I realize I am in pajamas, so I cannot go outside any more than this….At some point we, my family perhaps?, are in Washington, D.C. for a visit, and Alicia calls me….She is surprised that I am in town, and asks if I want to have a visit….I’m somewhat angry she found out I am there, this creates a situation I did not want to deal with….

I am on a bike riding on a street, it’s a sunny day….The traffic in front of me stops….It looks like a minor accident between two trucks….I can get by them on my bike, I don’t have to wait behind with the rest of the cars….I go forward, and one of the truck drivers looks like he needs help….I wonder what I should do for a moment, then get off my bike to go help him….First I have to put down the calendar and other papers I’m carrying….This is difficult because one of the trucks is somehow spraying water in the air, so I have to find some place protected from the water sprinkling down on everything….I go by lots of people sitting at café tables under umbrellas….Later, I’m in a house, and two drug agents appear in the doorway….Scared, I run to hide in an empty bedroom closet, and another guy hides in there too….A third guy comes as well, we’re all hiding from the agents, who don’t yet seem to know we are there….

I am helping Bud pack all his stuff….Including candy dispensers?....His good clothes for parties?....Earlier, I am helping someone else with a big organizational thing….There are problems with the elite people, I am surprised to find I am one of them?....

I have an idea to write up a letter to editor, like an ad for a show/ exhibit at Museum (RMSC). For some reason I'm very psyched about enticing people to go see it. Possibly more about me wanting to show off my writing chops vs. the show itself. I'm not creatively involved with exhibit. I go to RMSC to gather info for my article. Want to talk with women who work there, to find out more. But these 2 middle aged gals don't seem to know much. When I ask title of exhibit they say something simple/ inane like: "The Whale Show." Duh. Boring. They tell me about work place. When they need to get to different wing or division at museum or gallery they have to pay! As if they're going to see the exhibit. It's nuts! I question them on it. How could it be? What a dumb place, charging their employees every time they need to go to another area in gallery. Makes no sense!

Here I'm out on my back deck. It has a very narrow walkway on one side of it. It's small; a tight squeeze. Overgrown shrubbery is crowding the path between yard and house and deck. Then I meet Chuy, Chelsea Handler's 'little person' Mexican side-kick on Chelsea Lately show. Yes, he's over at my house. He's friendly and talkative. He thinks I should have a nicer, bigger deck with a bigger, better hot tub. Maybe a small pool. And that Jeff should appreciate me more and want to treat me to nicer things, starting here. Chuy wants to be helpful. What can he do? He's not a builder, so deck is out. I think: Landscape! I'm aware landscaping falls into racial stereotyping with regards to him, though he's not offended. Tell him some neighbors have complained about our overgrown bushes & shrubbery. But fact is, he's too short to reach it and cut it back! We both laugh.

Grandpa/ Pop is over at my house, sitting quietly with me, as I watch TV. Milo and Harrison are playing, probably noisily, in next room. Pop and I are in a linoleum-floored family or rec room. My show is on and I miss what someone said so I rewind the DVR over & over. It's only a dumb show like 'The Nanny.' Something about family being taken or held in their home w secret cameras watching everything they do. Maybe Jerry Seinfeld is the protagonist dad ~ or is it Mr. Sheffield? He's always smiling and chipper despite hostage situation. Smiling too hard, inappropriately, I think. People would not smile so much if they didn't think someone was watching them. Like on TV. It's a nonsensical blend of old TV sitcom with touch of police drama. The TV woman, let's say Fran Dresher, is able to escape/ leave with the kids. Then she returns wearing a HUGE, long diamond necklace ~ like a small chandelier ~ on her neck and chest. She's over the top. I guess she thought if the hubby/ boss was trapped,why not live it up and take advantage and hit the bank account and buy jewelry?! And yet she returns! She could've run, escaped. Yet she returns, all jokey. This is what I re-play, her flamboyant entrance, over & over. What is she saying?! It doesn't really matter. I see the trapped man looking around room for something to use as a weapon. Hidden cameras follow his every move; the kidnappers have removed or dismantled any possible weapon like knives, umbrellas, sharp or hard objects. However...there's one thing. It's the solid block that a gavel would bang on a courtroom desk. Can work! Man unscrews it and possibly can use it to clobber the bad guy(s). Meanwhile, Pa asks me when my show will be over. I realize he's been patiently waiting to watch HIS show. Of course! He tells me that he's won a lottery for being in a drawing for something worth $500. Tells me he doesn't want or need the item, say luggage or electronics or trip. But he wants to see his show, and still would like to win. What does Pa want? He asks for a tea kettle, do we have a kettle? Yes! Mom ~ his middle daughter ~ always had one on the back corner of the kitchen stove! I picture it, in dream; it's chrome, possibly Farberware. I go to get it for Pop as it's right there in the family room, possibly on a second stove or hearth. One of my grandsons enters the room and I look up for split second. In that moment Pa is gone! Vanished. All I see is a tiny dust bunny on the floor where he'd been. I get up and pick up the chrome kettle, exactly as I recalled from Mom's 209 kitchen. Then I go to hall near where kids were playing and find Pa coming from kitchen with different kettle, possibly red kettle. Ahh. All's well. Back in TV room, while Pa's probably settled in with his show and his cup/ glass of tea, I find 2 small photo books I'd made with or for Sarah & Abby when they were quite young when homemade photo books first came out. They're covered with colored Saran Wrap. One is pink. One is lavender. Books are thin, paperback. One says "Dor" on cover with my aunt's photo from about 20 yrs ago. Pa's baby. She's serious, unsmiling. I figure that's what photograph suggested. I see pix of other women from Dor's era, equally deadpan expression. I see every detail in this already complex and emotional dream: One of the girls, either Sarah or Abbs, had written a note on front cover, without thinking it'd remain. Also, I look thru second book. It's of no one we know, only young female celebrities & singers. Like Brittney, Amber, Christina, maybe. Some I couldn't recall, today. Pix are in several sizes from full page, at first, then few per page, then pages become blank pages with assorted shrinking sized blank boxes. Clearly we didn't know what we were doing, how to upload, etc. What a waste. Later I give these 2 books to one person (Seinfeld?) and make a 3rd to give as well, because he or someone has 3 girls now. One each. Back to Pa. I'm glad he's here. It's a quiet, close, comfy visit. Milo enters room, approaching Pa. Pa kisses Milo on the head, or on face or lips. It's the sweetest gesture to ME. Connection. Validation that he sees, he's here. Shows that he knows "my boys". Feels so real. The visit.

Something about a couple, a guy and a girl, meeting together and taking pictures of each other….Like in the past….It is a fake picture?....Later: a guy comes into a town, goes up to two old ladies having lunch together, and asks them where to go….He is unsure where to go, needs directions?....

I've gone to a sort of arts & crafts sale inside a building with a few floors, like Anderson Alley. Converted factory or art studios, with maze of hallways. Crowds of people. As I walk about exploring, looking for cool art, with my companion ~ either Jeff or Sarah (again!) ~ all I see are food vendors. Small time, not like food trucks or pros, but homemade stuff like cookie bars, and maybe also fudge. I try to get past them, these amateurs cutting off and evening off hard little cookie bars on small tabletop counters. What?! Did I wander into an ersatz food court?! Where's the good stuff; the artwork? This isn't what I came here for. I go back toward the entrance to regroup and figure this out. Must be a different direction I need to take. Whoever came there with me is not necessarily next to me; maybe we separated so he (she?) can explore what's interesting to them. It's a confusing place. I know it'll be worth being there if only I can find the pathway to the ARTS section. May take a few tries 'til I discover where I wanted to be to begin with. Person going along with me will be happier, if I am. And I won't be satisfied there. I go back & forth more than once.

One main 'bit' in this dream is schtick about my ring ~ probably my engagement ring. It doesn't look like anything I own nor really like anything I've seen. It has 2 sort of wings with a modern flip in opposing directions. Like 2 convex waves not quite meeting in middle. There's a clear, arching tube between the 2 'waves.' It connects them, and it is filled with tiny sesame-like seeds. Weird. For some reason I'm extremely compelled to change/ alter the shape of this ring. I manipulate it until it softens and melds into a different shape. First I get the 'wings' to narrow and raise up. Eventually I flatten it out almost completely. Wait! I don't like how it looks. Was this a mistake? THEN I accidentally drop it in the kitchen sink, and it lands on the open/ wire drain top. Didn't quite fall in, and then it did! I let everyone in K know. Jeff, and Julie. Jeff says he'll "be happy to help" me get it out. That's code for: Don't tell me again and maybe I'll look at it eventually. It's possible Sarah & Canaan might be there, but if not then, soon. Julie runs water into sink, oblivious of my dire announcement. What?! Wait! I criticize her, my closest friend. HOW could you do that?! She's defensive, doesn't think she can do wrong nor hurt me. Says she used 'shower' function vs 'stream.' Yeah, well, it could still push it through TRAP! I go into frantic mode. Beg Jeff to please get narrow/flattened ring out NOW. He knows how to open sink drain trap. He takes of the elbow pipe, or maybe didn't need to go so far. Rescues ring! Then dream focuses on Sarah and Canaan both over and sitting in our family room, I guess. Possibly Jules is still in kitchen? Jeff, too. But I'm listening to Sarah & Canaan (and maybe another young person) talk. Sarah's telling Canaan there's a job opening at the hospital where Sarah works. She thinks Canaan should apply for it, it'd be good for her. It's like intake or welcome desk, something not too challenging, yet using Canaan's friendly skills. Also, in general, Sarah feels strongly Canaan should work. Cane agrees she might like this job, except she would NOT work where she couldn't bring Milo. Well, there might be daycare available. Nope. Not leaving him. We probably all wonder if that'll ever happen, or if she'll ever get a job. Discussion between my 2 girls continues like a ping pong game, quietly in distance. I hear it: Sarah's calculating how many more babies she'll have in say the next 3 years. Maybe 3-5 years. She'd like to knock out at least 2; probably 3 in total. It's sweet to hear them discussing this. Canaan sees Motherhood as the one true path. Sarah tries to incorporate work/ career into her path. Both are extremely integral to Sarah. Unlike Cane who only wants mommy track. But in this one instance they seem to be in tune, no one pushing the other's buttons. Five minutes of peace.

I am in a baseball game, with the setting at my old childhood house, our driveway?....Hunter Pence is up batting….He has a lot of power as a hitter….I hear people watching us getting excited, anticipating a long hit, maybe a home run….I am going to be his runner….I stretch and squat and shake my legs, get ready to run….But he hits a high fly ball, and I see the outfielders can catch it for an out….So I will not get to run….
Something about my nephew Gale and his college applications….They get messed up, lots of worry by the family….But then there is a surprise for us all: my sister tells me that he got into Stanford….

I am on the beach, explaining something to people….I am talking with them about an upcoming IASD meeting in San Diego….I say I was just in San Diego….But no, I think about saying that, but actually do not….I don’t want to draw attention to my travels?....They all talk about a good opening ceremony….I think of how it is an okay place, not great but not terrible, an enclosed space with the strand on either side, beach in front….

There are videos of me in a store, buying stuff….I do not like it, I want to find some way to make it stop….At some point I have a basketball in our kitchen, and I bounce it on the surface of the island counter, trying to get it to land in a particular spot by the sink on the other side of the kitchen….It does not go exactly as I planned, and oops, the ball almost hits some things, nearly breaking them….At another point, Ronald asks me about his complexion….It’s not very good these days, but to be nice to him I say it is fine….

I am playing baseball in a stadium filled with people….I have already been at bat once, and I did not do well….I struck out….The pitcher is very good, throws it hard….I did not even make contact with my bat….As I get ready to face him again I think about what I will do when I get up to the plate….I imagine hitting the ball and making good enough contact for the ball to reach the outfield….maybe straight down the first base line….

I am letting people do something that seems like a slow distraction….Then I am going to get rid of them….I see a mouse running away….Strauss our cat looks after it….It is a white mouse, and it starts to shit out a black turd, in anxiety….At another point I am driving down an old road, and I go a little too fast, and I have to skid to a stop….I am with Ronald?....Earlier, my wife and I get in someone else’s car….by a river?....We are listening to music….Oh oh, I worry, here comes a cop, I’m unsure, will he bust us, arrest us for some kind of criminal activity?....

I go out into the backyard of our house in my old town and see a huge gray metal chopper machine cutting horizontally across the top of our back fence, slicing off all tree branches taller than that line….I am shocked, I cannot believe they would do that without asking me for permission….I go out and yell angrily at the workers, but they do not care….I get a card with a phone number to call for my complaints, but I am not satisfied with that….I count the workers, six of them, evenly split between males and females….I go back inside the house, furious, yelling in frustration….At some point when I’m assessing the damage, I think of how it is now possible to see all the way down to the shore of the bay from our house….before, the tree branches obscured that view, but now I can see the tidal mud flats and the water at the shore….

I am in a tall building, leaving people, a party?....I am trying to go to my room….Into a big open atrium….I am surprised at how big it is….windows, mirrors, light and airy with yellow or gold colored walls….But I am still not alone?....Someone else is there?....At another point, someone’s mother drives me and lots of other people home in her car….It’s a Volvo station wagon?....We all pile into the back seats, and she drives through impossibly tiny alleys, driveways, through people’s yards….It’s like the Berkeley or El Cerrito hills, going from south to north….I am alarmed at her route, how narrow and intrusive it is, but I am impressed, too, by her local knowledge and driving skill….We go through an old person’s garage….I wonder, does the woman have to open and close the doors for them, in reciprocity for letting her pass through?....
I see a baby carriage in Fern’s room….Something to do with the laundry….

My brother is excited that somehow the prices of a particular stock share are going to go way up….or way down, it is not clear which, but apparently either way would be good….He looks to me to cash it in….I am confused, not sure what to do….
Something about a steward of dreams?....waiting outside a gate, to tell my sister something important?....About both extremes, trying to find language for both ends of the spectrum….

Lots of things about the essay, how to write, edit, finish it properly….At some point I am playing a game of football with other people….part of the essay situation, like a break from the work to play?....I am really good at football compared to the others….On the first kickoff they try to hold me….I call out a foul….Then it is our ball….and the guy who is quarterback for us does not know what to do….Does he even know, I wonder, how to throw a football?....At another point I am driving up a street in a residential area and another big car, a SUV, comes down the hill and slows to a stop so I can get by….However, he turns toward the center just a little, so I have to drive over a driveway gutter on the right side, a big bump for my car….I am annoyed at the guy….But then I find out he is a congressman, and Ronald is working for him?....I realize I should find out more about him….Then, at the house in my old town, like I am coming up the north side of the house, I see inside a big clump of bushes, where some old boxes, etc. have been stored….I am pleased at the discovery and look inside, amazed at the old stuff….I realize most of it is old, not of much use….old branches, yard waste, a wooden crate….still, a cool discovery of hidden items….

Something about many places to edit essays?....I see a big map of the United States, with lots of blue dots all over the country where this kind of thing can be done….I am surprised and pleased by this….

I am walking along a road….Above me, on a road paralleling mine, with lots of dark green ivy between us, I see lots of girls who are going to a Green Day concert….At the coliseum….This is in the East Bay?....some guys, too, with older people?....It gets dark, cloudy, and I think about how they will likely get rained on….I also think about going for a run in the dark rain….At first I decide no, that would be dangerous….But then I see all of them walking along the road, and I change my mind and decide yes, that would be fun….At another point I am walking through a conference hotel setting with an African-American guy….We are wearing overcoats, suits, nice shoes….We are walking arm-in-arm, very friendly….We are looking for someone, in another room?....At another point, a small deer is dying in a bathroom, like at our house?....Our two cats are laying nearby, waiting to attack it….I am unsure what to do, and I just walk past….

Bud goes down into a cave, through a crevice and into some water to look for something….I try to help him get back out….I show him an alternate route….At some point I am in downtown Berkeley….Running down some sidewalks, past freaky looking people in black leather, tattoos, etc….I have to get something, I am in a rush….Then, my wife and I are in a weird house, with a small window placed in a wall, surrounded by book shelves….the window looks into another house, with people who can see through to us….I ask if I should block the window, but my wife says no, it is okay….She sits down below the window so they cannot see her….I recognize that will work, but it surprises me that my wife would take that kind of passive approach….At another point, my wife, Ronald and I are at a weird restaurant….We go out, then realize we left our coats, purses, wallets, etc….I go back….The place is suddenly empty, with everything moved out for remodeling….I am worried, and wonder is all our stuff gone?....No, I find it, in a pile off to the side….Phew, I am relieved….A worker guy is there and keeps at his work as I look and find our stuff….

We are in a music video, unexpectedly….my wife and I are there, with lots of other people in the room, dancing to the music….The main people involved in making the video come over to us, I try to look lively, though I am not really interested in what’s going on….Some dancers see our bags of stuff….They make fun of our having so many things to carry around….It is my wife’s, and I defend her, telling them that she has not been home since seven this morning, so she had to carry it all with her….Then at a table with other people….I try to act cool….Some guys and girls are nice to us….They live in Kensington, near where my wife and I were walking that day….A guy tells me about his sister….She is having drug problems?....He could not play tennis today because he had to take care of her….He switches seats as he tells me this, from my right to my left side….Maybe so he can have more privacy to say such a personal thing….

I go into a room, like a party going on with other people….Nicholas Kristoff is there, some others….I had been looking at a map of where a new sports arena will be built….It’s like I am looking down on the land itself, like around a bay of blue water, with green lands around it….It seems the new arena will be very difficult for us to reach based on where we live, requiring lots of driving and traffic….I can see one place where they will have to build a road through the green fields to reach the site of the new arena….I realize this is a beautiful nature area, about to be paved over with development….Then I am down on the land, walking where they will build near the water….I slip and slowly fall into the water up to my waist….oh oh, I am surprised and upset….I get out fairly quickly, and nothing seems damaged, but I am soaking wet….Then I am in the party with Kristoff, and I say to him you grew up in Oregon, what do you think of this development plan?....Two African-American women are there, and it turns out they are in favor of the development….Not wanting to get into a direct argument, I back up and say whatever they do with this land, it should be done fairly, with everyone’s interests involved….They agree with that….I notice Kristoff has a flap of skin where his nose should be….Then I see he has numerous little cuts all over his face….Maybe he was hit with glass?....He is interested in the topic I have brought up, and he may write about it….Before that, I am talking with a young woman….She is standing and I am sitting….It seems like she looks at the top of my head, then comes close and brushes by me….I am surprised and pleased by her flirting….Before that, I am on a big log of wood, angled downward toward some water….I am sliding down, still in some control but likely to end up in the water….

I am in a house, bad guys come back so we have to get out first, before they get there….At some point a bear comes toward the house, a big black one….I try to keep it back, but it keeps coming….Levi our cat is outside, I have to help him get in before he runs away from the bear….It is a difficult situation….At another point I am talking with NBA basketball players like Damien Lillard about inheritance taxes….Damien and the others are mad because all the inheritance will be taken away, but I think to myself that it probably should be taxed out of fairness for society….But I want to keep it for my kids, too….

I get in a dispute with a big fat lawyer guy, who is supposed to represent me and Ronald….I say you are not so smart, he says yes I am….Ronald and I leave him….Or I imagine what it would be like to say that to him?....Another guy says tomorrow the meal at school is turkey, and he does not like it….Ronald says people get other food and go to hidden part of the school campus….Then, I am walking in a parking lot, looking for my car….There it is, I see it….At other points, lots of things happening with basketball players?....

I am going to the film shooting….lots of small roles people are doing….What about the bigger ones?....I wonder….At another point, I see Ronald and friends going up a trail into the woods….to smoke?....hmmm….I go a different direction so they cannot see me….Then, I am going into a bank just as it opens….my wife has some ice?....She has to go in first, I suppose because the ice may start to melt….But other older, slower people are ahead of us….

I see Mr. Johnson taking out his Christmas tree on my street….It reminds me that I should do that kind of clean up before I go….at another point, one of the women dancers from the film shows up on the set….I had been thinking she might appear to prod people to move faster at some point….But she actually shows up, and with another woman, too….
As time goes by, the film crew is trying to get new, good shots….The later ones are mostly obscure, but a few are important….

I am being filmed in various ways, and I try to stand still, do as I am supposed to do….At one point I am in water, like we are filming in the ocean?....At another point I am wearing gray clothes, but I need to switch to red ones….

A large group of people are at a weird house….At first Mike from the television show Breaking Bad is there, relaxing in a weird pit of compost?....he is rubbing his bald head in it?....I see the view from within, it looks like a set-up for someone to attack him at a vulnerable moment….I am too scared, I do not want to watch….but it turns out ok….two weird little people are there, they did sneak in, but they are not bad people….then outside, Jimmy and Juan arrive and talk with Ronald….Juan is happy, back from a baseball game where he hit a home run and five doubles….six runs batted in….very impressive, I wonder what kind of game, league he is playing in….Then Jimmy’s dad comes, they have to go now….A woman is in the group, she recognizes his dad and goes to say hello to him….But he is going so fast, will she catch up to him?....I am unsure….

I leave a bunch of people, we were outside doing something….Filming?....I go off for a walk, without a jacket in the rain….it is night….I realize people will think I am weird for being outside in this kind of weather….I decide I may want to get some food….Maybe I could walk to the Laughing Planet restaurant?....Then I go out on a trail along the ocean coast….I realize the rocks are too steep to keep going….I see a way I could go if I really wanted to push it, but I decide that would be a bad idea….On a big rock not too far away, I see a crab-like creature with long antennae, going after littler creatures and attacking them….It is amazing….The big one is creepy looking….Then another creature, not quite so big, fights back, gets right up in the big one’s face….I think, wow, that would be an amazing video….But there is to way to reach my phone in my pocket, I am holding onto the steep rocks too tightly….

I am driving in San Rafael toward 101 from the north on 2nd street….I am a spy of some kind….We have to go north, to follow someone?....Then I get on a bus with Ronald and another guy….We are trying to be stealthy, but also trying to stay away from the other guy, whom I do not trust….I start to sit behind Ronald, but he moves seats so I can sit next to him….He has all his shoes, clothes, etc. in a big pile in the aisle of the bus, totally blocking passage for other people….Hmmm, I worry that will be a problem if anyone needs to pass….Later, my wife and I are looking for plums and we find a jar with little black pellets….we realize that’s not plums and not even some kind of weird new smoke product….but we are unsure what exactly it is….Then Fern brings a big jar of green plums and gives it to my wife….Oh, that is a surprise, but helpful….

I am in some neighborhood, sneaking through the brush and trees in the backyards…I go into a strange person’s house, trying not to be seen….But the person does see me?....I try to hide my stuff, or I change clothes….I am uncertain why I am there, what I am trying to do….Getting from one place to another?....this just happens to be a place I have to pass through….Later lots of people are around, like a party….It is okay to be there, but now I have to get my phone and gray sweat pants, which I left somewhere in the house….I do not know where, I seem to have forgotten….At another point I am outside in a brushy area, behind the houses….Suddenly a big dog charges at me from the direction of the houses….The dog grabs my arm in its mouth and holds it….It is very aggressive, and I am scared….I close my eyes and turn my head away, trying not to provoke it, hoping it will not bite….
I am helping a woman escape something….I go to her, to get out of a house?....Something to do with word searches?....Something about 80%, a low figure, she could do much better….

A vague dream….I am with two guys, they are making me leave….or do something I do not want to do….At one point they make me find one instance of a famous guy, to show how that he is overcome by all the others….This has something to do with the database?....

I am driving in a car with my wife in the front seat, other people in the back seat….I say to the ones in back, what do you think about—I can’t remember what it was, but in the dream I suddenly realize as soon as I have spoken that I have revealed my wife’s ideas about some kind of secret….I can tell she is mad, and I am sorry….I say to them, forget I said that, but it is too late….
Some big fat guy will not do what I want him to do….We are supposed to drive somewhere?....I am frustrated and scared….this somehow puts me in danger….

By the sea shore, a group of people are sitting, being friendly with each other….I go with a shovel to help them set up a good place to sit….As I go around them I stagger and fall for a moment, then get up and start digging, in front of a big rock….Lots of shells and rocks are in the sand, and shallow puddles of water form as I dig….Earlier, I am driving in downtown Berkeley, turning left from University onto Shattuck, from west to south….Lots of people are on the street, I have to carefully guide my car through the crowds….Also earlier: I pick up a cat, like Strauss?....I am taking it to be eaten by another big creature….It seems we have lots of cats like Strauss for this purpose?....

Bud and Fern drive a car back home….it is not the car we were expecting….It is an old 50’s car, big and bulky, light pink or tan in color?....We are all wondering, what happened to the car they were supposed to be driving?....we ask them, and Bud tells us they had some kind of problem….They pull the car into a garage like the one at our Bradcliff Court house….

I am by a sea shore, and I see tons of money, old coins, and such laying on the sand….No one else sees it….I start picking up as much as I can….As I do so I wonder if I should tell anyone….Maybe I should, but I do not see anyone around….And I do not want to leave, with so many interesting, valuable things right there on the ground….It’s too much for me to take all of it, so I focus only on what looks like the oldest, rarest, most valuable things….some old brown coins, some wads of green cash….It’s amazing, makes me happy, but curious….At another point I am with Ronald in a little car or vehicle of some kind….We are at one end of a small, narrow wooden bridge….someone else is coming across from the other side….a kid?....as he comes across, the wooden slats of the bridge start to fall apart….Earlier, perhaps connected to the seashore scene, I go into a cave, it’s cool and beautiful….Water is gushing through, and lots of people are in there, too….

I walk into a room or house with some guys, my friends….As soon as we go in, the others see that no one is looking, then we suddenly turn around and go back out….They grab a white plastic garbage bag that turns out to have our get away stuff in it….Like this is an escape that has been well planned….I go along with it, trying not to act surprised….At some point I am walking past some water, it is green and deep….Something is down there?....As I walk by I imagine sending a mechanical probe or camera down there to take a look….
Something about a repair company with the motto, “More than bricks”….promising more of a modern upgrade to the hotel where I am at….It needs work, but I don’t want to do it the old fashioned way….

I am supposed to help two women learn something about dreams….Other people have gone off to do something flashier?....Now I wonder, what I will I show them?....Should I take them out, or stay here?....

I am some place by a dry creek bed….I see water start to flow down it….That is cool, I am pleased to see it….But farther down I see a big red rubber ball caught in the water’s flow….about to be carried down the creek and lost….I run to catch up to it, and fortunately I just get there in time, before the ball is gone….I am happily surprised that I did it….I pick the ball up out of the water….

On a road, I see a kid running around a turn out….By a lot of trees, a dirt area to the side of the road….two other people are laying down….They have car trouble?....That’s too bad, I think….I feel sorry for them….I expect it will be a long time to get service for their car all the way out here….Then, I am running up a hill, thinking if I should get some plums before I keep going….No, I decide, it would be too much hassle to go back for that….Then I go down a trail, rocky and steep….I stop to let a bunch of young women athletes go by….They are coming from the other direction….As they go I think of how they should be more careful, watch out for the uneven rocks, rather than talking so much with each other….I worry they will get hurt….

I am at some sort of school or rural resort….In one of many projects, I am with three young women, we talk about how it’s going, what we need to do….I am unsure if they get it as well as I do, understand the project, but in any case it is fun to be working with them….Later in a room, and supposedly Michael Jackson is going to appear and do a brief performance here at the school….I think of how that’s weird, but ok, everyone is excited….It seems so small for a star like him….I pull the bed covers up before he comes into the room, to tidy up, have it less messy….Before that, I am walking through a house and then realizing this has the same floor plan as the ranch house….These people have redesigned it differently….I look at how they changed the furnace room into a play area….white walls, brightly lit….At one point I am about to go on a run….but I am on dinner duty to make taco meat….Hmm, I realize there is not enough time to run and do that….so I will have to decide not to run….Later, in another class, lots of people sitting at a long rectangular table….I’m surprised how many people….to my left are some women, and to my right are some military people in various uniforms….they are also students in the class….sitting and talking together….Next time, I think, I will sit with them, introduce myself, try to help them feel part of the class….I might mention that I was in ROTC once, but decided not to pursue a military career because I wanted to keep studying dreams and I liked “recreational drug use”….

Up on a ridge, with the ocean below….my wife and I get in a cab, which is driving us back on a twisting road….I say to the driver be careful of the snow, go slowly, we are in no rush….Apparently snow is blowing in over the ocean from Hawaii?....I know this and try to help the driver with the information….At another point I am walking along a narrow path on the ridge….I have to hold onto a metal chain link fence so I won’t fall….Anyone going along here has to be careful….

Something about I have to go to do 4 extra little payments of money at the end of a bigger promise….I make sure I have my wallet….Other people are suspicious of my motives….Maybe they think I am making a romantic move on someone, or running away so I will not be caught by the authorities?....No, I am simply doing as I am told….A young woman is involved, she is guiding me….A the end I see beautiful white clouds on the horizon….A couple of them look like polished, curved ivory columns or pillars….standing out against the gray clouds in the background….

Something about a train coming towards the place I am….a town or small station….somehow this is part of database research….I thought it was already here, ready for study….But I see it coming down the line, pulling into the station….Other people seem surprised it is here….

People are doing similar projects to us….Going out to Eastern Connecticut?....something about hipsters, or the ranch?....the same things happening out there as here, drawing people’s interests….Later, an image of a jeep or small tractor trying to go up a muddy hill….I wonder, will it make it?....

Up in a room, it is cleaning time….my people are doing things….I look out a window to my right, and see other people doing harder clean up tasks outside….A guy looks up at me, and I realize I should work, too, and not slack off….Later, more cleaning….a guy has a white bag full of used kitty litter….He puts the bag over his head, to compact the bags inside the bag, but instead it is just cat litter, and it pours all over him….I think my wife should have take care of the bags within bags?....I feel terrible and sad for the guy and I hurry to help him and apologize….he is somewhat angry….He is wearing a cool gray hat and gray suit, jacket and pants?....I want to be friends with him, but this will put him in a bad mood….

A bus comes to get me in the horse arena….brown dirt on the ground….it is going to take me to others?....But I wonder, will the bus fit in there?....I am unsure….Before, I was up in a health club of rich people….It is not my place, through, I want to find how to get out….At some point I am hiding under a huge bed because a dragon is coming after us….

Lots about getting a big house and property ready for other people….but it is too big to prepare properly….Some people become our helpers….Then I am outside and I see a canal behind the house….two naked black women are coming out of the water and crawling low and sneaky, with their backs to the ground, across the green grass towards the house….I am intrigued by them, and I say are you coming over to my place?....But they turn around without a word and swim onwards….Too many other people are around for them to feel comfortable….I am both aroused and scared by them….

I am in the studio house at the ranch….In the side room, with my green bong….Someone comes in the front door….Mr. Johnson?....I do not have time to fully hide everything, so I go say hi….Then lots of people come in….Eventually I go outside, look for a place against the walls of the house so I cannot be seen from inside, to have a smoke….It is hard to find a place without too much wind blowing….

I am talking with people about fixing up the ranch….Making things better, adding things, but also keeping everything natural….we go by a building, of dark red stone, with an arched doorway….at the top of the arch there is a stone marker with the date of when the building was constructed: 1922….I say to the people with me, look at how old that building is….

I am at a house at the beach, looking out at the ocean….Big waves come up, crash against the windows of the house….nothing is broken, but the waves are strong, and the house is very close to the shore….I feel we should all be careful….At one point Fern (not her age now, but a baby) and another woman, my wife maybe?, go into the water and they are pushed up against the side of the house….I am worried for them, although they do not seem harmed right now….

People are helping with the ranch….It is hard to coordinate everyone’s efforts….A chinese woman leaves some water in the sink, she did not open the stopper….not the way I like it….Then at another point the chinese woman shows up at a gathering in a nice, attractive evening dress, dark blue with a low, sharp neckline….More formal, sexy than the situation calls for….But I like it….

“The Tiny Bird” I am in a house and had gone up some stairs. Distantly I can hear a bird chirping. I have a desperate feeling of needing to feed the bird. I hear it in the attic space. I pull off a little door in the wall and the bird comes out. It fluttered in front of me, it’s white with a little brown like a finch, and it wants to sit on my finger. I am going to take it home and we are both very happy about that.

I am in a car with two other people….In the back seat….I am in the middle, and I put my arms affectionately around both of them….They are kids, or teenagers?....I am taking care of them?....Then at another point I go up a hill fast, running, and other people notice my speed and are impressed by me….

A guy is trying to close a sliding door, from top down to bottom, and then latch it down securely….But he does not have the right kinds of hooks on the door to make it stay down….Finally he gets good hooks, and it works….
I see Lucrecia writing down a big dream….she is a girl, seven or eight years old….no one has paid attention to her before….But now it is more dramatic, meaningful….
It is like I am looking through the original Lucrecia files, and I see a note saying she was taken….I am a little angry, because it is such a short note, and more should have been said….
Something about male and female versions of Lucrecia’s story….they are different time lines, and I am unsure how to relate them….The female time line is more complicated than the male one….

Something about people pressuring me to go faster on the Lucrecia project….Like they removed the lid on top, which now I can see has a rectangular opening, with four round pipes forming the frame….Now I can go faster….I have an image of Batman and Robin climbing a wall, talking to people through the building windows….

“The Old Man’s Brain” There is a hill and a lot of families, lots of kids. There is an accident outside. It was a game of go karts and the go kart has a rubber band around it, it helps it move. The accident has caused the rubber band to wrap around his head. It had squeezed so tight that it was embedded an inch. I get some scissors to remove it but can’t see how. People are saying, “hurry, hurry! Then I am someplace else. There is a very old man and I am going to go check in on him, I have this feeling that he has fallen asleep in the bathtub. When he starts up, the thing is…his skull is fragile, like plastic, when he leaned up so quickly he has cracked it and now water is pouring into his brain. I watch his eyes turn gray and opaque, lifeless. I call 911 but the phone also has connected to the water. I can hear water running inside the phone. I was trying to call when I awoke.
Some cleaning supplies have been left out in the front garden of the Kensington house….Lots of green plants around….I wonder what I should do about the supplies….

Long dreams….People want to shut my project down….I have to switch to a different form that will cause problems at the end….At one point I look in a brown paper bag I see inside it a scorpion with all my stuff….I have to get it out, then shush it down some stairs, outdoors….Will it survive, I wonder?....Probably not….I also find a small circular snake in the bag, and I have to get rid of it, too….

I am driving up a hill, with a river on the right….I have to be careful at the final turn, so I do not fall into the water….I have to stop the car, back up a little ways, and then try the turn again….something about packing up to leave?....

Something about a neighbor on the other side of our property being willing to merge….I can see the two rectangular shaped properties, side by side….flat green grass….It has something to do with Stanford?....

I am walking down into the ranch valley, with some friends….I see a worker crew of guys down there….To my shock, they have cut several tall, thick trees half-way down, leaving tall stumps….I can see the yellow and orange disks at the top where they were cut….I go down and ask for the foreman of the crew….They try to ignore me, but I say I am the property owner….What are you doing?
