We have a woman planning some things at the ranch….We need to provide her with plenty of resources….She does not have enough?....At some point I see Carole King, the musician, singing, and I am impressed by her vigor and fine body, despite being pretty old at this point in her career….Then I see lots of people at the ranch, and I am amazed and disbelieving: they have so many cows and horses, much more than they can handle….the whole thing is like an advertisement?....

I go into a room in some house….A woman says can you get it out….I look, and see a skunk in the living room….I try to guide it to the open door outside….it is very active….But I finally get it out….Later, I am going into a room with a friend….we are staying out of the way of cooking people, who complained about us before….We go in looking for a gun that someone hid in there?....I say it must be easy to find….The guy came in and hid it or got it fast, so it cannot be in too elaborate a hiding place….At another point: I slide down a steep wall skillfully, while holding something in one of my hands, holding onto little loops of rope that extend from the wall in various places….I land on my feet at the bottom, and other people are impressed by my skill….and something about filming MCDD, the characters are ready….

It is like the property is surrounded by people, and now all their legal troubles are over….So they are coming for us, threatening us somehow….At another point, I am in a big classroom, the first day of class for something….I sit at the edge of the left side of the auditorium, filled with at least one hundred other students….The teacher is talking, but I am working on my computer….Then she says she is going to call on a student at random, and she apologizes for doing it this way at the beginning of class….then she says my name and with anxiety and reluctance I raise my hand….I did not hear what she was saying before the question, so I have absolutely no idea what to say….She comes over to me, and sees my laptop computer….I try to explain quietly why I was not prepared, but then I say sure, go ahead, ask me anything….I am not going to hide or avoid the tough situation….She moves on to talk about something else….

I am playing lacrosse with a long, long defenseman’s stick….I go onto a field to practice at a far goal….running around the big grass field, swinging the stick around….I have picked up a piece of shit to use as a pretend ball, cradling it in the stick….at another point, I am in a house with other people, a strange place with lots of weird rooms….I go to run on the indoor track in the house….I try to avoid the other people, and get to my running….

I am trying to organize something….But it is hard to get together….People are being lame….I feel mild frustration….

I am walking out of some tunnel or house….a tube-shaped passage out of a house, along the second story level and then down stairs to the ground level….The house is down in the valley at the ranch?....Other people are there walking around, coming up and down the stairs….hmm, I wonder if this is a problem, them being on my property….no, I guess it is okay….I am only wearing black sweat pants, with no shirt, shoes, or even underwear….kind of inappropriately dressed….again, I wonder if this is a problem….is that okay?....I guess it is….

The picture frame is cool; ornate, round at the edges, sculpted, and included a back on it like a lazy susan; it spun when you held it. As the event is unfolding I look at the frame, it’s white and unpainted, I think,”Oh my gosh! This picture frame does so much more! It could have been so beautiful. Making big improvements on the ranch….I am helping, me and a woman….But there are problems….Things are not as easy as I assumed….At one point I am driving the Kubota tractor to a spot in the upper meadow, to get supplies of some kind….rows of tall white rectangular boxes….We do stuff, make some changes and get some things done, but not what we expected?....
I am walking along the far upper meadows at the ranch….Suddenly I see two neighbors I already know….Hmm, I realize there is no way to avoid talking with them….

I am putting together political plans for what to do in case things go wrong….A woman is loyal to me, I know she will stick with me no matter what….At another time, I try to make a point to my wife and others by asking them who was the winner of the best leading performance by a male actor….As I say it I pretend to act like I am running, hiding, going in tunnels….hiding on the other side of the table, like the actor in the movie….will they guess the movie?....I feel it should be obvious to them, but to my surprise it is not….

A woman and I are playing Frisbee….other things are going on at the same time, so what we are doing seems frivolous….But we have a plan to make it bigger, more important….Something with the color red will help….at some point, a big bad guy is involved in the situation….

Intrigue is happening at a house, lots of people there….I say something about my woman friend….another guy is upset, but he should not be….I say to him relax, do you know everything about women?....he calms down….Then some guy is going to shave my lower body hair, like he’s a barber?....He uses a green marker to draw on my thighs and under my testes, where he is going to shave….then he goes out so I can lie down on the table where he will do it, kind of like a massage….I worry, and wonder what I should do….I feel I should wipe my ass better to be clean, I don’t want to smell like shit….

Other people are doing something about HP Lovecraft, I do not understand it….They have large glass boxes that have something to do with it….I am curious, and worried that I am missing something important or relevant to my project….

April, the young assistant on Parks and Rec, is sad about something….A party is happening, other people around, but she has been taken away by someone?....I say go on with the party, that will make the people bring her back….I am concerned about her, and I want to help make the situation better for her….
There are rabbits; someone wants me to take the rabbits.

I am running a political campaign, trying to do it right….Lots of good energy, happiness in the process….people are working hard, feeling good about it….Some else is working on the campaign….They bungle it at first, do a bad job, but then do well later….

“The Bad Guys” I am with the bad guys. Running and escaping, jumping and hiding in the tops of buildings and the middle of buildings. Rooms and places and shoot outs. All the same usual suspects; you know them after a while. They all want me dead. I was fighting for myself but I don’t want them dead. I am just playing the game. I don’t even think I have a gun! I have escaped and come so far! I have climbed the tops of buildings, and gone through holes, up stairs and around pulleys, pulled myself up and done so much. When I arrive at the hideout they say, “You’ve been shot!” I was going to play it out, like I’m going to die, sneak away, remain anonymous, disappear. I do, I pretend it’s bad. It was the end of the fight, the calm after a storm. I am thinking they are all bad and I don’t trust them. I make like I’m going to wander off and bleed to death but really…..I am going somewhere. I see a building and a red car. I see a person in the car and I have a flash: NOT INNOCENT. I am trying to communicate but my phone is damaged. I am hiding in a plastic bathroom when…TA-DA! My people come to find me! They are getting dressed in secret identities so we could escape and they want me to come too!So good!
Something about HP Lovecraft, a conference or event about him?....I have a strong feeling that I can do the project better and faster than other people can….

For some reason a hit man is coming to our house to kill us….I see him walk around the house casually, below the stairs outside my study….I realize he is checking out the house, planning how he will do it….I tell Bud and Ron what is happening….I suddenly realize the hit man is going to a pool to swim before coming after us….That is part of his weird preparation for killing….I tell them to lock all the doors and get weapons, and meet me at the bottom of the hall stairs….It seems I’m just wearing a white towel around my waist, I have just gotten out of the shower?....I look in my study for guns, I know I have at least a couple in the closets, with a few bullets….But I cannot find them….What will we do?....I see shiny silver and metal knives in my closets, but those will not be enough to help us….

“By Boat” I am with a woman that I love. I love her so that when I look at her I look at every inch of her face to take it all in. I want to protect her. Suddenly we are separated by boat. I am in a lovely river boat with paddle wheels on the river. But the boat seems to be getting smaller and smaller reduced eventually to a boat using oars. I am trying to get home. This home is a place I know from dreams. It is a home in the country beyond an apple orchard in a valley. I know every path along the edges, through other farms, and in between forests that get to this place. And in other dreams I have also seen the routes as if from an aerial view. I KNOW this place. Yet, I have misunderstood where I am and have traveled too far down river. I am way past where I need to be. I start to back track in the water, I can see the sternwheeler again and again as I trek upriver. Some men are in a boat coming by, they say I can get on their boat but it’s skinny and narrow, too skinny and narrow and my things will get wet. I opt to say no.
Some kind of political campaign is going on….Lame, incompetent people are managing it, I try to cover for the bad work of a guy and a woman, who are flirting when they should not be….
I am planning something people, and other people see my schedule and assume I set it up to maximize my power, but I know it was actually a random process….
A puddle of water is on the kitchen floor….It is bigger, more extensive than I initially thought it was….Other people are sitting at the table watching me as I clean it up….

I am running down a hill, like coming into Olema….a car passes going up the hill, and the driver does something obnoxious and mean….It makes me mad….I yell and flip him off….I see the car slow down and stop….I wonder, will he turn around and come back to fight me?....I think of running down and to the right, where I know a police station is….At another point, in my study I see a big guy on a motorcycle come into our driveway….he is dressed in black leather….I am scared, and I look for a phone to call 911, without being seen….but I cannot find a phone….now what do I do?....

Everyone wants to plant a tree along with other ones, but I am worried the root system of the other trees will be too tough….I look at the thick tangle of dark brown roots and wonder, will it harm them to plant a bunch of new trees in there?....Then, we hear there is a black bear outside….I see a door open in the house….I wonder, did the bear get in?....No, it turns out to be the cats going into an old room and getting into a dark cabinet….I get them out….But then outside I see the bear….I tell my wife to look….The bear is climbing a tree, I see it go up into the branches….it has a long black tail, like a dog?....that seems strange….

Everyone is worried about how the last writing, book, or piece of text will show my wife in a bad way….Everyone is looking around to find it….I, however, am not worried….I know the last writing is not bad, and there is no need for concern….

People are worried about the consequences of something, but not me….a change we are making will disrupt things….it will affect animals….then, ahead on a trail, a mountain lion steps out from the right….tan, big, majestic….I am amazed….It is a good sign of the changes to come?....although we have to be careful, the lion is a dangerous animal….

I am with someone, and we see Adolph Hitler walking ahead of us….coming onto the road from the right….I have a rifle, a good one, and I want to shoot him right away, but I do not have a good enough angle on him….We pursue him, running off to the left, trying to intercept him at another place….as we go I look for a better rifle….

I am going outside with the cats, Levi and Strauss….For some reason Strauss jumps into a pool, chasing after something to catch it….I help him get out, because it is dangerous for him….But then he chases after something else, going down into a toilet….Oh no, I am surprised and worried, I have no idea how I will get him out of the pipes….This could be very bad for him….
Something about Lucrecia and a newspaper….I am laying out a newspaper properly, to make a modern argument?....

Andy and April from the television show Parks and Recreation post something about me on social media….on facebook and other internet sites….They do not get the information right, so I need to correct it somehow….But it is getting lots of attention, so that is good, I am happy about that….
“Going to the hospital to lose buddy for Christmas”
Something about two old people being mistreated….It has to do with two straws or tubes being used to bother them?....But it is okay, I am helping them, I will help figure it out for them….

“Smooth Sailing” I am standing outside of big house on the front stoop. I am waiting for someone. Next I am riding in a car, a silver Rolls Royce. We are driving down a street of water. I am in the front of the car in what is like a rumble seat. Tater is curled up on the seat next to me. I extend my legs out in front of me and put my feet gently to the surface of the water. My heels delicately skimming as we drive along. My last thought is whether I am being aerodynamic.

“The Tall Man” I am in the bathtub and waiting for my boyfriend to come in. He knocks on the door and comes in. I was excited, I had a big smile on my face and so did he. He got in but it was not very comfortable, we leaned away from eachother. I wrapped my arm around him to get water on his back but I couldn’t reach. He was leaning away and it was awkward. Then I am standing in a shower looking out a window to a campus with tall trees and grass. There are people milling around. I see someone I know. They are with a very tall man. A breast and head and shoulder above everyone else. I felt bad for him. He is having a hard time communicating overall because of his height. He would lean down but my feeling is that he didn’t catch half of what was being said and was tired of asking.

“Opossums” It was a thick, pretty, older rug with patterns of brown. I am walking across it with Tater and as we do there is a small area that starts to wiggle. I say,”Tater, look!” He runs over just as opossums start to come out. Then the opossum shrieks, Tater shrieked, and then I shrieked. I feel happy and silly about this!

April is helping me set up some papers….She is not into what I am doing, but she still helps….At some point I jump off a big drop off or cement ledge….Miraculously I am fine, and someone else is about to try….At some point I come up to my wife, and point to her left….There is an image of me down in the water, which has some kind of romantic quality….

“Oasis” I am driving fast on the freeway in the hills of northern California. It’s beautiful and the light is spectacular, twilight I come up on a car driving beside me pushing in front of it, as if on a trailer, an oasis! A bunch of desert plants, palm trees, old signs, statues of frogs and many things. It was made more fantastic against the back drop of the scenery. It belonged to a musician….”I thought I found love but now I have…..?” A pond? A garden? It implied that a person had settled down and bought a bunch of things only to find out they didn’t want that. All she wanted was the garden, or an oasis, not the other stuff.

Something about an ax, learning to use it well….another thing about two people who had been practicing for a conference presentation, suddenly they are leaving….We are surprised….it turns out they were trying to scamming us all along….

I am trying to set up something….it takes so many times to get it right….but eventually I do….Then, something about my father-in-law, I am behind him, helping him with something….His shirt is off, and I am careful not to touch him near his side bulge….

“David” It was easy to contact him but I can’t explain how I did it. His name is David. He is the best spiritual advisor. I wait for him in a public place like a bar and when he comes he sits away from me. Our energy together creates a wobble.

“Slo-mo” It was a small town with a bar on one side. As I go past I see the dog, it’s the dog that hangs out in the bar and occasionally wonders off across the street. I see him slo-mo walkin’ back. Many snippets this night……lots of dust in these dreams, I huffed a lot of dust.

I am walking in a canyon area….Up above me and to the right I see in the cliffs two big cats….Scared, I run back and tell people to be careful….Then I see an overview of the neighborhood yards, like I’m above in the air looking down….I see our cats Levi and Strauss coming back home, but I can see other cats and a dog in the area, making it harder for our cats to take the route they want to take….I wonder, how will they make it?....Then, later, I am watching an “Entourage” show, and suddenly there is a brief image of a guy on top of Vinnie, face down, having sex; it’s surprising, and I wonder if that’s the dramatic point….I am watching with Ron, sitting on a couch to my right, and laughing with embarrassment at this very inappropriate scene I try to cover Ron’s eyes….
As part of a longer thing, I get to three stages of sexual positions with my wife….I’m laying on my back on our bed, and she comes and lays down on top of me….the erotic sensation is super intense….
I am about to give a talk or make a pitch about dreams, and I hear a supervisor tell other people to get ready for my request, which they may or may not fulfill….
Some kind of intrigue is happening….a guy is in a classroom….I am helping him?....

“All I want” All I want to do is get the horses. It would be so fast; I would grab a bridal and go! There are many of them in the pine trees below. In my mind’s eye I can see them very clearly, glancing from one horse color to another. But my time is difficult and tumultuous. Old west and many people. Things to get done but also to run from. I know there are dogs but I can’t see them. The thought of getting to the horses is my salvation and the ease against the turmoil.
Something about Fern’s graduation….A speech….something will be relaxed?....We are awaiting….

Some kind of text analysis program tracks all of the conversations I am having with people….Every time someone says a question, the program asks if it heard and understood the question accurately….it is interesting, but a little annoying and intrusive….

“Cinder is a Sleed” Angelina Jolie, Dave, and I went camping in my trailer. It was a wonderful time; a lot of questions. Then I know that I left my trailer behind…by accident? It was in the woods in a gulch. Angelina wanted to explore, she wanted to see things and talk to people. She wanted to stop in every small town and talk to every small business person. No one seemed to recognize her. She was an ordinary person; worried about her kids, worried about money, yet she was in no hurry to get home. We stopped in a neighborhood, hick and western. A young boy in a stunt dropped himself from 28ft. We started talking to people in the crowd. The more we talked and the more we told our story the more discombobulated things got. It started to seem like people thought we were snobbish. Angelina just wanted to stay there. But the rawness of the people turned into aggressive behavior against us. They thought we were lying and that we had ulterior motives for being there. Then we are in a bar having a heated discussion about things when suddenly all of them drew their guns. “Why are we sittin’ here?!” they said. Angelina just started walking towards them. She had written a poem, “Cinder is a sleed”, and it meant the sleaziness of people. She walked towards them reciting the poem. She had guns but she wasn’t using them. I saw her getting shot over and over again in a hail of gunfire. I was thinking about her kids but……I don’t know if she was.

I am in a house, and bad guys are coming….I find various ways to avoid them, but it is a constant threat….Then, I see my wife in a black sheer blouse….She climbs over a couch to sit down, with other people around….I am aroused by the sight of her breasts under the blouse….Later, I am going some place and I come to a long steep rocky slide area….with no hesitation I go out and slide several hundred feet down to a lower road….A little later I go by an old tree….I remember talking to the woman who is our arborist, saying there was a bird’s nest with chicks in a tree like that….I see the birds scurrying on the ground, and I tell my wife to take a look, they are pretty and cute….Although I am worried they are in danger from other creatures who might attack them on the ground….
I am working with some other people on getting wolves taken better care of?....an old guy in a wheelchair is there, we both want to do it….

I am going running, as is someone else….From our house, and I figure why not go for a long one, maybe 5 miles?....I go get high to prepare….When I go out, other people know I have gotten high….I feel awkward around them….Then when I get outside, it is weird and difficult to get to the trails….I have to go through a city, through streets, traffic….at one point it is like I am standing at the corner of Solano and San Pablo in Albany?....I finally get out to the trails, and up into a mountain area….I find a box of stuff on the trail, and for some reason I have to carry it somewhere?....I get in a car, and the guy driving downhill is distracted….I say be more careful on the turns….Later, something about President Obama….I am in a hotel room near him, within his security perimeter….He is in a good mood….I wonder about his safety….

I am dealing with some big guy….He is hostile toward me, but I manage to persuade him to cooperate with me….At some point I am in a house, and I see bees have gotten into a room….I close the door, trying to keep them from getting into the rest of the house….one of the bees gets into the nearby bathroom, and I close that door too….Then I am with a woman at that house, we are sleeping….a knock at the door, and I have to quickly get out of bed and put on my clothes to deal with the delivery guys outside….

I am standing in a field by a fence….lots of little animals are around….cats among them….then a big white dog, like a Labrador, comes over and all the other animals scatter and hide in fear….the dog comes to greet me, big and happy, and I pet it but I am upset it came and disrupted everything else….at another point I am driving around a corner on a hilly road….Some kind of accident or impediment slows traffic….I get around it, and keep going up….I make sure people behind can keep going up too….my friends?....

I see bad guys in the house across the street….The Olsons in Kensington….I shoot a gun at them, fight, try to make them go away….But they are attacking us, and they keep coming, so we have to flee….I run back across the street to our house (which is in the position of Ari’s house, two doors up the street from us)….I tell people to gather their things quickly, whatever they need to bring, and to do it fast….I wonder about the cats, how we will take them….But no one will listen to me, it is frustrating….No one goes as fast or takes it as seriously as I do….

A bunch of animals get loose outside….our cats, and birds that apparently are also our pets….People have left the doors open, and the animals have gotten out….I have to chase them down….None of them get away, but I am frustrated that the people were careless about the doors….

I am in a small boat….The driver guides it so it turns and comes ashore at a beach….a resort area….I am unsure if we are picking people up or if the boat is dropping us off….Then, I am running, with a bunch of guys on a trail….we go around a turn, up some wooden stairs….There will be a race on this route soon, I wonder if these guys are going to run in it?....

“Trish” I was trying to explain about a woman named Trish. The person who let Trish live in their house was attracted to Trish because she had those qualities which were attractive to that person. Those qualities were-she was a craft person. I remember a train track in a hollow and a mailbox outside an adobe house with a beautiful sculpture above it of the mother. A flash of changing my clothes and a lot of people.

I am with my daughter, she sits down for some interview or business process….It seems well managed….then we are on a large ship, standing at the back on the deck….Suddenly a huge wave looms up ahead and crashes down on top of the ship, breaking it in half….We are plunged into the water, and as we sink down I see the broken ship above, sinking down too….We have to swim out and away from the ship, then up to the surface….I wonder if maybe we should take off some clothes, like our jackets, so it is easier to swim?....

“The bluebird” I am with a couple on vacation, a tour. We have done a lot of things but we don’t necessarily get along. We are in a little room, a kitchen, in Mexico. I have turned on the dishwasher, it’s small, plastic, and I can see its heart pumping. The kitchen is in a closed restaurant. Suddenly I hear a tapping on glass. When I look I see a tank of water, as if which to hold lobster but when I look inside I see a blue bird, a swallow. It’s trapped under water in the tank. In my mind’s eye I see it as tapping with a finger. I run over, open the door yet instead of the bird coming out a walrus/hippo comes out. I know right away it’s going to be a total pain to get it back in. It’s crawling across the floor with other companions. The bird is still trapped but it is conveying to me that it will be ready next time I open the door. It sees my hand coming and swims toward the door through the water like a dart and then wiggles in preparation and when I open the door it shoots out. I anticipate and wonder what it is like to fly underwater. The utilities in the kitchen are strange. We have already been many places and to other countries. There are many quaint and archaic systems for running water and getting soap. The toiletries cabinet is amazing; small wood boxes and secret compartments. I accidently spill urine out of a box in an old commode. The four of us had arrived at this place with relief as if we had escaped something. And there is still something not right, there is ownership or manipulation. Then I realize I’m late! I’m late to a competition in which my partner is reciting a poem. I hear him saying, “And the man………….” He had written an argument as to why something is one way. I felt bad for not being there.

Lots of people are around….I am driving along a road that comes to a place where water is covering it….lots of rocks and boulders in the water….Other cars have made it through, and I guess my car can too, but I worry the water might be high enough to get into the engine….It is about two or three feet deep at one point, like the road crosses a creek….At another point, other things happening, and I happen to see a little crab scurrying away toward a book case….I try to catch so I can help it get outside to safety….but it is too fast and gets under the book case….we seem to be near the ocean, so I figure that is why a crab could have gotten inside like this….

I am with some people at the sea shore….Suddenly I look up and a huge wave is towering above us, about to crash….it is too late to run away, or even to warn the others….So I decide to step forward, up to the edge of the wave, thinking maybe that will be a safer place when the water washes over me….But then the wave seems to pause, suspended in position about to hit….I wonder, now what is going to happen?....

I am supposed to give a talk, like at a graduation….but then I do not have to do it….others give talks, like Jones….I have mixed feelings of relief, envy, and disappointment….I watch as the others are told what to do….Then I am walking up some stairs….I am carrying something….I go up the stairs lightly, quicker than the other people, which makes me happy….At some point I am walking on our street outside the gate….Other people are around, including children….It is Halloween?....People are trick-or-treating….Oh, I wish I had a kid, we could participate in the fun….At another point I see Ron in formal wear clothing….A nice white shirt….He then turns around and I see he is in a tuxedo, with black jacket and tie….
I am with lots of people in waiting rooms….trying to figure out what is next to do….Lots of wasted time….

A woman news reporter is waiting for the results of something, or an interview with someone….She is excited and expectant….But no one comes….I am concerned for her, and I start to wonder, is she being tricked?....
Lots of wealthy people are lining up for some kind of service….The process is taking longer than they expect….

Outside someplace, I somehow become friendly with a huge brown bear….It is like a city area, buildings and streets….as the bear ambles around I wonder if it is going to be dangerous, or playful….I worry a car will hit the bear as it crosses the street, so I go help get it back over to this side….Later, a bunch of people involved in movie making….It is like they are playing a game that comes through our place or apartment….they are playing a blind tag game….a girl comes over in an empty area, with a blindfold over her eyes….she stubs her toe on something on the ground….I wonder, will she figure out how to get out again?....then they go out, and I hit them all with pillows, still as a game, but hard, to keep them out….
We and some other people are excited about the delivery of new tractors….shiny black metal ones….it is fun equipment and machinery to have, learn how to use….
In a tan grassy area, I’m looking amid all the tangled stalks of grass….A tarantula suddenly takes form and comes at me….I fall back in fear and alarm….

I am up on a balcony at our Kensington house….I see a woman below, in her house….I do not want to be seen, so I lie down flat on the balcony….Then I walk around three black boys playing baseball in the driveway….Then I want to go around Fern’s room, but a pool of water outside blocks the way….so I step up on her window, and climb around….But then I see she is in bed looking at me….I apologize….Later, someone and I are holding a bad guy….the other guy puts white powder on the bad guy’s neck that will knock him out in 90 seconds….I wonder if it will work….

I am with people in a café in Portland….Lots of other people are around….A guy starts talking to me, I do not like him, I am suspicious of his motives?....we get up to go, and so does he, and then I realize our white jacket (my wife’s? a woman’s jacket?) is gone, they must have stolen it….I get angry, at some point I try to remember what street the café was on….Not Burnside, but the next one over, Couch….Then I am chasing some people, trying to figure out some intrigue in a house….I suddenly find a secret room, and there is an older woman, like the mom of one of the daughters I am seeking….This is a surprise, and solves the mystery: they have been plotting in this room….

I am playing Frisbee on a beach with some people….lots of sand all around….As the disc is thrown to me I lose track of it as I see birds flying in the sky….An eagle?.... Then I am going into a forest, and Lightning our cat is there….Like we are exploring together….But ahead is a guy with a dog….Oh oh, I am worried Lightning will run into the trees to hide, and I will have a hard time finding her….I am irked at the guy with the dog….then, something about little kids, lots of them at a school….I am nice to them as they play….At some point they start to act weird….Like they are possessed….They start building something together….Other adults are scared, but not me….I stay connected to them….At one point I say something, and they all repeat it in a weird chant, with wide eyes….Then the structure they are building starts to collapse, fall down, and the spell breaks….Then they are all in a bus, driving away, and I say goodbye affectionately….They wave in a friendly way to me as they go….At another point, I cross a street to a couple of people who are handing out flyers, orange papers with some “technical” information….I read it, it says Vito was killed in Zimbabwe, at the age of 37….I am shocked, and sad….I crouch down and cry for a long time….I try to imagine what might have happened, how he was killed….a riot, when he was a tourist?....Then, I am driving in a car up to a check point, and I tell the small Asian man who is guard that I am going where I usually go….I have passed by him several times, so we recognize each other….I am friendly, but he curtly says “Go home”….Like he is angry and sick of dealing with me….

“3 days” I was sitting next to Mark, we tried to interweave our legs but nothing really worked. One was stretched out too far, it just wasn’t working. Mt. St. Helens is going to blow; wefts of smoke are coming out of it. But I hear on the news that it would still be 3 days until it erupts.
Something about the numbers 7, and 4 + 40….Like two programs that people set up….A thing involving 7, and another with 4 + 40 things?....
After our trip, a complex process of loading and unloading our stuff….Someone is trying to take advantage of us, moving his things before ours….A wooden post is centrally stuck in the ground….

I am in a city like New York, with dad and my brother….they go off after we are done with something, and I lose sight of them in the crowd….oh well, I figure we will meet back at home, getting there via our separate ways….But then dad finds me, and we go together….Then, at some other point I am walking with, or rather escorting, a young woman in an emerald green dress, like an evening gown….She is young, with short dark hair….I am one of her escorts….She is an important person, has special powers of some kind….she is in the midst of an important mission, and I am helping her with it….

“The Wizard of Oz” I was at the shipyard and it was dusty! As if apocalyptic there is machinery in disrepair, boats out of water, it looks like an old carnival scene. I saw a lot of people but I’m not interacting with them. I walked toward a shed and see some belongings that I had left behind. I see some blankets folded up along the backside of the shed and I grab a red blanket even though I knew I had given it away. Behind me are several girls sitting. I said to one, “Let me see your teeth.” They were dirty, I say that it’s okay but “You need to floss and brush!” Then one of the girls says, “Chyrese, this book you gave me is SO GREAT!” I see it is titled the Wizard of Oz. When she opens the pages I see they are laminated, thick plastic and yellow pages, each of a map. Each is like a territory or section of a larger map and on each page there are two tiny cowboys on horses as if running across the page together. They are animated but look as if they are collaged on. They are galloping, kicking up little bits of dust behind them waving their hats.

Something about a Spanish family, I am observing them as they go through their lives….I can see good things happening, positive forces from outside lining up to influence, support them….it is kind of a magical process, and I feel I can perceive how it is working….

Lots of signs in Spanish….I see them….Marking different towns, places….At another point I watch a music band get ready to play….There are big gym pads, like for gymnastics, in the way of their instruments….The drummers will use the pads for drums, improvising with the situation?....Other musicians try to play with all the pads around them, but it will not work….

I am watching a movie or tv show in a viewing room with a small crowd….it’s not an entertaining show, more of a teaching or educational video?....It is like I have already seen it, so I go….But I want to talk to the lead person….So I go over into the living room area, and listen while someone else talks to that person….At another point, I am going up into some huge building under construction….As I go higher and higher up, I realize I am very scared of heights….It is like skyscraper in a city, and this is the tallest building of all….I wonder, how will I get down?....I realize I will have to climb….

I am driving with someone on a small street toward Sir Francis Drake Boulevard….Oh oh, I see no cars at all going on the street, then I see why….Lots of cars are stuck at a previous intersection….several police cars with blue and red lights flashing are directing traffic away from the street where I am about to enter….I wonder, what is my strategy for driving here?....
A guy is standing outside, in the rain….I see him in front of a big wooden structure, like a set of wings?....like a banner or emblem, made of big pieces of wood….

In some city or mall area….I go with dad and another guy….into a sidewalk that’s about waist deep in water….Wait, I realize I am naked, which is fine while going in the water but what will I do when I get to our destination?....I have to get out of the water, go back the way we came to get some clothes….I ask dad what he will do with his cell phone as he goes through the water?....He has a shoulder bag he will put it into….At some point I see Ruth it is a surprise….At another point I am at a restaurant outside, and I go get some things I left there….I go by some black boys sitting at a park bench, and I offer them some cookies to eat….
“4 dogs” I had 4 dogs and a vanagon. It was a total disaster! If anyone looked in the windows they would see 4 dogs and a bunch of STUFF! They would judge.
Something about cars, seeing one elevated a foot off the ground, magically, like at a car show?....other people are around….
Lots of fragments….People trying to lay something out, but just in pieces….An ethnic woman is doing well in a business setting?....my wife takes note of her, approves of her work….
Something about a plan, work to be done?....A woman is behind it, but I expect that actually nothing will happen?....

“Werewolf Disease“ I had 2 dogs and I had to put both of them down. I had to shoot them. They had gotten parvo virus and they were trying to eat me. I was at the beach but it seemed more like a sandy side channel on a river. I have a friend there who was helping me; I think he had given me the gun. I was telling everyone, “You can’t go near my dogs!” They were more like werewolves; after dusk no one could be around them. I remember holding their neck down so that when they were in a crazy state they would be calm and not hurt anyone. They were difficult to be around so I had to shoot them. One was Ollie and one was a short haired pit-bull. Everyone was sorry for my loss but no one really understood what the disease was. During the day they were just normal dogs but at night they became a monster. A person couldn’t live like that. It seemed like not long before I had had to put Tater to sleep. And everyone was so sorry about that. I couldn’t believe this was happening. Part of me thought that I would be relieved after they were gone because the disease had been so difficult to live with. But I was so sad and upset….I woke up sobbing.
Something about gravel….trying to move it around with a special tool or shovel, with a curved metal bar on it….

Lots of people want me to do things at the ranch, in the valley….I do not want to, even though what they are asking seems benign, harmless….I have an image of several people standing in special places, and I am supposed to pick them so we can be more together?....I am not into it, do not want to participate….
We are trying to get going on making improvements in the valley….deciding how much old stuff to keep down there, and how much to get rid of….Several people are helping us in the process….

Something about a person in white pants doing something….I am pretty sure the pants will get dirty….At some point I am driving the family up a strange staircase by a house….the road turned into a steep stairway, and it is obviously impossible to go up it in a car, but I start trying….At another point I am in a room shared with two women, like a dorm….I have to get out now, it is their turn to be in there….

There is a central person in a home network, and everyone goes to that person for help and guidance in dealing with situations….at some point I become that person….like I am growing up?....at another point, Murdoch is usually in that role, and now it is Bud….
Someone else’s hair….is it a problem?....the hair is blond….will, or should, it be cut?....no, apparently not….
Lots of people are doing things that take a long time….They slow me down, I am frustrated….I want to get past these people, but I cannot….

I am pitching baseball to some people in a courtyard of a house….I am throwing a tennis ball….The first guy batting, an African-American, hits the ball well….He runs to second base before I can stop him….I tell him go on, run to home and score a run, I do not want to worry about you on the bases….It is a bold move by me to say that….Then Fern is batting, and she hits it to the right side….I am the only fielder, so she gets on base….I say this is not really a baseball game, with no fielders, just me pitching….we are just playing around….Now a big guy comes up to bat….He was here before, but he was too early?....I tease him about it….Now you are on time to bat, I say….Before: I am with someone driving a car over a low cement bridge, with water washing over it on both sides….It seems too dangerous to me to drive over, with so much water….But people are doing it, so it must be ok….

I am a servant of some kind….I go to a guy in private and say my person wants to propose some political measure, but I do not agree with it….I think rich people like my boss have enough already….I whisper this to him so others will not here….

“The Forest of Non existence” I have it in my mind I am in the forest of non existence. I am an entity at first alone. It’s a forest of very tall wispy trees, a tall slender forest. I can smell the sulfur from the heat. It is hot. It’s not the trees it’s the environment. My lesson is to learn to survive here. I can escape the heat by becoming a creature or seeking refuge in a tree as if I can become a creature or a tree. I cannot see myself I only know I can change; I am a little girl and I walk into the tree but not into a separate place. Soon I am growing and the land becomes ice. It’s taboo. It is all frozen. There are tremendous mountains and these are my new path. I walk a great distance. It’s frozen to the core of all things. At last there is a cottage; a lone cottage on this white snowy mountainside deep within. I know that here waiting for me is a bowl of hot soup. I also know it is not the destiny I follow. I will stay outside. It isn’t that I feel stoic about denying myself this pleasure. Moreover I understand what is implied by NOT having it. In the end I find myself escaping back into a tree.

“The Art Studio” I was in an art studio, maybe on the second floor, very rustic. I am in a different country? A man invites me into his studio. There are other people there maybe showing their art? A gallery? The studio is lovely and homey. I am going through some old newspapers and see an article in which a musician has died. But the picture is of Sam Rockwell. Did Sam play this musician in a movie? Eventually I sit down with some people and chat. Then the man of the studio comes over to me and asks, “Why don’t you bring your books up here and read them?” I said I just wouldn’t do that, I don’t really know why. But then it seems like I’m there because he had invited me to come. I feel warm.
A small glass vase has a flower in it….I see on the other side of the flower some mold….Hmm, I think to myself, that is not good….the time has come to throw it out….

Something about a theater, different aspects of it….each one has some element of me?....at some point I am getting ready to play a football game….I take the ball we are going to play with, and hold it in my hands….the ball is a little under-inflated, which makes it easier to grip….at the end I am in the back seat of a car, and a bunch of guys come out of a hockey game and pile in….a big guy sits next to me….It is his car….I compliment him, say it is a nice car….

I walk by dad, and I fling a letter at him….it hits him in the neck….We start to argue about something….Later, I get into a dispute with people down in the valley….some of the people are on my side, and some of them are on the other side….

“The Velvet Chair” I am making a chair for Jim. Not a wood chair, just a chair, a red velvet chair. He knew I was going to finish it like that, he says, “Here, put this on it.” I said,” Why don’t you want the chair that I’m going to make?” “No”, he says, “I’m so used to getting screwed over by people that I would just rather it not be that way.” I decided there would be no point in explaining. I wanted to ask if that is what Thich Nhat Hahn would say, or something that might jostle him out of his position, but I knew he was just that way.

“Two Kittens” I met Mark in a huge desert-like place. Something bad had happened. There was something in the background, in the past; I had accidentally killed my boyfriend, or he had accidentally died. I had left him alone with no water. A taboo subject BUT….I hadn’t done the deed. Later I discover it was actually two kittens that had the accident, yet they were okay! I was worried that they were dehydrated but they took off to go play. I see a barn-like structure…..painted pale white. There are nice deep colors in a deserty mad max kinda style, but hard ground like an empty quarry.
I see a reference to Fern’s boyfriend….I read his name on something, like a typewriter key….Then, Fern or someone else is doing laundry?....
I buy things at a store, and the bill is $700….that seems like a lot….But is it enough stuff?....

I am down in the valley, with a pillow and bare feet….hmmm, I wonder, that will make it hard to run around….although I realize I have been doing ok so far with bare feet….Then I go into a neighbor’s yard, and try to find a short cut through a shed, down and out of their yard….But it leads back to a house, and the woman is out there who owns it….an Asian woman….I think of going out and admitting what I am doing, but I am concerned she will be surprised and angry when she sees me….So I stay put, and she eventually leaves….Earlier, we have a nice long brown woven wool coat….I touch the fabric, and I am impressed by its feel….also, we have a box of the most beautiful ripe red strawberries I have ever seen….Everyone goes by the box and pops one of the fruits into their mouths….

“200 bucks and a date” I had been given a till to put in the bank from a business owned by some women friends. I decided to steal 2 100 dollar bills, yet, when I pulled the bills out I was pretty sure they would disappear; immediately evaporate because they could not be used twice. At the same time I am going on a date. I don’t like him; he’s not with the program, out of it, in his own head. He walked away a few times and I said, “Okay…..bye”. And he would come back and say sorry but he wasn’t sorry. He would just wander back as if he didn’t know he’d wandered off. There is a song playing in a restaurant, Nirvana’s heart shaped box; “Hey wait, I’ve got a new complaint”. The song reveals that someone is in possession of a surf board. Everyone is trying to claim that the surf board is theirs and my date says mater of factly,” You know….That guy has my surf board”. I guess he could have been telling the truth but I was thinking,”Tsa, everybody thinks that”.
Different groups are working on their version of the wall….it is going well, but the groups are competitive in their efforts….Everyone is making adjustments, trying to get it right….

Different people are doing things for the filming….all in a row….it is good work….I am showing people a place along a river or creek where people used to surf….but now the water level is so low, there are no waves, it is like a small channel leading to the shore by some rocks….At some point I am flying, coming in for a landing….I am wondering if I should take off again….

Many flashes of sorting dreams; I was told that I don’t need such precision to enter the Akashic field. Chickens! Blasted chickens! Blue Dog is too sick to get up. And all the while Tater is sitting to one side in the field or frame of my dream time, the left.
I am crossing a tall, long bridge over water….Looking to my right inland, where I can see the people I am with, they are doing things….I am taking a break?....

I see a big stack of white papers, on the floor behind a chair….later, I go down a hill road while lots of men on bikes ride fast up the hill….I have to get off the road to the left so I don’t get hit….

I see a long line of people, waiting for something….some of the women are in evening gowns, blue in color, long and attractive….I am standing apart from them, and I feel glad not to be in that line….the people seem anxious, or concerned to make sure they stay in the line….

my wife drives a blue car away from me….we are going the same place, but I am going to walk or run there….I start, and a car turning right at a street corner almost hits me….I run past the car while it waits for me, then I run down the street toward the coast and the water….Running feels good, but I wonder if I will be sweaty when I get to our destination….I realize I am wearing gray jeans and a maroon red long sleeve shirt….I wonder if I should go back to get a short sleeve shirt, but I decide that would take too long and would not even be that much better from a sweating perspective….

A young woman is involved with something with a plane, as am I….she takes my spot on the plane, or I take hers, on a short, local flight….It is a nice thing for her to do, and I am grateful….Afterwards, we become friendly….We spend more time together than expected….

I am working with lots of people on a film project….trying to get everyone organized, set in motion….lots of weird people, but all aiming at the same goal….Then, I am in an airplane, coming in for a landing….we are flying too low, lower than on a normal safe landing….I worry and wonder, will we crash and skid on the ground?....Then, I am sitting at a table, in a restaurant, waiting for someone to join me….Suddenly lots of people come, my whole family, Ron….they all walk into the restaurant, and I am surprised to see them all, I thought I was just going to be with one other person….

“Love” I had hugged this man, though younger than I, in a warm embrace. He was familiar to me and we had been friends for a long time. Against my hip I can feel his erection. A change came over him. He looked at me with a surprised expression. He lifted my face to kiss me. I didn’t feel excitement as much as warmth. We kissed and it wasn’t perfect as much as it was genuine. He was tall. We stayed close for the rest of the dream.

I am trying to get some people to coordinate, get to a filming location….An African-American guy is part of the crew….He is friendly, but late, and not right for the role….I wonder, can we improvise? Make use of something we can actually film now?....yes, we can….

Three women are doing something for me, but a mean guy somehow gets control over us, and makes them do what he wants….I cannot stop it….It is frustrating to me….There are weird sexual things involved, that is what he wants….

We are having some important people over for dinner, and we are trying to get things nice….Everyone is in tuxedos, formal wear?....Something about lemons….I see a lemon tree, and cutting one of the lemons in half?....yellow and white inside….

Something about me having a shotgun….I am carrying it around, not to threaten anyone, but just because….It feels familiar in my hands….Later, I am with some people, and we go up into a tower….I am scared of heights, but once we get up there I am fine….It is like an ocean vista….I see the Statue of Liberty?....the open elevator carrying us up says how much it weighs, 328 tons, more than King Kong….wow, I am impressed, that is an amazing weight….later I feel more comfortable being up on a high rooftop, and I have to remind myself to be careful not to slip and fall….

“The Deer” I saw a deer walking towards me. I stood still. There is someone next to me and someone next to the deer, an animal. It walked towards me, our eyes locked the whole while. I felt warm and very calm.

Confusion, frustration around pillows, which seem like solid blocks, hard to move around, work with….Then, an event at our house….I see lots of people in my study….oh oh, I’m surprised and worried….I like them looking at all my books, but not my plums….I go in, see that plums are out, my storage closet is open, and someone has rummaged through it, made a big mess….I am upset people have messed up my things….At some point I am pushing a canoe with someone in it through water….Shirley, the character from “Community”?....I have fins on my feet, so I can go fast….I am happy about that….At some point I get out of the water, and look down a cement hallway….I see some homeless people camped there….I quickly turn back, realizing this is not a place I want to go….They laugh at me, as I am wearing nothing but a red Stanford bathing suit….I am embarrassed….At another point I see from overhead Shirley try to get on a fast moving vehicle….It is dangerous, she almost falls….I see her high heel shoes, she should not be trying such a difficult maneuver while wearing shoes like those….But she does successfully make it on the vehicle, so it turns out ok….

“The Family” I want to say it’s Moscow. And there has been either a friend of mine or someone that I am connected with that has lived in and protected a very old building. I don’t know much about this but I do know that as the fall of the town comes…..he’s let his guard down. And it doesn’t seem important anymore to protect the building and the grounds without showing the people if it’s appropriate, the absolute beauty of it. I went inside the building, it’s built of stone and it’s majestic. In the center is a turret made of glass and just outside it above is a windmill like feature; blades that spin around. Shaped more like a boat propeller. As it turns it faces down, faces into the glass. When you’re inside and look up you can see the blades and every time it turns it scoops up the earth. This is one of the aspects that is so beautiful, that you can see the dirt. And as it rotates slowly the earth falls off and tumbles down the glass. It’s really a wonder to see it. Outside the grounds around the building are covered in flat stones and in each one is a keystone; each flag stone has a circle in it. Like a core sample drilled out and then replaced.

Some people were supposed to come at the end, but I stopped them so I could finish….Other people are surprised I made such a bold move….I did not like them, they screwed up something before, so I was justified in my action….

I am playing baseball with other people….I am running the bases on a hit, and I come around to home and score….another guy is behind me, running from second to third base….The little white ball bounces away from the shortstop, and the runner rounds third and sprints home so fast he’s safe….We high-five in celebration….I say dude, you were going so fast!....that was amazing….I say it again when we get into the dugout with the other players….

Somehow Donald Trump has a claim to some part of the ranch….We get there, and he wants to fix it up, make changes….I am surprised, and not willing to make those changes….But I am intrigued by what he is trying to do….At another point: I am climbing a ladder, and someone takes a shot at me with a gun….I duck down, the bullet misses….another guy tries to shoot me….I wonder why?....I get up to safety….Then, later a helicopter is trying to take pictures of me and my wife in a hotel room in a tall skyscraper….they must think we are celebrities, but we are not famous….Down the street, I see lots of protestors….like a clear divide between the privileged elite and the angry masses….At one point I am with a girl, a young woman in her twenties maybe, sitting next to her….our fingers touch and slightly intertwine….she smiles, we become friends….

A woman does not look good….she has not been eating?....her face is pale, ashen, gray in color….Is it Fulda?....At another point I see an outbox of work papers, etc. destined for China….There are too many papers to fit, the box is overly full….Somehow this is part of Mira's job at Netflix?....

Something about Blake Griffin, the basketball player….showing him the valley….but how to stay on the regular trails, that is the challenge….he keeps wandering off?....The, I see people arguing in a parking lot….hmm, I want to get away from this place, there’s a bad vibe here….I do not want to get caught up in the negativity, aggression….At one point I am at a house, there are doors open to the outside….it is nice to have the fresh air, but ice gets into the house, that is bad….Lots of people are around, too many guests, an unexpected number….I see a guy come in, he has brought three other people with him….I think of how that is one example of how the place has gotten so crowded, the problem has developed….

I am ready to use a young guy for some service, like for work out at the ranch, but my wife reminds me if I do, I will have to go with one particular service that he offered before….I thought there might be choices….Earlier, I see a guy with a sport coat and a bright green square where the central button should be….

I have been taking care of a woman in some kind of glass container?....other people do not care for her, but I do….I am trimming the bushes around her and the container….Someone says to me that I should not have cut one of the low branches I just cut, because it would have grown more and been healthy, but I stopped that….I realize with regret the person is right, I should not have cut it….

“Ropers” Ashley is explaining to me a “roper”. A roper is like a poor kid with a nap sac that follows the train tracks. In my mind I see a music video of them; a bunch of kids with their narrow pants tucked into their socks and suspenders and caps with short hair. A musician. A musician that dresses like this is a roper. Bruce was there.

I see a tall green tree, shaped like a Christmas tree, conical, and it is laden with fruit….some people want to pick the fruit right now, but I say we should wait longer to let it ripen….At another point, some guy loses a little black book with lots of names and addresses….other people are mad, they do not want the book to get out….I see written in Spanish a warning to turn it over or else….a little kid is the one making the threat….

I am with some people, we get to a place, like it’s on the ranch, with a huge old tree….I look up and see that at the top it is dead, no real living branches above….but it is still majestic, I am very impressed….lots of animals are living in it….It is a deciduous tree, I realize, not an evergreen….I look down and see lots of monkeys in the bushes around the tree….most of them are light colored, tan, but a couple are darker colored, more brown….A dark one comes at us, threatening to attack….then it goes away….I realize the dark ones are the aggressive members of the species….

“The Dancer” I had an admirer that was a beautiful dancer. He was wonderful. We danced as though on the floor of a mall, wide open and shiny. We had seen each other before but hadn’t engaged in such high quality dancing. But this time…..oh boy! Busting all the moves; tip toes, hip shakes, he could dance circles around me. I mostly watched in amazement. I can also see myself in a line of people as though it’s a human migration. We were getting together and experiencing each other, something about peace.

Someone is cooking in a kitchen….a couple of pots and other things are on the stove….a young woman is stirring the pots with a big wooden spoon….She is anxious about it all….I try to reassure her….At some other point I am running on a trail, down a hill, around a corner….I have to slow down for other people….

Something about being in the valley, people are going too fast with logs….I want them to slow down….At another point something bad happens, the police are there….I stand up, they say we have to lightly knock you on the head to make you unconscious, so we can move you….they will hit me on the back of the head….I say no, don’t do that, it’s not necessary and I do not want to get hurt….But they do it anyway….

We, my wife and I, are involved in judging some kind of contest related to the ranch….A young woman puts together a flower bouquet, and some kind of drink, a glass of water?....Her work is simple but good….she wins the contest….

“Faerie” In the beginning there is conversation, dogs, a man and his van, and a woman. I am with the woman in a grassy area. It’s like a party in the country, it’s getting dark. I think I’m having a good time but the woman and I don’t know each other really. Suddenly there are these AMAZING lights in the sky. Like glowing jellyfish all over. Then a huge faerie appeared in the sky, she swooped down and gestured her arm across the sky, there was so much detail! Then I am SO happy! I am now with 3 guys that are so familiar to me. I was remembering a memory of being with them but it hadn’t happened yet. We were playing so much; giggling and laughing, grabbing each other and wrestling around. It’s like we were intoxicated with love. I had so many memories of them. Then suddenly there is a moment of divine talking to me….asking the question…..”How many inquiries of the mother do you know?” I was having an epiphany! A charm came over all of us. But the question is a two part question…..but as soon as I tried to focus my attention on it….boink, I am squeezed out of the dream. I woke up in wrenching laughter.

Something about spilled water on a wooden floor….it was a guest, a young woman, who did it by accident….my wife and I have to clean it up….it is not a problem because it is an old, weathered floor, but we need to wipe the water up before it damages the wood any further….

Part of something where Fern is trying to get an application together….We keep getting letters, but they do not go through….In frustration I spit into a bottle of water and mix it in….That bottle is being sent to the other people….

I am looking at an old stone dagger….about a foot in length….I touch it, run my hand along the stone….At another point I sit on a rock, like the one in our yard….there is a depression in the rock where water gathers, and usually that would make it hard to sit there, but now it is fine to sit on, no water….At another point, something about an airplane, a big one….It is slowly taking off, flying low….It leaves dessert on the ground?....

“The Zoo” I am in a place like a zoo and there are dogs there. One of them was a giant wolfhound. The dogs there are helping us study other animals such as birds. But the dogs have died. It’s a great expense! They have been lured over the edge…..of the experiment area. And oh how we lament the loss! The dogs have died. Other people have sabotaged the testing. All that work to save the animals and the birds. There is a woman there who has also been pushed over the edge. Like a zoo exhibit with boulders and cliff sides. I can see her leg is folded behind her from the fall. I think she’s dead but then she lifts her head to look at her arm. There are many, many small birds on her arm. She doesn’t seem to mind, she’s letting them eat or pull stuff off of her.

I see a big pile of sticks and poles at the ranch….Hmm, I am perturbed I have to deal with that, wondering who put it there in the first place….At another point I am in some kind of race….It starts in the backyard of our Kensington house….in the back (southern) corner….People are coming through a place in the fence….then I suddenly realize I am in a race, running back to our Portland house….an old guy is behind me….I should beat him, but now I will have to run hard all the way, and I will be much more tired at the end….
A message: “Discovering that which comes into themselves…” This dream message quickly gone.

Something about two framed paintings, fairly large in size….my wife and I like them, but they have been sitting on the ground for some period of time, so that has affected their quality….They have been touching the dirt….

Something about old train tracks coming to an end point….I see the tracks set in the dark ground….At another point, I see Zach de la Rocha at a store….I say to him my wife said his band just played for fun, but I know they wanted to change the world….Zach seems to agree with me….As we talk, I fill a glass with ice….I keep filling it, much higher than the top of the glass, too much ice, it finally overflows at the end and falls to the floor….

In some house, I come out of a bedroom in the morning, my wife is still in there….I am walking naked and carrying my clothes like usual….But then I see a glimpse of the man whose house it is, he is coming out of his room….I hurry back to my room, trying to cover my nudity….he can probably see me….

“The Practice” We make dreams and play out scenarios in this house. It’s kind of old. I had just asked a woman, “Do you think this house will ever move?” She said,”Nope.” It was supposed to go somewhere and do something but it was too old and rundown but SO lovely. We played out all kinds of scenarios there. Right before the end I stuck a small green dot onto the wall………I was going to wear it later! “The Practice” We make dreams and play out scenarios in this house. It’s kind of old. I had just asked a woman, “Do you think this house will ever move?” She said,”Nope.” It was supposed to go somewhere and do something but it was too old and rundown but SO lovely. We played out all kinds of scenarios there. Right before the end I stuck a small green dot onto the wall………I was going to wear it later!

“The Pod” I had just flown up and landed on a plastic white pod on a cliff side. But there were 2 horses in it and suddenly with the 3 of us, it was unstable. One horse fell out, down a cliff, into a landscaped yard? I was able to hold on but they were not.

my wife is doing something with a flower farm….The farm is located in a mall with a Denny’s restaurant and a gas station….At some point I see a big bunch of red flowers on vines covering a piece of metal machinery, pipes….they are beautiful flowers, very vivid in color….As I look, I realize there is a romantic aspect to this….At another point, I am looking into someone’s eyes….

Some big animal, like an elephant, puts its trunk on me in a friendly way….Other people think it is showing too much interest in me, not as much to others, and they will get upset….At another point I am running on a street, I get to a car and hide by the side of the road behind it….I do not want other people to see me….earlier, someone is taking over my cell phone and using it to send text messages I do not want….the messages are about fixing up the ranch?....not my plans….

People are sitting in rows in an auditorium….Like an auction for property….People are talking about our land, what to do with it….I am glad about their enthusiasm, but I would not want anyone to do anything, like divide the land into smaller sections, without my agreement….
“Vegetarian” My mom is cooking tofu. She says, “Don’t you want some meat?” I try to explain I am a vegetarian.

A guy and his daughter apply for something….college?....at first it seems like there is a problem, and they are upset, but then it works out….Something about Skip, one of his paintings….At some point I drop a piece of gum on the ground….I kick it to the side, I do not want it to make a sticky mess….
A man has some kind of control over me and the people with me….I do not like it….

Lots of people like the Crowders from the tv show “Justified” are hassling me, making it hard for me to move….I have a sense of restricted movement….At another point I see Strauss looking out my study door….I look and see the other neighborhood cat that looks just like Strauss, sitting up in the window….I am surprised….
Like it’s Easter, and lots of little kids are running around, bursting out with energy….very happy….I see an image of empty plastic Tupperware containers….ready to be filled?....

“Delicate Skeletons” I was with Ashley picking out movies at an outdoor sale. Old movies like porky pig. As I am walking around it suddenly seems like I’m at Robbie’s. I see him, he’s outside. The more I walk around the weirder it gets! I saw dehydrated rat’s, skinny, leathery, rats. There seemed to be a parasite eating them? Sucks their blood. Nothing had any hair. There are bats and rats stretched over a mesh enclosure like a chicken coop. They are like mummified skins. Some of them had been there for a long time. As I walked around I saw a small cubby where a chicken had tried to roost but had gotten stuck and died a long time ago. I took pictures of all the little skeletons hanging.

“Still dreaming of Robbie” I was walking around at Robbie’s; he has a second hand store. I hadn’t been there for a while, it looks nice; cleaned up, new stuff, great job! I pass a shelf with a half of a beer on it and pick it up and drink it. There is a couple sitting nearby. Behind them is a school bus waiting to take everyone….somewhere. The couple gets up from the couch. At first I didn’t really like her but I said,” Where are you guys going?” She says,” A hip hop show, why don’t you come?” I say no thanks. She says, “Why? I think everyone there needs to see your beautiful smile. And you can share smiles!” I realize it’s all about sharing, and that I have something great to offer. She was SO nice to me. I felt bad for judging her in the beginning.

Lots of dreaming about Lucrecia, the different places she lived, the people involved with her….It is good, I am learning everything I want, it is good and easy….At some point, I am starting to fool around with my wife, sexually caressing her naked body….

“Bruce” Bruce was someone else’s dog. I kept trying to get his attention but….he was someone else’s dog! For a while I thought he just didn’t see me. But nope, he acted like he didn’t know me. I saw him walking, standing, hanging out in a back yard, but as if I was invisible, he was just doing his thing with someone else.

I am getting ready for Lucrecia’s arrival in Toledo….My brother and his family are going to come….I make it seem it is totally safe and good, but then I worry it will not be when she arrives….But then we get good news about their housing, and it is fine again….At some point, people outside begin acting strangely, lurching around and threatening others….weird….have they become zombies?....I am worried about our cats, and I go to get them inside….But I cannot fine one of them, the oldest?....I finally get her, and bring her inside safely….But is see that part of her back fur has turned pink, to go with the white fur she already had….

Something about Donald Trump….he comes into town and messes things up….at each point there is a set way of doing things, and he always does something different, problematic….I feel a constant duality in dealing with him….

I am helping people walk around an old city….it is confusing, but I know my way….this goes on for a long time….At one point go the sea shore….I go out in the water and try riding the waves, like I am surfing but I do not have a board….it is fun, but then I get worried about sharks….I realize that at this point, I am alone out there in the water….Earlier, I am walking with our family past a field of green grass, where a girls’ softball game is being played….a big crowd of parents watch their daughters playing….as we go past I say they (meaning this whole community) sure are into their softball….a slightly disparaging comment about everyone’s enthusiasm about the game….We walk along the first base side of the field, trying not to be noticed or distracting to the players and spectators….

“Being Beat” I was trying to cry out or say something. The more I tried to say something the worse it got…for ME! I was on the road in a neighborhood with grass on the sides. My mom came out and the more I faded and tried to talk the stronger her energy was towards me. She was beating me down; I could feel it on my legs. She was yelling at me. I tried to get away, I went across the street, I was hiding in the grass but I could NOT open my eyes! I couldn’t see where I was going! I was afraid. My eyelids were glued. She was hitting me on the leg. The more I struggled the worse it got. I feel scared. Really afraid like….I can’t open my mouth and can’t see. Alone and sad for myself.
I am going around an old town, not knowing it well, getting lost, but it is ok, I am in a fine mood about it….Andy from the tv show Parks and Rec is with us, he knows more about what is going on….

Something about Andy and April….They leave some white papers out in a shed or barn, which is partly open to the outside….Later it seems the papers will get wet from the rain, but when they go to check, the papers are all put away….that is a good thing, it makes us happy….

“Scooter Truck” I am way up a hill and with some dogs. I’m in a house and I have my truck. Then I remember walking away and thinking,” Well that’s weird, I’m walking away from an empty house…or some dead people…..It starts to clear up…..yes, I’m in a house with a fortune teller. I don’t want to be there, I’m whispering and sneaking. There is a trick or a twist that when they ask you something you have to be VERY careful about your answer. I am thinking about my truck…I’m pretty sure I drove it up here. But now I am going down and down and down the hill, and the dogs and I are trekking through weird territory. I finally get to my truck but it is reduced to…like a scooter with a truck front. You stood on it like a scooter and it went pretty fast but it had no headlights! Now I’m on the scooter truck and I guess I’m going back up the hill to the house because in the end……That’s where my stuff is!

Something about wood in the valley….a building project, it will go faster than I expected….the wood is being cut or processed in a special way….Then, at another point, my wife and I are in a floating thing on a creek….it spins and floats down the water….I get out and stop it….Then, I am going into a house, and a guy walking ahead of me asks a dark skinned woman (Mandy?) about a three-way sexual encounter with another woman….she is just back from a day at her job, and she scornfully says to him no way….As I walk by and we go into different rooms, I say as a joke, it sounds like a lot of work….after I say it, I worry and wonder if my comment came across as lewd, like another proposition….

I am on the street in Madrid where Lucrecia lives….I am looking for the exact house….Other people are there in the street, too….A guy seems to be the most forceful in doing things there….I am unsure if they are looking for what I am looking for….it is a competitive scene?....Something about metal pipes coming out of the ground, like utility lines….These are more the concern of the guy and other people?....I do not get into any competition with them, but I am happy I now know, more or less, where her house is….
“Earthquake” I watched the land under me in earthquake. I am driving my truck and the road is waving up and down and then one of the loops just compounded on me and squished my truck.

I am traveling to see something related to Lucrecia….I have people in Spain gathering stuff for me….At one point there are two pictures….one of them is so big it is no longer free, it requires payment to use….That is ok, I say….

I am looking for Lucrecia, in a place with lots of people….She lives there, I am close….But I do not see her, just the house and kitchen….Other people are around….There is some kind of competition going on….People are shooting water at each other?....I have a squirt bottle, I look for a particular guy above on a stairway to shoot….But he is not there….At another point I am on a bus, in my red underwear….I have to get out to help the driver see something on the sidewalk….I do not want to go, being dressed as I am….but then the usual guy comes out to do it, so I can go back in the bus….

I hear about a city that burns 27,000 people….it is horrible, I am upset by it….At another point, I am sitting in the dining room of our house here, talking on a cell phone….Out the window I see a couple of women and children coming from the driveway, like a little parade….Then they realize it is a house, not a through street, and they slow down….They turn around, worried….but I smile in a friendly way and tell them it is ok….

Something about a big lid out at the ranch, keeping the pool and hot tub from being finished….I have to do things to get the lid removed, but it is complex….It has to do with gay people?....and grading papers for some kind of school?....
I am in an old English town….It is confusing and frustrating trying to move where I want to go….I cannot find my way around….There are people around, but it is hard to know who is doing what….

I am traveling to other planets, but some sheets of paper get in the way….there are two pieces of paper in particular, white rectangles, and they seem to have images of chess pieces on them….three on one, and five on the other….something else surprising happens, makes me do something with the first part?....Then later, two people are in a car, a man and a woman….I see another car, a tan van, blocking them….moving like a hit, an attempted murder?....I walk away….Then the woman gets out….I go past a guy hiding with a bow and arrow, who says the guy in the car is right behind the third Kangaroo sticker on the car’s window….He is going to shoot him….But then the guy in the car gets out and runs….where did he get to?....I happen to see him moving in the shadows of a garage behind us….but I say nothing to reveal him to the others….
Something about a house, it is empty….I am going there, and I know that people are preparing to attack me?....

It is night time, and I come up to a large house, or a little town….it has been fixed up, and now there is lots of action, bright lights, people bustling around….it looks like they are preparing for a party of some kind….it seems all too much for me….I get there, and start turning things off….wasteful, unnecessary….I am confused, who did all this, and why?....I partly like it, and partly I do not….

“The Celts are Coming” I am on an island at war. And water is a weapon. I can hear someone saying “The Celts are coming”. I know they are coming to the land. I see a man interrogating a small child. There is a translator, but what he doesn’t know is that what he is translating was going to lead to her exile. They were asking if she had done something, saw something. They end up taking her away. In the end I saw the translator tied to a metal boat in the water. And all that was left uncovered was his head.
“Cornered” I saw Mark spazzing out against a corner; a corner of a wall that existed in space, nothing else, no building or wall, just a corner.
