“Driving blind” I went to go see my mom at her house. When I arrived there were moving men at her house. She also had her car there in which she was driving in a reclined position, nearly lying down, unable to see out the windshield.

I am watching a basketball game….some old people are sitting on chairs, acting as referees….They are not very attentive to the game….A guy has the ball above the key to the right of the basket….He dribbles, stops, and then takes three or four steps toward the basket to shoot a layup….It is an obvious travel violation, but the old people do not see it, and they do not make the call against him….I try to help and explain it to them, showing where he started his drive to the basket….I say there is no way he could have made that a legal shot….

I see a bunch of people I knew in college….they are older now, but we talk about the good times….At one point I go into a swimming pool, and I swim like a shark through the water to amuse a kid, also in the pool….At some point I am out walking with a group, and I toss my maroon scarf into some green ivy bushes….I plan to get it later….but I forget, and never pick it up….Now I have to go back to get it?....at another point, Spanish people are planning to blow up a house, with a bomb of some kind….But it is a mistake, this is our house, not the one they really want to blow up….In the end they don’t do it….

“Human Remains” I have applied for a job, a business owned by two whacky guys, cool guys. My job is to mix something far down below. I’m on a catwalk; I do a motion above that causes an effect down below; a long arm with a ball weight that stirs down below. There are two of us doing this. Then there are cookies, that’s how we become acquainted; I am eating the crumbs of cookies. It opens a playful relationship I have with the two guys. We stop working and sit outside on the stoop. We notice there is a car double parked out front and inside there are 3 animals that I think are a strange combo, as if they do not go together; a Raccoon, German Sheppard, and…..? Then it is somehow known by writing that there are human remains in the car. As if we had a mental picture of a bloody foot against the window. When we go to look in the back of the car we find a person who looks eaten. As though the animals in the car have turned on the person. As a last thought I have a flash that what I am stirring at work is bloody clothes.

“Tater is the baby” I am on my way to a house where I know I will find free clothes that fit me, a giveaway box from someone else who is tall. I was happy and excited. Once I get to the house I feel like I’m with a child but it was Tater. Inside the house I try to show Tater a toy, a rubber thing…..it’s “What happens when you don’t brush your teeth”, when you squeeze it a creature pops out from under the gum. It’s very amusing but Tate is not interested. As I look around for stuff I wander into a back area. Suddenly I heard a baby cry. I looked around to find it was Tater! His face is so close to mine, I can see his whole face so clearly. He wasn’t crying anymore. I thought maybe he was playing a game but then I realized that he was crying because he didn’t know where I was. Then he is REALLY playful, I wish I had played with him but I was so surprised I just stared.

“Oracle” I was in a place that required me to explain why I was there. Not that I shouldn’t have been there, it just wasn’t my place. It is a seers place. It’s a big house, old, dark wood, quite empty. The seer will tell your future. I see that Rachel is there working with the seer and I feel regret because I should have been asking the seer for my own, yet, perhaps I did. I saw a rat with a very long tail slip through rocks inh the wall. There is a man there, who is not a welcome guest, yet I know myself to not have trouble with spatial relations; to be close to someone or to share with someone is not an issue. I wasn’t a fan of Rachel either but we shared a bed. Suddenly I’m washing a lot of makeup off my face, so much eye makeup, blue and green eye shadow and eyeliner globbed on. And there is a terrible wax in my mouth. The more I tried to get it out the more it was building up. I was scraping along my gum line with my finger. So much wax! Rinsing it with water just made it worse. As I reenter the room I recognize the man as a negative aspect to Rachel’s future. There is a lot of coming and going and a lot of unsettledness. Some had come and gone because they weren’t welcome and some because they didn’t fit into the future.

Something about a full moon, and that being the time for people to attack, come against me….I have an image of being in a house, there are signs they have been in there, trying to get me….But it is not all bad….They have some constructive purposes?....

Lots of stuff with me and a Spanish woman going around together, maybe through a town, we are friendly….We are trying to figure out a variety of confusing situations….At some point I am at a house, it is our family house?....but other people are using it….There is a room, like a living room, with three walls that open to the outside, the garden, lots of green plants….But I realize the people never closed the walls after using the room, so now I wonder if any water got in….Concerned, I check the rug, couches, and other furniture….It turns out to be not as bad as I thought it might be….But I still feel it was careless of the other people to leave things open like that….

“Flying Truck” I was flying with my truck. I was holding onto the tailgate, dipping and turning, legs flapping like a flag. As I realize I will land soon I spot another pickup on a big tall shiny silver lift, as if a statue. A 100 ft. in the air or more. I separate from my truck because I fear crashing to the road and crab onto the back of this other truck on the lift. Safely, I am lowered enough to fly down to the ground on my own. I am going to see a man. His home seems to be right there. We are SO happy to see each other. We get along great! He has 2 kids. There is high energy; we get ready to go to a baseball game. I tell the son about my truck adventure. He is not impressed.
“Rob” I am at Robbie’s, he’s on a health kick. We have a funny ordinary conversation, joking, that I am a hit man for him. I get people that have more than him.

“Fire Truck Horses” There were two horses in a fire truck, in the top. I was going to a new fire house and taking those horses with me. But I soon realize that they have been in that truck for a few days. There is a big one and a baby. I see the baby is still wearing all of its gear. I take all the stuff off. I have a clear picture of the hair and the felt lining under the leather. In the new firehouse I am busy doing things, meanwhile people in the offices are training the horses. They can do things like lay on the couch.

I am sitting in a forested area, lots of green trees, on a trail….I am getting ready to go down a smaller trail to my left, going downhill….but a big group of girls, young women come from the other direction, and go down the trail I was planning to take….Oh oh, I am confused, what should I do….I could start running and speed past them?....Or I could just wait until they have gone far enough that it does not matter?....I have some things with me, a magazine and other stuff….I could perhaps do something with them to pass the time….socks too….I wonder, should I bring them with me or leave them here?....At another point, I am in a room with someone I am not psyched to be with….after going through a weird airport, leaving an odd woman who sits and a table with another woman and I….we try to ignore her….In the room, with very tall ceilings, I want to fly up to the top….I know I have the ability to fly up there, but another person is in the room and they distract me….To fly I need some quiet concentration to gather myself….

A woman and I are on a street, looking for house addresses….It causes me pain to do so, but we keep going….At another point I am with a woman who is a warrior, dominating….Another woman is kneeling on the ground, like she is a prisoner or a supplicant, or someone who has fallen into the control of the first woman….I am standing with the first woman, who takes her sword and gently uses the tip to make a small slice down the front of the kneeling woman’s blouse, deepening the sight of her cleavage….The first woman says she usually does not do this with women, but now why not?....I take this to mean something sexual….It is like I am holding the sword as it lightly cuts and opens the blouse….

I am in a huge house, looking at other people….but trying to be secret….I go outside, looking into other houses, then come back to let the other people know….Maybe I do it again, a couple of times?....this is all happening in French?....somewhat confusing....I come back at one point, and I walk by a large brown tree stump and a length of green garden hose on the ground….I wonder if I should cover up the stump, preserve it better so we can create a table or something out of it….The spirals in the center of the stump are vivid and beautiful, lighter tan in color, a strong contrast with the brown of the bark….

A guy is looking at real estate….he is checking out various houses, considering whether to buy them….I am with him, looking at houses too?....At some point I look out at the ocean, and I see lots of people surfing….My point of view is out in the water to my left, but I am not in the water myself….I see the waves moving in several directions, not just straight in….this makes it hard for the surfers to ride the waves….But all of the people seem to be doing well, having fun….it is a sunny day….I see a kind of middle trough, where the waves are all around, and a couple of guys are floating on their surfboards….At another point, a young woman is walking past me, wearing shorts….I look and admire the smooth, pale skin on the back of her leg….

Lots of discussion about the two stories or versions of the story within our film….are we going to show it again?....Yes, that is the plan….Someone asks us if one of the stories has a symbol like a sideways trident….I say no, that one is not ours….

I feel some uncertainty about showing our film in the same time block as a descriptive film about how we made it?....in my view, there is a conflict in showing the two together….somehow it disrupts or impairs the audience from judging the film on its own merits….A woman is the filmmaker….she seems kind of clueless, unaware of the problem?....I try to help her….

Something about the opening of the film….the first showing….Someone else is trying to run the show, make things happen, take credit for the results?....I am uncertain whether that is a good or bad thing….A brown paper bag is involved somehow….I see it on the ground, down to my left, and the movie theater is ahead on the right, brightly lit in the darkness of night….

It is like the film, or a town, is being replaced?....The nice things in it are done or finished, and now a bunch of other people are trying to get in, so they can insert their work into this….it is weird being there, seeing them try to get in….Lots of dark machines are involved, black metal objects with lots of edges and sharp corners….

Something about moving boxes around….I do not want to do it, but it has to be done….Other people are involved….At one point a dog comes up to me with a yellow tennis ball in its mouth….it is a whippet dog, light brown in color, and it looks up at me expectantly, friendly, ready to play….I am slightly reluctant, but it seems like a good dog, so I will probably go ahead and play fetch with it….

Something about a place with zombies about….lots of space, so no concern yet about the zombies actually attacking us, but we are trying to decide who goes with whom for safety….it is hard to think through the possibilities….At some point someone is having a party, to lighten the mood….Women are dressing to be waitresses….I hoped they would not be wearing any tops, but they are wearing white blouses….At some point someone has a baby, I take it and sit it on my lap, playful and friendly….it is a good kid….I am glad to be part of caring for it….
“I will” I hear the metaphor, “I will bring down the house.” I see Helen Marin. I see a map where it’s really far to travel all the way on land, down and up. But it’s difficult to cross the waters.

I see a tree, like an apple tree, with some metal tubing connecting some of its branches to each other….At another point I jump into the water of a pool with a guitar case held high, so it will not get wet….Some of the bottom of the case gets in the water, but it is ok….I am standing about chest-deep in the water….but I wonder, did I drop a box attached to the guitar?....There is still a small red box attached to the case, but I think there was something else too, and now I am unsure if it is still there….maybe….At another point I walk down a cement hallway, like in some kind of public building or arena….I walk by guy who is a fan of the St. Louis Cardinals baseball team….I stop and say, have the Cards been in the playoffs for four years in a row?....That is amazing, I hope fans like you appreciate that….He does not really respond….I ask, have the Cards even lost the first series ever?....They do not just get into the playoffs, they play well and go deep….At another point, I am trying to walk through an outdoor parking lot while carrying my bong, and I see a car with my family, parents in it….I do not want them to see what I am carrying, and they do not….I go past them to another car….

“Ric Sham Swim” There is a vampire. When you come into contact with him one of the symptoms is that your mouth would become foamy. As if….if you saw someone running with a foaming mouth you knew that they had come into contact with the vampire, coming from his direction. I thought I knew who it was but perhaps I was wrong. We follow the vampire to investigate-he goes into a classroom. Suddenly I have a flash, the Ric Sham Swim, Ah yes of course! The Ric Sham Swim is the event that causes people to come into contact with the vampire who otherwise wouldn’t have.

I am living in a square area adjacent to a big area of wild lands….I am there to observe dinosaurs?....I am very enthusiastic and excited about this, more than the other people involved who are more scared about it….I can see a boundary line, up and down, separating the wild lands to the left from other land to the right….My square of living space is positioned in the wild lands, with its right side on the main boundary….At some point I see an area of meadow with tall tan grasses….I should scythe it, I think to myself….But I see a patch of some particular plant with white puffy tops….Hmm, I decide I will let that one grow, and see what it does….

“Cups Not Pups” The dream is mostly about being at a house of Jim’s. It’s condo like, I feel anxious like we are going on a trip, hurry and get my stuff, we are packing up and I am doing laundry. The dogs are there and a pony. Simultaneously I am driving away and walking back. Seems like I had been driving for a couple hours yet now I don’t remember what direction I’ve walked. Suddenly I’m back at the house and I say, “Okay, I’ve got the dogs!” I have Tater and Ollie and Bruce. Then I realize I was supposed to come back for the cups not pups!

It is a situation where we are only able to move or visit a stairway just outside the front door of a house or building….A man is taking care of the stairway, a square pad adjacent to the house….It is very limited, but fine given the circumstances….he’s friendly to us….There are two such places he takes care of?....Someone serves us little drop pancakes to eat….I see lots of little white dots that have been cooked….

A small pickup truck, loaded with stuff, is driving away….it is an emergency?....filled with supplies?....But then I see the truck stop and come back to get some more stuff….Then, at another point I am looking at a family, like a picture portrait, all of them standing there….I see two teenagers who I somehow know will grow up to be important….An older sister, a younger brother….Looking solemn….They do not know their future, but I do?....

“Spitting Shit” I woke myself up gagging because I had tons of shit in my mouth. The story is messy; I am in a house with Vincent and Jones and it is also a house that I rent from Robbie. There is also an aspect that I am arriving at a party. There are a lot of people I know including Matt Stein. There is a black guy there named Rick Springfield. I am moving my stuff into the upstairs part of the house I am renting. I was thinking what happened to that one couch? Vincent and Jones are by my side the whole time, they represent good energy. Suddenly the toilet overflows! I am also on my period and there are pads everywhere and I am embarrassed. I am in the bathroom and suddenly everyone wants to come in and talk to me. Matt walks in and sees the toilet overflow and says, “Oh my god!” Rick Springfield comes in and wants to buy some pot, I tell him Robbie’s place is next door. There is shit everywhere! Huge logs of shit and shit water soaking into the carpet. It’s coming out of the sink as well. It had happened that I had put my mouth over the sink to blow or force it the other way but my mouth just filled up with shit. I was spitting and spitting it out. Rick Springfield is looking around and my eyes are following his, looking at what he is seeing; an empty floor and carpet drenched in shit. I was gagging and heaving, I threw up. My main point is to not swallow any of the shit. I feel curious and blank. I am embarrassed of the shit and because I’m on my period. I wonder if I caused this.

“Roosters” A man or group comes to live at this house. I am there because I am curious. I wonder what will happen and if it’s going to work out. He has these really big pet roosters. One of them flew up on my shoulder. I was afraid at first but it was nice. And its feathers smelled like soap, he gives them baths. It stands out that I hear him say, “Oh Crap!” There are friends with dune buggies outside making tracks in the grass. I’m really observing, curious, and waiting for something to happen. There are roosters, cows, and dogs. There are 2 species curiously getting along. I see an animal that is shaggy and a cow with really thick hair.

Lots of stored up food….I see it all stacked up in a kitchen or house, lots of boxes, packages, and cans….I did not know, but I was supposed to do something to renew my ability to have any of the food….I have to do something for the second time….Then I will be a regular member again….my wife or mom are at the head of the process….

A young woman is visiting us….She borrows my wife's white car….I see the young woman drive the car back into our garage….I am watching from above, and she drives toward the garage door a little too fast….The door has barely raised enough when she drives through, and she has to lean her head back to get clearance…It is like the car is a convertible at this point?....She is an interesting person, I wonder where she is from….She is listening to a Led Zeppelin song while driving in, I figure my wife must have had one of my music CD’s in her car….That is cool, I am more impressed by the young woman….At some point I go to an upstairs bathroom (it feels like the bathroom in our master bedroom, but it is not) to change out of my sweat pants, which seem too casual for this setting; I want to look better than that, cooler for her….In the bathroom the toilet water is running, so I push the flush button and start to pee….But there to my right is a couch, and I realize the young woman is laying there, with a dark green sweater pulled over her like a blanket covering her head….I quickly apologize and leave….She is resting, that is ok by me….Then, another scene: Andy from Parks and Rec is showing me how to use a fire extinguisher….We practice spraying it against a wall….bits of white foam shoot out of the extinguisher….I am not very good at it, but I manage….other people are watching, I am somewhat embarrassed….

“The Inlet” All I can see is a neighborhood near a coastline. There are 2 houses at the edge near to me. There is a coastal inlet right there. Day after day I see this one big house. It’s under construction. I see a young woman outside. It’s a coastline like I’ve never seen; no street, subtle and hilly, short green grass, and these cliffs. The cliffs are extraordinary. When the water rushes down the surface an amazing pattern is revealed.

I was in a seemingly ordinary room, white-walled and minimally furnished, when something unusual caught my eye. Near the leg of a chair was a tiny little human, no more than two inches high. Closer inspection revealed that it was Donald Trump! Trying to figure out what was going on, I remembered hearing that this room had been designed as a sort of art installation by the punk rock impresario Malcolm MacLaren. All the furniture was subtly oversized in order to make one feel smaller, maybe even bring back memories of navigating the grown-up world as a child. But what I was seeing now was a much greater shift of scale than I would have expected. Just how big is this furniture, if it makes a grown man look only two inches tall? I knew that Malcolm MacLaren had been rich, but it would have cost a fortune to build an installation to a scale like that! Then I realized that my scale was perfectly ordinary in relation to the furniture, which could mean only one of two things. If the furniture were vastly oversized, then I too must be an enormous giant, so that if I left this room I would be blundering through the city like godzilla... but that seemed unlikely. I was pretty sure that I remembered being in ordinary scale to the world outside this room. The other possibility was that Donald Trump is actually only two inches tall. A couple of women are walking up a hill to a place….they are unsure if they should be there?....Bright beautiful blue sky….And round red balloons in the lower left corner?....At another point I go down into a creek area, where a broad, deep flow of water becomes a natural pool….I climb down the bank, and it looks like I can step across the water to get on solid land?....But no, when I go forward I go straight down in the water….what looked like land was just leaves, twigs, and other debris on the surface of the water….I am treading water in a very deep place, while wearing all my clothes….Oh oh, I am worried I have my phone with me….I look for a way to climb out….I am aware this is a very dangerous situation to be in, and I know I was stupid for going forward….But I feel confident I can get out of the water safely….somehow I knew that and did not worry when I first took the chance to try crossing….I see a vine or branch I can grab to pull myself out….

I am in a place that is my space in our house….Lots of change going on outside, in other parts of the house….Other people are controlling the house….But not my area….Later, I am in a different room and I look out a window and to my surprise see alien ships flying down and hovering over the water….I try to hide, but they find me immediately….I tried to go behind some big red floaties, lined up in the room….But the aliens could see me easily….At another point I see a glimpse of a blond woman in a bright blue outfit, walking outside somewhere….She is rather far away, but she catches my eye….

I see a red Ferrari car….it is misshapen?....there is a strange bulge in the front of the car….Maybe there is a death body hidden in the trunk, which is in front?....Later, I am riding a double-decker bus, on top, open to the outside air….Other people are on the bus, and one guy suddenly topples over by accident as we turn….He falls out, and lands straight on his head with a sickening thud….I watch the whole thing, and after he falls I quickly tell the bus to stop….I say we have to hurry to help him, he might have broken his neck or even died….I think of how I will never forget the sound his head made as it hit the ground….I am very worried and upset….But it turns out that somehow he is ok, he has suffered no serious injury….I am surprised but still upset….
