I am at the top of a hill, in a car….Maybe in San Francisco, very steep hills….I went up one earlier….Now I wait at a stop sign or signal, ready to go down….Ron Swanson is in a car near me?....We go forward, over the edge and down the hill….I cannot believe how steep it is; a vertical drop straight down….I immediately wonder if my brakes will work in these conditions; I am worried they will not….But down we go….I try to go straight, but apparently I swerve a little to my right, because the person over there says I am driving on the radio speakers, not the road….radio speakers lining the road down?....It all turns out fine at the end….

People are playing a weird board game….But they have different identities?....The game is not what it seems?....They are playing on Alcatraz island, with boats around in the water, with people waiting to play, interested in the game….I play the game, but I am confused….Maybe the people with the game are going to try to escape through all the boats on the water?....
Cary Grant is doing something, and suddenly he says it is related to the Nazis….I am surprised….

I am with a big group, April from Parks and Rec is there, with other people from the show….She is managing the group’s activities….It is fun, but rather disorganized….At some point a doctor looks at me, I ask what he thinks….He says it’s bad….Bad? I say in surprise….Throat cancer, he says….I am shocked….Later, I am fooling around with Hilary….At first I am not totally hard, not ready for intercourse….But after a few moments of fondling and rubbing hips I am ready to go….At another point I am outside hacking at brush and blackberries with a machete, when suddenly a big bunny rushes out….He stops behind me, sits, and looks at me….I am surprised at how big and mature the bunny is, it must be an old one….

The pretty young woman who plays Anne in Merry Wives of Windsor is dancing around, happy….Later, I am with a group of OSF people….In a small setting, a big white blond guy says racist things….I confront him, but he does not care….I am very mad, and as he sits on a chair I think of ways to harm him, get his attention….I break a beer bottle on the top of the chair near his head, and I’m getting ready to punch him….I know he might beat me up in response, but I have to do it….Then I go tell other people, friends, about what happened….I realize as we talk there are more like that guy, and by talking about them we might inadvertently help them band together….But they are still much fewer than us….I wonder if I should go back and apologize to the guy….As bad as he is, I should not stoop down to violence like that….

I am putting on a play….Falstaff is here, and I am trying to set things up well for him….Later, I am getting out of a car on Amherst Avenue, in front of our house….Parked on the wrong side of the street….I look around and see an amazing purple band in the sky on the horizon….it is beautiful….I stop to admire….I see Hilary go out of the gate from our house, to go on a run….I do not want her to see me?….I do not want to distract her?….At some point I drop my wallet, then pick it up….Later, I see out over the ocean an amazing sight: huge trees hanging upside down in the sky, leaves touching the water, their trunks and roots high up in the clouds….They look like redwood trees, the biggest in the world….it is incredible, beautiful…I think about trying to get a picture, but as I move around there isn’t a perfect viewing spot….

An OSF actor is doing something, and I am trying to help, but the actor is disappointed in me….Later, I am doing things with machinery here at the ranch….two metal carts or little tractors….At another point, I see three white vehicles driving onto the ranch….I do not know who they are, and I am surprised the gate monitor did not sound when they drove in….

I am clearing long vines and other brush from around the house….Later, I go to a small social gathering for a guy who is sad and feels lonely….I go, and tell him not to worry….Will other people come, too?....I am unsure….At another point, I am going for a run on a dirt trail along a creek….Going up the creek, dark brown dirt, shady trees, very beautiful….Other people are running down the trail, and at the very end, going very slowly, is Maurice M….I am surprised to see him, and wonder why he is going so slow….I get the sense he is coming back to running after some time away….

I see four deer walking by a house….Two big stags with large antlers in front, a smaller stag and another deer just behind….I stop to admire them….Later, I am in a parked car at someone’s house and I see a woman outside, talking to other people….I look more closely, and the woman is actually a guy?....I am slightly confused….Then later I am down in a secret room or lair of this person, he has a beautiful woman held captive there who tries to run away, and he shoots her down with a machine gun….Very violent and bloody….The other guys laugh….Then he goes upstairs….Now I am both watching and in his perspective as the woman/guy emerges into a super fancy restaurant where he or she is the head chef….Waiters come up to give her (she is totally a woman now?) little bites of specially cooked food….The whole thing seems gross and abhorrent to me….

I send a tiny woman, no more than a foot tall, wearing workout clothes, on a little raft down a creek….She looks cute in that outfit….She seems happy about floating down the water….Later, I go to a house to do something, but lots of people are there….I see others returning from a walk outside….I do not want them to know something I know, so I leave….I have some knowledge that is important, but cannot be shared in this setting….

Retta, the African-American actress who plays Donna on Parks and Rec tv show, does something with a fantasy card game like Magic….She is playing very well, I am impressed….it is a complicated game, lots of cool cards in action….Later, I see some things on the kitchen floor I have to pick up and put away….A pair of gloves, which go in a drawer in the mud room….

I am watching as lots of people with disabilities are playing the fantasy card game Magic together….I am a little confused how they will play, how they game will unfold, how the players will interact with each other….

I am watching people perform a play at an early stage….Only one thing can be modified in this performance….Either acting, or seating, or the stage….Only one thing can be controlled, the rest has to be left alone….It seems like an interesting artistic challenge….To improve the show for the future….the actor Kevin Kenealy is in the show….Later, I see someone’s bare back, with the beginnings of wings starting to grow?….Little buds that will get much bigger….

Two plays are going on, with Fastaff in one of them….We are ready to go with the second….In the first play we are all virtuous, but in the second we are playing crooks and thieves….Falstaff is eager for that….At another point, I see a big black SUV car in the creek at the ranch….How did it get there?....I am irked….
Something about a play going wrong, there are problems….Someone throws an egg, and I see the yellow yolk running down….Down a the face and chest of a person, or the exterior of a black car?....

I am with a lot of people swimming in an industrial area….Lots of old factory buildings around, with a large lake or bay of water….Tannish or brown in color, not very appealing….But lots of people are in the water enjoying themselves on a nice sunny day….It seems weird to me….I wonder how deep the water is, and my feet touch the bottom easily….soft, mucky silt on the bottom….So the water is about chest deep….Later, I toss an empty paper to-go cup for tea into a toilet in a bathroom….I wonder why I did that, a toilet is not a recycling place….the cup is too big to flush down….

Like on television, I see a picture of a lacrosse guy….He has his stick, no gloves….Then he comes alive, and I ask him how he plays, is he fine with no gloves?....Yes, he says, he is fine….I realize that when players get to his level of skill, there is less need for padding because everything moves around better, more efficiently….he and I play catch in the living room of the old Hermosa Beach house….Not throwing it far, just little tosses of the white ball….It is fun but a little dangerous, I have to make sure I catch and throw it well, so we do not break anything….I do play pretty well, make some good moves that show I know what I am doing….I tell of playing with our three kids here, teaching them the game….Then we go driving in the city….I am behind the wheel of the car, and we go up a tall, steep white ramp, overlooking Los Angeles….Somehow the ball is lost, and the car’s brakes too….Maybe we tossed them out?....Now I get to a short downhill part of the ramp, before the very steep part….I realize I cannot do this without brakes, so we have to turn around, go back, and look for them somewhere behind us….

Something about a final little act of a play, with random people poking their heads through a hole in the floor, and doing a little play of their own….It is fun, brief, informal….I do it with great enthusiasm, fun….Although I am unsure how it will go, it is all improvised….

I am going down a narrow escalator, with someone else behind me….Ahead is a woman sitting at a desk, in the escalator….That’s weird, I think….I ask her to move as I come down, and she does so, and I say thanks….At the very bottom there’s a gate I have to push aside, swerving around to the left to get off the escalator….At some point maybe I see cats on the hunt, seeking prey?....I walk with a guy, we are laughing about something….Another blond guy I recognize from high school sees me, I imagine he is impressed by how happy I seem, laughing like this….I talk with the guy I am with….He is very tall, and he makes a joke about being the grossest one….We both have tickets in french, with “gross” meaning “large”….but then, he says, he saw James Harden come into the room, and he’s much bigger….I marvel, and say how tall is Harden, 6 feet 6 inches?....The other guy laughs and says his hair!....Harden does have an amazingly tall and sculpted black hairdo….

I am with a group….We are trapped?....I want to keep walking outside, rather than stay in one place….I go by the back stage area where we are being kept….I look at the two-story gray building façade to my right….Earlier I have to back a strange bus out of a square-shaped parking garage….No one thinks I can do it, the bus is so tightly squeezed inside, but I am going ahead anyway….At some point there are lots of black bugs crawling around….I am worried about them, their destructive potential….

I am walking along the Eagle Creek on the east side, on our property….Someone says I should not throw anything….I do not like that, someone telling me what to do on my own property….A few steps later I throw a round rock at a tree across the creek….I am close, but I do not hit it….Then, I see over on the other side Caroline Vasco, playing in the water nearby….Hmm, I am glad I did not hit her….I had seen her and her mother earlier?….

I am making a meal for lots of people….I use lots of fresh vegetables, but there is not enough food, I have to add more….I have bunches of cut up red peppers, orange carrots, and white onions….Raw, ready to cook….

A woman is helping me with plans for a gathering at a hotel….She shows me different combinations of things, which do I like?….Later, I am sitting in the front row of a dark theater, right next to the steps leading up to the left side of the stage….An actor, a young woman playing a sprite, with little sparkly threads and beads like a halo around her, comes over and whispers to me, come with me….I assume she means come up on the stage for some kind of audience-participation act, and I resist, saying I don’t want to go up on stage….

I am walking along a street and I see an area with a chain-link metal fence around it, with dozens of guys in black suits, milling around….They are salesmen, waiting to work….They are hanging around in a big blacktop area, black asphalt…..I avoid them as they mostly look the other way….I hope they do not see me and try to sell me something….

I am setting up something for dad, like a hotel arrangement….It is complicated, takes many tries, but it eventually works….More happens, then at the end I am in a small bedroom, partly open to the outside where I am standing, and someone pitches an object for me to hit with a tiny plastic white sword, like in a baseball game….I swing and miss….The person throws another pitch, I swing and miss again….Now I realize it is 0-2 already, I am already down to my last strike….In friendliness, to make it easier for me, the person puts a round plastic food container, empty, on a bed for me to hit….Now I can just smack it with my hand, rather than trying to connect with the tiny sword; a much easier physical task….I swing and somehow miss….What?....I am surprised and disappointed, and I walk away….

A bunch of people have gathered at a resort house….Out the window I see a bunch of Russians arrive, in a convoy of vehicles….The first truck drives up and pulls in front of a bench where a guy and a young woman are sitting….The white guy in the truck tries to get them to move by slowly inching the front of his truck toward them….That is mean, I think….The people finally do move….Then a big white bus arrives, with the main people….For some reason, another guy and I now want to get away….A joke aspect?....We did something funny, and now we want to avoid being caught for it….We run upstairs to get clothes and belongings, and I cannot find my shoes….I wonder if I should just take my sandals, will that be ok?....Then I run downstairs, but it is too late…A guy rows up in a pond in front of the house, with two little girls in the boat….The guy is like Manuel?....I was going to throw something with a lacrosse stick out of the house, but it is difficult to get a good hard swing inside the confines of the house….Now it is too late to do my plan, so I throw whatever I’ve got in the stick (a rock?) into the pond, which splashes a bunch of water on the boat….It is mean but funny….The New York Times newspaper in his lap gets all wet, I wonder if he will still be able to read it….Earlier, the kitchen door is open, and I see our cat Fireface outside, where she should not be….I go out, and she is very nervous and startled when I come out; she sprints across the driveway to a hiding place under the house….I did not know of that place before, I am impressed she found it….I go over and try to reassure her, and she comes to me and I carry her inside….

I am supposed to help move some people from a lame situation….An outside place with lots of junker cars?....old, broken down....I go and see what it is all about….I am ready to leave, but I have to make sure my car is not taken away by someone….

I am driving a big white delivery truck, going to pick some people up, take them somewhere?....I see a young woman playing darts, throwing them at a round board on a wall….At some point I am in a car on a big multi-lane road, and I see a guy on a bike suddenly cutting across lanes of traffic to get to an exit….That was rather dangerous, I think to myself, he could easily have been hit….
From a distance I see a big green square of forest, with a smaller but taller square of trees in the middle….I cannot see them, but I am pretty sure there are dinosaurs around....

I see a white swinging door in a house….At another point, the Pope, an old bald guy in white robes, is trying to stop me from doing something….Later, I am crossing a two-lane street of traffic, cars coming from my right….As I cross and come to the tall curb (the road dips down below an underpass, and the sidewalk rises at this point), I try to step up but my legs and feet will not work properly, it is like I am mildly paralyzed….I have to sit on the curb and use my arms to slowly push and swing myself up and out of the road….I am embarrassed that other people in cars can see me acting so lamely, disrupting traffic, but I have no choice….At another point I am trying to help some old people arrange something they will like….

Some people are setting up a new theater….They are putting on a play, but as it gets going I realize it is way too ambitious for the space they currently have….They have launched a play that requires much more infrastructure for the stage and backstage than they have….I realize I will be called on to help….At some point I am in a house, and a sargeant from the army comes in, then a captain….The sergeant goes into the bathroom for a long time, and the captain comes back and asks where he is….I tell the captain he is in the bathroom….There is a moment of confusion whether a higher ranked officer comes into the room?....Maybe I pretend to be an officer for a moment?....Later, back to the play: they want to set it up on a big field….With lots of outside places for small scenes, to take breaks, etc….I will help….

I go into a room of ours at a resort....A young blond woman is cleaning....I try to be respectful....I fix the door latches?....Outside a sliding glass door, I see lots of her friends are outside in the yard....Is there a party going on, too?....Hmmm, I wonder about the propriety of that....I guess it is ok....I see lots of dirty dishes in the kitchen sink....Later, Bud is holding a dart board for me to throw at....I do so, but it goes low and hits him in the leg?....I'm surprised and worried I hurt him....

I am in some dispute with the government....They say there is a problem in our yard, but I say I do not know about it....Suddenly a military jet shoots a missile, and it blows up a big pile of dirt in our yard....I am shocked and scared, what are they doing?....That's a crazy escalation of force....Later, something about a woman and a bathing suit?....Going in our out of a building, along a second story walkway outside....I am trying to help, but also keep a respectful distance....
I am with theater people....I am helping to set up a new stage....Falstaff is around....I see some weird piles or mounds of dirt outside....What should we do with them?....

I am at a play performance place, outside....Someone has changed out my addition for a smaller, worse one....What I put in is an outside pool of green grass, tall stalks that grow taller as the ground slopes down, so it is all even at the top but different below....Mine is deeper than the other one they put in, much better....At some point, a young woman and I are romantic with each other....

I see a drawer in a room, maybe a bathroom….The knob for the drawer is made of stone….I paint it blue so I can remember it better….At another point, I am in the front row of a theater with some friends….The lights go down and we start playing jokes, making mischief….We assume we cannot be seen since it is dark, but then I realize we can be identified by where we are sitting….Something about the number 88?....A column or shaft of light that would show anyone where we are?....Later, I go in a bathroom, and I see Levi our cat is swimming in the water of the white sink….He seems very happy and comfortable in the water….I am surprised and amused….
We are putting together a show or artistic production of some kind….David Lynch is there, he is doing it much better than anyone else, it is impressive….somehow it makes sense that he is there….

A young woman has a house, she is in charge of fixing it up….I see it from the outside….Other people are at the house helping with the work, there is more going on with the project than I know, more details and parts of the house being repaired, improved….A little dog is running around outside the house….

I am walking on a sunny day with someone past a big, nice house, with a well-kept garden in front….We try to stay in the shade as we walk, going around the house to the right, to some place down and beyond….At some point I drive a car to a nearby house….I pull around a right corner and find a quiet place to park….Later, I am in a nearby house, not my usual house….I look in a bathroom cabinet, and find some old weed stuff….Not my usual place, but I cannot get to that right now, so this will be fine....

An off-season theatrical show is in town….There is less pressure on the performers because it is not the regular season….But now more opportunity for pure mischief by the audience….First it is a white production, then a red one?....The audience is mean-spirited, wants to see destruction, mayhem….Not how the play is supposed to go….Later, I am in the back of a pickup truck with some other guys….I feel unsteady on my feet, like the truck is rattling, and I have to sit down….One guy gets in the cab of the truck, like he’s going to drive….he reaches down to the passenger side floor to get something (that is where I am viewing him from), and another guy who is a cop leans in and shoots the first guy in the back….The first guy is surprised, then dies….I am surprised, too, and angry at such violence, but then realize the second guy is a police officer, and was justified in doing this….Still, it seems sneaky to me, though, an unnecessary and cowardly killing….

A variety of shows, dramatic performances are being put on, big and little….I run from one to another….I see a huge blanket covering a large space outside….The blanket is grayish-green in color, rather drab….At some point I see women are hiding….Showgirls, trying to avoid attention?....

Some people are setting up theaters for plays along the Mississippi river....The theaters are on the shore at various places, and there is competition among the people about how to do it....I am facing upriver....Later, I see my wife, with a thin gold chain or necklace dangling from her mouth....I am unsure if she is aware of it, I tend to think not....

A Japanese couple is remodeling a house….The guy keeps changing things, without the woman knowing about it….Later, I am hanging out with a famous woman rap singer….It seems we are romantic with each other?....At one point she gets away from the other people around, and under a blanket she sings to me….I like it a lot….Later, I am in a house, and when some people enter in another part I go through a small door into a little room, and hide there….downstairs in a secret room, I do not want anyone knowing about it….Before that, I am driving a little cart with a woman through a restaurant, weaving past the tables on an outside patio until we reach our table….It is a very odd thing to do, I know that, but I can make it through fine, so why not….something about flowing water….

I am out doing something, and I get in a small boat driven by an old guy….We go through the water of a bay, and suddenly it is very crowded, with lots of other little boats all cruising along in the same direction, I wonder where they all came from….Some of the boats come very close to hitting ours….we are all very low to the water, and as one boat nearly hits us I casually lift my right arm to avoid it….I do not mind the dangers of collision, I am serene in the open air and blue sky….We get to a dock with no problems, I get out of the boat, and walk on my way….Earlier, I am with a woman….we are dealing with challenges?....We are close with each other, but have to deal with problems….

I am with a group of people at an outdoor party, or a club, maybe a show or performance of some kind….It is fun….Suddenly we become aware of bombing, a battle nearby….Shells flying through the air and exploding….We all take cover together in fear, hiding under pillows and blankets in an L-shaped couch area ….I think of how one of the shells arcing through the sky could easily hit us, even though we do not seem to be the direct targets….I am peeking outside through a space in my blankets, and I see a woman walking around, unaware of the danger she is in….I call to her to come join us in safety; she comes over to us….At one point I am standing near the couch area, looking at the city around us, and I see a plane in the distance flying low, faltering, coming down towards us….It crashes to the ground nearby, and the concussion of the crash knocks me to the floor….I am surprised and scared, as I realize how easily I could have been hit by flying debris….Although when I look back, there’s a window in that direction, which is strange because it was not there before….The window is not broken, and I figure that must mean the blast was not so bad, else the window would have broken; although that would have been extremely dangerous for me, standing where I was….Then all of us are in trouble from the owner of the club, he says we have to pay for the current damage, broken bottles of alcohol, by giving him our earnings from our future shows; we have done three of five, so he gets everything from the next two?….He is surprisingly harsh to us, and I feel it is very unfair….Later, I find myself on a run, at the end of Mountain View avenue, just before the hill gets very steep….An older Asian man is also running on my left, very slowly….I could go faster, but for some reason my legs feel very heavy and slow, like I just woke up, so I can go no faster than he does….At some point after the bombing, I am with some of the people from the party, and we are swimming in the calm, shallow water of the ocean, near the shore….we come around the corner of some rocks, and ahead we see a huge gold statue of a sea god, partly submerged in the water….Wow, it is an amazing sight….Is it Poseidon?....The god is in a reclining position, feet to our left, head to our right, and it seems like an ancient monument that has been partly lost to modern view….At some point, I see birds flying in the sky….

I am with my family, staying at a motel….We are on the ground floor, near a window, trying to fix something….Suddenly a guy shows up at the front door of the motel, which is a couple steps above our room, so he is standing higher than where we are….We are quiet, hiding, waiting to see what will happen….We wonder who he is….He seems a weird guy, kind of a robot….maybe dangerous to us….We wait till he goes by, hoping he does not see us….I am helping my wife with bracelets on her arms?....

I am with some people outside….Bad guys are around….Some kind of ritual or ceremony is beginning, it is about them….they assume it is favorable, praising them?….the ceremony has three parts, one of which involves putting lights on the forearms?....Suddenly all of them are taken up into the sky, floating upwards in a big shaft of golden light….They are surprised, this is not what they expected….The rest of us are glad, reassured they are gone….things will be easier without them here….

I am trying to run up a cement staircase outside, with a metal railing…..But I am very slow, cannot get my legs and feet to move as they are supposed to….I have a sense people are coming behind me?....Bad guys?....I want to go faster, stay ahead of them….At some point, maybe before, we are in a house on the beach….Men from a ship suddenly arrive at our door, and say their captain, a big old white guy in a blue and white uniform, commands that both sides must temporarily stop the conflict….Our side must accept huge piles of blankets and bundles of other stuff from their ship, which is having problems and must pause in the fighting….This is part of the rules of war for us to take their extra goods….I am suspicious they are just making it up….But then the men take advantage of being in the house, and start taking over….A little guy starts chopping at a wooden door with an ax….it is very sad….Later, I am in a kitchen with lots of people….my wife is there, she has been drinking red wine and she is feeling aroused….She makes playful sexual overtures toward me while we are putting clean dishes away….I am reluctant to be too open about it with so many people around, but I am aroused, too….

I am in a car, trying to park in a downhill parking place along the curb….It is a difficult maneuver, with the downhill direction affecting my speed, and suddenly I just go, turning once then again, and I am in, it is perfect….Wow, I am impressed by myself, I did that very well….After, I go in a diner restaurant, other people, men and women, are there talking about my work, which makes me happy….A guy says, everyone thinks I am so….What? I ask….the guy will not say….Then we are agents, like in the FBI, and we are looking for bad guys….I smack a guy over the head with a wooden stick, as he is standing next to a truck, to stun him….I check his identification, wallet, it turns out he is ok….Then the guy turns out to be Alan Alda….He makes a joke about Agent Cooper sending him to Alaska….

I see lots of leaves falling from trees….Just their skeletal structures, most of the inner leave parts have gone….A girl points the leaves out to me….Earlier, I see a mailman delivering things to a dormitory….A fairly big building on a street, daytime….This is Ronald’s dorm….The mailman and I get talking, as he is delivering something to Ronald….The mailman says actually, Ronald gets too much or has too much already, for whatever reason the mailman should not keep delivering to Ronald, but to be friendly he is anyway….He just wants to let me know….I say I probably should not mention it, but you are right, and I appreciate your being nice; I will talk to Ronald about it….Then a security guard comes out of the dorm, bringing in custody a small white guy in a white suit who had snuck into the building with the mailman….I had seen that guy, and thought he did not belong, but said nothing about it….I am glad the guard has removed him, he clearly had bad intentions, was up to mischief….

Somehow everything is charged with lots of energy….Small and big things, little objects, pieces of food, buildings, everything….It is surprising, no one knows what to do….We try to think of how each thing can be used differently now….In some cases it is a very good thing, in other cases not….I am intrigued by how widespread the change is….At some point I see Peaches, our old dog….She gets outside while other things are going on….I wonder if she will be ok on her own?....Yes, she is….cute black curly hair….Later, I am in a room with others….Suddenly we see through a window bad guys coming from outside to attack us….They are dressed in black like paramilitary guys, but they are not police….A big black guy is among them, they all have guns….In fear I wonder what will happen….Will they shoot us?....I wonder if this is when I am going to die….

A young woman suddenly gets a new, bigger white bra….She is surprised and happy, as she admires her bigger bust under her shirt….I am happy for her, too….Later, I am on a stage with a guitar, as if I was in front of an audience….Pointing up to special people in the crowd, then playing a big chord just for them….At the very end, I am sitting at the dinner table with other family members….Levi the cat jumps up in the air so he can see what we are eating….I find it amusing….

David Lynch is in a wilderness area, at the intersection of two creeks….He decides what goes which way….Some things go up to where he is making Twin Peaks, and other things go somewhere else….I wonder, does he have too much power?....Later, I see a Jewish community center is set up in a building on Shattuck Avenue in Berkeley, right below a Thai restaurant which is positioned on the hill just above it….a gray cement building….

my wife and I are in a theater, waiting for an informal play to start….Somehow this is part of her work?....An actress comes from the stage into the audience, towards our seats….She wants my wife to speak, invites her to come up and join the show….my wife gets up and runs away to the other side of the theater….I have our pillows in our seats, and I hold both of them as I watch her run away….I am amused by her reaction, and wonder why she is so reluctant….On my left, a Mexican guy is sitting next to me….I start to ask in Spanish if a poster on the wall or window to our left is about a politician in an election campaign….The guy does not understand me, as I struggle to find the right words in Spanish….at one point I stop and ask a small grammatical question, is it el or la radio?….he says el….So I go to the poster and look, and realize I am wrong, it is not the politician I thought….I say to the guy, la culpa es mia, it is my fault….

I see a big, black piece of chocolate cake, with a smooth, glossy frosting….Later, I go down to a small room, several people are there….I suddenly realize it is a running race, about to start, and I am in it….Before we know it, the starter says “Go!”....There are three of us, and a young thin guy runs out of the room….I quickly take off my black sweatshirt as I start running….I am much faster than the first guy, and I get past him, outside a door where the course turns sharply left….Now there are lanes to run in, it is a very short sprint to the end….I go in lane number two, and I realize I can win the race, although I know the other guy who started behind me is very fast....Caesario?....as I see the end, I start to feel slow, somewhat paralyzed….Later, I go into a kitchen in the same general building, like an old school or church or dorm facility….I go in thinking there will be food, but I am surprised and disappointed, no there is not, the food has all been put away….I look in a refrigerator, which turns out to be tiny, and empty….I see another refrigerator, but I assume that one is just for drinks….There is another room next to the kitchen, like a big recreation room, and I can tell someone is in there….But I do not go and look, I figure let them be….At some point a woman is around, needing help?....

Some people send us lots of very short messages and letters, trying to buy the ranch from us….We do not want to sell it, but the letters are so numerous and aggressive, I am worried about how to deal with it all….

There is a place where someone tells me there are more creatures in the big space and volume of air than on the earth….I think about this, how the atmosphere could house a large number of very small animals….Later, I am in a conflict with some guys….I am inside a house, and I have a gun or weapon like a crossbow….I shoot at one guy who is threatening us from outside the door….My shot, like a long white piece of wood, hits him perfectly and knocks him back and away from us….Later, I am outside playing soccer on a green grass field, and a girl makes a perfect pass to me from my right as we are running towards the goal….I shoot the ball and score in the far right corner of the net….

In a house or room, I hear a guy talking about the future of the ranch, like a prophecy….Someone in charge of things goes outside to talk with a woman about all that has come out in what the guy said….After the guy in charge goes, I go and lead the prophecy guy out of the room….I tell him let’s go someplace safe, so they can deal with it all, and they will not be able to turn meanly on you….
A woman with light brown curly hair has a message for my family about the creek….I listen to her….Earlier: we receive lots of email messages about the ranch….

I am sitting somewhere with my lacrosse stick and my new tan work shirt, unbuttoned….Later, two people are in a bed, like in a bedroom in our house, and to tease one of them in a friendly way I put a white plastic garbage bag on the bed; I am taking the bag out, and I heave it onto the bed briefly to surprise them….But unfortunately the full bag leaks some dark gross water onto the bed….The other person on the bed, a woman, is surprised and upset by that….Now I wonder what I should do about it?....Clean it up?....Later, I am driving a car somewhere, and I miss the right turn I was supposed to take….Now I keep going on an empty road with tan rocky hillside to my right, no way to turn around….So I will have to keep going in this direction for a while….At some point, I am at home and I wonder, what would I do if some bad guys suddenly broke into the house?....What would I grab to take with me, where would I go?....At the end, I am around the garbage area of our house here, and a worker guy is cleaning things by spraying water from a hose….I move behind a wall so he will not see me and spray water on me….But as I do so, I go more slowly than I wanted, so my back foot gets wet….

Outside I see a group of cross-country runners….In a forest area….They are going on a practice run at a big broad lake, like Lake Phoenix….I see the girls running team on the other side of the lake….Some of the runners near me have not gone yet, while others with shorter runs are already coming back….I see some of the runners walking across a surprisingly shallow part of the lake to come back at the end of their runs….Wow, I am surprised and disappointed in them for taking a short-cut and not finishing the run with a final burst of energy, but just walking it in….That seems to me a real decline from my time as a cross-country runner….

Some actors are setting up a show in an outside theater….But when the show goes on, there is suddenly a very different set….Someone changed it all….all the actors are unsure why….There is a downward flow to the scene, like the stage is tilted down from back to front….Later, I am making an omelette, and getting eggs out of a carton….oh oh, I realize with concern that one of the eggs has a thin crack in it; the crack is not big at all, but I know this means the egg inside could be contaminated, so I cannot use it….

At a theater, all of the people back stage come out to the front of the stage, and say they need more attention and help….their appearance is surprising, but they are confident and united in what they are saying….Later, I am sitting on an outside toilet, by the side of a road….A white van appears at the bottom of the hill to my right….I wave at them to please go ahead and drive by, but they wait for me to finish….That makes me anxious, because even though I keep using big wads of white tissue paper to wipe myself, I do not feel I am clean and done with the process….I am aware I am in a rather ridiculous position….

A play is going on, in a space or theater we manage, and for some reason we cannot sell tickets, communicate about it in normal ways, or make any money on it….I am confused at first….But then it seems liberating….Everyone involved in the play is happy, and wants us to go to the performance….At some point an animal is around….

Lots of people are excited to show us things….Four big tan pads out in a field….Things flow from there….I see two people setting up two small tan pads in a green grass field….They expect the flow to go between those two?....I am doubtful, it seems the flow will go wherever it wants….Later, I see a glass amphibian cage, and I’m surprised and saddened to see a dead snake in there, one of my pets; hard, dry, straight, leaning at a diagonal against the glass….Other people forgot to put water in, and now it is dead….I am upset, guilty….At another point, I see from above a stream of water flowing straight down through the air and hitting a brown grass area, churning up a hole in the ground….I think, that cannot be good for the soil, so much impact and erosion….

Lots of uncomfortable activity….People are trying to get me to do things, go places, but I am very reluctant….I see a half cup of white sugar?....in a small metal measuring cup….it is being used for some sweet treats, which I think are unnecessary?....

I am very close to some turkey vultures on the ground, they are eating something….Are they too close to me?….I am worried they might try to bite me….Later, a plane comes by….It skims along the ground, and I get on board….A couple other guys are already there….The plane goes up, and we ride on an outside platform, holding onto poles for balance….The plane lands again, I get off and comment on it being a very short flight….I joke that it was like hitchhiking on a plane….Then, outside on a field, I am playing catch with small dark melons with a couple of women….One of the women says she just got a new job….I cannot hear what she says about it, though, because the melon falls to the green grass and rolls away….I go get it, and say to her what was that?….I thrown the melon again, and the other woman does not catch it….To save her the trouble, I go and get the melon myself, which has rolled near a metal chain link fence….

There is a big uphill ramp outside, made of bumpy cement and sand….about halfway up it turns to the right….People have been going up it, and now it is my turn….I start walking towards it with strong purpose, gathering momentum….I have ski poles in each hand to help with balance….But once I get going up the hill, it is very steep, and right when I start I hit a small curb that slows me down….About halfway up I slow down….I wonder, will I get to the top without falling?….At some point I tell a woman my computer password….I’m not sure why I tell her, but she is surprised and amused by it….

Two players from the Blazers basketball team, Damian Lillard and someone else, compete for slots….to the detriment of the rest of the team….layups that people follow up with baskets….At some point I remember being caught up in a big wave of water and drowning….I wonder, wait, is that when I died?….

Lots of people are trying to get me to do complicated things, like buying property?….But I am reluctant, and try to find ways to save time and make it easier….At another point, in my study I see an ostrich has appeared outside, walking on the roof, looking through the skylight windows….I am very surprised and amazed, and I try to show our cats, since I assume they will be interested….I try to make contact with the ostrich as I notice it walking over the roof and looking in the windows….

I get in a boat with my wife and some other people….A guy is captain….Out into the ocean water we go, with my wife and me standing in the front….Suddenly, I notice water coming in through a view hole in the prow of the boat, which is painted white….I tell my wife to step back, and I tell the captain we have a problem….More and more water comes in, and the captain turns around and heads back for shore….But I can see we will not make it, the water has already swamped the boat….I say to the other people on the boat, who thinks it is too far for them to swim back to shore?….I want to know who is going to need extra help….Mira says yes, she would not make it….I yell to other people out in the water near us, SOS….They are surprised, and say really?….A woman looks at us with concern….it takes them a moment to realize we truly are in trouble….I want them to throw us some life preservers, but then I realize we are in shallow water, and fortunately we can jump out of the boat and stand in the water….my wife and I do so, and leave the ship behind….Later, I watch a woman in an airport terminal say “goodbye” twice, rudely, to another woman….But after the other woman walks away, the first woman takes a few steps after her and watches her leave, regretfully….At another point, an older black guy who may be mentally ill goes outside into a parking lot….I rush after him, and with concern I ask where is he going?….He tells me he has an important task to take care of….Going to help someone….OK, I say, and I hug him and tell him to be careful….

I am helping a woman with something….She pours some water out into the shore of a lake, or bay….I can see it from a room above….The water suddenly fills the whole space….Other authoritative men are amazed….so am I….it is a miracle….I helped her, but did I help her do that?….No, that is her magic….Later: I am in a small boat in or by the shore near a forest….I have to climb out here, even with other people around, because I cannot go farther in the direction I want to go….It is a little awkward….Earlier: I see some people in a car approaching a gate into my forest….I run towards them, but hidden in the trees….I want to make sure the gate is secured, but I do not want them to see me….

I am going through a bookstore, riding in a small brown wooden cart….Lots of people are around….I bump into a guy, who is surprised at first, but then looks at me and assumes I am disabled….Ahead of me another guy is frantically and quickly buying lots of paperback kids books….He has kids to entertain….I am buying similar books, but in hardback….Earlier, I am at the house in my old home town, and I see construction is going on down in the lower back part of the house….oh oh, I am alarmed to see three of our cats, including one of the kittens, looking around down there, and going out of our yard….I run around to the front of the house, up to the street, where I see the cats starting to wander away….I try to coax them back to the house….two of them are willing to go with me, but Strauss is looking like he might keep going….

I am in a plane flying over water….My brother is in another plane….Mine crashes suddenly into the water, and I die….Or is it my brother who dies?….A huge tragedy….No one can believe it….I dive into the water to search for remains, but no luck….Every few minutes I realize what has happened, and I go back into the water, desperately seeking to save him….I cry and cry, sadly….I had Julio's cell phone with me, an old large one, in the plane….I wonder how I can contact him to let him know I have it….I think of how there will be no more life for me/my brother, and I cry very hard….Earlier: I am friendly wrestling with our cat Phantom, who is unusually large, as big as I am….oh oh, I worry, is he getting ready to really attack me?….At another point, I am at our Portland house, like in my study but it is open to outside?….I describe to someone why a thick stand of deciduous trees they can see in a nearby area is not a problem; the person thinks those trees should be cut down, but I explain the relations between the deciduous trees and the firs….I show the person how the big leaf maple tree right in front of us is creating shade for the other trees, which I touch and look at closely….The trees are growing in the house, in my study?….Then I am outside on the driveway, looking at the huge trees growing all around the house, and I wonder if some of the trees should be trimmed….Hmmm, if I do it, the tree trunks might fall and hit the house….That would not be good….One of the trees has a very long branch that curves and arcs over the top of the house….At another point I smell dog shit on my shoes….Earlier: a train goes up a large hill, but then starts sliding back down the hill, dangerously….We are alarmed, and try to brace for the impact below….Down at the bottom of the hill, it is an intersection in Berkeley, Shattuck avenue near University avenue?….We get ready….I yell at someone, a girl perhaps, not to do something that disrupts our preparations….I yell very loudly and angrily at this person….

In a car or small bus, I go with a guy who is a big Christian….He just dropped some of his church members off, and I get in….On the freeway, there are lots of big wide trucks that make our lane very narrow, I am unsure if we will make it through without an accident…I am sitting with a woman, we are very friendly and close….I almost flirt with her, but decide not to, she might not be interested….At some point a bad guy starts running past a big train that is stopped at a station….Two cops run after him….Then I grab him, and they all shoot….down he goes….I yell to everyone stop shooting, so I do not get hit….Someone stabs him in the chest for emphasis, and so do I, thrusting a big sword into his chest….Then I walk into a kitchen, my wife is there….It feels weird, after the violent scene, to go into such a calm domestic scene….I see the window is cracked and broken, I ask what happened?….Earlier, I am in the Portland house garage, some other people around….I do this amazing spin and hopping maneuver, keeping my balance with a walking stick while I whirl around, never touching the ground, almost like I am flying….I swirl around until I land on a small circle in the garage, just as I intended….The other people are impressed by me….Later, I am in a big public building, with a long hallway ramp leading down to doors outside….Another guy wearing socks slides down the smooth flooring, it is fun…..I slide down too, faster and better and more graceful than him….I come to an almost perfect stop at the doors, everyone is amazed, I am pleased, that was fun indeed….Later, a woman takes people on a ride out into some water….She offers a huge assortment of old-fashioned candies, very appetizing….She throws a silver ring out in the water, and I go get it as it rests on the surface….Then I find another ring of my own; I add to her magical ring toss with one of my own….Earlier: our cats Levi and Strauss chase a mouse around a place like our house….They are hunting it as I watch and cheer them on….

For some reason I kill someone, then try to find ways to hide it or deflect blame….It happens in a city, and I walk away, trying to decide what if anything I can do….I wonder if people will find the body….I try to get rid of the gun, grabbing it from a place up on a sign and putting it in my waistband, but other people see me….I feel very guilty, and shocked at my own act….Why did I do that?….What will happen to me?….Later I am with a woman on a trip, we are doing some kind of job together….We are in a plane or bus, sitting in seats across from each other….There is a jolt and we accidentally bump into each other….Then she readjusts her bra….She does so a second time, and now I say, as a joke, is everything ok in there?….meaning her breasts….She gets an upset look on her face, and I immediately apologize….I tell her I am sorry, I should not have said that….At another point I am with Al in a weird urban area….He has a problem, loses his wallet?….He goes into dark areas, with lots of bad guys around….I almost leave,  but decide no, that is not cool….So I go back, walking through the dusty dirt under a huge cement overpass….I am wearing boots, the dirt is loose and powdery, and the way is uphill, so I find it tough footing….Later, in a hospital or store, bad guys are trying to pressure someone to talk….Lots of intrigue, I am involved in trying to protect the person….But it is very dangerous….I think hmm, this might be a reason to have a dog, for protection….People hold knives and needle to a person’s throat while they are laying in bed….Very threatening….

Putting a white plastic cutting board in the right side of a sink….Later, I am in the back of a theater or auditorium, and some people go off the stage to my left, while some boys, like from the tv show “Stranger Things,” go up on the stage from the other side, to the right….They are going to give a talk or presentation?....They seem hesitant, unsure of themselves….At another point, someone leans over another person in a hospital bed, to check on them….Suddenly the person in bed stabs the other person in the left side of their neck with a needle….it is shockingly violent….Later, me or someone else sets up a shelter or home for rattlesnakes in the desert….A medium-sized white box, like a bee hive?....it is not too near the house, because that would draw the snakes closer, and the other people would be scared, they would not like that….But it is ok to put the shelter where it is, because the snakes do live in the desert, and they need to shelter somewhere….

I am in the midst of a social scene, a party of some kind, and I go to put on some new shoes….I realize I have put on a mixed pair, not mine….One of the shoes is a very fancy black Nike shoe, the others are strange, not so cool, I do not recognize them….I have socks on, do the shoes that look like sandals go with this?....I do not have any good choices, but I wonder how much I really care….Am I going to flirt at these social events?....No, I should not….So it does not matter what I wear….At another point, I am up on the large roof of a building, looking around….It is a big open space, with lots of social activity up here….I think of the interesting potentials for the people who live here, who must enjoy it….Later, I am in a small airplane….I realize the door next to me is slightly open….That is why other people in the plane are complaining of being cold….With great effort I pull the door closed….I think it is weird to have a door like that, able to open while we are flying….

I am with a group of kids, mostly boys, some girls?....From the “Stranger Things” tv show….We are preparing for a battle, but what we have as weapons are journal articles….The kids do not get it….They see strange page numbers, like in the 600’s and 700’s, and they are confused and worry these high numbers mean large, unwieldy texts….I have to show them that articles are short, with high starting numbers but short ranges, ten to eleven pages overall….Somehow the articles are in black, shiny forms, like the shells of a dark creature….I explain to them this is how it is done with journal articles….Though I still do not know how this will serve us as a weapon….

Something about a play being put on….Sally is directing….She seems confused, disorganized up on stage….I am sitting in the seats, the space is a dark theater with brown seats and wooden stage….Later, I get on a plane for a very short flight….flying with Murva of OSF as another passenger, my guide?....The pilot of the plane is a young guy I do not totally trust, but when the time comes to land he aims at a small cement driveway at a house….I am very nervous when I see it, but the pilot lands the plane no problem….I am impressed….That was so quick! The whole trip there and back too less than an hour, it is only 8:30 am….I am amazed….Then, I walk around an open area, some houses, lots of trees, somewhat near the coast?....As I walk around I see one enormous trunk….absolutely amazing, awe-inspiring.…I look closely at it, and see it’s broken about a hundred feet up; an ancient, massive trunk….And now I look around, I see all the big trees in a ring around the trunk, part of its legacy….I am glad to realize this tree is on our property, I will get to care for it….Then, in the distance, down towards the coast, I see the shadow monster from the tv show Stranger Things, a huge black spider-like creature….I am unsure if it sees me, but I realize if it does it could easily chase me and track me down….Scared, I quickly move off into the thicker trees and brush, trying to decide what to do….After a while I start heading up a trail, through thick bramble, towards a ridge….I am figuring if I can get over the ridge to the other side, the creature probably would not know where to follow me….But it is hard, slow going up the hill, and now I am somewhat in the open, more exposed….

I am in a small cart of some kind, with other people driving….The process has something to do with clothing, fashion….We are trying to get properly dressed for something….We have to wait a while, then turn around and go back the way we came….Other people are in charge, I am just sitting there….The cart is stopped in a one-lane road….Al is involved somehow….I am aware he is doing something, making plans to go off somewhere….

People are asleep in a dorm like house, with two stories….Two guys come into an office in the dorm, to get knives and scissors and other cutting weapons to kill the sleeping people….It is a weird plan, there is no reason for it, the appeal is simply that we can get away with it….This is like an end of a season or a term at school, a transition with lots of comings and goings….it would be easy to get away with….As the two guys approach the office, I am scared of the one coming from the ground floor, a sullen guy in a dirty bathrobe….I back away from him, worried he might try to attack me….Once they are gone again, I put my weapons down and I quickly walk away….Suddenly I want nothing to do with this, it disgusts and upsets me that I even thought about it….I walk through buildings towards the street, through corridors, past some families waiting outside….they are concerned, I see a mom who sees me coming out, and she knows something is wrong….I go out into the street….I go through a store, like a fancy clothing store….An old, not well-dressed woman in a white blouse is lounging on a chair; probably not the kind of customer the store wants hanging out, I think to myself….I go through the revolving doors to get back out to the street, and pass some odd small person on the other side of the glass….Earlier, before going into the dorm, I go up a water tube of some kind, like at a water play park, then I go back down it, steep with a sharp right turn at the bottom….At some point a play is being cast, and I want a small part; definitely not a speaking role, but something that takes me onstage….I realize I may not get it, even though I am a board member….which is weird, I realize….Much earlier, I am walking near a creek or channel of water going downhill at a fairly steep angle….

I am in a car, a white SUV, with my wife in the passenger seat….We are in a parking garage, maybe near a street….I start rolling backwards, and I cannot control the brakes….I try to slow us down, but cannot….I get very worried, and tell my wife in panic that I cannot stop it, I do not know what to do….I think of all the things I might hit….I hope we will be ok, but I am waiting for an impact at any moment….Then we end up fine, I see the car stopped in a parking place along the curb of a nice house on a residential street, green lawn and trees, other people there….a family of African-Americans?….like they are having a family gathering, a barbecue, nice sunny day….Phew, I am relieved….

Lots of people are given poker chips, little black round discs….each chip has five different possible values….Everyone expects that each of the values will require the person to shrink things, get smaller….But as a surprise, the last two values, 4 and 5, lead to bigger extensions….I thought all the values would lead to shrinking and pulling back….But that is just for 1, 2, and 3….At some point I am driving a car, and I am stopped in front of a line of traffic passing horizontally across my way….All of us under a cement overpass….Some other people in cars are off to my left and right, trying to go the same direction I’m going….I see a gap in traffic, and even though no one says it is ok, I quickly dash across the street to the other side….

A mousy woman in a nice suit, light blond or gray hair, is telling me something….Like she is an official informing me of something….I am unhappy about it, slightly annoyed, though I do not say anything….Later, I go into a small weird room, my wife’s bedroom?....There are lots of clothes on the floor, a dresser, a bed, and a shower stall in the room; all very strange, cramped….I did not know about this, but it seems appropriate for her….For some reason I get the idea of trying on one of her robes, or some of her clothes….But I have to pee really badly, so I do not stay there long enough to try….Then I am in a busy town, like a resort, lots of people around….I walk down a road, down a slight hill away from the town center….I go to a big McDonalds restaurant….I am going to interview someone, like for research?....When I go inside, all the workers are sitting down, there is no rush now, they are resting….At another point I walk into a small gym, where the Blazers are playing basketball….Barely any other people around….I see the Blazers have the ball under the other team’s basket, but no one is ready for a pass….I yell out, hey, that guy needs help!....It is helpful I say that, the other players turn and get the pass….But an official sitting at the scorer’s table on the other side of the court from me looks at me, and I am afraid he will make me leave….But instead to my surprise he is friendly and says you can come in now….Later, I see two pictures of an army after taking over a city….One of the pictures is calm, everyone sitting down….The other is more active, tense….at the bottom, guys with horses, soldiers with sharp noses and shifty eyes….They are still going to fight….I mention while looking at the pictures that I still had my shirt off for the second one, with the fighting going on….I am pleased with myself as I point this out….

Some people are holding a young woman captive….They play weird music in her room, give her things that do not give her the choices she wants….She is confused, and I do not know why they are keeping and treating her like this….Someone and I are playing a weird little game of baseball in a kitchen….The person is sitting on a counter, pitching to me….I swing and miss, down to my last strike….I decide to swing no matter what, just to keep it fun….The pitch is low, I swing and miss….In mock anger I grab a huge metal pot of cooked oatmeal and start dumping it on the floor….As I do so I say I will clean it all up….And I notice that lots of oatmeal will still be in the pot, fine to eat after I’m done….

A young woman singer is put upon somehow, mistreated….People are trying to make her do things she does not want to do….She seems trapped in the situation….I am sympathetic with her….Some of the objects being used are dark blue….

I am in a large indoor pool, during the daytime….Other people are around….Someone and I grab hold of some tubes or hoses under water and swim while pulling them….Like we are trying to pull someone out of the pool?....As a joke?....But then some other people from the other side of the pool, where we are swimming towards, reach through openings above and start trying to pull on us, as another surprising level to the joke….So we have to pull back the other way….The scene has a yellow cast, the building seems rather old, faded….At one point I am grateful to a woman who helped me with the pool scene….I try to put back together a little cardboard box with little tubes and personal care products, which she had given me as a gift….But the box will not fold back into place properly….I was going to give it back to her, but now I cannot….

I see a couple of big cardboard boxes, brown, laying on the ground….One of them has a little hole in the corner….I think about lifting one of the boxes upright….At another point, something about actors, a young woman among them….

In a big hall or auditorium, with lots of people….It is time for people to leave….A guy (taller than me, older) and I happen to stand up, and suddenly everyone thinks we are going to give a helpful talk explaining what to do….Neither of us intends any such thing, but the group gets up and people start arguing about what to do next….The guy and I, who did not know each other beforehand, are both surprised and want to avoid that, so we go into the next room where everyone will eventually have to go next anyway, once they are done talking and arguing….We know this, so we just get there and wait for the others….I do not want to be leading that group, and neither does he….

I am with some people, inside somewhere….An older guy is there, wealthy….He has a check for lots of money with him….We all go down an escalator….At the bottom, I get off fine and start walking….But for the other people it is too steep, they cannot figure out how to get off….Lots of people behind me fall at the bottom, land on the ground awkwardly….I go back and help them….The older guy just fell to the floor and lay there, without even putting his arms out to break his fall….I wonder, is he dead?….I see a body wrapped completely in dark gray plastic….Is that him?….no, I see him later….There is another escalator going down, like in a mall….

I am with some people….We are taking care of someone….A woman….But for some reason her skin turns brown….I wonder, why?....Is it bad?....Maybe….At another point I am walking through a neighborhood, with nice hills, trees, a hillside….But I do not belong?....Later, something about a button….a red button on a brown wooden wall….I push it….

I see racing machines or cars, going fast along a road, very close to each other....My perspective is close to the ground, looking up at the machines as they go....I see a little black machine or device, a spy?, as it moves forward and attaches to the car ahead of me....The black thing fits into a slot in the back left corner of the car....But then someone else sees it or becomes aware of it, and will try to remove it?....

I am helping with a restoration process, getting things back in health....There are lots of sticks, vines, and branches involved, but they are dry and woody, not a problem, easy to clear away....Later, I walk with someone to our house, and I point out several black guys scattered around on a large open field, sitting in chairs with guns, waiting....I tell my companion they are waiting for an attack....I go to one of the guys sitting by the front door of the house, and I lean close and say softly, I would rather you not come in the house, but if you need more guns or ammunition, let me know and I will help....At another point, I see Michelle Pfeiffer, completely naked, laying on her stomach and looking at me with a mischievous smile....wow, she is beautiful, and we both seem to be aroused....

Something about an investigation….Some people really want it done with, but it is not over yet….I see an image of an array of ink spots, splayed randomly to the left of an imaginary vertical line….It seems like a brand image, or a title page, something to show other people….This is supposed to signify the investigation is done and in the past now….Later, I see three people walking outside, in a widely spaced single file….One of them, the one in the middle, is a small woman in an enormous bright green dress, fancy and old-fashioned, strangely wide on either side….This seems weird to me….

I am going through a city, up and down hilly streets, like in San Francisco….A black dog starts running with me….I am nice to it, and now several other dogs are following me….I know people sitting up in the houses are watching me as I am friendly with all the dogs….We get to the top of the steep hill, and now I have to crawl to get to the crest….Later, I am with a guy, my brother maybe, and we go on a little boat….We are going to another place, across a body of water….I bring a machete, since we are going to need metal tools when we get there….I hide the machete behind where we are sitting, so no one else in the boat gets worried, the owners won’t freak out….But then I realize it is ok to bring the tools, so I get the other ones and put them behind us on the bench too….At another point I climb a big cliff, along the shore of the ocean….I get to the top and look down….Lots of people there, and I hear them mention ducks in the water….Oh no, my brother raises a shotgun, aims, and shoots at one of the ducks close to shore, killing it….No!....I yell Boo! to express how mad and unhappy I am….I throw one of my gloves down towards them in anger, but the glove floats to the left and lands in the top of a tree with pink blossoms….I say aloud, why do we have to kill things like that?....There is no sport to it, we do not need to eat it….Later, I am in Vinton’s house, working on a puzzle with my wife….Some little wooden objects on a table, we are trying to arrange them properly….It is fun, engrossing….I just smoked some plums, and suddenly I realize I should not do that here, openly in his house….I apologize, and he says it is ok, but do make sure the smoke goes outside….I can tell he is unhappy about it….I feel bad….Later, I am outside in a city, there is some kind of college festival going on, lots of activities, people walking around….I want to tell the guy in charge that hey, I organized this same festival when I was a senior in college….Though now I think of it, I can barely remember any of it, how much work I must have done to make it happen….I am outside on a street, and realize I am only wearing socks and shorts, and carrying a brown overcoat…. Hmm, I wonder, can I walk home like this?....Sure, I decide….I try to toss a leaf into a square space created by tall metal fencing, like a container for something, but the leaf keeps floating out and away….I decide that is ok….

A woman is in charge of a process of cleaning a house….By dancing?....Performing?....But she stops at a certain point, there is too much stuff in the house….boxes, furniture, etc….It makes it harder for her to do what she is doing….I am attracted to her, there is a positive sexual vibe and energy between us throughout the scene….

Something about tomatoes, growing lots of them....I am in charge of taking care of lots of plants....Too many?....I am unsure I can manage it all....Later, I am with a bunch of people in an outside area at the base of a steep hill....There's a retaining wall, and a backyard to a house with people hanging out on lounge chairs, around a pool perhaps?....But I look up and see shadows in the trees above on the hill....They are soldiers running for cover....I worry they are going to attack us....We are very vulnerable....I keep looking up, wondering will they attack?....maybe....it would be so easy for them to drop hand grenades on us....But then I wonder why would they do that....I am pretty sure they are from Canada, a neighboring country, so why would they want to do us harm?....
There are problems staging Othello....the first part of the play is its own little unit....The main actor is there, but it is a weird situation....Like a self-contained box?....

Something about play rehearsals….I know they are ending, but it is not yet time to say so?....I can see the rehearsals as little units….They seem interchangeable with the big pillows in my bed….I wonder, will I need help from someone else?....

Lots of people are getting ready for rehearsals….Women in beautiful dresses, gowns, I admire them….At some point I see a mattress laying crooked on the floor, it has been peed on?....Some of the guys wonder if they have time to go outside and do other things….Look at the production from a different angle….Yes, that is ok….

Lots of acting people are in a small yard or outside area….This is the last stage of a process of rehearsal….They must go to a pool and put little bricks into the water?....I see a big round wheel of the bricks, or rectangular units, floating in the air above us….The water is waist deep, I am standing there with the others….At some point there is a romantic aspect between me and a woman?....quiet, but real and pleasurable….No one quite knows what to do, they seem rather confused….Two people over by the side of the pool have darker bricks….Ours are white?....

Cam is doing things, but he gets more responsibility than he wants….Other people are supposed to come and be in charge, but it is just him….He is unhappy about that….Now he has to take care of two or three other things, it makes him flustered….A little dog is somewhere around?....I see a large oval silver platter, with some food on it….At another point, I see lots of discarded signs, for directions….Pointing to Cleveland?....

I go to this big new house or ranch….A man and his daughter are moving in….I see some boxes, other things that have been brought into the house, but not yet unpacked and put away….I go inside, then out back into the yard….I look around….No one is there, it is all so nice….though not lived in yet….tan walls and fences and buildings, tan grass fields….Lots of room and potential, but nothing happening right now….At one point I see some baby pigs….I try to pet them, not scare them….They are so adorable and cute….I bend down and pet one of them who is friendly with me….Very soft pink skin….little soft creatures….Then, inside the house, someone is hassling me while I sit at a table and fiddle with little objects in a bag….Then a woman comes into the room….She looks like the dark-haired actress from OSF?....She is nice to me, we touch briefly, then she tells the other people to stop and leave me alone….She is very forceful to them on my behalf….I am relieved and grateful to her….

I am in a group of people doing some cooking things….Barack Obama is there, he is dealing with a Thanksgiving turkey?....he is having some difficulties with it, I find that amusing....At another point it’s like I am out in space and I see lots of planets with rings like Saturn….very cool, beautiful….

I am running around, lots of people doing agitated, active things, I’m unsure why….going in and out of houses….I find a machine gun in one of the rooms, amid some piles of clothes….A black Thompson machine gun, a good thing for me….I will need it….I am not sure it works, and I wonder if it would be good to test it, but I realize there is no easy way to do that….But I do wonder, will it work if I try shooting it?....It seems fragile, like the parts are barely holding together….But now I do feel confident, having it in my hands during all this mayhem….

I am with a group of people outside, we are upset with some other people who are misbehaving….Somehow they have gotten away with four different things, but we feel they should have gotten in trouble for all four of them….I see an image of four slots, with vertical lines, and a horizontal line on top; the things they have done have stayed below, seemingly nothing, but we want everything to be seen above the line….A person in authority is happy with us about that, agrees with our feelings….Earlier: I see a guy with a black mustache….I see someone trying to plant a golden poppy plant in a jar of pool water from our pool here?....I doubt it will grow that way….

I am at a big party for the new president….I go with some kids, but then they run off, go exploring….They go into a new set of rooms, but they do so by going through a small square opening, with a white wooden frame….I cannot fit through there….I wonder if I should try to force it, but I look at it carefully….there is no way, it’s too small….I wonder if the kids will be ok on the other side?....Probably….Later I am in a rather open bathroom, sitting on a toilet, when lots of people come in and walk by….Like a new bus load of people just arrived at the party….Morgana is one of them?....I say hi to people and shake someone’s hands, then say aloud, this is too social….I get up from the toilet with a swift, privacy covering move, and leave….I wander around the big rooms of the party venue, like a large hotel….Wow, it is very lavish….I look out a window at the city below, and for a moment I see a flash of a white shirt; are the kids out there, climbing up from lower stories?....I cannot quite tell, but as I lean against the window to look down, I realize a guy who’s a window cleaner is to my left, doing his job….I have been kneeling down on his dark red rug platform rig, without knowing it, and it’s a little unstable, so to be nice to him I stand up and leave….Later I see #45, he is leaning over a table, looking at the hair of a famous guy sitting at the table, some new detail of his sideburns, like a curly lock….The president doesn’t like it, thinks it’s a bad change, but the guy does not care at all….At another point I am outside on a patio, and for some reason I am laying on my left side on a patch of gray gravel….I try to subtly lift my body using only my arms, like a gymnastics move, but it is too hard….A black and white cat is sitting nearby, it looks at me with curiosity….I realize I am making too much effort to do this, it is too obvious, so I stop and get up….I go inside, realizing I am wearing old faded jeans and a gray hoodie….is this clothing too casual for such a fancy gathering?....I decide that is ok, I do not like this party anyway….Earlier, I see a woman I know, like in a big hallway or airport, and she hugs me….We talk while embracing….She is a couple inches taller than me, which is a little odd, but comforting, too….This is such a public place, I wonder if other people I know will see me, wonder why I am hugging this woman….I decide so what, I do not care….Earlier: I see some vegetable boxes, filled with food for people?....Also, I see a woman I have seen before….She is suddenly younger than before, and we meet in a dark wood-paneled attic....I say we have seen each other, and she seems to remember, but not as strongly as I do….I am very happy about it….

I am part of an OSF play process, putting a show together, lots of positive energy….It is going fast, they have cast a couple of actresses already, one black, one white….I am not sure I want to go so fast, but I realize they have good reason for doing so….But of course I will not be a performer in the show, that is not what I want….

Someone tries to fake others out by switching out objects, like orange plastic cups, to make it look like they are not interfering in a process….But I know they are interfering….At some point, Cam and Mitchell are involved….
Something about a cat, and lots of green ferns….

I see a sheet of white paper with a diagram of three things….The phases of the King?….One on the right is a tree trunk, a fairly young tree, brown bark, long and thin….The other two on the left are the king in royal fashion, also long and thin, rather abstract, but adorned with clothes and finery….This is where he eventually leads, toward this tree trunk….It is a very clear image….Later, I am walking through a restaurant, and my companion says my black and green camouflage backpack accidentally bumped a kid on the head as I passed….The kid is sitting at the bar of the restaurant, crying….someone is else is with him, a parent I presume….I go back to the kid and apologize, talk to him nicely, try to make it better….At another point I see a little pile of white objects, close to me in a shadowy space….I pick one up, it’s the skull of a mouse….They are all little mouse skulls….

There is some kind of written document I do not like, it gets my identity wrong….I am angry about it, and I do not like it when the document goes public….Something about a couple, a man and woman, they are romantic….I am happy for them, but somehow they are part of the bigger problem and mis-identification….
It is time to bring the play production to the stage, but a couple of assistant directors say wait, we have changes to make first….Everyone else is ok with it, but not me….

I am on a big gray rock or boulder outside with another person….We are slowly climbing down the rock, picking things off the rock that people left behind or dropped?....I go down too low, and feel my momentum starting to slide down….I realize I am about to fall, and I say it’s ok, here I go….The rock is above a creek, and I fall down into the water….The water is deeper than I expect, though, and I wonder with a little fear if I will be able to push off the bottom and get back to the top….

Lots of security guards are around….A show is supposed to go on, but the organizer says no, not yet….We have to deal with security issues first….I see little black objects, like traffic cones, are all around, marking the security issues….I feel the show should go on now, they should stop waiting and delaying….At some point, I hear Mitchell from the Modern Family television show say to no one in particular, of course I’m gay, in a weary whisper….

The music for the Dream Ballet from Oklahoma! plays, and different figures go where they should go….stopping and starting to the plinking tune….Later: I seem to be in my study, looking out the window, and I see Levi our cat out on the driveway….He is not moving, and I wonder if he is ok?....I worry there is something wrong with him….Later: I have a long gun, a rifle….This is part of being in a war of some kind?....
