I am going through some process….I think I know what it is about, but I turn out to be wrong….It is much more complicated than I thought….Two people who I think are doing little things are actually doing very complex things….And somehow I have disrupted it for them….At some point I see a pair of long black leather gloves, like for a fancy party or formal wear….

I watch some kind of contest, with two opponents going in opposite circles, preparing to confront each other….I wonder, will they actually meet and fight?….It is unclear if they really will….At some point, someone delivers two cooked eggs to my wife….It is a prelude to her going in the contest?….She starts cutting into the white cooked egg with a knife and fork, and I think oh oh, my wife likes a runny yolk in her eggs, and this looks like it is too hard cooked….I am concerned for those who brought it to her, she will not like this….

Some kind of event is about to start, but a person is going to show me things first….This person is being nice to me, preparing me?….At another point, I see a white car driving around in a big square….

I am driving a car down a hill, and suddenly I spin out….The car twirls and flies through the air, then I come down and land on the road again and keep driving, like nothing happened….It is both weird and scary….Earlier, people are trying to get me to do something before a show, some kind of preparation….

I am walking down a city street, and I get concerned that people are getting ready to attack or do bad things….To my surprise I am brought to a huge black-gray bull….A couple of small dark gray animals, maybe small bulls, are standing next to it as guards….It wants me to know, but it will not hurt me….I am scared, and in awe….

It is suddenly announced that I am the head of the new Artistic Director search at OSF….This is surprising news, but fun….OK, I will do it, I agree….Lots of people are already helping, so it will not be that hard….What an energizing project!....I am surprised but excited….Later, someone gives me a tray of plants in little containers….Hmmm, it looks like they need to be watered, they seem rather dry….But I realize I can do that, I can take care of them, planting and watering them….

As part of a gift program, people are given four boxes with living things in them….Two of them are full-sized people, or at least simulations of them….They are all parts of a bigger process or show, lots of happiness and excitement among the people receiving the boxes….But I see through all that, I know there is something more going on, more complicated….One of the figures is stitched together from many parts, somehow it is alive….the figure does not know, but I do….The other whole figure gets bathed in water….

Some guy is giving out a box with special things in it….I am surprised but pleased….There is a big square behind me, and the guy brings the box around the square before giving it to me….At another point, my wife goes outside the kitchen door and starts to close it, but to our surprise, Levi our cat quickly tries to rush inside….Oh oh, I worry he is caught in the door, and hurt….I open the door to let him go free….

A process gets going, and it has a show at the middle….I get back to my room, and I see some new people are going in….This is the next wave of people, after the first story is told….Earlier, a Shakespeare play is being put on, and we have people for the cast….But more people than we need?....The question now becomes how to get them all into the show….More and more people keep showing up….I go back and forth between wondering how we will get them all in, and feeling confident this is just how it is supposed to be, what I should be helping to do, create an expanded cast, bigger and better….At another point, I am in Bud’s room, when he is not there….I go into the bathroom, and to my surprise he comes back....I say I will leave soon, and he looks at the open toilet, with brown shit in it, and says make sure to flush….

Some people take care of mom inside a facility of some kind….She does not know what is going on, but I am sure it is good and ok, I am glad about it….She sits patiently while they do their things….Later, some other people are looking at me with skepticism?....I do not know what their problem is….

There is a heavy bucket or container outside that a couple of guys (one of them an OSF actor) are trying to move….I am willing to help them, but I am concerned the metal wire handle will hurt my hands when I lift….But when I go to get some gloves from a nearby car, the guys are almost done with the job….I delayed too much….

I am in a play, indoors, in a small dark theater….I am playing a king, and I cannot quite read my lines from the pages I have in my hand….I wonder with some anxiety, should I say them exactly as I read them, or should I summarize and say it in my own words?....Fortunately I have a small part, and others go on with the dialogue after me….As I stand there, I realize all the male performers are naked….hmm, it is part of the play, so seems normal, but I also think it is a little weird….The play goes on, and in a scene with a young guy, he accidentally knocks his head against a metal can….The young students in the audience, who know the guy already, laugh in amusement….Later, I am walking up a forest trail, out of a residential area, bearing to the right, gently pushing tree branches with green needles out of my way, and I think of how much I liked being a professor, teaching students in hard classes….At some point, I am driving a car in a city area with lots of pedestrians around….I am confused about where to go, and decide I have to turn around….I turn right into what I think is an alley, where I can make a three point turn, but it turns into a narrow lane, with a big metal pole at the end….So I have to back out the way I came….It will be hard, and I wonder if I can do it?....yes, I manage….At another point I see my wife sitting at her work desk, like in a huge auditorium or gym….All the other workers are walking by, saying hello to her, everyone is very friendly and happy, she is consumed with it….I see a bong on the very front of the desk, is that ok?....apparently so, she is ok with that….I cannot get her attention to say goodbye, there are too many people talking to her….Earlier, my sister says my niece like to have dinners around their house’s kitchen island best, informal, unstructured, that is how she will talk the most….Earlier, I am driving down a big hill on a freeway, and an old red car or station wagon turns off abruptly to the right….I wonder why?....a strange and potentially dangerous move….But then I see there is a driveway by the side of the freeway, going to a country home, and now it makes sense to me….

I am going down some stairs, carrying a cool type of electric guitar….I come out onto a deck, where a bunch of guys from a famous rock band, maybe Metallica?, are sitting….This is like a hotel rooftop lounge area….As I walk by the guys, I pretend to play the guitar in a goofy way….They laugh at my joke….Then I go and sit on a bench, where another guy is sitting….I think to myself, I really do not know how to play the guitar….It would be very embarrassing to have to acknowledge that in public….Later, a kid reads two articles in the newspaper, on the same page….One is about people, the other about animals….Both are about breeding, and controlled reproduction….I think it is a puzzling and rather aggressive editorial combination, putting the two articles together like that….It is making a point about people, they are not much better than animals….
I am sitting outside by two poles or metal posts….Someone comes and tells me bad news….I was not expecting it, I thought things were going well….Now I am unsure what to do about it….
DeLanna is telling her stories….I see little elements of it….She adds some new elements, from our story….I like that….I wonder, where will it lead?….

Something about Bud helping me out with a project….Other people get going on creating the workshop space….They focus on defenses, protections, relationships….OK, I think to myself, if that is what you prepare for, that is what you will get….But that is only one way to do it….

I am driving a car down a hill on a freeway, with other people in the car, when we suddenly hit a deep pool of water at the bottom of the hill….The car slams to a stop and flips forward onto the roof, then keeps flipping, and I suddenly realize the car may end up back on its wheels like normal….I hope and almost will the car to keep going until it lands that way, and it does….I am thrilled, it’s like the accident never happened….I say to everyone, you are ok, yes?….Like it was nothing….But I realize that is too quick, the other people are freaking out from fear and shock….

I am driving on a wide freeway, with lots of cars also on the road….Over a hill and a way ahead, I see several police cars with their red and blue lights flashing, on either side of the road….I realize I should slow down, but as I come over the hill and start down toward the police, I realize I am going very fast, almost 80 mph, and sliding across the lanes….worried, I need to slow down and get control again….At another point, I am at beach on a sunny day, with my wife….Something is wrong with her bathing suit….It is not attached correctly?….To help her, I crawl under and between her legs, from front to back, which is awkward….that is a very weird bodily situation for her….I wonder, how do I fix the bathing suit?….It is difficult, because I am not trying to think about this as a sexual situation, but rather as a problem to be solved….I am unsure I can succeed in this….Some guy, an authority of some sort, is observing to make sure it is dealt with….

I am in the kitchen with my wife, in a house that is ours but I do not recognize….The phone rings, and I answer….A woman’s voice says, you now have six properties, what will you do with them now?….I ask who is calling….She does not say….I am worried it is a local person who is hassling me somehow, and I am aware my wife can hear my side of the conversation, which makes me want to be clear and strong….I say again, who are you?….She says you do not know who you were this morning….I say I know exactly who I was, and I know what you are talking about….But if you will not tell me who you are, I am hanging up in ten seconds….I now see a small Asian woman sitting in a chair in a corner near the phone….But I know my wife cannot see her….The woman says fifteen seconds….I say no, ten….I start to count down as I look at her, nine, eight, seven….She curls up and hides in her clothes as I finish the countdown fast, four three two one, and I hang up….I am surprised, scared, and angry….The call comes early in the morning, 7 am?….Earlier, I keep trying thinking of a way to do more with the artists group, but without adding more time now, which we do not have….But I cannot….I think of how this seems to illustrate a principle of conservation of time and energy….One form will inevitably lead to another form….At some point, I pull a car out of a small dirt road onto the freeway, trying to get away from something?….As I start driving fast, I see a woman, white, sitting by the right side of the road….She is curled in a small ball, and I make sure to steer clear of her….

It is like I am the ranch, but in a different kind of house….I see a hawk in the sky….Then I cannot see it….Where did it go?....Oh, there, very high up….I call towards it, and to my surprise it comes down to me….It lands on the balcony of my second floor room….Wow, that is amazing!....But I wonder if it will come into the house….I have to close the balcony glass doors and windows so it will not fly into the house….I see the hawk’s backside, it has some teeth around its ass?....That seems strange, perhaps it is a secondary way of eating and digesting food?....Then I am taking a shit, but there is no toilet paper….Suddenly I see my nieces walking outside….They are going down to the creek for breakfast….and now my sister wants to come into the house for something….I am very anxious, and try to wipe my ass before she comes in….I go deal with her, then I realize I got out of bed without writing down a dream….So I go back to bed….I walk past the master bedroom, where I see the sheets and blankets have been slept in, and Strauss our cat is laying there asleep on the big bed….Before: some people and I get into an old, beat-up car, parked next to a sidewalk in a modest, quiet neighborhood….I start to jump through the open window on the passenger side, but realize I should be driving….So I go around and hop in, as do the others with me….we all jump through the windows, not using the doors of the car….who owns it?....we do not know….it is not ours, but no one is taking care of it, so it seems ok for us to use it….But then as I get ready to drive, I wonder, will we get in trouble if the police stop us for any reason?....I do not know anything about the registration of the car….

I see several images of the wives of politicians, how the women actually feel disgust with the process they have to go through….These are candid images of their facial expressions when they think no one is looking at them….One woman sitting in a darkened auditorium, in the audience, and I see her turn her head and frown in displeasure….I agree with them….Later, I join a small group of people meeting to work on some common project….The outside people ask me why I was chosen for this job….I say, softly, I have no idea, I am too new to the company….I do my work, and that is all I can discuss….I speak softly, but I am trying to forcefully deflect the question….It is none of their business….They seem too assertive, too focused on their own activities….They do not see or appreciate all the rest going on in this process….
Someone is skeptical about the artists project….We have to set up a meeting to show them how it works….It takes some time to arrange the meeting, there are many complications and delays….
Someone is asking about the artists project, at a meeting….We try to explain what is going on….A girl, the daughter of that person, is there, we tell her about it, too….

A woman with a long, torn piece of white paper is helping us set up a final performance….How do we do it, with that kind of material, in that kind of condition?....it is hard to figure out exactly what to do….A large ball or sphere is also involved….I am thinking of doing something different….

Two women are very interested in learning about our process at the workshop….We try to show them….We are pulling things out of a purse?….Earlier, I am in a building with lots of bare white rooms….A house of some kind….I have a sense of many mysteries here….I am curious….

People want to bring a new round of reflections on the workshop here, to where I live, in this country….I am very surprised, and not ready for it….I see two big black piles of shiny, sharp-edged debris….Other people get to work elaborating on one of the piles; the new reflections start with this material….I look at the other pile and think there is so much to do, so many possibilities to explore….At one point I am in an audience of well-dressed people who are watching intently to see what is going to happen next….We are in the audience, too, dressed more casually, but we are actively doing it, not just observing….

Everyone is getting ready to do new projects for the workshop….They are bringing their things and materials here, to the U.S….But Isla is the hardest to handle….There is a question of how to set her up properly….A challenge for her and us….At some point someone says to her, you have to cut the work open to show what is inside….This would force her to make her work a bright, feminine color, like yellow, orange, or pink….This is not what she wants….I wonder how to help her….

I am doing something with complex cameras….A dog almost takes my ring without my knowing it….Earlier, I am in Kensington, in the family room, but it is different….Instead of a wall facing the street, there are three old windows….I wonder if they are safe and secure enough….They do not look like they close tightly….I will have to find a way to fix them….On the other side of the street I see Omika, Teresa, and Shana walking on the sidewalk, like they are coming back from school, with backpacks….They seem very happy and chatty with each other….I wonder, should I say hi?....Earlier, there is a photo project with the workshop group, and the process is going to start with me….But my set-up is not very good, complex, or interesting, and nothing of use gets going….I say, let’s start with someone else, and come back to me….

A guy is helping us in the workshop with creative activities….He is somehow pushing dirt through things?....using his fingers to push dirt through a big chunk of rock?....Later, my wife and I are walking down a sidewalk in a city during the daytime….We are both wearing thick, soft white terry-cloth towels or robes, naked underneath, and aroused….At another point, I am outside in a yard that seems abandoned, in a city with lots of junk around….On the other side of the fence, a garbage guy is picking stuff up….I try to avoid being seen, but his big hand comes through the fence, reaching for other pieces of junk to take away….I see from his hand it is a black guy….I finally say hi to him, as it seems too awkward to keep hiding….

I see a guy with white chalk on his face, part of some special performance?....And I have to deal with a woman who is obnoxious to me….Then, a different scene, outside in a big city like Chicago, in the lower courtyard of a tall apartment building….I look out at the lake, or ocean, and see an enormous wave, with cresting white foam, looming in the distance, coming our way….I seem to know where it comes from, maybe an asteroid strike?....At first I think, I will just hurry up to the top floor of the building myself, without telling anyone else, there is no time….But then I start doing everything I can to tell other people and get them to move to safety, go up fast….I run through the halls, down into the patio, telling everyone to go go go….I follow a guy and his dog down into the basement, telling them no, go up!....The dog finally comes, but the guy is slower….Up in a room about midway up the building I tell a couple of people the wave will hit soon, and right at this level….I take the woman by the shoulders and point her in the direction of the wave, which we can see in the distance as it approaches the shoreline and all the tall buildings lined up there….There it is, I say, now go!....At some point I go to my room, quickly pack a bag, and wonder if I have a book of stories I can bring to read to the family during the dark time after the wave hits….I keep going around the building, and come to a room where a woman is sitting listlessly in a chair, with her child on her lap….she looks like Kate Winslet?....I yell let’s go, but they do not move….I go in the bathroom, run water on my hands, and throw it on them to get them to respond….They finally get up and start moving….Then I tell the other two young women sitting in the room, please just go, I cannot yell any more….

I am with a young woman, she is preparing various magical spells and rites….She is using simple objects and items from around the house….I am impressed by how clever and resourceful she is….She is turning simple things into sources of power….There is a round rattan or straw place mat that she finds and is using for something….It has an amazing spiral in it….My eye is drawn to that spiral….

I am driving with my father-in-law down a narrow onramp to a freeway….There is road construction on the right side, and our car clips the side of a yellow work vehicle, a tractor or something….Our car spins around, out of control for a moment, until I regain control of the wheel….We are ok, but it is scary, and I am annoyed at the other vehicle for being parked too close to an active road….Now the front bumper of our car is dragging on the ground, that is a big hassle to fix….Later, a woman is leading a process of moving to Indiana?....I am part of it….Little squares of chocolate are unwrapped as part of it…
A small dark-haired woman is doing something….I do not think it is a good idea, but she seems determined and focused and enthusiastic about it, so I let her go on with it….

A woman and I are leaving a place….She starts to walk ahead, but I want to check our room for books I might have forgotten….Instead of walking up the stairs, I start climbing on the railing, going up the outside of the building….very thin white tubes are dangling around me, and I hold onto one as I step up onto the railing and try to grab the one above me, to pull myself up….But the main horizontal pillars are big round white tubes, and I cannot get a good grip….I have to use the stairs….Later, I am walking in a city and thinking about where to have dinner….I walk around the corner, and the restaurant we wanted to go to is under construction….Lots of scaffolding, debris in front of it….I see a class of school kids standing in line at a nearby place….I wonder, are they waiting to go inside and eat?....Somehow this reminds me of Juan, like all the kids resemble him….

Outside I see a weird, thick black cloud with strange pointy tendrils approaching from a city….I am unsure what it is, but I worry it is something bad, dangerous….I make sure everyone in our group is inside….I see a woman outside, doing something up on a cement walkway with metal railings….I call for her to come inside quickly, before the cloud reaches us….She starts coming back towards me at the door….I look back and forth from her to the cloud, and I wonder, will she make it in time?....Yes, she will….

I arrive into a group, magically?....I have some black bags filled with arts equipment….I am going to teach them things….But it turns out the people need me for a much more mundane task….OK, I can do that, it is helpful in a different way….Another arts guy is also involved….He magically appears, too, with black bags, and they need him to help for the same reason….

my wife and I are out on a residential street….She leads us through a door and semi-enclosed passage, a private entrance to a large open yard and garden….We will walk through it together to the other side….my wife is confident it is ok with the owners to do this, but I wonder if this is allowed….I follow her through….Fern has been waiting nearby in a car, and as we go through the door, she starts driving the car, to meet us on the other, far side of the yard….Earlier, I see two cars on a street, parked at strange angles to each other next to a sidewalk….it looks awkward, and I wonder what happened….I think it must have resulted from something bad or problematic….

I get an avatar, or a double, of myself….A big black figure….Everyone has a double like this?....The question now is how to feed and care for it….How best to do so?....The avatar gets different food and drink from normal people….We have to keep that point clearly in mind….

I am with a group of people in a friendly social situation….We come up with the idea of putting our special people on separate teams, in groups of four, to see how they look and perform….Some of the combinations are much better than others….Some of the members are superstar athletes, others are just regular people….The teams with just normal people are rather disappointing, not as organized or dynamic….The other teams are amazing, everyone loves and enjoys watching them….

I am working with the arts group, trying to figure out our next alternatives….it is hard to envision how we will make it work in smaller groups, not all at once….I focus on the women, helping to set them up….Then, without my wanting it, the process just starts up again….and away we go….Earlier: I fall from a great height….As I go down I see where I might land….on a tennis court?....A grassy area near it?....I do land, and I seem fine….Before that, Bud and I walk into a café, with lots of people at tables, eating and drinking….A small black guy with gray-black curly leads us inside….He already knows, is friendly with Bud….When I say I am Bud’s father, the guy is surprised….He looks at us, and I can tell he wonders if I am too young to be a father of someone so old….

I am with a big guy outside, going around a curve….There are little black spots on him, and on me?....Later, a man and a woman bend down to the ground to fiddle with something, a package perhaps….They are behind a big curved wall….

Something about a black water bottle….A young woman points out that it is empty, it needs filling….Earlier, I am in an apartment building, walking across a long curved room….something about my mother?....

I am in an apartment building….I am with some people, and we know some obnoxious guys are coming back into the room….Two of the people I’m with jump behind a couch then sneak out of the room….I jump behind the couch and cover myself with a long foam pillow, scared and hoping the obnoxious guys will not see me and make me come out….They probably will see me, I am not very well hidden….I go to another room in the building, which is kind of like a hotel resort, and I hear something out on the deck….I turn and see a big toucan bird, practically talking to me….I do not want it to come inside, so I close the sliding glass doors….But I realize the bird can open the doors pretty easily….So I have to latch it shut….Later, I am in a room, and outside I see Ronald put a little piece of brown shit in the back fold of a woman’s white t-shirt as she walks by….as a joke….Someone else says do not do that, and angrily tries to take it out of the shirt….Ronald laughs, and tries to get it out too….At some point, I go into a room where lots of people are sitting down at tables, like a restaurant….They clearly do not expect me to be there….

Someone tries to set me up in a nice house….at some point, I see a yellow goblet of water on the floor of a living room, on an old yellow carpet….Earlier, someone tries to arrange a marriage for me with a woman….

I am involved with several women, like witches in black….Something has happened where they keep coming to me in pairs, of different kinds of symmetry, around me as the center….It is challenging to figure out what to do, I am unsure why this is happening to me….But I want to be of help….Later, I am running along a rocky path outside….There is a cliff wall to my right and a steep fall to my left….As I run through the sunny parts, I cannot see the path ahead in the shadows….I get anxious about running fast into a place I can’t see, and I finally get down on my hands and knees to crawl on the trail, to make sure I do not fall….I know this is silly, I am being too scared, but suddenly the whole situation feels frightening….

Lots of people in the family are trying to tell my nephew Henry what to do….They put out many ideas and options….I tell everyone to let him do what he wants….Later, I get someplace, and I do something I like, it makes me happy….but then lots of people come, and the space turns into a cafeteria….noisy, crowded, serving and eating food….I am disappointed by the change….

I am riding a bicycle outside, on a sidewalk….An open field is nearby, a few houses….Some young people are on the sidewalk, they see me coming and move out of my way, for which I’m grateful….I keep going, around a corner to the right and then left again to a porch, where two other people are sitting in chairs, waiting….Just as I pull up to the porch, a young woman is walking from the right to the same place….She gets there a couple of steps before I do….You win this time, I say with a smile….We know each other, and have met here before….the last time I arrived before she did, so we have a friendly rivalry going about this….Someone is driving a car, it’s new, the previous person messed up?....Earlier, some very violent things happen, people making others do things by force…

I am inside somewhere….A soldier place?....other people are there….We are going to be told something, have a presentation….But then there is a surprising change: it will now be a video, not a personal presentation….The video will start when I press a round, half-globe white button….Something else about white snow….

A woman gives me a big black bag, like a backpack….I am surprised it has so many pockets and sections, more than I expected….Later, I think of making a bag with extra material from some clothing….So they match….I am happy with that, it seems like a good idea to me….Later, I am getting ready to drive somewhere, take a trip….

We help our friend Lou Reed to get somewhere….it is a hassle, difficulties along the way, but we eventually succeed….he is going to talk to the Queen, and he says he will make a joke about how much he enjoys being morbidly gay….He wants to start planning a party or celebration of some kind….he is happy….Earlier, I am helping to set up a gathering or meeting for a woman….

I am with some people, and I guide them in various ways….I use a silver bowl as my guide for them….I am dealing with lots of older people, even though I am younger?....The bowl comes out of the dishwasher here in our kitchen at one point….It has a little pool of water in it, like the other bowls and glasses after the wash cycle has run….This is where the power is?....Each little pool of water has its own power….I am telling a woman about this….at some point I do not have my wedding ring on, so I can be more persuasive?....

Something about being with mom and dad….I need some papers?.....I see a black magazine and yellow papers, those are the ones….But they are backwards?....when I reach for them….Later, I am walking down some rickety stairs outside….High above the ground….There is a big gap I have to step over….I am nervous….my wife is behind me, and I say I have to go slow, this is scary…..At the end I look at the shaky railing, with dull red paint, and I wonder who is maintaining this?....is it a public facility?....it seems to me to be in bad shape, and not really appropriate for other people to use….At some point, I see two young boys go up some stairs inside, to deliver something….I say to them, wait….I accidentally catch one of the guys by the pants, and he falls back down the stairs….I apologize, and I try to help him, but he is upset and leaves….

I am getting ready for something….I am helping a young woman….We go into a hotel room, and out walk Ronald and Jimmy wearing very short rave shorts, for dancing to the music at a rave party?....I tell the young woman I will take care of it, make sure it is good enough for her….Something about getting ready for metaphysics….

I am with a bunch of people, including mom….Other people, especially a woman, try to get into our group….But we do not want that, we keep doing things to keep her out….At some point, after I assume the situation is over, there is a police group that arrives outside our door to force her in….But I run out to talk to them, try to stop it….Then they are suddenly gone?....At another point, I am outside and I see Strauss our cat asleep on a ledge….I worry and wonder, will an eagle or other bird of prey try to grab him?....I decide no, that is very unlikely, and I will protect him….Later, I am walking outside, past a field of green grass where lots of kids are playing, and I see two little black boys kicking a soccer ball….It rolls over towards me, and I make a good move and kick the ball well, as I slide and almost fall into a small mud puddle….But I do not fall all the way in, and I feel pretty good about making a skillful kick….Later, I am inside, like a gym….Lots of people are playing basketball….I get the ball under the basket, and I casually flip it over my shoulder and into the basket….A very skillful move….Then I walk outside, flipping my hair back, which I realize probably looks arrogant and self-involved….Then, I’m not sure when, I am back with the original group, trying to stop a guy who is helping the woman….There is a gun, we wrestle for it, and he gets it and tries to shoot himself?....I do not understand why or what that will do….Later, I go to a small apartment, and when I go in, a woman is there, acting a little strangely, and so is a friend of hers….a man, her husband?, is there too….They say I have a call waiting on their phone….I wonder why did they call me here?....it turns out to be an affair with some other woman who is part of this house?....That’s why they are all so weird to me, because the call coming here for me is an open acknowledgment of the affair, and that’s why the woman’s friend is there, to comfort her….I sit down, and before I pick up the phone, I put my head down and start to cry….this is all so intense and emotional, I do not know what I should do….Earlier: in the house, I see the road outside, and several cars strewn about after an accident….but I see no people….I run through the house to get shoes so I can go out to help, and I yell to Ronald to call 911….But when I go outside, all the cars are gone….

Outside in a big yard, with green grass and lots of trees, I see a black bear coming towards our house….I feel that is threatening, so I grab a hose and go after the bear, trying to spray water on it to keep it away….the bear runs off….Later, I am playing a kickball game, and I am in left field, on defense….Helmut is up, and he kicks the ball high over my head….There is no way I can get it, it’s a home run, I feel despairing….I try to turn and run after it, but I cannot move, I seem to be nearly paralyzed….then I see the ball bounce hard off the green ivy colored wall behind me, and it bounces straight back towards me….I think, that’s fortunate, if I can grab the ball now, I can probably hold him to a double, stop him from running all around the bases….But I still cannot move, and so the ball bounces right past me….I am embarrassed at how poorly I am playing, and envious of Helmut for being so good….Later, I go into the old bird watching shack at the ranch, and to my surprise I see over in the corner a nice, neatly made single bed, with white sheets, over in the corner where the previous owners were making drugs….That’s a strange but positive change….

A bunch of people are outside, gathered in a yard or patio area, doing something friendly as a group….I see a long worm on the ground, and I worry it is in danger….I pick it up and toss it up into some shrubs on a hillside behind the people in the patio….The worm tumbles back down, though, over the cement retaining wall and back onto the ground behind them….But at least the worm is now behind the people, along the edge, and not liable to be stepped on….I wonder where it will go now….At another point, my father-in-law is sitting at a table inside….I have a stack of mail, with bills and checks…Many of the envelopes are of the tear-off-the-edges type….my father-in-law wants to help with the process, but I think no, if he gets this information about our finances, he will surely misbehave….At another point, I am in a backyard with some other people….A blue bird swoops around, I watch it with pleasure….It is aware of us, but will not let anyone catch it….I am amazed at its intelligence….Later, I see a guy, with dark hair and skin, on an iPad….he is an actor, performing some intense role, and as I watch I think, wow, he is very good at acting….Later, I see Ronald and some other people walking away on a street….my wife too?....I toss a white cup at them, then a handful of little rocks, to get their attention….A rock hits Ronald in the head, and he looks around….oh oh, I worry, I did not mean that….

A black guy is sitting at a table inside….he is part of a group or gang, I am part of it too….Someone new joins the group, and he says now we have to split things six ways….later, I and some other people throw rocks from a distance at a long, old-fashioned convertible car, a light baby blue color….Later, I see an elephant on the other side of a low wooden fence….I playfully touch the tip of its trunk….I recognize this as its nose and nostrils, so distinctive of this species of animal….The elephant then plays back with me, showing far more dexterity and intelligence with its trunk than I was expecting….I almost feel like a giggling baby within the curves of its trunk….it is very fun….At another point, I am in the garage here at home, when I see the garbage collection people come, men and women….I am confused and say, this isn’t Tuesday, it is Thursday, are you coming on a different day now?....They say nothing and go about their work, like the answer to my question is obvious….Then, maybe before or after, some other people are with me in the garage, a woman too?....We see some people coming to our house from the outside….these are not the garbage guys, but someone we know socially?....We try to hide, scurrying around inside the house to avoid being seen….

I walk off a city street into the narrow hallway of a building with lots of construction going on….I am checking this out for possibly living here with other people in my group….There are rooms below, lights and colors and people moving about, I can see down through small holes….I wonder, is this too weird a place to live?....Other people are living in this place, and some are coming and going….it seems too unsettled to me….Earlier, I am working on my laptop computer, trying to help a woman prepare for dreaming?....

I am in a house set on a steep hill….I am wearing formal clothes, a dark jacket….Getting ready to go on a trip….Two different paths are being followed?....I lead one of the paths, someone else leads the other?....Then I am at a little grocery store, like the one in San Rafael, and I am standing at the checkout….A group of people come around the cashier, a guy I think, to start hassling him….I step forward to defend the cashier against the group, with an aggressive guy as their leader….
The plane is flying through a burst of rain, I can hear it spattering on the outside of the hull….

I am helping people figure out creative things they came to do here in Barcelona….Later, I am out in a big green forest area, and I take off and fly in the air by myself….I go up high enough where I can almost touch a flying black bird….I check my balance, as I seem to be standing on a small piece of wood….I am ok, and I go higher, all over this area….It is very fun….Another family is also involved….They are so excited to join in, they drive their car over a cliff and straight down….There is a moment of concern as the car streaks down, but it lands ok at the bottom on the cliff, by a big tree….

Lots of things happening about being with NBA basketball players….I go to see an event with LeBron James….As I am going upstairs, in an outside setting, I try to make a cool play with Stephen Curry….But it fails….I say let’s try it again, and we do it well….Then some other people talk about an accident, and I realize I have some small scabs on my face….How did that happen?....I wonder, did I have an accident and I do not remember?....As part of this, I am romantic with another woman, with dark hair….We make out, kiss and fondle each other’s bodies, it is very arousing….But some other guy sees us, and gets jealous….He is in a car, and for a moment I am seeing from his view….Out he comes to get me….But he fails….At one point I go into a house, and I wonder where are the cats?....I see the kittens, but not the boys….

I am in a tall tower, on the coast….There is some kind of question about LeBron James, where he will go next….Up in the tower, one guy is tossed over the side, then LeBron is too?....He has relationship problems, and this is supposed to help….But he lands awkwardly on the sand, rather than in the water of the ocean….I wonder, is he ok?....No, he has hurt his let, and now he will be out for all of next season….At another point, I see Iris outside, sitting in the sun doing something….She seems very happy, I am amazed at her bliss….Then, I am driving around in a car with Harika in a city….I take the wheel to steer while she looks at her phone….Later, the current president is talking at some event, I have to listen….He says to me, we all hate Bush, right?....

On an Amherst Avenue like street, I park my car in another neighbor’s yard for a few minutes, to unload some things….I go to tell the people in that house, just to make sure it is ok….They are theater people, now about to move out….Oh, that is too bad, I think, I wish I could have gotten to know them better before….Another neighbor has a son, and he is mad at me….I do not know why….Later, I see them at a store….I go inside and say to the dad, I would like to apologize to your son….But the kid does not want it….OK, I let it go….Later, I am going to get in my car, parked on the side of the street….Farther down the street I see a huge reptile, like a dinosaur lizard, crawling out onto the road….Wow, that is weird….Then I see an alligator on the roof of my car….It is close to the driver’s side door, so I get into the car on the passenger side, and drive away….I see other alligators on the road, they scurry away….Then, I see a guy going down a cliff, sliding down a dirt wall….I wonder, will it hurt him when he lands at the bottom?....Maybe….

It is like I am in a Hitchcock movie called “Shade”....In a doctor’s or dentist’s office, some intrigue is happening in the attic, at the top of a building of three or four stories….I help figure out what is going on….As part of it, I become romantic with a young blond woman….We are both part of the intrigue, and we both try to avoid being caught by the bad guy….At one point she leans forward and kisses me lightly….Wow, that is the sweetest thing anyone has ever done….I tell her she is so lovely….We go on a road trip to escape, all through the night….A long period of driving, until dawn….By that point I am very tired, and I would usually go to sleep now….But because I am with her, I do not want to sleep, so I say let’s have breakfast together….At one point, outside on a patio, I ask if I can kiss her….She smiles and says yes….As I do, I am shy because other people can see us….So I kiss her on the left cheek….At some point I put my hand affectionately on her back….I could caress her more sensually, but I realize I just want to enjoy this simple moment with her….Then we go back up to the attic, to finish our escape, bring the intrigue to an end….There are two white electric cords connected by a plug, and I put them together more firmly than they were; I thought that was a dangerous situation….But then I realize the bad guy will probably notice in another part of the building, as the lights flicker on….We go back out, down the stairs….All the children in the building are now dressed in white outfits and singing the same song….it is weird, like they are brainwashed….When we get to the ground again, we walk together down the street, under the green trees, trying to get away without attracting any attention….Then we hear the doctor woman, who turns out to be the bad guy, say the problem was caused by someone else….So the young woman and I are safe and free….Earlier, I am in a market, and an old woman thinks I am chasing her, and she hurries away from me….But I am not….

In an outside area, my yard, with lots of trees….There was just a flood through this area….lots of destruction, debris….I see a couple of men laying on the ground in the dirt….Are they dead?....Yes, they were homeless guys….A doctor comes by, he knew them, and he checks their bodies….It is so sad….Also, Vito is also dead?....Some of the trees are leaning, in bad shape, dead….We have to cut them down at some point soon to make sure they will not fall on our neighbors….

Some tour guides are taking the family around….But it is complicated….The map of the land is strange, does not make sense to me….A woman comes in, she wants to add politics to the process….Two big guys with axes come with her, and set their axes down on the ground, head first….It is intimidating….

Lots of groups are going out on tours, but not organized….I am lounging on a bench along a street, I see and hear lots of young people, teenage girls, planning spring break trips to the beach….I wonder how they manage to make that happen, with money and travel….A guy is sitting next to me, and I tell him to go ahead and lean his head back against my stomach as I lie down perpendicular to him….at some point, I am in a film contest, and I lose….But I figure that’s ok, I can probably still make my movie, and the other person who won needs the money more than I do….I see that person’s film being made, with an aerial view over a street, looking down at cars driving by….The colors of the cars change to varying shades of purple, and I wonder how they manage to create that effect….It is cool, interesting….Later, I am at the Kensington house, and a bunch of worker guys try to come inside to do something….I cannot keep them out….they admire the view, with the late afternoon sun streaming in the windows….they are planning to dig under the street or house?....One of the guys outside in the front has these huge work boots….I see him close a big sharp blade into the boots, and I see the back ankle area is covered with rough gray rocks….I joke that someone could shoot a gun at the boots and you would not feel it….The guy laughs and says yes, you could do that while I was going to sleep….

A somewhat patchy gathering to see books….Mine and others….A few people wander in and out of rooms, nothing is well set up….My books are not featured….I see Petrof there….That’s cool, a good sign….I go to Bud and Fern, and she asks me for some money, some change, to buy a snack….I see a picture of myself on the back of a book, about to jump in a pool, wearing a white shirt….Then I see Petrof and another guy about to walk out the door….I was hoping to talk with him casually, as part of the event, but now I have to make an active effort….I hurry over and slide up to the door as they go out, almost bumping into them….I say goodbye, and we have a brief chat….Earlier, I am playing basketball, and I see a guy go on a fast break but step out of bounds near midcourt….I point to the spot where he stepped out, so the referees will see it and make the right call….Then the playing keeps going, and I make a good move, a steal of the ball from the other team….I think of how that will count as a positive for my game statistics….

I am driving on a freeway, and I see some accidents on the road….Police are all around, dealing with the situation….I am going to a police station to talk about a murder I was somehow a witness to….It happened a while ago, and I try to figure out what I will say….The police do not know how much I was involved….But a spirit being or ghost does know, and I am worried my role will be revealed, and I will get in trouble….the spirit has an electric haze around it, and perhaps only I can see it?....Later, I go to a classroom at Santa Clara University….I am supposed to teach a class, but I do not know what it is, how to proceed….Students come in, and I try to figure it out by looking at the class list, and the required books….Another teacher is there, a woman, who is supposed to observe me….That makes me even more nervous….A woman student comes in and stands next to me….We know each other from before, and she subtly flirts with me….I do not have a syllabus, and I try to think of what I will say to excuse my total lack of preparation….I worry and wonder, how will I start the class?....

Several guys are playing basketball in a gym….I see a scuffle between the opposing players, but the referee does not see it….So I tell him one of the other players hit one of our players….Then I am in the game, and I make a couple of good plays….I steal the ball on an in-bounds pass….At another point, I am outside, sitting with Rock Hudson….He is sad and crying….A woman has left him, and I try to comfort him and tell him it is ok….He cries like a child, hunched over and sobbing….Earlier, I am at an IASD conference, and a woman gives a talk, but her husband is not supportive of her….She gets mad and stalks off….They have a big argument….

I am at a theological school, and a man and a woman are filing papers….I think of offering to help them with my library, the plans I have to preserve documents….The woman says she knows how my books are structured like my days, with a first part, then a break in the middle, then a second part….Hmm, I wonder if this is a secret I want other people to know….Later, I have a big black truck, like a double wide bed?....Someone has borrowed it, and I do a double-take as I notice it has a dent in the back….I wonder how it happened, who is responsible?....Should I worry about it?....Not a very big dent, but still….Soon after, I see my brother drive the truck up from the valley to the ridge, so he can go pee in a port-a-potty….That seems overly cautious, and I tell him out here in the forest you can pee wherever you want….I go over into the bushes to pee myself, though it is difficult to find a place without blackberry thorns….At another point, I am driving a big black SUV car down the hill in Kensington, with the family in the back….As I make a left turn, I accidentally drop the black electronic key out the open window….Some school kids are walking across the street, and a boy with dark hair picks up the key and runs away….I stop the car in the middle of the intersection, in an awkward place, and chase after the boy….I catch him, hold him by the arm, and demand that he give the key back….He refuses….I can tell he knows he has me trapped in a mischievous game, which makes me very angry….I take him to a nearby hamburger place, where a guy is working behind the counter….I ask the guy if he knows who this kid is….The guy says no….Now I wonder, what can I do?....

The whole family is together, we have a super early wake up to go to the airport….We are at someone’s wedding, and it is very hard to find our luggage, tickets, etc., and get to the car….Ronald is part of the wedding party activities, so it is difficult to pull him away….At one point, I am at a market, at a small counter for buying food, pastries and drinks….There is a long line of people waiting behind me, and I am slow in getting my wallet, giving my order….At one point I lose track of my wallet, and I turn to the woman behind me and accuse her of taking it….But then I see I dropped it on the side of the counter….I apologize to her….

I am talking with people about the number 18, how it applies, where it is found….Also, I am with people in San Sebastian, and we are talking about the differences between traditional and modern styles in architecture….I see the new convention center building, its many straight lines….Later, in a semi-lucid state, I see a series of patches of beautiful blue light, like through a brilliant stained glass window….Then I am in a vast, dark ocean, churning like it’s alive….It’s amazing, I feel awe as I move across the endlessly changing surface….Then, I am in a small Spanish village, with lots of woman journalists with cameras and microphones gathered around someone who is sitting, speaking about something important….Later, I am driving a car with my family, in a city like San Sebastian….I pull up to a stop at a busy intersection….Oh oh, I suddenly realize I am in a pedestrian and bike lane….My mistake….Other people look at me, noticing how I am not in the proper place….I worry and wonder, will the police get me in trouble for this?....I look in the mirrors to see if they are coming….Later, I walk into a theater, just as a big crowd of people files out….we want to pass through in the same direction they are going….I am leading a small group, my family?, through this complex space, through another empty theater, unsure where to go….We go into a nice apartment area….Oh oh, I realize this is the private residence of the president or chief executive of this place, like a hotel or resort center….We should not be here….We go back out, hoping we have not disturbed anyone….Then a woman shows me a big room where I will be sleeping during my stay….it is like an open dorm room….She points to a big silver metal tray, raised off the ground, as my mattress….She helps me make the bed, put sheets on it….It does not seem likely to be very comfortable….I look out the window at the gray morning sky….

There is a festival or holiday ritual going on in a city….People are giving each other things in a complex pattern, back and forth….But I realize with surprise and despair that it is all working to give more money and power to the richest people….This is not obvious to everyone, but when I see it, I know it is true….Later, I am sitting with others outside in a city….I peer through my sunglasses at people walking on the street….We are part of the ceremony, but we want it to end?....Someone comes over and asks if we will share, I say ok….

I am on a boat with other people, out on the water….cruising around the Bay?....The main woman gets mad about something, I do not know what….She is arguing with someone, it is awkward for the rest of us….Later in a house, I am helping to babysit….After a while I say I’m going to leave, come back later in the day, but the other young woman babysitting with me reminds me of what I’m doing….OK, I say, I’ll be back in a few minutes, I’ll go get food and bring it back….Into the house some drops of rain blow in through a window….I go to close it, but I see it is partly broken, and some upright sticks are positioned to block the wind from coming through the gaps in the window….At some point I am walking with some people up a sidewalk, uphill….There are two stairways ahead, I go to the left one….A young woman is ahead of me, and as she walks she arranges and pulls down her short skirt….she is clearly self-conscious with me behind, and I think she has no need to worry over me, I am not leering at her….Later, outside I see a house being re-modeled….a sunny day….On the sidewalk median strip I see lots of dry yellow grass….like in Kensington?….I wonder, should it be cut down?....No, it is habitat for animals….then I see a big, amazing insect climbing on the grass….huge, yellow, many complex parts, a very intelligent face….it has a feminine, queen bee quality….on its back it has a row of things that look like sunflowers as a disguise?....It sees me and flies at me….I gently but firmly block it from landing on me, it scares me a little….it keeps trying to fly at me, and I don’t know what to do, I don’t want to hurt it….it is very intelligent, sophisticated, evolved….

Outside I see ahead two lines of people, getting ready for travel….The line on the left has a red Delta Airlines sign above it….The other side has a blank gray sign, I don’t know what it is for….The situation is a little confusing….

I see an image of a woman outside, in a white dress, next to a box or container that holds an entire scene….A place with clothes, furniture, like a large dressing room….Her dressing room?....It is rather messy, disorganized….Now it is closed up into this magically condensed box….but somehow it is my responsibility now….I am supposed to make sure it keeps working, remains an open space….
A woman stands alongside a long white rectangle, like a small building, with little pillars and arcs….Is it like a constant garage sale?....I wonder if that is legal….

In a tour situation, a woman really likes our guide….She worships him, thinks a lot about him when not on the tour….She has lots of little books of his….At the hotel, I sit down at a restaurant table with some other people, family perhaps, almost like I am in bed, with white pillows and sheets still around me….Suddenly the table starts moving, sliding through the room, out the door, down the street, and into another restaurant….Wow, that was unusual….I wonder, is this a special feature of the restaurant?....apparently so….cool and delightful, but it takes us away from our place….and I feel rather exposed in this public area, while still feeling like I’m in bed….Later, I see a big gray snake, with a blue head and narrow jaw line….The cage is in the hotel lobby….Other people are amazed, pleased by it….So am I, but I am also worried, aware of the danger….The cage bars are fairly wide, and the snake can easily get out….Our cats wander around the cage, and I realize the snake is big enough to try and attack them, eat them….I keep Fireface away from the cage so the snake won’t be able to get her….

I get into a car with other people….We are packed in rather tightly in a row….An earlier scene with a couple of tour guides?....I am romantic with a woman in the group….She has a thick white terry cloth robe?....

In a house or building of some sort, people are helping us organize ourselves for some task….I sit at a table with a young woman on the other side….We are eating breakfast, like in a cafeteria or hotel dining room….Nice white tablecloth….I accidentally spill some milk from my food, and I have to quickly move things and dab the liquid with my napkin to clean it up, I apologize for making a mess….Duh, that was a dumb move on my part, embarrassing….

I am in a small group, someone is supposed to be taking care of us, but we do not want it, it is a mistake….three blue bottles are part of it?....Mom is especially resistant….At some point Ronald and I are sitting at a table inside, like at a restaurant, when a hugely tall guy walks past us into the bathroom….we are amazed….it is the same Spanish guy we saw in Barcelona….I only saw his shoes as he walked by us….Later, there is a contest outside, and I have to climb a ladder to get over a structure….I get near the top, but I cannot make my legs move the final couple of rungs….I am wearing the tall guy’s pants?....so they do not fit well, are in danger of falling off, embarrassing….Another guy comes up the ladder, he goes around me to the right….it is embarrassing….

I am walking on a street….to my right, in the shade of trees on green grass, I see some kids are having a sidewalk sale….Are they selling lemonade?....I start to walk past them, but then I see they are not selling lemonade, but something to do with very old dresses, vintage gowns from earlier times….with frills, lace, intricate sewing; light colors, pale blue and yellow….I realize they are beautiful and valuable, but the girls having the sale do not seem to know that….They are just sitting in the dresses on the grass, bored….I go over and look at the dresses with admiration….I think the girls should be more proud of all this….

I am in an enclosed room with the family….Lots of little metal bowls are involved….everything is blue….The people who have us in here do not really know who we are….There are a few little nozzles, like from kitchen sinks, with metal mesh screens, that I can see, they are related to the bowls….Later, I am outside, stretching on my black exercise pad….A car is parked very near me, with one of its doors open….This makes it more awkward to do my stretching….I feel like I was here first, or this is more a place for me than the car, so I am a little annoyed….But I keep going anyway….A woman is in another car, stopped nearby at a signal, and she watches me….She is impressed by my flexibility and dedication to exercise….

I see large metal hoops or circles, in a rotating display, like a massive sculpture….Later, I am in some nature area, lots of trees….Then I see the same area from a distance, and it looks like many layers of flat white rectangles or squares, stacked up on each other, with grooves running through them in parallel lines….dirt and plants grow in the grooves….As I look at it, I think it would be fun to explore….But I wonder if I would fall into the grooves, get trapped; it would probably be dangerous….At another point, I am at the top of a hill, with several running trails going down from there, all very steep….An older man is amazed I am going down one of these trails….Somehow this is my home course?....

Someone shows me a display of things….Lots of blue rectangles, one, then a smaller row, then a longer row, on and on….I have to choose one, then go through the rows picking more….It has to do with women?....I go along, but I am thinking this is not right, I do not like it….

Something about training as a spy….My family is brought to this place, with metal chain link fencing….my wife is part of it, we are on one side of the fence, it is dark, we are outside, plain flat grassland around us….a bluish tinge to things….

Outside in a yard, I see a black and gray cat behind a fence, in some green grass and small shrubs….I call to the cat, it looks friendly….But I wonder, will it be able to come through the metal screen fence to reach me for petting?....Earlier, I am with a group, maybe our family….We are being trained for something….Three things to learn?....At one point I am in a room, other people are doing things….the place is like an old inn, with small dark wood paneled rooms….The room I’m in gets crowded with people, and a super tall guy is standing next to me, his waist in my face….I decide to leave the room….Later I am outside, in water at the edge of the ocean….I happen to cross past some people moving fish, big ones, from a boat across a white chute or plank that’s on the surface of the water, and then to shore….I stop to help them, it’s a rather awkward process, but I am surprised the fish are not more difficult to handle….At some point in the dream, I am unsure if I have the right clothes….

A woman in a fancy old blue dress….She has a box, it has things that will help people change somehow….Our family is with her inside, she is going to help us?....Later, I see a tiny streak of light in the darkness….I wonder, is it a photon?....At another point I am outside, and suddenly Strauss our cat runs up from the left….He seems to be wondering what is going on….

There is a brown paper bag out by the front gate at our house here in Portland, by the green hedge….I wonder what it is there for….I look inside, and it has lots of little things in it, dry goods, snacks, food items, napkins, little cups, etc….Later, someone tells me it is a give-away bag….Anyone who wants something can take it….I think that’s nice, what a kind gesture, like a gift bag….At some point, my wife is taking the lead with something….I am happy to follow her….

I am with some people, we are doing a training of some sort inside….At one point a woman’s friend, a guy, shows us his version of the training, as a helpful gesture….It’s like a secret, and he has been trying to replicate it….He has a complex arrangement of cardboard tubes, lots of blue….I think it still does not look like the training we have been doing….At some point, I find my wife….She is in big, almost communal bed in a room somewhere….We start kissing, more and more passionately….happily, it is very arousing for us both….I move around, rearrange things for a moment, and then go back under the blankets to find her and kiss her some more, but to my surprise and disappointment, she is asleep….

Somehow the bed I am sleeping in here at the Inn can create the perfect pillows for a person….You go to sleep, and the pillows form in the bed during the night….I am trying it, and so is Juliet….She is going first….Others are around, her parents?....I am wondering how to get the new pillows home….they are very comfortable and pleasurable, but mysterious….

I am at a place with a perfect bed, a circular delight, white in color….journeys through and around it all night….my wife, or someone who is my wife, is there?....Octavia is there, too?....It is all very pleasurable, comfortable….Earlier, a big brown dog with curly hair like a poodle jumps up at me in a friendly way….I am surprised, but I pet it nicely, without wanting it to get any rowdier….That seems to start the whole process….At the end, I am at a restaurant or café, with a stack of books and papers….I move them from one counter with all the sugar and milk, to another counter so they will not be damaged or get wet….
I am with Terefina, on a long journey or process of some kind….it seems interesting, I am glad we are doing this together….At some point I am romantic with a woman, we are very happy together….

I go into a grand house, our house, at night….Up on the second floor, I see some water coming down from the roof….Oh oh, I realize with worry, lots of water, from many places in the ceiling….it is raining hard outside, a heavy rain that is coming through the roof, then dripping down walls, over paintings, furniture, down into the lower parts of the house….Oh no, I am very alarmed, this is a big disaster, there is so much to do to fix things….I wonder, how did it get this bad?....did I not see the problem coming?....my wife is there too, as she and I walk through the house, amazed by so much water getting in from so many different places….Later, I see three people, a family?....a guy, the dad, has green face paint on him, like a silly mask….there are three bars of white soap in a sink, and it seems the dad now realizes, ok, it is time to wash the green face paint off….

A tall bearded guy, like a trickster, has a large set of purple water bottles surrounding him….Later he has lots of fun with people….Doing odd things with clothing….At some point a woman challenges him about something….in a friendly way, as part of everyone’s fun….At another point I see one of my kids, a baby boy, with dark hair….I have not checked on him in a while….There is a sheet of clear plastic over the little boy’s face, and I wonder, he’s ok, isn’t he?....he can’t be accidentally dead?....I am worried, but not too much because I can’t believe he is actually dead….

Something is going on, I am outside and have two big coils of garden hose….I realizes this is not a good set up for whatever is happening, I am at a disadvantage….One of the hoses is black, one is green….

Some older, short dweeby guy, like an old scholar with a beard and glasses, has made an awesome pillow….It has everything you want….A peak of pillow ingredients….I actually see some little lines or arrows bundled into it?....yet it is deceptively mild, unassuming….I am impressed, it is very comfortable….Later, I see a woman down at the front row of an auditorium, in a big audience….She needs help….I am concerned for her….Some people go down the aisle to help her get out of her seat and leave the auditorium….But the woman is out of it; groggy, unconscious?....Then I see an image of her, perhaps from earlier, and a good friend of hers, dressed in elaborate pink dresses, with black fringe and black lipstick….it’s very dramatic, they look great….

Some artists have four simple objects, transforming them into art….A pillow, a suitcase or duffel bag, and a dress are among the items….And another pillow: the first piece of art is made as an overnight project, starting in the evening and finishing the next morning….It is to be a petrified pillow?....I am unsure if I like this particular piece, although I like the overall project….As the artist works, people try to keep him happy, content….A woman artist goes next….She will make something I will like more?....something to do with a dress….I see her standing, from the back, up front in an aisle in an auditorium, and I notice her dress has the tags showing in the back….I help her move those so they cannot be seen….

Three people are doing something as a group….Like they have a start-up company?....They have created some open space, little structures, food?....like in a triangular outside area....We come back a week later, and it is all scattered around….I am confused, what happened?....I think we should stay from the food….some old vanilla milkshakes?....There are insects around it….

I see a big pool of water, in the daytime….it’s our pool here....A little red arrow is in the water, with a string attached to it….Like a magic dart that zips around, a potentially dangerous weapon….I wonder how to get it out….

A woman police officer sets up four chairs in an outside area, like a backyard or a neighborhood sidewalk….She wants to question me and two other people about some crime….This is the second time she is questioning us, and she clearly thinks there is more for her to learn….I am fine with it, happy to answer her questions….Let’s get started, I say….At another point, two new dogs walk into an outdoor area where some other dogs are enclosed in cages….I wonder, will the dogs notice each other and get excited to play?....The new dogs don’t see the other ones, who do see the new dogs but do not react….Hmm, maybe not….At another point I see Octavia sitting in an auditorium….like a pool of water?....She has on a black suit and black hat, and she is one of the very last people to leave the auditorium….I am up front on the stage….At some point, I am in a car someone else is driving through a college campus….We go slowly, and I start to notice how many dorm rooms, especially those of the resident assistants, have coverings over their windows….It’s all very colorful and slapdash, in a college campus spirit, but I realize this is the way people handle this situation, and I can learn from that….

We are with some people from a village or neighborhood, doing a financial transaction with a new, fancy kind of credit card….They have me use a pen to sign the transaction outside on a table lined with empty, upside down egg cartons….This provides a good cushion for the signing….As I do it I think to myself, this is a good, healthy psychological move for them….When an advanced outside technology arrives and destabilizes life, a practice like this makes it seem like something more in their normal realm, at a scale they can understand and deal with….I am impressed….At some point, I see a tall African-American woman, elegant and dignified, doing something….she seems serious and focused….

At some facility, two women point out there are more mouse turds to clean….I ask them uncertainly, is it just a few, or are they evenly distributed around, so the whole place has to be cleaned again?....I am annoyed, this means I have at least a couple of hours of cleaning to do….the whole kitchen will have to be cleaned….I am in a large bed, and I get out and put on my pants….Lots of people start getting out of bed, too, and putting on their clothes….I realize everyone was sleeping here….this must have been a group nap time, which is now over as everyone rises up to become active again….At one point I help an animal get at its food bowl….it is outside in a yard or garden, and I move some overhanging leaves so the animal has unobstructed access to the bowl….it’s a pig?....

Something about a ring of cooking, making dishes to replace others in special spots on the ring….But it does not go as planned….There are problems in replacing the big dishes with little ones….Other people cooking around me….Later, I see from behind Billy and his son standing together….I wonder, is his son still alive?....No, he is not….but there he is….That is very sad….Later, I see someone take a pastry out of a pan….it is a big flaky mess….it might taste ok, but it looks terrible….

We are with some black rapper guys, trying to rehab an outside area, fix up the buildings and make it more hospitable….it’s a good thing to do, there is a positive feeling about it….I see a small sign on the ground, it has a double meaning?....I cannot read what it says….

Two guys come out of a crowd of people outside….One is the leader of a music band, the other is a short and bald guy, the drummer for the band?....They are bare-chested, wearing no shirts….Earlier, somewhere outside I see a backpack with some buttered bread at the bottom….That looks awkward, I think; it is going to make a mess….

We are trying to close an area, prevent others from going there….it is outside….There is danger, we are concerned?....We could let a little guy do it, he is already there, but we would prefer that a woman from our group do it….Earlier, I am standing with a very short woman at a door, we are about to go inside….the woman is my wife, maybe my wife, maybe not?....

I am doing something with cats….a party….Someone teases me about it….I see the black shadow of a cat on a wall….the cat’s back is arched, and its tail is straight up….it is a cool image, kind of creepy….I did not do it intentionally, the image is a surprise, but it comes out well….
Something about cats….at one point I see someone has left things on top of the waterfall….I have to get the stuff….I am irked by this….
A woman and her child are going into a playground….I know that other people are planning to fix it up, improve the playground….

I am in charge of fixing or improving something, an outside area….In the midst of that, I am with my wife, fooling around….it is very arousing….Later, I am with a group being held captive by someone….One person has their arm cut off….Our captors pretend it is nothing, not something to get alarmed about, but we are, very much so….I help the person with their wounds….

There is some big gathering of people, arranged in a large circle outside….it is a circus?....I see computers and monitors and other equipment spread around in circles….with blankets too?....on the grass, open ground….everything is widely spaced apart….We do not want people to touch the equipment….A woman is there, a civilian, as opposed to people like me who are organizing the situation….She is not supposed to touch any of the computers or monitors, but she does anyway….She does not know what she is doing, I know she is innocent, but this is dangerous and disruptive….I am supposed to figure out a way to help the situation and stop the bad consequences from happening….Something about black light coming out of the monitors?....

I am with people who are in charge of a big circle gathering outside in a grassy area….Two women are part of the group of people in the circle, they think it is a camp site….But I know it is not….Those of us in charge are concerned about the circle, making sure it is used for the purpose we intended….There is a little white and blue wooden structure on one point of the circle, it becomes a focus of everyone’s attention….it looks like an outhouse, but we know that is not what it really is….Something is off about it….it is spinning in the opposite direction it should?....It seems over-built for what it is, with tall, straight wooden boards and a pointed ceiling, like a Victorian or New England house….it is really just a small enclosure, with a toilet inside….I see there are still little bits of shit floating in the water….Someone did not flush totally….

Something about my brother and destruction….At some point, I am walking through a big garden outside of roses in bloom….lots of them, in beautiful colors….red, yellow, blue….Then, I am in a market, and a guy working behind the counter says this is very fresh butter….He puts out a stick of butter in the display case, and it is rather soft….I think that is ok, it is so fresh, that is a good sign….

I am helping at woman as she comes to a place outside with lots of little holes in the ground….brown dirt, a low mound….She is ok with the holes, but she wants something else….Some kind of black device….It does not do what she thinks it will do….Hmm, I wonder what to do about that….Should I tell her, or not?....

I am with a woman, and maybe other people too….We are going around a big circle, a place for activity….There are black microphones at several spots, sitting on the ground….I realize they are for me….I will be saying something to help the cause along, keep the process moving forward?....it will be unexpected, a surprise to people, but I have a good feeling about all this….There is a sense of happy anticipation….At one point someone is outside on a pool patio, talking with someone by video on an ipad….The screen is leaning against the leg of a chair, and as a joke I sneak up to the ipad, staying out of view behind other chairs until I am close enough to jump out and surprise whoever is on the screen….They did not see me coming….The other person seems a little exasperated with me, but does not really mind what I am doing….

An OSF show is going on outside….Around an open hillside….I put chrome or silver microphones at a couple of important spots, spaced far apart from each other….These microphones are meant to help the actors and the show….But it does not work as I expected….At the end we gather at the top microphone, positioned highest on the hill….We need to discuss all of this more….One of the actors likes milk, and I make sure this person has a jug of her own….Mirabla is there, and others from Oklahoma!....

I am setting up a signal to the OSF actors and people, as I leave….the signal is a collection of things in an open field, with a gentle mound or hill in the middle….Everything in a broad circle….One of the items in the circle outside is a ladder….I wonder if I should keep the ladder open or not….if it stays open after I leave, will someone use it to climb in our window?....Octavia is there, one of the OSF people….At the end, the ladder is open, and someone says they closed it, there was nothing to see?....

At a big gathering, lots of people are standing around a large swimming pool….like in the backyard of someone’s house….I go to stand at the deep end….I am dressed in very muddy clothes, like I have been on a long wilderness hike….I jump into the pool to clean myself off….The other people around are shocked….I know I have messed up the water for the others, but I don’t really care….When I swim to the other end and stop to look back, I see some dirt in the pool at the other end, but actually not that much….That’s surprising, not such a mess as I expected….At some point I am walking around with a guy, and he smiles and marvels at all the attractive young women walking by….Hmmm, I wonder as he says this, aren’t these women much too young for us?....His interest seems inappropriate….I notice there are cats around….

I watch some kind of big show or performance happening in a circular setting outside….Later, a guy and I are on top of a very tall tower, made of metal….We are admiring the view of the city, coast, and ocean below us, it is amazing….But the longer we are there, the more scared I become of falling….There is no outer railing, and the top of the tower is very narrow….I try to stay in the center, and hold onto a low bar to keep steady….Later, I am laying outside on the ground, covered with brown blankets….Then Strauss our cat comes over, and he immediately pushes his nose under the blankets by my feet….He is curious….OK, I decide I will let him do so, even though he will probably be annoying at some point….
I am with a group….I am supposed to go for a run outside, as part of the group’s activities, but I do not have the right shorts to wear?....The other people are disappointed in me….
