There is a general sense of disruption….My two usual ways of sleeping are disturbed, and new plans are being developed?....I walk along a shore of water, stepping from one thin square platform to another….Other people have gone ahead of me, but I am scared I will fall in the water….At another point, bad guys have kidnapped me and a child….They are bringing us out of one place, holding us hostage at gunpoint….One of the bad guys with a gun looks through my backpack, and finds a Lara bar….I offer it to him, say he can eat it if he wants….He looks at me and says nothing….I am very, very scared, almost crying….Later, I am helping a guy who is in a car….I am strapping him into a car seat, to prepare for whatever is coming next?....a trip, a movement?....The straps are too tight for him, but they are needed for safety….Briefly, I am walking someplace and see on a path below, going the opposite direction, is a dark black guy with a white turban and white robe….We wink and smile at each other….he is going to fill in?....Somehow compensate for the other things that have been disturbed?....At some point I am with some people, and I brush a small spider off my arm, where it was crawling….Once on the ground, we can all see the spider is actually quite big, with long legs….At another point, I get on a bus with a famous musician, rock star….Tom Petty?....an older white guy, thinning brown hair, friendly….The bus is going to a place where he is having a concert, but he is pretending to be just another person….I sit in the row ahead of him, and I can see all the teenage girls in the bus are aware he is there, are avidly interested in what he is doing….

I am with someone who goes to another person’s house and makes lots of critical comments about all the things that need to be changed….I say nothing, but I think the person is being rather rude and pushy, insensitive to the person in the house….Later, I am thinking a lot about Latent Dirichlit Analysis….

Strauss our cat is strolling into a house….He has been helping set it up, make various changes to it, to show other people….From the outside it is a complex combination of wilderness and landscaping….He wants flowers, lots of green growth, but I see that it is just mounds of blackberries….I think, he should not get any special credit for that, since blackberries grow wild and are invasive….I have to decide if this is ok….A Russian guy is involved….I do not trust him….I have to go along with him, though….Maybe, I wonder, I can make it better….

Ronald or Leonard are involved in a weird scam….They dress up as a poor farmer, in that kind of role, and when others come to the house, they pretend that is who they are….they dress in blue overalls and red checked shirts, dirty and worn….I do not know why they are doing this….Now people are going to come to our regular house, and he will be revealed….I am confused about the whole point of it, and I am unsure if I want to help fix it….But I probably will….A woman is in general charge of the overall house situation?....In the first house they have created a semi-circle seating area, where he sits and talks to the people who visit….

I am in a convertible car, with the roof down, driving during the daytime in areas where we pick people up to form a creative team….I am doubtful about the whole thing at first….But it gets better as we go along….People walk on the back of the car’s trunk to get in and out of the seats….That is not the normal way, but it seems right for this process….By the end, we are no longer choosing people, but letting others decide to come and go from the team….it is very organic….Later, my wife and I are in a swimming pool during the day, with other people lounging around….we are pretending to be casual, but it is very pleasurable, we are both very sexually aroused….

Some big brown cardboard boxes arrive at our house….But somehow this is not what we wanted….I say to the family I will deal with it….At another point I am looking towards our pool, and a river otter suddenly pops its head out of the water….I am surprised and amazed, how cool….Later I see that Felicity has the New York Times newspaper, in paper form….I am glad, that is a happy surprise, I am grateful to her….

Some kind of friendly social event is going on, lots of people involved….the adults are supposed to be in charge, but then the kids have to take over….I am unsure if the adults are aware of this, but the kids know what they have to do, and they go ahead and do it….At another point I fool around with Nellie….Then, I am in a floating chair, being pulled behind a speed boat on the water at a beach area….It is a sunny day, and I am relaxed as we cruise along the shore….The floating chair starts rising off the water a little, and I do not like it that way….I ask the person driving to make the chair go up higher….Soon I am floating over the whole resort beach area….Very happy about it….I see Nellie on a float in the water, in a blue bikini….She looks younger than I remembered….She and I are together somehow?....At another point, I am playing a game with a little guy, who chases me upstairs with a nerf gun….He shoots lots of darts at me, so many I have to take cover….I have a water gun to shoot at him?....

A man and a woman build a big fan-shaped stage or structure….They are worried it is not good enough….It is large, outside, a nice shape, but it will work for some kinds of functions and not for others….I recommend using Fescue grass to improve it….plant nice green grass within the shape of the structure, that will be better….Later, a woman suddenly tells a man that blueberry muffins are a problem with diversity and inclusion….I am surprised, I do not understand what problems the muffins are causing….

A little dark-skinned guy, a Muslim?, appears suddenly to take pictures….A woman owns a big garden, lots of green grass, and lots of people are there, including many other photographers….I watch as he takes a picture of a medium-sized ceramic object….It is an ancient creature or monster?....it is gold with little spikes sticking out around its face….He gets a good photo of the spikes, with their shiny gold color in the light, I am impressed….

A disabled woman has a small triangular patch of land to cultivate….She is going to grow cannabis….it seems like a good plan, I support her….there is a happy vibe around it….Somehow this is related to three round layers of cake, like for a cake….There is some paper related to the planning for the layers, but the paper is wet and soggy, which makes it difficult to hold and use….At some point a guy comes over to help her….

Something about people coming to see some guy, but they have to deal with another guy, me….They are disappointed, but come anyway….I try to do as well as I can….I try to walk in a line outside on the grass field towards the people, to make them feel happier….But I walk in a shaky curve, veering to the left….Later, I am pouring hot water from our electric tea pot on a plant outside, a clump of black Mondo grass….I wonder, is that good for the plant?....

Octavia and Kylie and I are trying to make the theatrical show work, moving it around to three different places….the main theater, the backup theater, and my bedroom….There are many problems and lots of confusion, how to make sure the show goes on….I help as best as I can….At one point I see a huge patch of sword ferns, very healthy and full, a massive green swath of them on a nearly vertical hillside….That is how things should work, I think to myself….At another point I see a patch of some white liquid spilled on the floor near my bedside….cat throw up?....I wonder how it got there and how to clean it up….

I am working on some kind of rooftop garden outside, putting in plants….Later, inside, my wife is in the bathroom, and I walk by the door just as she comes out, which means I accidentally startle her….Hmm, I think to myself, I could have avoided that, I saw it coming….Earlier, someone says that Phantom our cat has gotten outside….Oh oh, that’s worrisome….We look and look for him, and I finally find him, curled up in a gray ball of fur, in a little basket….What a relief it is to find him….

I am outside and I see a small shop or store across the street from the larger main place where I was fooling around with my wife….I wonder, what is this little shop?....it seems like a small inside version of the larger outside activity….Later, I look in a mirror and see three little white spots above my chin, under my lip….They are laid out in a symmetrical curve…I wonder if this is somehow related to my having just shaved off my soul patch on that part of my face….Like the seeds for a future one?....

Something about little swarms of bees outside….Also, I see owls and hawks, setting up their nests on a fence pole, one of the gray ones at the ranch?....Later, I find out Haley is planning a to start a computer academy, like an internet school, to teach kids online….She seems happy and well….I am so relieved for her….
A new way of growing beards has been developed….Colorful gases, rather than hair, can be made to surround a man’s face….Later, I am walking through a long green valley, up a hill….

I am in a big social gathering inside somewhere….Some boxes of art work are there, no one is looking at them….Only if you come the next day will you see them?....There is something strange or magical about this; I can see it, but other people apparently do not….I see a little white box on a wall….curious….Somehow this has to do with immigration?....At the dinner table of the party I see small mounds of something on the plates….I wonder what they are….Other people sit there and do not seem to notice….At some point I feel a sexual energy, maybe involving me, maybe involving others….During the party, I see that a short attractive woman is upset, sad about something….I kneel down to look in her eyes directly, actually a little lower than hers, and I ask her what’s wrong….I put my hand gently on the small of her back….I am wearing leather gloves and outdoor work clothes, and I have a machete in its leather sheath; I realize I must look like a medieval knight….She looks at me with wide eyes, very surprised, and grateful to me….

I see a big house or building made of red bricks….I see it from a distance….In the light of the setting sun….It looks beautiful, and I mention it to someone I am with, take a look….At another point I am helping someone with food preparation, for a social gathering?....Later, I see a woman, perhaps a waiter at the social event?....She has short dark hair and fair skin, and somehow she has nicked the left side of her chin, so there is a little spot of red blood there….I think that is odd, since that would be a typical wound from shaving, but she is a woman so unlikely to shave her face….

I see our gray cat Phantom has somehow gotten outside….I persuade him to come into the back of a car with me, where he is safe….I was quite worried, and now I am relieved….Later, I am with some young women at a party….Suddenly the doors open to my right and in walk a group of young women with lots of attitude and authority, holding big shoulder bags….They come over and look at the young women I am with, checking if their clothes are acceptable….When they leave, I go after them and ask, so you really are the fashion police?....I realize that is kind of a joke….At another point, outside in a backyard, a guy says he sees blood up in the branches of a tree….I go over, and I see a hurt bird….something attacked it?....it is female, kind of puffy and large, and it falls from the branches onto the sloped roof of a garage….It slowly slides down to the bottom edge of the roof….The other people are confused, they ask me what is happening….I can see the bird is dying….It has a terrible bloody wound in its chest, and its breathing is labored….I put my hand on the soft feathers of its chest, below the wound, and stay with it….very sad….

I am with Manuel….We are sitting together, and he tells me that his mother has died….He is very upset and crying, and I try to console him….At another point I am in a wilderness creek, big rocks and big trees all around, and some other people in the water with me, women and guys….I am partly in the water, and I think about tossing a stick across the rocks into another part of the water….But I am unsure, I do now know where or how the currents are flowing, so I do not throw it….I see a small snake slithering in the water….I wonder, should I swim over to join the other people, hanging out together in a bigger pool?....I worry about getting there, because the depth of the water would be over my head….

On a sidewalk during the day, I am putting luggage into the back of a car….One of the pieces of luggage I am packing is a valuable gray backpack….I see a kid on the sidewalk, looking at the backpack, and I suddenly worry, wondering if he might try to steal it….I stand there, making sure he does not….He sits down on a gray cement curb and uses a surprisingly elaborate and large black camera to take pictures of the backpack….I ask one of our people to stand in his way, so he cannot get a direct view of the backpack, while I finish loading….Later, there is an issue at the ranch, something about lines and water?....Someone needs help, and I ask my wife to deal with it….I realize as I do so that it’s not really appropriate for her to deal with this, it’s too much of a hassle, I should be doing it….

A boy uses a tree branch to fend off a dog that is barking at him, trying to bite him….This is happening outside at Corner Road….Earlier, I am supposed to help someone, a woman?....But I do more to help myself, extend my lines from the structure or layout we currently have….

Some people come to help us fix up the arena at the ranch, improve it and build something new….But once they get there, the people realize that everything is more complicated and intimidating than they expected….They run away in surprise….I watch this from an elevated view, up in the air….Later, I am at a house in a neighborhood, outside in the yard….I am a kid, with another kid, a guy, and we hide as some other kids on bikes ride away….They go right past where we are hiding, but they do not notice us….That is good, we want them gone….Maybe inside the same house, I want to take a hot tub with my wife….I tell her I will get it ready for us, then go into a bathroom where a small square hot tub has been set up….it is Bud’s room?….I get in, and the water is only half full, and it is barely warm….I sit down, and figure if both my wife and I are inside, then the water level will probably be fine….I fiddle with the equipment to turn up the heat….A sexual encounter ensues....

Someone comes into a place, a house that is to be their new home?....But they do not understand that….They seem confused, anxious….I want to help them, but I wonder how?....They put a backpack on the floor by a window with a curved lower frame, like a semi-circle, a creamy white in color….Later, I go outside into a backyard, at night….In the dark I suddenly realize there are several deer all around me, I can barely see them….I have a weird feeling, like a sudden awareness of something that has been alive and active surrounding me without my knowing it….The deer are alarmed by our arrival, but they realize we will not harm them….They quickly scatter in all directions….

Some people are thinking and wondering about where to locate their new homes….I see white grid lines on the ground, laying out the arrangement of the buildings….….But I know this is a bad flood area….only I can see the grid lines….The people should not build here, their houses will get washed away….I try to talk an old lady out of it….

I go into a house on a lake….I seem to be with some other people….The contours of the watershed creeks are inlaid in the floor, so you can see the whole water flow system….it is very cool, I am pleased to see it….But then I realize we are lost….This is not our house, and we are unsure where to go….I realize my red-pink apple cooking process is in a different place….Here, they are doing it better, doing it right….I observe….There is a woman in the group, she is aging badly?....She wants pictures taken?....

A man and a woman help us get the house together….They enable me and my wife to move from mere outlines and thought bubbles to real changes….At another point, I am at a house, and I get in an epic supernatural fight with another powerful person….Their helper is a guy in a suit, Rudy Guiliani?....He is running around on the periphery, and suddenly he falls down in a room with lots of weapons, swords, spears….I pin him down and say, now if you were in the fight, it would be easy to kill you….He runs away….At some point I see Vinton wearing a green shirt run by me….I wonder why?....Then I see the guy in a suit, he steps into a weird pool of hot oil or some kind of liquid?....A gross dull orange color, maybe yellow….he is in there as a punishment for his stupid behavior?....he walks around in a slow circle, pointlessly, knee deep in the liquid….But then I suddenly realize he has pushed a woman under the surface, and he is killing her as he walks in bored circles around the pool….I think that is disgusting, and I leave, I do not want to watch it….I think with disappointment how all of David Lynch’s movies seem to end this way….I go through a hotel lobby, looking for an elevator….I see Vinton going past again?....

The new president and his wife and two young kids stroll into a theatrical show….Everything has been held up for them, and now they are taking their time walking across a field and into the theater….Later, other situations happen in which he is disrupting OSF activities, getting involved in everything and making it all harder….we have very negative feelings towards him….

The whole cast from Love’s Labors Lost are together in a circle, getting ready for the next show….They ask for audience input, for ideas about the performers, what they can do….I can see that Octavia has her fingers crossed behind he back, though, which I think is meant to suggest she is holding something back, she isn’t being totally forthcoming….Another actor, Macklin, is running around too….I wonder, how do we, the audience, help them develop a new innovative show?....

my wife and I do some little decorative thing with flowers and a wood cutting board….to make a pretty display for the new house in Ashland….Other people like it….But someone has a much larger cutting board, and they are following us?....They come out through the door to the garage at the ranch, and I have to close it….The kittens would be able to get out, and they are around in the house, though not close here because they are hiding from the person, and so they are far away elsewhere in the house….Later, I see a woman and her kid, who is playing along the rocky shore of a creek….He slips on a rock, which slides at a 45 degree angle into the water….into the water he goes, and we react with alarm and go to help him….there might be a whirlpool down there….

People are going in the water of a lake or creek, but it is too shallow, there is nothing old in there?....Later, I go into a meeting with the dean of a school, in his office….I am too early, so I go back out to the waiting room….I have lots of clothing and other things in my arms, it is awkward walking without dropping things….I wonder with some anxiety, do I look foolish to the other people in the waiting room?....This is taking place at a fancy school, with a big quad, green grass, lots of tall buildings….
Some people walk by a big white and blue ship that is moored by the shore….I see them walking on the wooden planks, right to left….

A square table with several gray objects on it….Some have to be cleaned, properly tended….We are helping to get a man ready for something, but he is clueless, unaware of what is really going on….Later, I am aware of three women in a house, grandmother, mother, and daughter….At another point, I am going to fool around with a woman….there is no rush, a good happy vibe about where it is going….Inside a theater, I can suddenly see outside through a door straight to a black house….and I see the same thing a moment later with a white house, too….These are our houses, and somehow this alignment helps the show be better….a better performance will result….

I see a woman doubled over outside the kitchen door of the house here, maybe there is something wrong with her….I open the door to let her come inside, to help her….But a big guy comes inside, too….oh oh, I wonder and worry, was that a mistake?....Now what is going to happen?....

Someone, a guy, is shifting the program here at our house, to an all non-Shakespeare program….This will be better for that guy, it makes him happy, but it is not what I would do….At some point, a little gray cat is in danger somehow….I wonder how I can help protect it….

We are trying to set up a show of Romeo and Juliet, but it is complicated and frustrating, nothing works as it should….This goes on and on, constant shifts and frustrations….We are trying to prepare things for an older woman, this is all intended to make her happy?....

With some people’s help, I am designing and building a perfect home base for seeing shows, etc….But everyone has different ideas about the elements of the house, it is very confusing….At first I am reluctant to do what they want because I know Ashland does not like such multi-element houses, which do not fit in with the other houses in the neighborhood….But then I see the wisdom of going in this direction….I see light and dark patches of space, inner and outer rooms….

I am with someone in a small plane….We take off over water, the bay of a resort town, with beaches and hotels, lots of people….The pilot is mom?....She takes off and we are going very fast, so she steers the plane straight up in the sky to let the speed diminish, then she banks the plane left and down again….Soon we are flying fairly low over the water, curving around, it is exhilarating….I wonder, does this plane have an engine?....It seems to be gliding only….that would be dangerous if it had no engine….Then I am in the resort town, going on a run with some friends and family members, my wife?....I am in front, and I go around a corner on the street and suddenly realize it is the finish line for a race, with banners, crowds, signs, and race officials….A woman in a white wedding dress runs around the corner after me, she is about to cross the finish line….I turn around and go back, and I shout at the rest of our group to turn down a different street, and not go around that corner….I feel it is very important for us to avoid disrupting the race….As I figure out what is going on, I realize it is a staggered race, with people starting and finishing at different times, to keep the course from getting too crowded….I see other runners, and I think of how I will be going out at some point to join the race….I am excited, I feel I might have a chance at winning….I yell in excitement and clap my hands….At this point I am in a yard, on a dirt hillside, with some play structures around, and lots of kids playing, while other people are preparing for an Easter celebration….I see a guy putting several Easter eggs into a shallow hole in the dirt, which he will then cover….I wonder how anyone will be able to find them….

Something about trying to move lots of people out of a space, like an arena, before lots of water comes in, which seems to be dangerous….Later I am at a baseball game, at the home field of the San Francisco Giants, sitting in a luxury box with other people up above the third base side of the field….A ball flies up and towards us, and I reach out my black glove and catch it….That is lucky!....I happily hold up the ball in my bare hand and show it to the crowd, as one is expected to do in such situations, and they cheer….I am sitting in a high-backed easy chair, facing away from the field….I take off my black Giants cap and turn around in my chair to wave the hat towards the fans, I know they will like that….There is more cheering, though not as much as the first time….

Aliens have taken control of our world….They choose a small number of people and put them in charge of society, during the time before the aliens destroy everything….I know this is a final trick by the aliens to deceive us and eliminate any resistance….They know that all the people will fall to arguing and disagreeing amongst themselves, and nothing will happen….So I take charge of the group, and I get everyone to focus on dreams….By doing this, the aliens will not know what we are planning, and we can make the best use of our own intelligence….That’s what I want, for us to use this resource, rather than letting the aliens benefit from it to use against us….This is our special source of wisdom….Now I am feeling at least a little hopeful….At some point I see streaks of bright white light going into the sky….

Two teams are playing a pro baseball game, and one of the teams is winning, by a score of something like 7-2….Then towards the end of the game, each team puts in position players as pitchers, since the outcome of the contest is basically over….The final score ends up something absurd like 29-10, which means those replacement pitchers did a terrible job, and the game got sloppy….I do not like that, I think it is a bad, lame decision by both teams….most importantly, it is unfair and disrespectful to the fans who have to watch players going through the motions, not really playing the way they are supposed to play….

I go with a group of people into a cave area….We are riding a small car or open train….it is very dark inside, and suddenly from above we notice black shapes flying in the air….Are those bats?....Yes, I realize they are, and unusually large ones….Everyone is very afraid, and I feel a surge of fear, too, but then I immediately try to calm myself down, telling myself the bats are harmless, not a danger to us….At another point, I see a white streak in the blue sky….The streak is moving from left to right and upwards, but suddenly it bends more sharply upwards, as if it hit an obstacle….I wonder what is blocking it, what is preventing it from being able to go forward….

Someone has a table of goods for sale, at the beginning of a long journey….But they are making fake things, not what they appear to be….lower quality, it seems to be a rip-off….I do not want any of the things….But the salesperson tosses me a little black ball or round package anyway….I see it fly in the air towards me….Later, I am in a car, and a little kid in a car seat in front of me suddenly says I am choking, I cannot breathe….In alarm suddenly spring forward to help the kid….

I am walking on a trail with a guy, on a nice sunny day, blue sky….We are going up a steep trail towards a rocky pinnacle….I get scared suddenly, and say I cannot go any further….I am afraid I will fall….Later, I am in a small cart or open car, someone else is driving, and we go through an area where a guy with a dog is ahead of us….The dog gets in our way and will not move….I have to get out of the cart to guide the dog to the side….The dog’s owner, a white guy in a short-sleeved plaid shirt, is oblivious to the problems his dog is causing, and I get mad at him for not thinking of other people….He gets mad at me, too….Later, a black woman and I are paired together to do something, but what?....I am unsure….I see a picture of her, in a small square frame….There is a question, a complex choice involved in deciding where we will go, how this process will unfold….

I go into a restaurant….The lights are on, but no one is there….That is weird, I know it is open, but it is completely empty……..I put down my backpack on the floor, and wait by the front door….Later, some white guy, Chip?, is shooting an M16 rifle at me….He is on a hill above me, and I run below, from right to left, very scared and looking for cover….I go behind a wooden crib and turn it over to hide behind….He keeps shooting, and I see the bullet holes pop through the wood….I realize this is not going to give me that much protection….I also see his kids up with him on the hill….I yell, you are shooting at a crib!....a bed for babies!....Aren’t you ashamed?....He laughs and keeps shooting….I am angry at him….Earlier, someone wants to claim a long thing, like a pole….but I know it is a fake….set in a square somewhere?....

Some people have a plan for humans and aliens to get along….But I realize the plan will lead to the death of all humans….I see the humans as tiny white square pods, laid out in a grid?....I step forward and say no, don’t do it….and don’t trust them going forward….I say this shows that the people making the plans are both incompetent and immoral, trying to commit genocide against us….That rules them out forever as people we should listen to….Later, I follow a group of people until they get to an open courtyard, where they stop to rest and hang out….I stop, too, and sit on a round stool with a green padded top and wheels on the bottom, so I can roll and slide around….it is fun, I enjoy it….A woman is part of their group, she notices I am there….At another point, I am walking down a beach, the water to my left, along a resort area with hotels and buildings….I come to a turn in the beach where a lot of young women in bikinis are laying on the sand….There is no easy way to get through or around them, without causing a big disruption, drawing attention to myself….I do not really need to get to the other side, I am just out for a walk, so I decide to turn around and go back the way I came….

I walk with a dark-haired woman somewhere….We are together and happy….We come to a new place where a black guy and two other people of color should be coming in….Everything is set for their entry into the space….But then the white men who run this, they do not like what is happening, it angers them, and they are thinking about changing it so he cannot come in….to me that seems blatantly unfair of them….

I am with a woman, we are trying to make an M-shaped structure work….But it is too uncomfortable….Later I see Strauss our cat, he wants to come inside….I wonder, what is he doing outside?....That is not where I thought I had left him  -- not at our house, but near the M structure?

A guy needs to get some product finished by June 30 so it can be ready for sale….something to do with energy?....I am in front of him in the process, like ahead of him in line, and I am not going as fast as he wants to go, he is getting frustrated with me….

I am in an inside swimming pool, in a shallow area, watching some kind of show….Several women (three?) are in the water, performing in the show….I wonder if it is ok for me to be so close to the action, I did not expect to be this near to them….I curl up my knees to make myself less obtrusive….Later, I am in the pool by myself….I see a couple of plastic knives floating in the water….I toss them out to the side of the pool, but they fall into the water again….I see a couple of other knives in the water, too  --  the whole place is kind of dingy, old yellow walls, like an old school gym….

I go into this weird neighborhood, where people are supposed to be taking care of Ronald and a friend, both little kids….But then I see a group of them, big, dark, hairy guys, walking towards Ronald and his friend in a menacing way, beating drums and throwing rocks….In the shade under some trees in a park….I am confused, and at first I run away….But then I stop, turn around, and go back to tell them stop, I angrily yell fuck you, don’t throw rocks at my son….At some point later, I go to my wife in a big, square glass motel room, in the same neighborhood….I ask if it’s ok to close the blinds for some privacy….it is a weird setting….and more weird coercive people are around….one guy is in charge, and my wife refers to him as dad?....I don’t like it….At one point, maybe in another room in the same motel, I am caring for a slender young woman, with long red hair, who seems scared and vulnerable….we are laying down, and she is on top of me and I’m holding her tight, trying to comfort her….I have a vague sense we may fool around later, but that’s not what we are doing now, it feels good as it is….Earlier: as I drive through a city, I become aware of a group of people trying to help and publicize the plight of Mexican women who are working so long and hard they do not have time to care for their own children….I totally agree about how unjust that is….And before that: I am angry at a boy who will not listen to me, do what I ask him to do….

I go to meet a guy who will be our guide for some kind of cultural event….He is standing at a sidewalk, outside a stadium….but also like the Del Norte BART train station….He is wearing a tan trench coat, rather nice and stylish….I see that parked right behind him, taking up a lot of space, is a big old dirty white van, which has been parked there forever, he says….that’s not right, I think, it’s disrupting his business….my wife agrees and calls the police on her cell phone to get the van removed….While she does so I see a menacing Hispanic guy with a shaved head walking towards us….It is his van, and he realizes what is happening and he is angry….He comes up to me and another guy and says, are you trying to jam me?....I see him pull back his elbow and I brace in fear for a sudden blow, but instead he hits the other guy hard in the midriff….

I am running down a hill on a street, and I’m aware that an old woman in a car is driving behind me to my left….I close my eyes and take huge strides, which magically elongate, almost as if I am flying….I feel if I really tried, I could jump in the air and maneuver a little bit….a brief happy elation….But then I open my eyes, because I realize I might veer off course in my jumping and fall, I have to be careful….Then, I am driving a little car in a small town, and I see the road turns sharply downhill, almost like a cliff….I do not know if I can make that without falling out of control, so I pause and wonder for a moment….No, I cannot….I turn right into an antique store, and I realize that a woman in a small box-like car has been waiting behind me, she is annoyed as she drives by me….

An older guy in a stylish tan trench coat and hat is at a social gathering….He says little, but he puts two little objects out in the room, which subtly signal that he wants to go….Others can look at the objects and figure it out from here for themselves, without him having to say anything else, I am impressed….a cat goes up and sniffs at the objects, and understands what is happening….At some point I look down a stairwell and to my surprise see that someone has been shot on a lower floor….It’s a friend of mine?....I wonder what I should do….I am shocked and scared….At the very end, I see one of the cats about to nibble and eat at some aluminum foil, I need to stop it, that’s dangerous….

I am driving a car in a parking lot, looking for a space, but it is all full of cars….But then I see an open space, in a lane that’s going the wrong way for me….I am disappointed that I have to drive by it….But then I realize, oh, I can back into that lane and into the space….That will work just fine….I am pleased with my cleverness….

I am in a big building, a recording studio for three rich brothers….It is crazy inside the house, lots of people around doing various things, not organized, chaotic….At one point, inside a large hall or chamber, it seems like Congress, and I think wait, is dad a new member of Congress?....I look for him in the crowd, but I do not see him….At some point I see a woman with a silver patch on her vagina….I guess this is a new kind of contraception?....I am glad I do not have to deal with situations and developments like this in my sexual life….

I learn to make a special kind of cake, but it must be both consistent and interesting….Dad helps me at various points….But it is hard to do both, I struggle with it….Lots of people are around, and there is a sense that some of them are doing mischief, disrupting things on purpose….

We own a bakery, and Fern works there….Bad guys are disrupting things for us?....At some point a bad guy has a hostage….my kid?....I sneak up to try and rescue the kid, but they see me and shoot a laser at me….It stings as it hits my right thigh, I block it with my right hand and scramble for cover….This is happening outside, in an area with big gray cement blocks….

I am in some club with other people, it is a sex club for women?....I am brought over to pose for a picture with other men, as attractive background for the women….Before the picture, the women tell us to pinch our nipples to make us look more aroused….I turn away and say no, I will not do that….Later, I am in a line waiting for something, and two men pushing baby strollers try to cut to the front of the line….I am a little angry, and think that is not fair….But because they seem to have babies, I am unsure if it is worth making a fuss about it….At another point I am trying to take care of a little slug creature, for Ronald….Two of the creatures?....Strauss our cat gets one of them, picks it up in his mouth and starts walking away….I make him stop and give it back….Now the creature has become a little blue furry thing, not green and slimy as before….it is outside, walking up some cement stairs and onto a plaza in front of a big building, looking where to go….I keep a close eye on it, to keep it safe in case it tries to get away….At some point I am taking care of a young woman….I feel very protective of her, affectionate and intimate….positive feelings….

I stand in for an artist in a dispute….He was in an incident earlier in the evening, left traces of his presence, pieces of shit?....I now say to others, yes, he was here….Earlier: two actors in in control of a space, and they hassle Fern over something….

Some people show me a strange leak problem in a house of mine….Water drips through some tan or light brown tubes, then through some black tubes, and then finally into a puddle on the floor….I am unsure which one of the tubes is the cause of the problem….I am also unsure which contractor to follow….I suspect they may try to fool me….

A guy no one likes is the owner of a big complex….He leaves, and other people freak out in anxiety and try to catch him….One of the security guards pulls a fire alarm, he thinks this will help, and water from the overhead sprinklers starts spraying everywhere….I think, that was a dumb move by the guard, it will not help catch the guy, and now we, not the owner, have made everything a big mess….

I am with a woman in some indoor art scene….I am trying to help get her properly set up in the room….It is difficult….various things making it all complicated….She kneels down, and waits patiently for whatever is going to happen….She seems to trust me….Later, I am in my study, standing over by the bookcase with my plums, with my sweat pants down at my ankles….At that moment, my wife opens the door and suddenly lets in Sally, who has arrived for a surprise visit for some reason….My wife gives me a look as she leaves, I can tell she is angry about this….I am shocked, this is such an unfortunate moment for a visitor, but I try to recover….Sally is cheerful, and seems oblivious to my embarrassed discomfort or my wife's reaction….She wants my help or advice with something, and I do try to help, but the whole thing is awkward….

A bunch of guys has me trapped, surrounding me….I am afraid they are going to take me somewhere and hurt me….But then I am suddenly outside somewhere, with only a button-down shirt wrapped around me, nothing else….I am outside my apartment building, but I do not have a key, so I cannot get inside, and I realize I do not know the language that others are speaking….It is all very confusing and embarrassing….Somehow I get inside, and people are looking at me funny and critically, as I am naked and confused and lost….Then I realize the cats have gotten outside while I have been away…. Worried, I go out and whistle for them, and I see Fireface, she comes out of the bushes and walks towards me, tail high….That’s one cat back, I think, but I wonder, what about the others?....

I am with a bunch of people in a big warehouse, somewhat like the arena at the ranch….We have been driving around, as part of a costume party?....Then the police drive into the warehouse….We all try to get back into our car, a big old tan sedan….I am slow, I fumble with the rear passenger door, trying to get it open so I can climb inside before the police arrive….I almost do not make it in….The police question us, and now we are all sitting around, in casual clothes….The police officers are women, and they talk to us….They show one person in our group, an older woman, how much prison time she will do….I am scared at the impending punishment, and I wonder, do the police really have to go ahead with this?....Don’t they have the discretion to be nice and just let us go?....I notice one of the police officers is wearing a white cotton tank top, very casual….

Some guy is trying to sell silver….But he has trouble doing so, and I need to help him figure it out….At some point I see a picture of something that folds at an angle, but the picture is on a flat piece of paper….I wonder at the optical illusion of a folded angle on a flat space….

I go into a big room where a party is happening….Like the inside of a Club….An Asian woman tells me it is over, and about to change back to something more interesting….As she talks, I see a girl going through the room, looking at the chairs and tables, considering each thing that will change….Later, someone is asking about the change in weather between this full moon and the last one….Now it is clearly winter; this is the moon that shifts to the real cold….
I am helping dad with something….I have an apartment high up against a cliff, far above the town below….

I am driving a van, and I realize it has the same hood insignia as a van used only for a charity group….My van is red, that one is white?....I drive the van up to an airport, which is across a large square green grass field….I suddenly realize no, I should go back, this is not right, I am not ready for this yet….Earlier, I am with a boy, and when he sees a group of people he starts crying….He was crying earlier, and now he’s crying again….I wonder why….
Someone is following me around, messing up everything I do….It is very frustrating….Later, some people are looking at gross animal parts, like a dead animal….I look away in disgust….

I am running through a city….I am not going very fast, but I try to speed up as I realize other people are watching me….Later, I see some nice angles….Everything in my view lines up….the furniture, light, angles….it’s quite beautiful….

I am doing some things, sitting on the ground outside….Someone comes to help me with each of the things, in different places….it has to do with pretty little crystal or glass objects, like candle holders?....I am happy about it, happy for the help….
I am working with some trees, and other people help me….I am grateful for the help….It goes better once we realize it is a mostly religious process….that makes it easier to do….

Some people were knocking at [my] door and they were just calling [my] name and [I] was making some tea or like that and then they told [me] to come with them... and [I] went with them and [I] saw people… some were crying, some were laughing, some were smiling and then I was surprised, “Where have I gone, I don't know? I was making tea. But I suddenly came here, I don't know how I reached but the man… two men had taken me here… and now they are not here, so what do I do?” And then like some horn people with the big horn with tusks like elephant they were beating people... those to whom they were doing things were in a lot of pain… [the horned people] were angry because [those they were beating] had sinned… [the people being beaten were] in hell and [they were] badly beaten and then I was speaking to [myself], “I have to be at my house, I have to make tea”... and then [I] was walking and again the two men were pulling [me]... “You should stay here, you have to be here”... and [I] wanted to go but [I] was pulled by them and then finally [I] reached to [my] home and [I] woke up...

I go to the roof of my house – in other words I go to a little bit of a high place. Then I decide to jump down from there. While jumping off, I feel some kind of divine power. Then I try to push myself back up. My effort is successful. Again, something – a dangerous animal – chases me. I try to run away and again I reach that roof and, again, I jump off the roof. I feel like I fly far away from that thing. I reach some house, but again I am chased [by it]. Now I feel I have supernatural power in me. I can just walk through any material things and I can take the form of any body. I am able to deceive it. When I feel that I am successful, then suddenly my dream disappears.

I am flying in the sky. Below [me] the big buildings and people looked very small. Probably I was flying too high so everything looked very small. Then, I suddenly saw myself far away from other people and even when I tried to come down I did not feel that the distance decreased.

As I was going to my uncle’s house [in the dream] I was talking to myself about all the things I saw along the way. One family had lost their father. Therefore lots of things were running in my mind. Why do we have to die? Why can't we live on this earth for a long time? When I was still thinking about these things I woke up.

One day while watching my favorite program in TV as I forgot my school time for a moment but later when advertisement came in TV I just looked at time and [I was] scared because the time had gone 15 minutes ahead of my school time. So I hurriedly wore uniform and without checking all the books and copies, etc., I just put it on my back and went from home for school. Because of being late I was stopped to wait at the gate for 30 minutes as punishment. After that I entered into my classroom. I had missed my first class and then teacher of second period came into classroom and ordered to come in order with their homework. I also looked at my bag inside and unluckily I had no copy of homework. I [was] scared. Then, after the teacher knew that, he dropped me out of class and then I woke up.

As my older sister and I were walking through the jungle we lost our way and walked looking for the right path, but we did not find it. We were afraid. Then we sensed a jungle animal – a tiger – was coming from somewhere and we were more afraid. But the tiger was so friendly that he showed us the way to our home. When we reached home, each of us died at the same instant. Afterwards we came back to life again and we met each other. When we met there was so much happiness that because of the happiness I woke up.

Just one night in my dream I got myself in a strange place. I don’t know more about that place but there was trees, a house, and its pet. Suddenly I saw my family members there in that house. They were engaged in their work and when I got closer to them they don’t even saw me. Then I called my dad and bro saying, “I am here,” but they don’t respond. Then I realized I was invisible for them and I had already left them few months ago without saying them anything. I was just dying to being scolded from my parents for what I have done without their permission. I thereafter felt that I was an inseparable part for them. I was there and I saw my parents working hard and was in critical condition. I myself was just helpless to help them and easily got away from there. I was crying and crying.

I was sleeping alone at night. Suddenly in front of me [there was] one person wearing white clothes [who] was slowly coming towards me. All of my peace had already left me when I saw the body full of hairs and the long fangs. I was unconsciously moving backward and in my mind I was thinking about how to get away from this bhut [ghost/demon]. And I was stopped in a place that looked like the trunk of the tree. Lots of thoughts were playing in my mind and I thought I would not be left alive. The demon came close to me and said, "Where are you going? Can we go together?" And I couldn't respond. Due to fear I felt as if my heart stopped. Then I remembered God: "O God, please save me today by any means." For some time I felt even the demon was perplexed. Then he turned into the form of a monkey and walked away. I kept watching. And after the demon reached far away I also returned home and slept remembering the divine power. It was already morning.
When I used to see the dreams about dead people, at that time I used to think that the Lord is with me. In the dream, I used to pray, “Lord, Lord.”
I saw a dream in which I was riding a bus. At that time rain came from above and I got wet. I got off the bus, went to a [covered] place, and drank some water. I realized that it was holy water.
In my dream I saw 4 or 5 white empty vessels. When I went to fetch water, two of them got swept away by the current of the flooded river.

In my dream I went to a certain place that was very remote. I saw so many different kinds of people there. And one poor man came to me and was saying, “I am poor,” that is, he shared his problems with me. And I shared the gospel with him and he [indicated that he] hated me for being a Christian.

I saw a man standing before me who was like the Son of God. I saw him with my eyes. From him light was coming. That was like burning pillar. Because of shining I couldn’t see him. I close my eye because of fear. I couldn’t understand who was he.
I saw a scary dream. One man called me and took me to an angel who asked me: "Where do you come from?" As soon as I replied, "I am coming from home," the angel left. And I woke up.
I saw a dream of a child being sick and something was taking the child away. The child was begging for my help. [I prayed for him when I saw this happening.]

There was a small bridge that I had to cross. The [river] was very deep. I sat down [on] the bridge and slowly crossed. [The bridge] had no sidebars but I crossed it. After that, I saw some people celebrating and happy. Then I also started celebrating happily with them. Then I woke up.
I was afraid because I was continually vomiting. For a long time, I was continually vomiting. I was very exhausted and afraid. Then, suddenly I woke up.

In one of dreams I was lost in the world and one man dressed in white asked me to come close to him, to his embrace. Then, I said to him, "Lord, I am very sinful and wicked and how can I come to you?" He said to me, "Come near me, I love you." Then I cried a lot and he hugged me. And I felt strange when I woke up.

When I was walking in the jungle, I heard someone crying so I went following the voice. I found a man who was turning to the other side and was crying. And I asked, "Why are you crying?" He said, "Because I see you." Perplexed, I asked him, "Why are you crying seeing me?" He said, "Because you are spoilt." Then I asked, "Why are you crying because I am spoilt?" He replied, "Because I have a great plan for your life." Lastly, I asked, "Who are you?" He said, "I am Jesus."
A white thing came and entered into my body and I experienced the bright light.
I was falling from a tall mountain. When I was falling from the mountain I was feeling shocked and when I woke up I was still afraid.

I saw a dream that I was in my home and without reason my dad scold me very bitterly but my mom [who had recently died] came and she take against my dad and she counseled me. She gave me many advice. One of the advice I remember is that she told me, “My son please complete B.Th. with excellence.”
In front of many people I was preaching or saying word of God. [I was preaching] in English.
When I saw my dream that time the evil spirit attacked me. Immediately I cast away evil spirit in the name of Jesus Christ. That evil spirit left me.

In my dream I was sleeping and my one of friend she was praying. After some time she said, “Wake up and see.” And I woke up [in the dream] and I saw the angel. He was so bright I could not see him. And he change his face and came near said, “Second coming of Jesus is very near. Be prepared.” And not only that, in my dream all people they were busy in sharing gospel. And suddenly I woke up.
I saw a very bright-clothes-wearing Jesus. He came to meet me and at that time in my heart some joy came.

One day in dream I was wandering around in a strange land. At that time I worshipped many gods. After moving forward for some time I saw a pond of clean and clear water, which was large. In that beautiful place there was a statue of Mahadev. I bowed down to the statue and began worshipping. Then I saw a huge snake god come out which was very big and there was a supernaturally bright light in its head.

Once I was going to an unknown place. There were so many native people in that place who used to worship Bhagawan [God] a lot. While searching in the jungle I fell and became unconscious. Those native people were spraying water on me. Then there was one vision of divine power and I woke up from the dream.

It was dark and I was at home. My one friend calls me and tells me, “Come see me.” I asked him, “Where are you?” and he said, “There is a map on your table; come following it.” I took the map and started to run. After a little while I reached a big jungle where there were a lot of wild animals. I escaped from them when I was about to reach my friend. I saw my friend. My friend also saw me. Suddenly an animal attacked me and I disappeared.

One day in my dream I saw a big wall. That wall was holding lots of water. The water was blue, clear and pure. In the dream my friends and I were enjoying playing with the water. And also on the wall was a small pond where there was some water.

I was in a dense jungle but there was a narrow walking path. As I was walking all alone, I suddenly see a monkey in the tree. When it saw me it jumped to different trees and came near me and started teasing me. Just the way I am afraid of monkeys in real life, I was afraid in the dream and I started running away. The more I ran the more the monkey chased me. The monkey was just chasing me – it was not doing anything to me. I felt as if he wanted to make a friend of me. He comes close to me and pokes but I am afraid and try to keep his hands off me.

One night I dreamed that I went to my home in Baglung. So after reaching my home in the dream I went to my uncle’s home to see my uncle’s family. When I was coming near uncle’s house, suddenly I saw a tire and because of fear I immediately woke up.
In one of my dreams I saw my deceased grandmother.
In my dream a tiger was chasing me. I was restless. I was crying and running and the tiger was chasing me. Suddenly I woke up.
I was about to go to the market from my home. I was not feeling comfortable to go alone. After walking for 5 minutes I met my girlfriend and felt comfortable walking up the hill to the market.

A close friend of mine calls me to her college gate to meet her. After her classes were over, I met her. After that we walk around a place and share our hearts. As we were returning home, suddenly we meet my friend's mom. She asked us different things. My friend was a girl. Then, I just woke up.
After walking a lot I arrived in a temple and was doing worship. At that time, I had a vision of the goddess. There was no limit of my joy.
I was walking a certain path in the village. As I walked I reached the river. It was dark, and I was afraid. There was a bridge to cross the river but I wasn't able to cross it.
In a dream that I can remember, I was holding a man's legs, and pushing his head against the wall. I was feeling very powerful. I was becoming very rude. The brain came out of his head and he died.

In my dream I saw myself with my family. [We] reached a strange land. There was a river. There were also trees. I climbed up the extraordinary tree and plucked a flower I had never seen before. I had to struggle a lot to climb up the tree. And I gave this flower to my family members.

[In my dream] me and my boyfriend were having a walk and on the way we came to see a pond. It was a little messed. It seemed so polluted. I asked him not to cross it and take another way. We were walking by the side of it but accidentally he fell in the pond and got messed.

In one of my dreams, as I was travelling through the jungle I reached a new village. Later on, when I tried to return back to my home, there was no path. As a result, I stayed in that village for 30 years.

I had to go somewhere to meet my friends and it was getting late. My scooter was being used by someone who would not give it to me. Then I asked one of my uncles to drop me there and he said, “No,” so I forcefully let myself in and I reached the destination and met my friends. I had a chance to meet significant people in my life.
In my dream I saw my deceased father and [deceased] neighbor sister.

I dream that I got married to my boyfriend. As we come from different family background, I realized that the ceremony was conducted in different manner. I was not happy about it. In the function my parents were also present. Even they didn’t look happy either. I felt low. They left and I attended the guests of his family. All were busy taking care and serving the guest, but no one came to me to ask for anything. At that moment I missed my parents, remembering their care and concern. Inside I felt like crying.

I saw a dream… in the dream what I saw is that [my friends and I] are in college… we were in grade 12… that friend, our friend who was in the hospital [in reality at the time that the dream occurred], that friend was back… fully recovered… fully recovered and he was totally walking with us… he was back in college… he was healed… I saw he came… we were shaking hands, we were hugging, we were happy… everyone was happy…

I was bowing, I was doing something, I was praying in front of Krishna… I was praying to him for blessing me like him… make me some beautiful – like handsome – like him… and prettiness like him… pretty sound like him… I bowed to him like that… [Krishna was playing the flute]… [he looked like] that same picture we used to see… he is speaking to me and he is asking for me to speak, to beg something… I think he was moving there, and while I am praying he came in front of me and he has blessed me… [I was praying] in front of Krishna mandir in Mangalbazaar [in the dream when all of this happened]… [I felt Krishna’s presence]… That same dream that I have explained about the Krishna…while I was [bowing] to him… that flashlight flashed in my eyes and that was the light I saw, while in the appearance of Lord Krishna… I feel so quite relieved… I was happy to see him
I saw tiger roaring towards me, coming towards me
In the dream I was not riding an international plane, I was only on a domestic plane… I rode on the plane and went to America in the dream

I remember I saw [goddess Kali]… she was like dancing, she was huge… I was just looking from bench… I was sitting (and like this kind of place)… and [Kali] was dancing… it was quite like open ground like this… it was open ground and there was a blue sky… and she was so huge, she danced in front of me… and I was just seeing her

I saw Buddha in Pashupatinath [temple]… there was Bagmati River and the Buddha’s statue was floating on it… It was a statue only… it was big one, it was floating on the river, and I was just standing at the corner… I just remembered that I dropped one of my leg in the river…
Once I saw Jesus Christ… I was falling from the mountain at the time and the Jesus Christ came and saved me… He was wearing white dress… but I don’t remember his face…

Once I saw a dream [in which I felt God’s presence]… I was in chanting some mantra with Shiva… I could feel the vibration at the time… I was like shaking in the dream only… I could feel it… [Shiva looked] like the one I see in the pictures… blue [skin]… with snake on the neck… and twisted hair… Bob Marley also have, the same one… I was somewhere in dark place, like a cave… Like I was feeling so strange like I was shaking with him alone… he told me not to eat flesh – meat… [I felt like I was one with him]… he was in chanting some mantras and I was also in chanting with him… I don’t remember it so clearly… I was [chanting] like, “OM namma Shivay” and some different languages… I was just in chanting some different languages… not in Nepali, it was different
I saw a dream, I was like climbing mountain… I was jumping [from there] in the big lake… [the lake] was very blue, it was clear

In that time I used to have dream of how great [Jesus] was and what sacrifice he made for humanity. He has long hair, because I had… that was the portrait of [him]… long hair, mustache… I think little full mustache and he was walking with his all disciples. He was [wearing white clothes].

So once I had that dream of Shiva… he was… we have male figure of him, he has snake around his neck and he was standing in front of me. I was probably sitting or standing by the side of him. I didn’t feel anything…
Once I saw Taal Barahi temple… I saw the temple [surrounded by the water of the lake]
As for me, I saw one dream in which a cow was trying to kill me… one cow searching to hit me but the cow did not hit…
It was very scary. Lots of snakes came and after they chased me…

I saw Shiva Bhagavan. [He looked like] extremely God image… [like in picture]… like drum, snake… necklace – necklace of [living] snake… tiger skin… [I felt good in this dream.] I went to temple and did puja. God said to me, “May you be good.”

It is a very scary jungle. In the jungle there is a temple. Many people went in the temple… many people went to get a vision [of God]… where was it, I don’t know. Immediately after being afraid I woke

14 years ago I had a dream... [I saw] a lake of blood… Many police came and surrounded [the house]… they came to search [my husband]. I hid him under the bed and I told them – in the dream – “He is not here. He is not in the house.” All the blood was overflowing and this was very bad dream – in night. And I suddenly woke up.

There is one location [I have seen]… that is a gorge type of location… it is very deep there… [I have not imagined or thought of that deep location in the dream prior to seeing the dream]… I was jumping at that place where I saw… I was jumping… I was jumping from there and I felt very scared due to the height… because of the fear at that time I felt like this [body part] was very tight… because of the fear of looking down at such a great height I woke

I felt one time… the case was like I was crossing a stream… in the stream a big flood came… I must cross to the other side but after [I started] crossing I was afraid… [actually] the stream swept me away… [because I was swept away in the dream I was afraid I would die]… I said, “I will die,” but suddenly I felt that, “Ey, this is only a dream… I will not die actually”… after saying, “I won’t die” I went without fear… actually I crossed the stream

I have seen one dream of a dead person. Dead person… this person “returned” after dying… like this I have seen one time… my relative’s death had already happened, and this person came in my dream… and I had spoken with him [in the dream]… He said to me, “[Give] me this food,”… food... “it was my difficult days when I lived,” he said... in the dream... “I have a problem of food… there is no food”… “I have been hungry, usually there is no food for me in the home”… these are the kind of things he said… The end of the dream… he could not be inside the house… I mean, he did not enter in his house. We are talking outside. I asked to come inside but he did not come in. It was in our place. It was in the countryside, in the village. It is very far from here... in the far West... the name of the place is Daan. [We lived in the same village together.] [We were at] his own house [in the dream], which is my cousin’s house… I asked him to go inside but he did not go… I said, “Please go inside”... but he did not go... “I should not go inside – I am a dead person – I should not go inside... I must stay outside,” he said.
I was in a temple, and I was taking one of the god's names and repeating a mantra that was like the mantra one says to Shiva
And I saw [my father]… he was dead in my dream, and I was crying like that
[I saw] that person wearing white clothes… I will be shivering in fear… while dreaming… [the figure wears a robe that covers the whole body]… they wear very long and come
I saw a full body of water. I was at [my friend] Bina’s place and the swimming pool was full of toilet water
So I had a dream like I’m in my school and I suddenly heard that my dad is no more and I’m crying like that… my friends are approaching me with the bad news, like that
I see Ganesh. I just see him and I just go nearby and I don’t get any blessing from because I just see a stone of that only

I saw my friend… she was like so depressed, and I tried to ask her what happened but she wasn’t telling me anything… she was going far away from me, and I tried to stop her as well… and it was like, “I don’t know what was that”… I just saw that only

[I saw a dream where Shiva was blessing me with his hand. I looked up to the sky and I saw the half body of Shiva.] It was just the figure, it was in the sky and it wasn’t the full figure, it was a half body. [I felt] awestruck. [I felt] his presence.

[I have a dream in which] snakes do come from a temple [known as] Naagpokhari. [It is] this whole big pond and they have this big snake [statue] in the middle. I actually see snakes coming out of that place. The water is like way above the pond [in the dream]. Like it’s all over the street. I mean the water and they’re like huge snakes, like bigger than anacondas or whatever. And they’re not harming me or anything, but they’re scary to look at.

Well, it’s like I don’t actually see somebody behind me but I know somebody’s chasing me. I’m not running; I’m actually flying. And I do these breaststrokes to run faster… Yeah, like dogpaddling and breast-stroking. Yeah that kind. It’s like somebody’s chasing me. I look behind, there’s nobody. But I’m still running and sometimes I’m almost like falling and then I do the breaststroke again and I come up and I’m going through hills and mountains and all these scenic places, whatever… [the mountains are not snow-capped]… just greenery… Yeah and I’m really scared and I feel like I’m about to fall and then you have that adrenaline or whatever, I had that in my dream. Just I’m just running. I’m flying I’m flying I’m flying, and this thing is chasing me. I’m about to fall somewhere and then I get a lift again and then I fly again, you know. Yeah.

[While dreaming] I’ve been in the open area where there is garden and all and just meditating for a while. It’s same like in the reality. When we meditate we really feel refreshing and more spiritual thinking come into your mind. I feel [the presence of God].
It’s not scary. Just I’ll be in some place and there I saw snake and it will be not much.
Once I saw a place inside a mountain… it was a cave type of place… in the side of there was Shiva’s symbol and lingam…
[In one of my dreams I saw a dead member of my family]

In my dream I saw that I was just helping the old people, old people and the street childrens and we were distributing clothes and some kind of light just came and make me feels happy like I’m happy from inside. Just give me that blessings. I feel that I don’t see any figures, but just light which makes me feel that I am on the right way on the right path. I was in that orphanage house [where I volunteered in real life]. [The light] was so bright. More than bright than this the daylight.

In ghost dream I find myself surrounded in a dark room with different types of places like horror movies with spider net and over there and all the broken chairs with the empty room and filled of some different sound from the different animals and all over there and I find out some type of force is just calling my name and just calling to our seats and I was just moving over there and when I just… just about to reach that place I suddenly wake up. Inside that [dream] I was just nervous and afraid with full of fears. I don’t see the exact face and shape [of the ghost], I just find some kind of forces is attracting me and disturbing me. [I felt like the force was related to a ghost.] I was enchanting some mantras over there [to protect myself]. [When I did the mantras] I feel that is special type of force that could not touch to be reached to me and they are just moving away from me.

In the dream also I was sleeping. [Saraswati] came there. I was sleeping here. And she was giving me some blessings… some kind of blessings. I did see my body [and the room around me]. [The room was the same as my bedroom in real life.] [Saraswati] was still; her eyes were moving I think. Maybe she was breathing. [Her hand was outstretched towards me and she was blessing me]. I saw light behind her head… some circles [of light]… bright… um bit bright light. Like sun. Yellowish bright. I felt good at that moment in time.
I was being chased by a dog. [I managed to get behind a door]. I opened my door and I went to fight with the dog. I combatted it and killed it. I lost fear at that moment of time.

I was chased by a snake. I ran as fast as I could but [there were many] obstacles in the road. I had to slide, jump, hang on different obstacles and I was able to keep myself safe from the danger, though it was hard.

So what I dreamt was I came to the college, I submitted my papers, I did my presentation, and then I woke up. That worked fine. I felt good [during the dream]. And I did a good presentation. And it was accepted. The presentation was accepted. [I saw] the students, my friends and Professor Aryal.

I am here and some animals are chasing me. The first time I saw the dream I was being chased fiercely by a dog – fiercely… very fiercely. Then I somehow managed to get in my home, close my door, then I was relieved, and the dream was gone.

[During the day I rebuked a demon. That night I saw a dream.] Here were two women… there were two women but one called to me [in the dream]… She called to me in the dream and after that I went up. I was going up and one person was barely moving; I saw that he was full of blood – like watching a film – he was full of blood, and seemed to be barely moving… I saw that sight. And that girl was staying there… And after that the girl said, “I am killing him… Just like you gave the word [of rebuke earlier], I am the one to kill him… I was there at that time [during the day], now I will kill you… just like you gave the word, I was there… why did you give that word?… that word is God’s word… and because you gave those words to cast out, now I have come in the night to kill you!” On the same night in a dream that young girl said, “Why did you give that message [during the day]” and came to kill me… That girl said, “I am a cobra”… She brought a rope and tried to kill me in that moment… and the one who was trying to kill me I threw from a cliff and a white vehicle came to take me… I rode the vehicle and left

I killed a boy, cut him, and I had taken out all his blood… I killed him inside, took him [outside], and buried him. The [boy] came to kill me… he brought a knife and came to kill me… he came to snatch me but I killed him and cut him into pieces

In the dream there was one small road… I was walking on the small road… it was [so small that] even if a vehicle came there would be no place for it to pass… I was walking on that road when again I reached the side of a stream… on the side of the stream – in the middle of the stream – there was one black vehicle… and inside that vehicle there was one dead young girl… and on the road I was walking there was one dead girl as well… on that road there were corpses… I was walking on that road… what can be done [about the corpses]? Nothing was being done… Exactly when I reached that girl she got up and grasped my hand… when she grasped my hand and was rising that girl in the vehicle got up… she started driving the vehicle… and I cried, “Jesus, Jesus” three times… and exactly then she released my hand

I was at one big clean river… at the clean river I was told [by Jesus], “Cross the river. Stamp with [this] white staff and go”… I was given one staff… a long white staff… I did not see [Jesus’s] face but I saw the white dress and the staff and the staff was given [to me]… I crossed that river

I saw one dream that I still remember now… In the sky in that dream I saw one cross… underneath the cross there was a rainbow… From underneath that rainbow below [the cross] I went up… I was speaking about the cross of Jesus… I was with other non-believing persons who are my friends and I was telling them to look at Jesus’s cross… and they did not see… only I was looking… and again above that cross there were seven other crosses

I am walking on very glassy stairs... and then all of a sudden somebody comes and attacks me... I am alone walking on a glass... and then there is a very fine white guy, and his name is Michael or Joshua – I just don't remember properly – and then he comes with a very shiny sword and then he says this word “slash” or something and then there is a very bright light and all the people who have come to attack on us vanish, and then I go up on stairs with him… a person comes with a sword and saves me and it is all bright and I walk up with them... and then when I walk up with them, like walk up [emphasis] with them, there are not just one or two very neat and tidy dressed up people but there are many, you know... I just remember now, in my dream that guy was wearing a white shirt, but his pant was black, I guess... or the whole uniform he was wearing was white... but whatever I saw he was wearing a white shirt on, very clearly I can remember his shirt was white… [the other people are] putting on the same dress… they are very fine, their faces are glowing, they are all white... they are so bright that they all look like they are white… they are walking up with me [on the same staircase]… [the staircase is] wide

In my dream the demon comes in the form of a child... the demon attacks the child or the demon is there in the form of child... and then I am just, “In Jesus' name get out of that person!” I am just doing those things in my dream... and then the demon just leaves the person. I speak in tongues, and then I say, “Get out in Jesus’ name.” And then again I speak in tongues, I am just making my eyes big, staring at that person, speaking in tongues, and I cast out demons. Sometimes it's a struggle between me and the devils... like the devil spirit... it doesn't just leave away that person... it comes back and again I have to do the same thing, and then it goes and comes back, but in the end I just have victory over the demon.

And there is another dream where all of my family members go to a place where there are very high towers built out of stones, like in the old, like you can see in the movies – biblical movies – where they have these huge towers... [we went] up, and then all of my families choose one stone to pray on... they sit on the stone and pray... they kneel down on the stone, like on the top of the stone, and then they pray… all of my family members including Pastor Saul [my uncle] was with me... and his wife was there, my mother was there, my grandmom was there, and I... like I remember this five people very clearly, and we all have to choose... there were many pillars out of stones... then [Pastor Saul] chooses one first, and then there were other surrounding him or somewhere nearby him, and I keep on walking and I choose the stone that is the highest, and then I sit on it and I pray… as I was praying [in the dream] I felt like God is just watching over me... I felt so free and happy, joyful... I can't describe the feeling, but I felt one with God... the setting was really very interesting... there were many stone pillars, and I still clearly remember those pillars – they were of different shapes and sizes – and the place was a wilderness, so that's interesting too... even the background was meaningful to me
There is one white figure… he showed some very beautiful land and a house and he said, “Now this is yours,” and that's all…

I know that it was a dream but I am not able to distinguish whether it was in my dream or reality... but a very big hand and very black and started to choke me... and I was shouting and I was shouting and I was praying to God... help me help me help me... and during that time I cried… it was very scary

There was a white guy in the dream. [He had] a long beard and [he was] wearing a white gown. It was calling to me saying, “Come to me, come to me.” I don't have exact figure of that... I saw only hands... his image was not so vivid to me, but the hand was very clear, and I saw the robe and the hand calling like this... [everything] was white color.

In the dream I saw myself dead, and my body was lying right there in Leknath – you know there is a chok, football ground there – the open chok there, right there actually, my body was lying… and I had the striped blue and white shirt - in those days I used to wear (that was my favorite shirt, even to this day)… and my body was this way, facing up, lying on the floor, on the back, on the grass there, on the field…. and I saw the people, some of them were crying, I didn’t know people (so many of them I did not know)… it was a big crowd… and the crowd, in the inner circle, some of them were crying… some of them who were crying I knew, but most of them I did not know, so I didn’t know most of those people… I thought, “Oh, they’re crying”… and I was up, I am looking from there, my body is down… I am looking down on my body that is facing up, and then I am seeing the heads of those people, and some of them I see are kind of crying and all, and I feel like, “Oh, they shouldn’t cry because nothing has happened to me”… you know that’s what I’m feeling up there… “nothing has really happened to me, I am good here, why should they cry?”… and I am kind of worrying a little bit about those people who were crying for me… there was a big crowd of people right there

And then that particular time I saw a dream. In the dream I saw nothing: no beginning, no end of the dream. It was kind of clip. [My] brother Luke was driving, you know – riding his bike. I just saw him all of a sudden riding; dad was behind it. He was holding it; he was holding the carriage at the back. He was holding to keep himself on. He was a kind of he was not big. He was a shabby old man those days. But, and then he, you know, the bike slid off. Actually [Luke’s] helmet fell. There were a couple of young people standing there. And dad fell down on the floor, on that road. But strange thing, [Luke] didn’t pick up the helmet. He didn’t pick up dad. He just drove off. You know like in the dream when I saw like [dad] was really hurt badly.

In my dream I went to the river [by my house]. And [my friends and I] swam and really enjoyed. And then we were coming out [of the river in the dream] styling our hair as boys. As we were coming back actually we walked a little down little south from that [peepal] tree [by the river].
