I said that it could not be done, and then went up before them ; I had a rope, and pulled, but noticed that there was something beneath which pulled strongly against me ; finally I saw that it was a man, but I was stronger and pulled up ; then I was glad and said that it was as I had said. Afterwards I remained long in the same thought, which became more and more luminously red.

46. My sister Caisa appeared ; she pretended she was sick, and she threw herself down and screamed; but when our mother came, she put on quite a different face and talk. [Then] there was a minister preaching to a large congregation, and at the end he spoke personally against a certain individual, but whether that one was mentioned by name or not I do not know ; but someone arose and rebuked the preacher, saying that such a thing ought not to be done. I was afterwards with them in a private com- pany, and then, on inquiry, it was said that the punishment for libelling anyone is a fine of three marks Swedish. He [the preacher] did not seem to know that it was thus punishable ; it was said that the fine begins with one mark, then two marks, etc. Afterwards my knees moved of themselves.

45. The whole night I was in a dream; I recollect only the smallest part. It was as if I was being instructed during the whole night in many things which I do not remember. I was asleep about eleven hours, as far as I remember it seemed to me: 1. That substantial or essentials were mentioned, and that these should be cultivated and sought for ; 2. Mention was made also of the thymus gland and renal glands, which I interpret as meaning that as the thymus gland secretes the impure serum from the blood, and the renal glands remit into the blood that which has been purified, so also it takes place in us, as I believe, spiritually.

44. I came into a chamber below, where there were many persons, but I saw only a woman, dressed in black, not malicious ; she walked far into a chamber, but I did not wish to go with her, though with her hand she beckoned me towards the door. Afterwards I went out and found myself several times stopped by a spectre which covered me over the whole of the back ; finally it vanished. I came out, and then there came an ugly spectre who did the same ; it was an ugly old man ; at last I escaped from them. When I came out I saw many persons sitting in a gallery, and, lo, a mighty stream of water came pouring down through the roof, and it was so strong that it broke through everything in its way. There were some who tried to close the opening so that the water should not come in ; others who tried to get away so that it should not reach them ; others again tried to dissipate it into drops, and one who tried to divert it so that it would pass outside the gallery. Afterwards I came out thence, and in my thoughts I began as it were to measure and divide into parts that which proceeds from the centre to the circumference. It seemed to be heaven, for afterwards there appeared there a heavenly shining light.

43. Afterwards I fell asleep, and I beheld one of my acquaintances sitting at a table. He greeted me, but I did not notice it at once, and before I had returned his greeting he became offended and gave me some harsh words. I wanted to excuse myself, and finally managed to say that I am often in deep thought and do not observe when someone greets me, and sometimes pass my friends on the street without seeing them. I appealed to an acquaintance, who was present, to bear witness, and he said that it was so, and I said that no one was more anxious to be polite and humble than I am, (God grant that this may be the case). My friend, however, said nothing in reply, but still seemed satisfied, as I believed.

42. Afterwards I saw someone in St. Peter's church going into the vault underneath, where Peter lies. He was carried out, but it was said that yet another is hiding there. It seemed that I was free to go in and out. May God lead me! Afterwards I saw all that was impure, and I acknowledged that I was impure from head to foot ; I cried for the mercy of Jesus Christ. Then it seemed that the words "I poor sinful creature" occurred to me.

41. Afterwards there came in a young woman dressed in black, and said that I ought to travel to . . . then she came behind me, holding my whole back with her hand so firmly that I could not make a movement; I asked for help from a person near by, and he helped to get her away, but I was not able to move the arm myself. I then heard as if someone were whistling, but he went away, and I was seized with a tremor.
40. I seemed to have a dog on my knees, and I was astonished that it could speak. I asked about his former master. Swab. It was of a blackish color; it kissed me.

39. I saw a bookshop, and immediately the thought struck me that my work would have greater effect than the works of others, but I checked myself at once by the thought that one person serves another and that our Lord has many thousand ways of preparing everyone, so that every book must be left to its own merits, as a medium near or remote, according to the state of the understanding of everyone. Nevertheless, the pride at once was bound to assert itself; may God control it, for the power is in His hands.

38. I heard a person at the table asking his neighbor the question whether any one who had an abundance of money could be melancholic. I smiled in my mind and would have replied, — if it had been proper for me to do so in that company, or if the question had been addressed to me, — that a person who possesses everything in abundance, is not only subject to melancholy, but is [exposed] to a still higher kind, that of the mind and the soul, or of the spirit which operates therein, and I wondered that he had proposed such a question.

37. Throughout the whole night I seemed to be going deep down, by ladders and other spaces, but quite safely and securely, so that the depth did not bring me into any danger, and there occurred to me in the dream the verse, "Lowliness or other things, be they coming or " Afterwards I seemed to be at dinner in company with a number of persons at the house of a clergyman. I paid about a louis-d'or for the meal, and thus more than I ought, but when I was on my way from the place I had with me two vessels of silver which I had taken from the table. This troubled me and I tried to return them, and it seemed to me I had a plan to do so. Afterwards I was in quite a large company at the house of another clergyman, where I seemed to have been before. When we arrived it seemed to me that we were so many as to overwhelm the clergyman, and I did not like that we were so many as to cause him trouble.

36. I then saw my father, dressed in a different costume, almost reddish. He called me to himself and took hold of my arms, which were in short sleeves, but with lace ruffles for cuffs; he took both cuffs and tied them with my ribbons.He then asked me what I thought about this question, viz., that a certain king had granted leave to about thirty persons who belonged to the spiritual order, to get married and thus to change their estate. I replied that I had thought and written something about this subject but that it has no relation to it. Immediately afterwards I found myself able to answer, according to my conscience, that no one ought to be permitted to change his estate, no matter what it may be, to which he has devoted him- self. He said that he also was of the same opinion, but I added that if the king had resolved upon it then the matter was settled. He said that he would present his vote in writing'; if there are fifty [votes] then the matter is fixed. I noticed as a remarkable circumstance that I did not call him "my father" but "my brother." I afterwards wondered how this was: it seemed to me that my father was dead, and that this one, who is my father, thus must be my brother.

35. Later on, about day-break, I fell asleep again, and then had continually in my thought how Christ conjoins Himself with men ; holy thoughts came, but of such a nature that they are unfathomable, for I cannot in the least express by the pen what then took place ; for I only know that I was in such thoughts.

34. I then fell asleep, but about twelve, one, or two o'clock in the night there came over me a very powerful tremor from the head to the feet, accompanied with a booming sound as if many winds had clashed against one an- other. It was indescribable, and it shook me and prostrated me on my face. In the moment that I was prostrated I became wide awake, and I saw that I had been thrown down. I wondered what it meant, and I spoke as if I were awake, but still I found that the words were put into my mouth, and I said, ''Oh, Thou Almighty Jesus Christ, who of Thy great mercy deignest to come to so great a sinner, make me worthy of this grace !" I kept my hands folded and I prayed, and then there came forth a hand which strongly pressed my hands.I then continued my prayer, saying, "Thou hast promised to receive in grace all sinners ; Thou canst not otherwise than keep Thy words !" In the same moment I was sitting at His bosom and beheld Him face to face. It was a countenance of a holy mien, and all was such that it cannot be expressed, and also smiling, so that I believe that His countenance was such also while He lived [in the world]. He spoke to me and asked if I had a bill of health, [om jag har sundhets pass.] I answered, "Lord, Thou knowest better than I." He said, "Well, then do." I awoke, with tremors. I then again came into such a state that in my thoughts I was neither sleeping nor awake.

33. Afterwards I awoke and fell asleep again a number of times, and all [that I dreamed] was in answer to my thoughts, yet in such a manner that there was such a life and such a glory in the whole of it that I cannot describe the least particular, for all of it was heavenly. At the time it was clear to me, but after it I cannot express anything. In short, I was in heaven and heard a speech which no human tongue can utter wath the life that is there or the glory and inmost delight that flow from it.

32. Afterwards I fell asleep, and it seemed the whole night how in various ways I was first joined with others, by what was sinful ; and then how I was enveloped, by wonderful and indescribable circumvolutions, so that during 3. the whole night I was inaugurated in a wonderful manner, and then it was said: "Is there any Jacobite more than honest?'' Then, in conclusion. I was received with an embrace. Afterwards it was said that "he ought not to be thus called or thus named,'' but how, I do not remember, if it was not Jacobite, this I cannot describe ; it was a mystical series.

31. I then fell into a sleep in which my whole temptation was represented to me : how Er[land] B[roman] sought by various means to get me on his side, so as to be of that party, (voluptuousness, riches, vanity), but he could not gain me over. I became still more obstinate against him because he showed contempt. Afterwards I was together with a crouching dark-grey snake, and it was B[roman's] dog. I struck at him many times with a club but tried in vain to hit him on the head ; he wanted to bite me but could not ; I seized him by the throat, and he could not bite me, nor was I able to do him much harm ; finally I got hold of him by the jaws and squeezed him hard, and also by the nose which I squeezed so that the venom burst forth. I said that while the dog did not belong to me, still, as he wanted to bite me, I had to chastise him. Thereupon it seemed someone said he had not gotten me to say one word to him, and then 1 quarreled with him. When I awoke, the words which I said were: Shut your mouth!
30. There was sung the melody and a line which I remember from the hymn "Jesus is my friend, the best one." It seemed to me that green buds had opened.
29. It was said that one more courier had arrived.

28. Towards the morning it seemed to me I was riding, and the direction was shown to me, but when I looked it was dark, and I found I had lost my way on account of the darkness. But then it lightened up and I saw that I had gone wrong ; I saw the road and the forests and groves to which I should travel, and behind them the sky. I awoke.

27. I saw two groups of soldiers, dressed in blue, who marched in two troops past my window which stood ajar. I desired to look out and watch the marching of the first troop, which seemed to me magnificent. I awoke.
26. There was a beggar who cried that he wanted some pork ; they wished to give him something else, but he insistently called for pork. I awoke.

25. Two persons came; they entered a house which, though built, was not yet furnished ; they went about but did not seem favorable : we realized that our power was gone, and were afraid of them. One of them came to me and said that they intended to inflict a punishment on me the next Thursday before Easter, unless I made my escape. I did not know how to get out, but he told me he would show me the way. I awoke.

24. I stepped out of a carriage; it was driven into a lake. While driving into it the coachman cried to the other carriage to take care, as there was danger when he drove in ; I looked at the other carriage ; behind it there seemed to be a screen which was unfolded like an umbrella. I, together with the man who sat behind, took the screen, went in, and folded it together.

23. King Charles was sitting in a dark room and said something, but somewhat indistinctly ; afterwards one at the table inquired whether he had not received the information he had asked about ; he replied. Yes. He afterwards closed the windows, and I helped him with the curtains. Afterwards I mounted a horse, but did not take the road I had intended but went across hills and mountains, riding swiftly. A wagon with a load followed after me, and I could not get away from it ; still the horse by the load became tired, and [the driver] wanted to get him into some place ; he came in, and the horse became like a slaughtered, bloody beast, fallen down.

22. I rode in the air [flying] on a horse; went into all the rooms, the kitchen, and other places, hunting for one whom I did not find ; the rooms were untidy ; finally I was carried through the air into a drawing room where I received two beautiful loaves of bread, and then I found him again. Quite a number of people were there and the room was in good order.
21. I saw a magnificent procession of men. adorned so handsomely that I have never seen anything more handsome, but it soon disappeared.
20. I saw a very handsome woman by a window where a child was placing roses ; she took me by the hand and conducted me.

19. I saw a group of women, one who wrote a letter; I took it but do not know what became of it. She was sewing, and a yellow man struck her on the back ; wished she should get more blows, but it was enough.

18. I asked to be cured of my illness ; there was given me a heap of rags to buy for [it] ; I took half of them, and looked out for the other half, but returned all the rags. He said that he himself would buy [something] that would lead to a cure. The rags were my corporeal thoughts by which I wished to cure myself, but they were good for nothing. Afterwards I went out and saw many black images; a black one was thrown at me; I saw that he could not get about with his foot.

17. It seemed as if I took a key and went in ; the door keeper examined the keys which I had ; I showed them all, in case I should have two, but it seemed that Hesselius had another. I was arrested and put under guard ; there came to me many in carriages. It seemed to me I had done nothing wrong, but I remembered that it might be considered in a bad light if it turns out that I had taken the key. I awoke.

16. I came into a magnificent chamber and spoke with a woman who was governess of the court. She wished to relate something to me; then came the queen and passed through to another chamber ; it seemed to be the same one who represented our Successor. I went out for I was rather meanly dressed, as I had just returned from my journey, [wearing] a long old overcoat, and without hat and wig; I wondered that she condescended to come to me; she related that a certain one had given all the jewels to his mistress, but he had received them back again in this manner that it was told her that he had not given her the best, whereupon she threw away the jewels. She asked me to come again, but I excused myself on the plea that I was so shabbily dressed and had no wig, and must go home first ; she said it did not matter.

15. I spoke long and familiarly with our Successor in Sweden, who changed into a woman. Afterwards I spoke with Carl Broman, [saying] that he ought to be in favor of him; he answered something ; [then I spoke] with Erland Broman. [saying] that I had returned here.

14. Quite freely and boldly I stepped down a large stairway ; by and by there was a ladder, below it there was a hole which went down to quite a great depth ; it was difficult to get to the other side without falling into the hole. On the other side there were persons to whom I reached out my hand to help them cross over, I awoke.

13. I was in a garden containing many fine beds, one of which I desired to own, but I looked about to see if there was any road to walk out ; I also seemed to see it, and thought of another : there was one there who was picking away a heap of invisible vermin and killed them ; he said they were bedbugs which some person had carried thither and thrown in, infesting those who were there. I did not see them, but some other little insect, which I dropped on a white linen cloth beside a woman.
12. I was standing by a machine which was moved by a wheel ; its spokes involved me more and more and carried me up so that I could not escape: I awoke.

11. How a woman was by my side, just as if I had been awake ; I wanted to know who she was. She spoke in a low voice, but said that she was pure, but that I had a bad odor. She was, as I believe, mv guardian angel, for the temptation then began.

10. I seemed to be reclining on a mountain beneath which there was an abyss ; there were projections ; I was lying there, trying to get up, holding on to a projection, without foot-hold, an abyss beneath.

9. How I had resisted the power of the Holy Spirit, and what then happened; how I beheld hideous spectres, without life, horribly involved, and within [something] moved itself; with a beast which attacked me but not the child.

8. About my joys at night. I wondered at myself that there remained nothing of the desire to work for my own glory, so as to have sensation thereof, and that I was not inclined toward sexual relations, as I had been in all my days.
7. About the manservant who wished that I would go away on a journey.
6. About the king who gave something very precious in a peasant's hut.
5. About the one who tumbled with the chain into the depth.
4. In Leipzig, about the one who lay in seething water.
3. In Sweden, about the white cloud of the sky.
2. In Venice, about the beautiful palace.
1. In my younger days, and the Gustavian family

Many times I was found in the church. Some times I was singing the same song for a long time. After singing, the people would say, â€œThat song is very nice, repeat it.â€ So I would until I got tired. The inside of the church appears to be exactly like my church, Saili. And the people are members of this church. In the same dream, the scene shifts. I am with friends from the church, discussing how we can develop the Manyika area for the spread of Christianity. The dream ends. No answer.
I saw a scary dream last night. I saw my mom and other people as well. We have to walk from a high cliff to go to our church and in my dream I see me going from that cliff to the fellowship.

In my dream I was talking with one American lady. She was one of the Christian [ladies]. And I proposed her and she accepted, but by that time her pastor came and teased her as well as scolded her. At that moment she was so afraid, and I was looking for a chance to [move] away from her pastor, because I was also afraid of him.

When I was alone going to market, any place, and anywhere else in the way there will be lots of snakes. They always follow me. Lots of snake will follow me in my ways but they don’t do anything [else]. I ran away from them.
I saw a dream of quarrelling with my close [male] friend. I did not like the way he spoke [so I argued with him].
I saw a horse in my dream. That horse was coming towards me. And God said to me, "Ride.” But I was afraid, terrified. Lastly, I refused to ride the horse and I woke up.

I was going to my home. And [my family members] were happy because I was coming home after a long time. Suddenly, I met my younger sister, but she was acting shy. I treated her as if she was my girlfriend but when I realized she was my sister, I treated her again as my sister.

The context of the dream was familiar. I was having fun with friend[s] from my place. Some of them were of my age. They were all men. They were all kind of my close friends. There I saw a bird and my dream was good. We were all enjoying using something.

In my dream there was a big stone. A girl was worshipping at the stone and a big snake came out of the stone. In other words the stone turned into a snake. Afterwards there were some pigs and then there was darkness. But I saw the way to escape and I was running away. Those pigs disappeared behind me and I did not see the snake any more. [The dream took place] in the jungle.
In my dream I saw my sister was sick. She is 27 years old. I met her in a bad condition and I wept – I cried a lot. I [saw] her in the mouth of death.

I was in an airplane. And I was travelling to go somewhere but in the airplane there were lots of other people too. My younger brother was also there. After some time the plane crashed and everyone was taken to the emergency ward in the hospital but nothing happened to my brother and me. I was worried more about my younger brother more than myself. Nothing happened to me but I saved my brother because there was a kind of belt around his waist and I was able to unbuckle it. Both of us were safe.

I saw a dream of cooking lots of food with an [older man and woman] I know. That house was a very small hut. We were cooking food in a traditional firewood stove and lots of disabled children came and ate the food. I was crying seeing such a scene. How hungry these disabled children were! I was crying because of seeing it. The children were happy and having a good time.
I saw my church family in my dream. In that dream my church uncle slapped my brother on his cheek.

I went to the house of my older sister and brother-in-law. It was about 3pm in the afternoon. At that time the daughter of my brother-in-law’s uncle had also come. She was very beautiful and I wanted to marry her. In my dream I talked to her and spent lots of time with her. Lastly, I also kissed her on the cheek. After that I woke up.

In the dream I went to my college friend's house. She was very sick and she was lying on the bed. I went close to her and talked with her (I don't remember what I said). But I was sad. As I was still talking, I woke up.

In my dream I created a Facebook page and uploaded [my] photo. I [connected] with many Christian organizations and friends. I chatted in a very nice way with my friends. When I was talking with [male friends] we shared good photos. I was very happy. I was happy to meet the people I wanted to meet. Then, I woke up.

In my dream my friend, Sangita, and I were at NMTS College. All of our college friends had to take kitchen products from the ground floor upstairs. Brothers were carrying heavy bags and my friend and I carried one bag that was very light. I thought, “How can that very heavy [bag] be carried?” My friend and I were happy. Then, I was in the marketplace. I was looking at the statues people were making. Then, I woke up.

I was [working] at a shop. I did not know the price of any product. One man came to the shop to buy [but] I did not know the price. The man chided me. I was angry and walked away. One man took me away on his motorbike. As we were travelling the motorbike went into the field. He rode right by the vegetable farm by the home. And whatever things I [was carrying] were blown away. The rider looked back and both of us fell in a heap of glass but we were not hurt. Then others pulled us out. And I embraced the guy from behind. After that I realized that he was my friend. I was happy to see him. And I woke up.

In my dream I went to a temple in Kathmandu. And there I was saying "In Jesus’ name, Satan get lost." One man accused me of being a Christian. That man was about 25 or 26. I had never seen him before. That man gathered the people and came to the Bible college. I was in college and I was afraid and also I was angry. But that man was like a drunkard and I bribed him using 2000 rupees and he left.

[In my dream] it was daytime and I was in college campus. Suddenly, before me was the college principal Mr. Timothy Sir and he became weak and began to fall. But I supported him and carried him to the kitchen door. Then, I saw other friends also and I woke up.

I saw a dream that I had gone to the bank of the big river. After that I saw a huge animal coming towards me from the forest and the forest was covered with snow. When I saw that huge animal I was afraid and I began to run away and that animal was chasing me. I come to village and I was saved and that animal went back to that forest. That animal had big ears, long tail, and small claws.
In my dream I saw my [male] friend use drugs.

As I was walking on the road I met a friend. Right in front of the place where my friend was standing was a deep ditch full of water. Some of the goods I had fall into the water. I jumped into the water and searched for the goods.

It was a place in a village that I knew about. There were many houses, many people. There were many known and unknown people. There were also animals like cows and horses. I was afraid in my dream. Lots of people there were crying a lot. I also wanted to cry. Other people's houses were swept away by a landslide. All the people were troubled.

I saw a strange dream in which there were people [who] were unknown. I heard a scary voice that was saying that Christ's second coming was near. This is what the voice was saying: "Behold, the time of persecution will begin in 2073 BS [2016-2017]. Those who believe shall be saved but those who do not believe shall be destroyed."
I was in a room. My grandmother was insisting [that I] go with her. I was not willing to go. She dragged me to the gate. At that time, my mom came and shouted at my grandmother and she left.

In my dream I saw my close friend. He was a man. I called him and he gave me some food to eat and also he gave me some fruits. At that time, I was very happy because my loving friend had given me such things.

There were girls in a certain place and they were working. There were also boys and they were dangerous. When I reached the place, the boys started chasing me. I ran away. I reached the jungle and I was afraid. I was trying to say 'Hallelujah' but I was not able to.

I was with my pastor and youth friends. In the dream we had a house fellowship at my home. The fellowship was inside our home but my dad was not present. He arrived after the fellowship was over. My dad was shouting, "Who gave you the authority to do fellowship at my home?" I was very afraid. But my pastor and youth friends were reminding me: "Don't be afraid, after some time the Lord will also change his heart." After everyone left, I was afraid that my dad would beat me for doing fellowship at my home. Then, I woke up.

I was in a village but the place was unknown and new to me. I was there with my big sister. And there was one stranger who was the landlord. He sent my sister to his farmland. We went there and worked. After irrigating the farm, as we were returning to his home, I was afraid and angry.

In my dream I saw this: while I was sitting in a certain place rain started falling. After that, as I was going home, I had to cross the river. But the river was flooding and I was asking for help to cross the river. Then I woke up.
In my dream I do not see my body but I feel that my body is there. In the dream a dangerous animal chases me. It is very difficult for me to run.

I was on a path in village. I saw my mother who had already died. She was talking with me; she was caring for me. She was my mother: only I could see her, others would not be able to see. I was surprised. When she started walking [and] talking with me I felt happy.

I was in a large unknown jungle and I was alone. I saw an old man but I did not understand what he was asking of me. When I was still trying to speak with the old man, animals came and started chasing me. I was afraid and I fled from there and I do not know where I reached. I was very angry with the animals. I was so angry that I [wanted] to kill them.

I was walking in my village with my friends. As I was walking I reached a place where there was a barko tree. As I turned back, I saw the ghost of a dead daughter of a village brother – she was coming towards me. The ghost child did not look that terrifying but I was very afraid. And I began crying [in my dream and] even in the real life.

I was driving a big bus. There was many children inside the bus. I felt like I was driving a school bus. At that moment I had driven bus on the highway. I was very confident. No fear was there. And I drove just for 5 minutes. I took that bus in the big playground. I did one round. Again I came to the same road. Thereafter, Krishna Dai was in the scooter. Krishna Dai said to me, “You don’t know how to drive the bus. Why did you drive?” Then I woke up.

I see the dream is that we all friends were together. Many friends came in my house and they said, “Come to visit [us].” I said that I won’t. I can’t because I said that I have a job and I want to do job. I can’t left my job and I said to all my friends, “Why are you coming? [Don’t you] have work to do?” I angry with all my friends and all friends are angry.

I’ve got a dream that my exam were coming near and me and my friend Pratiksha – age 20 – went to the college to give the exam. I realized that my seat was on the first bench and my friend was far from me, so I was so worried. [I was writing the exam] then suddenly my friend came and said that she was going to Bangalore, India, for the abroad study. Then she began to catch the bus, and I cried for so long time that when I woke up from my dream I was really crying.

My dream was about my college friends, but in my school. I was with my four college friend. We were just talking normally as in college. In my dream I was happy and confused also. In the dream I laughed with my friends and [bantered] with them, etc. I only saw the school buildings around me.

I came to know about a dead man in an unknown village. After I heard the news, I went to the village with my friends and there was nothing. The village was silent and my friends were disappearing one by one. Finally, only I was left. Then, as I was looking for my friends, I saw a man clad in white clothes. And when I went close to the person, I woke up.

In my dream I saw my dead maternal grandfather. In that dream I had gone to my maternal uncle’s house. My dead grandpa and [living] grandmother were staying [there]. My dead grandfather was cooking food to eat whereas my grandma was sitting in patio. I reached there and sat together with my grandma on the patio. But the strange thing is my grandpa did not speak with me nor did my grandma. Then, I woke up. I was afraid.

When I was walking, I saw a woman of about 32 years of age. She was our neighbor. At that time I saw a snake. I wanted to kill it but it escaped. It was green in color and the woman was asking me not to kill it. I hurled some stones at it two or three times but I missed the target. And it ran away. Then, I woke up.

One day [in my dream] I went to roam in a dense jungle. While I was roaming in the jungle I was observing the natural elements. At that time, I saw a big scary snake that was coming towards me. I started running away from there and the snake was chasing me. I reached a place that looked like a cave and I went down into it and felt safe.

My grandfather was sick and I went to the hospital to visit him. I saw [my] dad, mom, and uncles from my mom’s side. They were worried [about my grandfather] so I felt bad. [Therefore] I went home and my sense of the environment there was such that I felt fine.

I was traveling in a bus. I did not know where the bus came from or where it was going. In the bus were a few of my close college friends. But my voice was not reaching them or they were ignoring me. The closer I tried to get [to them] the farther they seemed to go. On one hand I was enjoying [the time] but on the other hand I was upset.

In my dream I saw a large jungle and in the midst of dark jungle I saw a temple. I also saw the photos of many gods [in the temple] and people were worshipping them. The priest of the temple asked me to clean the worship utensils and gave [them to me].

In my dream I saw my friends Bandana and Elisha. We were having a great time and we were wandering around. I went with them to my school to study. We were enjoying [ourselves] in the class. Then suddenly I saw myself fall off the cliff and I woke up.

I was walking on the road. It was winter. Suddenly, I saw a beautiful girl. She was about 18. She came close to me and started talking. She was wearing a white sari. She took me through the jungle to the graveyard. She was extra-ordinary and I was captivated by her beauty. She took me to her home and we spent the night together. She treated me to dinner and then took me to the living room. And she hit me with a khukuri [Nepali knife] and began eating my flesh.

I could not remember all the things exactly. I saw a man who came to take me with him but I did not go. Instead I was fighting with him. It was very dark and I was in the jungle. I found that man was wearing a type of dress that was unreal. Finally I managed to run from that man.
I saw going home, and at that [time] I remembered that my dad would drink alcohol and fight with us. Therefore in my dream my older brother and I were there and we were beating my dad.
In my dream I saw my grandmother from my mother’s side at her deathbed. But at that time her face was that of my mother. Therefore I was perplexed.

In my dream I saw fighting and bombs [exploding]. [It was happening] in my school. Bombs were being thrown from above. I don't know who was throwing the bombs, but after some time the bombing stopped. My father and I died and my grandmother who can't walk [in real life] was dancing in my dream.

In my dream I was among 10-12 year old boys and I was vomiting. Just the way water gushes from a pipe, water was coming from my mouth. The children were trying to drink the water [but] I was asking the children not to do so.

In this dream I was inside my church doing fellowship when I saw my dad being placed outside wrapped up with linen like a dead person. Then, I ran from the church to the place [where] my dad was brought. Everyone was saying my dad had already died and I was very afraid. After coming close and looking, [I realized] my dad had not died but he had been hit in a very bad way such that his face was blue. I asked them, “Who has hit my dad in this way?” They said some Christians hit him but did not know what church they came from. Then I was very angry. I was shouting, "Who are they? I will not leave them alone!"

I saw large trees and a green pasture and I was fighting with one teacher. Then there was an earthquake and we ran away from there. We were running and running but I don't know where we reached. But I was late to go to fellowship and I was in a hurry. In that time I was searching [for] my Bible but immediately I wake up. Nothing happen to me and them also.

In my dream I saw a hall like a church or a court. Lots of people were there and we were sitting on the benches. And I was asked to pray for something. As I began to pray, I felt led by the Spirit and I began to say things very loudly. I was prophesying: 14, 15, 16. At that time one prophet [also] started to say 14 and then there appeared a green thing that looked like a notice board. I kept looking astonished. The dream ended.

In my dream some men were chasing me and I was afraid. But at that time, one person came and saved me. Before that I was crying and he wiped away my tears. And I thought I would not live but I was flying in the sky. And I saw the green forest set on fire. On top of the green forest a strange person clad in white, bright clothing was standing. And the five people who were looking for me were looking up to me from the ground but I was flying up in the sky.

[Achyut’s] land was very dry. His sister Usha [came to me] and said, “We must go to Achyut's farmland to sow rice paddies but it has not rained on his farmland and it is dry.” In the dream I prayed for his land and after the prayers rain fell from the sky and watered the land. And green rice paddies had taken root.

One village woman who used to run a teashop was doing witchcraft incantations [dhaami jhaankri mantratantra gardaithiin] to trap me. In the dream, I saw her face clearly. In the dream I started rebuking the woman in Jesus' name. I felt some kind of spirit was holding my body. I called everyone but no one replied. But my friend, who is a boy (Achyut Tamang, whom I love), he heard and prayed for me. And that woman's spirit left me and walked away as a cat. It went out of my bedroom window.

I saw a large pond filled with water. In the pond were a lot of people. I thought those people were very hungry. I gave food to those people. I took food and went to the pond. When those people finished eating the food one of the people I fed who was rich came and said, “Thank you.”

Last night I saw a dream in which I saw something like a house but it also looked like a church. I saw three college friends in that church. They were serving in that church. When they were serving a strange man came in. He sat between them and was talking. Then the man cried very loudly and being startled, I woke up.

In the dream there was a program at NEHTS College. My older sister and all my relatives had come for the program. They were all very happy that they sent me to the Bible college because it was very nice. But I was crying because I was about to separate from them. I was happy to see them come but I was crying when they were leaving.

That dream was like this: last night all my NEHTS friends were in chapel. One fellowship was going on. And one “sister” [female member] has to lead. While she lead for that fellowship she prayed. After prayer my church’s “sister” was also in my dream. She was sitting with me. She started to [speak in tongues] but because of her tongue language I am so afraid. All [my] friends and teaching fellowship sister also became surprised.
I am at home with my [father]. I was [spending] time with my father and sometimes with other family members and I was enjoying [being] with them. At that time I felt so good to be with them.
In my dream I was wondering around in a dry desert and it suddenly started raining. I started to get wet and the rain was cold and I felt too cold. I felt cold even after I woke up.

I saw a dream of the girl I like and her younger sister fighting. The reason for fighting was a mobile phone. They squabbled a lot over the phone and at the end both cried. And I was very distressed in my dream because of their behavior. After some time their mom came to know about their fighting. She was suffering from high blood pressure. After seeing her daughters fight about such a small thing, she left home. I saw her leaving from the window and I followed her. I was concerned she would hurt herself or fall unconscious due to blood pressure. Then, I woke up.

Last night in my dream I saw things related to the 3-day tour we were on. I was having a good time with friends and I saw the daily activities we did. Everyone was enjoying, singing songs, dancing and shouting. And because of a jam, the bus stopped and we left the bus. I saw that all [my] friends were enjoying. While singing we sang a secular song and our teacher criticized us. [The teacher] was angry. Then, I woke up.

I saw a familiar person in my dream. This person was my friend. Other friends were also there. [The first friend] parted from me and he and I cried a lot. My other friends and I returned to the college, but my beloved friend parted from me. Then I woke up.

I saw one dream in which my good [male] friend and I fought because other friends came in between us. Between us there was a bad misunderstanding so there was a big fight. The dream made me very afraid.

I was travelling through a gravelly mountainous area with my friend. We held our hands together and crossed the slope. When we would step the earth under our feet would slide out. I forgot what happened in the middle of the dream. Then suddenly we were part of a group inside a room. A little distance from the room was a grave and a group of 3-4 people were there. They were ghosts – I do not remember their faces. Our group was planning to go there but I did not agree. Suddenly my friend’s face started changing. It started changing because a ghost from the grave saw him and entered him. I pulled him aside and prayed [for him]. "Evil spirit, come out!" I spoke too loud and woke up. This dream made me afraid.
The dreams I remember are about warfare. I see me killing many with a gun or khukuri [Nepali knife].

I was climbing up a steep slope. I don’t remember going to that place before. In that place when I was going up, as I was reaching the top, a certain hand helps me to the plain. I tried to connect the hand to his face, but I couldn’t and I woke up.

Last night I saw a bhut [ghost] coming before me in my dream. The ghost was wearing a white dress. I cried seeing that ghost. The ghost was in sari. It was not trying to scare me. I felt it was trying to say something. But I was afraid of ghosts, so I cried. Then I woke up.

I saw my grandmother who died two years ago. She was alive [in the dream] and I was beating her with stones, bricks, etc. but she was not dying. No matter how much I hit her she lived. She didn't die no matter I how much I beat her. Suddenly, I woke up.
While I am sleeping in the night I see a thief come to my house in the dream… around the house he started to dig
Talking about my recent dream I had a dream of pond at my house… I mean a clear water where there were lots of fishes

The recent one was what I dreamed yesterday. I was about to go into a reception party, but accidentally I went to another’s reception by near Party Palace. [This party palace was in a] nearby place – Jammel. I knew there is this party palace [there], but I haven’t been there [before]. [I knew it was the wrong reception] after seeing the people and there was no one that I recognized so… [I was trying to see] my family members, my relatives.

It was a disgusting [dream], where I was travelling in a vehicle that carries dead bodies. The stretcher still had blood clots of a dead body over them and on the same stretcher the driver and his assistant butchered goats. They gave me a hitchhike to a place where my friend was getting married. The place where my friend was getting married in my dreams was kinda old temple with only some remaining of temple pillar. I thought there were many people attending the wedding but there were just the bride and the groom (my friends) and one man and I. I don’t remember who my friends were in that dream. I mean I don’t know them in real life.
I was going into battle and I was fighting with sword

I saw a dream where I was with my supervisor. We were in the new office where we work [in real life]. He called me into the office and he asked me to sign a write-up paper [which signifies disciplinary action]. He wasn’t looking at me but he asked me to sign. I asked him why he wanted me to sign the paper. He wasn’t giving me an answer and we started kind of arguing. I was not getting angry but I was feeling worried [about my job]. Then I woke up without having signed the paper.

Me, our librarian Nabin, our president Sanjiv, and another is – I couldn’t recognize him. Actually that room was I didn’t remember. I can’t remember where it was but we were inside of that room. We are and in that time we were playing card. In the middle what happened is that Nabin got up and he said… and he got up and went… after some time Timothy Sir immediately came and after… me, the president Sanjiv, and one other person… we were caught… because we are special persons here, because we are ministers we were caught and after that we were “resticated” [by Timothy]. “Resticated” means in Nepali to take someone out from college, leave [our] position… and after that I woke
Two nights ago I saw that I was riding a bike in my dream… I don't know that place. I think that place might be Bhaktapur Highway. There is a broad road.

Five days ago I saw a dream. In my dream I was in one place close to my home. And two or three persons who I did not recognize came and complained to me about the way that I looked. And I discussed [this] with them and they understood and accepted what I was saying… I was like “new generation” [and they could not understand]… they think I am not good but in actuality I was good and I was right… and then I convinced them that I was right.

There was a dog that bit two people… one of them died (it was my friend from real life) and the other was going to hospital (this was Pastor Timothy, who was actually in the hospital at the same time this dream took place)

In this dream what I saw is this is like a building apartment… we are in first floor… so just like this building to another building there is a shop… just crossing the main way road, there is a shop… and I saw myself, my father, my mother… we were just like in that shop… my father and mother, they wanted me to get new TV for us… so they were saying like, “Go and bring TV”… like we have one TV here, but they wanted another TV… when I was going to that shop, when [I was crossing the road] there was one police officer… he was not in uniform… he was like undercover cop, something like that… when I was like indoor and just like looking for that TV to buy… but I was like in his way, and all of a sudden he told me like, “Can I see your ID?”… but unfortunately I was not carrying that ID… so I was scared… I was trying to search in my pocket, where it is, but I know I don’t have that ID… but I see my parents, my father and mother, in the same shop… again I saw my parents… they were inside but [acting as if] they do not know me… like doing their own stuff… they know the police officer is doing inquiry to me but they were just [acting like] they don’t know me… so I was saying like, “I don’t have ID over here… I have to go to the building and bring it here”… and that police officer, he didn’t know what to do [with that]…

I saw that same camp [I had just attended in real life]… and that camp over there, I saw all the peoples, who were there in that camp… they were all like singing… some are playing… and there was one house… that same house where we stayed [in real life]… and there was above like wall… the boundary wall of that house… the boundary house of that building… and in that building I saw me playing lawn tennis ball… green one, lawn tennis ball… I was playing with it… and then again – like my mind – it seems like I wanted to play cricket… I was playing cricket… so when I was playing, all the things over there, I was playing very pleasant… I was playing good… there was singing, there was guitar… and all of them, all of people… they were just inside the boundary… and I was playing… I was playing very good… [I saw the people I went to camp with]… but I didn’t see their face… but I knew they were the person I met in that camp…

I was inside some place like a room. Suddenly the light left and it became dark. Then in the dark it became a new place like a dark hill where there were no people. I looked from here to there and I couldn’t see anyone. I was alone. After some time this voice automatically [came]. It said, “I will eat you, I will kill you.” Then I saw one who was so terrible to see. [I was afraid.] I saw one person who was like animal [and] talking like man.

I saw one dream three days ago… I saw a dream like my “mummy” she was dead… I saw a death dream… and I was feeling bad in the dream and I was crying in the dream… I was crying a lot… I didn’t know what happened but I woke up suddenly with a start… my mummy was dead… Timothy Sir told me, “Your mummy is dead,” and these [sorts of things] in the dream… and after I woke up I said, “I have seen a dream”… [It was the most scary dream I have seen in my life]

There are playgrounds for children, and a nun wearing high platform shoes. But on closer look, it is a man in drag. He has a Mona Lisa smile, and is with other men in nun's habits. They are members of a social club, and are getting along well with everyone.

I am sitting on a badminton court of my childhood home. I am sitting in an Indian blanket wrapped around me on the ground. My former husband is approaching from the bottom of the hill. I am frightened.

I am among a group of men and women bicycling along a path. I leave my bike to watch a group singing in harmony. A band strikes up a tune and the group starts dancing. Then I see a nude man with an erection coming in my direction. He says he wants to give me one of the band instruments so I can play along with them.

I am watching snakes on the Fourth of July. I say, "I'm a fractal." Then I'm caught in a spider web. I try to get out by using a non-linear technique. A teaching Buddha appears and tells me there are two ways out. His insights help me get out.

I am in Europe with my mother looking at a map, trying to find France. I am frustrated because I can find England and Germany but not France. I see an athletic woman climbing a monument, and think she is going too high. But she bungs down with a rope and skips very confidently along. Then I am making love with Jesus. He tells me that we must go to Nazareth. He is young with short hair, wearing a woolen garment. There is a sense that we are reunited and the familiarity feels comforting.

I am in a house having dinner with my husband. There are lots of people there, but the other guests do not greet us. This is odd! I look for our hostess, I see her and try to get her attention, but she does not want to talk to me. I go into the next room to take a nap. There is a strange man standing there, but I lay down on the bed anyway and go to sleep. When I wake up, I go into the kitchen and find my husband. He is talking with our hostess very amicably, and says we have been invited to a party at the house the following night.

I am in my present house. It is very messy with books and papers all around. I go into the living room, expecting to see my books, but there is nothing there. I go into the bedroom and find the books scattered on the floor, but only the outer edges of the books are there. The pages have been cut out so that only the blank frame remains. I go back into the living room. It does not look as if anything has been stolen, but everything from the carpet to the ceiling is white. Something has obviously shifted. I am disturbed about the books, especially all of my herb books. I am confused but feel a little better.

I am abruptly aware of being in a desert landscape where there is a sparsity of plant life. There is a white light shining from the sky to the desert floor, at an angle. Then I am floating about15 feet above the ground, facing the source of light. My arms and legs are relaxed, limply hanging down from my torso. The sky is blue, the desert floor has natural colors. I have feelings that seem to have originated in the light--peace, "knowing," agape love, holistically healed, and that everything is truly beautiful at a cellular level.

I am in a dense jungle with my husband and a few native women. Men appear with spears. Their faces are bright and shining. They have painted their spears with primary colors. The aged chief enters the scene. He is in full dress with beautiful feathers in his headdress. His eyes see into me. He speaks: "Gather the truth from each person and you will see." These words left me with a sense of connected with the chief.

I see an image of a small quartz crystal pendulum that is attached to a very worn and dingy string. It is mine. I think that it needs a new string. I hold it in the palm of my hand, and it is in color. I feel that I need to replace the string soon, as something is going to happen. There were men and women in the background in a warm, well-lit colorful, friendly place.

I'm walking around the deck of a huge ocean liner. There is an academic conference taking place in the halls and rooms. Friends and colleagues are all over. I run into a huge vault-like door at the edge of the ship and open it. I fall through and go deep into the ocean, down, down, down, so deep. Then I pop up fast and am back on the ship. I run through the halls looking for friends to tell. Two, a man and woman, are fooling around in a small anteroom and are not interested in me. Others are talking and drinking. The point becomes clear. No one is interested in what happened, but I am ecstatic!

We are having a family dinner celebrating my mom and dad's 50th anniversary. I'm rushing around, cooking and serving people. The area where we're eating is a room off the kitchen. It is screened off and near the swimming pool. It's hot and somewhat stuffy. There are several young men who are serving as lifeguards. My dad decided he wants to go into the pool. He is fully dressed in a suit and wearing a carnation on his lapel. I yell at him not to jump and I wonder where the lifeguards are. He says he can do it and goes to the end of the diving board. I scream for someone to help. My mom says she'll get him out and jumps in after him. She is in her wedding gown and I yell at her not to. But she jumps in. I see them both sink gently to the bottom. They are both sitting at the deep end of the pool. They are holding hands and they're both dead. I wake up crying.

I come to a table that looks like an altar. There are family photos on it, and they bring back memories. I am enjoying them, and lift up the glass to put in new photos, taking out some old ones. There is a photo of my mother, looking glamorous, like a blonde movie star. Three are figurines of family members on the altar, and models of adobe homes. Nothing modern. The image of my father is superimposed on the front of the model home.

I was in a room with a female friend, talking. It was a class but we were lying on a bed. There was a small table nearby with an answering machine on it. The phone rang and it was a man I had spoken with in waking life two days earlier, a Southern gentleman. The conversation started off pleasant and casual. Then he asked, "Would you like to go to a little beach with me?" But before I could answer, a stranger came on the phone and he clicked the machine. The Southern gentleman became furious; I did not expect his rage when we were cut off. Later in the dream, I saw this man in a hallway in school but did not mention his invitation. I followed him out the door and notices that his ass was large, way out of proportion. He asked if I was okay, and I replied that I was fine.

I am with my daughter in a strange woman's house. It is on two levels. My daughter is in a crib, even though she is now grown. I see a red stretch of fire out of the window. This seems to be a radioactive wall and it is coming closer to the house. I snatch my daughter from the crib but there is no place to take her. I feel that it is Armageddon, and I am terrified.

I'm driving alone in my car. I get to the top of a hill, and can see a large house down at the bottom where I am to meet my husband. The house is gothic, redbrick, with towers. I drive alone a narrow road the winds through a meadow filled with red flowers. The road keeps getting narrower. I thought this road would take me into the courtyard of the large gothic house, but it still appears to be a long way off. Suddenly, I see I'm near an open gate, and a large yellow dog runs out. It seems friendly, but is also chained up. The dog runs back inside the gate. I see another dog behind the gate. A woman appears, chatting about how she loves to walk in the mornings.

I was at a convention. A woman and I decided not to stay for lunch. I walked outside to find another place to eat. We saw a school, and walked indoors in search of the lunch room. We walked down a hall thinking we could follow the boys and girls, but I was aware that all the kids we saw might not be going to lunch. I asked a police officer where the lunch room was. He pointed us in the right direction. The lunch area was extremely strange, large, almost outdoors. We had to sign in and pay with special tokens. I took a small piece of pastry shaped like a deer and began to eat it.

I have arrived at a garage sale. The house is a modern colonial. There is a flagstone retaining wall in front that is about 3 feet high. I notice a goldfish still alive on a wet spot, lying on the wall. I think that I child must have left it there. The sale items are in the back. A woman walks around from the back of the house with an electric rice cooker in her arms.

I am with a former boy friend in his home, but he is too rigid and controlling so I go over to his brother who is in the same room. In the dream, I am laughing and playing jokes on his brother. I am unafraid and spontaneous. The brother and I go to the seaside. I start to take my clothes off to get into the water. But there are so many layers of clothes that I don't think I can ever get them off. Finally, I get down to my underwear, and the two of us play volleyball in the water, having a good time.

A female friend and I are attempting to break into a house that is on an island with waterways and marshes. This humble home is occupied by a magician and we look through his cupboards and drawers for his secrets. Becoming apprehensive, we decide to run because we have found nothing there and he may return. Hurriedly leaving, I ask my friend if my cocker spaniel is with us. "She's up ahead," my friend answers. I feel relieved and we enter the very blue water. I ask, "Do you see what's in the water?" She replies, "You mean all the Baptists?" I reply, "No, the incredible blue light, shimmering into form. A blue lady who beckons me. "She shimmers, "Come dream with me and all will be revealed."

The ground trembles. It is a shadowy place. I feel the vibration throughout my body. I'm terrified, thinking I will perish in the quake. The group opens and a huge monolith of obsidian rises slowly out of the earth. A reified sun is carved on one side. I am in awe. A single bell rings and I hear it.

I dreamed about a large jungle cat, apparently a jaguar. It has a very human face. It is my power animal. It is being crushed by a huge python snake. The snake is a positive earth energy symbol. I am very upset and I scream "Help! This is terrifying! I am horrified! Help!"

I am in a house, sleeping. I have three female friends who live in a house behind me. They are separated from my house by one house. They are in danger and run from their house to mine. The two men in the middle house shoot at them. One woman is hit in the leg and falls. I am concerned that she has been left behind and is angry at my two other friends and me for leaving her. But they tell me they only want to go to sleep.

I dreamed of my beloved grandparents, one of who died very recently and the other who died 20 years ago. In the dream I was talking to someone who I couldn't see or remember. They said both grandparents are going to die soon. I felt a sense of urgency to say goodbye. The next thing I knew, I was speaking through a sofa. My grandfather was wheezing and he couldn't say anything. My beloved grandmother spoke to me and her voice was clear and coherent.

I drive into the driveway and turn off the engine. I get out and head toward the front door. It's dark out. I open the front door and go inside. I call out "hello." Suddenly, a man grabs me. He's choking me. It feels like my shoulder pops out of its socket. He starts pushing me toward the stairs and down the hall. All the doors are closed. He opens one and shoves me inside and slams the door behind me. I am lying on the floor. I start to grope around. My hand hits something. It is a body! I jump back to find another body. I'm screaming and crying. I put my hand on the floor and lean on it. I feel a soft wet pop as I put my weight down to push off. Suddenly there's a muted light and I see my thumb in some guy's eye socket. I scream and scream.

I am walking in a light gray mist with small luminous flashes of purple light that fade in and out. The mist partially clears and I see that I am in a small corner of a garden. I see a waterfall and a large rock to my right. The rock is a sandy color and I pause there. Out of the mist steps Stanley Krippner who presents me with a necklace made of a copper chain. Rectangular granite chips hang from the chain. As he holds the necklace for me, the granite chips turn into books. The scene fades and I feel peaceful.

I am with a large group of teenage boys and girls, perhaps 200or so. I am one of a dozen adult leaders, both men and women. This event is sponsored by a church I used to attend. A female magician arrives to provide the entertainment. She forms tubes that look like little snakes. She puts one of these tubes on a volunteer woman's head and spins it. Soon she has hundreds of tubes on her head. I volunteer next. But she hands me a bottle of red wine, not tubes. I spin the bottle on my head until there are 20 glasses of red wine on my head. Then the wine spills over my body. There is silence in the room. Then I scream. I realize that the red wine is Christ's blood, but I am a Jew. I scream "I am a Jewess!"

I am in a room in the upper floor of a house. It is dark. My grandmother tries to come in and I feel her presence. I am terrified because I do not want her to come in. I scream for my son. We arrive and we are successful in keeping my grandmother out of the room.

I have arrived at a resort hotel for a vacation. I am standing outside the building and in the parking lot, thinking it is going to be a great week. I can see the ocean and the beautiful flowers. The Pope is staying at the hotel. He gives me a rosary and kisses my hand. He says, "If you ever come to Italy, give mea call." I can not believe am I meeting the Pope and that he said that. But I look at my car and I have a parking ticket. Then I go for help from a teacher of mine who is by an ironing board; she writes me a note on the ironing board but will not show it to me. A hotel employee walks by us. He says, "The Pope just died." I remark that I had just met him.

I am outside taking a walk near my house. I hear my answering machine come on. My voice is on it, but it is slow as if the battery is wearing down. The woman who is calling me leaves a message which is a dynamic, articulate advertisement for a book she has just written. I run to pick up the phone. She hangs up before I get there, but I have her message to play back on the machine, so it is all right.

I am in my childhood home with my parents and my own husband and children. There is another building superimposed over my home. Lots of people come to visit these two houses, and they are messing things up and not listening to me asking them to leave. They want to see the houses and eat the food, but do not respect my wishes.

I am in a house, and am in a bed but it is not my own. A woman sits by the bed. She tells me she is there to protect another woman who owns the bed. A small girl emerges in vapor form from the foot at the foot of the bed. She sits on the woman's lap. The woman tells me that this girl is the owner of the bed, and that she is protecting her.

An event just ended at which there was a huge buffet. Several men were loading leftover fruit and vegetables on a 4 by 8 plywood tray and putting them on a truck. I asked to help. They said that they did not need me. That was okay! I was pleased we would have an abundance of food left over from the buffet.

My ex-husband and I are talking about how I should buy new blades for our electric knife. I began cutting the green skin off a huge cucumber with the old electric knife. I say I will need new blades because I will be cutting all of the cucumbers from the garden. Then the huge cucumber falls open because it is so seedy inside. And a snake's head and tail is wiggling out of it. The snake stares right at us.

I am driving home and my car breaks down so I have to walk three miles to get home. I am joined by three men who tell me what is wrong with my car. one says my front tires are low on air. One says I have run out of gas. One says the axle is broken. But I know the transmission has gone out.

I am sightseeing in a familiar section of my home town. I need to go home. I can't find my car. Each time I walk down a street I find myself in a different building. But the buildings are filled with fabulous art.

I am in hell. The place was dark, dreary, and it is like amaze to get out of it. There is only one familiar face, my boy friend. No one will help me get out, not even him. Finally I am out. I am safe. There are people around me smiling. I don't know how I got out.
I am working with a male friend in my very messy garage, cleaning and cleaning. We are having an easy time, making decisions on getting rid of things. We are enjoying the cleaning process.

I am with my daughter. She is in my arms. I look into her alert eyes and sense that she is from another planet. I am so glad I have brought her into the world, and know she is here for a special purpose because she is also part of my special purpose. I know that she is a gift and is destiny for both of us.

I dreamed I got in my car, and the hair on the back of my head stood up. I looked in the rear-view window and saw my father, who had died some time ago. His head popped up from the back seat. He had red eyes and large, snarling vampire fangs, and he was coming for me. I screamed -- and I woke up.

I am caring for toddlers at a day care center. I am snuggling one of the older boys, around 9 or 10, and am stroking his hair. At the same time a man is holding the lower part of my right leg, and is fondling my toes. He seems to approve of my nurturing the young boy.
I was putting on my makeup. My mother took it away from me. She also took away my jewelry and the other things I used to make myself beautiful. I could not get them back, and I was very sad.

A brass quartet of male musicians is performing on the stage of at heater. They are playing jazz. I am watching and am enjoying it, especially the trombonist. My former husband arrives because this is an African-American event and he is an official in the sponsoring organization. I introduce him to the musicians but by the wrong name and am embarrassed.

I am with my son and several other people, both male and female. My son is about ten years of age in the dream. The people around us said that I was ignoring him and not taking care of him. I felt very badly on hearing their comments.

(precognitive) I had a vivid precognitive dream about a valued colleague. I dreamed that he was rushed in an ambulance, to the hospital with heart trouble, even though he was in good health the last time I saw him. But when I called the hospital -- in the dream – they told me that he was in bad shape and they were preparing him for immediate surgery. (When I woke up, I telephoned and he told me he was preparing to enter the hospital for major heart surgery.)

I am in a mansion. It is very vague where I am. There is grass on one side of the mansion, and trees on the other side. There are about ten little girls on the concrete sidewalk that goes through the trees. I am watching them, and want to go down to play with them so that I will not feel left out.

I notice mosquitoes in the air. I begin to fly with them, noticing buildings and streets below. I am not a mosquito, however. So I fly and then land. I want to take off again, so I flap my hands. My flight is clumsy and I think what might happen if I start flapping my arms. Then I start and fly like a bird; I control my body absolutely. I get a feeling that I need to take a rest. I see the roof of the Ukrainian supermarket and barely have enough strength to land on the roof. There are lots of boxes with empty bottles, and I make my way through them. Everything sounds muted. Then I see three guys behind the boxes and I think that some sort of fighting is going to happen. They remind me of homeless people and I am very frightened.

I am observing events happening on a screen. There is a jungle all around with long green plants climbing on one another. A man is standing in the water, holding a large green boa constrictor by the tail in his hands. The whole snake is twisting. It is obvious that the man keeps control of it, although the snake is mighty and probably could injure him.

I find out that I did not pass the last exam at the university, but am given a last chance to pass it. I pick out a question that I absolutely do not know, and I fail. I true to persuade a professor to arrange the exam for me one more time. But he rejects all my arguments and tells me that I will be expelled. There is nothing to be done, and I realize it. As leave the building, I realize that the question was easy and expound on it. But it's too late.

My male friend and I go to the river to fish. We choose a place and begin fishing. We are sitting at approximately the same place. There is a man fishing a little distance down the river. In a while, we see that he pulls something out of the water. This turns out to be not a single fish but an entire fish pond. It hurts us because it looks like he got fish that could have belonged to us.

A male friend and I go out from a university dormitory. We are searching for an apartment for me. Then we see an edifice that reminds us of our university library. We go in and look for apartments. The first room is very large, luxurious, and pretty good. But we decide to look over the whole building. The second one is fine, but smaller; there are a few sofas inside and a man is sitting on one of them. I stare at him, begin shouting, and throw a chair at him. Emotions overwhelm me. (Then I wake up.)

I am in the square by the Moscow circus. There is a post about twice at high as I am. There is a loaf of bread on the top, and I try to reach it but can not. Then I go behind the circus. It is winter and the ground is very mushy. Cars have to make a detour so that they don't get stuck in the melting snow. I come there are find the station where bread is being distributed. I get a loaf but then have to fight a young man who tries to grab it.

I am in the laboratory where I work and know that a man with whom I work asked me to switch on a vacuum plant. He is about to come over, and I realize I forgot to do it. When I come, I remember but now it is too late. He says, "Never mind," but he looks very angry.

My wife and I come to our apartment and see a corpse of a man we know lying on the floor with bloody spots all over the place. We wrap the body and go to hide it because we are afraid of being suspected of a murder. We hear a voice on the way, like a hallucination, telling us we should cut the body in pieces. But we don't do it. We look for a hiding place in a forest. Then it turns out that the body is not the man we know at all, but is the body of a friend of mine who lived in Moscow. Then the voice tells us that both men are still alive! (I wake up.)

This is an extreme situation. There is a burst of light and a flash without noise. Several figures appear between me and the explosion. First they are vague, then they have familiar faces. They move in a row, side by side, right toward me. As they are marching, they crumble me down and walk over me. But I resurrect very quickly, and it a moment it is the same me. I observe a similar flash and the figures disappear.

The war is over. I'm in Soviet-liberated territory. A girl and I, wearing greatcoats and carrying rifles, are chasing three criminals. I hit their leader with a bayonet but he is still alive. They get in their old wartime car, and disappear. Then it is a sunny day. I walk by a bank with two male friends and see a similar car. The men in the car plan to rob the bank. I see hostages inside the car held at gunpoint. I snatch a rifle from the front seat and kill a robber. Everyone gets out of the car and we go to a canteen. I see a plate with sausage and gruel. One of the criminals says, "I don't want to eat" but eats a sausage anyway. I catch up with him at the train stop and say, "You didn't finish eating."

Four girls and three male friends are with me. We are going to have coffee. Some of us take a taxi, others walk. I am in the taxi with a girl I would like to know better; I count my money to be sure I have enough for cigarettes too. I cheer up the girl; west art kissing in the back seat of the taxi; I am a bit ashamed to do this in front of the others. We get to the baker's shop, then I go to get a pack of cigarettes. I have more money than I thought so when I return I tell everyone that I am buying them coffee. The men start giving me money, but I don't accept it. Then I notice the bill is twice as much as I expected so I start counting my money. The waiter brings 10 cups of coffee, but I am indignant.

There are two high cranes in the street because buildings are being constructed. One is rather high already, and the other one has only four of five floors built. There is a fence guarding the two buildings. As I look at them, I see a giant coming from behind the high building. I think the giant is the builder and owner of the edifices. He goes toward the lower one, steps over the fence, and then turns to me, saying, "What are you doing here, guy?"

I am walking on a street with a girl beside me. My hands have cuts and scars on them. They start to bleed. I also have wounds on my chest, elbows, and shoulders, with blood over my whole body. The girl says, "Look! It's blood!" Then I am in barracks and realize that it is a jail. There are plank beds, and so I walk up the planks and escape.

I am in my dormitory room with Slava, my roommate who tells me he is flying somewhere on a free trip. We are lying on our beds. I look at the wall and notice a new door. The door opens and I see a torrent of black light. A young guy dressed in American gangster style, wearing varnished shoes and gloves comes in a talks to me, telling me he has come for Slava. He has a huge bag in his hand and unzips it. There is a pillow on one end. Slava gets into the bag, and the other man zips it up and says, "It's okay." The door opens up again, and the guy disappears. The door doesn't disappear; I look at it for a while (and then wake up).

I am going from Borispol to Kiev. I see car headlights in back of me and a barrier in front. I get through the barriers. Then I see a UFO flying. It pours liquid from tanks down on the earth. People see this and hide. I also hide in a metro. But the trains don't move. I try to get home by walking through the tunnels. None of my phone calls home get through because the lines are busy. An old man tells me that there is an epidemic of "windy hills"; people fall dead for no reason. I leave the metro and catch a bus home. It is full of people, most of them in protective clothes. I see my brother; we are scared. Aliens arrive and handcuff us, and intend to make injections.

My wife and I are taking a train ride through the snow-covered Carpathian Mountains. We go through a tunnel; the railroad turns upwards. At this moment, out car gets separated from the other cars. I know that another train will arrive in a little while. My mother-in-law suddenly appears, along with other people. We get out and climb a hill. I suggest that our car be taken off the track so that the next train will not collide with it. We do this, and then walk to the top of the cliff. Somebody tells us that there is a town nearby. As we reach the top of the hill, I see the town below. We meet natives of the town, and my wife's mother starts talking with them. They point to the railroad track, telling us where it leads.

I go to work but abruptly find myself on a train to Paris and Strasburg. I am walking along the car and see my boss in one compartment. I let myself in, say "hello" to him, and we talk. He holds a large suitcase on his knees, and I ask him why he doesn't check it. He answers that the suitcase is full of money he has to use for our department.

I am in the Stone Age. I run through the jungle because there are primitive people running after me with their spears and stone weapons. Then this scene becomes a series of pictures, and I run into a room at a university. A lecture has started. Suddenly a spear makes a hole in the door and flies over my head. Students ask me to tell them about the Russian-Turkish War. I tell them to leave me alone, because I realize the danger. At that moment I think I see a monster in the room. It disappears, but I see two holes in the door left by the monster's claws.

I am inside a building when a fight breaks out. People are throwing sticks and pieces of wood at each other. I run out side in order not to be hit. A piece of wood flies by me because I could not get the door closed when I ran out. Everything happened so fast that I didn't have time to close the door.

There is a man chasing me who wants to kill me. I have a gun, and I shoot him, but not fatally. I look back and see this man standing, trying to catch me by the leg. I send electricity from my hands. It cleaves his skull so that I can see his brain and his eyes fall out. I feel that he is still alive and will chase me until he finally drops dead. So I am still very scared.

This dream was very bright. I am near a store. I car comes up, driving by my friend. There is a strange man with him in the front seat. There is something covered in the back seat, in plaid. It seems to me that it is a dead body. My friend and the stranger go to the store. I get in the car to explore the plaid covering. But now the seat is empty. Then my friend sees me in his car; he leaps on the roof but I find the keys, start the car, and drive away. As I drive, the two of us are talking in a friendly manner, and he does not stop me. I put on the brakes to through him off. He falls down, but has a bicycle. I also have one, and he chases me. I climb a hill with my bicycle and decide my friend could not scale it with his.

I am at home, but I decide to go outside. I see a girl sitting on a bench. I come over to her, and we start talking. I tell her, "This is a strange day. I was wounded and I shot a man myself." I tell her that my gun had been shopped in two, as if by an axe, but I was able to use it anyway. I don't think she believes that things are so violent in her home town, but they really are.

I am waiting for a train at a metro station with many other people. One of my friends and another man run up to the platform and jump between cars.
