People do not get astonished, even though this is against the law. Then a train arrives, but it doesn't start. I notice two men in black to the left of me, and a girl sitting in one car, reading something. Suddenly, I grab a door handle and push the train. People in the cars behind get out and help me. I think that we are committing a delinquent act, and I stop pushing. Nobody else does, and the girl stops reading, gets out of the car, and starts pushing too.

I am in my dormitory room. A man tries to shoot me, and we start fighting. I suddenly remember that I have a gun, and take it from a table drawer. But I shoot the man once. He rises, and I tell him, "Don't get up or I'll kill you." He tries to run way but I shoot him down. He lies on the floor while I go downstairs to call an ambulance. As I am making my call, I see myself at home, not in the dormitory. I reach the ambulance center at my hometown, and the voice on the telephone says, "We are getting very tired of emergency calls from your district, man!"

I go into a tunnel. There are rails along its walls. It seems tome that the tunnel has remained there since wartime. I walk with a candle in my hands, but I have a feeling that there is enough light. The tunnel changes continuously. One time it feels like I am walking through a basement, another time it is like I am walking through a garret, and so on. Then I notice the tunnel becomes narrower with more light. The rails disappear and there is a door ahead. I open the door and I am outside of the tunnel.

I am talking with a man in a strange town. I know he is a Communist. We start talking about an independent Ukraine, and he speaks with great enthusiasm, much to my surprise. Then we go to a friend's house where we talk about politics in one room and something else in another room. I move from room to room, not knowing where to stay or what to do.

I arrive at a train station in a strange city. I want to buy a ticket to go home. I turn around and see a train behind me. It is not a usual train. There are colored stripes painted on the front of the cabin in a scary design. There is a light in each cabin, and the cabins are high. It reminds me of those trains from the 1950s. The train will leave in a few minutes. Should I buy a ticket or not? I decide to do it, even though there are still people ahead of me in line. Then the doors of the train slam shut and it leaves before the appointed time. I say to myself, "Take it easy. It's okay. I have time to roam this city until the next train arrives."

I am on a trolley bus when a group of controllers comes up to me. They look like homeless people. One is rather tall. I have no ticket. Suddenly weapons appear in my hands and in their hands as well. We begin shooting. A bullet fired by the tall controller hits me in the leg. I raise my leg and the bullet falls down as though it hadn't penetrated me. It looks like a simple metal cylinder, not a real bullet.

I am on the seashore. I see the blue, lucid ocean. There are people beside me. A little girl of about thirteen is being eaten by sharks. There are many sharks, some small and some large. But it is too late to do anything. The sharks have already eaten her up.

Just as always, I am leaving home for school. I go to the bulletin board to see if there are any changes in my schedule. On Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday there are no lectures scheduled. On Tuesday, there is only a lecture scheduled in the morning. I was excited after I saw this. It means I could swim in a lake with no trouble for the entire five days!

I was going down a road and saw a girl. She started going down some stairs, like going down to a road. I was very curious but I did not want to follow her. But I could not stop myself, so I followed her. As I went down the stairs, it got darker and darker, and I became more and more frightened. But I wanted to see her. I wanted to get to know her. She began to run. Sometimes she turned her face back as if to determine if I was still following her. I sensed she was afraid of me. (And then I woke up.)

I am flying above a field of wild flowers. During a flight I feel a lightness come over me. I feel very free and very light. I don't know if I have any arms or legs, because I do not feel them or see them. Then I realize that I have left my body far behind. (I have had this dream five or six times since I was 16 years old.)

I am swimming in the ocean, and it is far away from my house. But then I realize that I can't get back to the shore and my house. I am engulfed in a whirlpool and something presses me to the bottom of the ocean. But I swim up again, and eventually I reach my house.

I am on a walk through an underground passageway. I notice a door that is ajar. I look in and see three men who the police are searching for. Two of them do not notice me, but the third one does. He asks me what I am doing there. I answer that I got lost. He leaves me alone. I hear someone coming down the tunnel. It is a group of my friends, but only one notices me. He asks me the same question, and I give the same answer. We begin running because someone might be chasing us.

I am captured by some men and find myself tied up in a chair with my mouth stopped with the rag. In a while, a man comes in and turns on the light. I understand this in this room where the criminals execute people. There is blood all over. He turns on a device with large knives in it, and my chair starts moving toward it. He and his group ask me if I am a police informer. Apparently, the police killed some of their people. I respond, "It wasn't me!" My chair moves closer to the knives. (I wake up.)

My sister and I are in a pigsty. There are two enclosures, two pigs are in one and one pig is in another. We are going into the second enclosure. I make a move to close the door so that the pig will not escape. At that moment, an axe falls down behind the fence of the enclosure. The pick picks it up, leans on the fence with one of its legs, and throws the axe at us. He nearly hits us. I try to close the door again, but a piece of wood falls down and prevents me from doing this.

Someone is chasing me. I run away, across a field. Whenever I wave my hand, this makes my pursuer stop and disappear for a while. Then I come to a medieval town and keep running on the streets of that town. I find the house of a witch, baba-yaga. I think she may have something that would help me. But I am afraid of her because she could betray me. Anyway, I follow her into her house and take a potion she gives me. It enables me to fly away.

I am walking down the street and see one man robbing another man. Then they kill him. They notice me and try to catch me so they can kill me. But I manage to escape. Then I come to a group of people who I do not know at all. We introduce ourselves to each other. It is late at night, but I can not get to sleep because I am afraid the two robbers will find me and kill me. But then I go to sleep. When I wake up, I go to the police and tell them everything.

My wife and I are in the Metro and we see that a train is about to leave. We are in a hurry and do not want to miss it. I try to keep the doors from closing, but the pressure is very strong and I can't get inside. I ask my wife to push me from the outside. She does it, and we both get through and we are very happy. But the train is not moving. I am afraid that we damaged the doors, and that everyone will suffer because of what I did. Suddenly the train starts moving and I think that it is all right.

I go to the city of Simferopol. It is very early in the morning, about 5:00 AM. It's October or November, but I wear flimsy trousers with a shirt and a winter jacket on top of it. I think that it was my grandmother's idea for me to put the jacket on, and I didn't object because I was in a hurry. I arrive at the train station and there is a long queue for tickets. There are large windows at the station. The lights are on because the sun has not yet risen. But the horizon is burning and it is light. I finally see a train coming.

I see a country house; I go there with a male friend, and find a little boy. The boy is jealous of my friend and wants to get rid of him. My friend experiences the same feeling. The boy insults my friend, and my friend taunts him. Eventually, my friend drives the boy into the corner of the room. Then my friend has a massive kind of wooden weapon. He wants to kill the boy. Suddenly, an old man comes down from the second floor bearing a rifle. He is going to defend the boy, but my friend seizes the rifle and kills the old man. He kills the boy too, even though I do not see the act. Then my friend beats me in my leg with his weapon and I feel terrible pain.

I am on a great desert. There is a huge oil pipeline going way beyond the horizon. A girl of my age runs out of a building, so the two of us run along the pipeline. Soon she becomes exhausted and falls down. I carry her further in my hands. Soon I began to see my home. When I come in, the first thin that attracts my attention is a picture of something. Then I see my male and female friends. I am sure they are my friends even though I don't recall their faces.

I am in a big hall somewhere. There are many people around me. Everyone is in chains and manacles, and I am too. I understand that all of us are slaves. Slave drivers control us. But then my chains fall off me. I run out into the street and suddenly realize that I am on another planet.

A strange man is standing on something like a UFO which emits blue light from the bottom. A little bit of white light is beaming from behind his back. I don't know if the two of us are on the outside of the UFO or inside a room, but it is very dark all around us.

There is a man who comes into my room. He is small and vicious with a steel dagger in his hand. I stand there while he starts to cut my hands, making me feel the pain. It is a very strong, real pain. Then I kill him, but even when he dies he keeps trying to kill me. I cut off his hands and went out of the room bleeding myself, and half dead. I see girls outside. I told them everything is fine, and we find the light.

I have an impractical desire -- to visit Paris. I am preoccupied with this desire, but there is no practical way to make it come true. As a matter of fact, I suddenly find myself in Paris. A company has sent me there with a stack of orders. I am to fill all the orders and return home. But at least I will see Paris.

I am on my knees before a big man, but to be exact he is not a man but a black terrifying silhouette. This figure is dressed in black with a long cloak and a hood on his head. I don't see his face, but see a very long beard with smoothly turns into a sword approximately just below the belly. He keeps his hands on the handle of this sword, raising it time after time with satanic laughter. The way he laughs scares me very much.

I am sitting in a dark room. The air is heavy and damp. It produces apathy. A man in black enters the room. He says I should kill everyone who comes in there. Then people with brutal faces come into the room, and each of them tries to kill me. So I killed them with no remorse and some bit of passion. Everything was very real, and I felt that if I didn't kill them, they would kill me.

I am driving a car. I do not recall how I was able to get the steering wheel in my hands because I was very far away from it. There are drops of water on the front window screen of the car. The water flows down to the corners of the window screen. It seems to me that it is drizzling. The road is empty, but suddenly a beautiful car appears in front of me. I am impressed, as it leaves me behind.

A male friend and I are dancing with some girls. But it is actually some type of rehearsal. I think that we will be called upon later to perform with the girls in some way. But I do not care, because I like the music and I also like the girls.

In this dream, my goal was to find a very wise creature and talk to it. I did not expect it to be human, because I had read bosky Carol Castaneda. Then I find a man lying down on a sofa. I throw a chair at him, as he is so lazy. Then I realize that he is the wise creature I have been trying to find.

I am walking down the main street of Kiev; it is named Kreschatic. I see a crowd of people running up to me and shouting that one railroad ticket to Paris now costs only thirty thousand coupons. I say, "What?" and run to get a ticket so that I can make a trip to Paris and a return trip back to Kiev. (But I wakeup before I can take the trip.)

While awake, I had been trying to find a proper ending to a piece of fiction I had been writing, but none of my solutions worked out. During my dream, I was at my desk writing. I seemed to be working on the same fictional piece that had been giving me trouble while awake. Then I saw a scene enacted before more of two men and a woman, the main characters in my story. Instead of choosing one or the other, the woman rejected them both. I laughed in my dream, as the ending was very appropriate. When I woke up, I put this dream into writing and was quite satisfied with it.

I found myself on the landing of a stairway. Somebody shot at me, and I was thrown against the wall by the energy of the bullets. I somehow crept home and on my way I met my mother who is a teacher. She helped me to get to my own place. My chest and belly hurt badly. I managed to ring the bell of my apartment. My father opened the door and would not let me in. He threw chunks of asphalt at me. I tried to hide behind trees. Then my friend Dima helped me by stopping my father. (Then I woke up.)

My family became rich because my father went to the USA, and worked there as a president of a bank. It was a large, thriving bank. When he returned to Kiev, he gave me a car, a Mitsibushi jeep, and a driver's license. He gave me a lot of things, then returned to the USA and sent me more money. I drove the car and went to the countryside. But I felt like a nasty guy because I spent the money that he sent me from the USA with girls in cafes, and with my other friends in restaurants. (I enjoyed this dream very much.)

I somehow get into a house unknown to me. There is a man in blue there with a sword in his hand. He runs after me and cries out oaths. Evidently, he is going to kill me. But I run into a door and it slams after me. Then I see my father, also dressed in blue, carrying a sword. Then the stranger kicks upon the door and comes it. My father fights with him, pierces his head, takes me in his hands, and we leave that place.

I am at the Dneiper River or perhaps another great river or lake. There is a big hill of sand, and a tree on the bank. I and my two classmates climb over the tree on the top of the hill. My friends, both of them males, jump into the water. It is my turn now. I jump and when I reach the surface of the river, the depth turns out to be so shallow that in nearly covers my knees. But I am still scared. (I wake up scared.)

I am riding a bicycle in the countryside. Then I see a big sheep dog running out of the neighboring gate. It starts to run after me, chasing me very quickly. I ride my bicycle very fast, just as fast as I can. At some moment, I notice a swamp ahead of me. But I can't stop the bike. (I wake up.)

My dream is about a war. I find myself in a village. I see Nazisline several people up and shoot them. They take little babies from their parents and throw them up, and prick them upon pitchforks. It is dreadful. It seems that they would notice me in a moment, catch me, and lead me to the gate where they shoot people. I get enormously scared, and even try not to breathe. There is a forest not far from there. I crawl toward the forest. When I get close to the trees, I spring up and run as fast as I can, but my legs refuse to work.

I am on my apartment balcony and believe that I can fly. I get higher and higher with each wave of my hands. Someone below tries to reach me, but several flaps of mine are enough to elude him and fly over a tree. I fly for a long time, up and down. At the end of the dream I feel that I can't rise anymore and lose altitude. (Then I wake up.)

I find myself in a room full of children. All of them are hungry and dirty. There are no windows. When I rise from the floor, children begin asking for help, but I don't know what they want. They take me to a bathroom that reminds me of my bathroom, but in this one, everything is spattered with blood. The bathroom is full of blood and children's cries are heard everywhere. I close the door and tell them not to open it. Then I find myself on a balcony, the same as mine. I look up in the sky and see red means burning my skin instead of blue space.

I wake up in the middle of the night because of noise. I go up to the window and see that it's light outside, as if it were day, although I know it has to be night. I see a glow like a fire and hear some sounds of an explosion. It seems strange to me that the glow was not above a building but right in the sky. It is very big, and the sound scares me. In a while it grows gray, and one more burst occurs in the glow. A cloud of smoke like a mushroom spreads above me, and something falls down on me. (I wake up.)

A train is going on a bridge at great speed. I am standing on the floor of a merchandise truck carrying goods. The door is open. From the truck, it is possible to see a river, the bank overgrown with dense bushes. Two of my friends are jumping off the train into the water. So I decide to jump off the truck too, but get caught on the fence of the bridge, and hang still for a moment. After that, I jump again but do not reach the water

I saw a funeral procession. Many people had come for this funeral. Close relatives went in a file by the coffin of the dead person. I got in line. When I went by the coffin, I was really scared because it was my mother who was lying in the coffin! (In two days my mother fell seriously ill, but she recovered.)

(After seeing the movie, "Jaws," I had this dream.) I had a dream in which I was running from a shark. The shark was not swimming, but could run on the land. In a little while, the shark turned into a pushy guy who chased me too. In no way could I achieve the speed I wanted, and my heart was beating wildly. (When I woke up, my heart was beating just as if I had really been running.)

There was an evacuation of Kiev. It happened at night. Crowds of people were boarding buses and my mother and father got too far ahead of me. I wanted to catch up with them, but couldn't run fast enough, and started flapping my hands like wings. I took off, flying, but still didn't find my parents, and therefore began to search for them on every street. People tried to catch me and drag me to a car in order to take me out of the city. Then I deliberately went to the top of a roof several times to jump off because I enjoyed flying.

I am near a cliff and think that it would be fun to fly. So I jump off the cliff. At first I am terrified, but then I start to move my arms. I begin to fly with the birds, and have a very good time. I think that I am doing something I never thought that I could ever do. I am very proud of myself.

(dream within a dream) I wake up in my dream and see a green, half-transparent creature with long hands touching my knees. I ask it, in my thoughts, who it is. The creature answers in a gentle low voice: "I am an angel." Then we talk. I don't remember what we talked about but this "angel" laid its hands on my neck and started squeezing it. I tell it that perhaps it's time to finish for today, but it answers in the same gentle, polite tone, "Shut up your fucking mouth." Then I try to throw it off but I can't. The creature increases its pressure more and more. I find my way to the bed of my mother, searching for help. (Then I actually wake up.)

There is a big pot of gruel right in front of me. Somebody feeds me some of this gruel with a big spoon. But the food doesn't go into my mouth or down into my stomach. Instead, it pours from my mouth underneath my clothes. I cough out of aversion to this situation, and start to suffocate.

I went into my country house, switched on an electrical pot, and decide to cook some potatoes. When the pot becomes hot, I -- for uncertain reasons -- threw it in the pail full of water which was beside me. Hardly had I done this as the electricity began striking me. So I decided to pull up my one leg to avoid the difference of the poles between the two. It didn't work and electricity went on shaking me. I understood that I was likely to die soon. (Then I woke up.)

I climb a very high mountain. I am on my skis. Then I began to ski down the mountain. When I am half way down the mountain, one of the skis breaks down. I have to finish my way down the mountain on the other ski. But I make it and the ending is okay.

I am swimming in the water. The water is clear. There are two trees on the river bank. So I go into the water and start swimming downstream. When I dive, the water begins to grow dark. It is getting darker and darker until the water becomes absolutely dark. Then I decide to leave.

In this dream, I am running down a road. My mother is far in front of me. I keep running, trying to catch up with her. Then my mother turns around. She starts shooting her gun at me. She is aiming at me, and I think she is trying to kill me. I am scared. I am very terrified. (Then I woke up, still feeling scared.)

(visitation dream) (My wife died six months ago.) In my dream, my dead wife visited me. We spent time together, and talked a lot. I asked her how she had settled. She said that there she was with very many dead people waiting in a railroad tunnel because of the lack of living space in heaven. She had made her place in a washroom because it felt more placid there. She asked me to come with her to the railroad station where many people were waiting. There were lots of people there. A grand piano was in the center of the hall. She took her place by the piano, beside a man. I followed her because I wanted to see her leave for heaven, but the man moved to the side and hid her. And when he took his previous position, there was nobody in her seat.

(This dream was neither scary nor funny, it was just a dream.) I was walking on the street and saw a little cafe. I went in and noticed my brother and some people with him. I looked around -- the walls and everything were painted in coffee color. Suddenly the must bust in from somewhere and everybody began singing. I sang too. We sang two songs, one of them I didn't know but went on singing with everybody. (Then I woke up and heard my radio switched on and understood that the songs were had sung were wedged in my dream from the radio.)

I was in a darkened room together with John Lennon and his girlfriend. I was very glad to see him, and asked him about something or other. But he answered, "Like, well I guess you understand you're dreaming, and I can't act beyond it. My power doesn't go further." I really understood at that moment that what he said was quite true, and that John does not actually exist. I would not be able to see him again.

In my dream, I am lying in my bed, reading, before going to sleep. Suddenly I hear that somebody is rummaging in my dresser throwing things about: dishes, clothing, and everything. This "somebody" turns out to be three or four goblins who do all of this, not paying attention to me at all. I attack them with my fists clenched, and hit one or two. They scatter and disappear. (When I wake up, I find myself clutching my wife instead of a goblin.)

I am in my bed before going to sleep, and notice a man with a little beast with a round mouth in his hands standing besides me. Suddenly the animal jumps down on me, sneaks under my pajamas, and digs its teeth into my belly. I grab the beast and hold it tight through the clothing. In a while, the beast becomes soft, and I get it out from under my pajamas. I see a bloody spot spreading over my pajamas.

It's daytime. I see a wasp stuck right down between my finger and my wedding ring, likely to sting me in a moment. I take a knife with a white handle from the table and put the edge under the stinger. The wasp stings the metal. Then I cut off the part of its body with the stinger, and pick out the front part.

(repetitive) In my dream I was back in the war in Afghanistan. I partake in action as a tank driver. The dream lasts from morning until evening. I am right on the battlefield fighting against Afghans, then we advance and seize and little village. Our troops find several rebels there who we shoot down. Then we make an offensive again and capture a camp of rebels and destroy everything in it. I remember well that after a battle we find a lot of bodies, disfigured, so at that moment we begin to bury them. I feel very unusual. (Whenever I have this dream, I wake up in the middle of the time, and sometimes the dream torments me even in the day.)

Just as always, before leaving for home from school, I went to see if there were any changes in the schedule. There was the following: On Tuesday I had two classes, but none late in the afternoon. I had no classes at all on Wednesday, Thursday, or Friday. I was very excited after I saw the schedule. I could swim in the lake with no trouble for the whole five days, Wednesday through Sunday.

In my dream there were a lot of flowers. I went into a meadow. There was a precipice across it and a pillar amidst this abyss. Pontius Pilate sat on the top of the pillar with his dog. I picked up flowers and threw them to him, but they didn't reach him and fell into the precipice. (I had this dream after reading the book Master and Margarita by Bulgchakov.)

(repetitive) (I have had this dream for a long time.) I drive my car at a tremendous speed on a mountain road. I see and feel everything in detail, how I drive, and the sights around me. It looks like an old highway in Crimea. Each time I have this dream, everything repeats itself exactly as before except the color and model of the car. I can see my car going by, or drive it from the inside. (Then I wake up.)

I entered a wartime tunnel with rails along its walls. I walked with a candle in my hand even though there was enough light. It changed continuously. One time it felt like I was walking through a basement, another time through a garret. Then I noticed a door ajar; I took a look inside. There were three men who were wanted by the police. Two of them were talking and didn't notice me. The third asked me what I was doing there. I answered that I was lost. He left me alone and I heard someone come in from the tunnel. It was my friend. We began running and someone was chasing us. As we ran back, I noticed the tunnel becoming shorter and better lit. Rails disappeared. We ran up to the wall, found a door, and I opened it.

I was in a field. There were many bright flowers around me. Poppies were on one side and ox-eyed daisies on the other. I walked on a small road and admired the beauty. A skylark sang in the sky. The road led into the forest. There were trees of different sorts. I sat down near the edge of the forest and the rain, a hedgehog went by, a squirrel jumped upon a tree, a woodpecker drummed his song. The forest lived its usual life. (Then I woke up and this dream was broken.)

I noticed two men robbing and killing another man on the street, then they tried to catch and kill me. I escaped. I couldn't sleep well; I thought the thieves would find me. I awakened, went to the police, and told them everything. Coming back, a black Lincoln stopped; a man got out, caught me, and in an hour I was in a chair with my hands tied and a rag in my mouth. The same men came into this room, switched on the light, and I saw lots of blood. They turned on a knife device; my chair started to move toward it. They asked, "Was it you who told the police?" I answered "Not me!" The police had killed some of their people. The chair was moving toward the knives faster and faster, with only a few seconds between the knives and me.

I was with my father, but he was my age, about 35, with dark hair instead of gray hair. The dream was very colorful. He was neatly dressed. He was quite slim and his hair was neatly combed. He wore dark colored slacks that were too big for him. I thought, "That is the way that young people like to dress nowadays." I talked with him about my own son, but he was not in the dream. As we talked about deep feelings, we started to embrace. I was impressed at how healthy my father looked. And he had just come into the house, in the dream, from cold, frosty weather.

In this dream, I was on a large Japanese ship during the Second World War. I could tell by the colorful uniforms that this was wartime. There was a high-ranking officer, an admiral, and he was respected by his crew. We were competing over the attentions of a beautiful woman from the United States. We had to fight a duel for her affection. But the pistols were strange; the barrel was curved and the bullets made neat holes through his skull, with no blood. But he did not notice it at all and kept shooting. Finally I hit him in a place that killed him. Then I forgot about the woman and took command of the ship. I became the new admiral.

I am with a group of five or six people, some are men and some are women, who are interested in spiritual matters, and we are having a discussion about these topics. One of them is a spiritual teacher. He tells me I am an angel. I feel very much like an angel, but I also feel very sexual. I can think of no reason why angels can't have sex with members of this group.

The dream began with a spatial experience of a small stone tunnel. With every step I took, I was aware that the tunnel was getting smaller. Soon I had to bend down, then get on my knees, then crawl. Then something dry began to pour on me. I asked, "How is it possible that something is pouring if I am in a tunnel inside a rock?" Thus I came to understand that I was in the belly of a mountain. The mountain seemed to eat me, and I could only crawl ahead and could not turn anywhere in the narrow aisle. I slipped on something made of leather and equipped with handles. I turned one of the handles, and something pushed me upwards. I was flying at the height of about 200 meters over a calm sea. I was flying long and happily.

(repetitive dream) I have had this dream several times. It was hot weather. My friend of Eastern origin and I were boating. There was nothing around our boat but killer whales. The sea was calm. It was so hot, I decided to swim a bit. I dived and noticed that I was near one of the whales. I got frightened but calmed down quickly when I saw the whale was not aggressive. I even touched its smooth skin. There were other whales near us. My friend was waiting in the cutter. He was watching me and my new friend, the whale. The time had come to say goodbye. I climbed on the deck and took a last look at the whale. The whale made a final circle around our boat and disappeared in depth. My friend and I turned on the motor and headed for the shore.

I was in our courtyard, standing in front of a tenement as Nazis come out of the front door of our house. They notice me, shoot, but miss. I fall down on the ground, I do not know why. Then another Nazi comes over and he shoots at my head. My mother runs out of the building and shouts at him. But I do not hear her. After some time elapses, I rise. My fall is all covered with blood but there is no hole in my head.

(dream within a dream) I wake up and see two green, luminous eyes on the wall. Then I see shadows, and a great black panther appears in the room. I get very frightened and run across the room. I hide behind the sofa. The panther follows me and tries to reach me with its claw. I think I wake up. But the panther is still after me. Then I really wake up.

I saw a boy fishing. A fish began biting but the boy couldn't pull it out. I helped him and we dragged out a big fish. Then I got a feeling that I could fly and control directions, speed, and other things. I flew in twilight, descending slowly. When I reached the ground an enormous 10 meters tall man began hunting me. He hit me and I fell down. Then I rose, and another punch from him threw me down. After that, I found myself in a trench. Men who were fascist soldiers attacked us. The men with me rose. I rose too and we shot them.

I dreamed that I, my classmates and my biology teacher all went to Greece. She was dressed completely in white. Not all my classmates went, only five people. Having come to Greece, we went to the bank of some river and hired several inflatable boats. As we drifted along the river, I was fishing and managed to catch a shark, but it fell into the river and swam toward the bank. After that some men who were bandits attacked our boat. The teacher and the male and female students swam toward the shore. At that moment, it seemed to me that I could fly. And I really flew up and could see the land and many countries. I enjoyed that feeling very much.

I was in my bed. An unknown force started to lift me up. I flew above my house, street, and district. I saw the whole of Kiev. It was beautiful. Night city lights city attracted me. There was the Earth in blue mist below me; the sky was full of stars, fireballs, and meteorites. I landed on a planet. The great red sun was shining. The heat was so great that blood boiled in my vessels. I knew I would die from lack of oxygen, but an alien saved me. He looked like an herb with straws instead of hands. His eyes reminded me of flower beds. He had tentacles and moved very fast on them. He had a white swatch of cloth and covered me up with this mystical cloth. Once he did, I felt coolness. The landscape started changing. Red dunes turned into my street. Deep inside I knew my bliss was induced by the alien's shroud.

The place in my dream was half the local railway station and half the local airport. I and a male schoolmate walked along the street and suddenly I felt a desire to go down into an underground pass. I saw a group of girls and guys from our school. Passing them by, I bumped into one girl and apologize. Then we introduced ourselves to each other. We talked a lot, then she left her group behind. My friend had left me at the underpass. She asked me how she could get to the airport and I pointed out the exit from the underpass. Then I went upstairs. Hardly had I reached the surface when I heard her scream. I ran back and saw two pushy, aggressive guys trying to get her. I bit one of them on his neck. Then I woke up.

A large lake suddenly appears near the village where I was born. Many people are in the water. But none of these people can swim! There are both men and women in the water. The only person who can swim is me. I have to save them, so I start taking them out one by one.

A truck is on the road, and it is coming near me. Some men are getting out of the truck. These men seize my two children, one boy and one girl. The men put the two children in their truck and drive away with them. I can not do anything about it.

I had a dream that I enter the living room and see my dad holding my mother's hair and dragging her onto the floor. I asked him what he was doing, because he was turning into stone. Dad replied that the Devil was in my mom's hair and that he was trying to relieve her from the Devil's power. Then mom and dad suddenly disappeared. I saw myself standing in front of the mirror and looking at my reflection in it. My reflection was moving closer to me from the mirror. In my reflection's hand there were scissors. My reflection was passing them out to me. I was trying to squeeze my reflection back into the mirror. It was very hard to do. My image did not want to get back there.

(I had this dream for several nights.) I see the face of a watch with the same figures on it: 10, 10; 12, 12; 3, 3; 5, 5. I am very afraid of these figures because on the fifth of the month, I am supposed to get my salary, but I don't. At 10:00AM I am supposed to start my work, which I hate. At 12:00 noon I am supposed to have my lunch. But what will happen at 3:00PM? I don't know. I start to fly away, and somebody sings that money is forbidden on her planet. (I awaken and notice that three fingers on my hand are crossed, and ache severely.)

I am dissatisfied with my job, and plan to go to Brazil on a lecture tour because I gave lectures in Sao Paulo and Curitiba, Brazil two years ago, and my success was publicized in the Brazilian newspapers. I was offered a high salary at the time, but refused because of my mother's poor health. So now my boss envies me and creates obstacles when I am again invited to lecture abroad. I even won travel grants to lecture in California and Switzerland. Suddenly, I notice an elderly man who recommends I phone a female psychologist in Curitiba. I follow his advice and ask for a job there, referring to the positive impressions that I made earlier. But then I realize I do not have money for the flight. I see a calculator which rapidly computes the number of years I need to work in order to buy a roundtrip ticket to Brazil. (I wake up in tears.)

I dreamed that I was eager to fly to Kiev with my female friend but all of a sudden I learned that I was not at the airport but at the railroad station. The flight had left, and there was no way to change my location. Moreover, my handbag with 120 grivnas had been stolen, just when, I didn't know. I am terrible upset because I have to go home and have no money at all. I am in a low mood as I lost my very expensive tickets to Kiev. I am standing at a bus stop, speculating on my problems. Suddenly, I noticed a colleague, and borrowed two grivnas from her. It brightened my mood, and made it possible for me to go back home and pay my taxes.

I am at a training seminar for psychotherapists. My instructor is someone I have worked with in the past, and now I am working with him again. He is giving me so much information, I do not know if I can master it. But slowly it makes sense to me, and finally I am able to keep up with him, even though he is speaking very rapidly.

It was a hot day; my mother and I went to a lake. On the beach there were many people. I went to swim and my mother stayed on the beach. Then my father came into view. He suggested that I race with him in the water. Soon I was lagging behind because I am not a good swimmer. My father understood that I couldn't keep pace with him, and returned to me. He invited me to take a ride on his back and I agreed. We swam along the shore and it was a pleasant feeling. Once again, I became his little girl. We swan for another two hours. My mother periodically was trying to lure us out of the water but we ignored her appeals. Suddenly, it became cold. The river began to be covered with ice. People hastily took their belongings and left the beach. My father told me that he did not have the strength to reach the shore. I knew that he was fatally sick. I was not afraid; I took it as it was. Little by little his strength abandoned him. He gradually plunged into the water and sank. But I reached the shore.

I was near a house and heard some sounds. I carefully approached the window and saw a man, a woman, and a girl of about fourteen. I assumed it was a family and that they lived in this house. The girl noticed that someone was peeking in and told her parents. The woman looked hard at me. I tried to hide myself and escape. The man began to search for me. I went to a shady spot and stood in the mud, in cold, liquid, filth. I could not take a risk and move. The man said, "There is nobody here" and then switched on the outdoors light. My fear increased, and I hit the man. It was a weak blow but I attempted once more. The man turned around and looked at me curiously. I hit his leg with a weak blow. The man bent to catch me. The glow in his eye reflected his wickedness. I ran through a door into the house and found myself in a room with a young woman. She was lying on a sofa in an awkward position; her blouse was up and a naked breast could be seen. I knew that she was waiting for the man who was chasing me. I saw a key in the keyhole of the door. I tried to turn it, but the man opened it more quickly. But then he disappeared. It seemed as if he didn't want the young woman and me to be discovered. So my fear disappeared.

This was a scary dream. I was alone on a street, in the world, in the whole universe. I roamed without a path, stumbling over logs and corpses. When I found myself at the edge of an abyss, I was terrified. I understood that I had to jump and be broken on the sharp stones. Something pushed me down. I resisted with my whole body. I didn't want to die. Suddenly, images of people I knew appeared out of the fog. I cried and an echo repeated my groans. It was the end and I had to jump.

I was in a building, and suddenly I looked up and saw the building in flames. I had to do something. I ran through corridors and got lost. In one room was our class sitting on the stage and the classroom smoothly turned into a cinema hall full of spectators. People watched us and threw rubber balls as if encouraging us. I tried to say the building is on fire, but nobody listened to me. One of the people shouted at me and told me to leave. I ran though corridors again and went out of the edifice. The streets were absolutely empty. It was raining.

My girl friend and I go to our college dormitory. The shape of the dormitory is not usual; it is a cross and the entrance is at the bottom of it. We go in and meet people by the door. There are several hospital attendants carrying a litter with an ill man on it. The patient leaps from his litter and starts to talk in aloud voice which I don't understand. He looks ugly. There are scars and bandages all over his body. My friend is interpreting, then goes away. So does the patient and the attendants. I stay there are think about what has happened.

I am with Boris, my boy friend who I sleep with. But in the dream there is a strained relationship between the two of us. We are in nature, under the sky and the stars. It should be the perfect settling for making love. But Boris says he has to go to run an errand for his parents. I think it is odd that he has to wait on them at this time of the night.

There is a young man in this dream who I do not know in waking life. He is being chased by someone who is very violent. He has committed several murders. This young man comes to me for help. I find a stick and hold off the violent man until the police arrive. They arrest him and we are safe.

I am in a wasteland with a female friend. There are ruins of a bathhouse there. I go in and hang up a small plate containing an inscription. I do not feel any terror, even though I think these bathrooms were once used to hide gas to kill people, and cameras to spy on people.

My uncle came to the country house where I and my grandmother lived; we decided to go somewhere in his car. While I packed and put on clothes too long for me, they went away. I wanted to catch up with them. I put on a fur coat and ran outside. Everyone was surprised to see me. I found myself riding a bicycle across our village, but not following my uncle's car.

In this dream, I am afraid of dying because my neighbors start to die, one by one. I think of what a short period of time it took for so many of them to die, both men and women. I would like to live a more spiritual life, but the conditions around me do not permit it, as I must work very hard each day. Then one of my dead neighbors comes to me and tells me that I can lead a spiritual life through my work.

It is light all around. The sky is strewn with kites. Not only are there kites that look like snakes, but different kinds of animals as well, a whole air menagerie! There are lots of dogs of different kinds, shapes, and sizes. There's too little sight. My vision is limited. I want to fly them, so I run, run, and run to the place where there are no wires and high buildings. I want to see everything. So I am on the bank of the Dneiper River, my house is nearby. The kite animals slowly turn into light clouds and drift on and on over my head. They drift away and disappear. (The word for kite and snake are the same in Ukrainian.)

I am going to have an interesting visit with my friends. I go to the building where they are waiting for me, but suddenly I meet my parents. They tell me that they need me to do something for them. They take me away, but after several steps backward, I tell them that I should at least let me friends know that my plans have changed. But my parents do not free me. Their eyes become cold, the tone of their voices gets harsh. I decide to leave immediately, but they take my hands. I have an insight that they are not really my parents!

I am driving a car, but I don't recall how to get to the steering wheel. There are drops of water of the front windscreen of the car. The water flows down from the middle of the window to its corners. It seems to me that I am flying. It is drizzling. The road is empty but suddenly a beautiful car appears on it. It quickly leaves me behind and vanished. I am impressed with it speed.

I am walking down an alley. It's misty. And I am like a part of the mist, perhaps a lot denser. It's easy for me to move. I feel the power getting into me, making me feel calmer. Then I see a man coming out of the fog. It seems that I have known him all my life. I know what he is thinking of and what he thinks of me. Then he disappears behind my back.

I'm in a strange building. I find a wardrobe and make contact with spirits of the former tenants. I contact the spirit of one woman and identify the former owner by means of his clothing. I notice a woman chasing me. I'm not scared. I go into the basement where there are people locked in. I run into the room, but this woman pushes her head in. I close the door and detach her head from her body, like a piece of batter. But the head exists independently from the body because this woman is death. She retreats. There's no life inside her. I free all the people. I get back to the stairs. I feel a certain tension even though the stairway is wide and beautiful. I notice death following me. There's a door in front. I have a pin and do something to the door so that death won't break through. This is not sorcery, but it works.

There is a dark blue horizon. I see an old belfry. I that it's old although it seems firm and stable. I am far away from this bell tower. In the high part of it, I see through windows that look like splits. There is no star in the sky. It is dark, but I see the tower well. The belfry draws my attention and my feelings. It seems that it keeps a great power. I feel like something very important slipped out of my memory and the bell tower will bring it back.

I come into a room and see my grandfather lying as if he is dead. His hands are crossed on his chest. He looks as if he is at peace. I lie down beside him, and he revives. Then my grandfather kisses me once. I don't mind the kiss. Then I go away. (My grandfather actually died before I had this dream.)

I get a new apartment. It is strange because the windows are too high for a normal building. To enter the apartment, I must use the windows because I don't know where the door is located. I feel a disharmony between this house and the world. I roam in the spaces of this building, finally choosing a room for myself.

I am sitting by the sea, admiring the sunset. It is really beautiful, an absolute idyll all around me. It's the end of the summer, the most beautiful time of the year. I am looking over pebbles and see that each one has a different shape. They look like crackers or dry breakfast food that consists of stars, triangles, squares, and other shapes. I take off the first layer of the pebble, and then the next layer, and then the next. Layer by layer, I see that each one contains different layers than each other pebble. It is very interesting and pleasant.

I meet my boy friend and he suggests we have a snack together. He takes me to a strange place where a few Chinese people crumble vegetables. It reminds me of community kitchen. Everyone may come over, take some food -- as much as they want. As we leave, I say "Wait for me. I'll be back in a minute," and go somewhere. When I return I see that my friend has eaten everything. He asks me why I was absent for so long. I begin shouting at him then start to cry. He tries to console me, but I get offended and leave him.

I am in the mountains with my friends, and we are walking up the road. We see a cafe and we go in. We sit there for a while talking. Recorded music is playing. Then somebody quarrels with another person from our group. As a result, I go down the path to the bus stop, and catch one. But then I don't know where I'm going.

I'm in a dark park. There are two channels of dark opaque water. It's cold, but children are playing by the water and some of them are in it. I go into the water, swimming along the channel. I see a group of my friends on the bank. One girl leaves them, and swims up to me. She says, "I'm hungry and want to have something to eat." We keep swimming. She tells me about her problems as we reach the end of the channel. We go out of the water on a barrier that separates this channel from one that extends further. She says, "I need to buy some cabbage." Later, I see her again, and she has the cabbage. She takes me to meet her stepfather who has a car. She tells me, "If you would like, we will drive you home."

I wake up, and am on an island that looks like one in a television advertisement. The colors are very vivid and bright. There are lots of birds and palm trees. I know that I committed a crime and have been exiled to this island for 4 to 5 years of isolation. I wander around the island and meet various people who also were perpetrators, but now they live on this island and organize different communities, thus separating themselves into groups. The first question I was asked by one man is to what community I would like to belong. I do not answer him. Instead, I go on roaming and see ships beached on a road.

Three people are taking a rest on some rocks in Kabarda: an old man, a young woman, and a young man. The woman says, "Recently, I have been given an invention to review and our boss has something to do with it." It turns out that this invention is a music box, and had already been contrived in France. I told the boss about it, but he responded that it didn't matter that this music box has been copied by us. We introduced a novel element; we varnish the surface of the box and use a special brush for it. I said that I didn't care, and that I didn't want to have anything to do with it. The told man observes us and tells the young man, "Don't disdain any kind of work."

I am in Moscow and one by one, I meet people with whom I work in Kiev. There are six of them. I walk quickly, and can't calm down and get rid of the thought, "Why did I meet them in Moscow? Whey were they not together? Why are there lots of them?" I really want to tell someone about this incident, as it is very strange.

I'm on a train with a female friend but we change to a trolley bus. It's full of people. I hold knitting needles in my hands and knit. All the people around me are doing the same thing. Then I notice another friend and go with her to her flat. When there, I tell her that the flat is very cozy and comfortable, because I see her two sons asleep in it. I tell her about what I saw in the trolley bus. We talk about how bad life is now, when people must knit even while taking public transportation. She tells me that I must deliver her key somewhere. To do this, I must take a train. I come across a railway stop and meet the friend with whom I was with at the beginning of the dream.

I introduce my female friend, Olga, to the man with whom I am living now, and he makes eyes at her, then suggests that they live together for a while. He asks me if I will be jealous. I say, "No, I don't care at all." Two other guys come over and tell Olga and me that they would like to arrange a two-room apartment for us if we want it. I think that it would be very nice and am pleased. Then the first man makes a proposal of marriage to Olga. She agrees and I understand that the proposal for a two-room flat has just broken down because it would only hold the two of them. I am very disappointed.

I'm sleeping in a room on a big downy blanket. There is a man beside me with whom I've slept in waking life. The other man, Soso, with whom I live now, is in another room. We both wake up early and think it wouldn't be nice for us to be seen together. So I go into the other room and join Soso who tells me it's time to have breakfast, fried eggs. I take a big egg, like an ostrich, from my shopping basket. Soso explains that our eggs are much bigger than the eggs of the other man. But our egg is yellow, not white. I look attentively at it, and notice that it is broken; the egg white is leaking out and it's even possible to see the yolk. Then I think of how to take it to a pan and not break it. (In Ukrainian, the word for "eggs" and "testicles" are the same.)

I'm on vacation with my parents near the sea. I go to the beach, and see an announcement saying, "Attention! Sharks have escaped from the sea zoo. Don't swim!" It's written in red ink. I'm not getting very scared, but I decide not to swim. Nothing is happening, so I go back to town, but then return. I see two people swimming. Two fins are getting close to them. Shouting doesn't make sense as they are too far away. But they see the fins and start swimming back. The fins make a few circles, then go out to sea. Panic overcomes everyone. Some run away, some stay, but no one goes into the water. I go home, go upstairs, and stand on our balcony to look at the beach. I see two young men coming out of the sea. They take off their aqualungs and cardboard fins. I understand their great joke and calm down.

I climb a steep, sandy mountain. Climbing is very difficult and something pulls me down. But I know that if I climb it, I'll surely find the river I've been searching for. There I'll find bliss. All my dreams will come true. On my way, I meet two young men. One of them is a conjurer. He's able to perform amazing feats like making fire by rubbing a finger against his skin. People take him for a little god and all his tricks for omens. Then I'm in the city blocks. I know that the second young man is being chased by someone who has already committed several murders and has raped women and cut off their breasts. The second young man hides in the men's room. The criminal is about to break in, but the police stop him.

I walk along a corridor. I see my former school classmates and members of my university group. They tell me they must leave. I find myself in the Metro, but it's not real. The tunnel walls are made of clay, there is a sun light, and it looks like an ancient underground net. A naked man assaults me and flattens me against the wall. But it feels pleasant. He disappears. I board the train and get off at the next stop. The station is still being built. There is a great clay crater. I look up and see the forest, the grass, and the blue sky, but suddenly I feel there is going to be a flood, and think I should take the last train back. Otherwise, there is no way out and I will sink. There is a boy there from our school class. We both take the last train.

I see a valley, open at one side and closed by the forest at the other side. I know that this is Hortitsa. I stand and see the Saint Sofia Temple in front of me. But it is red like our university. I live at the place and I like it very much. There are beautiful places behind the temple. I have always wanted to visit the temple, but something has always interfered. Behind my back is a building -- a foundation with piles of various materials, concrete, and weapons. I also see a man and a boy working on the building. Then I walk over there.

A neighbor (who has recently died in waking life) is coming back from the hospital. Another neighbor and I are sitting on a bench and see her return. She has become slender, healthy, has a nice hairdo, and so on. We joke about her. She really didn't want to go the hospital but now she looks much better that she did before she went.

I walk to a stadium. There is a lake with dark opaque water instead of a football field. Ducks are swimming there. I try to catch a small duck, and when I do, I feel that it is made of rubber. The other ducks rush to save the little one. When I look at them, I see that they are no longer ducks, but pigs. I'm scared. One little pig jumps the wire fence and waits for me. It's trying to get through the hole in the net but gets stuck. I twist the net in order not to let it out. But the pig turns orange and I understand it is suffocating. I take it out of the fence and know that it's necessary to put it in the water. I run to the lake carrying it, and watch its face change into a child's face. I hold the child and fear that it will die.

I am walking along a tunnel. It's dark, but there is a bit of moonlight. Stones and water are under my feet. I go barefoot. Thus, stones prick my feet. I hear a baby crying behind me. I turn back and find it is near the place where I am standing. The baby is not wrapped up but is lying on swaddling clothes. I pick it up and try to descend. The baby is about 3 or 4 months old, but smiles like an adult. It also has teeth, a short haircut, and in general an adult face. It smiles at me. I get scared and start to flounce. I don't know where to find the way out is. I am afraid the baby is a mutant but I don't know. So I am hesitating between the desire to leave the baby and feelings of pity for the baby. I am running to one side and think about the first decision, and then to the other side and think about the second decision. (Then I wake up.)

I am sitting in my dormitory room, watching television. Suddenly, a man appears there. He has a knife in his hand and starts something like a performance. He's taking the scalp from his own head. I see him do it, step by step, until my nerves break down and I come out from the room. The corridor which I went into doesn't look like a dormitory. It feels like I am in a hospital. I try to calm down and then come back for something. The man is still there. He goes on cutting off his hand. I hear the knife scratch against the bone while he is scraping flesh off the hand. It is terrible.

I am on top of a mountain with lots of friends including the young man I dated earlier. The man jumps off the top of the mountain into the water, but it's too far away and I think he will be killed. Nevertheless, he comes out of the water. He's alive and see him ascend the mountain. I think that he has done it because of me. Then, although I don't know why, I sit down on the edge of a piece of cardboard and I feel that stones are beginning to fall down from underneath me, but they really don't.

I am with some other young women, one of whom I know. We are told we must entertain the crowd of men erotically. We can use two chairs. We get started and we don't care about their response, we just want to cheer ourselves up. But the audience takes it seriously, especially one man. Our performance lasts a long time. Then we leave for Hydro Park, on an island near Kiev. I hold a picture of all participants of the show and we are searching for ourselves in it. We can not find ourselves because we are wearing bathing suits, and the picture keeps changing all the time. Finally we succeed. I notice that the natural setting is splendid and I regret not going there more often. It is autumn but still warm. However, it is not as pleasant as spring because of the gnats.

I am in a waiting room at a train station. I see a French text on one of the seats. I take it, and start to read it. I ask a man if there is exercise equipment like dumbbells. He answers that there are. I say, "Okay. If so, I won't waste my time. I will combine learning French and physical exercise." Then I hear a voice saying that the train is about to leave. I run very quickly and catch it. But I see the staff is making small monuments on the seats to the people who missed the train.

I am standing in a great field. The night is dark black and the sky is very clear, a light blue without any star in it. There are plants growing on the field. They look like violet flowers. There is also a man wearing white garments, further back in the field. He says to me, "Eat the flowers." I take one of them and taste it. There is something interesting and attractive in it, but it tastes insipid and therefore I am not satisfied. But I have a feeling that I need it.

My friends and I set sail on a ship. There is a big shot on board, and he tells everyone what to do. He tells us that there are lots of perfidious, unkind people on the island where we are headed, and that we are supposed to fight them. We arrive on the island and it reminds me of Kiev. It is late evening. Our crown is driven to the war, but everyone wants to elude it. To prevent desertion, the militia is behind us, holding sticks, read to hit anyone who does not obey. The army cars shine their headlights on us. It's terrible and awful. But my friends and I escape through the gateway.

I am somewhere in a village. I see an airplane landing on a field, taking people on board, and leaving. I get very interested in what they are doing, but I didn't catch the first flight. Then the airplane comes back for a second load. I take a seat. It turns out that this airplane is an interstellar spacecraft that steals technology from different planets. The spacecraft, like a bus, is divided into parts, connected by corrugated flexible insertions. I'm sitting on my chair and a man comes up to me and offers me food. I take the food and while I am eating, he tells me what they do. Then we go through the salons of the airplane. I look through the window and see that we're already on another planet, although the life outside looks just the same.

I am in a great hall. There is a rehearsal, one in which I must participate. Everyone is fantastically dressed, everything is beautiful, and we are learning a dance. I feel as if I have missed something essential because I didn't arrive in time. Suddenly, our show begins, and we dance something like the ballet. There are nine girls in the dance, and they all have wonderful hairdos except me and one other girl. The two of us start to do inept things that are out of step with the dance because I was late for the rehearsal.

I go up the dusty floors, crowded with lumber, to our new flat. I reach the 5th floor but then remember that my flat is on the 4th floor. I descend, and meet a crazy old woman carrying a fluffy grey cat, saying that it's now time for the cat to walk on her own. Quietly, I follow them downstairs. We come to a green yard. The cat is set free. It goes on ahead. Then I become a gray, fluffy tomcat. I get excited, and recall cats' marriages last along time, so I want to get married to that cat right now. I catch up with the cat, and am surprised that when she sees me, she takes an appropriate pose and sets aside her tail, purring. I jump up on her and engage in a sexual act. I have very odd, very pleasant feelings. There are people observing us, so I must really be a tomcat.

I am at home with my mother-in-law. She sends me to dig up potatoes. I go out to the vegetable garden, take a look down, and see a ball of snakes. I get scared and call my mother-in-law. She tells me to throw the ball into the fire. I try to take them but they are slippery and slimy. Then I try to braid them, and I succeed. I throw the snakes into the store, but they crawl away and attack me.

I am in a hospital where women give birth to children. There are two janitors nearby who are also nurses. One of them is named "Valya." She is a blonde. I see my belly and the bed to the right of me where I am to give birth to a child. In this room there is also an apparatus that helps one to give birth. It is a uterus, inserted in something like an aqualung. Now it's my turn to lie on the bed and I turn to Valya and tell her that I am scared of this device. She say, "Oh, you are scared!" and starts to laugh. But I continue, "I know that it may cause a hemorrhage in the baby's brain." She keeps silent as if she understands that I know everything about the danger.

My brother and I went to pick mushrooms. We stopped at a glade. He began to make a fire and I sat down to read a book with my back toward him. When I turned away, the fire had already gone out and only smoke remained. Then we went on walking, met some people, and talked with them. Suddenly we caught a sight of cucumbers. There were three of them with unusual forms. We picked them and put them in our basket. (My brother has been dead for a while.)

It was a hot day in this dream. My mother and I went to a lake. We stopped at the shore where there were many people. I went for a swim and my mother stayed on the shore. Then my father appeared; he suggested that we have a race in the lake. I agreed. We started, and soon I was lagging behind. My father understood that I am not a good swimmer and couldn't keep pace with him. So he invited me to ride on his back. I agreed. It was a pleasant feeling being "a little girl" again with my father. My mother tried to lure us on to the shore, but we ignored her.

This dream was emotionally colored. I had a feeling of discontent. I was in a room with a stranger, a man I had never met. The fire of his eyes reflected his wickedness. I saw a key in the door hole, but the man saw it first. It is strange, but he did not lock the door. In fact, he disappeared. Later he came in again, but was looking for someone else, and went out. My fear disappeared.

I walk into a house and see a man, a woman, and a girl of about14 years. The woman looks hard at me. I try to avoid her stare, and try to hide. The man enters the house. He searches for me. I try not to be seen, and dash from one room to the next. Then I reach the last, most neglected room. The man enters and says, "This is the last room, and nobody is here." He switches the light on. I see green wallpaper. The terror accumulates in my soul. The man sees me and tries to catch me. I fight back but am too weak to stop him from grabbing me. I see an open door, and run through the door. I see a naked woman lying on a sofa in an awkward position, her blouse is up and I can see her naked breast. I understand that she is waiting for the man who chased me.

Mother and I are in a sanatorium. It is July and it is warm. Plants are green and blooming. Everything seems to be moving around at a slow pace. The foliage calmly moves to the breath of the wind. Water reflects the sun beams. People on a holiday are strolling in pairs. Then something unreal moves into view. It is my father's face. I still think I see it as I wake up.

I am sitting in a tree near an abandoned house. I am a little bird, with a sonorous voice and lovely plumage. I have been raining, and so I am wet. It's still damp and gloomy. I would like to be warm and dry. I have no energy to fly, so I hop to the windowsill of the house and which I see a pair of woman's open toe sandals. I peer into the house; it is rather luxurious. Suddenly I take on human form, but I still perceive myself as a bird.

I was chased, taken prisoner, and placed in a castle. My younger brother came to the castle to help me out. But he was also taken prisoner and put into the jail cell with me. We were scared and we worried a lot about what would happen to us. Then our parents came to the castle and rescued both of us.

My daughters and I were playing on the bank of the river. There were horses and we rode them. Then bandits came over and asked where our souls were. We said that we had left our souls at home. They went there to check to see if we had told them the truth. My soul was not at home that moment, and the bandits came back to try to catch me and take my soul. I ran away from them, and then flew up and hid in the clouds.

In this dream the weather is cold. Leaves fall on the ground. The sky turns gray and bleak. The river begins to cover with ice. I am with some other people and we are all frightened by this change of the weather. My father was with me, and told me he was fatally ill. He said he did not know if he could go with me. In fact, he plunged into the water and sank. I was not afraid. I did not pity him. I took his death as it was.

I died. My body was put in a coffin and was carried to a cemetery. I felt unhappy being dead and thought, "Why should I die and let them bury me?" I got up, ran away, and hid unnoticed. Everyone was searching for me. At some moment I realized they could see me behind the bushes, so I ran on the road. Two people chased me. When I got tired of running, I woke up.

I took a train to visit my friend who lives in a small village. I had to walk from the railway station. There were two roads. I chose the one that goes through a garden. So here I was going on this road and suddenly I saw a tree. I went over to it, touched it, and the tree began to incline, and fell down. I got frightened by the thought that I would be blamed for breaking this tree and ran away.

My family and I decided to visit my mother--me, my husband, and our little son. My mother lives on the seventh floor of her apartment building. We all arrived and began our visit. Then, my son and I went out for a walk on her balcony and -- bang – my son fell from the balcony down on the pavement. I was scared. (I woke up in fear. I have had this dream twice.)

My friends and I went to see a museum. There were carcasses of different animals. When we cam upon a skeleton of an elephant, one of us began to make fun of it. It happened so that the light was switched off and we heard a terrible scream of that boy. It seemed that something or somebody had hit him, and he cried. Then something big fell on the floor with a thud. We heard voices, trampling, and somebody's laughter. When the light was switched on, we saw the following picture and laughed: The carcass of an elephant had crashed down on that boy. There was a strip of cloth on its tusk where someone had pulled it down. The boy's hands were under the elephant's ribs and his shirt was torn. The boy was scared greatly. (I woke up.)

My friends and I walked near the technical school. Then we went down a road somewhere and found ourselves by the cemetery. It was late and dark. When I turned my head toward the cemetery, spirits began to rise from their graves. They moved toward us. We kneeled down and worshipped. Then a bright beam appeared around us. I don't remember what happened then.

I was an inventor. I wanted to design a module capable of rising into space, and I managed to do it. The dream was so real that I even had some doubts that I had, in fact, achieved this crazy goal. When I flew up to space, I saw various creatures around me. I was the grip of deep emotion about this world I had not seen before.

I walked out of the Metro. I carried two bags and wore a light, transparent dress and sandals. I looked toward the city and saw a strange skyscraper, a cone the top of which was lost in the air. The walls were made of transparent glass. I thought I should go inside and perhaps live there. There was an elevator; I had to go up. People there were strangers to me. But it seemed that all of them knew me well. Two long legged girls in leather took me by my hands and led me through numerous corridors. "You will live with us," they told me. We went out on a balcony. The balcony was inclined just as a wall, therefore it seemed to me that we were likely to slip down and would fall in a moment.

I was in a small, narrow room. It seemed to be a bathroom. It was lit with an unusual green light that was reflected by the walls. I stood to the left. A man on his knees stood by the right side of me. There were three others in front of him. I think he was going to be baptized, but in some strange way, as if they all had rehearsed it before performing it. People were in white garments for the ritual, but some wore gray cloth over the garments. I felt very strange.

I went outside and saw that everything was strange and unknown to me. I got scared. Through the shreds of fog and tremendous cobwebs that dangled everywhere, I saw that it was dark. There was only one star in the sky that lit my way a bit. I went somewhere, tearing a cobweb with my hands, stumbling over stones. I might as well have been blind. Then I understood that I was being led by a voice. A child was crying somewhere and I had to find him. The city had been bombed out, and the child was under the ruins. It was part of my destiny to try saving him. Then the cry stopped and I knew the child had died.

My friend and I are at a technical school. It is going to be a semester of concentrated work on Ukrainian, but I write dictation badly. I joke with my friend, saying let's go and miss this work. We go to the exit in jest and walk outside to a strange street. We go down the street somehow, and take our learning as a joke. But we get frightened inside and feel remorse. When we walk by an unfinished building, I soil myself with some white plaster. We reach the seventh floor and meet two of our classmates who are smoking there. They are sitting on a landing near a balcony. The house is now occupied; it has just been built. There is no linoleum on the floor and no phone in the window frames.

I walked down a small alley. There were decorative trees along it with a great amount of fruits. The fruits differed in forms and color. When I walked ahead, I saw a young man sneak up to a tree with fruit on it. He wanted to pick one, but couldn't reach it. Then he jumped up and reached a piece of fruit. At that moment, everything grew gray and disappeared.

My friend, her brother, and I walk in the city doing shopping. We buy some butter in a store. After that, they disappear. So I am left alone among many-storied buildings. The buildings are rather far from me. The place is absolutely clear, and there are white paths across the green glades. In the distance I see trees and a cliff behind them. I go toward the trees. The first one is an apple tree. There are green, small apples on it, but in a little wile great, watermelon size apples appear on the branches. They are also green. Then I notice a dark head of a sheet, but it is not what I have taken it for. This is a dinosaur, a small pterodactyl. I throw apples to it. My fear disappears fast and we become friends. I saddle it and we fly toward my street.

I, my father, and my younger brother of mine are walking across a hanging bridge made of wood, over a wide river. I wear new varnished black shoes with bows and a ring on a finger. Suddenly the bridge breaks down and we fall into the river. The water is turbid, but not very much so. There is a boat nearby, we reach it and get it. My bows come unstuck and sink; the ring sinks too. So I am sitting in the boat and I feel great pity about them. Water begins to get inside. We scoop it out, but can't cope with the whole amount. We jump off and swim to the shore. I don't see my father and brother, but feel them beside me. I nearly get to the bank, and my classmate takes my hand and pulls me out of the river. I begin to cry about my bows and rings again, then I go into a bathroom and see a bath full of water. I pull out the cork and notice my bows and a ring on the bottom of the tub. I take them. (I wake up.)

A guy and me are walking across a place reminding me of a dacha area or countryside. It is twilight. We are going along a path. There are net fences of both sides. There are fruit trees behind the fences. I begin to pick pears right and left, and eat them. Then we go on walking. I don't know this man but it seems to me that I have seen him somewhere. I don't remember his face. We kiss each other and say goodbye.

My friend and I are spending our holidays on the Black Sea. We are taking a stroll by the sea. We are admiring it, and then I notice at one moment that everything around us has changed. The buildings have grown old, and the apartments inside the buildings are arranged in another way. (When I wake up, I remember my actual trip to the Crimea.)

This dream was colorful in blue and white tones. I am very high in the mountains. All the time, I try to run away from a man. I run very fast, almost flying. I want to cry "Mama!" But I have no strength to do it. Some clouds are beneath the level where we run, but the others are as high as we are. Through the dream, I was very scared of the fact that the man might catch me.

I went to see my friend. I had been at her place many times before, therefore I opened the front door with no fear. I didn't find anything strange. I took an elevator because my friend lived on the sixth floor. When I reached the place where her apartment should have been, I didn't find anything. There was nothing but emptiness. I got frightened and decided to leave as soon as possible. When an elevator opened its doors, I noticed that there was no floor being scared ore than ever, I ran down a stairway. There were some black dusts there as if nobody had walked on it for a thousand years. I don't remember how I managed to get out of this terrible house.

My friends and I spent our holidays in a strange place in this dream. It was near the sea, but there were swimming pools also. I am afraid of water a little bit but only in the sea; in the pool it is okay. So I decided to swim in a pool. A little girl swam besides me. In this dream I swam badly, but that girl swam surprisingly well. But suddenly she began to sink, and a lot of people gathered around the pool and I rushed to save her. I took the girl shore and carried her in my hands to some building. I walked for so long, roamed in corridors, then I noticed a big door and opened it. (Then I woke up.)

I find myself in an ancient castle of the 16th or 17th century. The host of this castle guides me, showing me different rooms. Everything is ancient. We walk along a long corridor; there are many doors in the walls. I see something new every time we open a door, but now I can't remember what. So we come up to one of the doors, open it, and I see a big bed. A beautiful young woman lies upon it. But her beauty is scary; she is like a black gypsy with strange powers. The host tells me that she is just a mannequin and she can't do any harm. But he talks to her and she answers. At this moment I notice that there are many mannequins. They run after me. But they can't walk for a long time and just move their hands. The beautiful woman tells me she can't walk long either but after they take a rest, and use a camera to photograph my legs and hands, they will be able to walk endlessly not getting tired because they have captured my energy. I run away because I don't want the power of my hands and legs being taken away from me by them. But wherever I try to hide, I see them. The host has disappeared. I snatch a camera out of their hands, and run, but feel they will catch me soon. (I wake up holding my hands as if I really held a camera.)

(In waking life I never said a word against my father.) I was scolding my father. My mother just stood and smiled at us. Then I went outside and found myself right at our technical school of electronic devices, as if it been in front of my house. I went in, and there was nobody there. I hug around and left.
