Then I realized I was at a disco. I was there with a guy, but did not know if he was 20 or 40. We celebrated my 20th birthday. There was a big birthday cake on a table with candles and other things. All those things were there only for the two of us. We took out places at the table. (Then my mother woke me up.)

My younger son and I were walking down the riverbank. We found the breathless body of my older son in the water. We got him out of the water and placed him on the ground. I realized that he was alive, but he was not breathing for some reason. I started crying. (Then I woke up.)

I was walking on the roof of our house. On the other side of the roof there was a man. He came over to me and we talked, but I do not remember what we talked about. Then I came up to the edge of the roof. The man pushed me. I fell down. (I woke up.)

I was living with my son in some house. I went outside in the yard which was restricted from three sides by other buildings. There were large piles of snow, about three meters high. Those snowdrifts were situated perpendicular to each other. I walked among them taking to my son over the phone. He said that one girl, our relative, was his guest then. I heard her voice saying that my son had old fashioned clothes, and I told him, "Never mind, we will change it gradually" I went into the house. There was my son and small, curly, brown dog. We thought it would bark at us, but it starting fawning instead.

I see my best friend, who is dead. She wears a school uniform and pleats in her hair. I am glad to see her, but even realize in the dream that she is dead. She embraces me, rejoicing in my company and my appearance, and wants to kiss me. I don't let her do it, saying, in a joking manner, "No need to express such strong emotions. The others could think that we are lesbians."

It felt as if I had been in an unknown land. There was a horse by me, and it was empty inside. Only its skin was left. But it's head was alive and its eyes were staring at me. Suddenly the horse's body began to fill up as it lay on the ground. His head started talking in human language, but I forgot the words. Then the horse calmed down. Then there came another horse and everything happened the same way. I went on further and saw a wide river. There was a bridge across it, laying right on the water. The bridge swayed but was firm. I do not remember where I actually came to when I crossed the bridge.

I come to a dinner, but I am late. While I am eating salad, the other men and women are taking the rest of the food: meet, roast, soups. I try to be indignant at them, but they do not say anything cogent back to me. I see a tray with cakes and ask them to at least leave me one of them. They move the tray toward me.

It is summer. I am searching for something in a big building. I go outside but there is nothing there. I come back through the same gate and fall into a hatch in the concrete floor, getting caught on a railing. I cry for help, but people just stand around discussing how I should get out of the hatch. I swing several times, clinging to the edge of the hatch by my legs. I squirm and get on to the surface. I am enormously tired. After taking a rest, I go to the center of the building where people rejoice in my salvation. Everyone is smiling and congratulating me. But they soon lose interest in me and go about their business.

I went into a shop near my house and saw that the shop assistant at the counter was actually our department chief where I work. He said that had privatized the shop and then began to sell motorcar parts there. He had gold teeth in the dream. One of the men from our department had been helping him out. (I woke up shocked to find all of this out.)

I am going to a party of old school friends, the 20th anniversary when we finished school. I am preparing to go, but right now I am sitting, and am looking over old photo albums and noticing the suits and dresses in which we were dressed in these pictures of the day of the last school party when we graduated.

I am near a small, shallow river which has clear water, lilies, and other water plants in it. Suddenly, I see little puppies down there in the river, choking in the clear water. I pick them out of the river as quickly as I can to save the puppies' lives.

I am walking around a market place, going here and there, with seven containers of pumpkinseeds, trying to find the same amount of black seeds of sunflowers. But I can't because all the merchants have seeds that are burnt or defective. There are no sunflower seeds that are okay.

My grandmother and I were gong to the country and suddenly I got a desire to burn down our country house. Grandma said, "Don't do it." But I took matches and threw them, lit, on the floor. The country house burst into flames. We ran out into the road, far away. It was night. When we got back to the house in the morning, it was okay. And we began to live there.

A man and I are together. Because of the mist, I do not see his face. His voice tells me that he is a man, not a boy. I tremble. We talk about different things; he suggests we get married. I agree without thinking, although I don't love him and he is older than me. We prepare our marriage. I am very nervous. Nobody encourages my choice. My ex-boyfriend sees me when I am shopping and asks, "Why did you do that? I love you still!" I conclude that he's right, but it's too late. On the day of our marriage, I'm in a simple pink dress. I'm sad and wistful because I was wrong. I am confused. I do not want to marry this man, who I did not even see. I want to get rid of him!

Summer had come. My girl friends and I walked on the streets, coming across one strange young woman. We went to her house and saw a sofa, flowers, a bunch of onions, and wreaths in the hallway, everything that was necessary for fortune telling. We talked about different divinations and heard a noise turning into a voice. It was a TV set that answered questions! The landlady came in told us to leave. We began to tell fortunes right on the street. We all took each others' hands and formed a circle. We found out that if one of us had fallen as we moved outside, we would have lost the love of the young woman forever. She was very spiritual and beautiful, wearing a black dress with white sleeves.

In my dream I was in a field with other girls. Our task was to jump over nettings and to climb on a stairway. It was like a race. After a whistle was heard we ran. I saw that girls started climbing over bars. I did not feel like doing it and passed them around. Then me and others started getting under the nettings. All that lasted for a long time. After that, I appeared on a sand road. There was a tree near the place where I stood. I could reach the red apples that were spread all around. I and a little girl began to pick them up and eat them. Then it started to rain. There was a bed under the tree and we both got under the blanket and laughed, eating apples. It was pouring rain. After that, we noticed an old man going on the road. He came over and talked to us.

I was in a strange city. There was a strange woman who haunted me. She was beautiful, but I felt she was not like other people. Everywhere I went she followed me. I tried to find my mother, but couldn't. I ran along a narrow, dark alley and suddenly found myself at a railway station. It was dark, full of people, and trash. I got through the crowd to a train. As I was about to get into a wagon, that strange woman seized my hand and began to pull me somewhere. I found myself in a white room, sitting on a stool. She told me everything about my life, and I asked her how much time was left for me to live. She told me 14 years, 8 days, and 11 hours. I was frightened and woke up in fear.

This was the most beautiful dream I had in 1995. All my friends, male and female, came together in a big marvelous room. Two special guests were there. One was my ex-body and one was my present body. Then everything suddenly disappeared except the three of us. We ran upstairs and every door opened in front of us. During the long run, we reached a great, beautiful but somewhat strange but spiritual garden. There were swings right in the middle of the garden made of gold. White doves were flying and flowers were blossoming around them. Shapes of trees were unusual. I swung for a long time, then everything disappeared again. We ran somewhere as if trying to hide from someone. We passed through a long, narrow corridor; then we entered the garden again. As we went in, a white dove of peace perched upon my shoulder.

A male classmate and I go somewhere in a truck. Then it stops and we walk though fields, forests, and swamps. I talk to him and he says, "We are going to get married tomorrow." I am surprised and answer, "Are you a fool, boy? We are still students. There will not be any wedding tomorrow." At that point we suddenly are in his apartment. He starts doing things around the apartment. His mother comes out of her house and walks into the apartment, and takes a strange look at me, asking, "Why did you bring her here?" he says, "Well, mama, there are some things I should give her." He takes me by the hand and leads me into his mother's house.

(repetitive dream) I have had this dream many times. All that happens is very simple. My task is to keep a very small thing, somewhat like a needle, in my hands and not let it fall down or out of my hands. As I am trying to do this, very big things are falling down on me from above as if to interfere with my task. I try to get away from them. All these events make me feel very bad.

My girlfriend and I are on a bus. Two handsome men stand nearby and start to admire us. We are not acquainted with them. One says hat he likes me, another that he likes my friend. Suddenly I appear at our college. An old man with mustaches is cross with e, and I don't know him. He lifts me on his shoulders and goes into the classroom. There he pretends we are not quarreling. Here are lots of students, male and female, in the room. The man smiles at them and grips my leg. I feel a great deal of pain. Is art to struggle and manage to liberate myself? I run downstairs from the fourth floor of the building. A fellow student brings a beautiful white horse to me. I jump on the horse's back and run away.

I am in Italy with a group of tourists. Our guide invites us to see a shoemaking factory. The manager presents us with shoes. She says to choose the model we like best. Everyone else chooses quickly but I am at a loss, trying on one shoe after another in vain. At last I find a nice pair of top boots, but the moment I put them on they seem ugly. Finally I decide to take a pair of shoes, not top boots. The boots will wait for later because now I need a nice pair of shoes. I tell this to the manager and he gives them to me.

I am at my granny's house (she died some years ago). I approach a porch and open the door. It creaks. I recognize that creaking. Granny used to return home and night and I always waited for the creaking of the door as an end to my loneliness because I was afraid to stay home alone. So I am wandering in the house which consists only of one large room and I see granny. She is going along the river bank in my direction. And suddenly she disappears.

I see my kitchen garden in this dream. It is winter. Some seedlings I planted last fall are shooting sprouts out of the snow. I am looking at them and that is all I can do. There is a feeling of fear, unaccountable fear because I do not know the reason for it.

I am sitting at the mirror, speculating about the future. In the mirror I see a glass of water. On the bottom of it I notice a ring. There are two men standing on the ring. One of them is taller and one is shorter. I am acquainted with the short man. He is looking at me. In a few months we engaged to be married in waking life!

I am in a room that looks like a temple. A man in black clothes enters the room I am in. He demands that I give him my hands. I refuse. Then he takes off his own hands and disappears. I am still in the temple. Now there are other people there, praying, looking at the wall. I am also praying. But I am looking at the window. The man in black appears again. This time he demands my soul be sold to him. I refuse to do that. The man's head vanishes.

I hear a funeral procession carrying my grandfather's body. [This is a few nights before the 40-day remembrance of his death. Grandfather is wrapped with a ribbon resembling a thick bandage, like a mummy. His legs are wrapped together and the arms are tied to the body; only his eyes are visible. They are open. My sister is also near the coffin. The coffin is carried up the staircase, and they drop it. The body falls out. I am surprised that the body is not stiff. It bent and even resisted someone's attempts to put it back in the coffin. There are people's voices, but I could not hear the words, only intonations. Then the body is returned to the coffin, and it again is carried up the stairs, and again the body falls out. It rolls down the stairs and falls to the left where there is no railing. I go to the body and bend to lift it and carry it with someone else. I touch the body and am strongly surprised by my sensations. First, the body feels ice-cold; second, it is slippery; third, there is an absence of fear or squeamishness on my part; fourth, I could not life it from the floor. I look into my grandfather's eyes. They are veiled; they seem to be alive but don't express anything. [I need some sort of completion for this dream.]

I am in a park near buildings, one of which I live in. There are many trees in the park and many people. I see that a tornado is coming. I have a "bird's eye view" from above and notice that six small "daughter" tornadoes have separated from the main one, and are advancing in a symmetrical way. Each of them becomes thinner and weaker. I feel confused as to what is better: to run home and hide there, or to somehow escape the danger outside. I notice that everyone is staying. I look for a tree think enough that it would easy to hold to, but strong enough not to be damaged by the tornado. A street-cleaner sits down on the thick root of a larger tree, stretching his legs, places a sheet of plywood on top of them with an ax. I think, "Well, he won't be carried away now. "Many others are making a shed from wooden planks and tree branches. I decide to join this activity, but it is too late. I think, "The tornado is becoming weaker. I should jump aside at the last moment." I'm grasping a tree, and a young man is also holding in. One tornado moves directly toward me, but becomes too weak to reach me. Another more stable tornado is moving on the right of me. I stretch my arm toward it thinking, "I need at least to experience the next one," but I feel nothing. So everything has ended. People talk with each other and are relieved. No one was injured; nothing was destroyed. Some people say there were six tornadoes, but I know there were seven. The young man is standing near my. His tennis shoes are marred with blood. I see blood on my white shoes as well. I guess that it is my blood. I take off my shoe and see a liquid-filled blister on my big toe. I press the ground with my toe to let the liquid out. It doesn't hurt. I am calm. A doctor tells me what needs to be done, but his words don't register.

(repetitive dream) [I have had this dream several times, or ones like it.] I am talking with a girl, Marina, who lived in the house where I grew up. We are talking about the death of someone I did not know, a total stranger. At the same time, I sense very strongly that it is somehow directly related to me, and I experience very intense emotions of guilt and hopelessness. At the same moment I realize that it has nothing to do with me. I realize that I am in the neighborhood where I had grown up, the Moscow suburbs with beautiful weather and old wooden houses. At times there is the feeling of being in a terrifying fairy-tale. But I also experience a feeling of deep contentment for work well done.

(clairvoyant dream) An acquaintance and I are being drafted into the army. I am very happy. A company commander is welcoming us solemnly and with kindness as long-awaited guests. [We look like a warrant officer in waking life with whom I was on very good terms.] We are talking for a long time, and the commander says that there will be a soccer game that night. We go to an enormous green field with tall grass. I began to play soccer as a forward, easily and effectively. I felt enormously satisfied although I did not score goals. I have a feeling that I am playing alone, but at the same time, someone invisible passes me the ball and someone else invisible interferes with me. Somewhat to the left, on the opponent's part of the field, I see an enormous hole in the ground, two meters in diameter. I think, "What if I run into it with a ball? And I had another thought: "How can I run? I have a knee problem and can hardly walk." Then I look at my left knee and see that it is wrapped with an elastic bandage. After the game, the commander praises us and takes us somewhere in a card. I am sitting near the driver. We are riding along a winding road.[At this same time, my wife felt a severe pain in her left knee, and became aware that her knee really hurt. She said to me, "Andrei, take away this pain." Afterward, her pain disappeared.]

I am inside our apartment with my mother, father, and brother. We are eating and drinking together. Suddenly, there is a noise in the hall. It seems that a group of prisoners has broken out of jail. My family locks the door and hides in different parts of the apartment. If our home is destroyed and if our valuable items are stolen, at least we will save our lives and can start again.

I am flying in the sky. I feel that I must fly higher, and I seem to know where to go. I fly upward in the dark sky, totally without stars. Then I see that in the sky, there are two horizontal plates, 30-50 centimeters long, totally without support, parallel to each other. Electric lightning-like discharges spark between them. I know what I must do. I fly up to the plates, place my left hand on the lower plate and my right hand on the upper plate, and press them together with great effort. They gradually come closer to each other and finally connect. I feel very happy and inspired. My goal has been accomplished! I wake up with a feeling of the enormous significant of the dream.

(lucid dream; dream within a dream) In my dream, I am sitting in an armchair and watching television. It's late night or early morning. I notice that the door to the next room is open, and the room is dark. A feeling of anxiety comes upon me. Something is wrong. Suddenly, a midget, about 40 centimeters tall, comes out of the darkness. He is blue and luminous. I'm frightened, and feel like a child who can't escape. I don't know what to do and then realize that I'm dreaming. I want to wake up and start screaming. I know that my parents are sleeping in the next room and that if they hear me they will come and wake me up. Then I wake up in my bed, my face to the wall. Suddenly someone comes up from behind and takes off my blanket. I understand that I'm not yet awake, and that a terrifying shadow-like entity is behind me. This shadow starts suffocating me with the blanket. I'm in pain and cannot breathe, but I try to scream. I can only utter unintelligible sounds, like the crying of a newborn. It lasted for several minutes until my mother to my room and woke me up. Now I really was awake, and couldn't get back to sleep for a long time because I was in fear.

I am sitting at a table in a gray windowless room, a Spartan-looking room, undecorated and unfurnished, with unpainted cement walls and ceiling. A cup of black Turkish coffee is on the table. I take the cup and splash coffee against the wall. A coffee strain spreads. I realize that I've done something wrong. A human form gradually comes out from the stain; he moves slowly but persistently. I run away from him and find myself on a staircase. I go up the stairs, look down, and see that he is following me. It is night, but I can see everything. It is a cement grey building, four stories high, without windows. I see that I can't climb down the building. But I realize that I can fly. I jumped and flew from the balcony. I looked back and seethe monster on the balcony, but he can't get me because he can't fly.

In my dream I am in Novosibirsk Bay. There are cold rocks and a calm sea. I remember that two ships once collided there. I can imagine how they moved toward each other. Clash! People falling into the water. I don't understand why they drowned; the shore is so close. Then I explain it to myself: they panicked. This explanation doesn't seem satisfactory, but I stop thinking about it. Then I see myself running to the edge of a precipice. I must jump down and fly. It's frightening, but I jump. At the first instant, I feel fear and a sensation of falling. Then I am flying. I know I am flying but I don't feel it. Far away, in the middle of the bay, I see an astonishingly beautiful, radiant blue patch of light. An enormous water column surges up from under it, also radiant, blue, and astonishingly beautiful. I rush to it (and wake up).

I was walking in the street on a summer day, and saw some people. There was an unfamiliar girl with them who was wearing a dark, wine-colored pants suit. I came up to her and asked her name. She said "Tanya." Then I told her that I had a problem relating to women. I only wanted to have sex with them, not a real relationship. When I finished telling Tanya my story, I took her hand. But she dissolved, and finally her hand dissolved too.

(initiation dream) I see a large room and a man sitting on the edge of a windowsill. There is also some kind of a medical device or apparatus there. I am tying on a table, but I am a little boy in the dream. I am undergoing a surgical operation. A rusty shell-splinter is being removed from the left side of my chest, slightly below my collarbone. The man and the woman who are operating on me are both about 30 years of age. The woman behind forwards me, strokes my ear, and says, tenderly, "Poor little devil." On one hand, all three of them are ordinary people; on the other hand, the inner spiritual beauty shining through them is astounding. (This dream totally changed my life. After the dream, I said to myself, "I'll do all I can to see such beauty in people.")

I am surrounded by a stone fence. I am locked up. Only grass and high stone walls are around me. The sun is shining. The fence is made of white stone. I want to break free. I decide to dig under the stone wall, but a passage appears by itself. It is a very strange passage, a very deep and narrow passage. I think, "What an idiotic way to make a passage. It is actually a tunnel to America!" Then I see some water on the bottom of the passage. The water is crystal clear and clean. Then some kinds of machines appear which begin demolishing the wall. The are like bulldozers but they are made of white-enameled metal. They don't have sharp angels, and at the same time they are like a streamlined sports car. Soon, the wall is destroyed.

I am walking but suddenly I can't move. I try very hard. I strain myself trying to move my legs. I try to walk faster. It is all useless. It is all in vain, as if my feet are stuck in sand or quicksand. I feel helpless, irritated, angry, and frightened.

In my dream, I saw the sun. A sword was driven deeply into the sun, up to the hilt. I knew that the sun was God. There were also clouds that touched the sun but did not cover it. I had a camera with me and was able to take a picture of the sun. That way, I knew that my experience was real, and that God is real.

(lucid dream) I encountered a woman, and asked her to become a part of me. When it happened, I felt pressure in my upper chest, a lump in my throat, and I burst out sobbing. I was lucid, and thought that this was an attempt to attack unity with the feminine part of myself.

In my dream, I am walking along narrow city streets, being led by a female guide. I come up to a tall tower. It is made of white, fog-like material, and no entrance is visible. The tower-top is obscured by clouds. I follow the woman and enter the tower through fog-like stone, and we begin to ascend it together. She wants me to hurry because little time is left. We stop at one of the tower tiers; it looks like a large hall with transparent walls and a transparent floor. There are many people below, including an old man, and something is happening there--I can sense a wave of anger, indignation, and irritation. I feel I must do something and the woman points to the wall; I see the same tower outside, far away. I bring it closer in my view and see a man who looks like me. I call him loudly but he doesn't hear me; his attention is on something else. I try to see his eyes, and "flow" into him. I want to merge with him, to penetrate his very depth. But the woman puts her hand on my shoulder and breaks our connection. The dream dissolves.

I found myself in the house of my former teacher. I went through the rooms and saw three women talking, and knew that one of them was my teacher's wife. And I saw four or five girls playing in the room and somehow I knew that some of them were my teacher's daughters. Then the teacher turned to me and said, "You had better turn back to your father and take care of him. He has been drinking too much cognac during the past period of time." Suddenly I felt that it was true. In a moment I remembered that I had noticed this habit of my father's, and that our relationship was no longer very warm. Then I felt myself in the street looking back at the house of my teacher and thinking, "Well, now I know where he lives." (Actually, I had never been in his house.)

I'm standing in the street, waiting for a female acquaintance who promised me she would help take some of my things to another place. Then I decided to check on the car, to see that it had not been stolen. I looked around, and there were no people and no cars in the street. My female friend never showed up. But when I got home I found her there talking with my wife.

I'm going on a business trip to the Kursk province and somehow my mother-in-law is supposed to be there. I've arrived at a hotel where I stayed once before, and I'm assigned room #31. I enter the room, choose my bed, put down my luggage, and notice that there are a lot of things I had carried. Most of them were red-colored blankets, like those my mother-in-law has. When I put everything down, they turned out to be stacked high, like a wall, and I could hardly get to my bed. Then I woke up (in the dream) and didn't see what I had brought with me. Instead, I saw someone sitting on the edge of my bed; he told me that I'm in someone else's room, although everything looked like my mother-in-law's room, especially the wallpaper. He told me my things had been taken out of the room. Then I met my mother-in-law, and she lived in the same hotel, but in a different room. We talked, and she left. Then I discovered my clothes were missing; I only found my underpants. Suddenly I was in a bathhouse; most of the people there were naked but some were wearing winter clothing.

I am riding on a horse toward some destination quite far away. We have been having a very difficult ride through a dangerous road, and I feeling some fear and anxiety. I do not know if we made it safely to our destination. But the horse was very loyal to me and did not betray my trust.

In this dream, I am flying at a very high altitude over a road in India in a mountainous region. I am flying on some apparatus, looking like a bicycle. I need to land on this road but I am unsuccessful. The road changes into a snake -- a stone snake looking just like the Great Wall of China. The episode with the unsuccessful landing repeats itself three times.

(repetitive) I move to a new flat. It is a very big flat, much larger than my flat in waking life. And it is a rather strange flat. The furniture is covered with sheets. I move around the flat. I am surprised with the amount of space. I always wanted to have a big flat, but this flat is so huge that I don't even need so much room. Somebody tells that "This flat does not belong to you" and answers that I am a co-owner and have the other owner's permission to use this flat. I have a peaceful feeling but also a sad and anxious feeling as if the owner of the other part of the flat will come and take it back from me.

(repetitive) (The content of the dream may be different, and the characters may be different but there is a recurrent episode.) I am going somewhere, but I can not move. I try again. I try to find support on the ground for my feel. I try to increase the pace. It is all in vain. My feet are as if they are stuck in something which gives way. I experience powerlessness. I am irritated, angry, and scared.

(initiation) I dreamed about some deities who told me that I needed to transform myself to become a healer. It seemed as if I died, and then I was reborn again. The deities told me that I needed to advance one more level, to learn about external kindness but also to be kind to myself. Once I learned this lesson, I would be able to start healing people. I went through three cycles of death and rebirth, and when I awakened felt that my initiation was complete.

I dream that I am back in time when my grandmother was a teenager. I observe the village where she lived much differently than I have ever seen it before. It feels very strange to observe my grandmother as a young girl. A man in the village has romantic intentions toward her and they start to flirt a little bit.

I die in this dream but still am aware to a surprisingly large extent. So I go out of my body. From a higher perspective, I can observe my corpse. I stay out of my body, and after I while, I am happy to enter the afterlife.

I am thinking about how to bring some money into the family to pay our bills, many of which are overdue. Suddenly the dream becomes lucid and I think I will focus on this problem from a "higher level" where I can actually influence the results through my conscious intention. So I do this until I wake up.

I enter a house that I have never been in before. It is ancient, dark, and gloomy. Suddenly a vampire appears, and then another one. Then monsters appear. It is like I am on the set of a horror movie, but I know this is serious business and I fear for my life.

I am in a strange, old house, I become caught in a trap of some kind and can not move. Suddenly some rats appear. They come to me and sniff around my body. Then they start to eat my flesh. I am in terrible pain and can do nothing about it.

I am in a submarine with a crew. I am getting out on the deck. It looks like a thunderstorm is about to strike. We are expecting a storm, but suddenly a light rain starts. However, heavy closed are still everything. The submarine seems to be "beached" on the ground for the time being.

I am in the middle of a war. I see mountains even though it is nighttime, and the stars are shining in the sky. I hear shots, and suddenly everything is in flames. I am in a column of marching men. The column is small because I am told that almost all of these men served Russia in its war against the Chechens; those who were shot, and who died of their wounded, are commemorated in this monument.

I am sitting in a car which is covered with snow. It seems that it snows heavily in the place where I have found myself. Suddenly the car starts shaking, and the wipers are turned on. I see a werewolf out there. It shouts, "Open the door! I need to overturn the car, but you won't be hurt." I know that this is a lie, and try to go back a different way.

I am with several women, who are strangers to me. But they are very attractive, and soon we all start to have sex. Right in the middle of our sexual party, I wonder if my wife will ever hear of this. I keep thinking about the consequences if my wife discovers what I have done, and I lose my sexual desire. Finally, I give up, and I leave.

I am about to have intercourse with a woman who is a stranger. She has a handkerchief over her face. I take the kerchief off and discover, much to my horror, that this woman is a witch. I lose all sexual desire, and try to escape the situation as quickly as I can.

I am in a labyrinth. I am walking along it, and there are many turns. I am afraid, but there is no reason for these fears. I know that I have to only walk forward and that I can not look back. So on continue on my quest unafraid.

It's night. The streets are unfamiliar. Someone is chasing me. I am running, and remember that I can fly. But I have to concentrate in order to overcome gravity. I get to a higher spot and fly off, but my legs are close to the ground. Someone tries to grab my legs to ground me, so I immediately try flying again.

In this dream, I am walking along a shore on a path. Suddenly, I slip and fall into the water. I try to find a handhold and cling to something so that I will not be swept away by the current. But I feel a shock of falling on to a large rock. (When I wake up, I find I have fallen out of bed.)

I am flying around my apartment. I realize that I am dreaming and I pause to consider how unusual this state of affairs is for me. It is a very pleasant experience, but it is hard for me to get to a specific part of the room by giving direction to my flying.

I am in the Vietnam War as a solder. My battalion and I are walking in the jungle. Water is all around us, and I hear shots. I am on the American side, not the communist side, so the communist Viet Cong are shooting at us. We avoid the Viet Cong, but I am afraid of running into crocodiles. Those who are wounded disappear into the water, and I know the crocodiles have eaten them. I am afraid of being surrounded by the enemy or being eaten by the crocodiles.

In this dream, I am at a Metro station in a big city. Suddenly, I am feeling dizzy, waiting for the train to stop. So I go behind a column to steady myself. When the train stops and the doors open I rush into it headlong and grab a seat.

In this dream, two sturdy fellows come up to me at the place where I work. They demand that I tell them the composition of the substance that we produce at my plant. I tell them that I have no idea what the composition is, and this is no lie!

In this dream, I am in the vicinity of my summer cottage. I am walking down a path in a wooded area. Suddenly, I see some coins on the ground. I pick the money up. It is only small change, but I know that I can use it. Then I see more coins, and I pick them up as well.

(repetitive) From time to time I have a dream that I am in a dangerous situation. A man approaches me with a gun. He shoots me in the heart, and he runs away. I think I am dead, but am surprised to discover that I am still alive!

I am back at work in my old job. I notice that I am with several male and female co-workers who I have not seen for many years. We are happy to be working together again, even though the work is quite hard. (In waking life, I have not seen my co-workers in my former job for many years.)

In this dream, I am in the bathroom in my flat. I notice that there is water on the bathroom floor. I look around to find the place where the water leaked through, and I can not find it. I am upset because I know the owner of the building will not send anyone to repair the bathroom for many months.

I notice that a tooth of mine is loose. As I feel around in my mouth, the tooth falls out. I am surprised that there is no pain. Nor is there any blood. I keep my tooth, but know that I can not get it to grow back in my mouth again.

In this dream I am driving a car and feel comfortable doing so. I think that it is remarkable that I am driving a car again, because the last time I did so was two decades ago when I had a car of my own. But I enjoy the driving even though I do not know who owns the car. (In waking life, I do not own a car and have not driven one in 20 years.)

I am making some machinery in this dream that I actually make in the factory where I work. The supervisor tells us that we will finally be paid because the factory is getting some money. We wait patiently, working all the while, but the money never arrives, and we are disappointed. (The same thing happens at our factory in waking life.)

I dream that I am at a computer and am putting games into it. I am surprised that I am programming games instead of business material and economic data. But I am having much more fun with the computer games than I would with the other material.

I am driving a Zil car along the road. I am in the army and this car is being used for military service. But my soldier friends and I stop to enter a bar where a drinking party is going on. We have sex with some of the women there are forget about our military duties.

I am playing a game called "Money." This is a child's game, and I remember that in waking life, I had bought this for my young son to play. But in the game I am enjoying playing it myself, with some adult male friends. I tell them, "at least we can earn money in this game, even if we can't on our jobs!"

I am called up for army service in this dream. I am puzzled as to why I should be called up, as I have already completed my service. I am afraid that there has been some bureaucratic mix up and that I will have to go again. I fear for my life, as I may be involved in military action of some type.

(repetitive, precognitive) (In these dreams I see where I had lost something.) One night, in my dream, I recall that when awake, I had mislaid a rare, old coin. In my dream I determined to search for it. I systematically went through each desk in the house, and even looked under the bed. I found the coin on a shelf in the dream, and I had no idea how or when I had placed it there. (When I woke up, this is exactly where I found the coin.)

I am outside with my mother, father, and brother. We are enjoying the open skies and nature. Suddenly, a gang of tough looking men appears. They are threatening to destroy our home, and the homes of the other people in the town. All of us defend ourselves and our homes as best we can with sticks. But the invaders have knives. They are hitting and striking us with the knives, and we are outnumbered.

My co-workers ask me to join them for an alcoholic drink at the end of the working day. I refuse because of them phrased his offer like this: "Well, you certainly don't want it. Isn't that right?" When I refused the drink, he said, "Well, you're wrong in saying no. I've already had enough and I don't need much alcohol now." Then all of them began to put together a pile of old papers and folders and carried them for recycling. For an unknown reason, they carried them to a place where glass and not paper were usually recycled. One of my co-workers, when he handed the papers to the clerk, said that the papers were not from the office but were his won, and that therefore he was entitled to be paid for the papers.

I'm in a room where a man is lying in a bed. The man is a Tibetan lama and is suffering from an incurable illness. He has a very small body like a newborn baby with strangely curved palms. But is head is like an adult's and is relatively large. He sings mantras, and others listen to him. I'm overwhelmed with great love for him, and come to his bed in this ecstatic state. I began to sing along with him. I do not sing a mantra but a specific sound I am obtaining from him in a consciousness transfer. Then I lose consciousness and fall down. After a short time I raise my head and do not see him or the people. I surmise that he has died and has been taken for a cremation ritual. (Then I wake up.)

I've arrived in Hawaii, but I don't see tropical vegetation. I need to find a place to stay, a hotel. It seems that I need a hotel on a hill, but I don't see a hill. I walk through the streets. I sell a nice-looking hotel on a hill. A man tries to tell me something, but I walk up the hill. It is desolate inside. I walk through the back door into a park. I see a beautiful view from there, just what I think Hawaii should be. I want to take a picture of the bay but the range finder in my camera does not work. And I'm in a hurry.

I'm sitting in my apartment, watching television. I have a hunting rifle in my hands. I'll go hunting tomorrow. I am trying to remember whether the rifle is loaded. It seems as if both barrels should be loaded. Then something strange happens with the television set, as if the image on the screen becomes three-dimensional. Some people step out of the screen and enter the room, and fill it. I step back into the corner and look carefully. All of them are prominent politicians. They begin to move slowly toward me. I want to have the time to jump from the window and fly away, but then I am convinced that I must shoot two of them. Suddenly I remember that only one barrel is loaded. I shoot, knowing that I can't save myself.

I am fishing with my son from my first marriage. The river is large and wide; it looks like the Volga. The bank is steep, about 10 meters high--a precipice. My second wife is standing on this precipice with my younger son. I have a persistent feeling that I'd like to know where my first wife is. I think she is looking for her son. In the meantime, the fish are not biting. Suddenly both our floats go down. It looks like fish have swallowed the bait, both mine and my son's. Together we try to pull the fish out of the water. It's very difficult. Finally, we succeed and we see on the bank one of the fish. It is enormous, a terrible black fish with human eyes.

I walk around the city. I stop at a gap in the street. I see a complicated movement of two swings, moving in two planes, and a merry-go-round. They are continuously in a state of potential collision. My parents are on the swings. The people on the merry-go-round are unknown to me. Someone comes up from behind. It is my wife. I put my arms gently around her neck and have a strange feeling, a mixture of endearment and aggression. Then we hold hands and walk through the gap. My feel slide, and my wife helps me. The day becomes brighter with lots of sunlight, green grass, blue skies, and sensations of joy and freedom. I have not seen the people before but they are not really strangers. We approach the park where there is a lake. I look at my reflection in the lake and do not like it.

(dream within a dream) I see the daughter of my good friend. She is 15-years-old. I see her in a semi-intimate situation with the son of my former boss from a long time ago. I feel some discomfort at being an observer of this scene. I had watched her grow up before my very eyes. I remember that I had some sexually-colored thoughts about her, but not in the dream, in waking life. Then I wonder if I am awake or asleep. I see the boss interacting with me as if I were his son. I recall that his relationship with his own son is very complicated. I see some meetings between the three of us. Then I see myself and the girl's mother in an intimate situation. I return to the initial dream and start swearing.

I see a corridor. The place I am in looks like a hotel. A boy with swollen eyes comes out of one room. He comes up a stairwell, walks down, and out into the street. He walks around the city. An old man appears, hits himself in the chest, and falls unconscious. The boy gets frightened and returns to the building. The door opens slowly from the inside. The boys knocks and cries. The door opens and another boy come out, also with his eyes swollen with tears, but he looks somewhat older. Both of them leave for the city.

I am in a kind of dump or scrap heap. It's a cold day, hard frost. I make my way aimlessly through the dump and enter a cottage in the country. The house in empty although the fireplace is burning. But it's severely cold in the house. Much of this trash can be burned. I go to the attack because I feel there is something nice and interesting there. But I find only trash of all kinds. I try to sort it out. I am under the impression that some things that used to belong to me are there. I feel that I am not needed, useless. I hear someone enter the door and begin to climb up the stairs. I feel fear, and stop looking through the trash. I attempt to hide.

I am on a motorboat, alone. The boat is anchored in the midst of a calm expanse of water. The short is not visible, only something resembling blue mountains can be seen far away. Suddenly, the boat engine switches on by itself. The boat starts moving rapidly. The mountains are coming closer. The boat continues moving in a zigzag fashion. Something has to be done. But I am in a stupor, frozen. There is the noise of a waterfall ahead. I rush to the helm, but it is jammed. The boar, accelerating, plunges into the rapids. I want to turn off the motor. The switch doesn't work. It is too late to jump off the boat. (I awake in a cold sweat.)

My wife and I are in a small airplane. The airplane starts a take-off run. Through the window of an airplane right in front of us, I see a metal structure looking like a hoisting crane's boom. At the same time, another airplane is landing--a dark, huge, cigar-shaped plane resembling a Boeing. Our plane takes off

I come to the apartment of my former wife. The furniture is rearranged, and some unfamiliar clothes are on my ex-wife's bed. I understand that I am not welcome here and will be turned out. Then I see myself in a spacesuit, as a cosmonaut. I'm launched into space by means of a contrivance resembling a boy's giant catapult. I am flying into cold, airless space, and I fear that my oxygen supply will run out and I'll be unable to return. I feel helpless and frightened.

In my dream, I am walking outside. I am walking with my girlfriend. At a certain moment, I take off and I'm flying, not far from the ground. My girl friend does not follow me. She continues walking. I am calling to her. I want her to join me, so that we can fly together. But she says she can't do it.

I find myself in a chemistry class in high school. I come to the lab and meet my teacher there. He and I see nutshells on the floor and start crashing them with the heels of my shoes. Then I enter another classroom and see that it's a cooking class. I meet a woman there with whom I used to study. This young woman shows me a dish which looks like it's some kind of seafood but really it's made of onion. She asks me if I can suggest a way for her to find out what is in this dish. I don't answer her question, but then, as a joke, I say to her that one should taste the dish.

I am at a restaurant where all the customers are men. All of them pretend they are drinking whiskey, playing cards, and talking. It is really not so; they just pretend. Another man comes in, and he pretends that he's hugging a woman, but there's no woman there. For some reason, everyone believes it's improper, and they start to blush, sniff scornfully, and turn away. That man continues to pretend to hold the woman, as a protest. He sits down at a table, orders two glasses of whiskey, and talks with the imaginary woman. Suddenly he gives her a slap in the face. Everyone is indignant, and one man stands up for the woman. The first man draws out a pistol and fires at him. But no blood is seen. I sympathize with the second man.

I'm sitting on the roof of a very tall wooden house. I am not alone; there is someone there with me who understands me completely, my guardian angel. I'm sitting, talking with him, then, with ease, I am jumping down and flying. I'm filled with energy and happiness, and am returning to the roof. This happens several times. Then a male friend appears on the roof. He says, "Don't jump, you'll hurt yourself or die." I see that he doesn't understand and say to him joyfully, "Do you see that star? That is Altair, and it illuminates the way for the souls who are bound for hell." With these words, I jump down and see that the star is flying toward me at a furious speed. And it hits me. Again, I feel strength and happiness.

I am with my older son. I have just awakened, and tell him I had a dream about a river. He tells me he also had a dream. We find ourselves in a kitchen in my old apartment. My father is cooking breakfast -- toast with cheese. A female friend from school comes in and I introduce her. We sit down and eat the toast. And then I really wake up.

I have an invitation to visit a house. It is shaped like a heart. I can tell that a very loving family lives there. I enter the house and I am given a red valentine. It is also shaped like a heart, just as the house has a similar shape. The feelings are loving and kindly.

I am in an empty room. (I have been in the same room while dreaming at least twice.) I try to pass through the wall. It is solid and I can not go through it. This wall divided two spaces into invisible hindrances that it was impossible to overcome. There is a slogan on the wall, "If you are brave, come through it." Mr. Gorin, a business associate of mine appears. Then I wake up. (Later, I ask Mr. Gorin if I can visit his house. When I enter, I see the same wall -- but with no slogan on it.)

In this dream, I read many books in libraries that I have never visited. There were many rooms, and I seemed to go from one library to another. These images repeated non-stop. There were old books and new books, but I was not permitted to take home any of the books I saw. I was told that I must read them in the library.

I am by a river. One of its banks is a swamp, and the other is higher. In the middle of the river, there is a boat with three other men in it. I am standing on the swamp side. There is a wooden canal there, and I'm standing on a plank there. I'm trying to reach the boat, and finally get in. The people indicate that I am not quite welcome. I get to the oars. I start rowing against the current.

I open a door and find myself in the Mesozoic era, in a primordial forest. The forest is dense but there are paths there. The air is fresh. It feels wonderful. I decide to have a run. I see a house and I can run through it. Then I see all my superiors, all women, sitting in this house on a bench. They are merry and laughing. I get embarrassed and run further onward.

I find myself in an anteroom, and I see a limestone statue of a woman there. Such statues were crafted at the dawn of civilization. I understand that this is fate. All my energy is directed to grasp the statue's hand. Finally I've managed to grasp it thinking, "Let them say now that I didn't hold fate by the hand, and become master of my own life."

I am looking into a room from a window and see people who seem familiar from the past. I call to them. They smile; we chat. I have a strange feeling, like nostalgia for the past. I'm finding familiar features in the rooms. I peek in one of the rooms and see another life situation from my past. Everything is so realistic. In another room, I peek quickly enough, then immediately I gout and see an elderly person. I ask him a question, "If the rooms are the past, what is here?" He shrugs somewhat dazedly, looks at me, and says, "It's the archives of time." I realize that the rooms showed real past life situations, and there were other rooms different possible development of events.

I'm hurrying to the river in the cottage area. It consists of tiny slices of land and huge cottages. The streets are like some maze. From time to time, stunted firtrees appear. The river comes down from a terribly high san fall, and there are some dump trucks dumping sand from the fall. The water is very clear and ankle-deep. I walk through the water, admiring the gleam on the bottom. Ahead of me there are some children. Suddenly, one of them begins crying and jumping on one leg. All the others begin crying too. I see that the bottom now consists of glass splinters, bottles, jars, tin cans. I cut up my legs badly; blood is spreading through the water. I try to go to the shore but the water becomes thick and muddy. It's possible only to go downstream. I see big openings in the bottom of the river and hope I won't get caught in them. Despite this, I try to reach the shore and care only that sand won't get into the cuts.

Under strange circumstances, my girlfriend fell from a tree and perished. Arriving on the scene, I found a lot of matches and mismatches, as if this were a hoax. All the people, males and females, in the dream were friends of mine in waking life. But the details did not make sense. There was a falsification going on. I became highly emotional.

I'm walking. There is a crown in the city square. A singing contest is going on in the center of the square, and a car will be the prize. The mark on the car is something like "Cherokee" but it is a little bit larger. I had come to the square to meet my friend. But I entered the contest. And finally I win the car! The car was tawny with a dark cerise stripe. The design was certainly class. I peaked inside! The back seat was like a sofa, and the front seats were super modern. I went home and visited a store on the way.

I am on a battlefield during a war. I'm running, shooting enemies, and throwing grenades. Suddenly there is a blast in front of me. I fall and feel hot blood pouring on my head and neck. I get a first-aid kit and bandage my head, but doing this I pay attention to my hands. They were wounded; I could see the bones and ragged flesh. I run to a quiet place. I get some thin cords with cross bars from the first-aid kit, and begin to superimpose them on my fingers. After that, these sticks entered into my fingers like roots, and my hands were healed. They were like new.

I met a girl when walking down the street. We went to some concert, and there some people carried amplifiers to play loud music. Then I am standing in front of a door. A man approaches, carrying something heavy. He asks me to open the door for him. He comes in, and I am waiting to close the door. But there is another man inside saying, "Don't worry; close the door." The first man only enters the door but never leaves it; he goes in circles. I ask, "Guys, where is the concert?" The man explains that Alena Apina (a popular singer) will perform, and she will sing jazz. At once, Alena Apina goes out from this door, humming something that rhymes. She leaves, and I watch her. I want to tell the man that she is a mediocre singer, but consider this inadvisable in the presence of so many of her fans.

(repetitive dream) I dream repeatedly that I am riding the Metro. Moreover, these dreams are fantastic in nature. I'm not simply going through the train. Most of the time, I go through passages from one Metro station to another. These passages are incredibly beautiful, more so than the Metro stations in Moscow. They are long and tangled, looking like mazes. It is all right to go through them and admire them, but sometimes I get tangled in these mazes and can not get out of the tunnel. I wander in the tunnel. How terrible it becomes, particularly when I hear the noise of a train.

I am in my home. I put on my blazer. I look for my pen and pad thinking I will write a letter to President Yeltsin. Suddenly my aunt enters the room. I don't want to deal with her. I take my younger sister and go outside. We are going to the grocery. Everything begins to transform. My sister disappears. I feel as if my body is shrinking. I see a Japanese man explaining to an unknown girl the rules of karate fighting. Then he takes out of jackknife. I expect him to do a hara-kiri but instead he begins to carve some signs or hieroglyphics on his belly.

I find a bar on the table with numbers on it and try to measure the table with this bar. To do this, I start to roll it over the surface of the table making marks on the table. I count 20 lengths of the bar and realize that the table is 6 meters long.

I am in a hallway in an apartment house. A young woman who I do not know enters the hallway alone; I assume she is coming back from work. Suddenly a man comes out of nowhere, and grabs her. He tears off her clothes and starts to rape her. I am horrified. But I know I will be in danger if I try to come to her defense, so I just stand there. I look for a door so that I can escape and call the police, but I do not see any.

I am in a room where some men and women are eating at a table. On the left there is a women who I only met yesterday (in waking life). She has a saucer and a tablespoon in her hands. She puts vegetables or something like them, on my plate. They look more like mushrooms, as when I inspect them they are light brown. I see a porcelain plate with a yellow top in front of me. I feel my heart beating as I continue to eat.

I am walking down a street. The toes of my right foot catch on something solid. It seems that I falter and begin to lose my equilibrium. My body leans forward, but I manage to keep my equilibrium. I look around but can not see what my feet caught themselves on. So I just keep on walking.

I am sitting in the waiting room of a small railroad station with a low ceiling. The walls are dark blue. The building is made out of wood. It is evening, probably in the summer. I notice shades of light, so the setting is not somber. Yet I have a feeling of depression, and I sense it with the men and women too. All are strangers in this station. I sense that the train is about to arrive, but I really do not care.

I am with one of my former colleagues, a woman who is about45 years old. I do not like her. She is sitting to the left of me at a table and is slicing a red tomato. I know that she has been fired from her job, and I want to ask her about the circumstances. But I am afraid that she will turn on me with the knife, so I just leave her along.

I am with two people in a strange room. I know the second person. He is a friend of my son. But the other man is someone who I do not know. The friend of my son is writing something. This all seems to be taking place in the United States, not in Russia. (My son is going to school in the United States.)

I dreamed of a lovely young woman in a far away city named Chita. And in my dream, we were married and had a son. I see myself walking with my son in Moscow, and we passed by the buildings in Red Square. Our family was very happy in the dream. (I was unmarried at the time of the dream.)

I am in a large room. It is lit by inside light. The clothes of the men and women indicate that it is not very warm. The room is spacious with a high ceiling. It is partitioned with a table, and all the actions happen on one side of this table. There are several people participating in a conversation, most of the musing only gestures, facial expressions, and nodding "Yes." The main participant is a corpulent woman, about 45 years of age, a low-level bureaucrat, an "apparatchik." She wears a dark, formal dress. She works at a scientific laboratory which, in the dream seems to be in the town of Iksha, near Moscow. The table in front of me is a typical laboratory table, high and wide. On the front it is covered by pieces of wood and on top covered by brown linoleum. The woman says that the management of the Iksha branch of the laboratory must be changed. She speaks for a long time to make her argument. The others do not participate in the conversation. Then I see the chief manager of the Iksha branch. He is about 60 in the dream. He is well dressed in a black shiny suit, and a necktie. He does not respond to the conversation.

I am in the Donestsky monastery in Moscow. I enter a large hall with many tombs and monuments in it. Suddenly, one of the statues gets up and approaches me. It turns out to be the statue of Stalin. It shakes my hand and says, "Thanks very much dear Eleanora Ivanovna, that you do not condemn me too much in your lectures on the history of the Soviet Union Communist Party."

I'm in a tight built-up suburban area and need to find a way out. I find myself in a house where an elderly couple lives, a man and a woman. It stands on a riverbank over which is a natural bridge or embankment. My aim is to cross the bridge and get to the hills on the other wide that connect with freedom. It is dangerous to cross the embankment but it is possible. A small mechanism in the embankment's center picks up nearby rocks and grinds them into dust. The movement of its blade and the rock mashing is unmovable. The mechanism picks up huge rocks and throws them toward our side. The rocks fly in disorder. I feel danger but it is useless to run away. I ask the elderly man, "Who are they?" He says, "They are fate." The bombardment stops. The elderly woman decides to go to that side where she is met by some figures who hold a weapon which is like long sticks, with different tips -- maces, blades, hooks. One of the figures and the woman fight. The woman wins. The figure falls down. The elderly man wants to dodge the figures, but goes down. The figures catch him and beat him with sticks. But he does not seem to suffer very much.

I could not start my car, so I started out to walk to my home and met a woman who going the same way that I was. But she began to walk in another direction. Then I decided to check on the car, to see that it wasn't stolen. I looked around, and there were no people and no cars in the street. I was waiting for a while longer and then went to see the woman. When I arrived she was already home and was drinking tea together with my wife and my daughter. This woman said to me that she took a shortcut on the way home.

There is a swing. I find myself on the swing. The swing is very wide and also very heavy. There is a cross piece. I make the full turn around the cross piece. I want to stop the motion but I cannot do it. I am very frightened when I can not stop the motion.

I'm a prisoner in a Siberian castle in a remote area. My two jailers want to kill me. I am free to move around the building, but know there is no place to run. A little bald man who I do not know tells me that I will be killed tomorrow. He laughs at me and leaves his office. I look through his desk and find a gun but no bullets. I look further and find a few empty bullet holders as well as one with bullets in it. I put the bullet in the gun. I know I must kill the little man, and the other jailer who is a bigger man. I hide behind a door and wait. The door opens and I throw myself against the little man, put the gun to his head, but he escapes. I run after him, knowing he will lead me to the big man. He hides in a room, but I find him as well as the big man. Suddenly I realize my gun is very light. I shoot and hear shots from a toy gun. It has been transformed. I run out of the castle into a forest. There is really no place to run. I want to call the police and have them rescue me. The two men run out and shoot me. I realize I am dead. But I am transformed into a guest of an U.S. movie star!

I am opening a door and see another door behind it. I open the second door and see a third, and then a fourth. Then I am in a swimming pool, surrounded by other swimmers. The water is very warm. Everyone in the pool is quiet and calm, both men and women. I realize that people are disappearing, one by one. They swim to the corner of the pool and disappear there. I realize they come here to die. I am horrified. The ones who are left are telling me it is pleasant and painless, and that there is peace and comfort on the other side. Then they swim to the corner and disappear. And they don't seem to be scared. They do it out of their own free will. Now I am alone in the pool, slowly moving toward the corner. I am very scared. I am paralyzed. (I wake up in fear.)

(precognitive dream) I was in a city far from home. I was walking down the street with tall buildings on each side. I saw a beautiful woman approaching me from a distance. As she came closer to me, I could see her face. She smiled at me and I fell in love with her. I wanted to marry her and have a child with her. (A short time later, I saw the same woman in my graduate class in St. Petersburg; we are married now.)

I see a wall of a log frame just in front of me. My eyes are lifting up and stop on the space between the wall and the ceiling. Next, I see the ceiling from the outside. There are large chinks between the ceiling logs. The ceiling and the logs are a bit rotten, and some of them are totally rotten. In one part of the ceiling near the corner there are not two logs but a hole. In place of the logs there are two rotten parts of logs. I see the light inside--bright and yellow--the logs are joined with very thin staples.

I am talking with a little boy who was born in the Orient in1945, four hours before the end of World War II. Now he is in his forties, and gets a confirmation that he was a war veteran. He did not grow up. He has a grown man's face on a child's body, and is still bothered, while awake and while dreaming, by bombings and the roar of airplanes which he has heard from even before birth.

There was a new little girl in our car. At first I didn't know who she was, nor was I overly concerned. I just assumed she was part of the family. Soon I was sitting in the back seat; dad was driving and I asked him and mom about the girl. They casually told me it was their child. They didn't seem to show a strange emotion; it was treated as an ordinary event. She was about six and had been in India all this time. She was very bright, expressive, and assertive. None of my brothers or sisters knew about her either. My feeling was one of confusion, pity for the girl because she had to be sent away, pity for dad at having to raise another child all over again, and pity for mom especially. I was trying to remember what year they went to India, and when mom may have been pregnant, and so on. I was attempting to understand the chronological and practical aspects. There was another child of theirs who was still in India and they were soon going to get him over her. It seemed they felt he would be a burden.

A small mouse was the director of the vegetable warehouses. I had to get something from the director but some kind of a conflict took place, and it was funny to me that I was arguing with a mouse. Then I was chased by someone. It seemed like the 17th century. I felt I was in danger. My wife and I were looking for some treasure. I had a cardboard box in my hands with a device looking like a television set that could show what was happening behind an opaque wall. She and I were riding horses along a labyrinth. I went ahead and she was falling further behind.

I'm riding a car with my father and my husband, but do not think he can pass the border control. I think that I need to call my husband's parents. We pass several cars on the highway. My father stops the car and gets out to look at the tires. He asks me to look, and I see that one tire is flat. I say that we do not have enough time to change it. Shortly thereafter we barely avoid an accident, a collision with a blue car. We continue driving, and the highway turns into a corridor. A man is running along it; we keep nudging him with the car bumper. We come to a place filled with lights. I realize that we are close to our goal. I tell my father. He steps on the gas and we drive very fast. But then a noise wakes me up.

I am in my room in an old semi-ruined house where I grew up. But it looks older than the actual house where I used to live. It has been turned into a magic school. I suspect that something terrifying is going on there. My grandmother takes me out of my room and out of the building. I find myself in the magic school. I am in a different world. This is a city, and many people I know are there. Light lives in the city. Also playfulness, diligent work, and humor. I feel relived and happy. I am where I always lived. I know that special teachers are also here somewhere. There will be a right time to find my place in this structure. But right now I am watching exercises in learning how to fly. Then my husband appears. He has been a member of this school for a long time.

I'm about to leave for America to study. There is a group of us, but I know I've turned out to be in the group by accident. I have little time to pack, and am surprised how few things I have for my plastic bag. I think, "I'll buy everything I need in America. "I leave twice, the first time by bus with the group, and the second time by car with my Dad. An American is to ride with us on the bus; I try to get close to him to talk and smile. I think of being unfaithful to my husband in America; after all, it's faraway and no one will know. We are about to leave for the airport but I want to eat some pirozhki for the last time. I get ten rules from the American and some more money from someone else. I know that I have lots of money and it will be enough to buy pirozhki for everyone. I run into the cafe but can't get to the counter to buy pirozhki. Besides, they don't look appetizing.

I am walking by a neglected building. It looks like a dormitory. Two or three black men are standing in front of each entrance and talking. I sense that one is staring directly at me. I sense something is wrong and start walking faster, but they run after me. I can't get out through an opening between two stone columns and I'm terrified. Then I try to fly above it. Somehow I get beyond that entrance and find myself in an adjacent yard. Everything changes. A melodic female voice is reading a text that predicts a future disaster--icy winds which will come to Europe from Asia, and the oceans will be overpopulated by sharks. I see about a dozen blue sharks and being to wake up from fear. While waking up, the dream becomes lucid and I dissolve the sharks. Finally I see one giants shark with its characteristic smile, and know this is a generalized symbol of a shark. I wake up completely, happy that it was a dream.

I am in Kiev, my home town, walking around downtown and see my friends about to go hiking in the morning. We enter a park together and the mountains are right there. I walk with them for a while but my footwear is not suitable. I would fall to death in the mountains. With regret, I part from my friends and see my father. He and I are going to return a rubber boat we rented. The store is in a palace in which a fair is taking place with many souvenirs and sweets being sold. I enter the store to return the boat and my father is waiting for me. When I come out, he is not there. I run into the chief of police who tells me I am not a child, and can return home by myself. I am surprised to hear such a simple idea that had not occurred to me.

My girlfriends and I are walking along the street. We see gypsies and decide to keep our distance from them because nothing good can come from interacting with them. An old gypsy woman comes to me and tried to draw a black cross on my neck. I yell and push her away from me. I sense that she is a witch, and would bewitch me. But she yells that she wishes only good for me. I don't believe her. I see myself and my girlfriends in a room with three gypsy men. They say they are involved in charity and give gifts to people. A man with a mustache gives a bag of pork to one girl, and bag of potatoes to another girl, and a package of white eggs to me. The gypsies tell us that they give presents to other people as well. I give an insincere smile. We are about to leave. The girls take their bags and I take mine. I look inside and all the eggs are broken. I try to think how to preserve them, perhaps putting them in a glass jar. The gypsy expresses his sympathy, saying it can happen to anyone. My friends were lucky that they had pork and potatoes which could not be broken. But I think that my insincere smile caused the eggs to break; insincere behavior is not rewarded.

My husband and I come up to a train and barely manage to board it before it starts moving. Because of this, we find ourselves indifferent cars; he is in the middle and I am at the end. I walk along the train ad see a horrifying picture -- children of different ages have been in this car since they were born. They are untended to and dirty. The car also looks neglected. I dash from one child to another and my soul is breaking. As I enter the car, I see the head of an adolescent, as if the body disintegrated because of starvation. Walking back through the car, I see another head, more terrifying. The train stops at a station. My mother-in-law enters the car and sees the horror. I say to her, "I've been in this car for a long time. My husband doesn't know what's happening in this car." My mother-in-law looks terrified but I'm already accustomed to it. We are walking along this car of the living dead, and see a wonderful creature which suddenly becomes bigger -- a small, white, fluffy bear cub with a small chain on its neck. I want to take it home. Time passes. Then I see the bear grown up but still sweet. Everyone tells me to give it to the circus because it might bite someone, but I want to keep it at home.

My daughter and I are going to an amusement park. We are standing in a line of several people and I learn that today the park has been transformed into a familiar fairy tale, "Thumbelina." Before entering the park, every child receives a plastic-wrapped package that contains a doll and three red roses with thorns. We get beyond the park's fence and I'm surprised to see a landscape of trees and a clear river in which lotus flowers are floating. Someone hands me a white rose without thorns. I smell the rose; it turns out to be natural. I see a big balloon in the sky, and think the ballast should be thrown out in order for it to fly higher. I find myself in the balloon's basket. The ballast consists of bags filled with golden coins, and I begin to throw them out. The balloon starts moving upward. I notice another balloon coming alongside of me and is pulled to my basket. Where the door must have been, an open space has appeared and I see three tall honey jars in the other basket. A man in that other basket says to me that he does not need to throw out his ballast because it has a different essence. I look at my ballast and see that the bags of coins have turned into jars of liquid gold.

My friends and I are in the vestibule of a metro station. We are talking happily. Suddenly I see my husband [from whom I am separated] near the opposite wall. I come up to him and we start talking. I am surprised that his communication has changed so much during the time we have been separated. I feel mutual understanding and excitement of tenderness and affection. I ask why he is different and he points to a nondescript man standing nearby, and says it's thanks to him. Then I ask this man how he managed to change my husband. He says he's a psychotherapist and he used his methods. I express my thanks to him and come back to my husband. He puts his arm around my shoulders and leads me to an escalator to take a train somewhere. At this moment I see a small gray dove on the floor, and feel I have to take it with me. I take in on my left palm and feel how warm it is. I have anall-encompassing feeling of happiness of being with my husband and limitless love. I know we will fly away, with the psychotherapist and the bird. I'm ready to fly anywhere, even to the back of beyond; I have enormous happiness.

My husband and I are at the airport on our way to the sea to spend our vacation. My husband goes to check us in, and I remain to stop at a store. Suddenly I hear an announcement that there are only five more minutes to board the airplane or we will miss the flight. I'm looking for the check-in counter and find that it is about 200 meters from where I am. I get in a car and drive there. Then I find I've left my ticket at home. I live close to the airport, so I find my ticket, and start to walk back. I find myself near an abandoned building. I enter it; a lot of trash is there and windows are broken. I walk down a stairwell until I'm stopped by rusty bars. I hear a sound which frightens me, so I run back to the road and keep walking. I ask a man the way to the airport and he says it is not here. Finally I see a larger road and the airport, but the traffic is stopped. A policeman says the road is closed because all the planes have left. But he lets some cars pass and I try to get in one of them, explaining to the policeman that I have only five minutes to catch the plane. I feel tense and anxious when I wake up.

I am in an unfamiliar apartment and I realize that I've just given birth to a baby. I feel a strong surprise and happiness. I take the baby in my arms. He is warm and pleasant. I place him on my stomach, and enjoy him. I'm thinking that I need to tell my family about this baby, and know my mother won't be happy. This spoils my mood. I look at the baby and realize that his father is not my husband, but the actor Yevgeny Leonov. This surprises me, because I never had intimate relations with him. But I remember his son was very attractive, and I think my son will be attractive too. Several people enter the apartment, some of whom are my relatives. Then my baby is missing. My husband took him to the balcony. I take the baby back and see dark shadows under his eyes. I realize that he is ill, and think that a doctor is needed. The same moment, a strange woman in a hat made from hair comes in. Her collar is also hairy. I hold out the baby to her but she does not examine him. Instead, she starts to examine my relatives. At first I am surprised but then I think it is supposed to go this way.

I dream that my husband is in prison, and I come to see him. But an official tells me that my husband has escaped from the prison. Immediately, I see a train moving along flat country, with many people on it. I know they are prisoners. One of them, my husband who does not look like my actual husband, jumps from the train and runs along the plain on green grass. He is happy.

I see several men in military uniforms who are digging something on a green hill. Suddenly, a round disk-shaped object appears in the sky above them. It looks like a UFO. The men drop their shovels and run in different directions. I see them running in bright, juicy, knee-high grass. Three of them run to the very bottom of a ravine where a school is located. Somehow they find themselves on third floor, and continue running down a spiral staircase circling around the whole school, until they find themselves in a basement. There, they sit down near each other and, breathing heavily, look at each other. I think, "If this is so dangerous, why haven't they warned the children in the school?" The scene repeats itself; the soldiers run down the stairs through the school again, but again don't warn anyone, and again get to the same basement. I shrug my shoulders. They are total strangers. I don't know any of them, and what's happening is like scenes from a movie.

I am in a large department store. I am walking around this store, up and down its floors, and I can not decide what I need. Unexpectedly I stumble at a counter where salads are sold. Two girls and a young man are at the counter selling them. I know that I'm hungry but I pass them by. Then I meet my fired and they give me something tasty to eat. They ask me bout how things are with me, my problems, and other topics. Suddenly a woman appears who in reality lived in the same building' where I lived about ten years ago.
