She looks young but tired. Without my permission, she eats everything from my plate and falls as if in a dead faint. I try to revive her and get very frightened, but nothing works. But now I am not worried about it. I turn my back to her and leave the store, finding myself in a field or clearing.

I dreamed of my school teacher who taught Russian language and literature. [When I studied at school, our relationship was fraught with conflict; she baited and mocked me.] In my dream she is chasing me and I'm trying to escape from her. I'm running, grasping for breath, opening a door, and finding myself in a room. I hear her steps behind my back and I'm frightened. I cross the room and see another door. I open it and run across to another room, to the next door. I sense that she's catching up with me, and I continue running. It goes on for a long time. Finally, I open one more door, run into one more room, and see that it doesn't have a door. I dash around the room trying to find an exist. But there's one. I realize that she's got me any moment. She's running into the room and I have no escape. I'm horror-struck. [At this moment, I wake up.]

I am a little girl of about five years of age. I'm at an old abandoned cement plant where my parents used to work, near the warehouse. A lot of gray, deep, loose cement dust is there. In front of the warehouse there is a stationary train and my dad is supposed to be there. I'm standing between the train and the warehouse. I'm happy and curious, and I peek into a big booth. It's dark inside and I don't see who's sitting there. I expect a dog to get out, and I'll be able to pay it. I come closer and suddenly something black and terrifying jumps at me, on my face and check. I want to call my dad for help, but it covers my face and I'm in horror from my helplessness and inability to do anything.

I am in the kitchen of my parents' house, where I used to live. I want to prepare a meal. I take two sacks with flour and see bugs in one of them, and worms in the other. I want to through the flour away, but then I remember the hard economic situation and think that I can sift the flour. Suddenly, small polecat-like animals appear from somewhere. There are may of them, and they are supposed to eat the worms. But one of the sticks its sharp teeth into my finger. I try to open its jaws and shout, "Eat the worms," but am surprised that the animals didn't eat worms but bit me.

In my dream a black headless chicken is knocking against the window glass. There are bright blue skies in the background. Its blood flows in small streams along the class. Chicken's paws scratch the glass and slowly move to the open window. Mesmerized, I stare at it. I understand that I have to shut the window, and I can't move. I wake up with feelings of fear and frustration that my body does not obey me.

(repetitive dream) I'm a little girl about seven, and my mom and I am walking along the square near the local cultural center in my native town in Kirgiziya. Suddenly my mom is frightened while looking at the sky; she sees a giant fist. I, as a little girl, see this as a whimsical configuration of clouds. But my mother is frightened that this is a sign or an omen. I am fearful and intrigued at the same time. I don't understand if these are clouds or something different. My mother rushes to take me away and leads me with her. I still gaze at the sky and the giant fist as we walk away.[I had this dream as a child, as an adolescent, and later. I am now 34 and stopped having this dream five years ago.]

I am going up an escalator toward a metro station. I carry a huge bunch of pink carnations in my hands. I am so happy that I have these flowers, and I give them to everyone who crosses my path, even to a drink woman. I continue upward on the escalator, still smiling and giving away flowers. Suddenly I see that I have only a single flower left. At the end of the stairway, a man is standing and reaching out for the flower which is now a rose. But somehow I don't feel like giving it away. I hold the stem tightly, and I'm close to despair. His hand is about to close in on the stem, and he says with sarcasm, sneer, and even threat in his tone, "Because of just a rose, you wouldn't" -- he does not finish. But I hear the unsaid continuation "fight" or "beg reedy." But I still hold the flower rightful and am ready to stand up for it until the end. [Then I wake up.]

In this dream, my mother, who has died, came to see me. She gives me warning of some future event. From her appearance and action in the dream, I know that something in my intention is right. She gives me guidance about what to do, and it makes sense to me. I frequently have dreams about my mother, and she often tells me or warns me about future events.

I had a dream that I came to a seminar on holotropic breathwork. There were many people there, and I could not find a spot. Finally, I found a place near the wall and started breathing. I had no sitter. I saw everything happened with me from outside my body, and was inside my body at the same time. Doing the breathwork took me throw a large and long tunnel. I was terror-struck, not fear but terror. I started shouting, calling for her. I wanted to get out of the process but could not. No one helped me. I was forced to walk along this tunnel. I saw some faces and people floating toward me from different sides, and I was more and more terrified. I yelled, and then I lost my voice. I knew that at the end I would encounter something unknown and frightening. I continued to go on and saw something at the end of the tunnel. I was unable to move. Suddenly something happened inside of me. I realized that an encounter with death was ahead. But I no longer was afraid of death. Suddenly, it was very funny and I started laughing. I felt light and happy. The image in front of me started melting away and turned into a skeleton like the one used at biological classes in school--harmless. [I woke up laughing.]

It is a light and sweet morning in the countryside. A wind ripples the curtains at open windows of the houses. I'm walking together with other people along the road. We're animatedly talking about something. I feel peaceful, happy, and airy. Suddenly everything changes. My people including me find ourselves in a dark tower. We are on the very bottom of a deep circular tower without a single window or door, and no roof. It is cold and dirty; the sound of water drops is heard. I sense we are in mortal danger. A lit candle is high up on the wall. Somehow we know that if a child touches the candle with his or her hand, we will be saved. We begin to build a pyramid by standing on each other's shoulders. I find myself on the top of the pyramid, with my son in my arms, and he stretches his arm toward the candle. Little time is left; we are in a hurry. I try to encourage him, even though I am afraid he might burn his hand. He looks at me, and I can read his eyes, "Why, Mom? I'll be hurt." But he continues reaching up, knowing what's happening and that it's the only way to survive. My son has almost reached the candle, but the pyramid has become very unstable and is about to fall down, and no time is left. I am very tense. [I wake up.]

(out-of-body dream) It is night, but the street lamps are lit. Freddie Kruger is chasing me. I'm running from him, and he kills all the women who happen to be on his path. I hide in different houses, in small streets, in vacant rooms, but he keeps finding me. Freddie has dark skin, wears a green hat, has a wrinkled face, and an angry, evil smile. I yell wildly in terror and run away. Finally, I run into a dead end on a beach with a wire-net wall around it. It is now total darkness. Freddie catches me and kills me. As first I am horrified. But then I see myself from outside my body. My body is lying down in blood, and my spirit is near the body feeling good, light, and free. After Freddie killed me, he left the beach.

I dream I am on a hill with my mother, who died years ago, and other relatives including my little son who is four years old. It is getting dark. I'm wearing a bathing suit and feel somewhat uncomfortable. My mother suggests that we walk down toward the river. I firmly refuse because I think this is on a path to the cemetery, and I feel anxious. Instead, we stay on the hill. My mother, my son, and I sit down on the edge of a shallow hole filled with sand, and our feet reach its bottom. I hold my son on my lap. Sometime later we get up and start walking. I sense that we were forced to sit down, but my son did not sense this and was comfortable. The hill was close to the house where my grandmother, my mother's mother, lived when she was alive.

My husband and I have had some guests, and they have just left. There are lots of dirty dishes in the sink. I need to go out, but I must wash the dishes first. I put them in a sack and take them with me. Then I am at a metro station. I am not allowed to take this bag of dishes with me on a train. I throw it out somewhere and board. There are few people in the train, but I stand and there is a stranger near me. I ride the train and look around, then recognize the woman near me, and we start talking. Then I confess that I've left dirty dishes behind, and that they are valuable. I need to go back there. We go back and find the dishes, but some are broken and some are missing, those that are the most valuable and my favorites. But my new acquaintance tells me that she has found some dishes too. I look into her bag and find there everything that I thought I had lost.

I am in an unfamiliar house and see a woman with her face covered with a veil. I ask her to show her face and I ask who she is. The woman slowly uncovers her face and says, "I am death." People near us begin to clown around because she does not look like death. And suddenly the outlines of her ordinary young face begin to change in a strange way, to resemble a man's face. She turns her back to me and I see her develop a strong back of the head, and a muscular arm that grabs a running man and stops him in his tracks. In horror, I run down the stairs and death is after me. I run down one floor, and another. I know that if I get outside where people are, I'll be safe. I manage to get out. I could not calm down for a long time. I recall Hemingway: "Do not ask for whom the bell tolls, it tolls for you."

I am in a high rise building with some people. We are expecting an earthquake or explosion. The building may collapse, and our apartment is very high. It's dangerous. My husband, our children, and I feverishly drop groceries into a bag and run out. There is a man with two children in the apartment next door, and they are not going to leave. I get angry with them; I shout, order them to leave, and warn them of danger. But they are indifferent and stay. With an unpleasant feeling of something unfinished, I go down the stairs. There are guards at the entrance, sturdy fellows. Some kind of water and boats are around the house; a boat takes us to a safe place. A crown of children is playing nearby. They are already safe. Then I am back in our apartment upstairs, but now I have turned into our daughter, Katya, who is trying to catch up with the family. I take two pails of water with me, and go down the stairs, being careful not to spill the water. The guards check my papers, ask questions, and give me a pass. I come out and see water all around. I cross it by walking across a narrow path. Again I see children playing. It's bright, noisy, and happy there. But I'm working, carrying water. A beautiful view is in front of me, as in spring when a river overflows with green fields, bright water, and the sun.

We are having a body-oriented therapy training seminar in a gym that has been set up in my room at home. Tretyekov, a former instructor, and I are given an assignment to do the splits. At first, Tretyekov tries for a long time, then can not do it. Then I do the exercise easily and continue to watch Tretyekov's unsuccessful attempts. Then I hear that my study group-mate Olya is about to conduct a psychotherapy session. A larger part of the group continues to work in my room while Olya, Nadya -- another study group-mate, another woman, and I am sitting on a sofa. Olya does a trance induction for us. She sings something about seeing depths of the sea at a distance, and her voice sounds like a pleasant bell. I go deeply into trance, with some surprise because I did not expect such an effect. Then Olyastops, and her acquaintance -- who is a voice on tape -- continues. The recording resembles an interview about the depths of the sea. I recall a magazine with pictures of the sea, and notice the resemblance. I want to stay in trance, but I come back because the taped voice is unpleasant to me. Also, I know that a body-oriented therapy training continues in the next room.

(past life dream) In my dream, there is an ordinary house. One wall has collapsed, and there is an entrance to a ruined, uninhabited part of the house that no one suspected was there. The space opens and becomes larger. I turn into a seven- or eight-year-old boy, as if I am living a former life. My curiosity has led me to enter that space. I see that some repair is going on. The floor is covered with an even layer of sand, and there is an altar and candles. A man looking like the Frankenstein monster, but with some gleams of feeling, is working on the wall with a mallet. He is a guard. He tells the boy that he can not enter yet. The boy moves toward the altar anyway. The guard yells "Stop!" "Danger!" The guard runs after the boy, making him leave the space. The boy is frightened and runs to his parents' home.

I am given a personal car with keys as a gift. But I don't have a driver's license and I can't drive. I never was behind a wheel, but I sit down and begin to drive. I have been given a car, so I must learn how to drive it. Step-by-step, I get the hang of it. But I am afraid that I might violate some traffic rules, or inflict injury on someone, or that the police will catch me. I make a wrong turn, although I know the way and know where to go. I am delighted that I will soon drive well, that this is my car, and that I will soon be able to go where I want to go. I meet my father and he gives me some suggestions about driving. I want to learn how to drive before I am stopped.

Tom Sawyer and Huck Finn were in my dream. There was a road across a field. My parents were driving on the highway. I had been quarreling with them. Tom and Huck were walking across the field, talking and playing. One of the boys attempted to frighten the other one, as if trying to ambush him. I watch them from a distance, as if they were in a movie. But I feel excited as if I were a child playing a joyful and intriguing game.

A cheerful, elderly man tells me that he has cancer of the liver. I'm frightened by the words, and at the same time I'm surprised that he is smiling. Then, like another frame in a movie, I'm dissecting a liver. I'm amazed, even enraptured, that it's so beautiful. I don't feel squeamish while cutting the liver into layers with a big knife. I'm really enjoying it. I say to my husband, who's standing next to me, "Look, it's so beautiful!"

(repetitive) I am happy. I jump high and come down to the ground. Then I jump higher, and I feel that I can stay in the air. It is such a joy. I push myself up from the ground, stronger and stronger, and at a certain moment I can feel that my body is no longer subject to gravity. I can hover in the air. I can fly! Then I invite other people to fly with me. I explain to them that it's so easy, and I am surprised that they can't do it. And I travel in the air, feeling that it's easy for me to feel light. But I'm always alone.

My father and I are at home. A dead body shows up at our house and we don't know what to do with it. We cut it into pieces and hide it in the closet because we can't take it outside. People and coming and going all the time, and they would see it. We are under great stress, afraid of being discovered. Finally, there is a strange, dangerous situation outside, and so we take the pieces out there. We go to the woods and try to hide them. Something interferes with us doing this. We are afraid that someone will learn about this.

I dreamed that I was giving birth to a baby. It is a difficult birth, but I do not feel severe pain. I look at the baby and can't believe that this is my child, who I have dreamed about my whole life. I have always wanted to be a mother, and finally this moment has arrived. But instead of joy and happiness, I feel fear of the responsibility. Will I have enough love, kindness, and power to bring him up? While thinking about this, I notice that the baby is not moving. I unwrap the blanket and see that instead of a baby, this is a dry mummy. I am horrified, and in the utter panic I lose him. I feel guilty that I have not safeguarded him properly.

In this dream, my mongrel dog had five puppies. Interestingly, all the puppies were pure-bred and were of different breeds. One was a big black sheepdog, much bigger than its mom. One was a white, shaggy poodle, with disproportionately long paws. Another was a long-eared one with a sheared spine. In the dream, my ex-husband and I are living together again, and I am glad this is the case because there is someone to take charge of selling the puppies. At the same time, I am concerned that my ex-husband will remember that we are really divorced and that he will forget about the puppies.

The sky, high above, is yellow -- the color of sunlight. It consists only of sunlight. I can't see the ground. A single, bright green cloud, like one in a child's picture, is in the sky. There is an aerial rope way with one seat. It seems that I am sitting in this seat, or that I am seeing it from the outside.

I'm on an airplane flying to another city and another country in the East. The plane lands. I walk down the ladder, and a short, elderly man meets me and introduces himself as my friend's father. I'm surprised by his attention because I haven't expected it. He takes my two bags and quickly walks forward. I almost have to run after him, he is walking so fast. I ask him, "And where is my friend?" He doesn't answer and continues walking ahead in silence. I ask him again. Then he turns his head, and I see tears in his eyes. "Your friend is God's servant now; he has become a monk, a Holy Father," he answers. I feel considerable pain and sadness that my friend has left his family, his job, and me. I'm running around their large house and garden, looking for him near a swimming pool. His mother and father are very upset. They seem to be angry at me, but they are also sympathetic.

I am walking around the city in the evening and find myself underground. I try to get out. Suddenly, rats appear -- two, three, ten. I'm running fast and run into a well and a large pile of dirt near it. I climb upward. There are more and more rats, and they are climbing toward me, closer and closer to my face. I notice a short shovel, get it, and start smashing the rats. This goes on for a long time. The rats squeak and fall down. I see their red, burning eyes. Step by step, I kill all the big rats, but several baby rats are squeaking at my feet. They are very pathetic, but I can't stop. I can't get rid of the feeling of loathing. I kill them too. A sea of red-orange blood is around me.

(healing) In my dream, I'm walking along the road and see a man coming toward me. When he comes closer, I recognize him. He is my husband. We look at each other carefully. Suddenly, a small black snake appears and bites me on the right side of my neck. I squeeze it with three fingers and it opens its mouth. I squeeze the poison out of it, and try to find a place to put the snake. I find a glass box and open it with great difficulty. I put the snake in. (When I wake up, I am still squeezing my hands. But that action decreases my recurring headaches. I still use that squeeze when I have headaches, but they have almost disappeared.)

(lucid; repetitive) I am in a house decorated with light wood. Some people are entering the house. Someone shouts from the second floor, "What is this?" I see a bloody, cut erdel-terrier on a stair well landing. It is unclear whether or not the dog is alive. It seems alive but I am not sure. (I wake up alarmed, because dreams on Thursday night or Friday morning are supposed to come true, and that dogs in dreams are supposed to mean friends. I thought about this dream all day and in the evening I learned that someone with whom we used to be very close was ill with surgery. The last time I saw him was two months ago, and he was well then. As soon as I heard the news, the dream flashed in front of my eyes.)

(precognitive) I am in a house decorated with light wood. Some people are entering the house. Someone shouts from the second floor, "What is this?" I see a bloody, cut erdel-terrier on a stair well landing. It is unclear whether or not the dog is alive. It seems alive but I am not sure. (I wake up alarmed, because dreams on Thursday night or Friday morning are supposed to come true, and that dogs in dreams are supposed to mean friends. I thought about this dream all day and in the evening I learned that someone with whom we used to be very close was ill with surgery. The last time I saw him was two months ago, and he was well then. As soon as I heard the news, the dream flashed in front of my eyes.)

I am at home. My mother and I are busy in the kitchen preparing food for a celebration. A strange pet rushes in. It is similar to a goose; it runs all over and interferes with our work. It pinches me. I go into another room and it follows me and angrily attacks me. I grab its head and start to tear it off the body. I feel equal to it, and got angry when it attacked me. I think I killed it, and I look at the remains. But it didn't die. It just changed. Now it is very nasty -- wet, bloody, covered with nasty things. I look on it with disgust. I throw it outside and close the door on it.

I am in an unknown place where nature is extremely beautiful. In the middle of a green forest is a castle. I know it well, although I have never seen it. I enter the castle; there are many people around. I feel very comfortable in the castle; I know all about these people, what they like and dislike, and they know me too. I have a boy friend there--a handsome young man who gives me a bouquet of white flowers, a type I have never seen. They smell wonderful. We decide to walk around the castle. The man goes a bit ahead of me, and soon he is with some other women. Then an ugly old man steps from the shadows. He holds a pot and smoke is rising from it. He approaches my lover, and I try to warn him. But he doesn't hear me and the old man throws the pot into my lover's face. Immediately, all the people disappear. The sunlight fades. I can't help but cry. How can I ever find my lover and my own house? I go into a church, and when I come out I discover myself back in my home town.

I am working on an electronics project at a desk. A military man approaches me and asks me to dance with him. He leaves the woman he is with to dance with me. I go to dance with him, and the other woman goes to her desk and gets back to her work.

This dream was very vivid with bright colors. I am going to catch a train. I am standing in the corridor of the station looking out of a window. I see a gray forest, and a gray sky. The feeling is mundane; there are no other colors. I get on the train and see another gloomy scene outside. But suddenly there is a section that opens up that is bright and joyous. I think, "This is heaven; heaven must look like this." Then that section seems to close and the gloomy scene reappears. But I am no longer dissatisfied because I remembered the few minutes of beauty.

I am with another person from our class. A black snake appears and we interact with it, thinking it is part of a role-playing exercise. Our interaction keeps the snake from eating us. We are frightened by the snake. But it can move only 12 millimeters per hour, so we could escape if we needed to. We discuss strategies to neutralize the snake. Then I look into its eyes and discover that he role of the snake is being played by Sasha. I regret that we never had a chance to try our strategies out with a real snake.

I'm in a nightclub. Everybody is watching a film on a large screen. In the film, people dance in the water which is not quite up to their knees. Then I notice the people at the table are all dummies. A girl enters in a pink dress. She laughs and whirls. She runs against another girl who is very much like her. She embraces the other girl who is very pale and starts falling backwards. The second girl is a dummy! I rush to assist the girl, then discover that she is a dummy too.

I am in a railway station. My mother pushes me toward the train. I push her away, and tell her I'll manage to catch the train myself. But when I turn around, I see the doors are closing and the train is leaving. I decide to cling to the last carriage, but it is uncomfortable because my feet slide off all the time. In the middle of the way, the train turns into a trolley-bus. It proceeds without any traffic regulations. It catches up with the earlier trolley-bus, in which my family is sitting. Finally, my trolley-bus catches up with it! Then I see that there are several trolley-buses; the year 1993 is written on them instead of the numbers. People go out of the trolley-bus that I have been following, and I look for my family. A young man comes up to me and gives me money. I don't know what to do with the money because I don't need to buy a ticket; I have reached my destination.

I am trying to get out of the city where I live. I move down the metro stairs, walk across a bridge, and wait for a train. I am not sure where the train will take me, but I know that I have to escape the city. Any place will be better than where I am now.

I notice that I am starting to lose my teeth. I look in the mirror and am shocked to see what I look like without some of my teeth. I am puzzled that there is no blood. But the teeth are on the floor in front of me, so there is no doubt that they have fallen out.

I am thirsty and find a pitcher of water. I pour myself a glass and drink it. It is very good. But then I have to have another glass. I drink that glass as well. I need another glass, and then another. I just can not quench my thirst.

In this dream, I am going to a meeting with an acquaintance. He is waiting for me in a car. But I have to walk through the woods to meet him, and I lose my way. I can not find the familiar path through the woods that I have used so many times before.

In this dream I am flying. I am far up in the air, even though my wings are made of wood. I am enjoying my flight, but then I hear a telephone ringing. I know that it is a call for me from a male acquaintance, so I fly back to my apartment and get back to earth again. I answer the phone.

I am out on the street shopping. I go into a clothing store because I need new shoes. I try on many pairs of shoes because it is important to find some that fit me and some that I like very much. Finally, I find just the right pair and I buy them. (This dream is just about the same every time I have it.)

(repetitive) I am out on the street shopping. I go into a clothing store because I need new shoes. I try on many pairs of shoes because it is important to find some that fit me and some that I like very much. Finally, I find just the right pair and I buy them. (This dream is just about the same every time I have it.)

I am in bed with my husband. Almost immediately, we began to have sexual intercourse. During the sex, I have feelings that are very enjoyable and very erotic. The dream proceeds very slowly, and I have the sense of enjoying every minute of the sex I am having with my husband.

In this dream, I am at a party or a gathering of some sort. There are many people there, both men and women, but they are all strangers. I do not know any of them. I realize that I am standing there naked. I have no clothes on at all, while all the other people are very nicely dressed.

In this dream, a fat, pot-bellied man attempts to court me. He is wearing a uniform and I can tell that he is in the military. He is very persistent in his attentions to me, but he literally makes me sick. I wish he would go away, but he stays to court me and does not leave.

In this dream, my grandfather and my grandmother pay me a surprise visit in my home. I know that they are dead, and I ask, "Has my time already come?" My grandfather replies, "You don't think so, do you?" I reply that I certainly do not. Then my grandfather disappears. I feel a sense of relief.

I am all alone and two robbers burst into my room. These men push me to the wall of my room. They have knives in their hands. I know they want to rob me. I can not escape and I have no place to run. My situation appears to be hopeless. I am terrified and I am trapped.

In this dream, a dog comes up to me, and I start to pet it. Then I notice that my father and my mother are talking peacefully, even though they died many years ago. I know that they are dead, so I simply pay attention to the dog because I know that it is alive.

In this dream, I give birth to a child. I like the child very much, and he is very good-looking, just like a doll. But I know that I was not suppose to have any more children as the family can not afford them. So I look around for a place to hide my newborn baby.

My husband and I are talking about financial matters. My husband and I are discussing the possibility of exchanging our apartment. It is very spacious, but we are thinking of exchanging the apartment for two smaller ones. Then we could rent one of the apartments to bring in additional money.

A man's voice asks me to show him my purse, the place where I keep my money. I had hidden it behind a fence. It is a warm sunny day. A swamp surrounds the fence, and so people can not reach it. This is where I had to put the purse to safeguard my money.

I am visiting my sister in her apartment. The apartment of my sister is very nice. But my sister's apartment is very dark. And there is a huge pile of soil in front of the windows. I wonder what all of this dirt is doing in such a nice apartment.

In this dream, I am a little girl. My mother and I are walking on the edge of a precipice. My mother falls off the precipice and disappears! I am running along the edge of the precipice, shouting for help. I do not hear any reply. And I see no sign of my mother.

I had a dream about my mother-in-law, who has been deceased for many years. But in the dream she is driving a car. It is the car of my husband. My mother-in-law is at the wheel of the car. She is dashingly driving around the city with a very carefree attitude.

I am standing on the shore of a river. My son is with me by this river. Suddenly, without warning, my son jumps into the water. At first I am concerned, but then I see him swimming in the river, and he seems to be doing fine.

I am going back to school. I have already received my degree and never thought that I would need to go back. However, I am convinced that there is something important that I have not learned, and so I decide that I must return and learn what I need to know.

In my dream, my house and my vegetable garden are both flooded. I happen to drop a shoe from my foot, and it disappears into the water. My husband, my female friend, and I move to a road that is located higher than the flooded place. We stay there, waiting for the flood to recede.

I this dream, I am in a clothing store. I really want to buy a fur coat. In the meantime, I buy other clothing that I need, but I can not find a suitable fur coat. Those that I want are too expensive, and those that I can afford, I do not like. So I am frustrated at not being able to buy the coat.

In my dream, I am buying beef in a store. I thought that the store would not have many supplies, so I am very happy to see that beef is available. I look through my purse to see if I have enough money to buy the beef. I do, and I make the purchase.

In my dream, I am going out into the country, intent on picking mushrooms. I see a clearing among the trees. I head toward the clearing and see some mushrooms. On close inspection, I see a giant boletus. I know that this is a kind of edible mushroom, and I am delighted to have found it.

I had a dream that my husband and I were in a big city. There were monumental buildings with granite columns everywhere around us. We went over to one of the buildings and stood by it. Suddenly, the building collapsed. Then we went over to another building and stood by it. The same thing happened!

In this dream, I am eating something from a very big Chinese dish. Somehow, I know that the dish had been painted by Chinese women. I notice that there are several pieces of veal on the dish. The pieces of veal have been prepared Chinese style. I am eating them with great relish.

I am a little girl walking along Red Square with my father who is holding my hand. It snows. The chiming clock strikes. It is NewYear's Eve, and the New Year has arrived. Suddenly, we find ourselves in my grandmother's place, but we are now in a different city.

I'm in a big building near an ocean used to investigate hurricanes. I look through the window on the top floor. There are two men in the same room. They work with different electronic devices oriented to measure the win. I am a guest, and am excited by the bright colors and the force of the elements of nature mixed by a strong wind. I try to imagine how I could paint it. The ocean waves reach the bottom of the building and I can see wet yellow sand when the waves move back. Suddenly two people appear from a wave and walk forward hand-in-hand trying to get as far from the water as possible. One is an adult man in a red raincoat; another is a child in a bright blue raincoat. I call for the other people; one joins me while the other keeps caring for the devices. At that moment a giant wave covers the two people; the adult disappears but the child is on top of the wave. The man at the window tells his colleague to call a lifesaving service. They are both in shock because the other two were taken far from this dangerous area long ago, but came back.

(visitation dream) I'm on a bus, passing through some fields. I'm standing on the bus step, holding the handle of the door. But I don't want to get inside. It's pleasant to travel in the fresh air. The bus turned to the right and a strange dog darted out. It was a common grayish-red dog with a curved tail, but its eyes were not dog's eyes. Something was in the dog's body, something cruel and unkind; it wanted to hurt me. The dog tried to bite my leg. The thing in the dog's body wanted to destroy me. I brushed away my leg from the dog and suddenly it disappeared. At this moment I saw my mother (who died 17 years ago). She looked very worried and asked, "Why did you come here? This is a bad place. Strange things that look like dogs live here." She said that at night they assemble in a horde and look for something to eat. If people fall asleep, the dogs will destroy them. I took my mother's advice and hid myself in a shed, wrapped in some clothes. I heard the dog's howl, and their steps outside. They scratched the door for a long time. (When I woke up, I felt there was somebody cruel outside and didn't want to come out today.)

I dreamed about gypsies dancing, singing, and taking me with them. After a while, I try to run away from them. I bump into a black man. He asks me, "What's the matter?" I want to say something to him, but I can not speak. And after that I run back to be with the gypsies again.

I come into a room, and there is a door. I open the door, and there is another room. In the room, there is another door. I open it, and there is another room with another door. I continue adinfinitum to go from room to room and from door to door. It never ends. (I wake up twice, but as soon as I go to sleep, the same dream continues.)

A woman comes up to me near a kiosk in a shopping area. She tells me that she and her husband came to Moscow from the countryside recently. They are renting a small trailer somewhere in the suburbs, and are paying rent in foreign currency. They live illegally there, without the right kind of permits.

I am in an old, semi-destroyed building, a part of which is underground. There is electric lighting there, and long passages. The men and women who have come there with me look around quickly and say that we should leave, that there is nothing interesting here. But I disagree and decide to stay.

I am walking along the street in a town in the south of Russia. There are old women there who sell baskets filled with mulberries. The mulberries are displayed beautifully. The white ones are on the bottom of the basket, as a background, while a pattern made of red berries is on the top.

An acquaintance of mine is telling me that there is an "intellectual patch" in Moscow. Various interesting people come there and share their thoughts. Then I find myself there. Indeed, there are many interesting people there who approach each other without ceremony. They mix and talk with each other. I also began to mix and talk with them.

I am at home. Suddenly I find that there are snakes all around the next room. They are very beautiful but frightening. I close the door carefully. My son is playing in another room. I know that he likes to look at snakes in the zoo, but I can not let him into the room with these snakes. It is too dangerous.

I am at my girl friend's birthday party. I reach into my hand bag and get candles and candy bars of chocolate. She asks me to taste the salads. In the meantime, she is slicing the sausage. I see a loaf of bread. There is a knife stuck in it. I start slicing the bread.

I come to my dacha summer house and see my husband there and several people who are his guests. They don't pay attention to me. I'm walking around the house, then sit down in my favorite wicker chair, quite close to them. But they still don't pay attention to me. Then I get up and come up to them. I see that my husband is looking at one of the women in such a way that he used to look only at me. I feel uneasy, and I don't know what to do.

I am in an office. I know that an epidemic of a terrible disease has started to spread, but I am sure that it will not touch me. Before that, I was arrested and I struck some boss or chief in the face. But I got away with it and I managed to escape.

My male friend and I are getting into a sleigh and are driving down a tunnel. We find ourselves in a clearing in the woods and see a log hut on fowl's legs there. Near it, there are the people who live in it: Baba-Yaga (a Russian folk tale female character), a cat, and a peasant. He looks like a hobo, wearing a simple padded jacket. All of them are green.

Two boys and one young man set off in search for something. I feel that I am this man, even though I am actually a woman. We leave a Metro station and enter a store. We are indignant that everything is so expensive there. Then we walk some more and come to a lake. We go into the lake. It's very shallow. Then I do something that causes the lake to start filling with more water. From that moment on, I see this young man from without. I see water in the lake rising and I am terrified. I am afraid he might drown. But he is very calm. He says, "Well, there will be a real lake here now. And no other lake exists."

I am walking in the woods and meet a young boy. He takes my hand and leads me along a path. We come to a clearing and there is a house there. The boy's parents live in that house. They are happy to see me. They treat me as if I am their own daughter.

I am at the bottom of a staircase. The staircase has granite steps. Some people are cleaning these steps. On one of the first steps, I see Pavlov's grave. It is directly under the step, but is well marked. They decide to preserve that step, but to do away with the other steps.

I come to a Metro station somewhere in the outskirts of the city. A young man meets me there, and we go together and enter a building. Some people there ask me what I'm engaged in. I show them two cast-iron statuettes. One is a chariot harnessed by a beautiful horse, and with the god Dionysis in it. Another is a chariot with a different god, probably Apollo. Everyone likes these statuettes. Someone asks me to cast such a statuette for him, or to give him one of those I showed as a sample.

Two of my female friends and I are leaving a building. I'm bored. One of my friends brings over a group of guys. Their leader says, "It seems to me we've met before." I answer, "Yes, I also have such an impression" (but he doesn't resemble anyone I actually know). We go to an office in search of a book we need, looking for Room #717 to buy it, but there's no such room. I meet a group of my fellow students; they offer to join us. They say, "Those men are our competitors; they may find that room more quickly and buy all the books." But I laugh and return to the men, believing that I have to look for the book with them. But we can't find the room. I go to the cafeteria, buy some juice and pastry, and sit at a table. Someone shows me the book we were seeking. In the book I see photos of amateur performances and recognize one of the actors. The name of the play is "Creation of the World." Then I realize that I'll have to return this book and continue my search for room #717. A friend, Oksana, comes up and joins me at the table. A woman who knows this building well sits next to us. She says that she'll help us find the room, and we start walking together.

I'm naked, going into a huge lake in high mountains, and swimming to the middle. Suddenly a small boat appears, and there are many birds on it. The boat is rocking slowly as if it's waiting for me. I swim to the boat and, instead of the boat, a huge swan appears in front of me. The swan flaps its wing; I swim behind. Suddenly I fly into the sky and soar like a bird above the lake and the mountains. I merge with clouds and dissolve into the blue of the sky.

I find myself inside of a building which looks like my former school. Several women are staying in a woman's locker room because the school is occupied by fascists, and they don't allow us to move around. Still, I try to get into the men's locker room. But the fascist notices and catches me. He turns out to be a person of high rank. He begins to interrogate me, but I manage to run away. He's running after me, but can't run me down. We keep running with the distance between us staying the same. I can't break away and he can't overtake me.

photos, class pictures that I gave him awhile ago. Then we're leaving the university building and find ourselves in a dense forest. We come to a clearing in the woods. My friend plays a flute and mentions, in passing, that he's the younger brother of one of my classmates (actually, he's older than I am). Then I find myself in the university building again, walk along some long passageways, enter a lecture hall, and see a large picture on the wall--one of those my friend showed me. There is a cupboard at the end of the hall and I find two almonds there, each the size of a palm (of the hand). Suddenly a professor comes in and asks, "What are you doing here?" I say, "Well, I came to collect my almonds." He asks, "And are the shells yours?" I reply, "You don't say. They're not mine," and I run away.

I'm a group of people playing a game. One has to find a hidden fish, and the one who finds it will get a money prize. Everyone is looking for the fish, and all of them are adults. But I'm a little girl. I know where the fish is. It's a dry fish and it hangs from the ceiling. The adults brush their heads against it but don't see it. But it turns out that to find the fish is not sufficient to win the prize; after one finds the fish, one should play roulette, and if one wins that game, then one gets the prize. I found the fish but lost the roulette game, and didn't get the prize money.

My boyfriend and I are walking in a clean birch tree-filled grove filled with light. My girlfriend appears in a sun-dress, and I haven't seen her for a long time. She knows my boyfriend too. She sees us and joyfully rushes to my boyfriend, then gives me a much cooler greeting. This doesn't irritate me, as it might. At the same time, I have a feeling that this calm quiet of the grove is unnatural and is fraught with some kind of danger.

At first, I find myself in a castle full of enemies who are preventing me from getting out. I struggle with them and finally kill them all. I come out from the castle into the forest, and I feel sorry for the enemies I killed. Then I'm in a clearing, playing with my classmates and a woman geologist who is a schoolteacher I know. We sing and dance in a ring. Then I walk father on along the forest and come to another clearing where a large map hands on the tree branches. It's my understanding that the geologist put the map there.

movement. Somewhere deep down underneath me, a river is flowing. I believe that this is the Nara River (a river in my home town) or the river into which an acquaintance of mine wanted to throw herself. Below is a green spot, and I see the river clearly, winding deeply down. I sense some danger from the river. I'm standing, bent down on this bridge, feeling total despair. I keep thinking, "How can I get down from here?" I turn my head and suddenly I see my older brother who is also naked and is swinging on two thick electric wires which lead from the bridge to the ground. He isn't hurt by electricity. He laughs wildly and say, "You have a choice: either go down by the wires or jump into the river." My heart is ready to burst from despair and suddenly the soft warm sun appears. I'm walking along a meadow; birds are singing. I think this is close to the city of Voronezh. The River Don is in front of me; it's yellow. Everything is calm. I come up to the river and bend down. But my girlfriend behind me is shouting that I should step aside from the river because we are in Egypt and this is the Nile Riverin which crocodiles are found.

(This dream was long, unusual, and confused.) Somehow I find myself together with a short bald man. I have to go with him somewhere, maybe to sleep together, but I feel almost nothing. It seems like I'm under some obligation. I feel that I have to endure something, and then my life situation will change for the better. I even see this "better" as a sunny door to the light. However, some kind of pilaf is creating an obstacle. There is a lot of it. It is cooked well with a lot of butter in it, and each grain of rice is clearly visible. I don't remember any meat. The pilaf is on a huge white tablecloth lying on the floor. All my doubts, anxieties, and problems are connected with this pilaf, and that with that bald man. I'm supporting that man by his arm, and with my other hand I'm holding the edge of the tablecloth and am either mixing or shaking the pilaf. Another end of the tablecloth is in the man's hand. To get to that door, I have to do something with this pilaf, and this is a problem that could take years.

The whole earth became desolate. Buildings are in ruins. Only a small group of living and thinking human beings remained on the earth. There are seven of us, four men and three women, and I am in this group. All the other people are alive physically but dead intellectually. These people try to devour intellects of thinking people. A small group of them finds their prey and all the others run to that spot. The kill the ability to think, and the victim becomes like them. I and those who are still unharmed are alive because we are always on the run from these monsters. But then our group divided into two subgroups, and there was a feeling that everyone was for himself. A thought struck me that this is the Day of Judgment, that God is preparing the earth for the Last Judgment where the living will envy the dead. At that moment I feel hopeless. I don't want to become like these zombies but this is my fate; my struggle only somewhat delayed the inevitable end. And that's all. (Then I wake up.)

(lucid dream) I go through a market, passing people selling sweets and ice cream. I want to buy an ice cream cone, but haven't much money. I see Ira (a member of the lucid dreaming group) who talks, but she looks different. She has long, black, wavy hair and a rose blouse. She shows me a copy of a diploma of some American or British University and talks about that. I don't see the other members of our group but know they are present. Ira and I sit on chairs on the lawn beside a building, with some papers and books on our knees. I remember green grass and a white and yellow building. Afterwards, I walk home through the same market. They are selling flowers in pots. I like one of them. I stand there and admire it.

Our tourist group is vacationing on the sea in late autumn. It's time to leave, but we have not yet bathed. We walk closely together to the sea, along yellow autumn hills with trees lit by the sun. The weather is cloudy, cool, and windy, but the sea is surrounded with green vegetation. I want to bathe, but it's simply indecent to do so in such cold weather. Groups of elderly walruses pass us by. I see trees on the opposite coast, running along an uneven coastline. Lateral waves run on the sea, not to the shore, but perpendicularly. Near our shore, the water is deep, dark, stagnant, and scary. Where the waves are, the water is transparent; it's possible to see the bottom and the vegetation. If I unfocus my eyes, I can see underwater steppes and grass blown by the wind. It's so beautiful that I linger and play. As we leave, we move along the shore to some factory that pollutes the water. On the right and left of this place, there are two streams of dark water. . The streams are strong, and contain nasty red spume. Down where that dirt is, some people bathe, laugh, and enjoy themselves as if it is warm.

I have a wooden plank and I can fly on it. I take a run, jump on the board, and can fly wherever I want to. I am flying above a forest and mountains and saw people strolling, but they didn't pay any attention to me, as if everything were as it ought to be. Then I overtake a helicopter and am flying beside it. Suddenly, my board brushes against the helicopter's blade, and I am falling down. But I am flying down slowly and manage to catch hold of a tree branch. A squirrel helps me to climb down, and it turns out that she is a friend of mine.

I had a dream that my house and the land-plot are flooded, and all the plots nearby are flooded as well. Water is all around, everywhere. I am with a small group of people. I'm asking where I'm going to live now. A voice answers me, "You will be given new plots of land."

(repetitive) I go to that place whe+E17re I live. I come to the post-box and open it. There are a lot of things in the box--E50 bright magazines. I even did not subscribe to a great deal of that. The box is stuffed so tightly that I have to take out the contents in parts. The newspapers and magazines crumble; their pages tear off. There are several letters in the box; they are thick. The envelopes are of different forms and colors, with colorful stamps. (Sometimes some of the letters are open.) In these dreams I never am able to read the titles of newspapers and magazines and addresses on the envelopes.

(Repetitive dream since 16) There is a narrow long room. There is an old leatherette black divan by one wall. A wide high brown wardrobe is in front of the divan. The fruit bowl with a long stem is on the wardrobe. The bowl is made of blue glass in the form of petals. A wedding ring lies in the bowl. It is necessary to get it. I stand on the divan and try to reach the ring. The desire to get the ring is so great that I lost touch with the divan and hang in the air. My hand is right near the ring, but I still can not reach it. I feel like something draws aside my hand.

I am in an empty ground floor room with a wooden floor and a wooden door. An electric light bulb hangs from the ceiling. There is a bed in the corner and I lie in it. I know somebody wants to enter the room and hurt me. There is nowhere to hide. I think, "It is necessary to fly away!" I take a deep breath and see my body rise up. I think that I am afraid I may fall down. But they won't get me here under the ceiling. I fly through the room There is no way to fly through the door. I use my feelings to go through the wall. I fly over the land. I think, "It is necessary to rise higher not to be broke." I can fly higher or lower of my own accord. I rise up, higher and higher. It is twilight, evening. There are no stars. The land is below, and as are trees, groves, and grass. I am at a height of one or two hundred metes. I see a light far off, maybe it is the moon. The feeling is quiet, calm, and fine.

I see a bright orange flaming ball explode in front of my window. I seem to know that the war has begun. The missiles and bombs are flying. The explosions are everywhere. Gorbachev is sitting in an easy chair on the town square. The bomb falls down on him and it explodes.

I am standing near the window in a high-floor room. I see a large square outside in the twilight. People are running over the square. There is a high building far away. A colorful, beautiful picture emerges from behind that building. It is an image of a holy woman. It emerges slowly, stops, stays for a while, and then goes away. It repeats this three times.

I am in a semi-basement room with a window. It is empty and spacious. A gray kitten sits near the window and looks out with curiosity, stretching its neck. I think, "What does it see there?" I approach the window, the kitten jumps on the window-sill, looking anxious. I see the grating between two window frames. I have never seen it before. Outside the window, I see a silhouette of my dead mother. She lies in a coffin. There is candle burning near the coffin. (My mother did die some time ago.)

I find myself in a new flat, one that I have never visited before. It is very large and it is very spacious. The ceiling of this flat is very high. All the furniture is grand, very large. The furniture is made of ebony, and this ebony has been polished.

I am about to get on a car that is able to fly. I board the car and it starts to fly up into the sky. I notice that the blue sky is all around us. Then I realize that we are in a parachute jumping vehicle. So I take the parachute and jump down. It is dark. The wind blows on me again, as I float through the air.

I see a large water lily in a pond. It has some spiritual significance. It is closing slowly. There are a lot of small stars reflected in the pond. The small stars seem to be floating around the water lily as it closes. I feel as if I am flying, and falling down into the pond with the water lily.

I see myself as a man in this dream. I am sitting in the village of Yaranga somewhere in the north part of Russia. I am sitting along several other people, men and women. They give me raw meat to eat. I am considered to be the senior member of the group by these people.

I go to see my boyfriend, and I am in a hurry. I come inside of the flat where he is living. I go through the door, and then I meet him. As he sees me, he turns aside as if I am a stranger, just as if we have never met each other before.

I walk across the steppe. It is snowing. The wind blows from all sides. I am frightened. I hold my son, age five, by the hand, and feel some heavy burden in the other hand. I feel it is a child, but I do not see it. I look for my husband. I see the stream frozen and a small bridge across it. There is a large building on the other side. I know my husband is there. He is very ill. He dies before I can arrive.

I come home and see my husband with our neighbors. They are drinking vodka. The room is upside down. I am outraged and I say, "You are respectable people and you made all this mess in the room." My husband does not look in my eyes. I leave the room, angry. (My husband is dead.)

I walk down the street. The sun shines. The weather is warm and dry. A trolleybus comes, and I step in. On the next stop, I leave the trolleybus and come in again. I stand on the step, the doors are open, and we move very fast. I am frightened, but cannot move. On the next stop, I leave, and the closing door clutches my shoe. As the trolleybus goes off, I stay with one foot bare. I am confused. What should I do now? I can't catch up with the trolleybus. I feel doomed. I begin to think what if I could go through it all again. I return to the starting point, mentally. It is like fantasy in my sleep. I live through all of the events. Once more, finally, I have both my shoes on. The feeling of uncertainly leaves, I feel rehabilitated.

I am in a low, wooden house. Two young women are there. The newspaper with Lenin's picture on it lies on the floor. Someone's footsteps are on the portrait. I say, "You dragged him through the mud." The woman answer, "Our school director told us to throw it away." I say, "The time will come when everything will get into its right place." I take the newspaper, leave the room, and start crying.

I am inside a church. I am walking in a long corridor. The illumination is very bright. There are a lot of icons on the walls. I feel temptation. I want to take one of the icons. I always wanted to have one. But I pass through and leave, taking nothing.

I give birth. The baby appears, and the time in the dream changes quickly. I see the baby as a grown up girl. She is seven or eight years old. She has a star on her forehead. The girl is quite clever. Though not beautiful, she is dressed quite nicely. Looking at the star, I feel bewildered. "How will she grow up with that thing?" (I do not have a child in waking life.)

(Visitation dream) It is October. I see my mother-in-law going somewhere, holding a doll in her hands. I ask her, "are you going to my daughter's birthday?" She answers, "Yes." I say, "But her birthday is tomorrow, not today." She replies, "It does not matter. We will all have to die sometime." (My mother-in-law had died two years earlier.)

I am being pursued by a snake. It moves as if flying on the air. I feel anxious. I escape. I meet my friend and sit in his car. The snake keeps pursuing us. I jump out of the car and see the snake's head falling off its body. I feel frightened. My heart beats heavily.

My mom and me pick up the marrow plants in the field near the road. Suddenly, I think. "We are stealing them!" We come to the road, see a cart with a horse, and board the cart. We move along the road. The countryside surrounds us. The field is on the left side. A grain harvester combine gathers in the rye. We turn to the right, to the early autumn forest. I feel everything in my life will be fine.

I am in a small room with five or six people. There is a leaning staircase with a woman guarding it. This group of people is a secret society. One of us takes a round loaf made of gold. It has four crosswise lines on the surface. There is a hieroglyph and a picture in each square. A spiritual-looking woman says, "Using this loaf and a special spell, you can make gold and silver." I repeat the spell aloud, wanting to remember it. Goldand silver light beams appear after I repeat the spell. The woman puts ordinary Soviet coins under the beams, and the coins turn into gold and silver ones. I hear a tap of heels from the staircase. I know that it is the woman guard. The other woman, with the loaf, says, "We must stop now. I will call you again next time." We leave the room and go in different directions. That woman from the staircase approaches me and asks, "What did you do there?" I put my hand palms up, side by side, near my breast and say, "Just nothing."

I am at home. I hear somebody knocking at the door. I open the door. My husband (who I married two months ago in waking life) stands on the threshold. He has stumps instead of a right arm and a right leg. I escape in tears into the other room. And he follows me. And he keeps saying, "Well, now. The, I am such a man. Just bear it."

I see a man who I actually had met a day before (in waking life). He was in the same year that I was in medical school, but we never became acquainted with each other. He holds a huge brown volley-ball in his hands. Then he throws the volley-ball at me. I feel a flow. It is painful. I even flinch. (This dream was short, like a flash.)

My mom, my younger sister, and I visit my boyfriend. He lives in a wooden house. There is a fireplace in the group floor room. When the fire is set, there is a small salute, like a cannonball, that flies out. I do not like this salute because it flies toward my eyes. So my sister and I run upstairs. I look out of the window and see great clack smoke curling out of the ground floor window. Then I come to know that the house caught fire because of the salute. My sister and I jump out the window, and run away with mom and my boyfriend to survive. I run and sob, because I left my teddy bear in the house. I come back there, enter the house, and see my mom has extinguished the fire by water. The fire disappears. Everything is fine. My teddy-bear sits safe and sound. Suddenly I see wheels attached to the house and we all start driving. Everything ends well.

My sister and I go somewhere by train. The train stops at a station. I go out of the car, and wait for someone outside the train. My sister is inside, then decides to come outside and wait too. But the train has already started moving so she can't get back on. I leave with a woman who has arrived to pick me up; I do not know her and do not know where we are going. My sister looks for me, but without success.

(Out-of-body) I am in a village house, among other people. I see myself lying in a coffin on a stone stove. I stay and watch, and my corpse lies in the coffin at the same time. I turn to my relative and say, "Uncle Grisha, bury me. Some places already have run out of coffins. So how much more time can I lie here?" My uncle keeps his silence. Some other man puts on his outer clothing and goes out for a car to the graveyard. I feel gratitude. At least this one responded to my request.

shows me a piece of soil and says, "Loosen here, please." Green onions grow here, but the soil is all sand. A male stranger approaches, gives me a head on an onion, and says, "You should separate it." I say, "Why separate it? It would be single then." I take it and feel two smaller heads under the peel as is often the case. I separate it in two and see that can be separated more and more, endlessly. I decide to plant them just where I am loosening the soil. I start doing it, but the sand in the hole crumbles, and standing sprouts of onion fall down. I begin looking for another place for planting, and go around my friend's cottage and see many houses with many stories around me. I don't understand why I go planting inside of town where there are no kitchen-gardens.

I see a big field which is overgrown with flowers. The flowers are red, only the ends of the petals are white. A hare jumps far away in the field. I sit under the bush and tie some red ribbons to the twigs. There are a lot of ribbons on the twigs. They are blue, green, yellow, every color. But I tie only the red ones.

My mom and I are in a big room with a swimming pool. There are green plastic motor boats on one side. I say, "Let's go boating." My mother talks with somebody, and we do not get the boat. We leave the room and see a small swimming pool surrounded by asphalt. A big boat stays on the asphalt. I see an easy-chair near the boat, and near the chair there is a window. I switch on the light in the window so we can see better. My elder sister approaches me and says, "I will sit in this easy-chair." I say, "No, I will," and proceed further into the room. I see the bed and a window above it. I say, "I will have my place here," and go back. I see that easy-chair with flower designs on it.

I am in my flat. I undergo an operation. The surgeon is a man, dressed in black, but not like a doctor. He says, "We will lay her open to the bone and extract what is needless." He cuts my arm below the elbow from the external side, but there is no blood there. The blood starts spurting from the back of the hand. I shout, "Let's go to the hospital, them! Let them sew me up and repair me!" He agrees, and we start to go, but very slowly. I am not satisfied with the pace. I hurry him, but we keep going slowly.

I was running from something and fell further and further behind. Suddenly, a huge dragon appeared in front of me. It turned out that I had a sword in my hand. Without thinking, I plunged it into the dragon's neck and twisted it. I saw the dragon's flesh and the wound, but no blood. I thought that I did not kill the dragon, only angered it. Then I saw darts in the dragon's paws. The dragon threw darts at me but missed. In response, I mortally wounded the dragon with my sword and galloped away. The dragon was still alive, although doomed.

This was a dream where I was dreaming, then I thought I woke up but I was still dreaming. Three of four people came looking for me in the first dream. They were regular, modern hikers and they were going to come inside my cabin. But I started to scream, yet I couldn't let out a howl. Then I realized I was dreaming and I thought I had awakened. I now had rocks on my head and though I was really awake, but later I realized that this was simply a new dream.

Standing at the top of some stairs and looking down, I see a strange boy who is hanging over the banister. When I am looking down, I am looking only at the top of his head. His head comes up very automatically, just like he is automated. He is looking at me, then his head stops very abruptly. He has this strange look in his eyes, like in a poltergeist movie or something. I wasn't scared. It was just like, "Ugh." He seemed not quite real.

I am at home watching a television. An art film from Hungary comes on. Initially the screen is white, but gradually the camera pans up to a wedge of darkness in the center. Then it draws back and opens out into a closeup of a beautiful vulva of an artist's model. He comes into the shot, pushes her legs father apart, pulls her labia part and starts lick her there. I put a tape in the recorded. I hear voices outside and it is one of my girl friends with two other girls. One of the friend's friends is a girl who looks at the film and says, "Oh, I appear in this film." This girl looks lovely and I take her up to my room. I push her gently inside and kiss and pull her down with me onto the bed. I lock the door, then dive between her legs while reaching up to squeeze her breasts in semi-religious prostration and oral exploration. I enter her swiftly. We change positions frequently, until finally we face each other in the crossed-legged yogic position that has our legs entwined. Lily the slightest movements are needed as she tenses and relaxes her inner muscles, milking me silently as we gaze deeply into each other's eyes. Then I am with my dad in a Safari. We go to get a bite at the cafeteria and there is my friend who brought her two friends over. She comes over says, I want some loving too." The two girls invite me to the city with them. I leave my dad and a menage a trois ensures.

I am visiting a long-time family friend. There is a house that is much more spacious than it should be. I am with a friend in the kitchen and we make coffee together. I ask where the toilet is and he directs me down a massive hallway. At the end of the hallway there is a very old-fashioned room, with a toilet unit in the far corner. It is obviously used as a storage room. I urinate all over a pile of boxes and set of luxurious velvet curtains, then stop myself and finish in the toilet. I am shocked by my own actions. I go and wash my hands in the basic. But it's only half an inch deep and the waters all over the floor because the drainage hold is plugged up. Then my friend's father comes in dressed in his dressing gown. He looks normal, expcept where the few hairs come out from his bald head. The hairs go all the way down to his waist. His wife comes in and starts asking me about the welfare of my family members. I answer mater of factly. No one notices r comments on the urine stains, though it is so obvious I am embarrased. I try to lead them all into the kitchen, but I am trapped in the doorway of the toilet and they ca not move past me.

I am inside a massive castle with an English public school in session. I am searching for something, almost as If I am in a drug squad. I feel I must beat everyone else to find the treasure first. I am in a panic I systematically rifle through cupboards and desks in the classrooms and study halls. Then I her laughter and people's voices. I have no time left. Chaos erupts as teenagers fill the castle-like school. I feel despair at not finding my treasure, when I look up to see a female friend of mine wearing a pale floral patterned evening gown. She is delighted to meet me so unexpectedly. We hug and kiss briefly. In that short embrace I feel utterly transformed, awakened, and know I am strong again. I think to myself, "I don't know what has happened but things are going to be very simulating from now on!" I lead my friend down a deep spiral staircase into some converted dungeons. I lift her down off the bottom step and kiss her again. We go into the library where we meet a gypsy woman who offers us a variety of cakes. I end p having a piece of cake that has magical spices and herbs in it. It is an aphrodisiac. I think to myself, "Soon I will have sex with her."

There were three women standing on top of a flat roof. They were standing in buckets. Behind them there was a normal sloping roof, one that was raised up higher. On top of that roof there was a large pipe going up and curving around, upside facing down. The pipe had been tapped and there was a woman sanding next to it about to turn it on and give the others a shower. This image started to fade and a snake replaced it. The snake began to raise its head and as it did, its one head separated into three.

I remember dreaming about a scorpion and a black orb that seemed to be full of stars. The sphere seemed to be floating in the sky above the scorpion. The scorpion was quite large and the sky was quite dark. Then it became light and I saw stones that had carvings on them. The carvings seemed to be playing cards. One was an Ace, which was worth "one." The King and the Queen were worth "two." The Air card was worth "five."

I am gong somewhere and I decide to stay overnight at a youth hostel. There is a crowd of people with a big square pavilion that they put up in the dormitory. Much later, I am there again with a group of friends and we decide to stay at the same youth hostel. There is the same square pavilion that I had seen set up in the dormitory. We are lolling on the beds. We decide not to stay there are go and sit in the corridor. We have tea there. Someone has a sandwich but they take it away before she has eaten it. There is a wife of someone I know and she lives locally. She and I look through books to decide where to go ext. Mind is a little square guidebook with a cover on it. It's arranged in a strange way and I can't find anything in it, though I have found things in it before.

I had the image of someone rowing a boat. There was a green flash, then an image of a person, and then there was a red flash. The person who had flashed had no connection with the boat. He was tall and large. He was a Frankenstein-type fellow, who was wearing a suit. I was struck by how solidly he was built.

I had gone camping with a group of friends. We were just getting through with packing all of our equipment away and were about to set off for our homes. Before we went, I said, "I have to go for a pee." Well, I ended up going through a valley, getting on a new path and moving in a different direction. As I was walking down a path I saw a farmer and thought, "Well, I can't take a pee here." In fact everywhere I was planning to go was a place where people were already stationed. It seemed to me they were all waiting for a bus. So I gave up and walked back to my friends.

I see a lot of monkey-spiders. They are hatching from eggs. Hanging above them is a larger spider that is trying to collect them into the ball. The larger spider failed because the tiny spiders were escaping between the larger spider's legs and going any which way they pleased. Just as soon as he had them into a ball, it would fall apart and the tiny spiders would go their own way.

I am on a strange street trying to find my way to a place I have never visited before. I am walking along a road going through a remote town. I hear that a man in the town I am walking through has just fallen into the river. He has hit his head and drowned. This makes me feel very sad, even though I did not know the man.

I have the sensation of butterscotch. It is butterscotch as a flavor, and as a color. Both are coming to me in waves. I am also going to the field in front of me. I see occasional dots of mountain wild flowers made of deep purple and cardinal red. The waves are coming from the solar plexus region, rather than from my head. It wasn't really an image. It was more like a thought. I felt like there were places in this world of thought that are relevant to the physical world and vice versa.

I am in my mother's house. It is a house she has lived in before, and she has bought it back again. Even though I never lived there, it feels like coming home. There are letters there, one addressed to someone who has just left. After dinner we have visitors. I ask one fellow about his childhood. He tells me that he and his friends were all taken prisoner as schoolchildren and that he and his friends had tried to escape. They put carpets down their shirts, walked with the shoulders up to look like adults, and stole passes. I can see him as a boy getting past the guards. Then one of them points to the red schoolboy badge at this neck. The others have gone and he comes in and hugs me. I feel a lot of compassion. He continues his story, and it is like a move film. He tells me he is a man again, now captured. Alongside him is a frail old man. The guards bring a long brick and tell him to beat the old man. He refuses. Later, he's sitting at a desk and the guards say his mother has come to visit. He turns around to his see his mother and she opens up the smock he has on, which he closed to hide the badge he was wearing, but she saw the badge and thinks he is a collaborator with the other prison officials.

I am on a ship, measuring something. The other end of the measure is attached to a balloon, which flies off the ship and take me with it. I am swept into the air and out to sea. I dangle by the tape measure. It is a metal one and quite sharp. We fly far away from the ship and I wonder if I'll even get back, as the wind is blowing me away from the ship. But eventually, the ship does catch up. I hit against the side, then manage to climb up and onto the ship. Someone is pulling me from the other end. I tell someone to run quickly and tell the others I am here. I can't let go, or the balloon will go up into the air again.

I am going somewhere with a friend. He is going on ahead in his car, so I walk home. I meet a little boy from next door and pick him up. We take a short cut through he supermarket car park. There we find a huge tog on a chain, and I move back even though the dog is away from us. We go on a long walk on a straight road. When I get back and take the little boy home, we find is mom has left and that his father is out. The only people there are two young girls in care of a ten-year-old girl. She had prepared soup and toast for everyone. I go home and ell my friends about what I have seen I cry for the responsibility the ten-year-old girl must shoulder.

I am stuck in a traffic jam at the entrance to an underpass. The car in front of me is like a concept of a car of the future. The driver of the car also wears futuristic clothing. For reasons that are not clear to me, he talks about the style of my car, giving it many praises. He also tells me the reason for the traffic jam is there was a bomb threat inside the tunnel. I find myself in a split-level restaurant, looking out the window at the traffic jam. I think I am in a Russian restaurant. A far woman, who tells me bomb scares are a regular occurrence, is serving me. My wife then appears in the restaurant, waiting with me for the traffic jam to clear.

I am at a Ceramic Trading Fair. I notice an exquisite collection of pottery made by a new designer. I am invited to meet the new designer who turns out to be a young woman I once shared a studio with. She hands me a tiny animal figurine, which is excellently made. I accidentally drop it. I pick it up and it seems to be in one piece but then the head slowly comes off. We stand there looking at the small animal and I feel obliged to pay for it, which I do. It costs me a small fortune.

I am walking on a narrow street when crowds of boisterous youths jostle me at the entrance to a large civic building. They enter the foyer of the building and I video record the event with a camcorder. In my head I replay the scene in slow motion. I then reverse the motion in freeze frames, and I watch it again, backwards.

I am in an empty school by the sea, walking around the open spaces, walking up steel staircases and going along balconies that have a high tech appearance. I then go outside on a white beach, where I join a group of students. They set off in a rowing boar heading for an island on the horizon. But I am left alone and behind the others.

I am in a workshop with my musical instrument on the table. It is like a violin, but made from rosewood and redwood, like my guitar. I play a note and there is an unpleasant "clunk" coming from inside the instrument. Then I see the back is falling away from the sides. I hold down the piece and try again, but another piece falls away. The wood has a strong curve in it. A friend is standing over my head, telling me t is no good. I mustn't fiddle with it, I know. But also I know it needs sorting out. As continue to mess with it, the instrument gets worse.

There is a platform with dents in it and I think that people are supposed to lie down inside of it. At least my friend and I have been trying to do so. We have been trying to paint it red, but only had this very watery paint with us. The paint was so watering that when you put it on something, it just soaked into the wood and made the wood damp. We felt it was a poor idea to use this paint because we knew we were going to have to lie down on the platform afterwards.

This dream was disturbing; it was of a stone bridge. A stone structure that looks like a stone wall, except that I realized it was an army post with soldiers on it, camping out. This army post had been established here as part of a military set-up, put up in preparation for defense. It seems people are holding off fighting one another indefinitely. The post was not really on a bridge; it was on a platform, with a dry stone wall along one side. These soldiers were on it and it was swiveling. It was a whole dream about military secrets and strategy.
