I was on a mountaintop where there was lots of land. The only interesting quality I remember was that everything was much more spacious. I was on top of a mountain, where there was more room because there was all this grazing pasture, and all these wild animals, especially goats. Every animal had its own space, even though they usually run in herds. But it was very spacious there. At some point I was looking over a ledge and saw these really strange figures. They surprised me and in a childish way I was really frightened.

I had a dream about this big pool. It started of with me being in a forest and coming through some branches and into a clearing where this water had collected. The water was clear and stiff, and while the surroundings were always changing, the pool always stayed the same. The water was transparent and I thought, "This pool is hypnagogic."

I have this little child with me who I have to take to the bathroom. It was in a train or something and was extremely awkward because the train was jiggling. Anyway, going to the bathroom involves doing through this room, but first we have to find a towel in the luggage because the child has wet herself. We then have to go through somebody's berth. It is extremely awkward. We eventually get to this chap and he says it's all right to use his bathroom. He says it's all right to use his tub even though at the moment he's running a bath. Then it turned out there's a deer in this bathroom. There are two of them! We came to this bathroom to clean up these children, when suddenly the ground rules start to change. We realize we have been sent to round up these two nervous male Roe deer. Here we are with these great big, hulking animals, shoved into this bathroom and we have to get them out. I am aware that these deer could be violent so I am a little wary. These are beautiful creatures but now there are various people outside the bathroom door anxiously waiting for us to do our task.

I am packing to go home. I received a telephone call and I said, "To whom am I speaking?" But he wouldn't reveal his name. He was asking all sorts of questions and I said, "I can't tell you, actually. The line was going dead. He asked, "Did anything strange happen?" He was giving me the creeps. Again I asked, "whom am I speaking to?" He said, "Can't say." Then he said something like, "Pray for half an hour." I packed the phone away and this baby appears. He was lying on his back, perfectly content. At this point I began to understand that I was dreaming. I had put the face that I had received a pone call where there was no phone line together with the implausibility of a baby just materializing out of thin air. I was realizing how odd it all was. I asked the baby where he lived and he said, "Play school." Finally, there was a young boy clad in green arrived and acted hostile toward me. I don't know why he was there but I didn't worry about it because I knew he was part of the dream.

There are all sorts of animals and I'd been hearing them shuffling around. Suddenly there is this dog barking, and I get quite anxious because it comes charging. I realize then that I am in a tent and that the tent has just collapsed. I went to reassemble the pole at one end to fix it. As soon as I fixed the tent, I hear the dog barking and at the same time somebody is called, "Rosie" in a cross time. It can't be me, but it is dark. The dog is sniffing around and trying to get into the tent, getting cross. I then hear footsteps. They stop and someone tries calling "Rosie," which must be the name of the dog. I think that this person might want to challenge me. I peer out of the front of the tent express great surprise when it turns out to be a friend, who I am delighted to see.

The dream takes place in a passageway. The inside was very snug, very cozy, and installed with cats and things around. I hear someone moving along and it turns out to be my friend who takes care of this passageway. He is going to visit toe bottom of the place we are in, which can't see because of the darkness. He knows, and I do too, that a little boy is asleep in a bedroom down in the bottom of this particular passage. I think it's my friend's son [he doesn't have a son, actually]. It is interesting when we find that there are other people sleeping down there as well. Then, on the other side of where we were, it turns out there is this big bed where I am sleeping. Behind the bed it turns out there is this cave full of people who are all sleeping and lying about. They are about the age of students. Maybe they are researchers but what keeps it interesting is that they all have radios. One of these students says, "Oh, shall I play some music?" He turns on his radio and it is jazz. Someone groan, but the others sad, "Ph yeah, let's have a bit of jazz." Ad there is something very appropriate about it. All the other people start tying in to the same station and the reception was remarkable, extraordinary. All these different people, all men, were tuning in their radios to this one jazz station!

I am with a friend, trying to get the car ready. We have been running around, trying to go away. We decide to go in the old car instead of in the new one. We have a passenger and the three of us are having trouble starting, maneuvering, and just getting around. We're in a big of a hurry and we will have to stop to call on my son's guitar teacher. The interest bit of the dream is going to see him. When I go, a goat and my dog follow me. The teacher lives in a farmyard. I have to cross some fields and go up hills in order to get there, and all the while this pet goat is trotting after me. When I get there, the teacher has this young, teenage girl pupil with him and looks very embarrassed. He starts telling me that he is very concerned about this person who we both know and goes on at great length. I can't just leave the situation; it would be very rude. He goes on about this person and he has this student there; somehow I don't feel things are as they seem. I notice his trousers are not quite fixed. Anyway, my friends and I need to get away so off we go. I forgot about the message we had to give him but it was something about my son's lesson. We trip back to the car and try to go downhill, but these goals are sexually harassing the little white goat that had been following us. Then I figure it out. We need to go back to the bungalow to find the road that will get us out of there.

I am at one of those mad bidding auctions, where someone starts bidding on an object that they are not too keen but gets carried away and very much into it. It seems that the person bidding is my father, but it really isn't. He looks like my father but this guy is older, and has more lines on his face. What is important is that he is bidding against someone else, for what I don't know. Art, or something. Anyway, it could have been the devil doing the bidding. It is as if the person the old is bidding against is really evil. It seems that the old, lined-faced man is bidding because he wanted the art object, but not that much. So when the bidding started warming up, the expressions on the face of the old man become gradually alarmed. I think he should stop bidding but he can not help himself. When the decisive bidding came, he wins the auction. I wonder if he has any money at all. He had bid against someone evil. The bidding could have been for me, or for my soul. The one doing the bidding was like my father or teacher. His opponent was off screen, like there was a television camera focusing on him from somewhere else.

I dreamed about the maps of North America, and other places around the world. I am pointing out places on these maps. Also, I got the feeling that this had already been done by somebody using a different system but with the same maps. I think these maps had been alphabetically organized. This made places easier to find.

I am at my home waiting for a visitor. But I am anxious because I am not eager for this person to arrive and want to keep the visitor away. The house is like our old home with two stories, semi-detached from the house next door. Then the visitor arrives and I think that she is a witch. I shout and try to scare her away. I seem to be successful. [And then I wake up.]

I am at my neighbors' house with my family and they have been given a substance to eat. We think it is a drug of some sort. The neighbors seem placid and unconcerned about it. But we think that it is a drug and we refuse to take it. We suspect that it will make us forget everything about the event, including the fact that we have taken the drug. The neighbors keep arguing with us, trying to convince us to take it.

I am relaxing in my house when suddenly I notice a three-humped elongated dark gray object UFO land on a flat sandy area outside my front window. I rush around excitedly, calling for my mother to come to see it. By the time she comes to the window, two coach buses have obscured the view, one from the left and one from the right. The coach buses look as if they have been made in America. Then an American sedan car drives close to the window. A female FBI agent tries to enter the house through the window. I shout at her and tell her not to attempt to gain entry.

I am in a church and it is filled with candles. There is a church service going on, and there are many people worshipping. Suddenly the candles go out of control and the church goes up in flames. At this point, I realize that I am dreaming, and I very calmly rescue people from the church and put out the fire. Nobody is injured because of my quick actions.

I am waiting in the forecourt of a railway station in an unspecified place. I leave the forecourt, which is above street level, and go down into the street. A train leaped over the tracks and crashed into the very spot where I had been sitting. I think that this was a close call, and am grateful that I had decided to move into the street.

I am with an uncle of mine at some sort of a family function at a location that I can not identify. My wife, Vera, goes off with our housekeeper to visit a Roman Catholic priest in Northern Ireland. At first I think she wants to have our marriage annulled but when she comes back it seems as if our housekeeper needed to see the priest for confession.

Lights that seem to be coming from flames surround me. They are dancing and flickering. They could be coming from a bonfire or perhaps from fireworks. They could even be electric lights. It is hard to discern their source except that there is a celebration going on. I enjoy the lights, but I am completely baffled as to their source.

I am on the platform of a waiting area for a bus. The bus is about to leave when a young man pulls out a machine gun from his jacket. I grab it and turn in against him, pulling the trigger. But it turns out to be harmless, like a water pistol. I still do not trust that man and so I keep the machine gun. He says to me, "I will get it on the way back." As I inspect the gun I notice that it has other features that are lethal, such as a hidden trigger.

I am in a location that is a bit bleak. It is outdoors and it is snowing. There are other people there, and they seem to be adolescent boys and girls. I am trying to clear the snow away from a building so I can enter it with a man I know, and so we can have a private conversation. But the adolescents keeping getting in our way and coming inside. Finally, I simply kick them out physically and that seems to scare them away.

I am reading the morning newspaper. I see a headline that reads "Mortgage Rates Rise by 11%." This is surprising news to me, for some reason or another. There are other pieces of news in the paper but as I try to read the articles the words simply disappear or blur before my eyes. But I am able to go back and read the headline that is in large black letters.

I am having dinner with an old man. He is a friend of mine named Richard Lessing. But it is 1861, for some reason or other. I am having a variety of foods but Richard is only eating turkey. I am puzzled by this choice because there was a variety of good even back in 1861.

I am sitting together with two men in a hotel. Something is the main topic of conversation but I do not exactly recall what it is. I start to explain what has happened in the past, especially something that hurt me. But the two men simply laugh about it and don't pay me serious attention. I would like to leave because I feel angry and hurt. I stand up in anger and I walk out of the place where we have been sitting and go to my own room. I realize then that the topic of conversation had been a dinner we were planning.

I was in the middle of a fire. There were flames all around me. There were strange people doing a dance and I was in the middle of the circle. They had masks on their faces, and flames were coming out of their masks. For some reason I was not terrified because I knew it was a celebration of some sort and they meant me no harm.

I am at my aunt's house. There are several of my cousins there and some old school chums. They are all talking about their activities and I bring up the current issues in my life. I tell them that I won a prize for ceramic tiling. My prizewinning exhibit was in the shape of a tree. They congratulated me for this.

I am in some foreign country. There is a meeting going on. The three men at the meeting are very smart, and are having a serious deliberation. I am simply an onlooker. They are talking about debt reduction and other economic matters that I am having trouble understanding. But they seem to be moving toward a conclusion that makes sense.

I am on a train and fall asleep. I wake up just as they are serving breakfast. I recall having a dream about Jesus. I am trying to remember the details because I have very good feelings about the dream. Then I resume eating breakfast and I really wake up. I realize that I was still asleep when I was served breakfast and that it was all a dream. [This was a dream within a dream.]

I am watching a small, sweet cat moving through a field. A man comes out of the trees and catches the cat. He torments the cat and beats it. I do nothing because I am too far away. I feel badly for the cat because the beating is so brutal. Then he lets the cat go, thinking it is dead. Finally, I am able to move to where the cat is. The cat is very sweet and tells me that it has forgiven the tormenter. I am very moved by this act of kindness.

I dreamed that my mother walked into my room and asked me if my quilts were warm enough. I told her that they were warm enough, and she went over to another part of the room and closed the window. I thought that this was rather odd behavior because when I spend the night at her house, she does not walk in and she does not close the window. [When I woke up in the morning, my mother did exactly the same thing that she had done in the dream. She asked about the quilts and she closed the window. She had never done this before that I recall. I thought the dream might have been precognitive.]

I see a man dressed in a white tuxedo with a red rose in his buttonhole. He was dancing and celebrating, and was in a good mood. At his feet was a bowl of gooseberries and raspberries. Somebody called him "a dancing fool," but he did not seem to mind because he was having such a good time dancing.

I dream about a party. I am the first one there and notice a table holding fruit salad. There are bananas, apples, and pineapples, and probably many other types of fruit as well. The salad is fresh and ready to eat. The salad bowl is filled to overflowing and I hope that the guests will come soon while the fruit is still fresh.

I am standing near a volcano. Fire is falling all over the place. But fireworks are going off too. I am having trouble separating the fire from the volcano from the fire from the fireworks, and wonder if the fireworks set off the volcano in some way. But I can not see the people who set off the fireworks so am puzzled by the connection.

I am at my sister's house and our Aunt Milly is there. Aunt Milly goes to the restroom and tries to put her makeup on. While she is gone, I notice a cat outside the house. I open the gate and the cat comes into the yard. some of the people in the house are scared of the cat. I am not afraid, so I go out to see the cat. But it falls into a petal-covered pond. I try to lift the cat out of the pond but it is a difficult task.

I am in New Zealand with some native Maori people. But for some reason they reject me. I go for a walk down to the sea, and go down a gully slope. When I am at the bottom I hear a big rumble and looking ahead, I see the sea breaching the top of the gully. I start climbing back up the side of the gully to escape the water and the falling boulders that are heading straight for me. I see one that is going to strike me, but it splits into rubble. I see little specks of red. On closer inspection, I notice that they are small red birds about an inch long. Then I see that all of this is really wrapping paper. I open up the paper to find small hollowed out forms of champagne bottles made of precious metals like gold and silver. I think they must have come from a shipwreck.

This dream started with a flash of a red heart. I see a calendar and the month was February. There is a large table set for dinner, an intimate dinner for two people, a man and a woman. There are mirrors on the walls, and big red bows everywhere. I assume this is a celebration for Valentine's Day, and that the couple will be arriving soon.

I am in my primary school. There were aliens in spaceships flying around outside, trying to get in. I was running around the school making sure that all the windows were closed and locked. Suddenly I remember a door at the bottom of the stairs that was still unlocked and I started down the stairs to close it. As I came around the bend in the stars I ran into aliens coming up the stairs. [In retrospect I think I may have experienced an alien abduction at this point.]

I dream about choosing two cards from a deck of about fifth cards. One of the cards pictures five nuns dressed in black and white. The other card portrays colorful spring flowers, most of them tulips. So there is a combination of a religious theme and tulip time, which is a spring theme.

I dreamed that I woke up. In the dream I wake up and get ready to come to a conference. I take a shower, I eat breakfast, and then I get dressed. Then I go to Logan Hall in London. I sit down and listen to the lecture. The dream is very realistic, just as if I am actually attending a lecture like the one I am at this weekend.

I dreamed about the Crucifixion. In the dream, I am with Christ as he is nailed to the cross. The crown of thorns was jabbed on his head. This was a powerful dream. It told me that I was with him because he is in me. He is in all of us. The crown of thorns was painful, but he was at peace. We can be at peace too. But I also felt that we could escape the thorns if we really wanted to. That is simply a mortal tendency.

I am in a drugstore. There is a whole series of automated security checks. When I leave, I end up in a series of lift tubes that fire me along at great speed to another part of the shopping center. The idea is that I am supposed to work there are a shop assistant. I refuse to do so, and a security guard comes to stop me from leaving. I push him out of the way and he falls over and breaks, revealing that he is, in fact, a robot. More and more people are trying to grab me and I fall. When I come to, I am crawling among hundreds of children’s toys that have grabbed hold of me. There are only a handful of real people around and I call out to them for help. But they ignore me.

I am with some people and we are having a discussion. Most of the people are silent. But they are all interested and enthusiastic. Then I get invited to join a board of trustees and to enter their community. In some way it is a scientific investigation. A young woman is showing me a great many printed materials and is outlining my responsibilities.

Someone is taking water from a ladle and is drinking from it. He is near a bridge and I am watching him. This is a bridge with arches, a Roman style bridge. Ducks are swimming in the water. I see someone, and he is dressed up like a bird in a large seashell. It is part of a masquerade.

If feels as if I am living in a world that is not real, like “The Truman Show.” It has been created and is being filmed by a TV company. I’ve kind of figured this out and so I go around behaving in unusual ways, asking people awkward questions to see what happens. Later it turns out that a lot of people have become vampires and are trying to convert me. Seems this has been party due to pesticides in foods, but if you eat free range and organic stuff you are somewhat immune. I am with another man, but I don’t know him. Nevertheless, we are searching the town for other non-vampires who are hiding. We find them in a Boots department store.

A male friend and I were driving around in a car. We turned up into a field and we found a load of other people camping there. Someone came and helped us unload our car. They even offered us food and the like. It was a woman who offered us the food.

I dreamed of an Arabian woman holding a bottle wrapped in straw. The contents insider either water or wine. She was leaning her back against a wall, on a dusty street made of sand. I don’t know what was behind her, but I remember it was very dark. Then I kept seeing a man’s head on some sort of gate, as if it were on a spike, revolving. The head had a very twisted look on the face, and it was still alive. The male head never spoke but the eyes remained open and it had a really horrible expression. I believe it was fear, really. As the head revolved, it turned into the head of an eager or some bird of prey. At times, the bird was carrying a spear.

I dreamed about a turtle. Then a woman was saying goodbye to a gentleman in a nearby gazebo, and then she was walking away from him. She walked away from his twice in a row [in this dream]. They were dressed in old-fashioned clothing. I recall images of people and thought they were old-fashioned people.

I dreamed that the white lady, a lady in a white dress, with blonde hair, was walking up this mountain path with a basket of roses under her arm. They were white petal roses, and she was sprinkling them on the ground around her, as she walked up the path.

I am looking at an old wooden signpost with black writing on it. It was handwritten, not like the signposts we have these days. There was a very steep valley on one side with horses, a branch of mixed colored ponies. They were all around when I was looking at the signpost. It was at a form in the road when I came to the signpost, and I was deciding which branch I was gong to take—the one going along the ridge or the one going down into the valley. I needed information because I think I was lost and I was trying to look for something that started with the letter “R.” Nearby there were caravans. I think I was in a type of train carriage, one of those you see go down inside the gold mines. I might have been in the carriage or maybe walking, when I was travelling pat old houses. At some point, a friend of my daughter came up to talk with me. I was resting outside of her house, but I didn’t see anyone else but her.

Someone was trying to wake me up, but I wasn’t waking up. There was a door in front of me, the usual wooden door with a panel at the top. But instead of a panel, there were three bars running across the top. It was like a cell door, but not a modern cell does too. I couldn’t open the door and whoever was trying to wake me up couldn’t.

I am in this tent with lots of other people. I think we are camping by a road, and someone from the outside is coming and trying to take the tent away. But he was failing in his task. It appears that it was too difficult for them to get away from the group. So they just left.

There appeared to be several men, filing in a single line. They were wearing thick monastic robes, with a knot to one side made out of cord. They also had strange hats, ones that were tall and similar to a Moroccan fez. Singly, they appeared to be doing various movements with their arms, an act of consecration, maybe. One man seemed to emit a beam of light out of the palm of his hand. They all were taking and doing all types of blessings. It was all in black and white. I saw the whole thing through the negatives of a camera screen film role.

I had a vision. I was standing on top of this mountain. I had been there before, looking down. But this time, I could clearly see the way down to the bottom of the mountain, something I have never done before. When I really had been up this mountain, it was too misty to see the ground below. But now it was clear. At the bottom I saw fields and there was something about a farm tractor.

It was a straight and long road, and a buddy and I were walking down it. It was a modern tarmac road, like a modernized Roman street. Down the left hand side was a fence, and beyond both sides were meadows. I remember seeing a clump of trees somewhere along the way. Also, there were nice kinds of whipped-up clouds and blue sky. I think those clouds ere like the ones you get before a storm. They were off in the distance, on my left.

I lived in a town that had a small seaside resort located a few miles away from it. I had walked to the small resort and was returning, when I met an old girlfriend of mine who was also walking back from town. I asked her if she would like to walk with me and she said yes, she would. We began to notice the road was becoming very rough and as far as we could see, the road had been dug up and was under repair. As an alternative route, I suggested we might return via the coastline, although this would entail walking along dangerous cliff tops. I asked my friend if this suited her and she said that she would be happy to follow any route I suggested. We started to walk toward the coast [when the dream ended].

I was sitting in my desk at school when I realized that I had only one shoe on. I then knew that I had forgotten to put the other shoe on after the ball games I had been playing earlier. I was panicking about how I was going to leave the room to get my shoe, without anyone else finding out about it.

I dreamed I was on board the “Starship Enterprise.” I was with a woman from another planet. She had the body of a woman, but the head and face of a bird. We were in a large room, with all the other main characters who are on the show. “Scotty” was saying the people from Earth were the most intelligent life form in the universe. This upset the woman and myself. We started to disagree verbally.

I am driving a galloping jeep over and among cattle. There are passengers at a lower level as on a double-decker bus. I am driving upstairs. A friend is using a bathhouse around the back of a house in the village. I am going with him to visit a mountain lake that is very deep and dark. I sense it is at least as deep as the surrounding mountains are high.

I am under the influence of some drug and I am watching a film. I watch a woman crawling through a fiery cave, screaming on all fours, going into a cavern beyond which all types of mythical events happen. She points out some figures and one of them is King Arthur. I look through the door as he raises his sword high. He says something like, “He is beautiful here and will be beyond.” I know this is a friend of a Buddha figure. I have been watching all of this with Buddhist friends and now we are driving east of New York, and there is a threat of war coming from somewhere. We see strange lights on the horizon, but we see, later, they come from an industrial plant. Then we meet lots of girls coming out of a tunnel and we turn to take a good look at them before they go their own way. We continue to go east and come to a large green village. A stream runs through it and there are people picnicking. We want to join them, but we have no food, so we go into a café to ask for some. They tell us they will give us some cream tea if they have it there.

I am trying to teach a friend of mine yoga on the school playing field. I can see the tension in his body. I am trying to make him stand straight and relax, but he is never quite there—always an arm or leg sticks out. He cannot relax. It is a matter of pride with him. I realize it is useless to try and teach him. I tell him this, and he simply does his own thing. He does a dance for me, full of tension and wild poses. He is wearing a yellow woolen mane, like a horse’s mane. There is a bunch of people wearing similar costumes, making themselves into a long snake or dragon. I try to find myself a place in line, but I don’t fit in with this crowd.

While out for a walk, I was being passed by a vehicle that could attain various levels of speed and agility. It performed this feat by adapting to its environment and by metamorphosing into different animals. It never did turn into an animal; it was always a metal craft, but it acquired the characteristics of the animal it was mimicking. I remember it being a jaguar, a deer, and a gorilla.

In this dream, I was a four-year-old child combined with the acquired knowledge of a twenty-four-year-old man. I was playing in the garden of my home and saw that at the bottom of the garden and across the street, was an open-air swimming pool. I realized it had always been there while I was growing up, but my mother had withheld this fact from me because she didn’t want me crossing the busy road I order to get there. I felt cheated. I went to the pool. The lockers were small, so small I couldn’t fit any of my clothing inside of them. I noticed the whole place was surrounded with windows that had fish in them. I left the pool and climbed upon a train. I was the only passenger on board. Many people were refusing to get on the train, but I felt compelled to catch it.

I am running through London, on my way to a railroad station, so I can make the train and be on time for an interview. I have a young person’s railway card, but am only allowed to use it for work purposes, I am told. The rail card employees are playing video games, so it takes ages to get the ticket, which is frustrating for me. On my way to the station a man offers to give me directions. He also gives me a check for a large sum of money, but it is unsigned.

I am making a meal for many guests, including an old school friend. The meal is a meat dish, and I eat a small piece. I then talk about the cruelty of preparing and eating meat, and how easy it is to survive without it. Most of the guests leave. Some as so angry at me that they damage the house and garden.

I dreamed that I was flying over Egypt, at a low altitude, to the site of the Great Pyramid of Cheops, shortly before its construction began. It was a giant plaza, built as a meeting place for all the diverse cultures and races of the world. It was empty when I arrived, but soon people started to gather there, as I watched. After all the people had assembled, living theanthropes and deities came and joined in the gathering.

I was sitting at the computer of a person with whom I work closely, at his house in Oxfordshire. [I never have actually been to his house.] He was looking over my shoulder, dictating, as I was typing material for a project I was involved in. I am not sure if he was dictating the material word for word, or just helping me with the composition. I was particularly impressed with his unique phrasing of one sentence and I asked him if he was the one who wrote the lyrics. He said, “The best!” The colleague looked about twenty years older than he is now. He expressed some doubts as to whether his phrasings were timely enough to be used, but made the joke they would at least be good enough to impress my therapist.

I am in an old historic building, in the only room that had been preserved with its original décor. The walls had an intricate raised pattern, which I ran my hand over, feeling the relief with my fingertips. The pattern was a light reddish-brown on an off-while background.

My girlfriend and myself were dressed up as actors. We were with a newborn baby. He wasn’t ours. The baby seemed to be wired up to some equipment measuring pulse and heartbeat. We stood over him in vigilance for a while, when suddenly the baby’s heart stopped and flat-lined. Instinctively, I started giving the baby mouth-to-mouth recessitation while my girlfriend massaged the baby’s chest. After a few minutes, the baby still had not revived and we both became very concerned and alarmed. We continued our attempts to revive the infant, and then started to panic when, after a few more minutes, the baby still did not recover. Still we continued, although by now we were both filled with hopelessness and dread, almost a feeling of guilt and failure. I attempted to wake up, but felt unable to do so while the baby remained lifeless. Suddenly an older gentleman appeared on the scene. He seemed very calm and competent. We both stood aside as he approached the baby. He snipped one of the tubes connected to one of the arms of the baby, and then put an oxygen mask over the infant’s face. He calmly waited, and sure enough the blips returned and the baby breathed.

I’m in a town, maybe somewhere in Scandinavia, with a group of colleagues. We walk through narrow streets and climb an incline, which eventually opens into a vista. Here we find a collection of boxes. The boxes contain insects, and there follows a discussion about the significance of the find. We then enter a house and sit around expecting something to happen. My dead father enters the room. He looks to be about thirty-five years of age. One of my associates greets him with kisses on the mouth, which completely surprises him. Someone then turns on the television, where we see my father and the man who kissed him performing a doubles act. My father was performing a repertoire of tricks I had not seen since I was little. I had almost forgotten about them.

I am going to catch a train. To get my ticket, I have to have something copied ten times. I start doing it, but the machine is very slow. There is another photocopier in the station and I ask the man if I can use it. He says no. He doesn’t understand why I need it, the urgency. When I keep asking, he eventually agrees to do it. He is very slow and won’t be hurried, and so I miss the train. I had already missed it once before in the same dream. In fact, I had left earlier the second time, in the same dream, in order to catch the train for sure this last time.

I am returning by car from a distant town. I find myself on a lower road, next to the sea. And I see the road in the distance that I will eventually be taking. It is high and is located inland. I see a church with a tall spire. After a short distance, I find myself in a different, smaller town. I get out of the car and go shopping, taking the escalators through the store in hope I will eventually get to the high road, on the inland route I remember seeing earlier. But I never remember reaching it.

I dreamed I was aboard a satellite orbiting the earth. I was the engineer responsible for deploying a new staircase outside the satellite to permit repair work to be carried out. I was outside the satellite erecting the stairway and I felt quite scared at being so far away from the earth, which I could see floating past. The dream changed and I was on a train with an old colleague. We were in the dining car having a meal when the train arrived at our station. I had left my bag and jacket in a compartment, so I ran along with the train to retrieve it. I managed to do so only seconds before the train left the station, continuing on its journey to another city.

Someone gave me a musical instrument. It was a beautiful mouth organ, placed inside of a box. He just handed it to me and said, “This is for you.” We were at the bottom of the hill. Once I received the gift, I started waking up toward the top of the hill.

I am with my sister and a man who seems to be from a time before recorded history. He is a wise old man who speaks plain English, but uses no technical terms. We walk together along a ridge that is about fifty feet below the lip of a lake. The lake flows out into a waterfall ahead of us. Some water is trickling down the sides, making our path slippery. The old man doesn’t seem to care about the dangers. I lead the way down the steep craggy slope to a plain where there is a ruined ranch workstation. We break in, and I have to explain things to the old man as we look around. He has had no experience in our modern world. He is an old warrior and magician, and he seems to know everything about me intuitively. I seem to be the one in charge, but he is the calming presence of authority. We get set to prepare food and drink. Suddenly, two cars pull up outside. It is a gang of criminals! We hide in a store cupboard. We listen to the criminals and realize they are smugglers. They leave some boxes in the other room and depart. I say we must alert the army police. I run, while the others stay, to a red phone box when I see the criminals returning. I hide behind some bushes and after they pass, I call my sister on the phone box, alerting her that the criminals are on their way back. I am in a panic.

I am in a large bus terminal with a group of friends, having just disembarked. Another friend of mine is meeting us. He lives in this part of town. We leave the terminal by way of a tubular walkway. The tube is glass, so for the first time I notice we are hundreds of feet in the air. The sky is a network of really tall church-type buildings; all the same height and all connected by tubular glass walkways. Each church-type building seems bigger than the others do. Inside, we find either a casino or a restaurant. I am transfixed by the world below and notice that I can see people down there, but they seem to be a completely separate society, unaware that this higher society even exists. It feels very elitist to be so high. It is very futuristic; there are space ships flying around outside and everything is lit in neon. I feel very safe and calm up here; there seems to be no violence or anger. Everyone seems content, as well as superior. Suddenly it occurs to me that I belong down there, and that this is the first time I have been up here. I had no idea that this place existed either when I was down there.

In this dream, I am living in a large house in an old part of Edinburgh, and have engaged a builder to do some renovation work on it. On visiting my house to see what progress has been made, I am astonished to find utter chaos prevailing. One gable wall has been demolished and the inside of the room can be seen from the street. Sand and cement dust covers all of the furniture. I ask the builder when he is going to restore the wall, and he proposes hanging a curtain as a means of providing privacy. When the weather is fine and nice, he tells me, the curtain can be drawn back to provide an airy atmosphere. Besides, I would have a good view of the surrounding neighborhood. I tell the builder that by knocking down the wall he has removed the strength of the whole structure. Wind pressure could blow the building down right now! He tells me that he has seen this type of modification done successfully many times fore, and that everything will be all right. I am utterly depressed and feel very badly let down by him.

I dreamed I was with a male friend and we were walking down a hall. On the left hand side of the hall there were cats, and on the right hand side there were dogs. As we walked down the hall, about halfway down we found two people sitting in chairs. These were both females, dressed very plainly, as if they were very religious. They were sitting upright and rigid, very strict. When we moved closer to them, they moved to one side so that we could pass. My friend and I both felt older and quite weary, like we had been through a lot.

I am in a network of streets trying to find my way to a particular destination. Then I am in a rickshaw and am transporting my children to a particular place, along the same route where I was before. Then I am in a large railroad terminal and meet my father. He stretches out his arms and embraces me. [My father died nine years ago.]

I am walking around an embankment and meet a simpleton. He has a broken stick and threatens me with it. I run away. Later, in a shop, I explain this to someone and say I don’t really want to complain about him, but he’s really not safe and perhaps they could take the stick away from him. It is arranged he will only go about when his keeper is with him. Now I am at a poetry reading interview. I read some bits out of a big book. They want me to read “The Pond,” but I can’t find it. The woman next to me plans to read “The Old Woman” from a card in the same book. I look all over for that book and eventually find it with that woman’s other books.

I am at a banquet in an unfamiliar place surrounded by strangers. I am called to the telephone. It is my sister-in-law wanting to speak to me about problems she is having with my mother. I cannot make sense of what she is saying because my mother, who is standing next to her, is constantly interrupting her. My mother then appears at the door of the room where I am receiving the phone call. She looks mad and her appearance is disheveled. I can still hear her on the phone shouting at my sister-in-law. The banquet scene has changed into a skating rink when I return.

My wife and I are in Ireland. We ask a friend of ours the way to where we are going. She is on another friend’s motorbike and has a map We cross two crossroads on a long straight road and continue, where it ends, up onto a hill. We go to the summit and search amongst the rocks for something.

There are three of us in this tent because the other tent had collapsed. I think we all were aware that two men on a rescue mission had come up the hill. They said, "Well, we will have to do something about this." And the looked in the other tent to make sure that nobody was inside. We tried to tell them, "Don't worry. We are all in here." But we couldn't make them hear us. My voice wouldn't come out. We all began to try and attract their attention, but we couldn't manage it. One of the men opened the door to our tent and we all came tumbling out. The weather had changed. It was warm and sunny, and it was still early in the morning. We all were feeling happy and pleased.

I saw a side of a rock and a young man. Then, later on, I saw a white horse and some gates. Also, there were some old people getting in and out of the bus that had carried them to this, their desired destination. They looked uncomfortable and crippled. They started to walk up some steps when a particular woman looked at me. She had a very old face, and as she started to walk up the steps she started to get younger. Her hair became more full, dark, and long. As the old crippled people walked up the steps, the gates began to open for them. All this was happening in empty space, nowhere really. I saw a man on a white horse again. Yes, I believe that a tournament was going on.

I was one of three women wearing skirts and we were all hanging around outside an overhang of some building. We are watching a man who I think was Prince Charles and he was about to deliver an address to a large group of people. He was well dressed in a proper, dark suit. We were wondering if he was going to notice us. It seems we had done some service for him. I recall he looked towards us and raised his hand and nodded, as though we all knew what each of us had done for each other. Then, almost straight away, we three women had become three men. We were all wearing cycle shorts and riding sports bikes up and down a road that was like a switchback. We came to these gateposts that were not very decorated but instead were flat with sharp corers and after them, there was a road that went down, rather sharply to the right. It was obvious, after this downhill there was going to a long pull up, but we didn't care. Our impression was that Prince Charles, or whoever this man was who had given the address, was very pleased with for dong what we were doing. He was someone we all knew and admired and someone we wanted to do our best for.

I am in this unusual pub. I see a sign that says, "There are plenty of beds upstairs." It continues, "Please feel free to use them, as well as the oral sex room downstairs." I sat at empty seats at a small table and didn't realize that I sat directly across from a man. I actually had taken his friend's seat. When his friend came back, they both propositioned me for an act of prostitution. I wasn't too happy about that. There was a group of girls in the middle of the room carousing, but they left to go upstairs with some fat short businessmen. Next thing I know I am about to get married to my boyfriend. Instead of taking an hour, the ceremony seems to go forever. Eventually though, we get married. I feel the wedding could have been a lot more glamorous, but the important thing is we are married. We have a meal in a restaurant that has tables at all different heights and angles, overlooking a swimming pool.

I am in Australia with two characters from Australian soap operas. We are in a big group of adults and children, all of whom are eating a chatting by a lakeside with a waterfall. I think the waterfall must be really high, so I go and stand above it and see it only a couple of feet high. We r3ealize someone is intruding on the soap opera couple's property, so we listen very careful to what they are saying. They are insulting the soap opera couple and don't know we are all listening. We smell smoke and I think the intruders have set fire to the couple's house but it is really coming from elsewhere.

I found myself in a beautiful garden with its own running water. One the one wide of the river was a beautiful white horse and on the other side two black ones. I saw a man and he said to me, "Come and see my wonderful white wolf." He stood by the riverside and I went over to him. Sure enough when I looked down, there was the white wolf and I stood there stating at him for about ten minutes. Then he jumped out of the water and shook himself dry all over use. Then a black wolf came up to me and I picked him up into my arms I walked into the man's house and it turned into a shop. In, in turn, turned into a woman and the wolf turned into a black pussycat. I started to buy a leash and a collar for the cat, but then in turned back into a wolf.

I was visiting the Spiritualist Association. The building was very run down, with threadbare carpets, poverty, neglect, and thick brown sticky tape over holes in the carpet. There were people working there who looked worn out and incapacitated. I was looking for a private lavatory. I found one at the top of the stairs. It was a mahogany cabinet-like commode, with people walking past it. Very Victorian plumbing, with windows through which people could look! I found a larger room with a "proper" lavatory but I wasn't allowed to use it because a man was living in it. This was his private quarters. There were lots of corridors and doors in the building but nowhere where I could go to the lavatory in private.

I am preparing food for a feast of some type. It resembles a feast that I have been to in the Netherlands where children receive presents from a man wearing a costume. He plays the part of a saint. Another man called "Black Pete" accompanies him. I am a woman and so I can not play the part of the male saint. But I can play the part of Black Pete. But I would rather be the saint and it hurts me that I can not play that role.

My memory of the dream is quite incoherent but I recall that there were many animals in it. There were spiders and rats involved. My feelings were those of disgust. I could not overcome those feelings or control them. There were several stages in the dream, like some kind of show was taking place and there were scenes in the play. People were dressed up for the show, and hurried from one stage to the next. Many people were wearing black costumes. The name of the show was "Asaya Savey" and this seemed to be important.

I am by a colorful building. It is on the coast and by a beach. I sense that it is important, as if it is the headquarters for a business of some sort. There is a young boy playing in the garden near the building. There are autumn leaves on the trees. The boy has no idea that he is playing near an important building. There is a dome on the top of this building and several triangular layers moving out from the center of it.

My dad and I are trying to go down an avenue. He is in a wheelchair [in waking life, he is not in a wheelchair]. We are very frustrated because people will not let us pass. We get separated and I am angry with the rude people. I call on my dad to come to get me, even though it would be easier for me to find him. Then I see that he has crashed into a trailer and is trapped, and can not move. Now I am very worried about him, but can't get over to where he is trapped.

There is a lot of music, and a choir is singing. Somebody says it is 1924, and yet the song they are singing seems like a prayer. Then I realize that the choir is doing a shamanic ceremony, attempting to give healing to two friends of mine named Matthew and Bridget. They are in the middle of the circle receiving the healing energy. They are mother and son. The choir is singing, "Neither can be separated; they are both one."

I think that it is Guy Foulkes Day. Some type of celebration is going on. A member of our family is putting on makeup for a party that she will be going to later to celebrate the day. I am rather sad because my boy friend is not there. I will have to celebrate with my family members, or at least those who are sticking close to home.

I am in a crowd of people, and am very confused, hot, and nauseous. I feel guilty about something. Are the other people losing patience with me? Am I keeping people waiting? I am packing and sorting something and I feel I have to get it done. There are belongings everywhere and I must figure out which are mine. I am trying to pretend that I am okay, but I am really overwhelmed and confused. Then I find some chocolate and pretend that it is very nice. I give it to people thinking they will not be so angry with me.

On my way home in my car, I am stopped by a woman who asked me if I could give her and her four children a lift. I had never heard of the place but she said it was not much out of my way. I could only put three people in the car so she said her son could walk. We reached the area she directed me to but she could not find the street. We drove around the little streets, up the hills, and down the narrow lanes. After all of this, the woman decided the place was only accessible by footpath and so they got out and walked. I then had to get out of the maze, and had to stop because a car had stalled in the middle of the road. It was a female driver in an old Morris car. I waited patiently, then decided to help her. But her door wouldn't open. I got back into my car to go for help. I realized that the road had gone away and I was driving over the roofs of parked cars! My car turned into a small Stuart car, and I could see a bus shuttle was coming that was higher than the parked cars. I didn't want to drop off the end so got out and just lifted the car off the roofs of the other cars.

This was a sad dream because a friend of mine, Chris, had died. He left his schoolbooks behind and I began to cry. I asked another male friend of mine if I should give the schoolbooks away. He said, "Yes, that would be a good idea." I noticed that some books had a girl's name on them, and I wondered if Chris had borrowed them from her.

This dream took place on a small Caribbean island. There was camping equipment all around. I noticed a Stanley knife, a portable lamp, and some art equipment. My friend Mike was there and he laughed at me for putting my name on everything I owned. But I told him that without my name, I would not be able to tell what was mine. I thought it was a good idea.

I was given a box with small parcels in it. I realized that this was a Christmas present. The dream became lucid and I thought," This is a Christmas dream." I was doing housework at the same time and noticed a bare Christmas tree in the house alongside a wall. I thought that it needed decorating before the party I would have that night.

I was in a store trying to select a birthday present for my mother. Outside it was the beginning of winter and there was snow on the ground. There were some guinea pigs in the store and I thought they would make nice presents for my nephew. I never did find anything for my mother but my nephew liked the new pets.

I dreamed about a handsome Eastern European tennis player with long hair. He was about 30 years old. We were in a grassy, sunny place. But there was a feeling of underlying sadness even though he was popular and was talking with many people. I couldn't hear what he was saying but I knew he had AIDS and he knew it too, but no one else did. He climbed on to a motorbike. It was metallic, brightly colored, and well kept, but not huge. I realized that this was at a tennis club in Bristol.

My husband was waiting for me as I was buying some cotton in a store. He told me that he particularly liked a fabric that depicted small sprigs of holly on a silver gray background. I didn't like it very much and could only think of making it into padded strips and forming it into wreaths. I then went to another shop on my own and bought some red and green fabric from which I could make pretty little hangings.

I was with my family, my husband and two children. A man told me it was September 1961 and that we were in Denmark. Then my dream became lucid because I realized that my children had not yet been born. But we went out at night to enjoy the city. It was lit up with people walking around. It was probably Copenhagen, I thought, even though we had never been there.

I am near a strange-shaped building. It is very bright and colorful. There is sunshine and a sea with no beach. The water is turquoise. I notice the geometric shape of the building; the geometric shapes repeat themselves. It is as if the building is trying to teach me something. I have feelings of intrigue and connection. It seems important to remember all of this. There is a young boy nearby playing on a swing with a man in a large garden full of autumn leaves. People are happy and connected. I feel connected too even thought I am just observing all of this. I go inside the building and I feel really good.

I am traveling along a familiar local road. There is an old man in front of me, getting ignored by the passing traffic. One car that runs through a puddle splashes him. I am frustrated because I am caught behind him, and can't walk very rapidly. I give up, and get off that road and on to a side path. Here one of my cats appears. I try to pick him up. He is panicking. He gets away and runs across the road. I am anxious about him being hit. He gets across the street but gets caught in a bush. I get him out. He jumps to me howling.

I am at the seaside, wearing a 1950s style brown and white large patterned gingham dress. There is sunshine, rocky pools, and a sheer cliff with palm trees. Then the dream shifts to a store in London. People are trying on kilts and ponchos. I am in charge of a customer satisfaction survey and am asking people questions about what they have bought and how they like their purchases [just as I do in waking life].

I am looking for a student. I see people eating some chocolate and they ask, "Do you want some?" I think this is very nice and I take a piece. But then I feel sick. I go on a jeep ride, and I feel like spitting out the chocolate because I feel so sick. I finally recognize the student I was looking for. She is wearing a sweater with another girl's name on it and this is confusing.

I dream about dry leaves in a park. I am watching children laughing and playing on a merry-go-round. It seems as if one of the children is having a birthday, and so this is a birthday party. The dry leaves indicate that it is probably sometime during the fall season.

I dream of my two sons. Their birthdays will be coming up soon, I recall. One will be October 27th and one will be October 29th. I make a connection with All Souls' Day or Halloween. Joseph and Dominic will enjoy dressing up in Halloween costumes and maybe someone will give them birthday presents of costumes.

I dream about many people in robes and they are participating in some sort of a spiritual ritual. The ceremony seems to be conducted in moonlight among large stones and boulders. I think it is taking place in ancient times and not at the time in which I am living when awake. Both men and women are wearing robes.

I dream that I am in a meditative state and am having many intuitive moments. Then I am aware of a festival outside. I get back to meditation, but the festival distracts me. I take a look outside and see a gathering of people and pink petals floating over them. It seems to be a summer festival of some type.

I am painting my art studio. Lots of people are waiting around; they are nice and quite relaxed. Their stuff is everywhere. Chris, my ex-boyfriend, is not there. I miss him and I start to cry. I am trying to clean up my studio but waves of emotion come over me such as sadness and tears. My friends ask, "Aren't you over him yet?" I reply, "I thought I was." In the meantime I don't know if my friends and I will ever clear up all the stuff. Someone will be using the art studio over the weekend, so I have to get it ready for him.

Michael, a healer friend of mine, and I are discussing another healer friend named Lynne. But Lynne needs healing herself. Michael doesn't seem very engaged in my requests for help for Lynne. We are discussing this in the summertime, in a park and are sitting on the grass, facing each other, our knees bent, our toes touching. He eventually says he will do what he can. We get up and I discover that we have been sitting on goose droppings. I am enchanted by this, and not repulsed at all.

I am in an era where there are many dinosaurs. But they are small dinosaurs, not the type of dinosaurs that are large and threatening. I notice that some of the dinosaurs are dying, and suspect that soon they all will be dying out. This will be the end of one era and the beginning of a new era, with other forms of life. coming into being.

I am at an international school of learning, working outside in the sunshine. But the other students and I don't have the right equipment to finish our work. One man says that it is old and has to be replaced before we can finish our work. We are all looking forward to the arrival of the new equipment so that we can proceed with our class and learn new things.

The sun is rising in the sky and there is an aura around it. People below are having a celebration. They are in the mountains and many of them have been skiing. There is a feeling that they are all like one family, and that they are moving forward. Then someone says that "Jesus is coming," but I wake up before I know the outcome.

I am in a large house and there is a team of workmen trying to repair it. They are doing an amazing job of making the house just like new, and very quickly too. However, I have no idea of how I will pay for the repairs. But I like what they have done and determine to find some way to round up the money, even though I am not sure this is really my house.

This scene is very romantic. I see lots of couples together, holding hands and kissing. Some of them are sitting on couches and some are sitting on the stairs of this large house. It seems to be a party of some kind. The style of the house is art deco, and a woman arrives with an art deco face! It is elongated with a black hat and red lips. She is cool, sophisticated, distant, and shallow. She is displaying love but it is insincere as compared with all the couples in the house.

I am laying in a sleeping bag underneath a quilt in the upstairs room of a hostel. I am sleeping in the middle of the floor. A woman named Lisa arrives and gets under the covers with me. She gives me a kiss. I pull away and she leaves. Then the name "Passares" comes into my mind. I can not think of what it might mean.

I am in Paris. My friend, Utta, visits me there. She is from Germany. We go to see our friend Gisela in Munich. While we are having tea in Gisela's garden we hear the big bell by the garden gate ring. I jokingly say that it must be our friend Madame Gold, although I know she is living in Italy. Guess what. It is Madame Gold! She had stopped off in Munich on her way back from the United States where she had visited family members. None of us were there by design, yet we enjoyed the coincidence.

People are gathering from all the four corners of the world. They are present at a banquet. They are sitting at tables, and each table is decorated with red hearts. The hearts are on sticks fluttering over the tables in the wind. An old boy friend of mine arrives carrying roses. I hope they are for me because I have just been an observer during the rest of this dream.

In this dream I am a young person, and resemble a character from a television series. I have fallen in love and the man is also in love with me. For some reason, we can not be together but we are very happy with our new love just the same. We send love letters to each other, and this will have to do until we get together.

I am looking out of my bedroom window. I see two cards pull up outside. They are filled with people who look at the house and then drive off. I think they simply were looking at the wrong house. Across the road to the left, a car pulls away to go left but a small baby is crawling by the back wheel. The baby has been left behind, noticed only by a young girl in the neighborhood. She tries to alert the departing parents. But it is too late. The baby slides down between the bars of a curbside drain. I am horrified and phone 999, the emergency line. It takes some time for me to speak clearly and it is difficult to get action at the other end. Later, the car returns and the other children look into the drain for the baby. They are very casual, but they finally find her. Some friends come into my home and tell my husband and me that the baby was dead by the time she was found.

I am at a circus. Everything is colorful, like the atmosphere that generally surrounds circuses. But this had elements of a market as well, because everything was happening outdoors and people were walking right up to the stands, inspecting and buying things. So I decided that it was more of a fair than a circus.

I am walking though a supermarket. Easter eggs were broken in the dairy section, and were spread all over the floor. There were also pieces of broken chocolate and Easter wrapping paper for presents that had been soiled. I suspected that some children had gotten into the supermarket and had messed up and broken the Eggs, chocolate, and paper. But the men and women on the supermarket staff just left the mess there. I thought, "How could they do that?"

This dream was about rabbits. Some of them were big, some were little, some were mothers and fathers, and some were babies. They seemed to be multiplying as I was watching them, and I thought of the saying, "Multiplying like rabbits." They were soft and cuddly, and they were very friendly as I stroked and held them.

I am standing at the edge of the sea in a tropical island. Palm trees are gently flowing in the breeze. There is nobody else around. It is early in the year, and I have the impression that I am just finishing a vacation trip. It rejuvenated me in some way and I feel ready to return to work. I will be refreshed and reinvigorated. The sight of the trees has given me an idea on how to plant and grow young trees in the place where I live.

Someone is making carrot-shaped ice cream. But they are also using bread dough, like the type used for doughnuts. These items need to be deep-fried to come out as a solid doughnut. But they will come out in the shape of a carrot or an ice cream cone. Then the dream changed. Now I saw actual ice cream cones. They were giant, and filled with a spongy brown ice crease. I complained that they needed to be fried too, but I was told not to be silly. If they were fried, the cook told me, they would melt. I was angry with him, and very agitated.

I am sitting at a table. I see lots of pairs of shoes near the table. One pair of black boots with pointy heels stands out. There is a group of young girls, from 8 to 9 years playing nearby. They are dancing backwards and forwards. They decide to make a picture with acorn leaves, featuring other items from nature to fill in the details of the picture.

I am taking a journey to an airport. I am leaving my brother-in-law behind in another car. But I am taking a very strange short cut. In fact, I see Adam and Eve as I drive through the countryside, and I also see a lot of cats along the side of the road. I have a very happy feeling, even though the route I am taking is new to me.

It is summertime. It is hot, but there is a pool on a movie set. Four young boys dressed in blue cashmere sweaters are auditioning for a film. I am dressed in pink. I have just changed clothes so I can be in the scene, driving a car. Suddenly I have to go somewhere in a hurry. My car becomes a motorbike. I take a short cut across fields. Then the motorbike transforms into light, then rematerializes into a bike. This film takes place in a foreign country. I am back in the car again, looking at the wide-open spaces, with green bushes and a winding road. All of this is part of the film.

My family that is, my husband, our two sons, and I are enjoying a meal of freshly caught fish. The scene was very festive. It was Good Friday and so there was a spiritual significance to the event as well. The dream combined spirituality and a holiday mood in an integrated, highly satisfactory manner.

I have come from quite a distance to a home where I will be caring for children. I am told that a hat must be re-knit. It is a beautiful hat. A woman owns that hat. Her husband is in the background. The hat is soft beige and brown. One part of the hat is not well made. I tell the woman I will get someone to do-knit it. Then she says she will do it herself, and insists on this. I feel guilty because she told me about the hat out of kindness, but I was not able to re-knit it myself.

I am out in the countryside on a wide country road that has wide grass edges. I am cutting three wide strips in the grass with a lawnmower. One of the strips is done and David, my boy friend, is saying how nice it looks. I am in the process of mowing the other two strips and they seemed very long. Davis is encouraging me. [I wake up and say to myself, “What does this dream mean?” And I realize that the three strips were my essays. I have completed one and I am in the process of working on the other two. I recognize David’s encouragement and support.]

There were four baby boys dressed in pink, and their father had taken away two of them from their mother, and he was planning to take the other two as well. He was taking them away in a boat. It was like a boat that you would find in Venice. I was watching all this from above, like I was on a cliff or something. The mother was very upset and angry. The man was tall with brown hair; his clothes were good looking and I kept wondering why the baby boys were dressed in pink.

I am aware of my body shaking. My heart area is shaking a bit too, a sort of trembling around the heart region. I am with a group of people talking. I am giving instructions to some people, either shouting at them or telling them how to do something. It is outside somewhere. I am not sure whether it is a public place like a station, but I am not waiting for a train. I was definitely with some people, and it didn’t feel like they are children. I am in charge of them instructing them. We are gong somewhere during the daytime, because it isn’t dark. None of these people are in my family. I am shouting at these people, trying to get their attention. I am taking above the noises they are making, just to get them to become attentive.

I was with a man on a bus. We were on a plateau, just the two of us. It was nothing special, just two people and I was one of them. We were pretending that we were like a tiny little boat or that the bus was a tiny little being. We were pretending it was a toy world and were just having a laugh at that, while we were cruising along. I felt quite safe, and seemed to know the other passengers in the bus.

I was running in a fog, a very misty fog. I was happily running along, jumping up and down, and floating through the air. One strange thing was that I was wearing a waterproof jacket having the name of some news agency on the front. I kept looking at the emblem, thinking, “Is this my jacket?” I was changing my clothes to go somewhere. I had to change. I was about to take my clothes outside so I could gather them all together. [That’s why I remember the tee shirt with the news agency’s name on it.]

I dreamed that I was with three other women. We were sitting in a circle. We were at a completely dark campsite, and then this big light washed over us. It was the same as if a car’s headlights had passed by us from above. This light was mega-bright.

There was a bloke walking up the side of a mountain. He was a dark-haired, middle aged man whose eyes were caring, yet sorrowful. Then I saw a woman with beautiful long blonde hair, wearing a white dress. She was standing by some stones. I knew I was going to hold this man’s hand and that he would know he was going to hold mine—but we didn’t even try. Whatever happened with him, I knew I would be safe. Instead of holding hands with him, this woman took my hands and started running across the mountain. She wasn’t going to let me get near that guy, and then he didn’t pay any attention to us; he didn’t try to be near me at all. Then it changed again. This lady was suddenly standing near the stones again, but this time with a little girl. She was either in relationship with the man, or he had helped her in some. She had just come by to say thanks to him.

I am sitting on the top of a beach. I am watching people going in and coming out of the water, and walking up the beach toward me. They all had this sort of blank look on their faces. I remember that I have to meet a friend. I am to meet her at the spa, just outside the entrance.

I am telling some children how I am going to give birth to them, but they are not really my children. I am with some other people in a group, and we are discussing these things. We are all sitting around, talking about merits done by the different husbands of the women in the group. I can’t remember images or anything, but there were about ten women and a few men. The men were not the ones discussing these issues; it was the women.

I get on a double-decker bus with all of my possessions. I remember having trouble getting going, and also had trouble with an earlier bus. Then I see my bus being started and driven away. I try to catch it in my car, but the council workers had removed a bridge and left a chasm. I break down and cry in utter frustration. It is feels very important. The council workers tell me that they will put steel girders over the area so that I can get across in my car.

I dreamed about a little girl who was lying down. I was watching her from a distance and she did not see me. She had a round opening in her chest area. It was like a button, and out of this button came a little blue elephant brooch. It was about twice the size of a large coin. Then a man came along and touched the opening. It healed instantly and the little girl was happy to have the elephant brooch as a souvenir.

My husband and I were moving to a town near where some of our friends lived. They lived in a log cabin, but there were also people there who lived in caravans. A female friend and I were walking in this new town and we came across two caravans that struck us as unusual. One was red, the other orange, and they were interestingly designed, with geometric shapes. We had conversations with the people as they were helping us move in. I was happy because I had just given my old job up and was looking forward to finding new work so we could have a bit more money. My sister and her husband were there too. They were really tiny and living in a caravan. They seemed relaxed and happy, but it was bizarre seeing them so small and living in a caravan.

I was at a party, in a place I had never been to before. We all were sitting down at the dinner table eating all sorts of good food like Bengal peas. When we finished eating, we moved into a bigger room. Some ore people were arriving, and one of them brought mincemeat pies. They were really big and were shaped like a pot.

I went to a store to buy a looking glass. It was dotted on the back. The mirror was quite large, so my friends were advising me to take it back. I went back to where I was staying. I had heaps of magazines there. Someone gave me three pounds to eat with and ten pounds to go shopping with. I went into my purse to count the money, and I had nine pounds less than what I thought I had. And I still owed my daughter thirteen pounds.

A child is being adopted, and is taken away from a mother who does not want to give him up. She is being coerced. I become the mother who is being forced to give up my child. I am wailing over and over. I think that no one will understand, that this is really not what I want to do. They will think that I am just sad about it, as are lots of others who do the same thing. I can’t seem to get my feelings across to people, for some unknown reason.

I am on a college trip with some classmates. We are all sleeping in a dormitory. I know that a male friend of mine is there, and I’m excited to see him. But I am afraid to approach him. Then I am talking to a man who is wearing brightly colored boots. One of his boots has a string of beads attached to it. I have my big crystal with me. One of the parts of the crystal has broken off at the top. This man seems really concerned. He says, “Oh, how awful!” I am curious about his reaction. I think, “How strange; I wonder what that means.”

I arrive on an island that I take to be Malta, but really it looks more like Lands End. I walk down a path away from a girl friend to explore the island. I eventually do rejoin my friend at a tourist shop where a psychic festival is going on. An odd demonstration takes place. A group of blacksmiths dressed as miners show how to nail logs together. They finish by eating the nails. Looking out the door, I see an aerial display of tremendous waves that are battering the cliffs. I fear destruction by the water, but my fears are unfounded.

I am in a big quarry with a lot of rocks. I have to push them up, and it is very muddy. I tell someone I am glad I don’t have to do this anymore. We all go to this house with lots of interconnecting rooms. People are rushing around. I have to use a telephone because it is very important I get through to someone, but I keep forgetting the number and have to redial. It is raining out and the light is very dim. The house is gray.

My companions from college and I were going down somewhere near Bristol to visit some place, when I decided to pop in and see my daughter who lives there. She was taking her children to perform at a Judo presentation. We watched the display; the children did running chest presses in pairs. One little one had no partner. He had been sent off somewhere because he had been naughty. We went to look for him. He was in an office with a teenager, and they were sitting down playing with a matchbox car collection. We told him it was his turn, and he went out. The people running the program suggested I take part in the program because I knew Judo. So I went looking for a Batman uniform by climbing over a desk with a bicycle standing on it. I found one my size and then went out to find the children’s display, and join in.

My boyfriend and I were living in a small town. We ran several concessions that were located in the lobby of an old hotel. We wanted to close this store because we were not getting much business. We had employed a performer we called “the child star.” As we were leaving the hotel, we met our agent in the alley outside the building. She took us up to her own restaurant to talk. She told us we shouldn’t sell yet. She said it costs money to sell and since we had not made any money, it was a bad time to sell. After that, all I can remember is the look and feel of the town. It was very old, with buildings crowded together and the streets were very narrow. There seemed to be a border of some kind in the middle separating the two halves of the city. It was either a separation of jurisdiction or of nationality. There were a lot of towers and spires and these seemed somehow to duplicate in each half of the city. I thought they were municipal buildings. The division we were in was the smaller of the two.

I am in a factory that makes tiny, delicate ornaments, like little butterflies wrapped in tissue paper. Then we put them into cardboard boxes. I go back to school to start the beginning of the university term. I go to a lesbian and gay night at the student union. A guy I know is doing a lesbian show. I have seen him before and though he was a woman who I didn’t recognize. My ex-boyfriend is there with some other guys I know from the university. I want to get together with him, so we agree to meet later. I go to some girl’s house and my ex-housemate, with whom I had a falling out, is there. We make up and hug. I can’t breathe, so I put some Oibas oil into a tissue and stick it up my nostrils. I spill the oil on the floor and on the bed. The girl is really annoyed with me but pretends not to be.

A sheriff is chasing me. “What have I done?” I ask myself as I run blindly. I nearly escape with the help of my friends. They hide me in the woods and say they will bring me an airplane ticket. But things go wrong. I commit some minor traffic parking violations on the way to the airport, and have to go to the sheriff’s office. He recognizes me as I walk past his office. I have nothing left to do except escape. So I hijack a truck and my friends fly in on a funny little airplane. My friends fly close to the truck. I grab the back of the airplane as it flies off.

I am in a dark house. I go up a lift and find I am on the top level. It is a game, maybe some sort of test. A baby is on a table. There are a lot of triangles and I think I am in a tower. I am in chains. I press the top floor button by accident and can’t seem to get down. I can’t see. Nevertheless, I break free and run downstairs. It is a voluntary game, but very addictive.

A King Charles spaniel came into the kitchen of the house I was in. I showed the dog into the garden. It was a nice little dog. Then, as I went to lock the back door, I saw a man with blonde hair standing by the steps watching me. I became very frightened. As I locked the door, he started to come directly towards me with a key. He started trying to unlock the door.
