I started screaming with terror and as he rattled the back door, I ran into the hall and pressed the alarm. It started ringing and I was screaming. [I woke up screaming.]

I was in a narrow boat that was a kind of chapel. Inside was a crude, rustic window altar, where you could see one eye rolling around and a crude, rustic shutter covering the window. The eye said, “Now close all the doors.” I was sitting in the front and I went to close the shutter and someone said, “No, you’ll disturb the demons.” Then someone in the audience started playing a stringed instrument, and was singing a mournful song about a cat named “Sweet Bianca.”

Dozens of people were preparing to be suffocated by four individuals dressed in pink. The ones being executed were white people who had chopped down trees, and suffocation was the way they were being punished. They all were ordered to lie down, then the people in pink came around and packed mud on their faces. I remember that the place had no trees and no stumps; they had all been cut down exactly in line with the ground level. I was with them, and I didn’t want to lie down. I didn’t want to suffocate. I was in the back of the line, waiting for my turn, although I didn’t remember cutting any trees down. The men before me weren’t even struggling. I know I would have been executed if I had not awakened before they got to me.

I see a strange tundra-like landscape. It’s bleak, yet serene. I see a hooded figure pulling a sledge in the distance and I decide to follow him over the hill. There is a solitary wigwam tent with funny runic symbols on it and I want to know what they mean. Inside the tent is a hooded person sitting like the Buddha in meditation. I pull back the hood. It’s me. It’s my face.

I am in this mountainous region with friends and family. It is all very white and beautiful. We comment on the purity of the mountain air. I am there partly to visit this mountain gallery, which is normally situated in St. Ives, where I have gone to work. The gallery is constructed like a doctor’s surgery room, in the dream. You have to check in at this hatch, where you also collect any earnings you have made. You are then expected to look around reverentially. Friend and I go to this bookshop where we see a book called “The Mathematics of Pooh.” I think about buying this for my daughter, but I see a more interesting book about fantasy and magic. It has a picture of a piper on the front cover. I am about to buy it, but someone else gets to it first. My girl friend and I walk out into the open air and see wonderful mountain peaks. Suddenly, we see these white gliders swooping over the peaks. They look a bit like paper darts and have flexible wings. They are doing stunts. Their pilots apparently are a family of stunt gliders. Wishing to take a photo, I realize that I’ve mislaid my camera. I wonder if it is back in the gallery.

I am travelling through the woods, somewhere. A friend is carrying something. He is wearing a light fawn jacket. A girl friend and I have to let him go ahead a little way, then keep a lookout for him in the trees, at the side of the road. We hide. We see him crouched in the trees by the roadside. I raise my hand to him wearing. I walk into the woods. The ground is flooded underneath the trees. The water forms lakes between the banks of the earth that run through the forest. The trees are bare and the brilliant blue sky is reflected in the water. Suddenly, a big heron flies over the treetops, then it flies down over the water, brushing my head as it flies over me.

I am in a large green field at sunset. There are tents and marquees around. I see views to distant horizons, with pinks and purples and grays. I am there watching young person perform a beautiful tai chi dance, with a sword in the middle of a circle of tall poles and pennants flying at their top. He had long dark hair and looked vaguely South American. I beat out the rhythm on a small drum. When the dance was over, he came to me. He looked deep into my eyes and declared his love for me. I said that I had not considered him in that light before because he seemed too perfect. He replied that I seemed that way to him too. We kissed tenderly.

There were many gates. There were gates I was going through, and after passing through one of the gates, a tall white-robed figure stood before me. He was a curly haired male with a staff, and even though he wasn’t wearing his hood, he had one. I had this feeling that the side of the gate you would expect to go through was not open. Instead, you went somewhere else first, then on to other places. It was maybe like going through hell before you go to heaven.

I am with my sister and my best friend in a bookshop, which has a café in the back. My girl friend points out that Prince Charles is at a small table in the far corner. We approach him. My sister and I bow slightly. She speaks first about his architectural plans for a model village outside the town. I join in, supporting his neo-renaissance project. He seems grateful and has a copy of Laurens Van Der Post’s book in front of him. I ask the Prince if he reads the letters sent to him by strangers. He says he does read serious or original letters passed on to him by his secretary. My sister tells him her ideas about youth and creative projects for the area. He seems very impressed. My friend and I wander off, leaving them talking animatedly. We watch them from the bookshelves, and then they both come over and announce that he is offering her a job as a personal assistant to him. We are amused and amazed. Then we find a paper that has on the front page that Prince Charles and my sister are romantically linked.

I am traveling with this outdoor sporting crowd and there is news that one person whom they revere has died, so there is a whole lot to go about doing in order to honor him. The bigwigs look stuffy and so it seems that nothing will happen. There is a lot of fuss. Walking up a road we get a lift in a van. I put my sheepskin down and lie on it. A woman friend I know is talking to me. She is very unhappy and holds me close and puts her hands between my legs and I start to feel pleasure. I rub myself against her hand while she talks. The sporting people go to play sports and I don’t join them because they’re in a rush. They tell me not the rush, but later I regret it.

I am being shown around a prison. Somehow I become separated from my guide and only he knows the way out. I find myself having to negotiate my way through various rooms—the library, the dining room, and others. The more I walk around, the more terrifying the rooms become until I end up in a room with a bunch of prisoners acting like they are “out of their heads.” I manage to press the emergency bell and someone comes to my rescue. I reach the main gate, but then have to deal with inmate visitors. I get on the main road and just run and run.

I was dressed in dull Victorian clothing, loading up an old steam train with apples. Many people, dressed the same way, were there, but I didn’t know any of them. We set off down an old track through mountainsides and waterfalls, when we came to an old prehistoric ruin. The train suddenly came to a halt and all the apples came tumbling out. We had to put them all back on, then had a picnic. We got back on the train and rode off into the sunset.

I was standing at the bottom of a short crag with my husband and a female friend. We were doing some boulder climbing and I wanted to climb the short route in front of me. I started up and found it remarkably easy, which I was quite surprised at finding because the slope was graded much harder than the kind I normally climb. I moved fluidly up the rock, each hold feeling absolutely solid. I felt very confident; it was all instinct. My husband and my friend were encouraging me the whole way. I reached a point where the climb began to feel very dangerous and I knew I could not land safely if I were to fall. I looked at the next couple of moves and dedicated it was too dangerous to go to the top. I was thinking about giving up, even though I knew I could do it. Instead, with my husband’s encouragement, I went on. I felt very strong. As I was climbing onward, my index finger became stuck in the crack at the back of the hold, so I calmly pulled myself up using just one finger. After I got unstuck I jumped down, landing between the two people I was with. In the end I was happy I made the decision to jump and not fall by going into dangerous areas that were a little too risky.

I am looking after a friend’s shop for her, and I feel very responsible about what happens. There are things in my way and it is difficult to get there. I go through one shop and I find racks and packets in front of me on the floor. I figure that I will have to move them myself, because the assistant is refusing to assist. Then I find it is difficult to park the car, and I am going in circles trying to complete the task. Then I am on this residential course. Someone gives me an ancient, oriental coffee massage. I am not aware he has performed the massage until I notice this strange brown mark on the inside of my arm. I still haven’t gotten to my friend’s shop.

I was in a school cafeteria in familiar surroundings. I noticed new cutlery had been put out on the line. It had bright red handles and business ends. I had finished my meal and was only in line to scrape my plate and give it back with my tray, knife, and fork. Other people were clearing the food off their plates and into the sinks. There was swill and spilled food and drink all over the floor. The counters and things were filled with dirty items. There was a tall glass beaker on the counter. It was like those Florence flasks in a chemistry laboratory. It was filled with red liquid. I asked the kitchen help about this and they said it was in this particular container so the liquid wouldn’t spill. As I was putting my dishes into the pile, I realized I had one of those red forms, that I must have picked it up m mistake. I quickly put it with the other dirty utensil and as I did I noticed other red forks already in the pile.

I am bungy-jumping with some friends in a desert canyon. The sky is really deep blue. My mother comes to fetch me; she has two papers in her hand. They are for my social psychology exam later that afternoon. I get a call from my housemate. She is really excited because a man she likes is going to arrive in two hours. But he will have to wait because we both have exams at that time. I get to the exam late. It is in a cave, and I have to go down steps carved into the sandstone, up to the entrance to a church in the village where I used to live. Lots of people I used to go to school with are there, including two girls in particular whom I recognize. Everyone has big piles of paper in front of them, and they are talking about which questions they are going to answer. Someone is going to write about jealousy, another about scuba diving as an illustration of the marriage between earth, sea, and people. I panic because I am unprepared for the exam. I think about going home to retrieve my notes, but the exam is about to start any minute. I look at the questions and can’t understand them; they are too long and complex for me to answer. I look up at the instructor, a female professor I know, and she looks back at me strangely. The exam is just too difficult.

I am riding my bike along a wide road. A girl is walking along the road too, so I stop to see if she wants a lift. Instead, she gets into another car. I arrive at the place where I have a drama class, and have to ride my car through a gateway and up a slope to park safely. I am late for class. I see people – young and old, all with blue faces, and many wearing glasses. My partner is there, and he is supposed to perform judo, doing things like holds and rolls.

I am thinking of buying a car. It is an old, rusty car. It is parked facing me, on the right hand side of the road, outside some modern housing. I have to detach a series of plugs, and I unscrew a part underneath the car that makes everything inside fall out. I can’t get the screws back in. I know I ought not to buy this vehicle but I think that I need a car to make all these journeys.

I went downstairs to a male friend’s flat to let a cat in. I was distracted by the sound of a young girl weeping bitterly. She said she couldn’t find her way home, so I took her back to 183 Onley Street. When I arrived there, I discovered that I had been lured there under false pretenses, for the little girl hadn’t been lost at all. A group of young punks who were into magic wanted to perform a spell, and they needed my astrological guidance. I was taken to their meeting room above a pub. It had bare wooden floors, scattered wooden tables, and a musty smell. One girl asked me if I had a “grimore.” I replied that this was not my kind of magic. She asked if I had Tarot cards. Of course, I said. However, I was not impressed by their less-than-professional approach, and so decided to leave. I somehow felt that they seemed strangely confident that I would be back to perform their spell, however. I felt with a girl friend. On the way home, she put her arm around my shoulders and laughingly confided that they'd be absolutely amazed if they realized just whom they had encountered. They had bitten off far more than they knew, she told me. They did not realize just whom they had gotten in tricking me to join them.

I am travelling on a double-decker bus in an unfamiliar countryside. The bus takes off across the fields and I cannot get off, as it is moving too quickly. Eventually, it gets back to town and I disembark. I cannot recognize where I am, so I wander around for some time. Eventually, I find a modern conference hall. I go in and I meet some people.

I had a dream about a man with a gun. He is hunting a group of us. Some members of our group had tackled him and had been killed in the process. But I am not afraid of him. Suddenly, I am at college, carrying a huge folio of art. I am with a classmate. She is a year below me. I am on my own, not knowing what class I am supposed to be in because I have lost my timetable. I feel lost and lonely, so I cut my wrists. I am sitting on a wall. I want people to see me, to understand my pain. But the cuts are only scratches and so nobody takes notice. I decide to look for someplace to die. I go to the toilets, but I feel that I don’t want to die there because I might not be found. I realize that I want to be found before I die. Suddenly, the blood starts gushing from my wounds.

There is a little kitten in a pigpen; the kitten feels some affinity with the pigs. I try to explain to the cat that the pigs’ rooting noses could hurt it. I realize the shape of the kitten’s nose reflects its affinity with the pigs. There is also a tiny baby wrapped up, lying out in the farmyard. A woman starts to drive her car right where the baby is lying, and when I scream at her, she turns her wheel sharply, just missing the baby. I can’t understand why she drove like that. I am terrified and then terribly relieved. But I am deciding that I am going to tell her what she did.

A friend of mine is getting married, and I am at her wedding. Another friend of mine is nursing the bride’s baby. It was a bit strange because the wet nurse is over sixty. There is a great celebration going on, with dancing all around. The dancers are carrying a wooden coffin and are passing it around.

A strange man on a horse was chasing me. There was definitely an element of darkness about him. In fact, the whole dream had a very dangerous feeling. Suddenly, I was in a series of empty rooms all constructed from glass. There were various mirrors on the walls.

I walk up to my house and I find that there are doors open, and my dog is out. Then I see that the bull is out, and the gate at the far end is open. I must get the bull to come this way, put my dog in the house, go around the bull, and shut the gate so he wont go out into the road. I tell a friend of mine not to continue to walk toward my house, but instead just to go back to where she came from.

There were kings and battles and such in this dream. The idea was floating around that raising the economy of the people was the best way to project them from everything. There weren't any battles, but there might have been! You have to be prepared, they said. There was a choice of numbers you could have. It depended on the best quality of any one thing. I think they were recommending "7B" as the fastest and purest way. The local bus station was a palace and I became the king, because I was not a woman in this dream. At the moment, I was deciding whether I would do things the "red" way or not. I was intending to switch from the "green air" to the "red air" because this is what my subjects wanted. I had only "green air" because it helped my asthma. The way it worked was that what I could change was in front of me and beside me. Those things behind me belonged to a different world and were not in my control. I could also change the climate or the weather. I could only do these things because of the place I was in and where I was allowed to go. I wasn't God and I wasn't a woman.

A group of us were coming home from a trip on a bus. A woman who lives nowhere near me got off at my same stop. We were walking back to my house, and when we got there, we went down some stairs. As we were going down the stairs, the other person disappeared. Then, all these men and women I used to go to school with started to walk toward me. They looked the same as when I last saw them, when we were in school together. When I got home there was a letter on the wall about another trip I could go on. There was an application attached to the letter.

I am sitting in a room with my husband. Because I have lost my power of speech, he has to guess what my thoughts are. It is a frustrating and time-consuming task. Eventually he gives up and I am left trying to make a conversation using “Scrabble” game letter pieces. [I wake up shouting because, for a moment, I believe the dream has actually become reality.]

There were insects all over the floor, a cross between spiders and cockroaches. I asked my husband to come get them; they were in my room and my lodger’s room. The house was an old wooden one, with bamboo blinds and wooden floors. It had a bit of a tropical feel. There were three little ones I had to take to school, but I had taken ill. I was unloading the washer and the wash was all soggy. One of the girls said that I should buy this new type of powder. It was on trial for a limited period, and if not enough people bought it, the powder would be withdrawn.

(lucid dream) I am in a car with a woman who works with me. (In waking life, I am suspicious about her because I believe that she loves me, and mixes that feeling with her work tasks.) (In the dream) she is in love with a male friend of mine who I have not seen for many years. Both want to destroy me, and to put me in a situation where my life would be in danger. I try to escape from them, but she manages to find me wherever I try to hide. Suddenly, I realize it is a dream and say, "Look, you may try to do whatever you want to do. This is just a dream. Sooner or later I'll wakeup and get out of this."

I am in a supermarket near a house. The men and women in the house and I see some plastic balls moving through the air. Their velocity is proportional to my movement, only many times larger. The people I am with look for an open space to see the movement of the balls even better. They are ahead of me, and have passed me. Their movement is linear. It gives me a chance to watch their movement and the balls' movement at the same time. I do this two or three times. I have a sensation of absoluteness. I realize that I only exist here at this moment. To leave without knowing this would be an absolute failure. I leave the open space and enter a corridor. The balls are moving around me in this corridor, but they are unable to reach me. In this small corridor, I see that I am absolutely filled with the greatest triumph that I have ever felt. This feeling is so intense that I can not describe it, but there is an image of the Olympic Victory statue, but it is very small. I shout as loudly as I can, "I've won!" I leave the supermarket. (I was unable to get back to sleep for the rest of the night.)

In this dream, I arrived at my father's home in Brasilia. Some friends and relatives were there. I greeted each one differently, according to the strength of our affection. Those I didn't know, I greeted formally. Then I went to another room and a person I didn't recognize came with me. I greeted him formally and then I recognized him as a cousin and a very good friend. He had always been thin, but now he was a bit fat and bald, resembling his father. We started talking and I apologized for not recognizing him. I told him he was looking quite different. I wanted very much to have a long time to talk with him about personal and professional topics. But then his brother arrived, one year younger than me; I was close to him in our adolescence, but now we have been separated for more than five years and I do not consider him a very trustworthy person. He had a big stick like a crook, and asked me if I wore a watch. I suspected it was a trick, and that he would hit my watch with his stick. Because I didn't trust him, I took his stick and hit his watch. The stick broke into two parts. He took one half and said it was now his turn to hit my watch. The room sometimes looked like a cave.

I am with a friend of mine. He is carrying a book in his hands while we are talking. He has a new girl friend, and says he doesn't have much time for reading because he spends so much time making love with her.

I was in a tavern, sharing a beer with a musician friend of mine. He had just died and the mayor wanted to name a street after him. There was a great deal of conflict regarding renaming a street, and my dead friend said it was not worth the effort. Just the, the mayor came by. He paused at our table and my musician friend told him to forget all the troublesome business of renaming a street.

I am in a bus and seem to be lost. I don't know what I am doing on this bus. Then the bus stops. Two male friends are standing by the bus stop, so I join them. We go into a nearby house. I discover that this is my house, and that I have been constructing it for fifteen years without knowing it. It is my dream house. It has long corridors and a simple living room. A man and woman are there. They are the caretakers and are very friendly. The house has many lovely colors in it. It is a great surprise.

I meet an old Indian grandfather with long braids. He tells me to hold on to his braids. So I do. Then he starts to fly and I go right along with him. He is flying into the sky, and I am enjoying myself, holding on to his braids. We are swinging around. I think that I am learning spiritual wisdom and that this is some type of initiation. I am very grateful that I am with him.

I meet a beautiful young woman and fall in love with her. She feels the same way about me. Then there is a gap in time. But I see the same young woman again. This time she is a few years older and even more beautiful. She takes me to meet her father who is a physician from India with dark skin. He is very happy that we have fallen in love. He also is happy that we have waited until now to consummate our love for each other. We head off to have sex, but I wake up before it happens.

I was sleeping when I suddenly awoke. I was thirsty and went to the door. When I reached it, I looked behind me and saw my own body lying there on the bed. But I went to the kitchen to get some water. When I was passing through the hall, I suddenly saw three women and two men walking in the yard. They were talking and laughing. I thought they were thieves so I ran to the laundry room to close the doors and windows to keep them from entering the house. The woman seemed to be the leader. She saw me and suddenly all of them passed through the wall and got into the kitchen. I was scared but decided to talk with them. Their clothes were colorful and bright. One man wore blue jeans. The leader's clothes were old fashioned. She said they were only passing through. They had to help the family of the man in jeans. I asked if there was life after death; she said there was no death. She had lived a long time ago. They communicated telepathically. I saw that she was pregnant. She said pregnancy was completely natural, but the time was different. She said they lived in a peaceful, beautiful place, and asked me not to tell anyone about this matter. I tried to avoid saying goodbye but they needed to go. When they disappeared, I felt a different energy in the air. I could not keep this secret. It was too exciting. (out of body dream)

I am with a friend and we are watching a soccer game. We could not find a place to sit down with our team's supporters. So we have to sit on the side with our opponents. It is very disagreeable. We see a big Negro man arrive. He recognizes my friend and becomes furious. My takes an iron chair to defend himself. They start to fight. I try to help my friend but find a hand holding me back; he is trying to keep me from jumping into the fight. The person holding me back says that the fight is not mine. Four United States policemen arrive with a big wooden box. They catch the Negro man and hold him in that box, keeping his head out. He is carried away, furiously shouting against my friend.

I was in a strange house with a current running beside it. I was with a strange woman and we started to make love. It was a very positive experience. A small bridge was being built by the river running by the house. Then one could pass right across the river into the house. I felt very confident that something good would happen.

It was a dark night at the beach. I was walking on the sand. Suddenly, I saw some UFOs flying near the place where I was walking. Nobody got off, but I became scared and started to run into those high sand hills, jumping nervous and frightened over the dunes. I was very much afraid of falling down and hurting myself because the funds were so high. I had cold feelings in my stomach each time I jumped, but nothing happened. Suddenly, I felt that one of them could catch me. I tried to escape even more anxiously. I tried to run but couldn't move, and had to remain in the same place.

I am talking with a famous psychologist, and we are talking seriously about important matters. We are participating in an assembly where I man is talking about the efforts of a leader. He is trying to build a great country like the United States. There is a great amount of emotion among the people in this place.

I am in an old office which is appointed with furniture --old-fashioned, with dark brown couches, chairs and tables. It feels like another place and time. I am alone in the room. I feel totally alone there, totally inside. There are no other persons in that room, but I do not seem to mind.

I was in an old house on the beach with a close friend. He became very angry with me and ran after me, to kill me. He broke everything in the house. I took an elevator to escape him but it didn't work. A policeman came in to arrest me. I ran away, out to the beach. I ran over stones, sand, shrimp, plants, and other small things of the sea. I tried to jump over them, but I always slipped and fell down.

I was in the ocean having a good time. I began to surf toward the beautiful beach, even though I did not recognize the beach. Suddenly, there was a break in the water. When the water came in, I had no idea that the island, which I knew, was so close. The waves were very large. I was the only one there on the beach.

I encountered difficulties making a trip to Australia with my girl friend. Our relatives were giving us problems because she was not yet my girl friend, only my future girl friend. We got on a bus, and noticed that many of the people who we knew were on the bus too. We reached a city in the interior of Australian after a long ride. Some of the people got out of the bus as well.

I was swimming in a large river and saw an area that had been flooded by the water. I was with my brother-in-law. We saw an orchard that had survived the flood, and could smell the fruit. I started to swim, and found out that I could swim very well, and reached the other side of the river. The water was very clear. My brother-in-law was already on the other side. At first I thought that I had not been swimming directly. Then I thought that he had found a bridge and had walked over.

This dream was confusing to me. Each episode had a different setting and different people. At first, I was in the office of my director at work. He was scolding me for making an error on the computer. Then, I found out that someone had stolen my car after I left. I found this out after I left my office. Finally, I was given a list of names so that I could make a call on the day of examinations.

I was walking down the street and I did not know where I was. I walked for some time, and suddenly, I found myself at a beach that I know very well. There are many of my friends there, both men and women. I walk over and start talking with some of my friends, and am happy that I found the beach and the sea. It is a feeling that was very intense. I was very happy at the beach. My friends and I started to play beach ball. Then I returned to the street from which I had started.

I was feeling persecuted by people who I liked, especially my ex-girl friend who was leading the attack. It took place in a dark room. It seemed as if we were in a tunnel. I could only see the faces of people. I felt very tired and ejected. These people claimed that I owed them money and were trying to collect debts from me.

In this dream, I was working at a business firm where I was the head manager. I was trying to make a large deal, a very big business deal. But I was not able to deliver the product on time. There were many machines and many people working around them. The workers were producing goods at the peak hours of work. Suddenly, there appeared a group of workers to the side who said they were running out of energy and were gong to strike, to quit working. I was trying to resolve the strike but the production was falling off now. What was a I to do? The enterprise was running out of energy. I was getting a headache and felt a lack of breath because of these problems.

I was passing through a viaduct connecting two land masses. There were waves below. When I began to cross this bridge, suddenly I saw a while car. I also saw some mutilated bodies. It was chaotic. I was on the earthen road. The road was divided, and I took the higher road. Every time I walked further, I saw more and more bodies, and I made a special effort to push my way through them. Then the road improved and I was nearly at the end of the bridge. There were no more bodies, either male or female. The dead corpses had been both male and female. But now the bodies had been covered with an opaque cloth. Whenever I saw one of the corpses, I despaired because they had been abandoned to die.

I was in a high place, some type of structure, and was about to fall off. Just as I was about to fall, I began to fly. Once I was able to fly, the dream changed its theme and I was with a male friend who I see every day in waking life. We were involved in some sort of activity together.

I dreamed that I was in a situation that was very difficult for me. I was trying to find the solution to a problem at work. It was very real, and my late father was with me during the entire dream. The problem in the dream was parallel to reality, and my father was giving me advice. (problem-solving dream)

I had the impression that I was falling downward from the top of some building. But I could not see anything below, or imagine where I was going. I was falling toward a distant, vacant, dry place and it was my impression that I would be staying there. It was so silent that I could hear my breathing, and this intrigued me.

I was arriving at my office in the business where I work. I was assaulted by four cars with two persons in each car. To escape from the situation, I started to run. The assailants were starting to fight the guards in the business offices. But I was not able to run. My legs felt like they had been anesthetized and would not obey me. I began to despair because I was I could not move. I was very close to escaping. I could feel the impact of the blows in the car, and knew that the assailants were getting very close to me. Then I woke up.

I dreamed that I was in a dark room, then suddenly I was flying in a motorboat. The motorboat settled on the water and, with precision, headed toward a beach. Behind me were other motorboats. There was a struggle over which boat was going to land first. It was incredible. The men in the other boats were all heading toward each other. Their motive was to strike the other boats. There was a kickoff time for everyone to start to fight. My mind was acting very slowly, but I realized that this activity was very dangerous and that someone might die.

I was giving a workshop in a beautiful house with a great garden. It was on an island surrounded by water. Suddenly, I was in a subterranean part of the house. I was trying to understand how I got there, because there were no stairs between the house and the subterranean area. I could see fish and water through the windows, and it was a big, comfortable, nice space filled with all the things that I liked -- pianos, stereos, space, and peace. I wanted to live there, but was very worried how I could manage it. I just didn't know how to get in and out from there when I wanted to.

I was traveling in an airplane to the state of Rio Grande de Sulin southern Brazil. With me were my aunt and two female cousins. Near the end of the flight, the airplane started to fall rapidly with a great tile to the side, giving the impression that it was going to crash. I went to the pilot's cabin and discovered that the airplane was being piloted by a boy friend of my sister's. She had an abortion after he had made her pregnant during their time together.

I was in a large house, walking from room to room. There were sexual activities going on in each room. At first I thought it was a brothel, but nobody was paying for anything. Then it seemed that this was a group of hedonists just interested in having a good time. Some of the couples were heterosexual, some homosexual, and there was group sex in some of the rooms. I did not recognize any of the people, so I thought it would be safe to participate. Nobody could ever embarrass me later! Just as I was about to take off my clothes, I woke up.

I was in a soccer stadium with a cousin I have not seen for years. We were watching a soccer game. I could see very clearly the color of the players' shirts. They were vivid – bright yellow, black, green, and white. It was very realistic. I could feel the end of a nice, fresh day. Everybody was so quiet. We could hear the soccer players talking. Suddenly, I saw lots of people coming from the subways. They were whispering and crying. They were carrying an adolescent boy in a coffin, and his mother was shouting things against God.

I was in an unknown house, but it contained a spiritual center. The owner was my uncle. My mother and I entered by the side entry. On the back yard there was a pool, and I went there to fish. I caught a fish, but it was so ugly that I threw it back into the pool, and got into the house through a back door. The back door did not really exist; there was only a wooden staircase and I had to use it. When I touched the handrail, I saw that it was a dead snake. We got into a very strange kitchen where there were lots of furniture pieces and clothes. Then we started to talk, and to eat some small sandwiches made of small pieces of crows' necks.

I remember dunes that were very high. I had cold feelings in my stomach every time I jumped over them. But nothing bad happened. Suddenly, I felt that one of the creatures from the UFOs could catch me, so I tried to escape, feeling anxious. I tried to run, but couldn't. I tried moving, but remained in the same place.

I fell into a well, and did not know how to get out of that situation. Suddenly, a longhaired woman appeared beside me and took me out of the well. But nobody seemed to see her. They only saw my body floating away from the well. I became very impressed with her power, her beauty, and her majesty.

There was a big storm in the city and I started to fly over one of its larger avenues which became a river with two different flows. Suddenly, I was in an ugly and old two-floor building. There were only back and side walls, no front walls, nor furniture. It seemed to be abandoned, but I could see a man and a woman who seemed to be very tranquil. The heavy raindrops fell continuously, and I could see people in the street trying to hold on to the trees and the lamp posts to fight against the rain and the wind which blew furiously. The images were vivid and clear. Then I flew away again.

In the middle of an ordinary dream, I suddenly I saw a big mountain far away from me. I looked at it, and felt some strange feelings. I wanted to go there and reach its top. It seemed to be very, very important, but it was not reachable at that very moment. I thought it was some sort of a spiritual search that I was on.

In my dream, I was laying on my bed when suddenly I felt pain. It was a great deal of pain, and it was as if it were in my whole body. I looked at my body and I could see lots of toothpicks biting and biting my whole body, especially my back. I tried to escape and get rid of the pain by taking the toothpicks off, but they kept on biting me. I felt badly and betrayed. I was in anguish as I tried to take them off.

I am in a time machine and it brings me to the past of the Earth, although it looks like the future because of the high and modern buildings. Then my girl friend and I enter a place that looks like subways. In this place, we do not need to walk. The floor moves along to several different directions. People were different and scary. They have no face. Some of them wear masks. We have to find the "Lord of the Shadows." After some time, we reach what seems to be the center of that complex, and we meet a horrible figure that wants to kill us. I look at my girl friend and scream, "Run! Run! At least one of us will survive!" At this precise moment, my dream became lucid. The figure killed me and I looked at my mutilated body from somewhere outside of the body.(lucid dream; out-of-body dream)

I was walking in a dark and strange city with one of my sister with whom I do not get along with very well. Suddenly, a group of men appeared and started to follow us. When they reached us, they started to hit me and beat me, telling me that they would kill me.

I was in the basement of my grandmother's house and my father was there too. When we tried to get out, we realized that there were no doors or window, just a very small hole in the wall through which we could see the street. I don't know why, but I just came to the realization that we would remain there forever.

I was about to have sex with my girl friend when I realized that I was in a box stadium, and there were thousands of people looking at us. Then I looked at her, and she started to grow, and grow, and grow, becoming higher than a high building. I felt very bad and started to ask myself, "How can I manage this situation?"

I was in a big, expensive, and beautiful house. Although it seemed to be nice there, and I was enjoying the place, sometimes the whole house structure started to shake. Someone told me that in the center of the house there was an internal yard and a big and dangerous dinosaur was living there. Everybody in the house knew about it, but nobody was scared because, as the monster had grown up in the middle of the house, it was now too big to get rid of. However, somehow I realized that the dinosaur could become an inspect, and then change back into a monstrous dinosaur again any time he wanted to. So I became worried because I realized that he could destroy the house and all the people who lived there.

I was on a beach. It was night. I was swimming and some friends and relatives were on the beach, talking to a group of people. Suddenly, I started to feel pains fall over my body, and I realized that I might die. I tried to scream, but I could not utter a sound. So I started to die.

I am with a young woman and her parents. A friend of mine is there in the role of a psychotherapist. He tells us about her psychological condition. Her father is very depressed and distant, and she is too closely identified with her mother. During all of his talking, my friend uses a hoarse voice. This voice is similar to someone who is drunk, or even a person who has been possessed by a "caboclo" spirit, the spirit of someone with mixed parentage, both native Indian and European.

I am talking with someone in a place that is like a restaurant when a person tells me something. He tells me that my brother is very sad and is crying, and that he is right besides us. I look in that direction, and my brother is really there, very sad. But my brother looks much younger than he is now, perhaps fifteen years younger.

This dream was in color. The setting was a lagoon, probably in a tropical area. The weather was foggy and cool, and I could feel the breeze splashing on my face. There were nice tall green bushes around the lagoon. I was in the lagoon with maybe five other people scattered along the shoreline. We were fighting moray eels, yes, this strange animal. For some reason, we were not allowed to leave the lagoon, so the only way was to fight them. I do not remember diving, and the eels were almost my size. I would think, "Why can't I leave this lagoon?" And my own answer would be, "It is important to stay and fight." I felt energetic and like a warrior, prepared to win. In the periods between attacks, I would enjoy the water moving up and down my legs. I would also look around at the other people and they were also waiting for the next attack.

I was in my parents' home, walking up the ramp into the garage. Much to my surprise, I saw a unicorn and a white tiger. I went up to the white tiger and was surprised at how large it was, and how soft and fluffy it was. I started to touch the tiger and it reminded me of my pet cat. I had the same feeling of love toward it that I have toward my pet cat, and the feeling was mutual.

In this dream, I am standing on a large stone platform. I am observing many roads, all of them lined by stately white columns on either side of the road. These roads are made of solid material, and everything in the dream is pristine and beautiful. All the roads head toward the same destination.

I am slowly walking through a tunnel. My feeling is very unworldly, with no sense of my body at all. I look and can see my body at the beginning of the tunnel. Suddenly, I want to return to my body. As I enter my body, I have an intensely sexual feeling. I feel happy to be united again.

In my dream, I am at home, relaxing in my bed. Suddenly, I feel as if I am suffocating. There are no clothes on my face, and feel free from any health problems. Nevertheless, the feeling becomes more and more intense. Finally, two nephews of mine run through the door of the bedroom, pull me into the air, and I can again breathe easily.

I was dressed in a traditional Japanese robe. Suddenly, I pulled out a ceremonial sword and proceeded to disembowel myself, and I fell dead on a mat. Then, I found out that I was a ghost. My relatives were talking about my ritual suicide and were very proud of what I had done because it maintained the honor of the family in some way.

I felt afraid of being invaded and assaulted by them, even in my place of safety. I felt that dark side of that place would bring up my own dark side, and I would be vulnerable. Then I was driving on a dirt road that took me to the land of silence. It was a road filled with darkness but I was going in a direction that I felt was safe. There were many roads, and I kept going on just one of them. I found a steep road down through an area that threatened me, but I received a message that I should continue to keep going. Then I saw an owl and asked her if she was my power animal. She didn't answer, but stayed on my left shoulder looking at me. I thought the answer was "yes," and that I should remain silent.

I found a place with perfumes and soaps. There were some gifts that I had received from my older brother. Someone gave me a little car and a doll. Someone else showed me a chain made of sandalwood which was very sweet-smelling. I received two blue envelopes that were sealed. Then I designed a chapel, a little church in a unique style which would be used only for weddings.

I dreamed that I was walking with a friend in a river with water up to our knees. On the other side of the river, there was a large blaze. I wanted to know what was burning, but I did not get an answer from my friend or anyone else. Then I went away from the river.

I was standing in front of a big truck filled with cardboard boxes. A man who may have been my brother-in-law tried to throw one of these boxes into one of the compartments of the truck. These boxes were neatly piled up in the compartments and he tried to throw a box on top of a pile. No other space was available for the boxes. But then my brother-in-law took a box and threw it on the floor. It took a great deal of courage for him to do this because it disrupted the whole procedure by which the boxes were being organized. His behavior was strong, just like the boxes. I told him to try again and to put the right box in the right place. But when he continued, it seemed as if the boxes were no longer as strong as they were before and that they all might fall down.

I dreamed that a dark, good-looking man came into my house. I had not seen him before. He carried me into the bedroom. At first I did not want him to take off my clothes. But then he persuaded me and I took them off. We went to bed and made love. It was wonderful and I had very good feelings after it was over.

I was on a narrow train heading through a rural area, heading for the interior. On the right hand side it was all green, and on the left hand side was clean shallow water on the riverbed. The train went off the tracks and I was thrown into the water. I looked back and noticed that I was floating. But I was able to return to the train after a little bit of thought and using my mental powers.

I am gathering herbs in the field with my sweetheart. Afterwards, we go to a ritual ceremony in a circle, but I can't go into the ceremony because I do not have the pole that is required for entrance. Suddenly, someone gives a pole to me. Then I run to the ritual ceremony to get a blessing. I go out, leaving the pole there. Several chiefs who are running the ritual ceremony take my pole and other peoples' poles and dance around them. They are completing the ritual.

I dreamed that the door of my house was opened by accident. I was afraid of what might happen and who might come in. The house in the dream was the house where I lived as a child, not the house where I live now. But the fear was strong, and it remained with me throughout the dream.

In this dream, I am preparing to tell a dream to a group. It is about a tower that is ten stories high. It is a hard, plastic tower. When I'm up in the tower, it begins to fall down. I'm afraid of what will happen and close my eyes. When I am in the middle of the fall, I open my eyes and see a way I can escape the tower. In fact, I lead many people to safety.

I am in a group and we are discussing the goal of a series of tasks at my place of work -- my office. We are all unclear as to the objectives. Then a theatrical group arrives and asks what kind of clothes my relatives will use at the production of the play. I answer that they will be wearing Arabian clothes. I am curious because the original question about our objective had not been answered before the actors arrived.

I am in a dark place. It is night and I am crossing a huge river. Some wood, perhaps large trees, appears to be floating on the water. I am afraid of that movement. I do cross the river, but I can not get rid of my anxiety. It is so dark that I am concerned for my safety.

I was at a farm that I had inherited at some point in the dream. The farm was a huge place, with a farmhouse. Each place I looked was more beautiful than the place before. It had gardens that were especially beautiful. It was discovering this inheritance slowly, and was enjoying my exploration.

In this dream, an old aunt came to visit me. In waking life, she never did this, so I was very happy in the dream. But when she arrived, she moved around all of my furniture, changing the places where I had put them. I did not like the changes, but I thought as soon as the visit was over I would put the furniture back the way I liked it.

I had a dream about my ex-husband. I awakened in peace. We separated about two years ago, and in my dream we were happy that we were no longer living together. I said that our separation was for the best, and he agreed with me. We should have no regrets about our separation and our divorce.

I am with a very good friend in the city of Ouro Preto, and we are talking about a case we heard of in which a young man, sixteen years of age, was buried after he was killed. We continued to talk, but the shock of this was so upsetting that we forgot to buy the things that we had planned to purchase.

A female friend of mine bought a small piece of meat and was prepared to guard it. I asked her why she needed so much security. In my hands, I found moths that threatened to spoil the meat, so then I knew why she had to guard it. So seeing the moths answered my own question.

I am at a farm. I want to go to the farmhouse. I connect the horse to a carriage with two of its legs, but connect its other two legs to my car. On the way to the farmhouse, the connection falls apart and two of its legs become detached from the body and run off with the carriage. I notice all of this with a feeling of impotence. In the city, a friend sees the horse and notices a hole in its stomach. He puts a knife in the hole, and I am afraid that the horse will die. Then I see the head of the horse separated from its body. That horse was sweet and never got enough sympathy for its hard work.

My godmother has just died and left two small sons behind. I lived with her in her beautiful house and liked it very much. But this big house must now be sealed. I am sorry because her two beautiful sons must be sent away, and the beautiful house I liked so much must be closed.

I dreamed that I was just starting to go to sleep and recalled that I should remember a dream for the weekend workshop. I had a dream, but couldn't remember it. In my dream, I wake up happy because at least I had a dream. I go to a sad group of people, and share with them that I had a dream and remembered that I had a dream. The group asked me how I did it. I told them I put a paper and a gun by my head. Then I remembered that I dreamed. But I didn't tell them that I did not remember what had happened in the dream.

I'm at Stan Krippner's dream group. It is being held in my parents' house and yet it isn't quite my parents' house. It is in Brasilia, and at the same time it is an ancient town. There are a lot of people there, some who I know as family and friends, and some who I don't know. Through a glass door, I see some people outside. They are sick. Some are dying and some are dead. I incorporate an Indian shaman. This is facilitated by somebody who is there. The shaman I incorporated has the powers of visions and healing. I have a bowl of water and salt. There are lots of plants outside this room. I start to pour the water on the plant sand the people. I sing a song many times, like a mantra. I go up to a balcony and throw water outside, singing, "The plants should be saved, the people should be saved, everything should be saved. They should be saved from their own pain. Love heals."

I'm in my apartment. I have received three bear cubs. They are beautiful, white, and small -- like puppies. I hold them are caress them. A week later there is a party at my house. I go to play with the bear cubs and notice that they have grown a lot. They are not white anymore but dark brown. One comes to play with me. He stands upon his back paws, supporting his front paws on my chest. I feel scared because of his size. He is enormous! He makes a sound while looking into my eyes, and his teeth show. He is only greeting me, but I feel scared. I realize that the bears are transforming themselves into what they are -- wild animals! Right after this, the apartment becomes filled with people. I am apprehensive that I will have to make my children and guests aware of the bears, and tell them not to play with the bears because they can get hurt without the bears meaning to do it.

I am watching a movie in which a conflict is being solved. The problems revolve around a mother getting her daughters back from someone. After the film ends, I go to meet friends of mine to make a test of a propaganda film. My friends and I are acting in the film, and the director tells us not to forget our lines.

There was a guerrilla group, and a belonged to the group without knowing why. We entered a train with a promise that we would receive ammunition. We continued our voyage to the interior or Sao Paulo, and some people received arms and ammunition, but only those who were thirty or forty years of age. The old ones, the children, and the adolescents would be defended by us. We continued with fear, and paid attention, watching for the appearance of a group of enemies. The situation was that the train traveled very slowly. We received training in how to use the arms, and then -- at this moment -- achieved the objective of our struggle without having to fight. At this moment, I was with another woman, walking over the trails while the train went back. We passed a group of armed men mounted on horses, but they seemed not to see us. We hid our weapons behind our bodies but, actually, nobody looked for them. Further ahead, we boarded the train again at a little train station in the middle of the country. It had lost its way in the middle of a field of ripe wheat. At last, we approached the city again without having engaged in a conflict, even though we had been prepared for this confrontation but were afraid of it.

There was an open book, and I had to change its pages. A mandala suddenly appeared with people dancing in a circle, and I remembered a karmic wheel. After that, Ana and Felipe, a couple of friends of mine, were in the living room with me, and I said to them, "Everything fell down on me because I'm busy all the time, and it's a shit." Ana signaled me with her hands and eyes, telling me the news that she will give a gift to me. After that, I'm in the living room of my house. My son Gustavo is hidden in a dark place, and I see that he is looking for me with the same expression that my mother used to have.

I met my father who died some twenty years ago. We entered into a friendly dialogue, and finished with a lovely embrace. I walked up to him with a good sensation. The emotion was pleasant to me. Meeting with my father was good, and I could feel his presence close to me.

My dream takes place in a cloudy atmosphere in which the people are rather dim. It appears that a woman is there who is not doing anything but sleep. Then she starts to dream about various workers, artists, designers, and others who are sitting on a large table. Francisco represents the "third class" and he is there. I see many people but am able to identify my friend Francisco (who is in my class in waking life). This group has made designs that contain symbols. We do not know what they represent. A wise old man is able to interpret them. Meanwhile, we are not able to make them ourselves. We try again, and still can not make them ourselves. Some people, including me, say, "We are not able to interpret them. We are not going to be able to make them." (I woke up then and wrote down this part, then went back to sleep.) We are happy and joyous because we have deciphered the designs. The old man was knowledgeable and we took the opportunity to have a reunion with him and he taught us the meaning. We were happy and at peace.

I am on a beach, bathing in the ocean, and the waves start to become strong, pulling me away from the land. I struggle to leave the water but a barrier of land starts to form to counter the force of the waves. I am sliding toward an upward slope of this land, but it is difficult to leave the water. I am just about to suffocate, and then I wake up, feeling relief.

I am at a seaport inside of a night club with music and dancing. One fellow is dancing with a young woman. I want to dance, but have no partner. I have a business that has to do with arts and crafts. I look into a mirror and notice that my hair is short and my nose is ugly. Nearby is a blackboard and a piece of chalk. I see written words that read, "Communication from the shamans." A cat meows across from me. I am in accord with the cat and understand this is the communication. Then I wake up. But I go back to sleep to finish the dream. The cat is persecuted and is wet. It is sitting, then suddenly changes into a large rabbit that makes jokes and laughs. It "play acts" with other people. Children enter. Some children run to the beach and take a bath in the sea.

I am in a community which occupies a large building with many rooms. But I am in a closed space with no windows and little light. A pregnant female friend offers medicine to my family. She comes on to me sexually even though she is pregnant with her third child. This not the first time she has come on to me. She always does this when she is about to give birth. We find her husband in bed with another woman. We ask, "Why do you do this at the end of your wife's pregnancy?" He says, "Basically, I love my wife." But he says he is a shaman and he needs a younger woman and massage when his wife is about to give birth. I ask, "Why am I not a shaman?" He is massaging his daughter, then he touches me. I am in a blanket. I can feel emotion and spend a lot of time crying. Unknown people are taking care of me, but there is a civil war going on outside the community. Only when there is no pain can I shift to another feeling. I can not move. I think what is missing is compassion. The dream covers several days, and I can not move for several days. I enter a dream group and the leader suggests I discuss my feelings. It is tough to get in touch with feelings. This discussion integrates my daughter into the process.

I was climbing a hill. I knew it was just a dream. Suddenly, I saw a very poor house from outside. Later, I was inside but did not know how, because I did not see any door or window. I knew I could wake up, but I preferred to see what else would happen. Suddenly, I looked at the roof and realized that it was catching fire. I was frightened because I wanted to get out but I couldn't. A little later I saw myself outside the house, and saw the flames destroying it. I was wearing a white dress. There was a hole in the wall which I believe I made.

In this dream I am in a convent with Pedro, the great love of my life. He is a very simple man, a fisherman, but he loves another woman. She is very rich and he wants to have the things she can provide. My brothers observe me, and wonder why I would be interested in a poor man. So I leave him and have a reunion with some apostles of Jesus Christ who I have met before. One of the men is very old. He wants to sing and dance the same way he did when we first met. We go to an outside patio for this inspirational interaction.

My husband and I are in a big house with many windows and doors, all of them open. People on the street are saying there is going to be an invasion. I try to close all the windows and doors but many locks are not functioning. There is a man working in the balcony; I ask him to watch out for the invasion. We both see small children coming. Soon one of the boys is in the room. I grab him, hold him like a bag, and kill him. But there are others coming. I run to the balcony. The worker is no longer in control; the children have shoved him aside. I get the worker's ax to protect myself and the worker. I close the doors that give access to the internal part of the house, which becomes dark. I protect myself, the worker, and my husband this way.

In this dream, I am talking with my husband. He says that it is a nice day but that it will rain soon. It does rain, and my body dissolves into the rain. I feel very light and now am just like the rain. I feel that my soul has been cleansed internally.

I am in an ecological park with two male friends and some children who I do not know. Suddenly, we are being bitten by mosquitoes. The bites begin to swell. I warn my friends to go for cover, but they do not believe me. They do not believe they have been bitten. I put on mosquito repellent, and also apply it to the children. But my friends continue to laugh at me; they think it is funny that I am applying repellent. Then we enter an opening in the trees and a green light shines on us bringing tranquility and enlightenment. My friends now say, "We really were bitten."

Some female friends and I are cultivating a garden in a natural setting. We find some stones in the earth, and two of them are crystals. One of these is impure because it contains streaks of metal. The other is clear and pure. A young boy asked me for one of them and I give him the impure crystal. But he wants the pure crystal to protect him spiritually. At this moment one of my friends leaves the garden and offers both of us some coconut candy.

I dream that I am surrounded by a number of snakes. They are crawling all over the road on which I am walking. I am determined to reach a building, and I enter the first floor. A small boy in a wheelchair is there, and he looks quite sick, both physically and psychologically. His movements are limited. I watch as he throws himself over the railing and through the window on to the road, apparently trying to hurt himself.

A man who loves me calls me from his passing automobile. I ride with him in the front of the car, and another woman is in the back seat. We pass a bank, and I see my parents in front of the bank. Half way down the road, he turns around and kisses the other woman.

I dream that I hear a little bell that is ringing. Then I am falling. I have the sensation of absolute freedom as I drop into the emptiness. I realize that I am dreaming, and I enjoy the sensation which is quite spiritual in nature.

I am dressed in a transparent gown at a party. People are drinking, eating, and communicating with each other through phones or face-to-face. This is my home, and I see some dog feces. I try to clean them up when no one is looking. A baby appears and I kiss him, and he gives me a white rose to hold in my hand. I use it to hide the marijuana cigarette I am smoking because I see the police arriving. There is some type of an alliance, and Stan Krippner is there to supervise it. He also brigs a crystal which will complement the white rose.

I am with a child about two months of age. He is in my arms. I am going to take him away in a gold airplane that is just landing. I think the child is sleeping but now he makes a very noisy sound, and I tell him to be quiet as I am about ready to sleep. Instead, he urinates and I have no choice but to let the urine fall on me. Finally, I see his aunt and give the boy to his aunt. But I am still wet all over.

I am with a group of people, and then one woman starts to run. I see her passing by my side wearing a bright red scarf. As she passes, she is crying about how tragic her life is. Then I try to cheer her up by telling her some of the tragedies in my life. I began to cry, and she asks me what is tragic about my life. Slowly I stop crying and pull myself together, but now the woman is far ahead of my in the race.

I am on the edge of a building and I start falling. So I wouldn't fall, I toss my shoes down. They hit a woman on the head and she explodes and dies! I am accused of murder but protest that I am innocent of the woman's death.

A fisherman throws his net into the sea. Then he pulls it back and there are many fish in the net. He puts them in a basket. Some he tosses back into the sea. I ask him why he does this. He responds, "Because some fish are ready and some are not."

I am in a room that has a direct communication channel to spiritual beings. I am teaching a class and am in an advisory capacity to several people around me. I am carrying a light with me, and the light is to illuminate the people I teach. The light brings tranquility to me and to them. It has spiritual significance to us all.

There is a voice that comes to me from a distance, like from a cellular phone. It says one word, "Mahata." I hear the word over and over again, and suspect that is a spiritual command or a person I am to contact. But there is no further clue given.

I dreamed that a spiritual entity descends. It is an angel. The angel has light beams coming from its eyes and from its hands. These beams of green light are important. The angel channels information to me, telling me that I am to send light to all the people of the world.

I dream that I see an Indian man running. He has a knife in his hand, and is being chased by a leopard. I watch him fight with the leopard and am frightened. But them I stop being a witness and become the Indian in the exact moment that the leopard jumps on him. I wake up, go back to sleep, and have the same dream. But this time I am the leopard and attack the Indian!

I am in an ancient place embalming a mummy. The mummy has its arms outstretched in the form of a cross. It gives forth a sacred feeling. I feel happy that I have found this relic from the past and am preserving it.

I am with various men and women in an amusement park. It is a place to take rides that fly into the air. I enter the ride, but others are fearful and stay away. One man who is in charge of the ride offers me a place to sit and a safety belt. I accept the suggestion and fly very high. I feel an enormous sensation of good feeling while flying. It is a marvelous feeling, and I feel successful in this attempt and am glad I accepted the invitation.

I am near to my two parents in their home town. One of them -- my mother -- is nearer to me, while the other -- my father -- is at a distance. Even so, there is a brilliant light around him, and he is saying my name, Estiel very clearly. Then a black serpent appears baring its teeth. I feel fearful and perplexed but continue to listen to the sound of my name. The serpent continues to advance until it is at my feet. Then I understand that it is nothing to fear but is part of the spiritual message of my father.

I am with a number of people in a playground outside. One of the structures is something to hang from with your hands, and the cord reminds me of an umbilical cord as appears in childbirth. I began to fly with that cord, under the direction of a man who is like a spiritual guide. I fly higher and higher, and have a great feeling of well-being. The breeze is very pleasant and the pleasure is indescribable. There is a female friend with me, and she enjoys herself too.

I am reading a German newspaper story about a little girl named Anne Brown. Then I start looking for her desperately, thinking that she might have been kidnapped by some men. A hydroplane is overhead and I think she is in the hydroplane with some men and women. But the moment I see the plane, a woman falls out of the plane and seems to die on impact. Another woman tries to revive her and the fallen woman fights for survival. I surmise that Anne Brown is still in the airplane. By means of magic I enter the plane and save the girl. The men try to stop us from leaving the plane; I watch them shooting at us with guns. But we get to the ground and Anne Brown is saved.

I dream that I am driving a car but am sitting in the passenger's seat. The pedals of the car are very low, and so is the passenger's seat. It is raining very hard. My son is in the back seat. I have to adjust the speed of the car so that we are safe. Suddenly, I find myself on the driver's side of the car. I see our house directly ahead and know that we are safe.

I dreamed that I am in the middle of some sand dunes. I need to get someplace but I fall down because it is difficult to run through the sand dunes. There are mounds of sand, but I finally move through them successfully and reach my destination.

I am in the meat market, and I am watching the butcher slice up the meat. There is much blood as he cuts the meat into pieces. Then it is dawn and I am home with my boy friend. We have made love at night. But I receive a telephone call that it is time to go to the market again and get some food for the day.

I am in a natural environment walking hand-in-hand with a female friend. There are signs saying "Stop," "Prohibited," and "Danger." We continue to walk, and I step on to a poisonous thorn that injures my foot. I am afraid that I am going to die. But my friend brings my mother and my boy friend who rescue me. My boyfriend gives me a kiss and I feel much better.

I am in an outdoor place that is very beautiful. I meet a pretty little girl. She has lovely hair and attractive eyes. We embrace strongly, and she seems filled with longing for someone. I tell her she has been waiting too long, but now she has found someone who can help her be healthy.

I am in an open space where the land has the color of chocolate. There is an enormous hole and at the bottom sits a woman who calls me to join her. I accommodate her, and she takes a piece of earth and puts it in my hand. I am surprised at this offer, but take it anyway because I want to be gentle and polite.

I dreamed that I encountered a crazy man who was disfigured. He thought he was Napoleon and was imprisoned in a cage. I felt afraid that he would harm me, not physically but through what he would say. I covered his cage with a piece of grey cloth and turned off the lights so I would not have to see him.

I dreamed that I was watching members of my family being hurt by strangers, both men and women, who I did not know. And then I watched these strangers commit acts of aggression toward friends of mine. They strike them in the face and back. My friends and relatives tried to run away, but it was too late and some of them died.

I dreamed that I was seeing a lot food, and started to eat it. When I began to chew the food, it did not have any taste. Then a voice said to me, "You fool, the food does not taste like anything because this is just a dream!" I could not see the source of the voice.

I dreamed that I could see some Indians making a dream-catcher that would catch the helpful dreams and keep out the harmful dreams. Meanwhile a voice from an invisible spirit said something very touching and beautiful: "When this dream-catcher is ready, you will be able to retain, within yourself, the dreams that are inside a dream." I was successful in using the dream-catcher. I had a very inspirational feeling when I woke up.

I dreamed that I was in a church. It was the wedding ceremony of a niece. She arrived dressed in red. It was a short dress, very sexy. After the wedding, an unknown young woman caught my niece's bouquet; she was also going to get married. My gift to my niece was a doll. After the wedding, my sister and the bride's mother left, but the bride's father went with the wedding couple on their honeymoon.

I am at a meeting and there is lots of confusion, many people moving around and talking. There is loud music so I can barely hear them. I was feeling frustrated because I was translating for someone but could not hear him. I walked away. He called me back because he wanted to teach the group a breathing lesson. An old friend is sitting near me, and as he and I do the breathing exercise we can actually see the air or energy coming out of our and going into each other's body. It takes on a sexual overtone and I am scared, walking away from him. Then I see him pulling a big green and yellow snake from the ground, and he puts it around his neck. I tell him not to do this because the snake will get away and he will lose control. It is too late. He puts the snake back on the ground, but it comes after me! An older woman and I start running. Someone kills the snake and it explodes on me. I start to cry because I am covered with blood. Someone tells me to take a bath and dress in white.

I am a bird, a bird of the desert. I am flying across the land and see a tribe below. They are procuring food. The warriors are in front and the old men, women, and children are behind them. They do not have the strength to keep up with the warriors. Some of them are leaving the road to die. I feel a great compassion for these people but can do nothing about it. I fly to the top of a mountain. I feel strong with great power and then remember the tribal children who are dying and start to cry.

I am sleeping in a room where there is also a nun. She moves her hands in my direction, and I receive some energy from her. I feel the energy. It is very strong. I feel the energy enter my hands and arms. I integrate it into my body and feel good about it.

I am in a place that seems to be a pyramid. From the top of the pyramid shines a light, apparently from the sun. I am dressed in clothes with rustic colors. Another person is talking with me telepathically. We are to make a procession with a few other people, with them in front and the rest of us in back.

This dream was about my brother. A large yellow dog is watching us. I approach my brother to help him. The top of his head opens up, and from it comes various white insects. I am puzzled because I do not know what I can do to help him. But I wish I could have a dog like the one that is watching us.

I dreamed I was with a woman [who I had met a few days earlier in waking life]. She works with pulses and wanted me to enlist me for a session. During the session, she said "Your friend Yussarahas cancer, and you must ask her about this." At the end of my session, she showed me a short film. It was about the number 5.[The other day I telephoned Yussara and told her my dream. She told me that she had just been to a physician who told her she still has cancer. She was first diagnosed in 1989 but I did not know this.]

I was in the countryside where I was looking in the direction of a large tree, with a bird. It had large eyes and a prominent beak. I could see it had green eyes like mine. It was placed directly in my shadow. I could see that it wanted food. But it had difficulty eating, even though I gave it some corn. It continued to stare at me with its penetrating eyes.

A projectile is hitting me on the left side of my head. I try to escape it, and run into a tunnel. But there is a war going on there. I am some sort of doctor and save a man who is injured in the war. I am successful in what I do.

It is the end of the world. I am with a group of people who are trying to escape the water that is coming to cover us. We are very sad as the entire planet starts to become completely inundated. We are able to swim on the top of the waves, at least for a time.

Some female friends of mine and I are in a jungle where we are to meet some Indians. There are a few flowers around. The Indians arrive and they have snakes on their arms. They tell us that they have direct instructions for our group. We are to go take a bath and then jump from the top of a tree to the earth below where there is an enormous lion. I also see a toucan, and know it will help us as we jump.

I am in a place where I have to make decisions. My shoes are dirty. I look down and see that they are planted in the ground. If I leave the area, I will have to leave my shoes there because they are planted. There are three pieces of earth that I can transplant to another place. I am afraid to transplant them and move, but this is my destiny. I take one piece of earth and leave without my shoes.

I am in a civilization in a place that is the middle of the Indian Ocean. It has a perfect ecosystem. Life is integrated. Love and harmony pervade everything. There is a turbulence in the ocean, but it is only temporary. I like this place and believe that what I have done earlier in life was very superficial.

I am walking on a beach. A man and a woman approach me and say that this is the sea of the lamas. I can enjoy myself here, and it will be good for my health. So I am relaxing and a lama comes up. He approaches me. I feel good about his presence.

I had reported to work at a new job. In the office, there were many men and women. They all said it was necessary for me to have sex with them. Most of them were black people. I started to have sex with them because they said it was necessary for my work. But then I saw a door, and went through it and escaped.

I dreamed that the Baby Jesus of Prague appeared to me. I also saw our Lady of Caravajo. I felt that I knew her already. She was another form of the Virgin Mary who has been very close to me. Then I walked toward a church. In front of the church I saw two dead birds.

I was with a group of women taking part in a shamanic ritual. We are standing in a circle. We start to dance, still in the circle. We are all trying to remember the ceremony -- when we dance, when we slow down, and when we stand quite still.

I am in the apartment where I used to live. I am cleaning the kitchen and feel a strange presence. I think it may be thieves. There are two strangers who arrive, and they frighten me. They help me clean my apartment. They place molds and frames around all the light in the apartment. They give a box filled with three crystals, dolls, and other nice things. I keep the box open so that others can see it.

I am at this school, in a room with a dozen other women. There are huge pillows in the room. It is night. My cot is near the window. They are all sleeping. But I am trying to learn something and look out the window. I get bruised as I look out the window. [Today I have red and purple bruise marks on my body.]

I am in a school, but I am lost. I am studying chemistry. I do not know how to get out of the building. Then I discover an exit, and find myself outside. Then I see a lion. I am filled with fear. But I find an enormous watch, and this diverts the lion. Then the lion becomes calm.

I am with a man who is very old and who is shining with brilliant light. He calls me to accompany him, and I feel love toward him. I want to accompany him, and we go to catch a train. He talks with me about the art of the Renaissance, where people acquired a new perception of life. He gives me some liquid, and tells me that if I drink this I will die and be reborn. I drink it and die. Then I am in another lifetime, in a castle, and go into the catacombs of the castle. I find another liquid there. I drink it and revive. I walk outside and there is a woman with black horses. She says she means to do harmful things to me, and is preparing some herbs that I must eat.
