But I fight her magic with the magic of love given to me by the man of light. I win, and celebrate my victory with music and dance.

I dreamed that I was again an adolescent. There were two young men who were flirting with me. My sister and I were in a house, and they were trying to get in. But my mother did not like them. She locked the door and locked the window. One of them came up to the window and I could see him smiling.

I dreamed that I was on the beach with my mother. We were resting on a mattress. We saw some green snakes coming close to us. One of the snakes was a nagua -- the sacred snake that protected Buddha. It was mostly green with some red color on it. I did not feel fear; I was very impressed.

I am in a lake diving. There is a swimming instructor there. He and I dive to the bottom of the lake. The water is deep and there are small waves on top. As I go to the bottom, I feel a jelly-like creature. I see that it is a large insect. It bites me in the leg and I can feel the pain. My leg turns red where it bit me.

I am in Rio de Janeiro where my son is about to graduate. I am with my nephews and we are trying to find the place where the graduation will occur. My nephews are going to school in Rio too. But it is very dark and we fall into the mud. There is water nearby, and we wash ourselves off.

I dream of seeing the devil. I am frightened so call upon my angel. My lips are dry. I am alone but know my angel will protect me. There is nothing else I can do. I make an invocation but find it hard to speak out loud.

There is a hole and I descend into it. I see a primitive man. Is he an Indian? A cannibal? I do not know. I go by him into a clearing. There are trees with many leaves. I hear voices and see two tigers. I am frightened. I realize that I am the prey of the tigers and that they want to eat me.

I was here in the school classroom with other students, both male and female. Then the dream began to turn into a nightmare. I was incorporating entities. I was resisting them, but they entered me anyway. I fought them as hard as I could. One female entity wanted very much to enter me, but I was firm and refused to let her do it.

I had a dream about Professor Cicero from the university. He is meditating with his eyes closed. I can see an aura around his body. Suddenly an amethyst appears in the middle of his head. It is an enormous stone and it represents his "third eye." I think that Professor Cicero must have a great deal of spiritual power.

I am in a very large prison; everything is white. There is a very malevolent man there, a fakir from India. He looks into my eyes and explains his intention. He wants to harm me in some way. I find a sword and I cut off his head. I have a very strong sensation as I kill him, it is very disagreeable, and very realistic. But I had to do this to save my life.

I am flying in the sky and meet an angel. I ask the angel if she can help my daughter find a job. The angel smiles. The angel gives me a large egg. A bird comes out of the egg. The angel says one word, "North." I think the angel has done something to help my daughter find a job.

I dreamed that a man told me he was interested in the course I teach on neurolinguistic programming. He said that there were going to be many changes in his life, and that he would take the course so that I could help him out. The man seemed to be the brother of a woman I know, and he said he was dying of cancer. [Later, I talked with this woman and described the man in my dream. The description fit her brother exactly, and he does have cancer.]

I dreamed that I was with a group of friends making a tour of the city, and Stanley Krippner was with us. We were all on a bus together talking. We got off the bus to continue our tour on foot. But we returned after the bus had left. Stanley told us not to worry because we could always catch another bus. And in a few minutes another bus came, and we all boarded it.

I dreamed about a situation where I fought to stay alive. Someone had captured a group of people, and I was among the captives. We passed from house to house, and each time we moved there were fewer people because some of us had been exterminated. Suddenly, I was passing through water and I could see the powerful man who was conducting the murder of these people. I felt a great deal of fear.

I dream about an eagle. By the shape and the colors, I can tell that it is an American eagle, the kind that appears on anything connected with the United States. I feel strong, but the appearance of the eagle makes me feel stronger. Then a snake appears, with many colors on its body.

I am in a cavern that is the color of mud. I take a deep dive into the underground river. There is lots of water but the river is narrow, running underneath the earth. It leads to an underground lake. The walls of the cavern are humid and wet, and I get mud on my naked body. The sensation is one of great pleasure, and I spread it out over my skin. And the sensation of the earth gives me a sensation like an orgasm, even though I am alone. Afterwards I feel pregnant, and at the same time filled with strength and delight. But I do not give birth to a baby but to all of humanity.

In my dream I am swimming with a dolphin that gives me joy and renewal when I am with it. A goddess appears and starts to sing to me. Serpents appear, and they join the song. Usually I am afraid of serpents, but in the dream they bring me much happiness.

I dream that a band of bats is flying around me. It is night. I know that to get out of trouble, I will have to fight them, and break the wings of some of these bats. But I am terrified of the bats and thought of having to fight with them.

I am swimming in a deep sea without any type of equipment, not even a cap I can use to cover my head. I come out of the sea and go to a bridge. I discover that I am now wearing a cap filled with pom-poms. As I watch the sea, I see a manta ray swim by. The manta ray is smiling and is also wearing a pom-pom cap.

I am climbing a mountain with a group of people. It is difficult but we want to reach the Indians on the top so they will pass their teachings on to us. A woman starts to feel badly because of the altitude. She could not climb the last 100 feet. We give her a substance with a form. She becomes euphoric and falls asleep. An Indian asks why we are late and we tell him about the sick lady. He asks how we gave her the substance and we tell him. He digs into the ground and finds an indigenous form. He blows on it, and uses it to feed the substance to the lady. She wakes up, is fine, and we climb to meet the Indians.

I am climbing up some stairs made of tiles. Suddenly I am stopped by a wall. I manage to crawl and slide down to the floor and around the wall. In the meantime, some objects fall down and the noise indicates that they were very high. I see powerful balloons floating down of different shapes. They are oriental, beautiful, and very colorful. The steps appear again and the balloons greet me warmly. The stairs become flat and I am in the corridor and bleachers of a sports gymnasium. People are not sitting looking at the arena, but at tables looking at each other.

I am attending a workshop on dreams, but it is happening 15 years ago. The male coordinator of the workshop gives me a check and I let it fall into the corridor from my purse. It is 200 Brazilian bills and bears the signature of my client who gave it to the coordinator the night before. To warm up the group, the coordinator has all checks given to him; he shuffles them. As a group dynamic exercise, he has us each take one check and has us guess whose signature is on it. I do this, but select my own check. He asks people to notice each others' bodies, breathing patterns, and sounds. He has one group make sounds of the forest, and the other group sounds of a grasshopper. I start to make grasshopper sounds but he tells me to make forest sounds instead. I tell him I will make the noises I want to make. The blend of noises is very harmonious just like a forest. The coordinator asks us for our sensations and I say I feel like a fish. I visually people in circles, like we are in a huge aquarium. Suddenly I see a shark jumping into the middle but it tries to escape. I open my eyes and notice that the coordinator is watching me with a smile that is both satisfied and sarcastic. I hold back my anger.

I was in a large room, airy, nice white curtains on the windows. I was in a wooden bed with white sheets on it. I was making love with a man, exchanging sensual words and touches delicately. I saw the shadow of my mother coming in. She told me that a lion was coming. The man said that if I would fall to the floor, the lion would not attack her. Before he finished speaking, I had already dropped to the floor and felt the rigidity of the sleeping lion's body. Very carefully, I raised my hand to touch the lion's mane and mouth. The lion awakened and roared; the lion bit me. I caressed him and he accepted my caresses. The man was now kissing me on my legs. I was happy and thrilled.

I was in my mother's home. She was very happy to see me, and she gave me a gift. It was a book I had wanted to buy for a longtime. But it was a rare book, and I did not know where I could find it. But my mother had tracked it down and had given it tome. I was happy, and she shared my happiness.

I am with some kittens who are frolicking and having fun. But there is a plague of some sort and the kittens get sick. I try to get the kittens to an animal doctor who can help them. But by the time I reach the office, the kittens are breathing their last. As we enter the building, there is no sign of life. I am very sorry that the kittens are dead.

I am near two rivers, one in front of a house and one in back of a house. I think, "Here I am going to die. This is the end of everything." There is a woman who asks me not to leave her alone. I think that she is going to die too. I hold her hand. Together we go through the storm, and wade through the overflowing rivers. We walk along the terrace of the house. I think that if we drown, we will be together.

I am in a female friend's house. There is a hallway in the house and all of a sudden in front of the house there is a mud slide. A river of mud and rocks comes down close to the door. I think that is will come into the house, but instead it goes its way in front. It destroys everything that is in its path.

I am with Jim Morrison, the rock star, in a rehearsal hall. For some reason, I start attacking him. Jim Morrison says that if I stop hitting him, he will sing me a song. I agree and I stop my attack. Morrison is very grateful and thanks me. To keep his promise, he sings me one of his songs. It is about a bird.

I am in a taxi with someone who gets out while I continue my journey. I look at my watch and see that it is 3:57PM. At 4:00PMI have to catch a ship. I tell the taxi driver to hurry. I arrive at the port and the ship is still there. I go to a building where there is a ticket office. Then I realize that I have left my baggage at home. The man in the ticket office tells me there is another ship at 7:00PM. The taxi is waiting for me, and takes me back to my home.

I was a few blocks from my house, in my neighborhood, going to a place called "The Convent." I was looking for my sister. Before the received me at The Convent, they received other members of my family, my in-laws. I came into this house by aside door. The place is near the kitchen and two young women receive me. One of them hugs me. She is a beautiful woman in a lovely dress. Then my sister finishes meeting with some other people and comes over to me, joking. I like her attitude, but it surprises me at the same time. She has three problems for me, but I can not answer any of them. (In waking life, I do not have a sister.)

(Recurring dream) I am in a place like a forest. In the shadow of an old building there is a well with its opening covered by spider webs. I am walking around the edge of the well. I am attracted by its darkness in the depth but the fear I feel keeps me from falling, and I just keep walking around and around the edge.

I am in a minibus and I know we are going off a dirt road, and we are going to fall from a cliff. I am reclined in my seat and I see, while the bus is shaking a little, a beautiful blue sky, more beautiful than any sky I have ever seen before. There is almost no window, there is only the minibus and the sky. I am afraid. I feel vertigo in my chest and in my stomach. But I am amazed at the sky. I think, "Well, now I know what it means to be close to death." This thought gives me peace, because I know my spirit will survive.

(Recurring dream) I am walking along a path and everything in the dream is taking different forms and aspects -- people are turning into trees, buildings are turning into animals, animals are turning into other things. I keep walking because what is happening around me does not bother me at all. In fact, I think it is rather nice.

I am on a mountain of sand. It is sediment of some sort. I go to the top of the mountain and see a large city in a valley between two rocky mountains. I call a friend over and tell him to look at the sight. We can see hundreds of buildings and other portions of this huge city from where we are standing.

(Lucid dream) I am fighting a man who has jumped on me, and I am losing the fight. Then I realize, "this is only a dream." The knowledge that I am dreaming, gives me an advantage, and I escape the grasp of the man who had attacked me. I find my way to safety in a large house where he will never find me.

I am with some people planning a celebration. They say, "This is the Year of the Dragon." They decorate the rooms of the building we are in, and they say that the outsides must be decorated too in time for a big parade of celebration. I want to join the plans but do not seem to fit in.

I see a strange man sneaking up on me. I jump him and throw him to the ground. He looks very cruel, and I think that my attack was justified. But he asks me why I was so mean to him, and then I wonder if I was too quick in my judgment about him.

I was participating in group session. It was a class and we were sharing our memories. Our teacher seemed to be very wise. Each time we shared a memory, he told us how that event had been significant in our spiritual development. I decided that he was a spiritual teacher, and was making these interpretations for our benefit. In fact, I was lucky that I ended up in the class, as I registered for it my accident. I had meant to go into another class instead.

(Precognitive) I had a dream about a terrible accident. I saw a car smash into the window of an office building right in downtown Buenos Aires. I was afraid to look closely because I knew that many people were killed. So I sort of walked around the accident and did not look closely. I could hear the sirens of the police cars and knew that ambulances were coming. (A few days later, I read about such an accident in the newspaper.)

I was with a man who I knew in school. He says, "Why don't you invite me to your house? I would like to stay with you and renew old school ties." I get angry and attack him verbally. I say, "What right do you have to invite yourself to my house to stay, especially since we have not seen each other for years. I thought we could have a pleasant chat, and you start making demands on me."

I am in my house. My father asked me how my day had gone. I told him that a business associate had belittled me in some way. I got my father's sympathy. But actually I was the one who had insulted my colleague. I just was feeling mean that day.

I am in a restaurant near to the house of a friend who works with me. He had wanted to meet me there, and I agreed. But the food that we ordered did not arrive. I asked if the service was always so slow. He said that it was slow, but the quality of the beef made up for the poor service.

I was watching a game in a soccer stadium. I recall that my team was winning and I was cheering for them. I think I would have won some money on the event if my team had won. But they didn't. I think the game was fun to watch, even though my team did not win and I did not get any money as a result.

I start to go to a bus stop. I see some friends from my office. They were planning to take the same bus, and we all get on the same one. They talk to me about problems in the office, and I think they this was not a good idea. I tell them, "Stop talking about problems in the office. This is the weekend and I want to have some fun and forget about those office problems."

I go to a store to buy some supplies. I need to repair my automobile and am told that this store has the best equipment. I am impressed by the tires, especially. But they are very expensive and I do not know if I can afford to buy them. I ask the clerk if I can get a special bargain, but I am turned down.

I am in a traffic jam. I could not move my automobile to the left or to the right. I start to get hungry. I think that I will not get home in time for dinner. I might not even get home in time to go the bed. I might be in this traffic jam until the next morning. My office building is very near, and I can imagine going directly from the traffic jam to my office in about ten hours. I do not like the idea at all.

I am walking down a corridor on my way to the bathroom. I want very badly to go in, but the door is locked. I bang on the door and hear a female's voice saying, "I am not done yet." I tell her, "You had been get done in a hurry because there are other people waiting and you have no right to tie up the bathroom for so long."

In this dream, I am very young again and see myself in the house where I was raised. But there are no family members in the house, only strangers. I feel lost and wonder if these strangers could be my new family. I was walking into the kitchen and the food smelled very good. I thought that it would not be so bad to live in this family because they were good cooks.

(Precognitive dream) I had a dream that I was invited to my friend's house for dinner. We work at the office but we do not get together socially. In fact, I always thought that he was superior to me. So, in the dream, I accept with great happiness. I never to get to the house in this dream because I walk a long ways and can't quite find the location. (But in waking life, he does invite me out to lunch a few days later.)

I was out of doors, and started walking to the mountains. I heard a voice, and I thought that perhaps it was the voice of God. The voice said, "Look to the top of the mountains because that will give you strength to face the adversities of life." I thought to myself that I would always remember that command when I hiked in the mountains, and decided to do this more regularly.

Someone has stolen my identity. He is walking around saying that they are Roberto. I walk right up to him and say, "I am Roberto," and you must be someone else. He tries to escape, but I grab him and call for the police. I want justice done, and he has committed a crime.

A woman and I are in a class together. I start an argument with her because I disagree with her point of view. I start to strike her, and she calls for help. The police arrive and they take me away. I tell them that I do not recall the incident, and that I must have been on medication of some sort.

I dreamed that I was standing near an abandoned house made from bricks. In this house, there was danger, and it took the form of a burglar. I decided to attack him before he could attack me. Then I noticed he had a gun, so when I fought him, I took his gun away first. I knew he would try to kill me. I was frightened but I did get the gun away from him.

I was in a combat area, fighting the enemy. There were many enemy soldiers attacking our zone, and I kept shooting them down with my rifle. It was scary and I was terrified, but there was nothing else I could do. There were fortifications all around, some of them damaged and some of them still standing.

I was in a large room, seated behind a red curtain. I was waiting there to see my ex-wife who was supposed to come to the room. I kept on waiting for several hours, but she did not show up. I did not think of going to look for her. I felt anguish and just stayed there trying to figure out why she did not arrive.

I was with a group of friends in a large salon. There were other men and women there who I knew, as well as some people who I did not know. We were all participating in a number of common activities. I felt that I was sharing many common activities with them. It was a very large room. Suddenly a man appeared, and he was manifesting some spiritual power. And a light, without explanation, came out of his body. A staircase appeared, and everyone began to climb the stairs, but horizontally not vertically, as though they were floating up the staircase. I felt that this represented our spiritual development in some way.
(Out-of-body dream)

I was in a house on an island, and was quite happy there. But a young man told me that there was an even prettier section beneath the house. However, it was necessary to go through the water to reach it. I saw fish swimming in the water, but I was afraid to join them because I thought I might drown. Finally, I made a dive into the water, and found that I could swim underneath the water very easily. I reached the bottom level of the house and I just loved it there.

I was chatting with my brother in the living room of his house. We resolved to visit a male friend of his in another part of Buenos Aires, and used the telephone to tell him we were coming. When we went to his automobile, it was not the actual time, the time when the dream started. Instead, it was a year earlier. We arrived at the home of the friend and began to hold a conversation. We had a good time.

I was in my house. I had two labrador puppies and a black panther. The panther attacked the dogs, and me too. I did not believe that it was possible for the panther to attack us, but knew that the panther was carnivorous. The panther bit the faces of the dogs, and my face as well. I called for the panther to come into the house, but with fear for my life. She came in and settled down on the floor. I could see that all was finally well. The feline now kept by herself and took a peaceful attitude toward everything.

I am going to look for Roxana, my sweetheart during primary school. I am at a villa in the countryside outside of Buenos Aires, where there is a large house. I do not encounter her there, or in the inner hallways. So I go out. I am looking for a bus but don't see one. I ask a man and he gives me directions to an underground metro nearby. I feel danger. I am concerned about Roxana, so decide to look for her again, even though it is now night.

I was in a soccer stadium. I don't recall which one, nor do I recall the team. At the end of the event, I leave the stadium and I head for the bus stop. I am met there by my sister and a boyfriend of hers. They were taking another bus than the one I was planning to take, but I climb on to the bus with them anyway. They have not yet spoken to me or asked me anything. This was not the bus I wanted to take, the one that would have stopped within15 minutes of my house. After 15 minutes, I am at the wrong address. I get off and go underneath the bus stop to a store where electrical trains and electronic equipment for automobiles are being sold. In this place, my mother and father, and some uncles appear. I do not recall greeting them or speaking to them.

I was in my house and looked out the window. There was a truck of some sort, and it was menacing. I thought it was going to put its fuel in my house and blow me up. So I took a rifle and shot the driver through the window of the truck. I went down to see what was happening. I opened the door of the truck. It was my stepfather, and he was dead. He had abused me as a child, so I was not terribly unhappy. But I did feel guilty about killing him.

I am with my young daughter. We are at her school to meet her teachers. After the meeting, a female teacher comes with us to help her cross the street. The meeting went well, and I am pleased that the teacher takes the time to help my daughter across the street. I could have done it myself, but still feel good about the assistance.

(I am an architect.) I dreamed that I was at the construction site of a building I am actually constructing. It was near my house in the dream, as if I myself had constructed the building in this manner so that it would be neat to where I live. (In reality, it was planning for 1987 but did not get constructed because of financial problems at that time, but the project was resumed five years later. In reality, it was not near my house, but the plans were in my architectural office very near to my house). In the dream, the building was finished. I looked at it, and I was very pleased. (This was also the case in realty.)

I was eating a rich pizza with cheese. I was in a pizza restaurant, a pizzeria, located very near to my house. I was with a friend who works with me. He had invited me to lunch. He insisted that I eat no more pizza, and I agreed with him. Then the scene shifted to my house. My mother had the feelings that my friend from work had insulted me in some way. I told her the story about the pizza and she said, "Why do you invite him to your house if this is the way he treats you? Why do you keep company with him when he tells you not to eat your pizza and you agree with him?" I had no good answer for her, but felt she was right.

This dream took place in a house filled with birds and flowers. It was a garden house of some type. My little daughter was there playing with the birds and flowers. I seemed to have planted the flowers earlier and the birds must have come to enjoy the flowers' honey. The colors were very vivid and the emotions were very warm and happy.

(I play soccer every Sunday afternoon; it is my passion.) (I had a dream in which) I was playing soccer with several strangers, all of them men. I tried to get close to them, but they distanced themselves from me, even though they did not block me. They were urging me on to the goal because the teams were tied. I felt my toes kick the ball. But it was impossible to make the goal. I was desperate.

I saw some enormous birds, but I only recall the eyes of one. They were red or violet. I felt heavy for a long time, as if someone had touched me and caused me pain on my arm. After I had the image of the birds, I saw a bridge. But there was nothing under the bridge, no river, no city. I saw four men walking near me. I believe that there was one woman with them, and she was going to give me a gift.

I was sitting in a plaza with my house in the background. An old woman who I did not know was giving bread to the doves. At this moment, someone appeared, a man who I did not know. He had a disfigured face. I tried to get closer to them, but they disappeared. Night fell and I was still there, absolutely alone.

I was with my wife (who is now dead). The curious thing is that she looked very young, but she looked different than I had remembered her. In the dream, we were in a building talking. She told me to take care of my health, and we discussed many other topics as well. (She frequently appears in my dreams.)

I was in a room with flowers, very brightly illuminated, with walls absolutely blank. Suddenly, I am not in the place any longer but rind myself floating on the ceiling, covered with flowers, the same flowers I saw previously. Then my sister comes into the room, and the teachers from the school, both women, come in too.

I was talking to a great crowd of people, both men and woman, adults and children, about politics. I was running for office and everyone cheered me. They all said they were sure I would be elected. This sounded very nice but I had no idea what I would do once I got into office. At the end of the dream, I did win the election.

I am downtown on business. There are tall buildings all around, and I go in and out of them, taking care of things. But I get lost and can not find the most important building of all. I walk and walk for a log time. Finally, I find the right building but now it is closed. I will have to return tomorrow.

I am in a university classroom that is very hectic. I am trying to study for an examination. A woman asks me many questions and I can not concentrate. I think she is another student, but I do not recognize her. I tell her to shut up. She keeps on talking and I punch her. She runs away crying, and asks the teacher to eject me from class. But he takes my side and says the woman should not have interrupted my study.

I am in a medieval castle. I am carrying a sword to protect me. In fact, I am soon attacked by a strange man who thinks I am his enemy. I defend myself with the sword, and am surprised that I am so good at it. I run the other man through the stomach and he dies. Now I want to find my way out of the castle.

I am outside in a desert. I have been abandoned. All that I see is an old chair. There is also a shovel. What can I do with a chair and a shovel? I start to dig. I strike water. So now I ca sit back on the chair and drink the water. I feel confident that someone will show up and rescue me.

It is like I am back in school, in my old school where I was a student when I was a child. There is a strange man asking questions about the subject matter. I think it is geography. He asks many questions, and I hope he does not get around to me because I have not studied the topic for many, many years. He does get to me and I am embarrassed that I do not know the answer.

I am with my ex-girlfriend in a department store. I ask her if she has missed me. She replies, "Actually, I have had more time to open a business where I invest in properties." On the one hand, I am happy for her success. But on the other hand, I am angry that she did not seem to miss me one little bit, she was too busy with these properties to need companionship.

I am going into a hospital. My sister is very ill and I am trying to find her. Once I reach her room, she is much better. And she has won some type of a prize, a hospital lotto game, or something where she came up with the winning ticket. We are both very happy.

I was in a house where I lived when I was married. (But now my ex-wife lives there alone.) I did not know what I was doing in the house. My ex-wife was telling me off and said, "What are you doing here? You do not belong here anymore!" I tried to leave as quickly as I could, but I just got lost in the hallways.

I was playing soccer in the stadium and someone took me by the shirt and held me. I was not able to run. The other players yelled, "Run, Alberto, run!" But I was not able to run. I tried to break loose but it was impossible. I was supposed to play football with the other players, but the man who grabbed me made it impossible.

I was a child again, and was with my physical education teacher, who was also much younger than she is now. I had not seen him in 30 years, but the dream was taking place in the present. He told me something, but I do not recall just what it was. But it seemed to have a relationship with a trip that I was gong to make to the city of Bariloche. At this moment, he told me that we did not have the money to travel together. But he said that we wold try to travel together to a reunion where all the students were celebrating a festival where various musical instruments would be sold as well as dishes of food made by our mothers. My mother had made some of these dishes, but I do not recall just which ones. Then I saw this festival; we were at the festival selling the tickets that would pay for the trip. He said, "Now is the time to decide if you want to make the trip to Bariloche or not." But my mother appeared, and said I would have economic difficulties if I went.

I was sitting on the edge of a lake and suddenly saw, in the reflection of the water, my head with spots on my face. I did not get frightened but tried to see myself again to be sure it was my face reflecting in the clean water of the lake. I went inside the water to observe myself, as if I was the reflection in the water that I had been seeing. When I did this, the spots on my face were no longer there.

I am in a tall building. There are both men and women around me. We are waiting for something to happen. Then a door opens on the ceiling and we see a light. Light comes out of the door and envelops us. It is a spiritual feeling. We start to gloat up from the floor and through the door in the ceiling. There is so much light I am not sure where we are going.

I am driving a van down a dirt road. It is very straight and goes right into the horizon. There are two or three vehicles behind me. One is red. My van is going down a road with grass on the side, and the grass gets taller and taller as I proceed. The way gets darker, and I drive faster. Suddenly, I am in a clearing of short grass. There has been an accident. A car has gone off the road and has been turned around. Surprisingly, nobody was hurt.

I am walking toward a specific train platform inside the Buenos Aires railway terminal building. There are only a few people standing around. I ask one of them when the train will arrive. He tells me that due to a derailment, the trains have to make a detour that falls short of the terminal. This accident had happened a few weeks earlier. I follow the tracks until I reach the train, then I jump down onto the rail-bed and stark walking down the tracks. The tracks are narrow-gauge, as if belonging to a small train. I leave the terminal building and realized that the tracks have disintegrated into rusty ships. There are sleeping cards practically covered by pieces of rusty chips whichonce were the track rails. I assume they are older than the accident and feel more anxious as I progress, looking to both sides to see if there are sleeping cars in good condition. Off to the right and left of the trees I can see the lights of the evening traffic, going in the same direction. I think that I could go down there, but I seem determined to find the train I want by continuing down the track bed. I dither about what decision to make as it is almost 8:00 PM, until I suddenly realize that there are no more chips and the trains are brand new. I look up and see that off to the right there is a short train.

I am taking a walk around a range with Brian, my younger son. He is two years of age. We arrive at a building. The floor is covered with sawdust. It is a very large space. We enter through a large door. We walk slowly through the place, looking at the men and women who are working there. At the front of another door is a very large arcade. Three suspicious-looking men enter. The most corpulent of them comes near us. Brian laughs at him, and I take hold of Brian so that he will not offend the fat man any further. The other men say that Brian has insulted the fat man. At this moment I see between the wooden planks of the arcade bear. It comes behind the three men as they prepare to assault Brian. They do not see the bear. I stare at the bear and see it looking down toward my feet. I send a telepathic message to Brian to stay away from the bear. It moves slowly, distracted by the fat man. The bear bites off the leg of the fat man. This released Brian from the bear's attention. The bear continues to attack the fat man, and the workers in the arcade attack the other two suspicious-looking men. I quietly escape with Brian.

I am in a huge swimming pool. And I swim like a dolphin without moving my arms. I go through the length of the entire swimming pool at a great speed and with a very elegant style. I swim for a very long time without getting tired or having to take a break and stop.

It was night. I was in a barbershop sitting in front of a window. It was near the house of my daughter. I wanted to say something but found it difficult to talk. Soon, from the street, a suspicious-looking man arrives. He warned me about the barber but also had difficulty speaking. The barber had not arrived. More suspicious-looking people came in off the street. They took me by the arms and started to assault me. I wanted to scream but had difficulty expressing myself.

It is afternoon. I arrive in my automobile at the gate of my newly built lower garage. I observe an obstruction to the entrance of the automobile and push it with my hands. At the same time, in front of my automobile, a small truck parks. I can not resist the impulse to push my automobile into the truck. This action shatters the side of my automobile.

I was in a supermarket that was being remodeled. Some men are carrying an orange card case in which are the records of all the houses they work on, doing remodeling. A robot comes in, and I realize that the entire supermarket is controlled by robots. I meet some other people including a woman with two babies in her arms. She starts to cry and wonders if the robots will effect her babies in some harmful way. I feel anxiety and fear when I realize that the robots are in control of so much of our lives.

I arrive later at the building where my dentist has his office. I sit in his chair, close my eyes and try to relax. He gives me an injection and puts on a cassette of soothing music. I think of healing light and send it to my parents, my mother-in-law, and to a sick child who is the son of one of my friends. The light gets stronger and illuminates the faces of my father, my mother, my sister, and other family members. I feel an enormous ecstasy and calmness. I hear a voice and see a beautiful face. It is Rivka, my psychotherapist.

My parents and I are in a house with my male and female friends. It is not my home. A very bright light shines through the window. It frightens me terrible. I can tell it is from a police helicopter. The policemen begin to insist to my parents that we leave because it is about 2:00 AM Sunday. We can not meet in this place because there is voting this day, May 14th. In a moment, we go and we encounter some men dressed in black in an elevator that seems to be in the building where I live. But it is to the side and not in front, the way it always has been. Then we go to the entrance and ask ourselves why things have changed

One of my Doberman dogs was wrestling with me. I was on the ground and I was defending myself with my hands. The rest of my body was immobilized, but I don't know why. I gave the dog a slap with my hand. This slap ended its attach on me.

I am flying between the three famous pyramids of Egypt and see the Sphinx. My view is interrupted by my bird-like flight, caressing its edges, then I feel like a giant, superior in its form. In my flight I am appraising each detail and, unparticular, the pyramid's sides that are not eroded in the same way as the Sphinx is eroded. Suddenly, from various skimming movements, I pass over them at a great speed, (I awake with my arm in the air.)

I am in my car. In the dream I see myself taking a trip. My sister is by my side. I am the driver. Suddenly, water from somewhere comes into the side of the car where my sister is sitting. I act immediately to open the door of the car and pull my sister to safety.

I was leaving my body, about to go on a flight. I flew through the air. I could control my direction and speed of light. I felt like an eagle and held my arms out like wings. I felt the air currents against my body and thought, "I am really taking a flight."

I was sitting by a lake that had a very spiritual atmosphere. I lost the notion of time completely. Later, I redirected my attention to the lake and it became illuminated with the color blue. Later, it turned violet, and still later, pink. But even later, music started to play and I heard words being sung. I felt that this was my spiritual lake.

There is a group of three of my male companions on the right. They are at a distance from the middle of the scene. My office is in the background of the scene. I need a great deal of strength to go there are turn on the light. I would rather join my three companions and not return to work.

I am in an apartment similar to one I used to occupy with my parents. There is a window similar to one where I lived as a student. It is night and I am able to turn on and turn off alight in my room. But there is another light that I am not able to turn off from here. I am afraid that thieves will use it to enter my apartment. I overcome my fear and leave by the window, which is now a door, and climb without weapons downstairs, leaving the residence because there is nothing there for me.

I am in my automobile. It is much older than it really is (in waking life). My sister is by my side. I am driving the car. I drive into a swimming pool, and water enters the car on the side of my sister. We are in a critical situation. I want to leave the car but the door is jammed shut. I ask my sister for help. She opens the door and we leave the car.

I am with my wife. I know that she has been dead for several years, but now she has returned to me in the dream. I see my wife coming toward me. And then, all of a sudden, she is already here. I greet her with a great deal of gratitude for her return.

I am in the city of Bariloche with my wife, in a house made of material that was somewhat modern. Suddenly, the house starts to fall apart, starting with the top part. I see it start to fall and I see debris scattered for a few blocks. But don't panic. I am somewhat curious about how the house was made. I don't feel tremors from the earth, and I think the house must have been well constructed. I think the foundation must have been made of hard material. My wife and I leave the house and nothing happens to us.

I see an application for a vaccine against AIDS. It is not the conventional form of vaccine. You have to fill it out while lying down. So I lie down to get the "outside sustenance" that the vaccine promises. They tell me to keep lying down because I will be sent to the interior in a few days.

It is the Middle Ages. I am going down a street of a city block. The houses are colorful; some are lavender. The someone starts shouting at people who are walking on the sidewalk. It is a bloody scene. There is blood all over the street. Some people are dead. Others are wounded. There is anguish, fear, and grief that the survivors are expressing. I think that I am a king or member of the royal family. I am indifferent to all of this. My body does not register any emotion. The soldiers use sharp weapons to cut the people up. I think the royal family sent the soldiers out to kill the townspeople. The survivors are very sad.

(I frequently dream that) I am falling straight down into a deep shaft or well. I start out walking along a street that seems very safe. Then, suddenly, the earth opens up and I start to all. I am very scared but there is nothing I can do to stop falling. And I can not see the bottom of the shaft.

I am in a vehicle with a group of people I know already but do not want to be with for the trip. The group arrives, breaks up, then gets together again by a wall that it very tall. At the end of the wall is a precipice where the people fall off suddenly. In the group, I see my younger son and my 21-year-old nephew.

I saw an opportunity that was available to me for a job that I desperately needed. Other people had promised me a job but they did not deliver. But the person who had the concept for this undertaking did not keep his promise either. As a result, I had the profound feeling of sadness, injustice, and anguish.

I am on a small airplane being flown by my friend. It is a damaged airplane. We go, without secure conditions. We begin to make turns and somersaults, and he keeps flying faster without my assent. I ask my friend to stop. I shout. The situation is desperate. Suddenly, I see the ground that I had warned my friend about. But he has been thrown from the small airplane and smashed to death. I survive, but I cry wildly with much sadness.

I was flying over a staircase. The building in my dream was very high. Then I was no longer flying. I was driving a car. But when I tried to use the brakes, they didn't work. I was now on the street at the base of the building, and could not get the car to stop.

I am repairing my automobile. I am accompanied by a man, I think is my brother. Another automobile parks by my side and the driver assaults me. The automobile is parked in front of a house in the bar rio. At the same time, there is a boy in the door shouting "Mama!" While they are punching me in the groin, I am protecting my automobile against the aggression. The boy shouts "Mama!" again, and the other vehicle disappears with its driver.

I was with a former teacher of mine who had come to my office to give me some help with a project I am doing for our business (in waking life). I was surprised to see him in a building he had never entered before, but I welcome his interest and assistance. Much to my surprise, he knew exactly what advice I needed between the two of us, we finished the project successfully.

Thieves broke into my house, so I killed them, one by one, in desperate but efficient ways. When my parents got home, I told them I had killed the thieves. They told me I had done something wrong because they were really friends pretending to be thieves. And now we wouldn't be able to collect the insurance policy. I feel desperate about the situation.

I am in a room where I am able to identify three people. There is a woman to whom I was relating a dream, and my cousin Will who is observing us with attention. I tell the woman, "In this dream is an obscure scene, taking place at dawn. And I meet an entity whose name is 'Krippner.' All told, he has physical characteristics, unlike many other entities. I remember the 'caboclos' some entities who work in Umbanda. They are related to forests and native Indians. I asked him what to do in order to learn from my dreams and put the knowledge to use when I am awake. Krippner tells me I am a recruit for psychotherapy." (Then I wake up.)

I went to the library at the faculty building where my mother words. (I had never entered the library in my waking state.) I walked toward a bookshelf with books on pediatrics. I picked up a book, and with the book closed, I read a chapter about hemorrhage in childhood. I didn't use my eyes to read; I read it with my hands. I finished reading, and I left the book on the bookshelf.

A chicken comes out of an egg. The egg was in the middle of a huge bluish-green nest. The check is a beautiful yellow color. One of the children's feathers falls off. It falls off very slowly. It is falling very slowly to the floor and it forms itself into the word "MAAT."

I am in a deep forest surrounded by many strange primal people. I am very afraid but I observe that they seem to be friendly, even though we don't speak a common language. Then I observe that by watching thing carefully, we can understand each other without speech. The women gather about me and I sense they want me to undress, which I do. They put me in a beautiful, many colored flowering robe, and I understand I am to climb a ladder to the top of an enormous drum that reaches close to the surrounding tree tops. The ladder has been woven from some kind of branches which give way under my feet. I am very uneasy. Then I finally get to the top of the drum and am standing on the edge, I walk across the drum and I see a tall handsome dark man--obviously one of the natives. He is naked from the waist up and he is holding a tall spear. With a nod of his head, I realize that he means for me to dance with him. A voice within me calls my name. This is not ballet. It's not modern. It's not like any dance I've ever done, so I just follow him. We dance around the edge wildly with great intensity. I'm watching and finding that I have picked up his rhythms, and we come nearer and nearer to each other until we meet in the middle, completely exhausted. At least, I was.

I go downtown to do some business. When I have finished the task, I start to walk home, and then I find out that I forgot my address. I panic. I want to ask somebody, but it is of no use, because nobody knows where I have moved. Then I walk all evening and a friend of mine meets me, and takes me to my home.

A woman puts a finger into my watch bracelet. Immediately, I start to beat her. Nobody can stop me. Then they take us to the dormitory director of this university. The directed shouted for the woman to "shut up" because he knew her and already had many complaints about her behavior.

I dreamed that I was in a deserted place and saw a very big gray statue. Nearby there was an abandoned house made out of wood. In this house, there was a fellow who was hiding like a thief. I came nearer to see the statue. This fellow had a sword and started to move as I came closer, he tried to kill me with the sword. I came into the house and found another sword. I destroyed the house, and the statue fell down.

(It happened three days before the occurrence of the fact.) I was driving on a country road. I was not driving very fast, but heard a noise and knew that I had hit something. It so happened that my car had caught somebody who was on the road. I ran to help the victim, and saw the face of my mother with a stain of blood. I was so impressed that two days after, on the weekend, I went to pay a visit to my mother. She was fine. When I was driving back home, the accident happened. A child ran into the road, right in front of my car. I got out of the car to help the victim. The child was not badly hurt, but I saw her face with the stain of blood that I saw in the dream.)

I dreamed about my marriage shortly after my husband had been unfaithful to me. In my dream this event happened in the Mardel Plata (the Sea of Silver). It was in a chalet (not the park where it took place in waking life). The chalet was overlooking a turbulent sea where huge waves were rolling in, becoming rough, and intending to circle and surround my husband and the other woman. I was observing all of this happening at a distance.

I am leaving home. But there is a string tied on to my waist. The other end is tied to my house. It begins to unwind as I get further from my house. I am wondering that will happen as the string completely unwinds. I am afraid of the entire process.

I was annoyed with my mother because, after having left my marriage, I was expecting a daughter from this marriage. I entered her house casually because I was embarrassed and self-conscious. I wore a dress stamped, "The Future Mother." I tried to cover up my embarrassment casually, reproaching her for having had so many children. I said, "Why should anyone want more children, as the cost of living is so expensive? To have one child more would be expensive because we are so poor." She told me that it was clear that I wanted a man. Then the man and I could be a couple.

I encountered my ex-boy friend in a fancy shop. We were both sitting at the counter. The seats were of metal -- iron painted in various colors--black, green, orange, yellow, red, pink. They were turning. He was sitting in front of me, resting his left arm on the bar. His position was one of boredom; he did want to be distressed. I was sitting in front, appearing calm, secure, and speaking with assurance. I asked, "Do you miss me?" He said, "It is clear that I miss you, although I try not to think about it." We then began talking about the benefits we had obtained in the time we had been together. He said that he had opened a small business and was trying to advance it. I told him I was going to New York City in December, and he responded, "It is good that we both are dong well." At this moment I noted, "It is good that we are both well with our projects, so why don't we sell our apartment?" He was surprised, and replied, "It is too early."

I am in a place that seems like a school classroom, with all the chairs arranged in a circle. There are only a few students, men and women, in a great deal of space. I as resting on one of the chairs. There is a tall, thin man, about 40, with a mustache, and I am talking with him. A group of young women approach us; it seems as if they are his companions. They begin to talk with him about me, saying that I don't belong there. They ask me to leave. Suddenly, there appears an old bus and takes us to appear on a television program which is a series of questions and answers. This day, our team of two people is singing and dancing into the microphone. The song is "Patricia's Heart." Patricia and I win the contest, but earlier she had competed with me in the schoolhouse over the tall, thin man.

I had just finished a course on how to attract money. I wanted to rest because I felt sick. I rested on the floor with my eyes shut. I could see nothing. Soon my aunt came carrying a linen cloth, putting it over my head like a garment. Also, there was Fernando who had taken the course too, and I asked him to lend me a ticket. I could not find my purse. He turned me down and I was dejected.

I am an adolescent again. I am in the auditorium of a secondary school with many people. We are celebrating the end of our studies. We are feeling very good that classes are over. I have earned my degree. It had been an excellent curriculum, and it was a beautiful graduation. Many other male and female students are there.

I am in a deserted place. It is brown, clear, with a smooth breeze, and a great deal of light. I am dressed in a white skirt. I feel tranquil with considerable peace and energy. I am with a group of men and women dressed in the same way. I touch the heads and the hands of the people, noting a kind of light and vibration. Others are walking in silence, looking at a fixed point, something brilliant. It has a great intensity.

I see houses that have fallen down and this gives me anguish. I hear cries, voices, and the weeping of children. There are many ambulances, many wounded men and women, and many corpses. I think it might be a war. Then I see the Sacred Heart of Jesus and the Hebrew menorah candelabrum. I am with a lady friend and tell her, "How impotent is religion in stopping the war!"

I am in the kitchen of a humble house. On the table is a burning candle. It is the twilight hour, and I find two parts of chairs under the table, and the legs of my mother resting on the floor. I am afraid. Then I see that the rest of her is made of wax, and is at my side.

I have just arrived in a city where there are many people crying and screaming. There are many houses destroyed by an earthquake. I feel desperate and sad as I observe the destruction. There are men and women burned, with ambulances driving around, and civic helpers helping, and people from various religions helping, giving counsel, trying to find those who are lost, and calming the bewildered.

I am in a tall building. I see a woman. She is turning around slowly, showing me her face. I can see that she is paralyzed on the left side, which is covered with blood. She holds her throat with her hand. She falls down a flight of stairs, falling on her left side. I watch all of this and feel cold.

I find a house which seems to be a school for nuns, a convent. I see candles burning on tables inside. The Mother Superior is on the second floor. There is incense burning. The nuns are giving a Mass for a dead person. Suddenly I am all alone. I am in danger. I try to escape but the widows and doors are locked. But I do not give up. I know there must be more possibilities. I find a small window. I escape. Now I am safe.

My mother and I attended a seminar with Dr. Rivka. My mother and the doctor shared the company of a man. They both loved him. After the seminar finished, he left for Brazil, his country. She decided to abandon everything and go with him. I said, "Tell him to exchange you for Dr. Rivka." My mother prepared a bag of money and after a short period of time she left to catch a 7:00 AM bus. I went to her house and took with me all the ceramic statuettes, souvenirs or my grandmother because I imagined that my mother would break them all in her anger when she would realize her mistake and return to her husband. I took a nap and then woke up and went to my house. I encountered my mother who had left earlier, she had mistaken the hour for her bus departure. It was really 6:00 PM. But she was very content. I told her she would be very happy, but I had much sorrow for the suffering her husband, Rollo, would feel.

I was aroused suddenly by the noise of a drill in the house at the side off my house. The neighbors were doing this to torment me. I wanted them to stop, because I wanted to sleep and dream. In my dream I saw on the wall of my house overlooking the seacoast a line of circles, one lined up after the other. And suddenly, through this side, appeared Teresa, my friend. And the owner of the apartment appeared as the tormentors started to drill again. She told me that the scene with my friends and the circles was a dream, and that the tormentors with the drills were what I faced when I was awake.

I was in a place where light was shining on the ground. There was a great deal of light, and it focused an enormous reflection. I said it was the same light that Dr. Rivka spoke about on her cassette. My friend Diana was with me in this dream. Then I was in a station with my father who was going to live in the United States. There were many people there, sitting in large seats made of dark brown wood. I joined these people in the sets. I was wearing a red dress.

I tell my husband we must sell everything in our house --furniture, clothing, everything -- because we are not able to pay the expenses. We decide to rent out the house once it is empty. Then we decide to make various small cars to hire a building manager, a baker, and other people. It occurs to my husband to put in an airport too. He also hires a band that arrives with all their equipment and musical instruments. I am surprised by the band, which is named "The Rat."

I dreamed I was walking through a park. Water from the sea flowered toward me, up to my ankles. It all seemed very natural. I was preparing to go camping. I had a nylon purse in my hands. It was transparent and contained a gelatin-like substance with which I could measure the temperature. I passed by a physician who wanted to talk to me about this substance, but I said that I had no time at the moment. I was carrying the substance with a great deal of care because it was something valuable. The temperature was increasing, getting warmer. The water in the park now was enclosed in a sealed container. It made a noise while it boiled. The steam slowly turned into a woman. I continued walking. I don't know for how long, and met a group of people. Among them I recognized a woman who had come from the steam. I asked, "Who are you?" She said she was equal to humans and could not be distinguished from them. I looked and listened with approval. The man attacked her with a knife, cutting the vein of her right leg, through her cotton stocking. I tried to clear it up and help her, but she disappeared. I felt anguish.

I was in a building with my small sister-in-law. A man who was with us, a stranger, went forth because another man had to give him something outside. My sister-in-law breathed through an opening in her body and I was that the first man returned and was doing surgery with a knife of various parts of her body. When the repairs returned her body to normal, she was still very pallid. Then I was walking with my boy friend through a large train lined by businesses and restaurants. We selected a pear to eat and proceeded a bit further where soon we paused. We stopped at the home of a woman who had treated me in the legs with acupuncture. I had an inner hunch that I should watch out! I restrained myself and suddenly felt that there was someone with bad intent who wanted to do me harm. And instead of continuing to retreat, I asked help from my partner, and he gave it to me.

We were driving in the desert in a red car, looking for some drinking water. A man dressed in white with a white sombrero was with me. He was a racing car driver, a stranger to me. I was at this right, dressed in red. My seven-year-old daughter Julia was wearing a flowered dress and was sitting behind the man. We were moving at great speed, leaving a cloud of dust behind us. There was a sun. It was noon. The heat affected everyone. At one side of the car were men selling things. We stopped to buy something. The three of us quarreled. We had much money, evidently, but could not decide how to spend it. Across a table there were men offering white packets of different amounts. We asked what this was and they said it was marijuana and cocaine. We looked at them and said we were not drug addicts. They insisted that we think it over. We maintained our refusal and got into our car and left. The men shouted that we had to pay a lot of money, but actually we had bought nothing.

God tells me that I have to learn to give of myself. And, as human beings, we also have to learn to receive. But something keeps me from doing this. I am given by God a plant that will help me. It has a red flower that is a sign of health with deep roots. But in the opposite direction, the roots grow a black flower that signified destruction. I must nurture the healthy flower, not the other one.

I am waking on the ashes of a shopping building that had been destroyed. A tall man, dressed in white clothes, walks in front of me. On the ashes are the arms and legs of dolls. Everything looks like an atomic bomb had destroyed it. That man guides me. A lot of little people beg food from me. The shrouded man comes to help me, and I want to see his face, but it is covered.

(I had a marvelous dream.) A flying saucer entered my dormitory room. Out stepped a marvelous and beautiful being who told me not to run away. It was there to verify something about my daughter. Later, I saw the flying saucer and the beautiful being in a church while I was looking at a picture of the Sacred Heart of Jesus. The being had enormous eyes. I had no notion of space or time, but had a very emotional and memorable reaction to the image. I knew that the image of this being would always be present to cure me and help me, because I felt so much love coming from it. I knew it had also discovered something helpful about my daughter.

I was travelling with my father. We were in a tall building that was nothing but stairs. We took the stairs to the left and wondered where they would lead us. We looked for an exit on the top, into heaven. The building was filled with telephones, cables, and light fixtures. A guard would not let us go to heaven. He said we were in purgatory. I screamed and protested.

I am very preoccupied, concerned, and worried because I have become pregnant. But what is the reason that I have given birth to a stick figure object instead of giving birth to a baby? The stick is white in color. Then I fall from the top floor of a building and am over water.

I encounter magical art which portrays a house of thieves. It is on a sketch portraying waves of a black sea, a dark blue sky, a boat on the sea, three bright moons, and trees on the side. Between the villa and the seas there is a pastel green point of land on which animals graze. There are a few stars in the sky. I need to find this place. There are people there waiting to talk to me -- little people like dwarfs.

I am on an island trying to get to my automobile on a street, and met with a great obstacle. The street is covered with fish. I need to get into my car and go to a conference. But the fantastic thin is that there are two enormous collections of fish all over the street. No one is there to assist me. Suddenly, I am no longer preoccupied about how to get my automobile because it is too late for my conference. So I am happy enough to be in this nice place.

My cousin, who I adored and with whom I feel a close identification, died. I felt a great grief, but aside from this, I tried and I tried to console my aunt who was destroyed by her child's death. I told her that this would pass, that it was like a dream, and that meaning would return to her life.

In this dream, I am with a male friend. We notice a fountain in the shape of a cross in the middle of a place where there is a circle. Suddenly, another friend appears who I actually know at my place of work (in waking life). She has a strawberry pastry that is not circular or square, it is an odd shape. This pastry is for a wedding and she is taking it to the ceremony. She is dressed in a gown for this wedding.

(Telepathy in the dream) This dream takes place in a field, an open place where children are playing. There is a young man there with his three children. His wife has died. He serves food to all of the people who are there. He says that later, he will give the rest of the food away to hungry people. One of his children is three or four years of age, his baby is very pretty, and he has an older child as well. He is standing behind me, yet I hear his words telepathically. He seems to be saying, "I can see seven years ahead what I am going to do." I feel that he is very strong, and has survived the death of his wife to help many people. I understand the situation although no words have been exchanged.

I am in a plaza that is shaped like a mandala. There are various paths from which people can walk into the middle of the mandala. They can walk around on paths that look like the designs on a religious medallion. Now I see the central path, and it is an area on which there are a few camels lined up. Next to the camels is an Arab man with a beard. There are other men there too, and they are all very serious, discussing religious principles. In a corner there is a man and woman making love on top of an Arabian carpet and an Oriental blanket. I do not see their faces, so keep walking toward the center. I walk near a big pool of mud with a transparent center. The water is calm, bright, and I barely hear the murmuring of the water. In the pool there are three Arab men in formal dress; they are like the others with white robes covering them. I don't want to stay there but I can't move, and I become very upset.

I am in a plaza where an arts and crafts fair is going on. In the booths at the fair, I see things that are very nice, colorful, and beautiful, such as jewelry, clothing, and furniture and other things for the house. I am carrying some items, but I leave them on a bench and approach the arts fair. While I look and everything, and try to decide what to buy, I start worrying about my items that I left on the bench. I decide I really do not need anything, and go back to the bench. Nothing at the fair is appropriate for me, neither the objects nor the clothing. I go to the bench, but my items are not there. I resign myself to their loss, saying that maybe I will see them lying around but they really were not that important.

An instructor is giving a group of us directions. He says that a spider has to sting us. It will leave a white egg, so that a new being can emerge. Suddenly I see the rumpled, fat spider on a lamp post. It scares me. I think, "Why am I just standing here? It would be better to get away from the spider because that insect will be stinging all the people it can get to." I decide I do not want the spider to bite me, and so I move away.

I am seated on a chair in a big white circular circus tent. There are many events going on. I am seated in the front row. One of my colleagues is speaking at a lectern, and he is saying farewell to people I know. It is some sort of a graduation. He says that when we go out into the world, we will have good fortune and great success.

I am in a kitchen of a house. I am looking through a window, and see a river. On closer inspection of the river bank, I see two old ceramic white frescos that are half-buried. They have designs on them from a different era, showing men and women wearing ancient clothing.

I entered a bazaar full of very colorful kitchen cups and glasses. They were small to medium in size. I couldn't choose which one I wanted to buy because of the great variety and quantity. Then I went into the back room of the store. It led into an old house. In the ruins of the house were a window and a door, and the rest was open space. Above the window there was a shelf of old red and green cups made of thick glass with triangular stems. There was also a stack of cups and I moved from where they were to a place above the door.

My male friend and I are in the countryside, in an open place where there is a young man who serves all of us dinner on beautiful plates. He has suffered some misfortunate so I can note at all my food, and suggest that he serve the rest of the dinner later.

I am in a courtyard which is actually a courtyard for an artistic festival. A man and I see this art. It is very colorful and beautiful. I want to buy a painting. There are pillars around the courtyard, and many trees and flowers.

In this dream, I am in a house with a man who becomes somewhat violent, and starts to rip my clothing, and throw pot sand pans at me. A small child is watching, and is urging me to strike back. So I strike him, and he loses his power and runs away from me, and then leaves me alone.

I was with a little girl. She was not my child. She was wearing a pretty dress. We sat down at a piano and started top lay it together. It was a duet. I thought that I was very lucky to have found her.

(Lucid dream) I was passing through a large house with my two daughters. We were passing through the house, observing it as if we were ready to change this house around in order to know it better. We traveled to the bedrooms. We went into a salon which was a part of the complex. It was very modern with windows that opened into a garden where there was an arbor of trees. Suddenly I encountered a door to a workshop and saw a student walking down a long corridor. He was descending alone. When I arrived at this corridor, I realized that I was sleeping and dreaming. I was totally aware of this during the rest of the dream.

(Out of body dream). It was almost twilight. I was suspended from something white. It seemed to be near a cloud. I steered into that part of the cloud and the movement enables me to get out, surging out of the center of my body and surging with a high velocity until I had enough observations of the scene below. I did not like the sensations. I perceived a man I had known before. My impulse was to go to him but my velocity was so strong that my hope of seeing him more closely disappeared. I was frightened.

I am outside. A man is chasing me, and I start to run. Then I feel as if I am paralyzed and can not run any faster. I look back at the man who is chasing me, but I can not see his face. Also, it is dusk and so vision is difficult. I am frightened because I know he wants to hurt me.

(Out of body dream). I felt as if I were dying but it was not as traumatic as I had imagined. I felt peaceful and relaxed, almost incorporeal. It was a profound sensation. There was an appearance of vivid white light. I felt as though I was leaving my body and that I was dying. I looked down on my body; it had turned into a golden brown. I was wearing clothes but my skin was golden brown.

I am a child, and am in a country house that belongs to a relative. The country house is not far from the city. It is the end of the semester and we have gone there to celebrate. I am running and laughing a lot. It is a sunny day, and we are able to see the vivid colors of people's clothing, and we hear the sounds of the place, people talking and other sounds. I start to run, and am not able to stop running. It is as though the space were endless.

(Repetitive dream) I remember that I was on a road, minding my own business. But then I know someone is in back of me. He has a knife and I know he wants to kill me. I start running and he starts to chase me. He has a sword, and this is how he intends to kill me. My clothes are constricting and they keep me from running faster.

I am swimming in the middle of the sea. There are many people swimming in the water, but I do not know any of them. I am very tranquil. Suddenly, I touch the body of a dead man with my feet. I feel anxiety. I ask someone what I should do, having found a corpse with my feet. He just ignores me and the situation. I can feel the dead body with my feet, and now it is tied on to me, so it follows me as I swim toward the shore. I can touch the tips of the corpse's fingers with my toes.

I am carrying children to school. I am wearing good clothes so I am not dressed for the job, but it is my responsibility. While I am doing this work, I get diverted. This annoys me, and I am disgusted because we are just about to eat. While I am distracted, the children have nothing to do. I want to get back to them, and also to proceed to get some food. This dream was very realistic as if it were calling something to my attention.

I arrive at a large house with huge doors where there are three stone staircases which lead to another door with three other staircases of marble. They lead to a salon on the ground floor where there is, along the left hand side, a type of altar of dark wood which is elevated and connected to three wooden staircases. Behind are three statues of the same wood. I sit down and am very ecstatic because I am in a place which, for me, is sacred.

In this dream, I have two shells. Each one is a natural dark maroon and gray in color. I see a pearl inside of each shell. The pearl is in the middle of a fluid dribbling from the shell. The pearl stays clean while the dribble trickles out. These pearls are blue and rose. They all grew naturally from the shells.

I was with my husband in the sea. The waves broke in front of us, and also from where we had been. The time was luminescent but we could not see the horizon of either the sea or the beach. I said to him, "I want to go to the other side," thinking that we could walk there on the beach. I thought the beach would be better on the other side, and I was attracted to that place. My husband assured me that the beach did continue onto the other side and agreed that we should go there. But we did not feel secure. Meanwhile, we were looking at the sea which had a deep and profound attraction for me. We proceeded with much more intensity to get to the other side.

I was calmly walking through Santos Andrade Square. Then I could not get out. I noticed that there was no vegetation. Children were running after animals to kill them in order to have food. People were in jail, and the jailer was made out of stone. I knew that there was only one way to get out--breaking the stone. When I got closer, the stone started to break apart by itself. When it was completely on the ground, all the people felt themselves free.

I dreamed that my body above the waist was sticking up from a manhole cover that workers place over the entrance to the sewers. While I was in this position, a car that was about to run over me honked its horn and a man who had no legs and who was on a platform in the sewer pulled me down until the auto passed and later helped me up again.

I am travelling on a train. There are no signs in the train station, so I don't know where we are. I return to the station to take another train. I feel completely disoriented. I am trying to find my husband but I have no idea where I am or where I am going. (I have this dream frequently.)

I am in a hospital bathroom sitting on the toilet. I can see it is dirty. I have a disagreeable reaction. Through the door comes a cleaning machine. I see that it is meant to wash the bathroom. I suspect that the bathroom stain is much great than I supposed. It was fecal material. I think that very sick people must have used the bathroom and did not clean it up. I leave so that the bathroom can be cleaned. I have an appetite, so go to my mother's place.

This dream was in black and white. I was in a business in which there were other persons. But they did not want to pay attention to me, because I was a woman trying to do business with them. I was given a paper worth $2,500. It seemed very expensive, but I thought it was worth only $20. Afterwards, I was looking for the numbers 7+1+2+5+2+1=8, then another series 5+5+7=17,7+1=8.

I am wandering on a road that runs through ocher dunes. The air is heavy and oppressive. I am alone, nostalgic, abandoned, and sad. I fear something. There is fog enveloping everything. There is little light. I am afraid of being attacked and raped before I reach my destination. I have lost something very important. It is my small car. I find it and am filled with joy. But will I be able to drive it back? I am suffocating from the reddish-ocher fog.

The people in this dream live in an exterior space where they are floating. Their bodies are covered with gas-like clouds. I alone can see their faces which emanate peace and wisdom. They don't have regular eyes but their pose indicates they are happy and have plenitude. They are closer to God than humans. I give them books to read, cereals and grains to make bread, and wreathe of laurel to signify their spiritual triumph.

I am walking through a street in about 1930. I can tell because of the style of automobiles on the street. In front of me is a type of wagon carrying dead bodies. And I know that more and more people will be arrested. I feel a great anguish as a spectator and later I leave this site.

I was on a huge bed. I knew that on one side was my mother (who is actually dead). The bed was in a room without a wall. Instead, there was a great expanse of water. I knew that this was very profound. The bed and my mother had been put by the water to coerce me and to hurt me. But I was not afraid. I would be safe if I did not let my hand touch the water. There were other people at the side of the water.

I have just moved into a house in the city of Santo Prestes. I am told that the furniture will arrive tomorrow. Everything is fresh. The children are playing with their dog, and are exploring the neighborhood. Everything is calm. But I am experiencing much anxiety and uncertainty. This sensation of fear embarrasses me. I look across the sidewalk and see the neighbor's house and the entrance to their garden with a large arbor. Everything there is peaceful, harmonious, and tranquil. I alone have this persistent feeling of fear, as if someone or something was bout to jump on me, or as if a terrible torment was about to destroy so much peace at any moment.

(I have this dream often.) I am being pursued down the street by some unknown pursuers. When I reach a street of safety, I can see four ducks. Then I know that now I am safe from the pursuers who were after me. I rejoice and am very happy that I have escaped. I am very relieved that I am safe.

My mother has returned from her trip, and I have prosed myself to tell her my experiences and feelings as an equal to an equal. But she comes into the house telling her own stories and is indifferent to mine. So I am not able to communicate my ideas or these thoughts of mine to her.

I am taking a fight on an airplane. Looking down, I see the land that I am trying to reach by taking this airplane flight.
