But in a way that I can not understand or explain, the land below has been sliced into pieces. I ask myself how the airplane will be able to make a stop because the pieces seem too small. (I have had this recurring dream which repeats itself after many years.)

I am at a ski resort in the middle of winter. Instead of skiing, I am going to descent from the resort on foot because I do not have ski clothes. I see on my right a white horse arriving. It has the name of a man. I decide to go to the place in which they expect me. I take a train. The train's passenger car is almost vacant. At the other end is a woman who is a friend of mine. The train slows down. I pay my bill as this is my station. I am able to get off as the train stops. I look for a taxi and begin the trip to the determined destination after I pay the taxi driver.

I was on a street that had been damaged. People were trying to rebuild it. There was water flowing under the street that was dark and unpredictable. Suddenly, various dinosaurs appear and some of the tell me that I will have to win a battle against them if I am to go on my way. (At the time I had this dream, engineers were taking stock of Buenos Aires streets to refine telephone lines and of the pipes and conduits running under the streets.)

I was on a beach. This beach was surrounded by an arena of some sort. Suddenly, I was surrounded by a sea with huge waves, like five-story buildings. I felt quite desperate. I was afraid I would be touched by the water. My fear preceded any contact with the waves themselves.

I see a 40- to 50-year-old man who has climbed with force to the last steps of the stairs of my house. He seems content but tired. But I had been waiting for a woman of my age, dressed in a white blouse and a skirt decorated with flowers. The image comes of a mandala, and I am supposed to use that figure for meditation. Then I see the imagery of a triangle. I think the triangle is feminine and the mandala is masculine.

(I have a recurring dram.) I am in a small town. The town is unfamiliar to me. I have an appointment with a doctor or a dentist of some type, and I am trying to find his office. But I do not have the address and wander down street after street. Then I know that I am lost.

(I have a recurring dream.) A dog is attacking me and tries to bite me and snap at me. In the meantime, I am feeling emotionally upset. My legs are trembling and I can not run away from the vicious dog. This dog is very mean. This dog continues sits attack, using its teeth to snap and bite.

My mother (who actually had killed herself some time ago) is doing something or saying something that fills me with fear. She has the force and power of an overwhelming spirit, and I feel my breathing becoming irregular and my body trembling. I ask her if I have been resisting her message. She only screams. Then she screams my name (and I wake up). (This was a repetitive dream for many months after she died.)

I am sitting in front of a large door to my house. The door has a key. "How unusual," I declare, "because I do not use keys in doors." I think that if I ever feel threatened and strange, I may try to discover why I carelessly left the key in order to open the door and pass to the other side.

I am walking on the beach. The sea has a large wave. It is very hot. I am with my husband. I am jealous of the other people to whom he pays attention. Later we arrive in a hotel where we plan to stay. I want a room with an outside porch, but all the rooms are the same. There is nothing I can do to change the situation. Then I notice I am alone. I look for my husband, but now I am in our country house in Buenos Aires. Our caretaker is there, and I give him a tomato.

I am in my house, by the kitchen hall. A male stranger arrives and we begin to hold a conversation. I ask where he is from, and why he wants to kill me. H does not answer. He gives me poison. He is large and wears back. After drinking the poison, I fall down between the kitchen and the kitchen hall.

I have been adding chemicals to two reservoirs, the types that are used in big cities. I am permitted to go from one side to the other, of each reservoir to do my work. Thee reservoirs get water from a white mountain covered with snow. But some impurities get into the water on its way to the reservoirs.

I am imprisoned in a sanitarium with my husband and my three sons, two, five, and seven years of age. We have not done anything wrong. Terrorists enter, armed with guns and dressed in black. I escape with my youngest son to find help. My other two sons stay there and are killed. My husband survives and I saw, at least we have saved one son. I feel grief and sadness because I had not been able to get help from anyone.

I am in a place that I see from the top, because I am floating in the air. I see myself with a series of large and small planets, and with numbers and letters written on them that appear and disappear in the form of symbols that are like lights that turn on and off. (Later, I awaken with a headache.)

I went to the bathroom to take a bath. A lady friend of mind came looking for me. We left the house and walked by a mound of earth. A boy appeared -- my nephew Luis who then accompanied us to a house that had rose bushes. He cut a rose and put it with a pine branch across the floor of the house. Then he turned a corner of the house and I lost him. I tried looking for him outside on the beach where there were many babies lying in little carts. They were all dressed in white. I took one of them in my arms and left.

Almost always, I dream that) I am in a house where I lived when I was first married, and where we stayed for 20 years until I was 58. In the dream, I am living in that house with my husband, children, and in-laws. I am happy to be spending a brief period of time in my old house. But I know I musty go back to my present house eventually. This does not upset me because I have found happiness in my new house as well.

I saw a large mural or frieze. On it there was a great sun, very high in the sky. I knew I was dreaming and I believed that the sun represented me and my potential, pushing through the blanket of doubt and uncertainty. My head was covered with a white scarf, and I thought to myself that this confirmed my idea about the frieze.

Suddenly I found myself sleeping with the town mayor in the street, without clothes and without shame. I covered our bodies with my clothing that some passersby gave us. They passed very close to where we had been sleeping. But I did not have hear, and what's more, I was not surprised to be in this situation.

There was no reference to place or time in this dream. All I saw was a transparent silhouette of someone. It was made of plastic. It was someone lounging or sleeping near my female dog who was also sleeping. My dog was also transparent. A maroon chair surrounded her entire body. It was the only color there was in that entire scene.

I am in a house and it is twilight. I see a cable of an electrical artifact that is broken. I touch it, and it produces a short circuit. It begins to burn down the house. I am desperate because the fire is growing and I don't know how to disconnect it. I am discouraged.

I dreamed I had a place of my own, always flowing into a special form, becoming white. It is a difficult condition to maintain, however, in the middle of visitors, my marriage, and changes. But I try to keep it beautiful and still keep my feet on the ground. I hear a sound. Clouds have arrived. This puts my mind at rest. My body is relaxed and I know I will be able to sleep peacefully. The clouds tell me to remain in the present.

I am in an open elevator with a distinctive group of people, passing several floors, at times meeting other people coming down. I believe that at times I see my sons. All the elevators in the building are of this type, open at the side and the top. The floors in the building are also distinctive and unusual.

I am in the home of my in-laws where my husband and I have lived for the past nine years. A thief breaks into the room my father-in-law had built for me, entering through the window which begins to crumble. I feel terror and desperation. This room falls apart and is transformed into a modern, more chic apartment that is more useful. It is larger and in a different place. I am happy there, but feel nostalgia. But I am comfortable here. It is super-modern and can hold more people.

I dreamed that someone struck me and I felt as much fear as I was able to feel. This event had happened in my building, so I left it as quickly as I could. I felt that the building was under siege. And so I had no intention of returning there again.

I am in a market place where merchants are trading and selling clothes, jewelry, money, and other things. I left for the market very early and left my charge card behind. It is not here. Then I ask myself, "Where is my charge card?" I go back to search for it. It is in the bathroom and it is wet, but someone is there who had discovered it for me. I am drugged and did not notice my baby was lost. But I find the baby in the bathroom shower. I saw, "Thank God!"

I hear the sound of clever thieves in the house. The group of thieves is laughing and talking. I had forgotten to close the door, thinking that my brave dog would guard the house. But where is the dog? The dog is in the bathroom with my baby. I gather my strength to go into the bathroom and say, "My baby! My baby!"

I am in the bathroom but am not able to use the toilet or do anything else because the bathroom has many windows in it. I notice that the windows do not have any curtains, and people are passing by, ridiculing me, and looking at other people in other bathrooms who are in similar conditions.

I am happy with the new president of out nation. It is another opportunity for me to declare that my granddaughter will not have to wear a corset. Then I realize that many hours have passed, and that I am making a guess about her future. I know that soon I will have to wake up from the dream and face reality.

It is imminent that my house is to be torn down. In my hands I have the key to the strong box but I do not proceed to open it. Soon I decide to open it and take back the contents. Also at the same time I find myself very anguished and even more so as I observe my house being totally destroyed. But I turn my attention to the items I have acquired; they are totally brilliant and fresh.

I am being guided to a golden cave. I climb into the cave after I see Chinese statues at the entrance to the cave. I see where I man had broken off a piece of the cave, like a stalactite. On it was recorded the numbers 9, 7, and 7. There is a sound a bat comes out of the cave, and I go down the stairs.

I am in an old city, still ruled by Romans. I am a Prime Minister and am riding calmly and tranquilly, yet firmly, at the side of a carriage containing young people making nose and having a good time. Because of this noise, the Romans condemn me to death by decapitation. I travel quietly to the place where I will be beheaded, without thinking anything, neither grief nor sorrow. Finally, I arrive at the place of execution, and I remember my clients and find out that really need me. Therefore, I resolve to negotiate my liberty with the Romans.

I am in front of a building which has a simple medieval style, probably a kind of warehouse with many compartments. The ground is dirt and the building is made of terra-cotta. I see a group of women dressed in typical Italian style: white socks and flat shoes. The skirts and vests are embroidered over a dark background. They wear white blouses and a beret on their heads. They talk about the harvest. And it orders to guarantee a good harvest they decided to bring some dolls which were handing on the front part of the warehouse. I saw four dolls, two boys and two girls, wearing typical Italian clothes. They were big, and very well made, like papier-mache. They were hanging on the left side of the building. I asked the women why they did that. They said they could not answer me. It is a secret, they said, and they laughed. In that situation it because clear the women knew that I did not belong to their community. Nevertheless, I insisted, and one of them, a young woman, came closer to me, approximately six feet, and told me the reason the dolls were there was because of their differences. "You are intelligent, "she said. "You think about this and see if you can find out why."

I dream that my body is floating above the bed. I was feeling very bad. I felt I was going to throw up. I was looking at myself on the bed, and some people were around my body. They were dressed in green with berets and with a piece of cloth on their mouths. I knew they were medical doctors. There was a spotlight on the ceiling. (I woke up and I felt really bad.)

I am in a wide open space with a large green bush that extends its branches out horizontally without limits. It is huge. Someone comes, carrying some roosters. They are crowing, and then start eating the leaves of the bush. I go to the bush to look for a perfect rose. But the flowers have been eaten by the roosters. Other than that, everything is very beautiful.

I am in a kitchen to prepare coffee. I get together everything that I will need to make the coffee but I don't get started. Then I go to my bedroom to make my bed. It is in great disorder. Then I start to pack a suitcase with all my clothes to go on a trip. But I don't get it packed, and everything is a mess.

I dreamed of two palm trees, not so tall, one by the side of the other, totally yellow. They are at the side of my bed in the room where I sleep. They form the shape of an arch. I remember that I had seen the same two palm trees in an earlier dream.

I am in front of a clinic. I look through the second floor window and see my late brother. Then I see my late grandmother. They both look back at me through another window, I can see my late grandfather. My grandparents tell me that they have given a great deal of money to their daughter with the cooperation of the hospital.

I am in a very large room, somewhat like a castle. The ceiling is very, very high, and a ladder that I'm climbing goes way up. It's so high that the ladder and objects get scarier. Many rung sand missing from the ladder in some places. A fairy woman, actually very crone-like, pushes me up to areas without ladder steps. Finally at the top I'm looking at books as there's a library up there. Then I'm coming down. At the large missing places, the fairy woman just gives me a push. Going down is somewhat bumpy with long slides. When I reach the bottom a man--who apparently I know--is waiting for me. I start walking behind him. Other people are walking in this area. I feel love for this man and gratitude as well. I reach out and turn him around so I can express this feeling from my heart and kiss him.

I dreamed about spools of thread. They had been dropped on the street--purple, brown, wine-colored--six spools. I picked them up and was checking them. I thought about the carelessness of these people who had dropped them. The threat--the spools--were quite valuable to me but not so to the group and specifically not to the people who lost them or dropped them. I had to stay in a room that wasn't mind--a cluttered bedroom. I was going to put clean sheets on a single bed. The dream wandered on to a staircase and a man who is bearded followed me, which implied intimacy which I was not expecting. So I think about calling another man about getting a foot massage. My mother enters the dream and gives me a message that a man has called. She has trouble finding where she wrote the number--but eventually she finds it. I call him at his work--a radio station, and I ask him if he gives my mother and me a foot massage.

I'm with my husband. I think that this is strange because my husband died last year. There is something else strange because when I look at my husband, I only see my father's face. This is very puzzling to me because my father is dead. And he died some50 years ago.

I want to go back to my home, near a star, the planet "Lilaz. "It is made of crystal rock and amethyst. There, I'm only energy with other people who are also energy. Always in the dream I feel intense emotion, being homesick for my home on that planet. And I feel that I am travelling in the direction of the planet, through a dark space.

I was in a small car on a narrow road, ascending and descending, bumping against things, feeling isolated. My aunt was driving. We were sitting in the front seat very close to each other because another aunt of mind was on the other wise, so I was in the middle of both of them. I was feeling very well even though surprised with the face that the aunt of mind who was driving was of an advanced age. Each of us was bringing a shallow plate with colorful drawings with us. In the car, there were circular ones as well.

I started out at home and went to the center of town to finish something. I started to return but did not know in which direction to go. I was very confused, frightened, and puzzled, because I remembered where I started from but not how to get there. It was a simple thing, but I could not remember how to do it. I thought of asking somebody it was of no use. How could anybody else tell me where I started from? I tried many ways to find my directions but nothing worked. Then someone saw me and took me back, but it was to the wrong place. Finally, I saw the place I was looking for. But I thought the person waiting for me would not believe my story.

I was going to school, eating popcorn. I was very calm. When I began crossing the square, I passed by a statue which I had never seen before. However, I saw it because the statue moved. I observed it was a statue of a man. At the same time, he moved from his place, he caught a piece of my popcorn. I was not afraid, but surprised. I looked at him, and with the power of mind, he pushed me to the hole from which he had originally come. Well, I thought it was a hole. As soon as I was in the hole, I noticed it was a tunnel. I began to fall, feeling the cold walls, which were white. After some seconds, I stopped because I was at the end of the tunnel. I had a feeling I was in the center of the earth, completely alone. There was another kind of world here. It was possible to see mountains that were very far away. No houses, no people, nor any kind of roads. No trees, no vegetables. Gray mountains. There was no sun. So I could not understand why, even without sun, it was not completely dark. A few seconds later, I noticed other tunnels and immediately I saw other people arriving the same way I did. Now, not only people, but animals, like cat sand dogs, started to arrive. I asked one man what was going on.

I am in an elevator, generally with other people. When I want to use it, it begins to move and shake. I am in a panic--the elevator moves up or down at great velocity and I can't control it. (In one of the dreams) the elevator lost its walls and became a platform a moving platform, and started shaking. Finally, I am able to arrive (and the dream ended).

I have to get down from someplace, usually outdoors, and find the stairs are shaky, and some steps are missing. And I'm scared and begin to fall. I consider using some shaky structures like boards or planks that are loose, and I seem to swing back and forth and sideways when I try to step or crawl on them.

I was at home with my younger brother. We were playing the “Go” game endlessly. I was not as skilled as my brother was, however I won. That was the first victory I ever had over him. We were both surprised. I had wanted that moment to happen for a long time. I asked him to do it again to show how far I had improved. But he refused saying he was too tired. He suggested that I should study logic or math instead. I knew it was pure luck that I won. The next moment he was tutoring me in math with an arrogant attitude. I was upset about him superiority and his contempt for me. Then I forcefully took him to our headmaster’s office in the school we used to go to together. As soon as I opened the door, I found the headmaster was a woman who was teaching all the male faculty members math. I cheered and clapped as much as I could for her.

I was alone in a blank space. There was nothing to be seen. Nobody was to be seen, of course. I was looking for some activity. But everything seemed so pristine. Nothing could be heard but the sound of my breathing. I was watching myself so that I could see my whole action. I was attempting to control my movements by psychokinesis. I was so successful that I was acting like a robot. I knew then that I was dreaming. I thought I could use the power in waking life.

I was shopping for a birthday gift for my friend. I was not sure what she would like. I could not decide if I should buy a new gift or give her one that I already had. It didn’t take me a long time to make a decision. I found the perfect gift at home. It was something a friend had given me, but I had never used it. It was a refined china tea set, with a celadon glaze. I my other friend’s hobby was making tea for special dinners, and collecting chinaware for that task. I was so confident about the gift that I hardly could wait for the day to come. I went to the birthday party with the gift. I was actually showing the gift off in public. And I met the friend there who had originally given me the gift. I would never have imagined that the two of them were friends. I felt so embarrassed.

I was asked to organize a project where people would help other people by telephone. I had been hoping for this type of volunteer situation for a long time so I told the man “yes,” without any hesitation. I was floating on the thought, asking myself how much I could do and what kind of job it would be. I felt myself so nervous about doing that because I had never done such a job before. There was a meeting regarding what we could expect. I was insisting on planting trees and flowers along the street so that we could make the city cleaner with more birds, bees, and other insects. The people there seemed to agree with my idea. Then I found myself chosen as mayor for carrying out our project. But soon afterwards, I was surrounded by a lot of enemies who were shouting at me, telling me the city had become a jungle and that people couldn’t get to their offices to start work. I saw that trees were even coming out of buildings, but I was very pleased to see it happening.

My daughter was angry with me for some reason. I didn’t dare ask her the reason but I guessed it was because I was not able to understand or accept her behavior. Also, I knew I was manipulating her too much whenever she was attempting to do something. Suddenly, she came to me and said, “I will get married soon.” She showed me the picture of her boy friend. I was jealous of her because the picture of the man she loved closely resembled my husband in his appearance.

I am at the end of a dark room with some male and female friends. I feel uncomfortable because everything I have done in life has gone wrong. I am trying to find the way to get out of this pattern. I get some good advice from my friends. Some say that I should head out to the north and find a small village where different kinds of artists live. I should look for a Zen painter, the only one who could lead me to a meaningful life. I follow the advice and find him. He is an old man who I seemed to have met before; he reminds me of my grandfather who died about 15 years earlier. He asks me why I had come to see him. I honestly tell him about my problems in life. He tells me he had already died, but that he had known me well. Then I realize that he is my grandfather who had been an artist living in the northern part of Japan. Since then, “north” and “art” have become my symbols for meaning in life, and I have felt strongly that I could communicate with someone dead.

I am flying high in the sky, and then I am gradually going down, finally landing against my will because I want to keep flying. Then, I am trying to fly again, but my efforts are in vain. As soon as I realize that I won’t be able to fly, I realize that I am dreaming. [This is a typical sign that I am dreaming. If I actually had began to fly, I would not have known that I was dreaming.]

I was holding a cat in my arms, and it was getting heavier and heavier every second. Then I noticed that it had become a giant animal, like a big dog. The whole body became warmer, and its faced was filled with anger. I was so overwhelmed that I could not hold it any longer. It fell from my arms and ran away. I knew then that the animal was saying something, something important. I didn’t know what it could be. [The next morning, in the newspaper, I read that a number of dogs had been slaughtered in an animal shelter. I was chilled by the news.]

It was night, and I knew that there was something following me, but I didn’t know what it was. I was looking back to find what it was. It was a cat with some type of mask on. The mask it wore was my favorite cartoon character, one that has been my hero. I was attempting to catch it, but the cat ran with an amazing speed. In spite of that fact, I started to chase it as rapidly as I could. Then I found it, exhausted at the end of the corner in a small street. I noticed that its face had become the mask itself. Then I became in awe of the figure. I was kneeling to the animal. I became an obedient slave, following whatever orders it gave to me.

I have a surprise visitor. She is Ms. O-Chou from the Japanese cartoon series, “Becoming an Ace.” She is very beautiful with long, curly hair. I take her into my kitchen, and we bake a cake together. However, we did something wrong and the cake turns out to be a failure. [This Anime, or cartoon series, was very popular in Japan and focused on a girl who became a tennis star; Ms. O-Chou, or Ms. Butterfly, was her rival.]

I am at the school where I work, and the students come into my room. I count them, and discover that there is one too few. I talk to another teacher at this school and tell her about the situation. She tells me that there is a girl who wants to transfer to our school, and this vacancy will allow her to join my class.

I am at dinner, and a friend of mine is supposed to join me. But I can’t find her, and I fret nervously. There are some other women in the restaurant. I recognize them, because I work with them at the office. So we have something to eat, and then we take a walk together.

I am with my family, eating a meal in my house. My grandfather is outside sitting on a swing in the yard. Suddenly, there is a loud sound; the swing’s chair has broken. Then there was another sound, and it is my grandfather falling from the swing. I think I just go and get help, but I am afraid and I can’t move. It takes a long time for me just to go to the Genkan [the entrance of the house]. I look in the direction of the yard. My grandfather is limping along, in great confusion. With a stern look on his face, he enters the house and throws something out that he has been carrying. Then he leaves the house again, and there is another loud sound. He has fallen down on the road. [The image was so strong that I woke up, and could not get back to sleep again for an hour or so. My grandfather had died last year.]

I am at work. I get into an argument with a woman who I dislike. I feel that she has been needlessly hostile to me. And as a result, I make a mistake in my work assignment. This makes me even more upset and angry.

I am walking along a road in an area that I think I know very well. But I get lost, and end up somewhere I had not been before. I find that I am at the edge of a cliff, so I jump down and end up gliding through the air. I have not done this before, but I enjoy it.

I am in a house that I do not recognize, and am speaking with a few people. A middle-sized alligator comes in, and crawls up to my feet. I am surprised, and worried. I try to run away. However, this alligator likes people and so it comes after me. The other people don’t seem worried at all, and are very calm, feeding the alligator bits of food. I go into another room, and try to shut the door so it can not come in. But it looks like the alligator will force the door open and get in. I struggle with the door [and then I wake up].

I am in a room where there is only a table and a chair. Two or three men are in the room with me. They are strangers to me, and they are talking about something. I started telling them about someone who works at the same company that I do, and with whom I exchange emails. However, I called him “Mr. X” in my conversation with the strangers. I said, “We must contact Mr. X or else something serious will happen.” But these men did not listen to me. And then I noticed that they were not even listening to each other; each of them was talking on his own.

I dreamed I had witnessed a traffic accident, but I could not stop because I had to get to work. And then I was on a train, commuting to the place where I work. An old acquaintance came up to me and said, “Hello.” She was very friendly, even though we had not seen each other for a long time. [This was someone I actually did bump into the next day.]

My boyfriend and I are late to an international meeting. When we arrive at the meeting, we notice that all the other participants are women. Furthermore, they are all my former classmates from the private girls’ school I attended. My error is not just in being late, but who I brought along—someone not appropriate in this place, my boyfriend. I am severely frowned up for this transgression, and I am very embarrassed about the incident.

I open the door of my apartment and a UFO flies in the sky overhead. My family is in the living room and they all say, “It is just somebody’s remote control.” But as soon as they say this, the UFO suddenly picks up speed and enters the room. It falls to the floor and breaks. When I look closely, I see that inside is full of many button batteries. All of a sudden a voice speaks. [Then I wake up.]

I am walking outside, and notice that my wallet is missing. I turn around to see a guy running away with it. He drops it, and I pick it up. But it isn't mine. Then the guy comes back and shoots me in the head. I fall to the ground, holding my head where it was shot, and I hear a man say, “Man, pop her again.” I act as if I am dead, so I won’t get shot twice. My legs start to feel stiff and I can’t move.

I am in a bus, standing by the door. I am tired and look for a seat. I find one, but it is too narrow. I try to find another one, but that is too narrow as well. I move to the back and finally find a seat. A woman who I know sits down by me, asking, “Do you have some change?” I ignore her, take my purse, and walk to the door to get off. A girl I do not know sits down in front of me, and gets off the bus when I do. She is walking with a girl friend, and I am walking with someone too. At the corner, the girl turns around and talks with me: “I will come with this person, so I will be late.” I know where we are; it is like a market. I know this place and murmur, “Ah, this way leads to here.”

As I enter my classroom, my students are sitting in their seats. It is already past the time for the lesson to start, but I am late. I am told by a student, “You are late,” and feel as if I should go and sit in the corner.

I am dreaming of the man who lives next door, but not of his wife. In my dream, he leaves silently while I practice my piano lessons. This is my hobby, and I wonder what he does for hobbies. Then he comes back very late at night; but this time I am knitting because that is my other hobby. In my dream, I am happy that I am improving both my piano playing and my knitting.

I am walking through the downtown area of a city, with tall buildings lining the streets. This town is like a war battlefield, with rubble and buildings that are falling down. The sky is a strange red-black color. There are dead bodies all over lying on the ground. Also, there are many people falling from the tops of buildings and dying. [I did not like this dream.]

I am in the backyard of a house. There is a family of white cats with round black spots on them. Some look like large panthers, and others are little kittens. I try to play with the kittens but they escape before I can touch them. Suddenly, I realize that my mouth is filled with hard bits of something and I try to empty it. I spit out plastic miniatures of people. I spit out metal bits. Finally, I spit out teeth. At first, it didn’t seem as if I was emptying my mouth at all, but then I managed to spit out a lot. I could feel the spaces left by my missing teeth, but it didn’t bother me. But when I looked on the ground, I couldn’t see any of the bits I had spit out.

In this dream, I walk out of my room. I see my roommate but then I take a closer look and she has turned into a man. So I walk down the hallway, but then it changes into a shopping mall. I ask someone how to get out of here, and she says, “Go to the right.” I see this building that looks familiar. It has an elephant walking around on the outside, with another elephant on the inside.

I am climbing up on a cliff with my best friend and a guy she knows. We see a beautiful ocean with dolphins swimming in it. We all go down to the beach, and enjoy the water. This guy guides me while I go swimming in the ocean. Later, I go to a ski park, and there is that guy again. He calls me by name, but I ignore him. Finally, he comes up and hugs me really hard. I am afraid that my best friend is interested in this guy and I don’t want to encourage his attentions to me.

I dream that my best friend is married to a movie star. She has left her boyfriend behind. I also see her parents consoling the former boyfriend. But he surprises us all by telling us that he got married even before his ex-girlfriend did. I end up feeling jealous of my best friend, and of the women that her ex-boyfriend married.

I am trying to get dressed because I have to get to work, or I will get a poor grade in my class. My destination is a school and I have to be at a class that starts very punctually. I worry myself sick that I will be late. But then I arrive at the school and I am early. I have plenty of time to get to my class.

I am with a baby girl. She is beautiful and cute. Her mother and father are watching and smiling. The baby is playful, and she starts to play with all three of us. Then she is able to call each of us by name. I think she is growing up quite fast. The only problem is that I lose track of time while playing with her.

This guy [who I used to work with] is standing outside my office. He is getting ready to say “goodbye” but really does not want to go. There is another guy just getting out of a shower. He is eavesdropping on our conversation. Then the first guy leaves, and I really don’t care. But I am concerned with the second guy’s feelings, because I think I like him.

In this dream, an airplane is moving through the sky. The airplane eventually takes a nosedive and crashes. I am a spectator [in all these dreams]. I am watching from a distance, and seem to know that the airplane is going to crash. They start out by moving across a clear sky. And then they crash.

I am in the room where I lived when I was a young girl. But I am in my younger brother’s crib. But then the room looks like a rain forest, and a large snake is weaving its way in and out of the vegetation. I do not see its head, but I know that it is coming toward me. I feel quite safe because I am in the crib. I just watch it from what seems to be a safe distance.

I had a dream about the movie star, Jim Carey. I tell him that I don’t like him, and don’t like the movies he makes. But he wants to play a game or two with me, and I agree. First we play chess. Then he pulls out some paper and some scissors, and we cut them into various designs, and I really start to have fun.

I was at school with my boyfriend and we are walking around a building. He starts talking with his friends, and then we start making out right in front of these men and women. But they don’t pay attention to us. We about to have sex, and I wanted to, but then he said it was gross, and he stopped. Then his friends yelled at him, and said, “The building is on fire.” He grabs me around the waist, and walks out of the building with me.

I am with a guy who I really like. I have written a poem in his honor, and it expresses my feelings for him, even though I don’t think he really likes me. He is what people call a “mack daddy.” But I give him the poem anyway. He takes the poem and reads it. Then he shows it to everyone, and tells them that I am the only girl in the whole school who likes him.

In this dream, I am pregnant. I don’t see how this could have happened because I have been on Depo shots for one year and one half, taking the shots faithfully. I am married [in waking life] but I am simply not ready to have any more children at this time. There are several other women around me, and I know some of them. They are all pregnant, but don’t seem to be as concerned as I am.

I am somewhere, riding in an elevator. This is not a typical elevator. It always has an unusual door that one uses to get out. In this dream, there were three women in the elevator too. The elevator stops and two of the women take quick steps to get to the side of the elevator opposite the door we came in. I think, “Why are these two women moving to that side so quickly?” At that moment, the elevator stops and the side opens up just like one of those flip-up garage doors. I started to fall, and the third woman is standing on a bar that was under the floor. The other women have already exited. She watches me as I hit the floor. I have terrible back pain and just lay there [until the telephone rings and wakes me up].

There is a snake in my apartment. It is brown, black, and white. It attacks me, and is about to attack my seven-month old baby. But reach out just in time to prevent it from attacking. I pull my baby to safety. Later, it attacks my mother. Then the snake is killed by a schoolmate [one I don’t like in waking life]. The bite from the snake still hurts because it was very intense. [When I wake up, the mark it left in the dream is still on my arm.]

I am dreaming about my teeth. I am waking up in the morning, and everything is fine. But then I look into the mirror as I brush my teeth. I see that I have many cavities. And my braces are breaking. Worst of all, some of my teeth are falling out, first one and then another. They fall out gradually, with a lot of bleeding. [In all these dreams] I feel embarrassed by the lost teeth, but nobody seems to notice the problem.

I am waking with my boyfriend down the streets of a big city. There are lots of people around us. Then we see snakes everywhere. We try to avoid them, but have to step on them. Some are tan, some are gray, and some are black. And there are lizards on the street too, along with the snakes.

In this dream, a black and yellow spider was biting me. The spider seemed very playful and started jumping around from bush to bush. Then I saw a friend who I know in waking life. He is a college student majoring in ethics. He told me that the colorful spider was harmless and was just having some fun.

I am falling into something. There is very negative black imagery all around me as I fall. I start to tear at my shirt, and scream as loudly as I can. I try to jump out of this hole that I have fallen into, but the harder I try, the deeper I get. I am absolutely terrified and realize that I have never been so frightened. [When I wake up, my T-shirt has holes in it; I actually tore it while I was sleeping.]

My girl friend and her former boy friend start to chase after me with needles. I keep on running, hoping that I can catch a bus. But I just miss the bus. I am glad because I see my boyfriend coming down the street. I start to cry as he holds me. I wait with him for his bus, and my attackers don’t dare come after me.

I was in a dark room, and I could not find my way out of it. I saw Sam, a friend of mine. He was wearing a white shirt and black shorts. He entered the room. I was happy to see him, and was sure that he had come to help me out. But then, Sam attacks me sexually. We struggle and I can not get out from under him. Suddenly, a door opens and a faceless figure is there. He saves me from Sam, a friend who I thought I could trust. [The next day, I am at a friend’s house. Sam is there, and he puts his hand on my ankle and starts moving up my leg. I ask him to move back, and then I violently push him off. Was this dream a warning?]

My former boyfriend hands me a blue baby outfit. Then he tells me that his girlfriend is pregnant. If his girlfriend is pregnant, I do not understand why this guy hands me the blue baby outfit. I tell him this, and he does not give me an answer Nevertheless, he puts the outfit in my hand, as if I will know what to do with it.

There was a woman in this dream who I apparently knew. There was a man in the dream who seemed to know us both. [I did not know either of them in waking life.] He started to cut off her feet, and then wore them around his neck. I walked into the room and saw her shoes on the desk covered with blood. When I looked up at the man, he was wearing her feet. He was laughing, and implied that it was all my fault. It was very scary.

I dreamed that I was asleep in my bed when I heard a noise. I got up and decided to investigate. When I turned on the light, there were three kittens that came into my house by means of the bedroom window. There was one kitten in particular that was very friendly. It was a black and white kitten with blue eyes.

I am in my bathroom just coming out of the shower, and find a frog. I try kicking water at it, but it hops toward me. I try to step on it, but as my foot touches its back, the back hardens and grows tiny round bumps and I start spinning around on top of its back. I am afraid of what will happen next. [In waking life, I hate frogs.]

I am walking down the street, and I realize that I forgot to put my clothes on. There are many people, both men and women, on the street and I feel very exposed. But no one seems to be noticing that I am naked. They just keep walking on their way as if nothing unusual is happening. [In some dreams, I am at a public gathering and discover that I am naked.]

I had a dream that my boy friend left me. I thought that everything was going well in our relationship, and I had arranged to meet him for a date at a shopping mall. When I arrived, he was already there. But he said, “I do not love you anymore,” and walked away. I was surprised and sad.

I can not get a taxicab. As I am looking for one, I see a good-looking woman with long black hair in a car. She has her emergency flashers on; the car is like a big ranger-rover. Then I think this woman might be a man. While I am trying to make up my mind, a cute young guy with a shaved head starts to talk to me. But I am not interested and I point to the car and say, “I’m just waiting for my friend to park.” The kid leaves and I shrug my shoulders to the person in the car, and mouth “Thank you.” The driver waves me over and he is a man. He offers me a ride home, even though he has a five-hour drive ahead to visit his parents. I don’t feel the least bit nervous so I climb in. He is handsome and strong, like a guy in a cheesy romance novel. I ask him what he does for a living, and he says, “I’m a professional dancer, and I also study shiatsu massage.” I think, “What a package!” He is so charming that when he drops me off, I can’t resist giving him a kiss goodnight. Then we start to make out, but we have to stop because I don’t want to make him late for his visit, and the traffic will get bad soon. We exchange telephone numbers and promise to meet Saturday night. With fire in our eyes, we kiss one last time, and he drives off.

I am in my house. I notice that there is water in the room. The toilet overflows, and it fills the room with water. Then some little girl is throwing snow into the house, and I get very angry. I scream and yell. [I wake up hearing my own voice yelling.]

I am supposed to strike another person with all my might, but really can’t get it right. I feel very nervous that I can’t hit the other person. Then it is me who is being chased. I run to a river, and jump into it and hide. When I get out of the river, I discover that I am naked. I run through the forest without any clothes on.

I am driving a car with broken windshield wipers. I don’t know where I am going. All of a sudden, I enter a side road, not the road that will take me to my destination. I drive along a riverbank, and then get out of my car. The river overflows and I am waist deep in water. I walk to an apartment building, still waist deep in the water. On the second floor of the building, a little girl is playing. I climb a wall and there is Mr. Kikuno, a teacher I know. And there is Mr. Toyoguchi, my husband. I had been looking for him. I go to the room where I am to stay, and change my clothes, even though there are a lot of hotel clerks in the room.

It is my wedding. I am marrying a male friend, but he changes into a woman during the ceremony. We exchange earrings instead of finger rings. But the four earrings are all different. There is not even one pair that matches. One of my earrings is too long to wear, but finally I figure out how to manage it. Then, on the way back home, the mother of my best girl friend is driving a car and, at that time, my husband becomes a man again. He is someone I have always known. Then we find out that my mother was kidnapped on her way to our wedding.

Many different colored folded cards are flying about. There is an abundance of light blue cards, more than any other color. I am shown to a restaurant by a waitress and sit down in a chair. In the middle of the table there is a bouquet of sunflowers. At each table in the restaurant, a sunflower bouquet is placed at the far end of the table, opposite the knife and fork. Each bouquet is wrapped in while paper, with English letters on it.

When I open the door of my apartment’s living room, a toy UFO flies over my head. My family all says, “It’s just somebody’s remote control!” But as soon as they say this, the UFO suddenly picks up speed and enters the room. It falls to the floor and breaks. When I look closely, I see that the inside is full of many batteries. They are button batteries. All of a sudden, a strange voice speaks. But I don’t remember what it said.

A monster is chasing me. It has the shape of a human, but in reality it is a monster. To the surrounding people it appears to be human, because it has carefully disguised itself so that it looks human. However, eventually I figure it out, and it chases me. I run into a room with four corners, where the ceiling is like an alcove shelf. I enter the room and control my breathing. I breathe silently so that the monster will not discover me.

I am taking a drive in a new car that my friend has just bought. We stop at a shop in a familiar neighborhood, the catfish shop. She puts some of the fish in a plastic bag and we leave the shop. But the shop lady chases us. We are going to make our getaway in the car, but it won’t move. We desperately try to get away. We even push the car to get it started. We finally get the car started and find ourselves at a children’s party area, up ahead. There is a “fried chicken throwing contest,” like a pie throw. I stand up in amazement to watch this. I have never seen anything like it.

A voice, in English, was trying to tell me something. I didn’t speak at all but just listened to what this voice said. It was a male voice, coming out of nowhere into my house. Then a friend of mine, Chantalle, entered the room. I spoke to her in English. “I have naturally curly hair,” I said. I was amazed that I was speaking English so well.

At the steepest slope on the Kitataisetu ski hill, a cross-country ski race is being held. Students, teachers, and village people are lined up on the slope, and are making their final preparations for the race. The wind is very strong. It is very noisy, as everyone gets ready for the race. I don’t put my skis on, but remain standing. I will act as a race official. Standing next to me is a tour guide from a travel company. He is like an old friend and is speaking very freely with me. It is the coldest part of winter, but the tour guide is only wearing a navy blue suit. “It’s going to start any minute now,” he says. “Yes, it seems that way,” I answer. [As we are talking, I wake up.]

I dreamed about a member of our workshop, even though I had never met her before yesterday. For some reason, she transformed into my mother. I think she symbolized my mother. I told my mother that I was unreliable; I could not be depended upon 100% of the time. I was relieved that I was able to tell her this. (I never would have been able to tell her such a thing in waking life.) I told her that I hadn’t told her this before, because I was afraid I would shrink. And I did not want to shrink. Then I started to cry.

I was in Tokyo. For some reason, I had to find a job and live, even though the living conditions were very difficult. I felt too exhausted to look for a room. Besides, I did not have enough money for a good apartment. I settled for a small apartment in a slum. I was with a real estate agent; she was showing me around. In that area the houses were made out of wood. They were old, dirty, noisy, and surrounded by a lot of rubbish. I was crying in grief that I had to live in this place. (Then I woke up sweating, and my heart was beating rapidly.)

I was in the upstairs of a house. I went downstairs to the living room. There was my mother, father, my older sister, and my younger sister. My father was sleeping in a blanket, and the others were eating and watching television. I asked them about an odd man I had seen earlier that day. My father said, "Maybe is as on of Kaku." Kaku was a relative who had disappeared many years earlier. My father told me that Kaku had gone to sea, and had never been heard from again. Perhaps the strange man was his son.

I was watching a ship at sea. A storm came up. The men and women in the ship were caught in the wreck. I think they all drowned --hundreds of them. There were no survivors that I could see. Their bodies sank into the water. A long time later, one of the drowned men appeared to me. He said that he wanted peace. His soul wanted rest. He came to me, asking if I would help him. If I knew about him, this would give him permission to finally have peace.

I dreamed that someone was pulling my arms and was trying to wake me up. There was a man I did not know sitting near my head. He grasped both of my arms and kept pulling me. It was painful. I began to scream "Stop it! What are you doing?" He said nothing. But I began to feel that he was sad, almost crying. He wanted to tell me something but he couldn't. He kept pulling my arms and shaking them. Finally, with a lot of power, I moved my body and made him stop. He was still sitting in the same place. He looked like a white shadow. He could tell me nothing. He only had a sad look on his face. His eyes were full of expression, but he could not speak. I could tell he was full of emotion. Perhaps he did not know how to express his feelings.

I was trying to escape some evil men. I hid behind a dog. The dog was very large and it liked me very much. The dog couldn't hide my feet, however, and I was afraid that the evil men would notice my feet and that would be a giveaway that I was there.

(Dream within a dream) A witch was attacking me. I felt miserable and lonely. Then I woke up. But I was still in the dream. Now I was with another woman, and I was tired. I was telling her about the terrible dream. She wanted to know what city it was in, and wanted to hear about the structure of the city. I drew a map on a piece of paper. The houses were built along a winding river. The woman began to criticize my drawing. (Suddenly I woke up and I was really awake.)

(Past life dream) In this dream I was a young male beggar somewhere in Europe. Two other beggars and I came back from begging on the street. We had no food or money. My clothes were dirty and I had long, curly, brown hair. I had not bathed in a long time. I opened a heavy wooden door at a gate of a thick stone fortress. In the fortress there was an area for miserable beggars to sleep. An ugly old woman found me and the other beggars trying to keep warm by a fire. She hit one of us and dashed a container of liquid on the head of the other one. Nobody tried to stop her, or to help us. I think it was the tenth or the eleventh century. I was not Japanese. It might have been a former lifetime.

I was in the school that I attended when I was a child. I was talking with my teacher about my school tests. She had been scoring a test I had taken, and had given me a good mark on it, even though it was difficult. I was very happy because I had received a high score on the test.

I am flying as high as I can get, to the sun. At first I go slowly, but then, like a rocket, faster and faster. I penetrate the layer of clouds and forget about everything that has happened. The clouds are fluffy and soft, so I dive into them, swim in them as if I were in water, and dive down to the dark layers and then fly up. Below, it is stormy with lightening.

I killed another woman in this dream, and I am escaping from the police. I am hiding in the underground, and I am living there. Now I live with a terrified feeling all the time. I am very scared that the police will find me.

I am in the street and I meet a guy I really hate. As soon as he sees me, he runs toward me and chases me for a long time. He calls my name loudly, but I am not screaming. I am escaping from him. I try to get as far away from him as possible. But I am not successful. (Then I wake up and notice that I am kicking the wall. I think that this is why I could not get further in the dream.)

I am with my classmate from elementary school. I have just found out that if I do not teach her something, something really bad will happen to her brother. But I do not even remember her name, and I do not know what to say to her.

I am in a strange place. I have never been there before. It seems to be somewhere in the United States. I am walking in an underground shopping center. There are many black people and Hispanics around me, and I am very scared.

In this dream, my boy friend starts to chase me. He seems to be a different person now, different than I have ever known him before. I am puzzled at this difference in him. I think he is going to try to hurt me. I am frightened of him.

I am lying on the ground. There is a hole about ten centimeters further from the tips of my toes. The ground is wet, and it is dark all around. I feel like there is water coming from the hole, and I am keeping my toes from getting stuck in the hole. I scratch the dirt, and try to bury the hole. It is getting cold, and I am scared. (Even while I was sleeping, I was moving my toes to cover the hole.)

I am in front of my computer, making my home page. Somehow, I meet another girl on the net. I can see her on my screen. She is pretty. She is a tiny American girl. I have never met her before in dreams or in my waking life. However, we are talking like really close friends. She asks if she can link her page to mind, and I am happy to do it.

I am in a room. The room opens into a hallway. I am running down the hallway, away from a foreign-looking man with a long knife in his hand. I try to escape back into the room, but it takes forever to get there. I am frightened. Finally, he grabs me with a bear hug. His knife penetrates my back into my heart.

I am watching two scenes at the same time. I am looking at myself in a room. My hair is blond. My mother is there in the same room and I don't recognize her. She is sitting on a rocking chair and has blond hair too. My grandmother is in the room and I don't recognize her either. She is sitting on a couch drinking a cup of black tea. They both wear classic long fluffy skirts with many pleats. The room has a fireplace and it is warm.

I am standing on the stage of a large Kabuki theater. There I am supposed to dance a traditional Japanese dance alone. A Shamisen band and Nagauta singers are accompanying me. They are all ready to start. I don't have a clue as to what type of dance I am supposed to do. If could watch the dance routine at least once, I know I could do it. The hall is packed. The curtain opens and I wake up.

I am outside under the sky. I am with my husband looking up at the sky. Suddenly, we see a UFO--an unidentified flying object. I become very close with my husband under the influence of the UFO. It is as if I am breathing through him, as if we have one body. We both rise and meet the UFO. Then I realize that I can no longer breathe for both of us! I become terrified and start to breathe for myself alone.

I was in an open field. There were trees and hills and flowers. I heard a strange noise and looked up into the air. I could see an airplane. From the direction it was coming from, I knew it was from the United States. I waved my greetings to the airplane and knew I would be going to the United States someday (and I did).

This dream took place in the house where I grew up. I was with my sister's corpse. She had died. I was very sad. Then the dead body started to talk to me. She was very friendly. We had a nice conversation. She told me where some candy had been hidden by her. I went to her room and found it. It was in a box. I ate it. I told my sister it was very good.

I was dreaming that I had fallen ill. I was in my bed feeling very sickly. But my consciousness lifted right out of my body. I left the body, left the room I was in, and floated all over the city, seeing the buildings and the streets. When I returned to my body, I felt better. In fact, I was no longer sick and had healed myself.

I was traveling with a male friend in the country. We were going to a rifle expedition with guns and sports. One of the men in the group bragged that he was very dangerous with guns. I was wearing a green brocade outfit. We saw a sports display of guns and all kinds of weapons, and brought up the topic of a friend who is a strong Catholic. He was the one who said he was very dangerous with guns. And a friend said, "No matter who is around, he will go into his back yard and shoot like a mad man."

I was walking on a somewhat paved road in the valley where I was born. The mud of a paddy field next to me suddenly started to move. While I was wondering what was happening, a very large fish, larger than the depth of the paddy field, and a snapper-looking red fish suddenly appeared. First I was frightened, but then the fish started to talk to me normally, saying, "I've been living here about 150 years." I replied, "I saw a green fish before." The red fish said, "Oh, that is longer than I am. That fish has been living here about 200 years. Excuse me." Then it went back into the paddy field. Although I have just met an incredible thing, I was talking very calmly just like I was giving a direction when somebody asked me, or experiencing the feeling I have when I listen to a very interesting story.

I am in the dark and see a huge flood at a distance. I am filled with terror. I run and run, but the flood looks as if it is catching up with me. The flood is taking everything -- houses, trees, and people. I can see that the water of the flood is ultimately going to destroy the people.

Someone is chasing me and that someone is a man. I'm not alone. There are other people who are trying to help me escape. The place is an unused and dusty factory, light brown in color. The person chasing me seems to have a gun. I'm trying to run away from something unpleasant. I don't remember who was running with me. The person was right by me, but I don't recall who she was.

In a dark room a trainer is playing old court music. There are several other people in the room. He is wearing an ancient costume. There is a vague mist, but through the mist I can seethe man's face. I notice that his face is clear. I continue to hear the music.

I'm in a white concrete building talking with a woman who is not Japanese. A man, dark-skinned but not Japanese, with a gun comes in from outside. We are both scared. Both of us run away from the man. The places we run to are all narrow places. I find a gray box for two of us to get under. The man with a gun comes to that place. I wake up.

I see a big frog, and two frogs that are following it. They are blue, a nice color for frogs, I think. Their eyes are big and shiny, and are round. These frogs are traveling on a mountain road, cliff, field, or desert, under a glittering sun. They don't know where they are going. They become thirsty. Now they search for water but they can't find it easily. Now the beautiful blue-colored frogs become dusty, dirty, and are almost dying. Their tears are starting to fall. They think of dying, then two of the frogs find water. It is a place near my countryside, where I live. They drink the water, are satisfied, then go home.

I'm flying in the sky. It is not a big blue sky, but in between the electric wires of the poles in front of my house. I'm flying alone, below these wires. When I fly close to the earth, I don't touch the ground, but I can feel gravity. I feel like my soul is being taken away. After a while, I'm flying in a blue sky without any obstacles. I'm also watching this dream like I am watching a movie.

I am lying down and a long thing is around my neck. It doesn't go away. I'm suffering but I can't do anything. It is a long, thin thing. I am lying down by my husband. I want to tell him about the long, thin thing around my neck but I can't get the words out.

I am in a room and it is in the dark. Many friends and my husband are present. They believe very strongly that they have to getaway from me. So they are leaving me. I have been very cold and indifferent to them, so they have given up on me. I was scared and sad, crying and trying to stop them. Then I woke up with tears in my eyes.

This is a big house. It is old and it is shabby. There is something unknown here, and I am being chased. I run into the patio garden but something is still behind me. I keep on running away in despair. When I try to see what is chasing me, it looks like it is simply empty space.

This was a nightmare. It starts out very unclear. A white, floating thing is chasing me. I'm running away with a friend who is a boy. Still it chases me. Soon I see the gate of my house. I am the only one who could go in the gate because it is my house. I run inside. I'm saved, but my friend is still running away. I am full of guilt feelings that I didn't let him in my house.

My cousin is in the middle of a river. It looks as if she is drowning. I want to help her out but I have not done anything yet. My sister is standing beside me. The time to help our cousin is running out. But neither of us does anything to help our cousin.

A big black cockroach comes into my house from the garden. I try to stop it by shutting the door. The cockroach comes under my bedding, which is on the floor. I can see the green of the garden from the room. Besides the green, everything else in the dream is gray.

At my work place, where I do hard work, things do not seem to be going like they are supposed to go. The lectures that I usually give off the top of my head at the training sessions are difficult. I have a loss of memory and become unable to give the lectures. The participants do not follow my instructions, and my assistants do not do what I tell them. Everything I do is in vain.

I'm in a place like an office. I'm talking with two men about going to Hawaii. I'm the one who is going to Hawaii and I'm supposed to meet Shin Aoki. But he is in the United States and I am in Japan. Somehow we can not get in touch. I'm wondering how I am going to meet him, but I'm excited about going to Hawaii. Suddenly, I am in a university campus wearing a knit mini-skirt. And I have a feather-filled jacket on. It's a warm spring day. There are many college students around, walking and laughing. I feel too warm. I take my jacket off and look for an empty locker to put it in, but the locker room is full of dirty sport shirts and garbage. No empty lockers were available, so I put my jacket on my arm and start to walk away.

I am falling down some steps. Right before falling, I say, "I know I'm falling." Then in an instant, I fall. I think the steps came to an end, and when they ended, I feel down and kept on falling. I just seemed to keep on falling and falling some more until I woke up.

I am near the house I lived in before my marriage. I am at a coffee shop or small restaurant. I am having a good time with my friends. Then I am alone, and want to go back to that place. I'm looking for the red car I had been driving, but I could not find it. I get tired of looking for it and give up.

It is early in the morning, before sunrise. The area on the road in front of the train is full of mist. I'm in a good mood. I am arm in arm with my friend, Sakai-San. From behind, my young sister and mother are carrying suitcases. They look a little puzzled at my excitement, not saying anything. Then my mother says that there is no use saying anything to this child. Then she says that my sister is something -- but I can't hear the last word.

I am in a train station. A person moves toward me. He is a man who I like very much. I am very excited to be with him. He says to me that he also likes me very much. I feel really happy to hear him say that. I like him very much too. I am glad to be there with him and to know how he feels.

I am talking with a man. I like him very much. I want to see him again. We are looking at a globe and we are talking. The globe turns and stops at a certain time and place. He says, "I am going to the United States." When he says this, I am afraid he will go away and leave me.

I am walking in my hometown, among huge valleys. I see bubbles coming up from a rice field. As I watch, a big red fish comes up. It looks like a carp. First, I am scared, but this fish has started to talk to me. "I've been living here for 150 years," I told the fish. "I've seen green fish before." The fish replied, "Oh, that one lives longer, more than 200 years. Well, I have to go." Then it sank back into the paddy field. I had met something unbelievable and yet I felt very calm, almost exchanging conversation for asking directions, or listening to an interesting story.

I am in a hotel lobby. There is a big pillar there and I am standing by it. My younger sister comes in. She walks right up to me and stabs me with a knife. My younger sister's name is Aiko. I died from the stabbing. (The dreamer of #19 also dreamed about someone named Aiko, the younger sister of #20; these dreams occurred the same night.)
I am in the lobby of a big hotel. There is a large pillar made of marble. My friend Aiko is there and I stab her with a knife. I don't know why I stab her. Nobody seems to notice what I have done.

I go to a guesthouse on a hill. An old man who I never met is the owner of the guesthouse and gives me a warm welcome. There are lots of Japanese dumplings in the guesthouse. I feel happy when I see the dumplings, and join the other guests who are eating them.

I get off a train at a station. The station is on a cliff and I see the flank of the city. There are many dead bodies hanging over the cliff. They are samurai. Some of them are mummified. I go to a guesthouse on a hill. One old man who is the owner gives me a warm welcome. There are lots of Japanese dumplings -- the type eaten for special parties. I enter the house and look into the back yard. It is filled with dead samurai bodies. They are rotten, smelling, filled with gas. But I didn't actually smell the bad smell. I tell myself, "Well, this is the world in general."

My father, who died in World War II, appears to me. He gives me advice about my artwork. He gives me specific advice on what to paint and how to do it. He tells me the topics, what brushes to use, and what colors to use. (When I wake up, I follow his advice, and I sell the pictures!)

I am in a prairie. The grass is as tall as I am. I am with a man I do not recognize but I think he is my boyfriend. He pushes the tall grass away and it reveals a shocking pink, classic automobile. It's small, out of the 1970s, unique and round, with an old 1970s steering wheel. I say, "It's very cool." I turn two knobs at the driver's seat. He says, "Be careful, it's broken." I don't care and turn the knob. It almost comes off, and I know I must be careful. We get into a race with another car, I lose self-control and press the gas pedal hard, and our car starts to fall apart. But we don't lose the race, even when the roof comes off. I am laughing because the car looks like a wreck.
I am walking down the lonely street of a small town. Suddenly I see a monster. It is very frightening, something like Godzilla. I try to escape it but the monster captures me. I fear for my life.

I am in a bookstore. I see my grandmother reading a book. I move toward her to see what she is reading, as I want to buy it for her as a gift if she doesn't have it. But I can't read the writing on the pages.

I am lost. I cry out, "Someone please help me!" Then I realize that even though I am lonely, I am okay. I find some berries to eat in the forest, and I drink some water from a mountain stream. So I have found a way to take care of myself.

I am in a big city. I wander into a department store. Much to my surprise I see my mother there. I ask her what she is planning to buy, and she tells me that she is purchasing some food for dinner. (Later in the week, I walk into a department store and see my mother, even though I had not expected to do so.)

It is night. I am walking back to my dormitory with some of the other girls after a class. Halfway back, I regret my decision. But there was no futon in the school, so I could not have gone to sleep. And in the dormitory, all the girls keep talking and I can't get any sleep. And one of the girls reminds me there is no extra bed for me at the dorm. Then I remember that I left something at the school, so I have a good reason to go back. But I decide against it because I don't want to walk back alone.

I am reading a story about two babies, a boy and a girl. The babies are cutting off their fingers and their hair. I am scared. I can not deal with this topic. The story is about which baby is hurt more, the baby who is cutting the fingertips or the baby who is making a mistake with her hair. I think the baby cutting his fingertips hurts more.

I am on a train. The sun is setting. A girl near me is talking about music. I suddenly realize that I am in California. I have stayed in San Francisco for three days but didn't go to any nightclubs. I feel badly. This is ridiculous, as I may never get to San Francisco again. It's too late. I am on the train and it's leaving San Francisco.

I am taking a written test in a gymnasium. Most people are seated at their desks, but I am sitting on the floor with some of the others. The first subjects are Japanese and English, both of which I know. The next subject is fractions. I want to use a rule and write the answer neatly. I ask the teacher and she says, "This time it's all right." The questions are elementary but require patience and I get confused. The next three questions are all about a fraction inside another fraction. I don't remember how to solve these so I give up. Afraid of completely blowing my test, I decide to solve a question that takes up the entire space on the reverse side. No luck there either. It's the end of the day and today's exams are over.
I am drinking with my dad in a pub. The barmaid brings us drinks, and she laughs and jokes with us. I do not know her, but she gets along with us very well. We are all having a good time.

I am on a small beach. Grass and trees surround the beach. I see a huge tidal wave coming toward me. I run away. I start to climb up the stairs at the rear of the beach. I recall that there are many Jizo there. Jizo are the guardian deities of children.

I go to my apartment alone. My room is on the second floor. I enter the room and look for my dog, Sam, a grownup Maltese. I can't find him. I go to the bedroom. It's a small room; the bed occupies most of the space. Something moves under the bed. I think it's Sam, and I take the comforter off. It's a small dog, newly born with no hair. It's so cute. If I have this dog as my pet, I may forget about Sam. That's a shallow thought! The little dog runs away from the window. I find another baby dog, a bit larger and slower. I hold it in my hand. But this one isn't cute at all, so I put it outside. Something is still moving in the bed. It's a bird, but looks almost like a baby panda. Two parent birds are next to the baby. There are now hundreds of baby birds in the room, each with two parents! I am scared, and scoop up each bird with my hands and throw them out the window.

I am in Gasshuku, a retreat camp. I am taking an exam in which I am supposed to perform a routine dance in the river. Although I know I am fairly good at this performance, I cannot catch up with the tempo of the other examinees because I often become exhausted and sometimes feel a stabbing pain in my feet. I think I might have lost my nose pierce during the exam, but I feel it and it is still there.

I am in darkness with a faint light around me. I am walking, and I find a supermarket. I buy something from a female clerk. Looking at my hand, it turns out to be a flashlight. I turn the flashlight on. The beam of light draws a straight line in the darkness. I think, "This light is extending endlessly."

I am walking in a town. I can see the ocean far away. Suddenly, I see a huge tidal wave coming toward the town. I am surprised and attempt to escape by going to the top of a 60-story building. But I am the only one panicking; no one else is town seems to be afraid. I find a restaurant with a panoramic view. I see that the tidal wave is coming right at the town. Finally, the gigantic wave swallows the town. I can see many people and cars washed away. It's a disaster; the town is now in the ocean. I feel guilty that I am the only one to survive; the shock is over whelming.

It was an autumn night. I was in the Moon View Festival with some of my friends. Everything happening around me was very familiar. My friends’ behavior was familiar, so were the booths where people were selling toasted rice cakes, candy, ice cream, and so on. I remembered that I had seen this before. An old man I encountered at one of the booths said to me, “You know, my son wants to see you because he has a health problem. You should give him a call soon.” I nod my head yes because it seems that I have known them both. [When I awaken, I recall the man well. It was my father’s close friend from my middle school years who used to sell homemade rice cakes at local festivals. I had not contacted his son for a long time. I immediately called him. I found out that he had been hospitalized for three years due to lung cancer.]

I was in this town, sitting at a restaurant, ordering something to eat or drink. The town and the restaurant seem to be like a stage set, a stable stage set that I have seen before when I am awake. Then I realize that I am dreaming. I don’t do anything special. [Every time I see this setting, I know that I am dreaming.]

I am hearing a song by Joan Baez on the loudspeaker as I am walking to the public bathhouse. It is a protest song, as usual. When I arrive, I find a big crowd there, and do not find an empty locker for my clothes. I am rather tense even though my entire body is soaked in the cozy big bathtub. I feel that all the people’s eyes are on me. So I try to get out as soon as possible. I still hear the songs by Joan Baez outside. I am pleased with them, hoping they will continue forever. However, the people around me are not friendly, treating me as an outsider. Every time I go to the public bathroom, they block me. I am very frustrated.

I was with my girl friend having lunch in a coffee shop. I said that I did not intend to marry her. She was frustrated with my attitude. There was a bad feeling between us. Then I noticed a beautiful painting on the wall of the shop, a beautiful dog jumping in the air with its hair blowing. The picture reminded me of my childhood when I went camping. I remembered the dog, a river, trees, and wooden tables. Because my girl friend and I loved dogs so much, she said, “Let’s buy a dog so that we can get along, and finally get married.” I was confused with what she said. Then all of a sudden I was running away from her. However, the dog left the painting and was chasing me. So was the girl. Finally the dog caught me and asked me to get married or it would make both of us dogs. As soon as I refused, the girl and I both became dogs. We seemed to be a married couple of dogs, protecting each other against other dogs.

I saw a snake in a deep box climbing up to the top. It was having a hard time doing that. I help it by pushing its body up, so that it can get out of the box. It was not comfortable with my help; it acted as if I was in its way. It said to me, “Just leave me alone and let me go wherever I want to go.” I took its word seriously and say to myself, “Do nothing to the animal, or any other living being. Then everything will be alright.” I was full of confidence with that philosophy of “doing nothing.” Then I regretted what I had done in the past, wasting my time with an inefficient use of energy.

A lion is chasing me, and I rush into my house, and slam the door. I feel secure. Then I make myself at home, and I sit down to eat and drink something. But as soon as I feel secure, another emergency occurs because something dangerous is coming in the door. [This has happened to me frequently in my dreams. As soon as the lion or other danger disappears, something else takes over.]

I thought I got lost on my way home because all the scenes I saw on the way were changed and unfamiliar. I didn’t have any idea where I was. But I could recall some of the scenes I had seen in my childhood. This gave me comfort because of their natural beauty—a small river with colorful flowers around it, birds, and an open space where I could see the mountains. I was extremely happy for a while. However, I was in a hurry to go to my home in the big city. When I got home I was so sad to see the superficial decorations in my house. They were plastic, not natural. Then I started painting the whole wall with dirt and cow dung. Suddenly, many different kinds of flowers started coming out from the wall.

I was in a small river swimming alone, expecting to see some fish and to catch them if I am lucky. However, I could not see any fish. All could see around me were humans pretending to be fish. They all wore clothes and so did I. I was attracted to a young lady, especially her rounded fresh hips. I started to chase her but unfortunately she disappeared from my view because there were so many men and women hustling and bustling. Suddenly, she appeared again and rushed toward me with a full smiling face. She was nearly naked, and I wanted to make love with her then.
