126. Cleaning my room and birdcage thoroughly. Then try to go out with my friends in the car. They already left. Decide to stay home and study for math test.

125. Waiting for the bus - going to temple. The bus came and we all bowed down. Some girls were saying the Deity of Radharani reveals Herself the most just before the hour. On the bus I smoked and burnt Anuttama's pants with a cigarette. He was annoyed and wanted me to quit smoking. Sent a card to my father and grandfather, also lost medicine.

124. Some people came to office wanting to be paid, but no $$. I had to call the city and start telling them all the plumbing problems we had just had, and spent all our money. Later - a long computer list written by Joe and Cheryl of people wanting to be initiated. I had stolen a box with a red dot and securely hid it in my altar. Some people kept coming around, but I knew they'd never find it.

123. Annie Lennox at temple - I talked to her as an old friend. Cooked breakfast for everyone (they gave me money). Sita cooked. Everyone had a big kirtan before eating. A gang attacked the hair-nama party. Indians next door were devotees and came to mangal arotik.

122. I was at a party and Kyle S. was there. He was talking with his father about going to the East Coast and buying law books. I was cleaning up, but I wanted to talk to him. Finally I asked him to talk and he agreed. I told him I'd always liked him but felt unfulfilled, having always been afraid of him. He said I shouldn't have been afraid and that he liked me. He said our relationship was simple - rock 'n roll games. I wanted to get to know him, and told him that. He was very fat and boisterous. He called for some beer, but the waitress gave it to a girl who was dancing. He went over to get more beer, I went to get a cigarette. He was an alcoholic.

121. Riding on the bus, very hard to see - thought something wrong with my eyes. Could see K. Kirti - called to her. Later felt scars on my neck where doctors had done some kind of psychological (brain) surgery on me without telling me. They removed part of my brains so I wouldn't be depressed.

120. Nalini Kanta won election - Nirkula wrote story of the campaign, etc. Rebuilt a miniature golf land or some property - it was a moving thing (like a Vedic airplane). Earlier I wanted to fly to Russia. No one believed me. I missed plane, etc., ticket was wrong. Couldn't get anyone to tell me why.
119. dream two - I saw the bird outside that makes a lot of noise and it was a crow. I tried to shoot it.
118. dream one - Srila Ramesvara talked to my brother. He was there for school and planned to move to Mayapur. Srila Ramesvara said hello and goodbye to him.

117. dream two - Lived in a big house with hippies - there was a murder - then we left - wanted to live in an apartment with no roommates - smaller, clean, etc. Got stoned on pot and no one would talk to me.

116. dream one - Saw everyone very busy - engaged in Krishna's service. I walked to the temple and everyone was working hard. Bought garlands to Nirkula, the Deities motioned to put them on. Saw Mary Pat C., started hugging her, and pulled her off to the side to talk. She was a FOLK member and I saw her in a kirtan.

115. Rode a motorized skateboard around the pool, wanted to go swimming. Pool too crowded, saw people I know, wanted to do rounds. Went into Laguna - saw Srila Ramesvara. Talked to him for a while and begged for mercy. He told me things about the Deities and said we were highly confidential. He said I should chant all my rounds and go to the temple and he would talk to me when he got back.
114. Trying to get out of a murder. I had too many PE and business classes - wanted to get rid of them and just do some laps in pool, etc.
113. Found two purses I wanted to buy, but friends said to put on hold. I come to d.a. without getting them. Lost - couldn't call store or get there. Later some weird men in my apartment.

112. Two swimming pools - one clean, the other algae - swimming lessons. Then - visited a hospital with mother. One ward all people had casts on. One man gave away secrets about Soviet government, they threatened to throw him in ocean with cast on.
111. Earlier - we went to a girl's party. She was offended I wouldn't eat anything.

110. Stayed with cousins, aunt for school because it was closer. Uncle Dick called, wanted to visit the University. Later, Uds driving a moving van in Three Arch Bay. Uddhava was driving a big moving van through Three Arch Bay. We got on the wrong plane and all our luggage got lost - it went to China or Singapore (?). While in England Uds said I should see some sights. I went to a tourist cathedral and bought some sweets.

109. Decorating a table with crepe paper and foils. Syamasaki came to help. Made a weird painting on the rocks and lit a fire - it started melting the rocks. We all went swimming in the rain. Took a long time before we could leave. It was dark. I preached to Rohini that it was temporary. I snuck into my mom's bathroom and pretended I was Jim S., answered my dad's phone, and then he came home unexpectedly. I told my brother to quit taking drugs.

108. Fixing Jagannatha. I was at a school. Later I was in my apartment. My mother lived upstairs. I was trying to call Uddhava and a gigantic earthquake came. The water in the ocean became agitated and big waves started hitting, flooding houses along the shore. We thought it was the end and everyone started praying. I was praying with Subhananda's parents and my parents lying down on a bed. Subhananda was making fun. Next I was in the pool at my old house. All through the dream I kept trying to chant gayatri but couldn't finish. Satarupa was a mermaid who lived in the pool. She went to art school (at the school in the beginning of the dream) but dropped out to become a mermaid.

107. My pictures were in an art book published by my art teacher, Mrs. ____(?). I showed them to Uddhava and explained each one. We were in a bedroom. Later I saw my mom and Don and they were happy to see me. I told them about the book and they started to look through it (they already had it). I sat in the car and we drove. They were looking at it, but I couldn't show them which pictures were mine. Then there was a bad accident - we drove past it. A girl was hurt. Then Uds and I were in a big cafeteria trying to get lunch. Later I had two strings of pearls - necklaces. My mother said, "You have done so much for me and made me so happy," and started crying.

106. Catered a dinner and joined it by dancing in the party. Later, I had a bowl of vitamins, which the police confiscated. They wanted to analyze them - I snuck a few. I was spending the night somewhere and my mother gave me the vitamins. Tried to go up and see the new apt., but ended up in an Indian men's store. Bought miniature spoons and forks for Ud's birthday. Looked at Visvakarma's photos.

105. A new edition of a 1939 book was printed - It had all new cover, photos, etc. I stole two copies and paid for the third. The salesman (a friend?) put protein powder, water, and honey in a bowl and began mussing it up and spinning the bowl. He previously fixed something for me.
104. First dream was that I went to a movie with some fringe devotees. I thought it was wrong to go to a movie, because Krishna wasn't there

103. A new house - very opulent including a pool with wave machine. Took my dad there to bargain over money. Watched a balloon dance - dancers were dancing to Hare Krishna. It was some sort of Madras-style dance. I was bargaining with my dad in a restaurant. I was some valuable employee, but he wouldn't give me a big enough space. Uds and I saw one whole room being wasted on Navasi and Sangita's old clothes. I was designing a pamphlet.
102. Counting checks and chanting gayatri at the same time. Meaning - praying for money.

101. I went to work in a welfare office. The main task was to cancel out requests for assistance. We would page through cards, cancelling them off. I answered an offer for something free at a store. Later, at school I got my period early and a girl drove me in my car. I had to go back to get my books, notebooks.

100. Ud trying to fix the IWR to make it suitable for [?]. I was out of town, he went through a lot of unnecessary endeavor. I was in a restaurant - ordered lettuce and toast. . . (?), very expensive. A sit-down dinner. My cousin and I were to go to a movie, but the boys never came to get us. Several times I told people about my moving dilemmas - boxes, etc.
99. Eating inside someone's VW van, telling them I liked it (on the phone). A girl asked me if I want kids. I politely said "no" and then walked to market.

98. Went to a health spa and sat in the pool - went in the hot tub - read. Had my phone book, started looking in it for a friend. Uddhava was in it - said sometimes I got him so fried he could cry. Ghosts attacked me but I said "Krishna" and they went away. Woke up and thought I heard neighbors fighting.

97. Putting out the paper - we lived in an apt. in an industrial area - I wanted to move somewhere quieter. I met someone rich who said he knew a cheaper printer and said he would buy a LaserWriter and move us closer to the temple.
96. Very strong big ocean waves - I and a few others were diving under the waves. Waves were very big - almost violently strong when they break.

95. Made cereal from six bags of grains, etc. Uddhava drove us to school - I made them late by changing my clothes. Forgot my schedule, but then looked it up in a notebook. 9:30 - was first class. Night class on Monday night.
94. landed in Hong Kong - follow Nara Narayana to find a hotel. Patty Barnes dejected - wanted to sleep on the beach instead of going home.

93. At the Mayapur festival - we went to the Ganges. The waves were very strong. I sat on a rock with other women - two waves swept over the rock up to our house. We were drenched, so I went swimming. The water became very still and shallow. I floated down the river. One tilled canal, then called Subhananda and encouraged him to come out there. I got allergies, so Uds took me to an Ayurvedic allergy place - got lots of medicine. Tried to call Atlanta. Went in the water - pushed a boat - the boatman charged me 6 rs just to push it. Collected gopi candan from river bank. Tried to get Uds to go swimming.
92. Dragging Ud around a playing field; making bread for a few people - not enough. A meeting with Druta, Ud, Brihad, etc.
91. Craig B. asked if we fixed the computer yet - I said I found someone to fix it for $138 he said to do it. Ud and I were leaving, but we filled up our plates with prasadam from Gauranga's.

90. My dad did some scientific thing to improve the Laguna Beach restaurant and it caused the radiation of the planet to shift - scientists couldn't fix it and the planet was about to be annihilated. I wanted to take my dad and hide so we could chant HK till the end. I was afraid someone would try to kill him.
89. I was chanting in a back yard with other women devotees. Srila Ramesvara came out and had a darshan with us. We got it on tape.
88. went to BV to be in a festival; decorated a cart with flowers. Took photos. Then they said we had to spend the night. At first I didn't want to, but then surrendered. Then Uddhava didn't want to.

87. Srila Ramesvara was sending different devotees on the road to sell cookies, etc. I also had to go. I worked one day in a gas station. I put my car up, got it ready for an oil change, took it down, etc. A TV was on and there were two drivers - a man and a woman. The man's air supply went off and he floated up. Then they were in the hospital. I didn't want to watch the show. Too gory. I didn't want to go traveling, but had to. Uddhava gave our blue car to Bhajahari to use in emergencies. I get mad. (That's when the skin-diver show came on.)
86. Worked hard on a flyer for Chris L. - Bhatta-hari - directions to his house - then at prasadam there wasn't enough for me - had to eat an apple. Complained.
85. Another dream: Lila and I bought movie tickets.

84. Driving around, we wanted to find a fancy health spa to take over, [to turn] into a place. It turned out to be a state hospital and was very second-class. We saw Srila Ramesvara and he talked to us. We were about to go up some stairs and he pointed to a wall hanging of driftwood, bones, rocks, etc., and said, "What do you think of this?" I said, "It looks like Phoenix, AZ." He laughed and said, "Yeah - throw it away." Then he started taking it apart. We went upstairs and were supposed to clean up. I started throwing away trash - plates, cups, ashtrays, etc., my friend started washing dishes. KK was there and I was getting her to chant. Rich was there - I talked to him for three hours. We had someone work on the car who goofed it up. Had to pick a guy up who ruined his car. He was late. In the restaurant.

83. I was climbing Squaw Peak Mountain and it was very steep. At the bottom a big boulder came down and almost hit me, but I dodged it. I went to a more forest-ish area to continue hiking, but a mountain lion almost got me. I went to a hospital and told them about my near accident. The doctor wanted me to be careful - to quit hiking.

82. In Srila Ramesvara's room - a girl came in and started showing me where things were I could use. We get someone kicked out for being crazy. Maharaja walked down the street and kept getting stopped by people who wanted things.
81. Girls with their finances. KK asking me how it's going down here. Criticism that I've fringed out - I defend my position.

80. Had to move again. While moving I got mad at Uddhava over the price. Then I stormed out. Decided to eat at a cafeteria but there was meat in it. Then I took a nap and my wallet got stolen. I concentrated on where it was and a man handed it to me. Then I got him arrested. Shook hands with the cop. Then we were on our steps and the ocean came up. I was telling the kids to be careful of swimming because it was really deep with a current. One girl said, "In Puerto Rico the temple is so big you can see it no matter where you are."

79. I lived in a degraded place/time when everything you owned would be stolen or wrecked. I had to move into a shack. A. Swami and Subhananda were there - wanted to play Scrabble. Some hobo women came who were spies from the government. One played on the bank of a river with one boy and then ran away. I had a guide taking me around. Went to the market and bought a clod of dirt - shared it with another bum. My scale got smashed and my guide made me throw it away instead of fix it.

78. I made a statue and two drawings for my art teacher. I also had a project - go to a movie/parking lot as a devotee and meet people. My statue was of Lord Caitanya. It had a cord like the universal snake, which wrapped around His body and was attached at the crown. The drawings were of Lord Caitanya - pastel.

77. I had a baby and it was exactly like Saci's. Saci had to go somewhere and I had to take care of mine. I didn't want to. Later walked to apt. Door was open. I went in - then some black guys came in to rip off, but were kind of honest. They went away. Uddhava was with next-door neighbor. He had a TV and lots of favorable broadcasts were coming in. Laksmi called and wanted to know what to do about favorable coverage. I said - "prepare for bad coverage, too. But there is a trend toward better p.r." Sitting at Srila Ramesvara's feet. Other devotees were there. Baby small and delicate - put it in a bag, went to a movie. No sound track. Tried to get my money back - the man argued with me. Vaikuntha said she didn't know I was pregnant - I said I didn't want it, it was an accident. I said, we never had sex - be careful don't even touch. Inside the theater, kids were jumping around causing trouble - I couldn't follow the plot of the show because the sound track kept going off. I got angry at the manager when he couldn't give my money back.

76. The next-door neighbors were making noise, so we went over there. They had joints and we smoked some. I craved cigarettes. I went into a store and Sama-priya was a salesman there. I was smoking and my cigarette fell apart. Then I saw another devotee at my neighbor’s. I had a similar name to the neighbor's wife Nan/Ana or something. We talked to him about his noise and bad habits. He stayed up from 9-3 a.m. - we sleep then.
75. Srila Ramesvara saying the Jaya Om prayers, guaranteeing (for the residents of New Dvaraka) that we would be involved in the temple projects.

74. A pregnant girl didn't know what to do with her new baby. Too much taking a kitten to a movie - my cousin hated it at the movie. They say Krishna is God. A girl (Govinda) had a plate of food she was sharing with us. Pasta.

73. March [undated], 1986 - Some devotees were hitting people up for plane tickets, then saying how about two? I played my guitar. Chords: C, E, B, etc. It was very fancy and had a nice sound. It was just tuned.

72. Driving a big white car. We notice the "tires" were bad, the "treads" were popped out, and they could "blow up" any mile. I thought it would be so expensive to fix them, I'd have to get a job (more work). Then I thought of selling my own car and use the money to pay for it. Then Uds said, "You haven't even 'registered' it - how can you sell it now? First register it." Then I drove home in the car with "bad tires," and started cooking. Meaning: I'm over tired and things don't register. I need to get things in perspective (register) before I can do anything else.
71. Ydd was my roommate. Ud lived next door. I had a small bed and Ydd wanted the large bed.

70. I sold my stereo to a girl and she didn't give me very much for it - only about $35 (I wanted at least $50). Also - trying to cross the street with Dan and Hadassah. Jolie lost her private P.O. Box and had to receive mail from a community mailbox.

69. I was in a pot party and there was a rumor that Jagat Ambika ran away with a guy she met at the airport. Then a room full of people were smoking pot and I went out. Two crazy men tried to find the pot party, but I delayed them. The authorities came and captured them and put them on a train. The train went under a tunnel then went off the track. The conductor roped it and pulled it back on. I was showing him my pictures of Krishna. He wanted to know what Krishna looked like. I didn't have an exact picture of Him, but came very close. It was the beginning of KC - when trains were just starting too.
68. Someone tried to rob my Macintosh. I convinced them not to do it because I didn't have the new program. Later they came to get the new one.

67. I had a dream that I was cleaning up New Dvaraka. We went over every dept. and threw away all the garbage and cleaned it with a cloth. We pulled up weeds where people were criticizing, threw away broken glass, etc. We had brown paper bags and were throwing away the stuff in bags and hauling it away. Some rare saintly people were there and we recognized who they were. Then we brought my dad there and he subleased the offices so we could move out. I feel happy now - that dream shows that everything will work out okay.

66. At a gathering I loaned a guy my Daytimer - later he gave it back (everything was in it). I loaned a guy a bread bag and string of Ud's beads. Ud got mad. I tried to get it back but he was mean about it. Palya was my roommate and was driving me crazy. I kept trying to call Vrindavana to change the situation, but couldn't reach her. Palya would talk weird and keep me up at night. In the middle of the night I was having a dream that our PR moving ad read wrong.
65. Moving - doing it fast.

64. John, Jim, Don, John came over. I convinced them to go on Hari-nama. Jim asked Radha what some dreams meant, then she said his parents died. When I woke up, I prayed to Krishna to help us get our equipment if He wanted that. UD said a dream predicted his little bro wouldn't be a devotee, but would have his other bro as caretaker until he was thirty.
63. Peaceful - something about my dad and working on the paper. Also talking to SRS about being pregnant.

62. Went to a movie with Druta and a girl. It showed simultaneously in several theaters, and I kept going one to the other. Finally I just wanted to concentrate on it. But I had to meet with MG, put my luggage in the car, etc., so then I wanted to meet the actors, actresses. I was with one of the actresses and an earthquake happened - we hugged each other and prayed to Krishna to save us. My cousin was there and I gave her some carob and coconut (?) sweets.
61. Driving in my car - very difficult - was attacked by different things: bees, flies, rain, sleep. A small car - MG pulled hood over car, then couldn't see. Had to make a long trip.
60. Baking cookies using a blender - they keep coming out wrong. I ate a lot of it. Had to hide the box. It was at an old house - outside.

59. Working the Page Maker. We were doing a newsletter for Srila Ramesvara, he was saying what should go where. Earlier - needing new underwear. Kdd came over and we were going to do some errands for Srila Ramesvara. At some point we went to a bank and had to go to different windows. I had a ripped-up bra or skirt.
58. Worked on layout for the paper. Someone had an article with a baby - I moved it from p. 2 to the classified.

57. We went to the Dr's. Ud was too light, I was too heavy, so the drs. said I should meditate on being too heavy and him being too cool. Then I bought green paint (to help him out) and carried it home, but the color was wrong. I gave him all my food. We were in the HF store kissing but the people come and we had to stop. We tried to typeset, but some of the stories were red and were meant for p. 1. We had no control over it. Yasoda and Manasaganga wanted to eat fattening food.
56. Moving my car (vague) went to a house - big.

55. I was in a shop to buy a shirt and was smoking cigarettes. The shop owner showed me two birds for sale. They were in an open pen with perches and were playing with each other (parrots, love birds, or cockatiels). He had a really good deal on them. Later Raj had a big cage for wild birds. I talk to him about the birds and he went to check it out. We waited in the cage wishing he would get them. Finally he came back with the perch, then with the birds. He put them in the cage and everyone loved them. They were very gentle and friendly. They played with each other. Also in the dream - a beach. I was supposed to ask some rich people for a donation to build something for KK. I got all dressed up and got the names and numbers to check out. Then a guy from the temple drove me to the place. That was when I saw the birds. They were telling me not to smoke.
54. Another dream that BTG (or some magazine) put our "moving" ad in. Long dream can't remember.

53. Found cake/sweets Subhananda made in India - ate some, gave one to Srila Ramesvara. He was happy. Also had a house people stayed in. Had a late kirtan - Uddhava stopped it, then he had trouble with money. Subhananda was supposed to be at a conference, but the roads, etc., were messed up and he wasn't there - his books were. A knock at the door, I answer it - it was John Jim John Don, etc. I invite them in and tell UD to talk to them while I get dressed. He got mad at them because they weren't KC. He almost fried them.

52. Getting dressed up for someone's parents' party being the last one ready. Borrow earplugs from KK - she wanted them back. Said I'd bring new or something to replace. Put it on my list of things to do. Ud was laughing because the list was so long.

51. Getting dressed up for someone's parents' party being the last one ready. Borrow earplugs from KK - she wanted them back. Said I'd bring new or something to replace. Put it on my list of things to do. Ud was laughing because the list was so long.

50. Morning - Uddhava and I were on deadline - I also had to sew Deity clothes - found a sewing machine to use. Went to the temple, saw friends. Jolie was there. I embraced her. She had a phony arm. Went back to deadline - got a frozen pizza from the feast for Uddhava. He said Dan died and went back to Godhead. A weird guy (___) was working at our place. He left glue on our wooden table. I got mad and chastised him - he got mad. Had a problem with my navaratna - one jewel fell out, others were broken. I went to jewelry store to get it fixed. Said I knew MG, Bhu., etc., they said they'd fix it right away. A girl was driving me around.

49. At a school - wanted to go to swimming class but couldn't figure out when my next class was - forgot my schedule. Went to dorm to drop things off. Girls were there setting up bureau drawers. Tried to go to the pool.

48. Walking down a path in the forest we were attacked by a rat, which was guarding a dead carcass. As we watched, it followed us and wanted to bite our feet. We were scare it away. In the dream I had a two-day heart-to-heart talk with my dad so he could understand what I was doing. We stopped so MG could buy something. While he was in the store someone was yelling about Krishna. We were afraid he would hurt us or hurt MG (Ud) so we waited. We got away. The people in MG's car took off. When MG came out we said, "The people in your car left." They drove, but he followed. Finally my sister pulled over so we could give a full explanation.
47. We changed format and there were lots of things to change. We had to deal with Ratna-cintamani directly about her ad, but she ended up liking it.

46. A lady I knew was in a store, she gave me some shoes I was trying to return. I found a wallet with lots of money and gave it to her. She was really thankful. Then I told her it was a big trip if you lose your wallet, etc., then she left the store.

45. I was in school and after school went with some people to the Seidenbaum's old house. It was owned by new people and was very opulent and clean. While my friends were talking I walked off to look around. I saw Andha-Rupa and Jaya Lakshmi and said, "I used to live here when I was a karmi." They asked if I liked it better now and I said yes. (When I went to school I forgot my wallet and pen in my new purse.) Andha-rupa said she thought it must be hard in my service to accept the new trends, and I said I liked it.

44. An earthquake, then I walked out of body, went to temple. Later looked at my body sleeping and jumped back in. Went undercover to a business - saw another man - said I was working for SKP movement. He said he was too, but he saw lots of discrepancies. He even started criticizing Mukunda Maharaja. I defended him. Said, "After you spend some time with him, you see he's very pure." Then MG came in and said that a translation would be done when the company had the start we wanted and he had to find the "Order of Rights" (right order) building. I had to look it up on a complicated map. It was #68, but I couldn't find it. Finally I found it. When I was there with that man I had a computer with "IP" or "WYSIWYG" and was showing him different layouts on the screen.

43. An earthquake, then I walked out of body, went to temple. Later looked at my body sleeping and jumped back in. Went undercover to a business - saw another man - said I was working for SKP movement. He said he was too, but he saw lots of discrepancies. He even started criticizing Mukunda Maharaja. I defended him. Said, "After you spend some time with him, you see he's very pure." 42. Writing font page stories: added the one about Australia restaurant. They didn't have datelines; also Pope on Fiji. A dramatic play with a theme of early betrayal of a brother's rights. Goes unmentioned until the very end when the tragic hero meets his destiny. He says - "alas my brother you have denied my basic birthright.” Ydd watched this scene. We brushed our teeth together, then I used my tongue scraper.

41. Vrindavana put us on a "new" diet - high protein with veg juice to wash it through. She had a huge pyramid of things she would pour the juice over. She kept checking me to see if I would get embarrassed, but I didn't. We all went to my car to drive away but some fraternity men spotted us and started taunting us. We got in the car and complained that the school was all jocks. A married couple was in the front seat and I got in the back and started car - then I had to get in the front to drive, but wanted one of them to move.

40. In mangal aortik a guy wouldn't sing along with everyone else, so some guys from downstairs came up to throw him out. He started a fight and it ended up out in the street. Finally they had to take him really far away and put him on a farm in heaven. Then he called me - said it would be a while till he got home. Had to travel by scooter, pick up luggage - go on a barge towed down a river, then get on a cart and ride down a hill 11,000 miles. Then got home and wanted to shower, eat, rest, but my house was all different. Everything was moved out and the temple built shelves, etc., where my things were. Radhapati let me into his place where my things had been stored. A notice came from my insurance co. that my insurance was cancelled. Also I looked in the mirror during my trip and my face was different. My nose was flat and covered with blackheads. At one point I was with some devotee women. Divya and one other were making garlands. Vrindavana was there. In the first dream we were designing stories and Brihad was executing the design.

39. I was with Ud. - we tried to sleep in the same bed but I couldn't sleep. I kept waking him up saying, "You know it's only one more week till we move - I can't sleep with you." "I'm going to the restaurant." Then I went there and ate. Ud. had to check out at the key place. Caitanya Chandra was the only person at Govinda's and walked out. *really there's more than two. I was out of checks but used my extra one, even though I had no money. Uddhava never came so I left without paying. It was raining very heavily as I walked down Watseka. A blues singer was performing in the temple - singing very loudly. I wanted to go in since he was my favorite singer. Then I went home. The whole dream was about Brihad and the photo department.

38. On an airplane Ud. and I found two seats together. When the guy came for my ticket, he had to get my suitcase, then all I could find was a boarding sticker. Maharaja vouched for me. Also in dream: Went with some people on an adventure - took a tour of an old barn - wanted to see up on roof, but couldn't get up there. (Driving with Jolie through canyons ?) A car picked up Uds' brother and we were convincing him to give up his crummy job and instead become a devotee in Philadelphia. B.T. Swami and another guru were traveling with us - they were preaching to my cousin.
37. Nice dreams - calm - laying out a newspaper. Maharaja had a 2-col. boxed article on p. 1.
36. Typesetting and paste-up. Somehow very sweet - woke up feeling satisfied and was praying.
35. Lots of dreams - can't remember them. Last part was going into a plant nursery and trying to root some flowers I had in a pot. It was very windy. I looked through a bag full of cloth.

34. Another dream about handling Deities. Also in one part I made everything on the Varityper screen disappear.Another dream about handling Deities. Also in one part I made everything on the Varityper screen disappear.

33. A scientist researched this tomb (?) and found the Deities of Lord Caitanya, Nityananda, two of the Six Goswamis, and two of the other acharyas. The Deities were inside little boxes like eggcups. There was a larger Lord J. Deity, which I'd entrusted to some people. They ruined Him by some misunderstanding and I had to nurse Him back to health. We were all reading in a room and everyone was reading and chanting out loud. One devotee was being very loud. I shushed him and he became very offended. Then I felt guilty but a few people appreciated the silence and told me it was okay.

32. Trying to move some big machines. Indra and Jagaddhatri had some white ones. Ran. Looked really happy we were leaving. A big smile. Uddhava and I were working late and he came in. Said he had another hour to work, but we knew he wouldn't be there that long.

31. Trying to move some big machines. Indra and Jagaddhatri had some white ones. Ran. Looked really happy we were leaving. A big smile. Uddhava and I were working late and he came in. Said he had another hour to work, but we knew he wouldn't be there that long.
30. Another "school" dream.
29. At a school. I went to a health clinic and ate some special grains (with little bushes) and macaroni to clean out my intestines.

28. Talking casually, joking with people. Went to the car. I was eating dhal and bread, then was going to go. Some men came to the car and asked for a Higher Taste book. I thought they may be thieves or muggers so I got in the car and (hard to lock) tried to escape (hard to start car). Wake up. [probably recorded February 2, my thirtieth birthday] (February 2, 1986 - Last night I dreamed about a man with a Higher Taste book was going to hurt me. I looked it up and it seems like it means someone may be trying to rob me of my Higher Taste. Who could it be?)
27. A little girl (representing Krishna) would wait by some incense and when it would fall, give it to me. It was like a game we played.

26. Going on a trip in India - went back to airport to pick up my suitcase. Later swimming in a pool in Green Building. Courtyard too noisy - had to leave so Srila Ramesvara could take rest - then went to use pool next door. Bharata made some prasadam with cantaloupe and salad.

25. Eating ice cream before going to work. Chocolate rocky road. Also had marble and mint. Freezer crowded. Someone ate up almost all of it. Later - Yogini telling me she doesn't chant and probably never would.
24. Lived in a house way up on a hill that was hard to get to. Had to climb through people's back yards. Cut my finger. Uds was with me.
23. I saw Lila and embraced her - later lost my shoes in a pond. Was staying at some temples - doing my laundry.

22. Palya wanted to do things for me - wanted me to do things for her. SRS wanted certain things and she wanted to help and wanted advice, but it seemed more of a hassle to me to engage her than the help I needed.

21. John H., some other old friends were there. We were seeing how we'd changed/not changed. I went into an antique clothes store - tried to buy a shirt. It was an electrical storm - very violent. Having trouble getting home a lady pulled me over, gave me a ride. Said she knew where I lived - we went to a record store to buy music tapes.

20. Art showing of Bill Weber. He had all his statues in a row and was bringing people in to see them. I was in there. I was listening to a tape I did with Kalakanta - couldn't find a certain part. In part of it I spaced out talking to a cat (vanity) Ud. wanted me to hurry so we could go to a movie. We lived at the coast near campus. I walked on campus with no skirt. Phone co. wouldn't let me make a phone call. I got angry at the lady and made her mad. Then I went back for my purse/bead bag and cheered her up: "Hope you don't meet anymore like me today." Then I walked home - through a ravine - with Bhagavat, Divya, etc. Divya was pregnant and wearing a backless bathing suit. I brought some old ladies into my kitchen and started talking about God to them. I was telling them about love of God, God as a loving being. They hadn't thought of Him that way. Later I had some popcorn and cheese to take with me to the movie. I wanted to smoke some cigarettes. Buying different kinds of toothpaste.

19. I was at a country club with lots of pools. I was running around swimming in all of them. Then I was telling the guard (owner?) I thought it was very nice. Then there was some threat that one of the police was stealing. Then it was really unsafe. I couldn't even hang up my laundry. Then I parked in a window and saw Subhananda (or my dad) lying in bed. I thought my mother (or Uddhava) was there, but it was a professor. He called out for his wife, but she didn't want dinner. I went out in front and there were two fire engines and a police car. I asked what happened. He said he was driving by and a manhole cover blew off. Then a water main blew open. Then a police friend - Officer Boogie - drove up and the two of them took care of it. We were asking God "Why God? Why did this happen?" Just wanted to understand it. I was driving up the hill with my dad and we saw my brother putting gas in his car. There were lots of gas stations along the road up in the hills.

18. Some girlfriends and I were swimming in two pools. It was very nice. We also had lots of sweets - cookies especially - which we were eating. Some boys came and we had to go to the other pool. They were up there too, so we all had to use the same pools. Later Uddhava and I were driving. We were going to pass through the border and wanted to get temporary residency, so we didn't have to pay a visitors fee. We were in a market, showing the guy our bankbook, etc., to prove we weren't just passing through.

17. We were selling a store's veggies like SKP, but they ran out everyone went home. Ud and I came back. He came and got me and we walked along together and told stories about Jayananda. We went into a class and the teacher praised us for being determined and setting a good example. He didn't look like himself. I was proud to be with him. Next everyone was dissatisfied with their ad. One didn't want it and wouldn't pay, or wanted b/w, or wanted color; one wanted a class instead.

16. Painting a Lady Subhadra Deity yellow with a carnation and telling Prema Dutta about my past life. I said I weighed about 20 lb. more and took drugs, went out to bars, etc. He said he still had material desires and he and Radhanath went to a bar about two years ago. We were under the green building. They had a supply of IWRs, but Ud was upset because he thought they were running out. It was hard to drop them off. Mahanta was there.
15. I was discussing the science conference with my dad.
14. Dreamed a lot about veggie organizations and how they're fighting against meat-eating. Also had sex with a guy and was afraid I caught AIDS.
13. I moved everything into my dad's house. A girl was with me. I had tons of stuff I didn't unpack, but I planned to do it after my rounds.

12. - I was cleaning. Someone was reading from a story about a girl who sold paintings to earn money and become a prostitute. Also dreamed I was pregnant (by accident). I was telling the old man some things very truthfully about our community. Vyasaki was reading the story, then began playing the piano and the man was singing. When I came down they stopped so I could speak to him.

11. - I was doing SKP [fundraising], went to a beach, the Army took one of our big trucks for an emergency. Just then big waves came into the beach. I got pushed into a little house. Waves were going all across the sand. Then I was with Jolie and she played the guitar and sang. She had both arms. She said the injury had hurt her, but she didn't lose her arm.

10. Lalananami and I wanted to go somewhere, so we went to this party. A band was playing - like hitchhiked (?). Later Uddhava was carrying some special videos that could blow up. We had to take them to a special tent or building and deliver them, across from a filling station.
9. Riding a bicycle and buying a lock for it. Riding all around a college town. At 3 p.m. streets become crowded by cars.

8. dream two - Later I dreamed I was going to school and wanted to pick up some units by taking final exams in classes I wasn't enrolled in all year. I got in line for the final exam and began examining the textbooks. Someone in line asked if I was an artist. I showed her some old paintings. They were okay but unfinished and partially taken off the stretcher bars.
7. dream one - Printing a book for this mad scientist - an obligation because he worked for us. His theory was that the aquatic animals were going to take over the land.

6. “a dream from last night” - [after learning we would move to Laguna while still in Texas] - Kerry became very favorable and receptive to Krishna consciousness. Also later - something about a man making books.
5. Lots of tomcats were in my place trying to mate with each other. I shooed them out of my house with a handkerchief.

4. A big party in our house. I go from one room to another, talking to people, showing people things, kissing Uddhava, getting things, eating things, etc. Also Radhaseva was there and we collected the mail from a long tube or chute. She moved her office into one of the lower bedrooms and I wanted to move mine there too because of all the big windows. There was a restaurant with an outdoor dining area. I was turning up these flames that were like decorative fire pits to give heat. But it was already warm, so I turned them off. My cousin was also there.
3. On a campus, some newsmen thought everyone was crazy. They drove me to my car. Lost my ring. Later bought paper towels - to go back in market I let them unroll.
2. Looking up symbols in a dream graphics book. H – horse, hay, etc. Burned one page of it. We were in the mountains. Some of the old Seidenbaum people were with us, Uddhava and I.

1. I was with another devotee and guess that her spiritual master was Srila Prabhupada. I guessed one devotee's spiritual master: S.P. Uddhava took niacin (or some drug) and then ate a feast. Waited for the drug to have an effect. We were traveling.

I dream that I am touching a wall, and the paint seems soft, so I poke a hole through it, and cold air comes in through it.  very refreshing. I realize the there is a wrought iron gate right behind this very thin layer of paint. It has been painted over somehow very evenly so i keep poking holes through it. I understand that this gate is the famous summer garden gate in St. Petersburg Russia, and the cold air is very cold eastern air and I feel l like I can breathe easier. Symbolic yet again.

In my dream I am visiting St. Petersburg, my niece in particular. I realize that she lives in a sort of abandoned apartment. Like no one really cares about it. like it belongs to someone else, not her and they don’t clean it anymore and are halfway moved out. I can tell no one loves this place, although it is livable. And i realize I have to stay there for a day. I can’t go outside for me reason, so I sit by the window and i can see people walking around, the view is somehow panoramic. And I can see their faces. All of the people, the grandmothers, the men, I can see their expressions so clearly and I begin crying. Crying for my home. Like I am so homesick in this dream. It was so filled with longing and nostalgia. It was a beautiful dream. It looked like a moving painting.
Then i dreamt quite often of my grandmother. I don’t see her but i find a new of pair of pants that she has seen for me. I examine the stitchwork in my dream.

I dreamt that i was a very mighty woman. Wearing a long heavy skirt of some kind. Like gypsy from the wild west. It must have been an impression after the recent terror attacks because i had a feeling i was on a mission. I walk into a police station. And i have grenades hanging from a belt. The cops are sitting on a couch and everything is very dense feeling in the dream. I can feel the heaviness of the grenades and the guns the cops have. Everything is very tangible in the dream. Unlike most dreams i have. I look at the cop and who is looking up at me and say...do you want to touch my grenades..he reaches for the grenade and then i sit on his lap and say...how about my balls...? And then i realize i have balls and I am so disgusted that I wake up.

I had a nightmare yesterday. That my grandmother was in the next room. I knew she was dying. And i came into the dark room to see if she was still warm. She was sitting in the next room, and them she was lying, then sitting again. It was dark and i kept touching her to see if she was warm or cold. She was unresponsive. Just sitting there making odd sounds.

Seems the older woman was showing me the apartment as a potential option. A sublet but changed her mind at some point. She wanted to show me something there. I had this concept, since i have been doing quite a bit of spiritual work that it is that quantum field she was showing me. That other reality, where there is light despite darkness. It felt like a very safe place but one that I cannot yet attain.

I am with a dear friend of mine. An older woman. she shows me that there is an apartment on a rooftop close to my house that I had no idea existed. You have to go down a chute to get into it. I am absolutely curious about who lives there. the apartment is something like a submarine. I spent most of the dream examining it, trying to understand why there is so much light yet it is underground somehow. I want to live there but she tells me I cannot. There is a dog with us.

I am in the ocean with a lot of people, it is vast and very foggy. We are throwing beer bottles into the sky and they are sticking, they just hang in the sky like seagulls. But I am very concerned that they will fall back down and hit someone in the head.

I dream that I am in a cafe with two friends. One keeps trying to switch shoes with me, it is raining very hard outside. I exchange shoes with her and go to the bathroom. a bullet flies past me and hits the wall.  I realize there is a shooting upstairs, Martin luther King Junior is giving a speech up there and gunfire breaks out. I can see the bullets hitting the wooden walls of this cafe. I wake up.

I dreamt that I was in a gallery up to my chest in water. using all my strength to get around to look at the paintings. The water was kind of dirty and had a strange smell. I was looking at paintings, I realized the water was amniotic fluid. As I am walking through the water I see my old friend. I walk over to her. I am very happy to see her. I Am speaking to her and there is a cow next to me, the cow’s tongue is on the floor, I without hesitation pick it up and shove it in the cow’s mouth and it begins to talk. I wake up.

I had another dream. Made a big impression on me. I 'm walking up to a man.  He is fat and hairy in a wife beater tank top. Sweaty and some type of southern Russian ethnicity. He resembles a character I had drawn recently. He is pushing a baby carriage back and forth. I walk up to see the baby. Inside is the baby sitting up to its waste in wet clay. It playing with the clay. Squishing it around. I turn to the man and as i make eye contact he lifts a gun and i can see he aiming tight at my head. I know be is going to pull the trigger. i don’t hear a shot, just wake up...

I dreamt something similar a few months back. That I am going to visit my grandmother in an aircraft type of train to another city, and things look and feel alien. And I finally get there. and her place is very modern. And it feels very far away. almost as if it’s on another planet. I can’t describe the actual sensation. only that is of another world totally unfamiliar to me.

Then I dreamt that we [my grandmother and I] were in what looked like her apartment and she is telling me she wants to stay there, that they told her she has to leave the care facility. And she is going to stay at home. And I tell her you can’t. You can’t live on your own…and threw out all your things. But I look around and I see that there is two of everything. Two sinks for example. As if someone has begun redecorating her apartment. I have dreamt this dream before.
the first dream I must have been small and she [my grandmother] gave me some Thomas the Train set to play with and we were playing together.
I had a dream where i was force feeding flies to a venus flytrap.
A dream where I was caught like a fish. I could feel the line as if I swallowed it like a catfish. it was unpleasant.

another dream last night, I woman is showing me her boyfriend’s face and keeps telling me, Look how many masks he has, do you know how disfigured he is in real life?? I actually know this man’s face at well, and can’t believe my eyes that she keeps pulling layer after layer off of his face. it keeps getting uglier and uglier, until he barely has any features. I tell her I can’t believe he can keep all that on his face and have it look so perfect, especially in this heat.

I dreamt that I was away with friends at a summer resort. We were rock climbing and a man I know and admire, a gallerist who I suspect does not like my work, tells me he does not understand why I have to be so bold, so vulgar, and I wear colors that are too bright, his wife, a good friend of mine is looking at us, she is the one who invited me. I go back to our guest house where I am sleeping on the top bunk of a bunk bed. there are two bouquets of roses on my bed. one has 7 flowers and one has 3 of the same, I have a creepy feeling that someone was just in the room and my friend who invited me is telling me a man has been coming and leaving flowers for me every day at three o’clock, and he has been doing so in a way to make sure I do not see him.  I feel flattered yet somehow sickened by this.

Yesterday i dreamt of another man. One i have never even thought about outside of when i would normally see him. He works at the Russia Bath House. I have known him for years. In my dream we were romantically involved. This guy does not speak much in general so i remember thinking it is nice to be around a person who is silent. He is Asian. A mix of russian and korean and in my dream we were in russia and he was a bus driver. I would drive around with him in the bus with other people and then we went dancing. He was always speaking in a low voice about vague things. The dream was so vivid.

I had a dream that we [I and a Russian guy I am dating] were on a cruise ship. Something along the lines of the Titanic, and there was a lot of aristocrats on board. For some reason he had access to them and I did not. We were in a back room of some kind, he would go into the ballroom or dining hall of some kind and then come back and report to me, tell me what they were doing and who they were. sometimes bring someone back to introduce me too. I was envious and in awe of his ability to mingle with all of these people.

I dream that people who subscribe to the New Yorker magazine can come pick up four free tickets to listen to Leonard Cohen do a reading. I show up to get the tickets with my husband and another nice couple I know from Germany. It turned out that there were only two tickets available but the couple conveniently disappeared so it was fine. My husband and I go past a security guard, we take our seats in what appears to be a church. I realize that our seats have nothing to do with anything. We can’t see or hear anything, we are sitting in a wing of the church around the corner from the altar where he is performing. I tell my husband that we should see if the free are seats available near the stage. He says he is fine with the seats we have. I go forward myself and see that there are barely any people there. Two woman that look like they have tickets and another woman that looks uncomfortable but is also sitting in the front row. Leonard Cohen is preparing to give the talk. I am sitting in the corner near a pillar on the long church bench when I see a woman coming towards me. She is wearing a fur and is walking quickly words me, in Russian she says, "well this is a bit much, not only do you have a free ticket but you want to sit in the from row, maybe you are an interesting person, and maybe we should even hang out sometime but now you have to go back to your seat” I decide to not take my seat but hide behind a pillar from where I can hear and see Leonard Cohen. I look at the floor and see a chicken eating crumbs from the floor.

I dream that I wrote a script about a Jewish man trying to escape the holocaust by hiding in a book. But he knew that people reading the book would notice that there was an extra character, so he had to hide between the lines. I sent the script to Steven Spielberg and he seemed to be interested in in discussing it. He called me to discuss the idea but couldn’t hear what he was saying because everyone was screaming happy new year and setting of fireworks. I was at an office party, I was wearing panty hose and there was carpeting. My husband was having sex on the floor with a black woman but I just kept screaming shut up, Steven Spielberg is on the phone. Steven tells me it’s better that we talk at another time and I am horribly disappointed.

I dreamt that I am trying to sleep, my son is pulling my toes trying to wake me up (this is really happening) but I continue dreaming. In my dream I hear a fire cracking in the next room, I think it must be a relaxing place to go rest so I get out of my own bed, take a wad of blankets with me and walk to the next room. The room is mostly made of wood and very dusty, there is a fire burning in the middle of the floor, like a camp fire but it is not clear why. I see that there is a man sleeping in cot next to the fire, he looks like a left over from a part from the night before, there is an empty cot on the other side of the fire, right near it. I lie down next to it, I wonder if the fire will spread to my bed when I fall asleep. I look down at the corner of my blanket and it is burning, or melting. it looks like synthetic. The man leans out of his bed, he looks massive, I want to say he looks like a dutch man with stubble on his face, a kind person with messy hair. He holds a  large mirror over the fire and covers the flame with it to put it out.

I dream I am walking up a slight hill. very slight but I am exhausted, I am dragging one leg in front of the other, this slight hill is killing me, I look at my feet and they are old and I have thick beige pantyhose, my legs are swollen and I realize that this is what it must feel like to be 90 years old.

A slightly confusing dream where I am desperately trying to get somewhere but I am with the same friend who’s bag I was sitting next to, she cannot get her things in order and I realize we will not make the train to wherever it is we have to go, While this is all happening she introduces me to her brother, a Muslim looking teenager.  He seems to be an idiot Savant. He begins whispering strange things in my ear and tells me he wants to teach me how to kiss. We kiss, we are now sitting on a coach and his uncle is sitting next to us on chair watching. The teenager starts unbuckling his pants and I say no, we can’t have sex. He disappears and I spend the rest of the dream looking for him.

A person I have not seen in over 10 years is taking me on a tour of some sort of resort. There are large sunflowers and it looks nice. She takes me into a bar that is very very well polished, the bar is scrubbed down in the German style with fine sandpaper. I am admiring the facility. She takes me to the back room and there are unpleasant looking cots lined up in order, which she tells me are for having sex. They look like gurneys. I am a bit repulsed.

I am with another ex boyfriend that I told you I often dream of…in my dreams we are always doing something fun, like ice skating or looking at an exhibit. the exact things we do not do with my husband. This time this ex and I are trying to have sex in a bathroom when the door opens and a waiter in a suit brings in a tray with food. it’s the disgusting gills of a fried fish, they are black and charred but somehow the texture of a portobello mushroom. I still remember the taste.

I am with an ex boyfriend, his legs have been amputated, I wonder how I did not notice this before. He then shows me a Youtube video of himself in an Isis uniform beheading a child and tells me he has had a rough couple of years.

I dreamt I was in a building with many nationalities. A baby crawled out of one of the apartments. I went into the apartment and there was a very basic Russian couple living there but they had one of my sculptures. I saw that it needed some maintenance, I asked if I could fix it up by shellacking it. They said yes. I shellacked the sculpture and continued to shellac a whole bunch of cardboard boxes that were in the house. At some point I heard music coming from another room, the music made me nostalgic and I realized that in my dream I was actually revisiting other dreams I had had.
I dream I was watching a black girl designing some kind of an object with a device that was made of blue plastic.

I dream that there is a dog following me, it’s a pit bull, I hate them. It’s trying to lick my leg and being friendly. I notice there is a Puerto Rican man walking behind me with the dog attached to a leash. I am trying to keep my distance but the dog is really being clingy. I begin a conversation with the guy. He is friendly, dressed like a typical guy from my neighborhood. I am impressed with this demeanor, he seems very confident and tranquil. I am now holding the dog in my arms and we are walking, then realize the dog is just a puppy and smells good. I love the dog and the man. He shows me a photograph of him carrying the dog when he first got it in a baby carrier strapped to his chest. The baby carrier has a Puerto Rican flag embroidered on it. He is standing proudly and posing for the photograph.

I am sitting in a dark stone stairwell next to the purse of my friend. She never appears in the dream. I hear the phone ringing in her bag, I pick it up. Someone is calling with a very Banal Russian name like Oxana Smirnov. I put it down. Her boyfriend comes over and says. “I need to get out of this tourist trap. I am going to go smoke a cigarette” and leaves.

I am working in a swimming pool with two other people, my husband and my friend masha who actually did work in a pool for many years as I life guard. I am sitting by the side of this pool. The lighting is neon and it smells like bleach. I am making sand castles in a kind of almost autistic state. There are old Russian ladies sitting behind me with kerchiefs on the heads and they are gossiping, they are talking really loudly so I can hear them on purpose, they are saying that they saw my husband flirting with a woman by the pool. In my dream I am completely indifferent to this news, I keep building the sand castles and not looking up. To spite them I tell my friend masha to intentionally flirt with him right in front of them to give them more food for gossip. I keep building the sand castles and not turning around to the event take place. Next thing I see masha running off crying. I understand that the ladies said something hurtful to her, so I go after her to ask about it, my husband rushes past me and runs to comfort her. I can see he is wiping the tears from her face and i become insanely jealous, I attack her and grab her by the nose with two bent fingers and in a very violent way drag her across the pool area so the grandmothers can see it. I wake up.

I dream that I am either boarding or getting off a flight at LAX. I notice a Philippine Woman next to me, she introduces herself and tells me that there is a great children’s shoe store in the airport and I will find nice shoes there for my son. We go together and take carts. The store in not a shoe store but sells all kinds of house old goods, there are coffee makers and blenders etc. I am holding a coffee pot in my hand and notice that the lady sticking large pieces of merchandise into her bag, and it seems I too am about to steal this coffee maker, I then realize I am going to get into serious trouble if I keep hanging out with this lady so I put the coffee pot back on the self and quickly exit the store. I realize she is following me with her cart and I am now hiding in the bathroom of the airport with my feet up on the toilet. I can see her cart and her legs from under the stall and she is calling me. I wake up.

'36. March 19, 1588. This same day the nineteenth of March I went to bed for a siesta just after I had lunch. I dreamt that I was in the middle of a field on a very dark night. I saw many people lying on the ground, sleeping. In the middle of the crowd, there was a well. Some of them woke up and the moonlight was shining on them (although I could not see it) and they said to me: “Give us some water! This well has a rope and a bucket.” I started to pull out buckets of water and then I called them, whistling, as shepherds call their flock to come and drink. They got up and came to drink and all of them were dressed in black, and among them there was an old man who said to me: “You will wash these men’s ears with that water.” And after he said this, I did not see him again. I kneeled down with my right knee on the ground; I put my left arm through the buckle handle and put it over my left knee, without untying it from the rope. When the men arrived there to drink, I put my right hand in the water and washed their ears with it. In this manner, I was pulling out water, giving it to them and washing them all night. And after I arrived at the well, I saw a woman covered with a black cape; she was lying against a post where a small ladle for water has hanging. I could not see her well; she looked almost as a shadow. Then the old man from before appeared again and said to me: “You have been a great Rebecca! This will be the last bucket you pull out! With this one you will receive grace!” I started to pull the water bucket out, but after pulling and pulling, it was so heavy that my strength did not last. Not only could I not pull the rope itself, pressing it down with my foot to stop it while I switched hands, but also the bucket was sliding down again and again, almost pushing me down along with it. At last, I made such an effort that with great exertion I pulled the bucket out of the well. And when it was up, I saw that the water in it was clearer than before, although all of it had been very clear water. And on top of the bucket there was a small child, two years old or so, with a beautiful face, blond straight hair to his ears (with locks such as those that small boys and girls from the hills have when they come to sell their products at the court market). And this child was dressed with a white linen shirt open in the front and his hood sewn in black, the wrists of his shirt were wide so that you could see his arms; over his shirt he had a silk coat that was purple (as they call it), very short as it did not go past his shirt, which went down to his knees. And the sleeves of this clothing (that he had on) did not go past his elbows and were very tight, and this coat was open at the front like the shirt. And he had a round ball of medium size like a common ball or sweet lime, in his right hand. The ball was of a washed black color. On top of the ball there was a cross of similar proportions, and underneath, from its half, there were many small iron chains all tangled with each other, hanging there. And with this clothing and all the accessories he was bringing, he was standing up with a foot on one side of the bucket and the other foot on the other side. He had his two little hands holding both sides of his clothes and his shirt, opening them up on the front and with this gesture he seemed to welcome people to cover up with them; and his skin was so beautiful that it shined. And with the bucket in my hand, lifted from the floor in front of me, I said: “Baby, who is your father?” He answered: “I am the father!” And while he said this he stepped down from the bucket to the floor. And the old man, with his face covered, took the bucket from my hand, and I did not see him again. Around this time, the sun started to rise, and some of the men, lying down on the floor, started to become clear and some others were still dark. And the boy said to me: “Take me in your arms!” I added: “Listen, I am very tired, you are going to leave me exhausted with your heavy weight.” He said: “Come on! I was even heavier for Cristobal!” And feeling that he would be very happy if I lifted him in my arms, I bent down to grab him. I took him in my arms pressing him against my breast and he went up so much that his small belly was against my chin. And in this way he said to me: “I also bring a little girl with me. Take her, if you can because she is also very tired, although you will get tired as well so you would not be able to take her.” And while I was walking with this boy towards the east, leaving all the men behind, I turned my eyes to my left and I saw a little girl. She was five years old more or less with dark hair, black eyes and eyebrows and dressed in widow’s clothes, covered with a cape. She was grabbing my clothes on one side, and I thought she looked exhausted. I saw her in this way, and feeling sorry for her, I said: “Sweet heart, where would you like to go?” She said: “Take me to the high city!” The boy said: “There is a river where this girl says to go; look around to see where you need to cross it. I did not want to give you so much work, but she wants to go there.” I tried to cheer them up and said: “Grab me tight, do not get lost! I will take you there.” After I said this, I thought we had walked so much towards the east that we had arrived at the end of the world; we found a rock that seemed to be touching the sky on that side. The boy said: “We have to turn this way, that is what this girl wants.” So we turned to the left where he was pointing and we climbed very high hills and rocks, and on top of them, the boy said: “I do not have anything to eat.” And I wanted to feed him. I looked around to see if I could find something and I did not see anything, and while doing this, I saw that the boy gave me his hand and talked to me saying: “This fruit is grown in the very dry hills and there is no better soft fruit than this for hard work.” I saw that he had this fruit in his small hand, and he showed me that it was a ripe peach, and he ate it all. And then we arrived at a river and my boy said, looking at the girl close to the riverbank: “This girl has given you so much trouble; go and cross it! I will take you to the promised land!” I was getting into it and then I found myself with my boy and girl on the other side. And I was entering a city through a door on the east side, which I have used before some other times. My boy said: “You are in Toledo! And do not put me on the ground until you take me to a church that I will show you!” And walking up the streets, I passed Don Alonso’s house, and turning to the right, I arrived at a church with some steps at the front door and with columns decorated with chapters. And there I put my boy down on the highest step. And I saw that the girl, who had been grabbing me, moved to one side of the church door. She shook her skirt that was full of dust, with her face looking at the church. And the boy waited for her to do this. And when she joined him, she put her right hand on his head, and they went into the church together. And then I woke up…'

'35. March 19, 1588. The nineteenth of March of this year at six in the morning I fell asleep and dreamt, as I had been awake all night due to a high fever I suffered. I dreamt that a man that I did not know arrived in my room to tell me that Diego de Cordova was in my house and I said: “What does he want?” He answered: “He wants to tell you that Fray Luke is with the king.” “Well, what does Fray Luke want: that I go to him to show him how to talk? I do not want anybody to come in.” After I said this I woke up. And after a little bit, I fell asleep again and I dreamt that the king was sitting down in a chair at the head of my bed and I could hear him saying: “Madam, Fray Luke told me that you were sick in bed and that is why I came to see you.” I answered him: “Fray Luke is so afraid of you that he thought to excuse me by saying that I was sick. Now your finger nails cannot hurt me.” Philip responded: “Listen, I am the king!” I answered him: “A visit from Piedrola would be nicer.” And he thought that I could still not recognize him, he repeated: “Do not you see that I am the king?” I added: “Just this year!” He said: “I came to ask what is going to happen with my son. He is sick.” I answered him: “Think that he is David’s son, and thank God that he is taking him away before your bad advice can damage him!” Looking down at his feet, I saw that they were bare and I asked: “How did you arrive here?” He answered that it was in a carriage. I said to him: “You are going back walking!” He replied: “I do not want anything else from you but to keep me secret.” I added: “Oh, Philip, you have no idea who is in control of this dance!” I wanted to keep talking with another idea; however, I woke up because of the noise that my mother and Fray Luke made when they came in to my bedroom…'

'34. March 17, 1588. This same day the seventeenth of March, after I had dreamt what I mentioned before, I fell asleep again and dreamt that I was in the house of Peter de Robles, (the foreigner and the man that arranged lodging for the archers, who lives in my neighborhood), down the street. And there I found the lawyer Parra in his room, sitting down on a bench, and this man’s wife was also there in this room, lying down on a bed on her left side, with the front of her body covered with a rug from her breasts down and breastfeeding a baby with her left breast; her back was all naked flesh from her shoulders to her feet. And when she saw me she said: “We know all your things!” I asked her: “Who told you?” Her husband replied: “Don Guillen sent me a short letter that explained to me all your visions. He also sent me a sword and a helmet; he asked me to go with him to defend against our enemies.” I said: “How come? Why has that bad Christian Guillen done such a thing? Who brought the letter?” Parra answered and then I went closer to him, and very upset, I told him: “Who ordered it to be brought to you?” He answered that Don Guillen did. “Because he needed people.” And he called this man and I went closer to Rojas himself and said to him: “You are a man that knows a lot about modern times, and you also know a lot about women, so why did you never tell me anything about it or report it to someone?” And he stared at my arm, looking very anxious. My arm was naked and he wanted to cut it in half with a knife, asking for one. I said: “I just wanted to let you know with honesty that, although you cut it, I will not feel anything.” I turned around to talk to Rojas and said: “You are a man that continuously follows the stars, why have you not reported this year’s forthcomings to the king (being yourself his servant)?” He answered: “Because I wanted to live in peace. If I had reported some of these things, I would have been a traitor; because I know I have the most hard-working sign on earth, because they will find me guilty, as I am a descendant of the Borgona family, and because the king has done much wrong with those lands. So, it is good that you are the one to declare these things because they cannot find you guilty of planning anything. And look around! Look at all these weapons that the king ordered me to clean so that the men that are able may go to fight to defend themselves!” After he finished saying this, the woman in bed asked me to be quiet, making some finger signs. I understood that she did it so her husband would go with Parra (who was afraid of what I said and had gone out to the street). And her husband left. And forgetting about my anger, I saw my arm covered up. I went closer to the woman lying on the bed and told her: “Come here! Tell me why Don Guillen sent your husband the short letter!” She said: “Cover me up!” I covered her up with clothes and a blanket. Then she asked for food and they brought her two fried eggs with bread. “Do you know that in the short letter that Guillen sent my husband he asked him to hide all the king’s weapons that he had with him? So he did, with all the helmets clean.” After she said this, she ate the eggs’ yolks and gave me the whites and I ate them. And the woman said to me: “I want to go to the church of Victoria.” We went there and I saw that it was completely destroyed except for a small chapel with the tomb. And then, we saw my mother coming in and the woman that was with me stood up and told her: “Oh, madam, I am such a sinner!” My mother asked her: “What kind of sins? What is it?” She replied: “I have made a woman have a bad birth! Come with me and I will show you how I did it!” She took me to an orchard that is close to Leganitos and there we saw that she had put a cabbage over a fire of many human hairs, and with the heat, the cabbage started to open up on top of the fire, and she said: “The unknown woman’s hips are opening up in the same way!” And she called this woman’s name. Then I added: “How can you prevent it from happening?” She answered: “By pouring some water over the fire!” I went to the Leganitos fountain and brought a big jug full of water and poured it on the fire. I saw Don Alonso coming, riding fast on his mule, and I asked Martin, his servant: “Where is Don Alonso coming from?” He answered: “He is coming from the Discalced” and then I asked him: “Which way is Piedrola’s house?” He showed me the way, and leaving there my mother and the other woman… I found it full of weeds, very dense weeds but not very tall, and walking on them, I saw that they had become an orchard of vegetables. And I saw my mother coming with the other woman (who was dressed with a very white shirt and with a turban on her head, Turkish style). And while we were all in the orchard, we saw a man sitting down in a corner of the orchard surrounded by grass, and I heard that he had started to sing: “Do you want cherries? Do you want some?” He repeated this many times and I asked him: “Who are you? Are you my father?” He answered: “No, I am the orchard’s owner.” I asked him: “Where is the way out?” He said it was by passing above that water wheel. I said to my mother and the other woman: “Do not cross it until I make sure it is safe!” And then I put my foot on it and it crashed down, and I said: “There is some betrayal here!” The man said: “It seems the Demon is helping her because she knows so much! I would do much better if she were in my orchard.” I continued looking for an exit on the surrounding walls. I found a hidden door, covered with a layer of plaster on top, and I hit it hard with my foot. It fell down and there was a river behind it, with a very big field on its banks. I sat down, as I was very tired and said: “Drink, those that are thirsty! And thank God that he has taken us out of there to the open fields, freeing us from the betrayal and labor that other people wanted to impose on us!” And then I woke up…'

'33. March 17, 1588. The seventeenth of March of this year, when I was falling asleep, I saw a woman close to me. She had a very pale long face, (however, she did not look sick), a curvy nose, big eyes and full dark brown eyebrows. She was dressed in a very white nun’s habit with a black veil on her head. She came very close to me and took my face between her hands, squeezing it strongly. And as it hurt me, I said to her: “Madam, take away your hands because I am feeling sick; those nails of the cross that you have in your hands are hurting me.” She replied: “I came here to torment the flesh to cleanse the spirit. I am the nun from Portugal, you will know me from now on.” At this moment, I must have moved my face (as I did not like what she was doing to me) and she saw it and said: “Why are you moving?” I moved my hand up and down with disdain and told her: “Because I am not fond of Portuguese people.” Then I looked at her thoroughly and I saw that she calmed down and that she was covered with a dark reddish wool cape like those that the friars from the Saint Trinity order wear. I asked her: “Why are you wearing this cape if you do not belong to that order?” She answered: “Because there are Portuguese people.” And when she said it, she raised the wimple worn under her chin; I saw that she had her throat so tightened that no one could have it so tight, no matter how thin and small a person was. She said: “You do not have this!” (Pointing to her throat.) I denied it and then she said: “Neither does Martin although he is so close to God. I have it because I have spent a lot of time on my knees with many fasts.” I replied: “Madam, as you are saint, warn the king about these times!” She answered: “God gives each of us what we can take; he has given me this grace of having his sores and he has given you this other one. Use yours the best you can! I feel sorry for the evil that is coming; however, I cannot request more from him as I am not entitled to do so.” I said to her: “Oh! My head hurts!” She said: “It has been hurting me even more for three years now.” I asked her: “Madam, have you seen the Armada?” She did not answer. She put her hands together, intertwining her fingers and pressing them tightly together (as a very upset person). I saw that her sores were opening up more than before and were releasing tears of blood, some of them dropping down to my bed. And then she disappeared and I did not see her again. After that the Ordinary Man came to me and asked: “Do you want to come and see some good men of faith shooting arrows?” I nodded. He took me to the palace where I found his majesty sitting down on a big table, at which there were many people sitting and eating. I saw the king ordering a drink and one of his servants, joking with him, brought a silver jar full of wine and milk (I saw him pouring them into the jar). When he drank it, he started to talk a lot in a different language from ours, and as a crazy man with lost senses, he started to laugh and to fall asleep. And he was saying that he was going to name dukes and knights and archbishops and give some jobs and favors to whomever he wanted as much as he had power in his hands to do so. And when he was doing these things, I saw a man coming. He was medium size, dressed in black in ordinary attire and with his face covered, and carrying a loaded crossbow with an arrow. He shot many arrows at the king’s heart, but they did not hurt him and he did not feel any pain. This man saw that the king did not have any feelings, and he started to say: “What a heart, hard as a diamond!” And after he said that, the Ordinary Man got closer to him and took his crossbow from his hands and put it on his back, and the other man in black moved aside. And another three men arrived after him. They were dressed in the same habit (I did not look at them very long, only to see that their faces were covered as well and that they brought crossbows with arrows as the first man). They shot at the king and although they hurt him, he did not show any pain. And they started to tell him that his heart was hard as a stone, and other similar insults to express the king’s heart’s cruelty and brutality. The Ordinary Man, worried about this, said to me: “Take that crossbow and shoot some arrows yourself, let’s see what happens.” I shot at him and the first arrow vanished in the air without touching him. When the Ordinary Man saw this, he got upset and his face changed colors. He told me with surprise: “What is this? Are you hiding something from me?” Feeling very sorry, he asked me to shoot again and I did so. And I shot the king’s heart. I saw that he did not show any pain; water poured out of his heart.
