David teases me again, "Here he comes!"and we laugh together. Brian goes to see Susan for counseling about some unhappiness and difficulty in his relationship.

I'm under a bush with David. A woman in a pink jogging jacket is watching us from up above, from the loading dock. He knows her. He turns his back to her. We embrace. We're okay with other people seeing us embrace. We pull apart. "There's something I need to tell you, " I say. "Don't tell me. You have an STD," he says. I nod.

I'm driving a car with my mother in the passenger seat and my children in back. I can't find the brakes, I can't feel them beneath my feet. We are going downhill and for a moment it is as if I am unconscious. somehow we don't crash and we turn a corner. In front of us a car cuts across and crashes or pops over a brick wall. There is a drop and we don't hear the car crash for a couple of seconds. This tells me that it was a long drop and there would be no survivors. I get out with the intention to help but I can see it is hopeless.

I feel like I am in Hansel and Gretel's forest. I am walking down an unfinished dirt road. There are houses being built and I think, "what a shame that they are building them so close together." At least the children will be able to play with each other. I think of 5 children per group of houses. I am walking to a destination.

Pete is standing with another man. He asks me what my favorite perfume is. He wants to buy me a gift. He's a little embarrassed. I whisper into an oversized ear "we should talk" because I'm going to tell him that I'm married. He insists that he wants the indulgence. He says, "I missed my teen years and sitting on a fence drinking wine with someone." Interpretation: Pete is my id, asking for the indulgence of buying a sensual gift. And the id wants the indulgence of sitting on the fence for a while. The id is listening to my superego (oversized ear) whispering (we should talk/married), but the id insists. It wants the pleasure and the indulgence. This is the integration of the id and the superego.

I have had an experience with a handicapped guy. We both put on chainmail and walked around in it. It was a good experience but it's time to move on. My perspective is from high up a mountain and I'm looking ahead, down the side of the mountain. Interpretation: I think this is how I feel about my marriage: he was handicapped and we walked around with chainmail on. "It was a good experience but it's time to move on" to new experiences.

Reed is visiting me. He is staying with Mike and me. I get my hair cut, it's an awkward trim and now I have to find a stylist. It was as if she got half-way in and didn't know what she was doing. More of an image and a feeling than a dream: The shower (like the one in my girls' bathroom) is backwards and broken. To take a shower you have to slip in through a crack. The shower is a tile box and thinking about it makes me feel claustrophobic.

I'm camping, but indoors, like a sleep-over. We go to sleep, a young boy snuggles up to me and it's so pleasant. Simon is lying near me. Mike tells me, the doctor said his back evidences wear and tear. I'm annoyed. What does that even mean?

I am with a group of people, avoiding someone. Trying to get away. I go by three girls who I had previously been avoiding for a little protection and to blend in. There is safety in numbers. theme: being chased or pursued, hiding.

A Latino man in a loud colorful shirt is sheepishly presenting me with a bill for $2,700.00. We have been entangled, embracing? It's a beautiful Spring day and I'm walking along a road. I see Gerry Doherty and he's going hiking or doing an outdoor activity. I have parked my car in Garfield or Lodi and now I am lost. I want to get back to Oakland. I'm walking around town, trying to figure out how to get to Oakland. Which direction? I tell Ty and Curtis I will come back later to get them and then I forget. I'm home, it's 5 a.m. I believe my mother is returning home early with the girls after a camping trip or vacation of sorts. If I could accept who I am and my mistakes, have compassion for myself, my True Self would come out and there would be no drama, only compassion and understanding of Self and Other.

I'm walking into a restaurant with Simon and another couple. He and I are lightly holding hands,walking together as a couple. It feels nice, connected, and I am filled with anticipation as I look forward to a nice evening. I'm in a large, expansive mall.

I go to a run-down public bathroom, broken toilet seats, dirty. I miss the toilet, get it on myself and my robe. Interpretation: Self expression; getting rid of negative experience or emotions. A public bathroom: things you feel or things you might be ashamed of, sexual matters or attitudes.

I'm in my office with the lights out. A client shows up and I turn the lights on. The office is a mess. The client comes in, his name is Bob, and he tells me he's leaving treatment. I'm shocked. I offer him pizza, thin, small, cut with scissors.

The kids and their cousins are playing in the garage, but they are eeking out into the street. I go to get them to move it in. They put even more stuff out and it starts to rain. I'm trying to get them to clean up.

Sarah is laughing at a little boy who is dressed up by his mother to do door-to-door sales. It hurts his feelings. I feel bad for him and that Sarah made him feel bad. I think to myself, it's not his fault that his mother is doing this to him.

Justin Timberlake is at my house. He's a little rude. I have my hand on his stomach and he pushes it off. Either he gets something out of the fridge or he asks me to give him something to eat. We don't have much. He throws a glass on the floor. I scold him: "That's not what we do in our house."

Tom Supko calls me while I'm in session with Simon. He tells me it's a "marriage call." He wants to complain about his wife. I want to give him my full attention and I want to give Simon/myself my full attention. I tell him I'll call him back later.

I'm watching as the tennis courts at Packanack Lake are being torn down and a new, large one put up. There will be bleachers on either side. A woman who obviously wanted a divorce. I'm telling her she has to stay out of how her husband is parenting their children. Let him do it his way. There is a woman asleep or two asleep on the couch as I talk to her.

I'm on a waterslide and I hear my phone notification go off, twice. I realize my phone is down my bathing suit and is now wet. I quickly take it out and take out the battery, hopping to save it from being ruined.

I see Dave Boner and walk right up to him, kiss him on the lips which surprises me slightly (dry kiss), and stand talking to him, belly to belly. It feels intimate, pleasurable, rewarding. I'm on a log flume ride with a bunch of people, including my family, Mike, Phyllis, Casey Lai. The ride isn't wild, it just has a few drops here and there. He is talking about dates, schedules, when he is flying and driving, but he is all over the place, confusing me, not making any sense. I'm seeing a couple in my office and I hear someone come into my waiting room. I open the door and see a mother and young teen son. Joe Rude (who doesn't identify himself, nor do I identify myself, some question in my mind about how he seems to know it's me) is reassuring me and even hints that he knows about Mike and I and is there is anything he can do to help...

I won a telephone call with the lead singer of the Red Hot Chili Peppers. I'm standing in my closet talking to him on the phone. I'm disappointed in myself that all I can think of to talk about is the weather.

A two part dream. In the first part, I am given something by Paul Newman, it's cash and it's mine. I hide it in the wall of the attic at the log cabin. I am at a dinner or maybe at church and Barbara Habeeb is getting an award. I'm not sure what it's for, but I am happy for her. I am impressed by her ability to succeed and look happy, despite an troubled marriage.

This Russian woman (who is really a teller at my bank) cannot clean my house properly. She is leaving the wood wet and when I try to correct her, she makes an even bigger, disgusting mess. I'm angry at her and plan on reporting her to her employers.

I go into a hotel room with several people, we are there for a conference. The room is a suite. To the right is a small room with two twin beds. I feel the life there with her.

I dreamed that I called Chris, the neighbor down the street married to Cheryl, as a police officer, to help me. I walk down the street in the dark and stand outside his house. I see him shadow as he gets out of bed. I feel bad for waking him, so I sneak back down the street, hiding in the shadows. Finally, I cross over to my house, exposed momentarily in the light. I don't believe he saw me.

I am swimming in Packanack Lake with my children. I'm concerned when I see piles of "seaweed" that they will be freaked out about it. Then a boat zips by and creates waves. Big waves. I am with a man, confident that he will be sexually satisfied as long as I give him steak with pomegranate.

I'm traveling and I have a few bags and a lot of tickets, too much to carry. I'm at the airport. I'm leaving stuff behind. A woman leaves our group and "disappears" herself, very skillfully, too. No one will ever find her. It's sad, but necessary. Her job was done there. I see an amazing, wide, shining landscape, with stuff to explore way off in the distance. But I have to wait for someone's husband to come home from work. When he does come home, it's usually early at 2:00, he rings a bell. The sun has to line up on an ancient wall, in a brief vertical line, then insert the male and female key at the same time and turn. it will open and you will get the key to everything, the key to having a journey to completion.

I go to see a holistic doctor for a problem, which feels emotional or spiritual. The doctor has a male assistant. They tell me I have to eat internal organs, a heart and liver. I defecate and go back to the doctor's "shop."

I'm at a hotel and I cross over to a hotel lobby in another building. My father has packed my bags because my stuff was a mess. A bellhop is talking to me in a foreign language. I try to fend them off with nail polish and a coffee mug, household items. The dogs belong to a woman I know who is a bitch.

I am outside, typing on my laptop in the snow. The snow is piling up on me, I am covered with a foot of snow. My laptop is hot and the snow is melting on the laptop. For some reason we had Bailey, a small kitten and a snake for pets. I was with all of them in the get busy area. Bailey went away but I was paying attention to protecting the little snake. I was with some random guy up at the lake house. It seemed like there were other people there because I brought him downstairs to try to get away from everyone. I won a free Disney cruise that I had to go on by myself. I was really anxious about being all alone, but throughout the trip I tried to make the most of it. I was uncomfortable the whole time.

Still trying to get L-train to take me back and love me. The closest I got was that he held my hand. In these dreams I'm not scared to approach him or tell him what I think, but I also feel guilty for what I did in the past because he acts like he's still hurt and doesn't trust me. Raine, a girl from TCNJ, was staying over in the room I slept in. I moved stuff off of my bed, and i had red silk sheets on. I was talking to Raine and she told me I don't know how to talk to people well, and asked me if I talk to people. I told her no, I don't get out a lot. I had roller blades on both of my feet. I wasn't good at it, and when I fell over I didn't get hurt. I knew it wasn't going to hurt then, so I started going faster and faster. I figured out how to push diagonally with my back foot to get a better fast start. I think I saw Brian Gzemski, either on a bike or walking around. It was a college campus I was on, and i was going up a concrete sidewalk, up a hill. There were a lot of trees around too. I was afraid of hitting the cracks or bumps in the sidewalks.
I am with Rinpoche and Rosa. It is nighttime we are going to bed. I turn out the lights. Rosa tells me where the switches are. As I lye down in my bed Rinpoche gets up and starts talking to me.

I was with Jemma, she was going into flats that were empty. The last one she went in I had a sense that someone was upstairs. Then I heard a noise. I whispered to her. She came out just as a dog started barking. I shut the door. as I walked down the passage I was worried the People or Police would get me.

I am in a hotel tidying my clothes to move out. There is an awkward person wants me to get out quickly. I am wanting to have a shower because I have shit on me. I go to go in the shower but Becky goes in first. So I go for a walk. I forget the way back and end up in a shopping precinct . I look for my phone but don't have it . I realise I have no money or phone and am somewhere completely unknown but I feel good about it.

I wake up and hear the Chod being sung. I find myself downstairs Brendan is sitting in the corner, there are many voices around him. I go to the kitchen and realize I am dreaming, then I am back in bed but still hearing the Chod.

I am in a road by Colin Slatter's house. His Internet has problems. I make suggestions but people don't listen. So I sit down, a little sad and say to myself it is ok to be alone without respect. Then things change. They come and ask me my opinion.

I am in a room with Rinpoche. Judy comes in, there is a problem with some texts. Rinpoche is very unhappy about this and grabs here by the throat. I stand close to him to stop him getting closer. I realise this is a dream. He lets go. He asks me to do something and goes out of the room. I am worried in case I get something wrong. I find some dust all packed together and drop it through a hole in the floor. It catches fire. I can't reach it to put it out. I am worried, eventually it seems to go out by itself. I then go to see Rinpoche. He is on a train with big luxury rooms. It is snowing outside.

I am in a pub with Sally and Derek, we are talking about a previous occasion in the pub, then Martin Carthy walks in. He puts an inner tube on the floor. I ask him if he is playing here but don't quite hear his answer. The others do and say he is playing. We go upsatairs, where there are lots of shoes outside the door.

I am at Julia's I go out back talking with Julia and Becky. Becky talks about how she tried to commit suicide. I then go for a walk with Julia. Then I go into a café. When I come out Hami is across the road with Nigel. We go to some escalators and go on them.
I am at a retreat joining in a practice very badly. Adriano calls me outside, he wants to talk to me. Fabio comes along he is red and looks right into my face. I have confidence I can deal with it.
I am at a rehearsal. I am anxious about setting my stuff up. Colin is there. Then a large rocket arrives backs up and goes into a hole in the ground. There is a sense that we shouldn't have seen this
I am walking down a towpath. I see Paul McCartney and the Linda McCartney. I manage to get an invite onto their boat for me and another person. I think I have nobody to go with, then I think of Jemma

I am at a teaching. I go to speak to Fabio. He says he won't talk to me because I refused Amrita. I have some slight memory of this. I think to talk to Chogyal Namkhai Norbu about this but eventually don't.

I get on a train late at night. I am on my own and I press a button that I shouldn't . The train goes into a dark tunnel and stops. I am worried. I press another button, the back door opens and a guard comes. I appear to be in trouble. I am thinking to deny pressing the button.

I am at a party, Dom is there, she is being pretty wild. People take here into the pool I hear her screaming and go to help her but she is dead. They bring her body in and lay it down. She then rises from her body and I try to explain to her that she is dead.

I am in Coldershaw Road. I have overslept and missed morning school. Then I realize that it is exam time and I have missed some very important exams. I go to the school and try to explain. They are okay about it.

I am at a party. Jemma is there but she hasn't said hello. I am sad about that. Judy comes along and comments on a ribbon I have tied in my hair. Clare is there too. The booze runs out so I go looking to buy some. All the shops are shutting.

I am in the street, it is full of people. They are waiting for a fireworks display. Julia comes along and talks about death. Then Poppy is there. I give her a hug. I then go to a chip shop but I feel full. So I walk away. I see a burger that it seems I left so I start to eat it but it is tough so I drop it by the bushes for the rats. I am then walking between bushes in the dark.

I am in West Ealing by the station looking in the shops. At the end of the row is a guitar shop with strange wooden carved guitars, many have their back facing out. I go into the shop, it is cavernous dark and dusty. There are no guitars in there.
I am looking out of a window at a boat on the sea. I start telling myself a story about Gary Numan. How he was so quiet when he used to come into Tempo & about a party where he sat alone.

I am at a retreat. I talk to Rinpoche. He is reminiscing about retreats years ago. I ask him at what point it all changed. He laughs. He is leaning over me. I become very hot and have to move. I am a little embarrassed at having to do so.

I am in town. I go to a café. Alice is there. I am sitting on a kind of tall chair. Then everyone goes. I am left alone. I walk down to the high street, consider going somewhere spending money but then I decide to go home.

I am outside some kind of party. I go up a fire escape Michael is there he says about the band being good. I look away, he wants to know what is wrong. I go away then I realize I am dreaming. I decide to start flying I go up into the sky
I am in a tunnel, then I have a sense of deja vu. Then I realise I am dreaming.. The dream becomes lucid. I try to manifest something & find it only works if I don't look at the manifestation.

I am with schoolfriends but we have left school. I am involved with Dianne but she has gone to live elsewhere. I feel very sad. I am with Slinky in Coldershaw Road. He confesses to me that he is not at college, as he told the others. I am relieved because neither am I.

I am in a hotel. It is at a retreat. Red water begins to drip in from the ceiling. I go down to the foyer to tell them. Then I head for the teachings. I meet Diane Stanley on the way. The bed that the red water is dripping on to is hers, so I tell her.

I am in West Ealing at the crossroads by the lido. Mick Jagger comes along and offers me a woman, a lady of the night. I go to see her in a park. There is a guy behind the bushes gushing semen. The whole dream has an unwholesome feel.

I am staying the night at Lilley & Ernie's. I am surprised and puzzled that I have a room to myself. Then I begin to feel alone. It seems like I have a barrier between myself and others. I feel sad and start to practise Simhamukha, then I wonder if that won't make another barrier.

Rinpoche comes to me. He is very nice and kind to me. There is a strong sense of his presence. I realise I am dreaming and that I should be more dedicated to the Dharma. I pray that I may become a better practitioner and that Rinpoche stays for a long time. I have a sense he may not and time is running out.

I am in London with Julia. I become so tired I can hardly talk. Julia is talking about us getting back into a relationship but I just walk to the place where my bed is. She becomes upset & goes away. She then comes back with Tony. She doesn't believe I am tired. Tony goes to the toilet. I get angry with Julia. Then calm down as Tony comes back. He is watching me to see if I am being odd. We then go to Colchester, a bar. Kevin Turley is there behind the bar and Rachel calls us from across the room. I go sit on my own.

I am on a bridge initially with a friend. Then I am left alone. It is in London. At first it is just dark, pitch black darkness, then I look across and see the lights. I walk to a point on the bridge where there are steps. They go down into a reception area. I then go up some stairs and find I am on a plane. I ask where it is going, they say Cyprus. I am very worried as I have no passport and can't get off.

I am at home with Sally, she is helping me. She was going to stay the night but changes her mind. She goes back home which is next door. She comes out into the garden. I feel sad about the situation but then think to let it go and breathe out all the poisonous emotions.

I am doing exams, not very well. I am writing into a small book and my handwriting is very bad. As I hand the book in Someone I know asks me why I did so badly. I try to say I didn't. The only thing that is good are the illustrations.

At a retreat. Cooking. There are some candles on the table which have been put out. Someone asks about the burning smell. I say we have put them out. Then someone comes and says not to do this. I am angry at their officiosness. Then someone makes a joke about my anger.

I am setting up to do a gig with Morrissey. There are hundreds of people in the crowd. It is taking me ages to set up and there are things I can't find. I am getting anxious. I see Michaela in the audience.
I get in a taxi with my mother. I am chatting to the cabby. Them I tell him we are going to the BBC. He reverses on a roundabout and goes down a different road. We go through a barrier.

I am in a Georgian house, in Maida Vale in a narrow room with an arch window. I think it would be good to have the window widened. Then I go down to the kitchen. I get stuck but sound a phat & recognise this is a dream.
I am in a cookery class, the staff upset me, so I storm out. I get in a lift. I am so angry I hit the mirror at the back of the lift. It smashes, then I am full of regret.

I am walking through West Ealing, Uxbridge Road. There are riots some kind of left wing right wing thing. The right wing side are gathered around my house. So I start to walk through them but it is difficult. I have a go at one of them.

I am in Coldershaw road. I am in some kind of relationship but it is not going well. So I am going out. I get ready, there is a green cricket in the room. Two people come in but they can't see me. Then my partner comes in and I say I am going out.

I am talking to someone about playing and am blagging a bit. Brendan is there and hears me. I am embarrassed. Then I go to Ipswich. Then it is night and I go to see Boris, he is not there. I go into these flats and there are rooms. I can hear Nuala talking.
I am in a club. For some reason I kick out at a person. They stand back. I then go out and walk over a crossing. Someone is following me so I turn back twice so as not to go into the dark

I am at a concert, on stage. As we come off a young girl tells me not to take any credit for the show as it is nothing to do with me. I am angry but try to stay present. We are back at Coldershaw road and I throw a small piece of soap at her

It started out I was in a big bed having sex with who I believe was Seth Shaver from high school. He was on top of me and I was scratching his back. It was really really good. When we were done we just cuddled for a while before we went to sleep. I'm having trouble remembering what was next. It was the next day I think and we were at a party maybe. Seth kept following me around and I was ok with it, but he was way more into me than I was him. I remember thinking how if only this was 10 years ago it would have been perfect. He kept wanting to have sex again but I would always tell him no. Even though I wanted to too.

I was hiding from some people. I don't know who they were or why I was hiding. It was in a warehouse. Someone had already injected something into my upper arm and I don't know what it was. It didn't seem to have any effect on me. I was crouched behind a wall waiting for everyone to leave. I thought they were gone but someone came around the corner and shot me in the chest. it didn't hurt. then they shot me in the head. that didn't hurt either. I fell over expecting to die but I never did. I shut my eyes hoping they would assume I did and leave. they kept standing there. it felt like forever. I don't even know if I was bleeding. then a man came and got the person that shot me. I think I got up after they left and did something but now I can't remember what.

I was watching Noemi and Gabby. We lived in a different house. We were trading in our broken projection TV for a new TV. I looked out the window as the lady that was picking up/dropping off the TVs was leaving. I went downstairs to see the new TV. She left us a big pumpkin instead of a TV. I was pretty pissed off about it. I went back upstairs because the girls were about to leave. I went in the bathroom to run water in the bathtub. After I turned the water on I walked to my room. It was covered in cats. The tub started overflowing. I didn't know what to do. I was mad that there were cats everywhere but they were cute. Mom saw a kitten and a said we would keep it, but get rid of the others. The tub was still overflowing, cats were attacking me and I was still pissed about the pumpkin and then I woke up.
I think we were at home. Moon was making a huge breakfast. I was starving. When it was done I was going to get some but mom said it wasn't for me. Only her and Tracy. I got irrationally angry.

I was in class with Doctor Who. We were talking about what time it was. When the bell rang I went to lunch. I went to stand in line and I had to get behind Nico. I didn't even speak to him. I wasn't very hungry and couldn't decide if I wanted salad or pizza. I don't think I had enough money for pizza. When I finally got to a table Tim and Eric were sitting there. Eventually they went sky diving.

I was in live with some guy named Brandon. It featured me our that he had my brothers name but I was head over heels for him. There was something to do with horses. Nico played drums in a band. Heather was helping me pick one out.

I don't remember details because it was two days ago, but I got to watch the first episode of the second season (or series as they like to say) of My Mad Fat Diary. I was excited about it, but it seems like it wasn't a very happy episode. After I was done watching it I all of a sudden had a baby. It was newborn.

I was in someone's bedroom. It was kind of gloomy. Everything, even the air it seemed, had a brown tint to it. I was on the bed doing a word search. There were two other people there but I don't know who they were.

I was at home. It was almost night during one of the warmer months. The forecast had been calling for rain. I looked out the back door and it looked like it was snowing. I run over to the glass door to the deck and said out loud that it was snowing. When I got to the door I could tell it was snowing pretty hard. I yelled, "omg is snowing!" It was coming down so hard that it was a few inches deep in only a few minutes. I went outside to get a picture because I knew it was a once in a lifetime thing and no one would believe me. It's like every picture I took wasn't good enough for me. I kept on and on but couldn't get one I liked. It started to rain. The rain was melting the snow. I was very upset. I just stood out in the rain all sad.

It felt like a school or some other large building like that. It was very open though. There were couches and stuff everywhere. I'm almost positive there was a bouncy castle too. For some reason I can remember I had my hair up. Ewan McGregor was there and he was following me everywhere. I wasn't complaining. I sat down on the edge of a couch and he crawled in behind me. He was right up against me and we sat like that for a while. I was crazy happy.

In this dream I didn't know who my real father was. I was out west somewhere. Arizona or something where there is desert. I staying in a nice hotel. He didn't look like my dad in real life. He had grey hair and was really nice. I talked to him for a little bit. I went over to the window and I could see his wife and daughters walking to the hotel. I don't remember if his wife was nice to me, but I do know that one of the daughters was a real bitch. The other daughter was really nice to me and we really hit it off. She sat in my room and we talked forever like old friends.

I remember very little. A man, possibly family, punched me in the face like three times. My phone was left at a police station. There was a neighborhood being built. I was very upset about being punched. I found myself at an apartment building. I went up to a random one and was let in. It was Frank Iero. We sat around talking like old friends. Debating which Hitchcock movie was better. Birds or Psycho.

I was out somewhere. I may have been at mom's work, but I'm not sure. I was standing there with mom and the woman that plays Mrs. Thackeray in Upstairs Downstairs and Celia in Last Tango in Halifax was standing there with us. She worked with mom. Because that's what English actresses do. They quit acting and come work at the department of human services in Chattanooga, TN. Anyway, I think I asked her about Nico. She was really short in my dream. She looked up at me with sad eyes and told me he was married, he had a kid and his wife was pregnant with another. My heart broke lol. I was so sad.

I was still in school, living at grandma's. Tonya was over. There were other people in the room. I think I might have been feeling sad. She comes and whispers in my ear that everyone loves my ass. Every guy and even the girls at school. I tell her to come up to my room so we can discuss it because I was kind of confused and wanted to hear more about it. She said it again. Everyone was enchanted by it. I then told her how I had heard Blake Simmons talking about it one day in tenth grade. Then I told her about my dream where I was walking around in a building with my red heels on and how I knew they made my ass look awesome.

I was at Grandma's house. I was sitting downstairs with Grandma, Grandpa and Aunt Leigh Ann. I think Kim called me and asked if I would babysit for her. I told her I couldn't. She said fine and that she would call me the next day because we had already planned something. The next day comes and I never hear from her. I know it's because she's pouting that I told her I couldn't babysit. There was more to the dream but I can't remember it now.

I was with mom and a few other people. We were apartment hunting. We found this one but it was a ridiculous amount. I want to say it was something stupid like $600,000. Mom really liked it even though it wasn't that great to me. Turns out all of that money was for the whole building. I remember walking through one apartment in particular. The apartments outside had vomit on them. I'm pretty sure the vomit was from someone I knew. The whole dream was just very sad and depressing. It seems like we were talking about Tiffany and her drug problem and about how she wasn't going to be alive much longer.

I was at a house that was my house, but didn't look at all like my house. There was some kind of party happening. People were everywhere. I had holed myself up in what looked like an office type room. It was very white. I was just sitting there slightly spinning in the chair. Nico walked in and stood in the door. We started talking. About anything and everything. Hours went by and we were flirting and talking. I was over the moon by this point. I walked out of the room for some reason, but he knew I would be back. The next thing I know, I'm holding a Keurig coffee maker and I hand it to him. It was like the best thing I could have given anyone. He was over the moon about it.

I can only remember bits and pieces. I'm pretty sure at some point I gave a sad Will Smith a hug. Nico was there. We had been flirting the whole time we were shopping. I don't know what we bought, but I do know we were both holding bags of groceries when we were looking for the car. I feel like we may have kissed, but I can't actually remember it. I was telling someone about the show Miranda I had been watching. It wasn't Nico because being from England he already knows about it. It was probably mom. The whole dream just had this happiness to it. It's hard to explain, but I felt like my life was perfect at that moment.

I can't remember much. I know I was at my Grandmother's house like I was getting ready for school or something. I don't know if I was 17 again living there. My aunt was living there like she does now, so it's almost like I combined both time periods. I remember having to pee really bad and every time I would get up to go something would distract me or get in my way.

I was myself, but I was Rae. I was sitting at a table with Finn/Nico and we were talking about sex. How I wasn't ready, but I still wanted to get him off. He told me he wanted me to come too. I remember rocking my chair back and mom was in the living room. Not sure why I did that. I guess I didn't want her to hear our conversation. She couldn't so we kept talking. I told him I wanted to give him a handjob and that he didn't have to return the favor. He looked me dead in the eye and told me he wanted to touch me while I was touching him and he wanted us to come together. Wanted to see me come. I fucking melted.

I was in my room. I think I had just woke up. I could hear Florence and the Machine blasting from the living room. I don't know who I thought would be in there, but I walk in and Daryl is sitting there watching a concert of hers on the television. It shocked the shit out of me. I started singing and then I just walked back to my room and lied back down.

I was sitting near one of the entrances inside the mall. I was there alone. I was just people watching. I looked over as someone was about to walk out. They were tall, had brown hair, wearing a blue hoodie and they were on the phone. It only took about .001 seconds to realize it was John, one of my best friends from high school. I guess it was like real life and I hadn't seen him in 8 years. I didn't want him to see me, but I knew if I got up really fast and took off he definitely would. I kind of sank down in my chair a little and looked the other way. I heard, "Amber!" Of course he had seen me. He came over and sat down with me. We sat there for a while a talked a little about everything. I can't remember what we talked about only that I was really happy that we did. I woke up before we were done.

Since it's been two days ago I can't remember much. The main part of the dream was that I was painting the bathroom. I don't think I asked anyone if I could, I just did it. It went from a green color to a dark navy blue. That's mostly what I remember, being surrounded by blue. I do recall at one point not being myself. I was watching myself talk to Daryl from a corner.

I don't remember much. I can't tell what happened first, but the only things I can remember are that Jessica and I were sitting in my living room. I was over at the computer desk and she was on the couch in front of the window. For some reason we were talking about Twilight and I mentioned how much I hate it. She said she actually didn't think they were too bad. There was also a part where I was at some house I've never been and there were people standing around. It was really bright and sunny in the house. I don't know who was standing by me. There was a little blonde headed boy running around. He came up to me and called me mommy. It surprised me, but no one else in the house seemed surprised by it.

I started out at the mall. I was wandering around. I don't remember too many details of this part. If I can remember more I will come back later. I was then looking at some sort of facebook type website, looking at pictures of Tonya and apparently she had just had a baby. Then, I was actually at the house the pictures were taken at with a group of people. Her husband was a police officer (which I don't believe is true) and he was sitting outside with his partner in the police car.

I was in some strange apartment, but in the dream I knew where I was. I was sitting in the living room with a few people. I'm not sure who they were. Maybe mom, Brent and a few other people. We weren't watching TV or anything, but we knew there were tornado warnings out. Out of the blue we all run to the bedroom that was farthest back into the building. We were about to run into the bathroom that was in the bedroom when I looked up. The room didn't have a ceiling and I could see straight up into the sky. At first I only saw a few clouds. Slowly a funnel started forming. I freaked out. I was screaming and yelling that a tornado was forming right above us. I was so scared I couldn't move. I wanted to run, but I couldn't. Before it hit the ground I woke up.

I am in Rosedale with Shane. We're walking down 233rd St, when we see Wyatt Cenac walking out of a house. He's wearing a green jacket and chucks. He looks at us once, then does a double take before walking. Shane tells me he had sex with someone. The looking back the second time confirmed it.

I'm in a hotel room with my younger siblings. We're going on a trip and I've volunteered to drive. But I don't know how to drive! Shane is going to teach me how to drive. Then we're in another place and we notice my mother and father are missing. Some people go into a "strip club" and then are kicked out. There's a raid. I think my parents are being held hostage. I tell my siblings we need to get out as soon as possible. There's a woman who wants me to stay. But I think she's a "zombie." Whenever she approaches me, I scream at her and threaten her with violence.

I'm at my grandmother's house. She's at the hospital. My mother tells me that she only has seven weeks to live. We're all devastated. I tell everyone that we should clean the entire house before she returns. I then decide to write in my notebook about asking her all the questions I wanted to, before she passed. I cry.

I'm in Grenada, downtown area. There's a store that sells beautiful things and also cuts black people's hair. I see a beautiful and large green bag. It's $91. I buy it. I see some Mexican kids wanting to get their hair done. The stylist said they don't work on straight hair. Now I'm transported into a room with people. A music video plays. I thought it was Aaliyah. It's not. It's fresh music, but sounds slightly 80s. I make a pact with my friends.

I finally hear back from Jay. He apologizes for the extreme delay and wants to get to work as quickly as possible. I grill him because I am (understandably) upset. He tells me that he'd had an affair with a white girl, about 19. He produces many letters, which are multi-colored. I see photos. I get angry. But all I can think about is making money asap!

I'm at Anthony Matz's house, doing the domination thing. I look at the time and realize that I'm going to miss the next train. He gives me an extra $30 tip. I'm happy. I forget to buy a ticket and hop on the train. He does too. I have two plastic bags and a plastic bin with a blue top. When I get to the front of the train, I realize I don't have my bin. I keep trying to tell the conductor, but he doesn't care, just about the tickets. Anthony and I will have to get on the next train. But we end up staying. We get on a bus somewhere. I'm searching up and down for my bin but nothing. I ask the driver, who's stepped off the bus. Some Asian Girl says that my delivery was rude. I said I wasn't.

I'm in a large studio or loft. There are many sculptures and statues of naked women surrounding the room. A lot of people are walking around the room in amazement. I think my mother and Rosanna are there. I think I see Mayte there in a blue and white floral dress, but I pretend not to see her. I do see Malcolm Gladwell, though! I find out later that this is a funeral for Marie (I don't know who she is). I feel bad because I didn't know that. Then everyone in the room starts walking faster and faster in a circle. I'm confused , mad that nobody told me. When it's over, I'm sitting down with my family. I'm thinking about Marie and how amazing her life must have been. There's a back author there in a form-fitting red dress. I see her book on a chair. I see Hozier signing an autograph by a bench. I thought it was my paper, so OI reach over to get it, but it's not mine.

In an upstairs area that looks like a bus. I'm waiting til it's time to catch a bus downstairs. The time comes and I head down. On the stairs I realize that I didn't put my kindle, and two items I can't remember, in my backpack. I think that if I visualize that they're in there, then they will be when I open the pack at my destination. Then I lose faith that this will be the case and go back for them even though it could mean missing my bus.

I'm supposed to ink a comic page that shows Kirk and Spock in spacesuits using magnetic devices on their hands and knees to crawl up a curved metal corridor wall. Other artists are inking the same page. The image seems so silly to us, we think it's hilarious.

Working in a rich woman's house as a personal chef. I'm cooking a stew, but realize the sweet potatoes are in her freezer and that they've gone off. I also need green beans. I mention that we need these things. A voice keeps saying that sweet potato fries would be fine, but I insist that we need real, whole sweet potatoes. She gives me two loonies. I say I'm too far along with the stew to leave it now, so she grudgingly agrees to go buy the stuff. After the door closes behind her, I remember the loonies and go after her to ask if she wants them back. She doesn't answer, so I run to get the money from the kitchen. The rockin' part of Stairway to Heaven or Little Black Submarines is woven in somehow to this whole dream. I hope she'll get green beans, not peas. She reminds me of Sherry from the tarot class.

Joanne asks me if my phone is vegan. I'm not sure. I ask her how I can tell. Are there phones that definitely are, and is there a list? I then say that I'll get my next one used to avoid this problem. It's a big tablet phone that's hard to enter dreams on because it's hard to hold onto with one hand.

I'm at camp. I'm working on a painting project with Yvonne from St. Pats. She is also Applejack from MLP. I'm not sure how that works, it just is. She wants the poster we've been working on to be covered in protective paper and plastic. I start on that, and she leaves to do something else. I have trouble making the protective layer stick. The wind keeps blowing it off the painting. People are leaving, and I call to Yvonne for help. She doesn't answer, and I can't go looking for her because the protective stuff will blow away in the wind.

I see a plane, but it's not a plane. In the dream, I know what it is. It looks like it's going to land, but I'm nowhere near an airport so I wonder if it's going to crash. Then I'm in the mind of a cop who's flying a police craft and chasing after the plane thing. He's like Sundog -- hard bitten, but kind. A little craft zips by him. It's very maneuverable. He thinks to himself that it's an army surplus craft. I'm thrilled by this idea, and think what a cool writing universe this would be. The pilot of the small craft could be the love interest. The little ship is like an ambulance chaser, waiting to see what will happen.

I'm placed inside a cylindrical chamber with white walls. It's a device of some kind and I'm shown how it works. Then I'm taken out and let go, with a warning not to try and rebel against these people because I'll end up wishing I was dead. I'm given a pair of scissors and told to slash my wrists before they catch me, or I will be sorry.

I'm on a quest with a company of people like Lord of the Rings. It is discovered that there is a little purple octopus creature that is actually a magical spy who's been stowed away in someone's pack. Our medicine woman forces it to swallow its own tentacles, thus choking itself. Then she takes pity, and does something to reform it instead. Then I'm on a farm, or a camp-like area that has a lot of buildings and cabins that remind me of Pioneer Pacific. Everyone there is shocked by the appearance of dead animals of all different species elaborately posed in all the bunks. Ozzy and Sharon Osbourne and their son are in one of the bunks too, for some reason, but I think they're just posing, not dead. I then hear, like the voice of a news reporter announcing something after the fact, that at some point the animals all came back to life and walked away.

A black horse is trying to bite me. I've backed up in the narrow space between two cars, trying to get away from him, but the woman who's holding his rope keeps giving him more length so he can keep coming after me. I'm angry with her, and smack her. Then I decide to fuck her as "punishment." We get naked in a bedroom. She's wearing purple undies. I ask her where she keeps the lube, and she says in the bathroom. It turns out the "lube" is two different types of industrial silicone. She has several tubes of each kind -- a creamy type and an "icy" type. The tubes are white, blue and orange. I try both types on my finger. She calls out to me that she likes the icy one better.

Three middle aged women buy fancy sex toys, and gleefully take them to their respective homes to rate and review them. One woman's toy looks hilariously like a bong. Another's looks even *more* like a bong, to the point where she's afraid her teenage son might try to smoke from it. The third woman's toy plays loud, cheesy music that's supposed to be erotic. They all find this hysterical, and end up meeting up again and one of their houses. Her teenage daughter has bought some plates from a salesperson, along with a "Five Year Cake," a cake that's supposed to last up to 5 years. It's chocolate with mint icing and is totally stale. The saleswoman gets in a fight with her own teenage daughter in front of the first three ladies. The daughter angrily tells her mom that this sex toy sales gig isn't working out, they're broke, and that the mom needs to think about getting a "real" job.

I'm in a dentist chair, but not to see the dentist. It's a Full Moon meditation, and different herbs are being applied to each of my chakra points. A woman sets up most of them, but then a guy puts an amber bottle of lavender oil under my neck. The bottle has square edges and feels hard and uncomfortable. He tells me that the oil is fish derived. I disagree, since obviously it's just lavender. I feel like he's trying to upset me. It's a timed meditation, and supposed to go on for ten minutes. I feel stressed about the deadline, and can't concentrate. I get up in the middle of the meditation to look for my purple yoga mat.

This is one of those epic dreams of which I can remember only a tiny amount. It's a long, complex tale of a small group of people surviving in a zombie universe. The "world" of the dream is blue-gray in color. I remember torches, and the survivors working on an antidote.

This is a fragment from a much longer dream, but is all I can remember. I see a young girl who looks Indian, firing two pistols into the air. She seems to be doing this playfully. Her friends watch her do this, and see that she has run out of ammo. She is unarmed, and I somehow know that her "friends" will later take advantage of this fact in order to rape her. I feel sick but there is nothing I can do. I notice a pond with some ducks or geese behind her while she is shooting, and I'm relieved that they are unhurt and seem unafraid, despite the loud noise.

I've ripped the plastic "skin" from a Homer Simpson doll. I wash it and hang it in the shower to dry, hoping to sell it on ebay. Apparently it's a collector's item, providing I can keep it in perfect condition.

There's an old rich dude who's a real asshole. Some people break into his apartment looking for something... papers, maybe. Someone cuts out a section of his white shag carpet, and it comes to life like a dog. It's super affectionate. The police arrive while I'm hiding in the apartment with the dog.

I've put a couple (tiny, like the figures on a wedding cake, only real; he's in a suit or tux and she's in a long 1950's style dress) in a jar, and placed it in the refrigerator. I flip a toggle switch, and some kind of process begins, then intensifies. I start to feel bad about it and end the process, not without difficulty. Then I'm explaining they are "still within their tree of life, but in a different part, and that they have been physically altered to suit different conditions than before. A guy summons his human to meet him on the shore. He and his friends are on a boat. The human is lean and brown and powerful, but his claws have been removed. His owner wants to try an experiment to see how well he will adapt.

I'm a young black boy, living in a compound where kids are being experimented on. We have all been treated with a substance that gives us paranormal abilities. Mine is flying. I am hovering high above a dirt road that leads into the compound, waiting for my father to return. It's a pleasant, pastoral scene with trees and rolling hills. There's another kid standing on the road below. He's a friend of mine, and has the gift of seeing things at a distance. He says that the driver of a car approaching from the distance is his dad, not mine. We are waiting to see who's right.

Long, epic dream, of which only fragments remain. It centers around a group of teenagers. One gets killed near the beginning of the story, and "my" character sees her ghost in a garden and receives a message from her that she later shares with her other friends. She feels guilty and responsible for the girl's death. There are are also monsters whom the characters have to fight. It all takes place on a hill, under a very dark sky. The whole dream has kind of a gothic atmosphere, very dark with glints of silver, white and dark blue.

"The woman with the dirty blond bowl cut is back." I have no idea what this means. I wake up thinking I may have dreamed of her before, but I'm not sure. I think she's supposed to be a doctor, but she looks like Mrs. Warner.

I'm trying on a jacket I had been planning to sew. Corinne says it doesn't look good on me, so I go without it. We are going to a high school party. I realize that most of the women there rented their dresses. I feel like I want to take a shower, but someone compliments my hair and I almost change my mind. Then I'm in a gum commercial. I drop all my gum, and a big, scary, gangster tough guy picks one up and demands more because it's soooooo good! I say I don't have any more, so he puts me in a head lock.

thin slices of those gigantic carrots are being used instead of bread slices to make sandwiches. This was part of a larger dream that I don't remember -- I mostly just recall the colourful sandwiches, which had something green inside of them, like kale perhaps.

I am a young, straight girl on a special "date" with my boyfriend. The date is to take place in what seems like a dormitory room with a wooden floor, a bunk, and a heap of messy clothes and boots on the floor. My friends are all there, and we dance like we're in a Bollywood dance class. Then, we are making plans to meet up around 10pm after all the "date" stuff (food and sex, presumably) is done with. Then I remark that I'm thinking of running for Vice President, because the VP doesn't really have to do anything other than collect a paycheck.

i'm at a resort in the mountains with my family. Luckily, I brought my own food; the resort provides nothing but steaks, corn soaked in butter, and some other animal-based item that I don't recall. In one scene, I'm giving Leo, Corinne's dad, an impassioned lecture on how to get along better with Gita. Don't criticize her, I say. Practice saying something nice, and no matter how tempted you are, don't follow it with a "but." Leave the room if you have to! Surprise, surprise, Leo seems unimpressed with my wise advice. I hear about a scam that's being run by a ski resort nearby. I can't recall the details, but it sounds outrageous to me.

There is a coop full of golden "Buff" chickens on the Whonnock property (in the area of the hosue were the formerly blue bathroom would normally be, I think). I open the door, and set the birds free. They fly up into the trees. Gazing up at them, I worry that they haven't gone far enough, and that they could be re-captured. Then I notice that there are still some little animals inside the coop. On closer inspection, they turn out to be tiny little tiger cubs. I feel terrible that I won't be able to rescue them, too.

In the dining room of the Whonnock house with Jeff and Taraya. They're both white. I think, "that's wrong," and make a point of glancing at my hands. My left hand is all melty and creepy looking. I 'm dreaming, I think, and bend down and rub my palms against the carpet. It's that awful gold shag carpet we used to have. I glance at my right hand, and it's all balloony. It makes me laugh to see it. Then everything goes dark. My eyes are closed. I try to open them, and feel my body lying in bed. I think to myself, "Stay lucid, stay lucid," but no luck. Then I'm with Jeff and Taraya again. Taraya is back to her normal colours, and we have a long bonding moment, like I wished I'd had with her in life.

On vacation in a beautiful place, possibly Mexico. Looking at all kinds of archaeological stuff. I'm fascinated by a huge, temple-like building that was built during the previous ascending Treta yuga, which would make it, I guess, around 20 thousand years old. We fly over the ruins. They're built from a reddish stone and have these huge towers on them. The temple looks beautiful washed in the golden light of late afternoon, surrounded by the green and teal mass of jungle. Then, on a beach, I'm looking at little stalls selling tacky, colorful things for tourists. Looking closely at one stall, I notice with regret that many of its items are made from animals.

I'm driving the car at night; the streets are wet but it's not raining. My foot slips off the brake, and I smash into the car ahead of me, which was stopped at an intersection. I blame my new shoes. They have crepe soles, which I think may be more slippery than the ones I'd normally wear. Corinne doesn't seem to be buying this excuse, and I feel really guilty.

Walking on the dikes again (like previous dream) but this time I'm with Corinne, her boss, and someone else she works with. It's a crisp, sunny winter day with a bit of mist rising. Corinne has fallen behind the rest of us and I'm talking to her boss. The subject of Toronto comes up, and I accidentally let slip that we're thinking of moving there. Then I realize that I shouldn't have said anything about that, and I try to backtrack by saying that it would be far in the future if it ever even happens. I feel horribly guilty and confess my mistake to Corinne, but she doesn't seem as upset as I expected.

I'm a teen living at home. I'd thought that Dad was dead, but then I get a letter from him. It's written in pencil, and his handwriting looks a little different than I remember. Mom admits that he is actually living in London with his new girlfriend, whom I coincidentally happen to know. I'm glad he's alive, but I feel a great sense of responsibility about whether or not to share this knew knowledge. I tell Ted, but feel unsure about whether I should tell Megan. I seek Mom's advice as we walk along the dikes together.

An experiment is taking place in which a small brown pig is taken on walks on a leash half the time, and in another condition, he's allowed to roam around the city unattended the rest of the time. Not sure what the point of all this was, but it seemed to make sense while I was dreaming it!

A young man with curly, light brown hair is covering the evidence of two murders he's just committed. The weapons were a pink dog leash (like Izzy's) and some other innocuous item that I wasn't able to recall on waking. He puts the items into a drawer, where they are normally kept. There's a bucket involved too, somehow, and a messy pile of objects (laundry?) on the floor that he restores to a messy state (I guess they somehow got tidied up during the murders?) He is very cool and collected throughout. He has absolutely no concern about being caught. I feel that someone is waiting for him to finish these preparations. This person knows about the murders, but will never tell. I'm an over-the-shoulder observer in this dream: the murderer is the main character, and I'm following him around and hearing his thoughts as if he's a character in a book that I'm reading.

I'm listening to a vegan punk band and writing them a fan letter. There seems to be someone else in the dream, though I have no recollection of who they are or what they look like. I'm asking this mysterious person the name of one particular band member, with the observation that he "sounds handsome." Wryly, I add that I realize what a very reliable way that is of judging someone's attractiveness.

This was a long, involved dream, but on waking I could only remember a few scattered images. There was a dog, who I knew to be adopted, who looked like a jack russell terrier. There was a green, oval field that resembled a running track, but which I knew was actually a baseball field. There were bleachers in the field. There was an image of pulling a blanket over myself. And there was a woman in the dream who might have been Lisa, but I can't be sure. I wish I could remember more.

I and a group of people are driving past a Christian school that has a bus outside. It's mostly yellow, but has Jesus-themed graphics of some sort painted on the side. We drive past before we can see what the images are, and/or what the message says, and have to turn around. This is difficult to do, as we are driving a huge, clumsy vehicle. We pull into a parking lot and manage to get turned around just as the Jesus bus is pulling away.

I hear an awful story about a four year old pet bear being sent to slaughter. Evidently, there is a slaughterhouse for bears! It's sad and tragic, though I don't remember the details beyond that. An image goes with the story of the bear playfully showing his teeth, and his mouth looks like a shark's. There's another, cuter photo of him as well. I feel very sad about it.

I'm going to a Christmas party at my boss's house (not my boss in real life, just *a* boss), and I manage to spill my coffee, complete with generous amounts of soymilk, all over her couch. It's a dark gray-blue colour and the coffee soaks right in. A coworker of mine starts mopping it up before I can get to it, and I feel guilty both for spilling the coffee and for someone else cleaning it up.

I'm on a city sidewalk with Isabelle. It's breezy, and there's a homeless guy with bare feet. He has whitish fungus growing on his feet and other extremities, and flakes of it blow off in the breeze. They get on Izzy and her pink leash. I'm also concerned that I may have breathed some in. As I try to clean the leash, Corinne tells me that I've been really careless and I feel guilty.

I'm shown two illustrations of dwapara and treta yugas. Each shows a girl drawn in chibi style, a bit like the Karmavore logo, surrounded by various items representing her respective yuga. The treta version is seafoam green and vermillion, and the dwapara version is in teal and crimson. The colour examples provided by dreamboard are just approximations, unfortunately...

Haunting, anime-like scene of a girl and boy walking through a field of yellow grass that comes up to their chins. It's misty, and close to nightfall. A third person is with them -- is it me? I seem to be drifting alongside them, and I'm afraid of getting separated and lost in the fog.

Megan and I are talking about Yami. Megan has a strong feeling that Konoe should have a girlfriend. (My dreaming mind supplied me with an image of Konoe, though I couldn't recall his name -- I think we were both calling him "Smedley." LOL) I counter her suggestion, arguing that he is the only character who's established as for-sure gay. Which isn't true as far as I can remember -- but interesting discussion!

I'm in the gravel parking lot at a wooded park. I'm picking up bits of deadfall -- twigs, branches, dead leaves. A very condom-like white plastic bag snaps loose from a clump of yellowed grass, slaps itself onto my hand, and sticks there. I'm totally grossed out. There's a crew who are chopping down a dead tree, one piece at a time, with axes. I think it's sad that the tree has to go, but one of the crew explains that it's necessary -- the tree is dead, and is becoming a danger -- and I have to agree with him.

I have a record player at work, and plan to listen to LPs all day. My headphone cord isn't long enough, so I balance the record player on my head. This makes it hard for me to see my work, so I resign myself to a day without music. It's an old portable player, the kind that comes in its own little suitcase. The base is reddish brown and the lid is cream coloured.

I'm at a lawyers office, or something similar. A couple of people (notaries? paralegals?) are looking at my will and seem very disturbed by something in it. I go to look and see what the problem is, and they point out that my birth date and my "trans birth date" are both filled out with something that isn't just wrong, but is completely incomprehensible. I want to explain that I'm not even trans, but the people leave the room before I can say anything. They seem to have a tut-tutting, "how can you not be ashamed" attitude, but I can't figure out what I could have done that they think is so bad.

I'm looking through old boxes and suitcases full of clothes. There are lots of glittery party clothes and old makeup in shimmery, glittery colours. They're from my teenager-hood, and some are my sister's and some are mine. I feel like I'm ready to let go of this stuff now that I've taken the time to look through it all.

There's a guy like Sajid from "Lost," and a girl who looks like Shannon but is much gigglier. She's been away for a long time, but comes back and wants to have sex with him. He's not into it. Then the whole thing switches to a bar scene. It's being filmed, and the extras are being told to react in amazement when the light twin (Jacob, I guess) changes from a boy into a man and embraces the dark one, who came to threaten him. I'm a disembodied observer throughout.

I and someone else are looking at a larg bat clinging to the inside of a screen door. We're not sure that it's a bat on first glance, but then I notice the way he's holding the screen mesh with his thumbs. Then I notice a second, smaller bat who is also inside the screen door. We slide the door open, though I'm afraid of leaving the door open with the lights on inside, as I fear the light could attract even more bats who'd end up trapped inside. Then I'm outside the house and down a walkway, and there's a night-time party going on.

There are these church buildings that are each based on a different shape, or geometry, such as the piscea. Corinne and I are standing outside one and being told that they don't support themselves, but should. Corinne says she'll stop donating to one. (OMG, I have NO idea what that was about! LOL)

I was Colleen Patrick Goudreau in this dream, though evidently I was actually her stupid, angry, totally out-of-character alter ego because I had given two animals -- Gypsy and Taraya -- to a very flaky girl to take care of. In a conversation with this person, the girl casually mentions that she had the animals "euthanized" because she got a white persian cat who matches her furniture better. I (as "Colleen") am furious. I yell at her and castigate her, and at one point I kick her. But after I kick her, I see that she's turned into a little dog who looks like Isabelle, and is cowering against the wall. I feel sick and awful.

Corinne is waxing the kitchen floor. It's not our kitchen, but a much larger one in a house. It looks like the kitchen from the house where I spent my childhood, and the floor is dark brown vinyl "linoleum" with fake tiles, just like the floor in Mom's kitchen. I feel we're supposed to go somewhere in a few minutes, and I'm pulling on my jeans which are next to what seems like a small table -- almost like a shrine -- with bright flowers on it. Then I remember that I need to shower before I can go anywhere. I also realize that we've been walking on the floor, leaving footprints in the wax. I mention to C that you're not supposed to walk on the floor until the wax dries, but it's too late. I'm picking through a Whole Foods takeout container of stirfry vegetables, trying to put together a dinner for Isabelle.

I'm trying to get to my Tarot class, but I left home too late and so have missed the second bus that would take me to class on time. The next bus that comes along will only go part of the way there. It drives painfully slowly, and I feel tremendous impatience riding it. It stops at a shopping mall, and I get out and try to call for a cab.

I and a bunch of other people are supposed to inventory a large amount of wine and beer. It's all stored in what seems like a random order, so our first task is to reorganize it all. We work quickly as a team, and begin singing a song as we work. I seem to know the song really well, and am singing it with gusto. It might be a song from a movie (Rocky Horror Picture Show?), but on waking I can't remember what it is.

I'm going to what I think is a yoga class, but it turns out to be a surgery. The patient has a large incision from a previous surgery that had gotten badly infected. I watch as the surgeon re-opens the incision, which runs down the front of the woman's body and is very swollen, and begins pulling out fistfuls of gelatinous, dark brown stuff. It's kind of gross, but I feel strangely detached from the proceedings.

In a high alpine meadow, I'm shown a patchwork tent, or dome, made of multi-colored, brightly patterned fabrics sewn together. Each fabric represents a part of my spiritual experience or development, or a lifetime in which I grew spiritually. Then I'm shown another patchwork dome about four times the size of mine, and I'm told this is the dome that would belong to a spiritual master. I feel uplifted and encouraged by this. The message seems to be, "You're on the right track, keep going."

There's a man with a bird coop sitting out on the boulevard. It's full of baby birds he's trying to sell. I want to rescue them without paying him (and therefore helping him profit from it), so I ask if there are any birds in particular whom he thinks he won't be able to sell. There is one: a little brown hen. There's also a woman who's saying that you should always buy three pigs at a time, so that when you kill one the survivor still has one friend left. She thinks this is "humane," and I wonder how she can think this.

Add-on to previous (I woke up, then fell asleep again only to have this dream continue! Ugh.) A man is chopping or digging at the root of a tree. He says he thinks the guys at the farm are up to no good -- and red stuff splatters into his face as he says this. Apparently the murder of the two women is part of a black magic ceremony intended to kill a senator. The women will be killed at a particular time near the end of this ritual, which is supposed to go on for weeks. Until then they are at the mercy of their captors, who have simply been hired to keep them at the farm and can do whatever they like with them.

Two female joggers are kidnapped off a trail by two guys who are both experienced murderers and have decided to team up. The women are lovers, based on a couple from the series "Lip Service." Their abductors take them to a mossy farm and force them to have sex. One of them has been in this situation before, back in college.

Theres a robot whos really good at looking human, and passes among us without question. It's on a cop show, like Law and Order. The robot is blond and looks a bit like Max Headroom, or the robot butler on Red Dwarf. In one scene he comes home and takes his human face off but we only see him from the back. There's another where something is going on with the cops, some kind of crisis, and they meet at the robot's place. He is out of uniform and we see his metallic body with a human head on top. I think this is inconsistent with the earlier scene, and I feel frustrated watching it. There's something, too, about a surgeon who is giving someone an operation without anaesthetic, at their request. I have the role of the patient in that scene. I'm a man named "Gary," and I'm friends with the surgeon. In another scene, a woman is describing the robot running, and it runs in a very stiff, un-humanlike way.

Mom, Corinne and I are going to a beach with the dogs. Laurie and Julie are three. Julie is wearing a vermilion bikini. She flops down on a towel and demands that Laurie put suntan lotion on her back, which pretty much figures.

Image of a wooden toothpick with a red cellophane doodad on the end, like they use for cocktails and such. Apparently they are in danger of being discontinued, so there will be no more of them. I can't find mine, so I have to search for it.

Just a fragmentary image before waking. I see a female figure walking slowly. She isn't really visible, just the halo of rainbow light surrounding her body. The coloured light trails behind her in "clouds of glory," as my dreaming mind terms them. Then I wake.

Walking around with Corinne and my brother. Wondering if I can get back the amazing camera that someone gave me a long time ago, but that I never learned how to properly use. It's spring, and the trees are covered in flowers. In an alley, I notice a reddish pink tree with pinkish purple flowers.

I'm on a trip to Boston, and take a bus ride to a nearby city. I get lost trying to take the bus back. I'm not sure which bus to take, or where to catch it. I ask a bus employee who is driving a grey PT Cruiser. I glance in the back seat and notice that instead of a seat, there is a small field of bright green grass with dandelions growing in it. I notice that the closest bus shelter isn't a bus shelter at all, but a moss-covered shack. The man offers me a ride. I accept after making him promise that he isn't a psycho. We shake hands on this agreement. (OMG)

I'm talking to a food blogger I'm apparently a fan of. She has a large white dog, to whom she has given a tennis ball to play with. We're doing some kind of food thing; I'm chopping beets and pretending like I have amazing knife skills, trying to impress her. Then the dog makes a noise behind us. I turn and see that his face looks all puffy and his eyes are teary, as if he's in distress. I realize he's swallowed the ball. I feel horrified and guilty that I didn't notice sooner, that we gave him the ball and then paid no attention to what he was doing. I call animal emerg to find the nearest vet so we can rush him there. The food blogger then says *she's* a vet and can handle the situation, but I'm not sure if I believe or trust her.

Corinne and I are at an open house. It's a house out in the 'burbs somewhere and has worn beige carpet throughout. I think the carpet is nasty and I don't like the idea of living in the 'burbs but we're trying to get an idea of what we could afford. There is a large storage area underneath the stairs, and we and some other house-lookers comment on this as we climb to the second floor. One couple is actually crawling into this crawl space, though I, being grossed out by the idea of touching that carpet, am content to simply take a peek. When I get upstairs, Corinne is coming out of one of the bedrooms. She says (sarcastically) that it seems romantic on first glance with the cute, round window that looks like a porthole, until you glance through the window and see a dead crow hanging from a tree branch just outside.

I'm returning something (papers, I think) to Michael Yule, the realtor. He's in a hotel lobby behind a curved desk covered in iridescent tan-colored tiles. A fountain nearby is covered in the same tiles. Izzy might be there but I'm not sure. Corinne seems to be there, somewhere in the background. Michael is as upbeat and friendly as always. Once my business with him is done, I turn to Corinne and suggest that now we've completed this task, we could do some Xmas shopping and get it done a year early! It didn't seem too severe; it might have even been still in the mall but I felt like we were on the floor. Some restaurant owners were being very nice. One must have given us pizza, I guess, because another gave us a plate with pizza (cheese, pepperoni, and another topping, I think) with some other items and I asked everyone which pizza they liked better. Everyone said the current plate we were eating but I said although it's a better overall pizza, especially the texture of the crust, it was very bland and there was a weird aftertaste to it. Then they agreed enthusiastically with me.

Pat and I were in bed trying to do it but I couldn't cum. We were going at it for a while but he was getting frustrated, even though I was enjoying it, and he gave up. We got interrupted a couple time throughout by different Jersey Shore cast members. First was Snooki, possibly the Situation, then Ronnie. When Snooki was there, I got mad because I felt like Pat was only doing it a certain way to put on a show.

Cindy and I were watching some show (in real life, not TV). Some amateur cheerleaders (maybe HS) were doing a short routine but at the end, one of them, who was propped up several stories by the others, did some crazy flip sideways and then back (impossible - sort of like a boomerang) and onto a super-high stilted chair. The chair almost fell sideways but they managed to catch it and perform the stunt successfully. I remember Cindy and I both being scared during that moment the chair tipped; I was really concerned for their safety.

I was working at DDB again, briefing Dan and Kimb in on an assignment. I was super buddy-buddy with them, especially Dan. When they were done with the project, it was really good; I was genuinely impressed with what they'd done.

Dad was about to tell the family the story about when he was raped in prison. [Never mind the fact that he's never even been close to being imprisoned in real life.] WTF?? He started the story but he never got to finish. At some point he mentioned trying to look for or do something for one of his four or five godsons. [Again, no recognition of this in real life.] At another point in the dream he got shot in his ass (Forrest Gump style). I saw him facedown on the bed with his butt exposed (though it wasn't gross or anything in the dream). Another man was next to him in the bed -- an uncle or ninong type figure -- clearly some confidante to dad who we knew in the dream.

Mom came back from PI. She seemed older than when she left. The rest of the fam was running around doing productive things but I was in bed, feeling really sleepy but guilty at the same time. Mom came to the bed and we cuddled a little bit, even while feeling guilty. Dad may have been lecturing me about something.

I was giving some guy a BJ/HJ. He was sitting and I was more in a kneeling position. I really liked his dick; it was really fat and even rounded out towards the middle. Yes, this is strange but since it was a dream, it was fine.

I was offered a magic deal. If I found a way to get rich in the first three months, I would be set financially for the rest of the year. It would reset every year. I kept asking questions to clarify the deal I was planning a get rich scheme while others had more measured plans. Cindy Mark was in the last part of the dream. He seemed very confident.

In another part of my dream, Pat and I were running/trying to survive something. I don't remember what anymore. Details are gone. At some point, I got sprayed by a skunk on my left calf but it was also poisonous. It burned. Then I got into an altercation with a couple. I was getting ready to box the lady, jumping and dancing around.

I was at a bar and as I was about to leave, I saw some younger PSA folks at a long table near the window. I remember Angelica being there at the end. We talked for a little bit. I can't remember if she was the one was aight but not exactly personable. I made my way down the table and when I saw Abet, she was uncharacteristically in a frumpy blue floral dress. As I was about to say "hi," an entourage walked in. She screamed the name of some Pilipina stage star (similar to Lea Salonga) and ran off to meet her. I think she turned around briefly to apologize and I said it was fine because I reacted the same way about Lea, even though I was initially annoyed. The next person down the table was a taller Pinoy whom I'd never met before. I forgot his real name but he went by Whiting or Whitey. Something like that. Odd.

I was at Starbucks at some point and ordered a Grande Vanilla Rooibos. I stumbled a little on words as I ordered. I met a girl who was from New Zealand. She was possibly the barista. We connected because I told her I used to live in Australia. I had trouble getting the message across the first time. Later in the dream, the two of us were hanging out together with a male friend of hers (I'm assuming). He was driving, I was in the passenger seat, and she was in the backseat. It was a convertible and I suggested that we roll the top down.

Alhaji and I were pretty buddy-buddy in my dream. I hugged him, very low; my intentions were friendly. But he stated out loud that I was turning him on (which is something Pat would say). There was sexual tension but I didn't technically cheat on Pat. I resisted it.

I was prepping to perform a dance with Allana, LJ (Ling Jun from Kellstadt), and another girl who looked like Magda (Szumlakows?ka from Kellstadt). Her hair was similarly curly. Despite my attempts to get her to engage, the Magda girl was being uncooperative and I think we ended up performing without her.

I was responsible for something or someone - a child perhaps. It required me being strategic and stealthy at times. Towards the end of the dream, I started going somewhere; I was supposed to follow someone (in cars?) but lost them.

Can't remember details anymore but it was a lot of roaming around, figuring out what we wanted to do, just hanging out, mostly with Allana. At some point, I remember sitting around and Cindy was sitting in front of me. Sonia (from HS) was there but we were all coo.

I was in a venue where I could walk from show to show. One was possibly a Common concert. I bounced around for a bit until word got out that the police were coming to raid (not sure why). They were looking to catch anyone. I scrambled around but was too late and was spotted. I climbed a building/structure to hide but could still be seen from the ground. I was surrounded and the police was talking to me through a loudspeaker because I didn't want to come down. Eventually, they got Pat to convince me to come down. I agreed because I trusted that Pat would know what to do best in that situation.

Nana and I are in a doctor's waiting room. She is well and strong. There is a girl there watching a television program called 'the weird 90s.' The episode is of a group of swimmers, one is racist and hates swimming in the lane as a black woman in front of him.
