It started out with my old high school P.E. teacher announcing to a lot of people a new game where a large basketball was to be bounced into a huge crowd of people. This basketball was fifty times the size of a regular one. I was on the periphery of the crowd with my friends. I actually was able to bounce the ball back into the crowd once. Everyone is having a great time until somebody gets seriously hurt. I see a disturbance in the crowd and then hear far away murmurs of distress. The ambulance is called. Blame begins to be placed on my P.E. teacher. Next, I see a man deciding to commit suicide so that he can go into afterlife. He covers his head with a red cloth and shoots himself, I see blood splattered on the ground.

In my dream I was in a classroom at my middle school. A meeting was coming to a close. It was a work meeting. Everyone was about to leave, most of my co-workers were standing around. I remember only two co-workers specifically. One was my assistant manager, who kept repeating that I needed to bring something important to the next meeting. As she talked to me, I ate two bags of chips quickly. The first one was Cheetos. I also drank a large glass of soda with it. I started on the second bag as I walked home, it was also accompanied by another glass of soda. The house I walked to isn't my current home. It was our previous house that was just down the block from my old middle school. The day (weather) was dark and cloudy. I went downstairs to get a drink because I was very thirsty. I remember that the snack was very satisfying.

I started dreaming about a pain in my nose. I had some sort of surgery to fix it and then I went back to somewhat normal activities. I dreamt I was helping my family move again, but my nose really hurt.
I dreamt about being married and a mom. I don't know who I was married to, and the kids weren't around, but I knew they existed because of all the toys and clothing lying around. I was really happy.

I dreamt that I was at home just spending time with my family. I joked with my sisters, went shopping with my mom, and just relaxed at home. Another dream I had was about a typical day here at school. I went to my classes, work, etc.

I was at the airport and decided to take a bus back to Santa Clara. There were a lot of people on the bus already, and I sat in the only open seat next to a girl about my age. I soon realized that the majority of the people on the bus were all together and were all a little strange. The bus pulled into its first stop at a mental hospital and I put it all together. But then the bus driver announced that we had to wait for the next group of passengers. They were eating lunch and would be there in twenty minutes. So I got off the bus and started to walk around. All the people there seemed really nice but they all had their problems. When the group started to board again, they wouldn't let me go back on. They were calling me by a different name and told me to go to check-in to get my room. They wouldn't let me explain who I was and that I shouldn't be there. They started to drag me to my room.

I dreamt and it was basically a replay of the movie Scream 3. But this time my friends and I were in it somehow. I remember being terrified in the dream but I wasn't scared. It was like I was playing a character and I was watching myself. Subconsciously I knew it was all pretend. In the end my friends and I lived and helped catch the killer.

I had a series of dreams that involved one of my closest guy friends. In my dreams we were talking about our relationship, discussed our feelings for one another, talked about being more than friends. But we never came to a conclusion. Then I dreamt that we were married and had a family.

I dreamt I was at an outdoor type of event/play. I was there to watch my sisters. We were sitting towards the top of a hill to watch and then we moved closer so we could see better. My aunt and I went to the bathroom, which was down the street. While we were waiting in line, some teenage boys began harassing us. They exposed themselves to us and then left. We laughed at them then went back to our seats. When we got there it started to rain, and an umbrella appeared from nowhere.

I was walking through Benson, and I saw my high school ASB moderator. She said hi, she had to run to a meeting, but would talk to me later. Then a guy that goes here walked up to me, introduced himself to her and then she left, we went to class in market square. It was like high school and college were one.

My family and I were going to see my little brother in a play. I met up with my boyfriend there and we went to the front of the theater to sit with my dad's side of the family. After a few minutes, I got up and left with my best friend Vero. We were going to cross the street to get to her car, and I almost got hit by a car. We rushed to Vero's car and the lady that almost hit me came back. We sped off and went to this basketball tournament. I met a couple of new people, and I was looking around at some of the team's announcement boards and they were weird teams like Mealworms and Crickets. I saw this guy I know from school and I talked to him real fast. I met this girl and she was looking for her shirt, which ended up under my arms because I was bending over the bench and writing something.

The main setting for this dream was my dorm, except it was bigger and the bottom floor was more like a family recreation center. I was walking around it. It was pretty bright, but on an erase board in the kitchen, there was my name and another boy's name on it. I walked to a different room and this younger girl was there with a big rectangular plate of cookies. She gave me one, and then a different kind. I remember walking around a little more and hanging out a little more. Then I had to go to the bathroom so I walked in and there were about seven girls in there. It was so full. I went into one stall and this girl was standing on the seat waiting for a different stall to be open. I think three of us sat on one seat at the same time. This one girl came in and saw that it was so crowded that she just went on the floor.

Last night I dreamt that I was a big movie star, but at first I didn't know I was acting. It started off with a bunch of people in an interview room and this ex-serial killer was being interviewed. My husband was Denzel Washington. Throughout the interview the mad man kept looking at me. When he was describing his killings he walked right up to me. Denzel was very worried and limped over to me and knelt down on the floor saying he didn't want anything to happen to me. I held him and comforted him. Then he and I left and we had just purchased a brand new dark green SUV for our country house. As we were driving off, the mad man came running next to us and he had a knife. This is when I realized it was a movie because he was supposed to slice my arm but my window wasn't far down enough. The driver of the car was now Tom Cruise. We had to take a break so they could fix the window, and so we went to the room where all of the other actors and extras were, and a lot of my family was there. That's where I learned I was Julia Roberts, but I still looked like me. While in the big room, there was food (tortillas, fajitas, shrimp, rolls), but I didn't eat. Instead my cousin Beth helped me to pick out new sandals. They had really high heels, but were comfy. I tried on three pairs. I looked in the mirror. She also wanted me to buy a hat. There were also purses on sale on the wall and they had pictures of my family/relatives when they were younger. While in line to get food, it was so hot and I was wearing a thick black dress. Without thinking, I lifted it up a little and then all of these people took pictures. There wasn't that much food left so I had one bite.

First we were in a classroom here, but it wasn't here. Then, I was with some family and friends. My dad was driving a big fire truck, and he drove it into a little shop in my hometown in Texas. The shop was tiny and sold antiques and souvenirs. Kelsey Grammer (Frasier) was the owner and he was there working. We looked around and all of a sudden I worked there. I was getting white tissue paper from a high shelf and a customer came to help me. He was older than I and cute! It was Kelsey's birthday, so there was a small party and there were red plastic cups and for some reason we were sitting around lab tables. Everyone was throwing around cherries and at first I wasn't going to, but then I did. Kelsey had had a stressful day and someone didn't get him roses, so he wasn't enjoying himself that much.

Last night I dreamt that first I was at my grandparents' house and then we all of a sudden were at my great-aunt's house. It was my little brother, my first cousin, and I. When we were at her house, we were mainly on her front porch. I remember that there was a handkerchief that I kept trying to put on my head, and I was getting a little frustrated, but I kept trying to put it on right. An African-American couple and their child kept passing by. Before I left, I told my cousin Beth that her and I would do something the next day. Next, I remember that my boyfriend came to visit my school and we were walking together to eat in the cafeteria, but then he asked if I wanted to go out to eat, so I agreed.

This dream mainly dealt with the major event of the Academy Awards. I went with my mom and we parked her car outside and then went in and sat down. It was a low-key Academy Awards and the stage was a circular platform in the middle. I was paying attention, but it went by really fast. Two of my friends and I went up to receive an award and while we were up there, I thought about how my picture might come out in the paper. I was taller than most of the people. I remember looking down and seeing my big black sandals, which weren't that fashionable, but I liked them because they made me taller and I felt superior. We then sat down and watched the rest until the award for Best Actress was announced, and it was for Catherine Zeta-Jones, but for some reason, we went up to receive her award. Everyone clapped and then got up and started filing out right away, except for the group I was sitting in. We stayed for a little longer and watched all the famous people leave. For some reason, these twin men who were identical in almost every way; khaki shorts, brown shirt socks and loafers, same tattoos (except one), they jumped over the chains while singing acapella. We walked out to leave and my brothers were already waiting in front of the building. We found the car, which was supposed to be parked closer. My friend Pati rode with us and we drove around various neighborhoods, and while we were driving, my mom asked Pati many questions about where she lived and her schooling. We past a deserted building where some family friends used to live.

This dream was a recurring one in which we were on an escape. We is my two brothers and I. We were running away from two men, but at times there were other people chasing us. We jumped on a moving car and then jumped off and ran into this deserted house that I remember going into before, and I tried to lift up one of the wooden boards that I thought would reveal a secret passage but didn't, so we lifted one further up, but we were caught, so we tried to run but there were so many fences. I ran up a balcony and while up there, one of our pursuers threw a brick at me, it missed, but then he began throwing rocks, which I then picked up and threw back at him. Then he came up to the balcony and we almost tried to push each other off.

I dreamt that I was at my mom's friend's house. Her name is Lulu. It took place in her house, which I wasn't sure of the location. Her house had a various amount of art pieces in within. It was nicely and meticulously decorated. My mom was there too and she sat on one couch, I on another, and Lulu on a third. My mom got up and left after they had been talking and then Lulu proceeded to showing me some of her art pieces. I felt like I knew a little about what she was describing. At one point there was a mantel with a scenic picture hanging above and then a candlestick holder with a royal purple cloth over it. All I remember from my second dream is that I was being chased in a grocery store and we were trying to find the fastest check-out line.

I'm not sure exactly where I was but my mom and grandfather were there. There was also this little baby who was about one-year-old, and I wasn't sure whose it was, but she was really cute. At one point my mom was on the bed and I asked her to hold the baby, but before I did I went to the bathroom and then washed my hands, I did this twice. My mom was on the large bed with lots of pillows. I held the baby up to the mirror and she thought it was another baby. When my grandfather was picking her up, she hit her chin on his knee, but he didn't know why she was crying and somehow I was able to rewind the scene of how he picked her up. Next, I remember going outside to this busy area where various activities were going on. One in particular was little girls little league. The girls looked 7-9 years old and a large majority were African-American. One team was wearing blue shorts with yellow shirts and the other team was wearing the opposite. I liked watching them get ready to play, but I was watching alone.

My friends and I were on some weird road trip. At this one stop, we were all five in one bed trying to get some rest. My boyfriend and I talked to all my other friends. Everyone except me got out of bed. My boyfriend left and so did two of my friends and the rest stayed and did wash. It was about 6:00 am. I pondered getting up, but then we all tried to go back to sleep. I wasn't sure where my boyfriend went. We ended up just getting up and continuing our road trip. We were driving and one of my friends we accidentally left behind. We went to a place that was like a house/store. It was here that I met a family from India. They were nice and the lady said she would dress me up but it was weird because she spoke a little Spanish and I could understand her. We had a big dinner in the dining room and my little brother was supposed to say the prayer. Somehow we ended up in this entry way that looked almost like a greenhouse. There was a rummage sale in the room next door. My friend Lana bought and showed me a rhinoceros frame with a picture inside it and then she showed me this bracelet that my dad had given to me, but she was going to buy it.

I was hanging out with my 16-year-old cousin and we were waiting for her dad to come back so we could go see a movie, we were at her house, but it was right across from the theater. I finally decided not to wait any longer so didn't see the movie, and I went with my friend Nick. I went in his car and we somehow meet up with my mom and some family friends. Nick made a drug deal and a guard saw him. I ran to my mom's friend's house and my mom was on the phone. I wasn't going to tell her, but then I did and she was really upset and didn't know what to do. I got mad at her because she did not have a right to get mad because I didn't have to tell her what just happened.

I dreamt I was supposed to be on a trip to Hawaii with my family. I know I was with my cousin. For some reason, in the middle of the trip we had to go back to my grandparents' house. At their house, my grandmother was upset because I had taken too much clothes. There was a Hawaiian shirt that we bought at Walgreens and it had the Walgreens label on the top right. It was white with black writing. My mom tried it on and there was a lot of writing on the back. She had crossed some words out and added others. My grandmother pulled my hat off and hurt my newly pierced ear and I was really mad. There was a lot of commotion. I walked into this unknown town, where all of these suspicious people were. I approached this one large rough-looking man named Tucker and asked where he was from. He said San Antonio and I told him I was from El Paso, TX. He said money had been stolen and I wasn't sure who. I went into a building and saw Dan carrying the money bag. He was running, but I didn't tell on him. I saw and defended a lady from work and her baby, and my friend Sam let me taste her bowl of granola, dried cranberries and vanilla ice cream and marshmallows. We spilled most of it in the hospital bathroom. My other cousins were there too. I was driving near where I live and first I was driving and then all of a sudden there was no car. I scared this little five-year-old girl and she cut her elbow. At first I was going to keep going, but I stopped to help her. Her mom came out and all three of us talked. I made the girl feel better, her three brothers came out and I gave them all chocolate caramel candy.

I dreamt that I was on a trip to Alaska, somehow though it was close to Maryland. We had to work planting roses and also dealing with ice and the cold. So it would be really warm for a little bit, then really cold. Somehow I took a shower and never got out of my robe and towel. Somehow I wasn't cold though. The man my mother and I were with liked me but never did anything about it. Then somehow I got sand in my stomach and threw it up. Then it became around 5pm and it was as sunny as morning and no one else was hungry but me.

I went away from home for a weekend with a couple guy friends, yet on this trip I ran into many SCU friends. I guess, my mom decided to fly down to the same place and for awhile I can't find her in the city. We finally meet up and she shows me the stuff she got while shopping. Then she goes back to where she is staying and I go back to work while on vacation. I get off work and go out in search of my mother because I have no way of getting a hold of her. She didn't leave me a number to call. Then I end up at a diner and eat with now, a guy and a girl.

I remember a faceless man with big hairy, rat feet, with long toe nails, and he wore a black outfit with a black cowboy hat. Back to the apartment thing, I found one in the dream and it was a house, perfect in every way, so we got it. First night in the house I remember hearing two footsteps in the lower level. The next day, he follows me, tries to kill me with his car, tries to poison me, etc.

I remember dreaming about college, and there was a group who did things for people, but they got together and had parties about it. I went along with my close friends, we were considered the young geek freshmen, and I remember getting a tour of this massive house that had enormous beds that could hold oh, ten people or so. Then the ones in this group told me and my friend that they were moving into an apartment soon. Then we were still in the house, but it looked like a brightly colored diner, and I was sitting at a lower level booth. Then the group and we were all there eating, and discussing the apartment thing.

I vaguely remember walking down my hall in Swig and it was very dark, and there were people everywhere, I just walked into my room though and thought it was weird. I stayed up and talked to one of my friends really late.

I was camping in the woods with two of my friends. It was just like the Blair Witch Project, my friends disappeared one by one until I was alone. Then I was running from the Blair Witch and she killed me.
I had a dream I was running. My roommate was with me and I think we were being chased...then I was running by myself, because they didn't care about getting her, it was me they wanted.

I remember in one part I had a horrible sore throat and I just kept thinking about how sick I felt. Then, I was at work and this couple came up to me and wanted to buy 800 hearts. They wanted each one individually wrapped and I just felt total dread because I didn't want to do it.
Another weird one – In my dream, someone kept telling me “it’s 3:18” over and over. I woke up, and the clock read 3:18 am. That’s all.

I was running down a city block, like in New York, but there were more trees. It was strange because there were no cars or anything, no other people around me either. I was having a hard time breathing but I didn't want to stop running.

I dreamt I was staying at a hotel and it was on top of a cliff. It was a beautiful mansion, really ornate with a porch running all the way around the hotel. I fell into the ocean off of the porch and the ocean was really choppy. I was getting pulled out further but then Jeannie jumped in and we made it to the cliff and she helped me out. Everyone was watching. The next thing I knew, I was alone in the hotel and it had been abandoned and I didn't know how to get out.

I dreamt I was at work and it was really late at night, and customers kept coming in and my boss kept yelling at me to do things, a lot of things at once. I was running around the store talking to people and they were all complaining. I kept trying to shut the doors to the store, but the people would not stop coming in. I was getting really really angry.

I was climbing down the side of a mountain or a rock, and my boyfriend was climbing down beneath me. On the next step, there were all these neon colored snakes, green and blue and pink, swimming around in a puddle on the next step of the rock. There were all these bugs in it too, and I was too afraid to step down because I was going to squish all of them and it was totally gross. My boyfriend was yelling at me to come down but I was completely frozen and I couldn't move. My fingers and hands hurt from holding onto the rocks so long.

My dream took place at Sue's Mongolian barbecue. It looked just like a house inside, not really a restaurant. People were wandering around and I couldn't find my friends. I had a feeling that they were outside, so I went out back but no one was there, just remember feeling very confused and I was worried because I had to get back to school because one of my classes was about to start. The next thing I knew, I was in Marin's car and we were going to class. I walked into a strange classroom, one that I have never seen before, and sat down. The teacher started asking me questions.

I was at work, outside actually, and some guys drove by and started harassing me. Some friends walked me inside to my dorm, but it looked more like a hotel. I was really scared to go in there, but we got in the elevator and went up to the sixth floor. For some reason, I was so nervous that I had my hand on the close door button. The doors opened and one of my friends stepped out. I saw out of the corner of my eye a guy with a gun and one with a sword. They ran towards her and I kept pushing the close button. We heard gunshots.

I dreamt that I was in a big house with a pool outside and I was laying on the couch. I told everyone to leave me alone because I wanted to sleep. I fell asleep and started to dream. I dreamt that me and my friend went out and we were wearing really short skirts and trying to get cars to stop. Finally we got tired of doing that so we went to a club and got jobs as strippers. I woke up from my dream and my friends were laughing because I guess I was dancing in my sleep.

In this dream my family bought a new house which actually turned out to be a mansion. My brother and his daughter were there and they were making chicken sandwiches for everyone. My nephew was also there and my mom and my sister. We were standing next to a plant and all of a sudden the plant turned into an alien with one large eye in the middle. It was trying to get us because it had about eight arms, but we just picked up the pot and loaded it into a big white truck, and the truck drove away.

My dream started when I was at my boyfriend's house with all his sisters and brothers. The house was painted completely white. I heard a knock on the door and some girl I had never seen before was there with her mother. She said that her name was Amanda and that she was there to see my boyfriend. She had a bunch of suitcases with her and she told her mom to move them into a specific room because that is where she always stayed. She started telling me all this stuff about her being [one] of my boyfriend's other girls. Then I beat her up and her face got all bloody and her mom took her to the bathroom to wash her face. Then I went to the room where my boyfriend's brothers and sisters were and I started telling them about this girl and they all said that she came over a lot but they never knew her name. Then she came to me again and started yelling things at me and I beat her up again and her face got all bloody again and her mom took her away again. Then I moved to the next room where my boyfriend was and I told him I was leaving and he was begging me not to go. Then all of our friends walked in and he totally changed and said fine then leave, I don't care. He started ignoring me, except to tell me that he liked the other girl more anyways. So I just cursed at him and then I left.

In my dream I went back to visit my old work, a tuxedo store. I remember that I went to tell them that I started going to the gym. In the dream I had a very nice, toned body and I wanted to show my ex-coworkers. When I opened the door I saw that the place was decorated with hearts everywhere for Valentine's Day. I saw my coworkers sitting on top of the sales counter and I noticed that they had all gained a lot of weight and were now very heavy set. One of them who used to have short hair now had very long hair. When I walked in they welcomed me to sit with them on top of the counter. After sitting for a while, a man came in. At first we thought it was a customer, but it turned out to be a cop and he told us that he had a delivery for us. It turned out that we were shipped many pounds of drugs instead of coats, which we were supposed to receive. In the bottom of the box, after we opened it, we found there was a black man in a black sweater with tape over his mouth. He was in a black garbage bag so he was sweating. In his hand he had a princess crown with rhinestones. We took the tape off his mouth and then I heard beeping. In my dream, the beeping was so loud it scared him so he couldn't speak.

I dreamt that I had to go to a high school through the magnet program. I had to walk uphill to get to it through a street surrounded by dark trees and bushes like a forest. When I finally got there I saw on one side there was a McDonald's and on the other side there was a candy shop (an old-fashioned one). It was closed but we went in because the door was unlocked. Inside there were some nuns but they didn't look like regular nuns. They had shaved off their eyebrows completely and penciled them in. They had really shiny faces, like wax, and they had rosy red cheeks and dark red lipstick. They were bald and they only had a patch of hair with a braid coming out of it. We left the candy store because we heard one of our friends yelling down the hill. We went down there and she warned us not to stay with those nuns because they were wealthy yet corrupt. We didn't want to believe this because we liked those nuns, so we went back up the hill and it was like the nun had heard us because she changed into the outfit of a poor nun, and then we hugged her and picked her up (because she was really small and skinny) and carried her down hill.

I remember the old neighborhood I used to live in. One day me and my friend were walking and we saw the sun start to move around in a dancing motion. We ran away as fast as we could and we ended up at our church. My mom works at this church, and I saw one of her coworkers and I asked her why the sun was dancing. She said it had to do with the movement of the water in the ocean. I told this lady that I was running because I was scared because I thought I was receiving some type of revelation and I didn't want it. But this lady advised me to go back to the spot where I had seen this. I went and saw the sun dance again.

I kept dreaming about floating ears and a roll of paper towels. I dreamt that I was like the second coming of Jesus or something because I lived in a palace with a king and I was always getting in trouble with the law. Then one day I was trying to escape because they told me that they were going to crucify me. When I was running out an African-American cop stopped me by stopping the car right in front of me. Then instead of arresting me, he invited me to a diner. There, he ordered a whole bunch of candy and deserts for me because he told me that I was going to die on Friday anyway. [We] were sitting on the bench and we had a blanket covering us. The more I kept looking at the cop I saw him turn into a woman. After we ate and talked for a long time, I decided I need to find a way to tell my mom that I was going to be crucified. So I went to the mall with my boyfriend and his sisters to find a book on how to tell my mom that I was going to be crucified.

I dreamt that a bunch of friends and I went house-hunting I my old town -Pasadena, CA. I think we wanted to buy a house so we could stay there and go skiing nearby. We looked at several nice homes but nothing was quite what we wanted. One of my friends' boyfriend had a place there and he told us to come over. When my boyfriend and I showed up he said that we had to go snowboarding with him, but we didn't have our ski stuff. We decided to go anyway.

One [dream] was that I was going to visit a friend's grandmother who lived at the beach. We took the train and while I was looking out the window I saw my ex-boyfriend from high school and he saw me. In my dream I had a strong need to talk to him and thought it would be realistic that I'd see him soon. We had a special dinner in honor of our arrival. My next dream was that I was in some foreign place with my nanny and we were trying to get home but I didn't have a car, so we decided to take the train. We paid for tickets but were too late for the train, it left without us. When I got home, I was furious at my parents for not coming to get us. They apologized and my mom tried to make it up to me by offering strawberries dipped in chocolate.

I had a dream that I was trying to become a model but was having trouble finding an agency. I finally found an agency but the agent was more interested in some other girls who were unattractive and overweight. I was very frustrated! I remember that my agent looked like a Huge Hefner-type of man. He was old and I thought he must be a pervert. I went to his house to talk with him and he lived in my old hometown in a beautiful, huge mansion. I was impressed by this and thought he might be able to help me in the business because he looked successful.

I dreamt that my family and I were on a fishing boat. Everybody spent the day trying to catch fish and clams except for me. But finally at the end of the day, I threw out a net and caught a bunch offish. Everybody was amazed that I put such little effort into it, while they on the other hand spent the entire day trying to get fish with not much luck. I remember, also, that my father was an airplane pilot and he wanted to fly me back to SCU right away so that I didn't miss any school. I tried to convince him to let me stay longer, but he said no.

I had a very strange dream that ants were crawling all over my body while I was in bed asleep. I was at a strange house in a strange (unfamiliar) town. My friends were the same pretty much but the setting was weird. It reminded me of the set in Scream 3. There was a big party at the house I was at. The next thing I remember was the ants crawling on me.

I had a dream that I was a model but there was a problem because I wasn't tall enough and I weighed too much, but in my dream I didn't seem to care. My boyfriend was really supportive too. I had another dream that involved my entire family. We bought a piece of property in New Mexico. The property was on a cliff and l almost fell off. I didn't like the place at all but my dad did. I think we all got in some argument about it and I ended up not speaking to my parents all because I didn't like the place they bought. I just remembered that the setting of my New Mexico dream was the Grand Canyon, and I almost fell off from the top of the canyon.

I dreamt that I went with this guy to get a birthday present for my best friend Carrie. We drove around Santa Clara and finally went in this gift shop. I ended up buying her a book about food/birdseed, even though I originally wanted to buy her a small sleeping bag.

There was a war going on in the world. I was swimming in this huge pond in the woods, like I was on vacation. My parents made me get out for a minute - when I looked back at the pond, I saw it was filled with beavers and large turtles swimming in it, and I wanted to swim with them, but I decided not to, thinking there were too many. One of my best friend's family was there, and I was happily reunited with my best friend. Later I'm with this guy I used to like. He's shorter than he used to be. I'm excited that we can finally talk, but we don't really get to it.

I do remember that I was out on the town with my three close friends and we went to eat in this restaurant, and all we were getting for ourselves was a few beans, triscits, and cheese. One of the Aramark workers was there and rang us up. Then I was watching this movie about the bible and my grandma had been watching it. Then I was walking through the schoolyard/office building and an African-American woman and then a blond woman were lecturing to me about the racism still in this country, and I was agreeing.

I was with a bunch of my friends and we were babysitting these little kids. One girl came in looking shyly at me and her name tag had the same name as me on it. When I asked her how she pronounced it, she didn't really say anything. In a few minutes, I realized she was actually the younger sister of one of my best friends and we hug. And I was glad to see her period. In the rest of my dream, I was trying to figure out when I could ask that guy to the dance, but I never got the chance.

I am visiting with my extended family for some holiday. My uncle Bob is laying in a bed. I go up to talk to him. I ask him how his dad is doing and he tells me he goes to see him everyday, and I say I wish I could see him. So my whole family decides to go see him and we go by walking along these airport runways.

My family and I are at some vacation spot. There is another family there, and I hear them say allera so I know they are speaking Italian. I tell my grandma (who is Italian) and she starts speaking to them. I try to speak to them as best I can. I talk to the young girl and also her crusty father, who proceeds to keep hitting on me. I complain to my dad or someone, and I finally get to leave. We go to show wilderness-type place like Africa. I remember we are walking down the trail and there are all these lions cut in half and I'm afraid to look.

In my first dream, I am practicing with concert choir. Not many people are there. We are singing some pioneer songs, but we keep practicing Ubi Caritas, even though we know it. I feel we are not fully prepared for the concert, but then I am not in the concert, but afterwards I see pictures of the choir members carrying my friend (also in the choir) above their heads during the first song, to add some excitement to the show. Then I see pictures of myself in the concert being lifted up and then diving from their hands to the couch. I totally laugh, wondering how they even got me to do that. I go to show my mom the pictures, but she has already seen them. In another dream, I am walking home to my house in southern California with my friend Charlotte. We are walking through/down these hills and we get alongside the coast. We are standing at the top of these sandy cliffs and Charlotte, the avid hiker, is asking me if I want to take this special hike, named after some guy, down the cliff (a long ways) so that we can walk alongside the ocean. The other option is to walk along the cliffs, and I am scared of falling off and I would rather get to the seashore so that I will feel secure. We start going down the cliff, with many other people - it's some kind of tourist attraction. We are practically going straight down these cliffs, which are not solid sand at all, so I keep sinking my hands and feet in them, which I guess is supposed to support me, but I feel certain I will fall. There are also yellow and black cords around to sort of hold on to. When we reached the bottom, our other two friends are suddenly with us. We are looking for a restroom - there are many of them, but all the toilets are in a big room of this house-like place. We go to the bathroom and then climb back up the cliffs. So then we are on a street in a town and it is snowing, although the sand is part of the snow. I put on the hood of my gray SCU sweatshirt over my head and keep my umbrella over my head. I got this umbrella when I was going down the cliffs - we were supposed to have one so that sand from the people above us would not fall on us directly. Also, when my friends and I were at the restroom/tourist house, I found a pin that said Ubi Caritas on it. And my friends asked what it means and I tell them: Where true love and charity are found, God is there. This confuses my friend Kat.

I am with two good friends, Kat and Melia, and we are traveling around Sonoma. We are with a few other people and supposed to be doing some kind of experiment. Oh, my sister is with us too. We have to hop on to this truck/bus alongside the freeway to get somewhere. Kat, this unknown girl, me and my sister stop by Melia's home -1 feel awkward about just dropping in on her mom, but Kat thinks it's fine. Melia's mom looks different, younger, more exotic looking. I forget to introduce my sister to her, but Lauren (my sister) did it. Suddenly Melia is there and she and Kat get excited about eating the round pastry-like things they call ether - they have tons of powdered sugar on them but sardine paste in the middle. I am skeptical, but I eat it and it tastes good.

I'm with my family - we're at Ghiradelli's (it looks different) ordering food. I want just a simple sundae, but am unable to find it on the menu -1 tell the waitress I want a little vanilla ice cream, chocolate sauce, a cherry, and maybe a few nuts. The waitress points out that this item is on the back of the menu -1 say that I didn't look there because I thought it was just alcoholic drinks. At another cafe right next store, tons of people are lined up at the door -1 hear that it is very busy there and only two people working - somehow that cafe becomes a coffee shop where I worked two summers ago -I feel obligated to go help them, and I do - but that's not visible in the dream. I'm walking alongside a chain linked fence on a bike path - type path with Kat, my roommate, and one of my best friends. There is a Bougainvillea type bush growing along opposite side offence. Suddenly I notice all these different animals - realize I'm looking through a glass fence into a cage - that we are walking next to Marine World, Africa, USA. Then I'm with my family, touring this big mansion - all these rich people are there too going in all the rooms. I notice that the colors in the room - walls, picture frames - are very pink and green like this friend of our family's in real life. Then I see a picture of that woman (Sherry) 's son, John, and also pictures of Sherry with her friend and my real-life next door neighbor. I think it must be our neighbor's house, but I marvel at how different it is. I feel confused.

In my dream I was back home in Indonesia. It was Christmas break and my brother, his roommate and I were on a plane going home. When we got there, I went back to my high school and got to see all my friends again. One of my friends who has been with me since kindergarten and I were walking around school. We were both crying because we knew we had to leave and that we wouldn't ever see a lot of our friends again. At one point, I ran through the field and got all muddy. All of a sudden I was in my house, but it wasn't my house. I was running around my house looking for a razor. Then I had to eat lunch with my family really fast because me (my brother, his roommate, and I) had to catch a flight back here. We got to the airport four hours early. So we just hung out until the plane left.

I had a dream that my friends and I were all at a party dancing. My brother's roommate came up to me and started saying all these things. I don't know what he was saying because there were too many people around. We ended up going back to his room and watched a movie.

I had a dream that my best friend here and I were at my high school. We were in the office finding out our homerooms. Since we were both late, we ran to the class. When we got in there, there were all these random people. My ex was giving me a hard time and kept mouthing me off My best friend who lives in London now was also there. She told my ex off and he finally left me alone. Then the teacher passed out these slips of paper to everyone. It was a sign up sheet for dorms and roommates next year. I was having trouble deciding who to write down because both my best friends were there. But my best friend who lives in London said it was alright if I didn't put her name down because she wasn't even supposed to be there.

I had a dream that my best friend here and I got in a fight with my next door neighbor - not a physical fight, but we were just yelling at each other. Then I found myself walking around with my brother's roommate. We bumped into my brother and my mom and we all drove somewhere to eat. I remember driving around a parking garage... I don't know where though. Then my brother's roommate took me back to my dorm. I remember waking up in my dream the next morning, and my roommate was mad at me because I came home at 4 in the morning.
In my dream last night I called my ex-boyfriend who lives in Thailand. I also remember dreaming about a couple of my friends who I'm supposed to visit over spring break.

The dream began in a huge gym or cafeteria like place. I was in some sort of a school assembly. There were lots of people - adults and children all moving around, but little noise. I then found myself climbing (in a straight line) up sand dunes with the group from the assembly. Then I jumped locations again and the assembly group was walking across a huge bridge or highway overpass and I was talking to my middle school orchestra teacher. I also remember seeing my boyfriend throughout the events, but never talking to him. I was calm the whole time, a little curious about what was going on.

I was sailing on a river (it was brown with trees coming out of the water, it seemed like it was flooding) with my parents. We were in a huge boat and I was extremely nervous because we were going really fast. The boat tipped - this motion seemed very slow, my heart was racing because I was scared and nervous. I was also very worried about our stuff getting wet. I jumped from the boat to the water as the boat was tipping over. My dad was talking calmly telling my mom and I we were going to tip.

I dreamt about my boyfriend last night. I dreamt that he transferred here -1 was very excited about this. He acted like my boyfriend, but was in a different looking body - his face was different, he had different color hair - this didn't bother me in the dream though. One specific part I remember was eating in a cafeteria with my boyfriend and seeing my friends from high school. They ignored me though and wouldn't talk to me -this bothered me tremendously. I was nervous and upset during this part of the dream.

I was on a farm and I was playing in back of the house in the fields. It was extremely hot and I was very aware of being hot and sweaty in my dream. In the field I was running and I would look down and see corn kernels on the ground. The farm was in a small community and in the dream I could see the several other houses next to my family's small farmhouse. My body was physically very active in this dream - walking and running. I also had a little brother.

I had a calm dream about being in my friend Ali's house. Her dad and my grandma were both there. I was on the couch -very quiet, almost sad, listening to their conversation, I don't know what about. I remember looking out through double glass doors and seeing snow period. The outside was bright with this snow and there were some trees. The inside seemed dark and dismal. The couch I was sitting on was plaid and there was carpeting on the floor. I was thinking why my grandma and friend's dad were together. My friend's dad had many of the same personality traits as my grandpa -friend's dad had the same voice/tone as my grandpa does.

I dreamt that my friend Roz stole my alarm clock. The only way I could wake up was by my alarm clock, and everyone knew that. So then next morning I couldn't wake up. I missed practice and I missed a midterm. She was so proud of herself though for stealing it.

Last night I dreamt I was in a scene from ER. I was in a white room which only had a bed with a pillow and a sheet on it. A man came out of a corner with an ice pick and jammed it into the back of a doctor. I didn't want to scream, but I was so scared I had to.

I dreamt that my best guy friend flew out from Chicago to visit me. I was so surprised. I had no clue. He showed up with lots of flowers. We went to this restaurant with only one table and a little fountain. When we were done, our dessert came and on top of the cake was a ring. He then got down on one knee and proposed. We went from there to Vegas and eloped, then came back home and surprised everyone.

I was driving home all by myself to southern California. As it grew dark, I couldn't tell if I was going the right way or not. I began to realize street signs weren't at all familiar. I was afraid to stop cause it was so dark. I was way low on gas. I started going the other direction. About two hours later I saw a sign that said Los Angeles 500 miles. I had gotten so lost.

There was a doctor, Dr. Doogle. He kept telling me how I needed to put my fingerprints on things in his office. He thought it would enable [me] to find my best friend. Then I kept seeing myself sitting in a chair holding my smiling, happy baby. My mom and dad were with me and kept asking me if I was okay. I kept saying yes, but they continued to ask me.

I dreamt that when I woke up I was at my house down south, only everything was all different and it wasn't my family living in the house. Everything in my room was the same, but all the pictures in hallway were of another family. I was so confused. When I went into the kitchen the people treated me like I was their daughter. I went along with it, but I was so confused. The last thing I saw was a little picture on the table of my real family.

I had a dream that I went for a run. I was going to run to a particular spot and then turn around and head back. I could see the sign I had set my destination for, but as I would get closer and closer it would just get farther. No matter how hard I tried, or how fast I ran, I couldn't reach the sign. The road just kept going on and on.
I do remember picturing what summer was going to be like. I could see myself in Hawaii spending all day and night on the beach. I could feel how warm it was and see the blue of the ocean.

I only remember that I was going to get my belly button pierced and when they stuck the needle through it wasn't big enough to fit the bar so they had to do it again. It was so painful. I hadn't wanted to go in the first place, so having that happen made things even worse.

I dreamt I was leaving to come back up to school. I had to cross this big gully of water to be able to leave. It was so hard. When I finally did, I realized I had forgotten all my clothes, so I had to drive back with no clothes on. I also dreamt that I could hear somebody coming through the apartment door. I was yelling for my friend to wake up, but she wouldn't. I was freaking out. Another one I had was my best friend has a ringworm in her arm, and she kept trying to give me a hug but I didn't want to touch it. My last one was I dreamt I moved to the top bunk.

I had this dream someone wanted to sell me something. She first started calling and visiting at my office, then it was at school, then it was at my house. I kept moving so she wouldn't know where I lived, but she kept finding me. One time I finally just let her into my house to see what she was selling. She went on and on and was giving me all this paperwork. I was signing the dotted lines to what she had in front of me.

In my dream I hit my head on the couch and I didn't wake up in time for practice cause I had a concussion. It was awful. My parents sent me a box of gifts. I remember in my dream sitting on my bedroom floor in the dark with the box in my lap. I slowly began to open it and inside was a dark hole. As I began to fall, my alarm went off. I remember feeling the hole was never going to end.

I was at summer camp and living with a bunch of people that I knew from various places. I had to give a presentation and had all of my material and everything ready to write it, but just hadn't done it yet. It was the day that the presentation was due, but I couldn't find a place to write it. I kept entering different people's rooms to study, but each room had something wrong with it. One room had no lights, one room was loud, I could not focus and my presentation was due in twenty minutes. I was so mad and tried to come up with excuses to why I couldn't finish my homework. I was going to say I was sick and was going to leave before class.

I had a dream about my boyfriend and ex-boyfriend. They both wanted to talk to me and without the other person. It was really confusing and I felt very torn between them. I had another dream [where] my boyfriend was a prince and we met each other. We fell in love, but had to not tell anyone that we knew each other. One day he told me that he had to get married, but to someone else. His father had arranged for him to marry a girl with certain blood, so that his children were of royal blood. He didn't want to marry her but he didn't say anything about not marrying her. I was devastated, but decided not to say anything. I saw him all of the time up until the wedding, but he never said anything. The night before the wedding, I decided to tell him everything. I broke down crying and told him that I loved him and I didn't want to lose him forever. He thought that I really didn't want to be with him and was very shocked of the news. But he didn't change his plans and the wedding continued! I decided to go to the wedding and the girl (my friend) was not excited, and even though she knew I loved him, did not say anything to me about what she was doing. Well, the wedding started and I sat there crying watching him look upset. All of a sudden, one of the girls out in the crowd said their wedding can't go on!. She was one of my best friends and explained everything. Chris and I ran to each other and decided to get married.

One [dream] was at my Alviso house and all of my friends were coming over for the progressive party that we're having tonight. Another one was at my old, old, old house with my friends from junior high. They were making Christmas ornaments with me.

I was with my roommate and best friend going somewhere on a train. We were in a hurry and kept pacing back and forth. It was really dark and I don't remember seeing anyone else's faces, but it was crowded. Our two other friends were on the train, and they wanted to get off at the first stop because they realized that where we were going was not going to be fun. They jumped off the train as it slowed down. It was going really slow, but my roommate and I didn't know if we should get off or not. We decided to get off and it was really hard because the train was moving. I had to climb down the edge really slowly and thought I was going to fall off. I remember breathing really hard and trying not to fall. Once we got off we saw the train speed up and drive away. I had another dream about trying on clothes. I was in a huge white house with a few friends and I was trying to get to my 11:50 class. I had a long skirt on. I remember seeing these shoes that I hadn't had for about two years, and I couldn't fit my foot into, but finally did, and they made me a lot taller. I wasn't happy with my shirt and kept changing it. Running from upstairs, my mom's room, to downstairs with all of these mirrors. I liked this brown outfit. It was sort of flowing, but changed into a tighter white shirt that only had one button. I was very skinny, looked really good in the clothes. The whole time, I kept looking at the clock, trying to get to my 11:50 class. Because I kind of knew I was dreaming at the end.
I was in a contest and was with my friends. One girl was cheating and we had to figure out which girl it was. It was dark and I was frustrated.

I was teaching a dance class in a room but it was the Graham bathroom. I was leaving the bathroom, walked out, and ended up in my mom's office. I looked up, saw a sign, had the feeling I needed to change it for some reason. Then all of a sudden Leonardo DiCaprio walked in. He looked at me, nodded and said Eh, I got to use the bathroom. Then I heard something about a room in Campisi being all yellow or something.

It was Valentine's Day and my door opened. Two guys I was friends with in high school, Mike and Tom, walked in my door. They were going out with both my roommates. So I rolled over because I was depressed and my friend Kevin walked in and gave me flowers and a huge hug. I got really excited right away. Kevin came in and laid down with me. We cuddled and talked and joked around. It was so much fun and then he had to leave. I was a little upset but I was still in a good mood.
I had the exact same falling dream as last time. The only difference is that this time someone was with me, but I never saw who it was. I do know that it was a guy.

All I remember is being at this huge party where all of my friends from high school were. My roommate Meghan was there, but I didn't want to talk to her. Everybody was drinking and all I wanted was a cigarette, but everybody yelled at me and got mad and said I couldn't have one. So I snuck outside with a couple old friends that smoked and they let me have one.

I had one of those dreams where you're falling and all of a sudden you wake up. I was walking on a table and it seemed like I was there for awhile. Then all of a sudden I stepped off the edge but it seemed like I stepped off a cliff.

First, I was at my boyfriend's house just hanging out with him and his dad. We were talking about the presidential election when his dad offered me a beer. When I said no thanks, they both started yelling at me. I got really confused and scared, so I ran out of the house. But now everything changed. Now I was helping load a car for a trip to the beach. We finally left and started driving up a hill and it started snowing. I got out of the car and climbed up a snowy hill and had a snowball fight. I got hit with a snowball.

Me and this guy I am seeing were part of the Friends cast, but we worked in the offices of Ally McBeal. Anyway, Elaine (the secretary) ended up dying in my dream. It was the saddest thing ever. I felt horrible and couldn't stop crying. But then it totally turned around. New people joined my dream and we all got into a hot tub but couldn't get out.

Last night I dreamt I was with my cousins watching TV. Who Wants to be a Millionaire was on, and one of my cousins was the one in the hot seat. A question came up asking about some college in Connecticut, and he didn't know the answer. So he called me for his phone a friend lifeline. And I was so nervous. He gave me the question and I told him what I thought the answer was. And he used it and he was right. Me and my other cousins cheered. But I can't remember exactly what the question was about.

Last night, I dreamt about this little boy who was getting so much pressure placed on him by his mom, and especially his dad, to do really well in school. He was placed in an elite school where everybody else was a genius, and so he felt really out of place. I wasn't in the dream at all, just kinda watched as a detached observer.

The first [dream] me and a bunch of friends went to a restaurant to have an early dinner. And while there, we had quite a few drinks and ate and had a good time. The dream transitioned to later that night. We were around a college campus, but it wasn't here. We were at somebody's house that I know and across the street these two houses were throwing one big party together. So people were talking in groups like usual. And I was going from group to group talking to people. My best friend was there, but her mom came too, and so they were talking on the porch of one of the houses most of the night. A lot of people [were] trying to get with other people, one couple making it - typical party scene. I went into one of the houses to get some water to drink. When I came back out, a lot of people were dispersing everywhere... and cops were there. They had come to break it up. So me and my friends just went back across the street to hang out. Second dream had to do with volleyball again. Me and two other players were practicing while the rest of the team were doing some exercises on the bleacher. Then all of a sudden, they all started throwing buckets of water on each other. And then they came over and started throwing water on us. And our head coach got so mad at our assistant coach. So our assistant coach had to clean it all up. And then a big group of parents and kids came in to play some basketball while we were practicing. One parent came up to me to ask me about kids and sports and how much is too much. And I talked to her.

I dreamt that I was with my little volleyball club that I coach. We were at a tournament of some sort. I coach little 14-year-olds. And at first, I was with my Santa Clara coach, and we were watching this one girl play cause they were thinking about recruiting her. She wasn't very good, but had some potential. I remember at first watching her and her team play another team from the crowd. And then I switched perspectives and I was the referee. Except now the two teams were only playing two versus three rather than six versus six. And then my dream transitioned to where I was with my team that I coach. And other teams were there too, except we were all out at the pool. Bikes were all set up in the pool. For some reason, the object was for all of us to do some kind of bike workout in the pool. I remember trying but it just wouldn't work. And my little team was having a hard time with it too. We were all struggling to ride these bikes in the pool.

I vaguely remember having a dream in which me and some of my friends were competing to try to grab as many shirts as we could out of this store. But the shirts were the polo kind with the alligator on them. But we were competing to see who could grab the most. I remember bright colors, being at some department store, each of us taking turns to go in and take these shirts.

I dreamt about volleyball last night. Throughout the dream I felt a little nervous some reason. I dreamt about our workouts. It took place in the gym and I think I just kept dreaming over consecutive workout sessions. I could see everyone on the team on the bike machines, treadmill, stair-master, doing our workouts. And then I remember seeing our team in the weight room, lifting weights. One image stuck out in my mind, our two coaches were there, but they were both only assistants to a new older, mean woman coach. I recall her telling us that we all needed to be wearing the same clothes/uniform to practice, just like during regular season. Gave me the feeling like she was some kind of Nazi leader or something.

I dreamt that I was with my family at our home. But then me and my mom and my sister decided to go on a run. I remember that my mom wasn't wearing her running shoes and so her feet were hurting her. Later that same day, I guess, we ended up going to a volleyball game. I think it was here in the gym, but people were only sitting on one side. I was also in the stands and with my family, not playing. I remember the team we were playing was Pepperdine. I was excited to watch but sad to not be playing. And after I went down to talk to people after the match.

I was somewhere talking to someone, and my friend Justin, one of the guys that I have been having issues with, walked by with his girlfriend. They both walked right by me without saying hi. It was like they didn't even see, but I took it as if they were ignoring me. His girlfriend, Jenn, was wearing a pink tube dress with a white for trim around the top.

In the beginning of this dream I am an active participant. For some reason we drove to this house to stay the night. We pulled into the garage and parked. We were driving a red Jeep Cherokee. For some reason the person who greeted us did not want us to come inside the house, but we told that person that we needed to wash our faces and stuff. Then all of a sudden we became like an observer. We were away from the garage somewhere and we were watching some other people pull in that were just there to cause trouble. Even though we weren't in the garage, we had to remain completely silent. I was in biology lab or something and the experiment was to strategically place spiders on an ant. Most of the ants were very large and the spiders were very small, so for most it was easily done. But my ant was very small and my spiders were large, so every time I placed the spiders on my ant, it would get eaten.

One [dream] took place in my dorm but it really wasn't my dorm. In my dream, I just had a sense I was there. I was in the kitchen heating something up in the microwave and talking to someone about how they missed me. I can't remember who they were. I was in a hurry to go study. While I was waiting for my food to heat up, two guys. One was a friend from home, but he went to school here, the other guy lives in this dorm. They both wanted to hang out, but I told them I couldn't because I had to study. Their response was getting really sad. I felt guilty for leaving. The other dream was about Thanksgiving, I think. My family was getting together for dinner. I remember watching my cousin's wife just walk by me without saying hi. Plus she was calling people by the wrong name. I also remember seeing my only girl cousin. She was pregnant and she had become really unattractive. Lastly, I remember talking to my aunt. I asked her for a glass of water. Because of this act, I believe I was in her house, but at the beginning of the dream I thought I was in my house.

In the dream I recalled today my roommate and I were talking in the bathroom. It started out with the discussion of bath puffs. I was describing the difference between theirs and mine. Mine was clean and theirs were all soapy. I then started talking about how I only use soap on my puff and on my body. My roommate then started telling me how I used her soap one day and misplaced it. I started telling her that I never used her soap and if I did, I would have put it back. For a while, it seemed that my eyes just passed over the entire shower. Everything I saw was exactly how it looked when I got in the shower this morning.

I remember there were people, but I'm not sure who they were. People's faces were dark because they had this circle of light surrounding them. I think it was their aura. People in my dream were going around stealing people's aura, so everyone's concern was how to keep it. The people were giving tips, but I don't remember what they were. There wasn't any talking with mouths in my dream. All communication was done telepathically.

In my dream I got in a physical and emotional fight with my roommate, who is also one of my best friends. We were working at a restaurant and we were totally understaffed. Only the two of us were working plus two other boys. I knew the boys, but I cannot put names to them. I was trying to be organized and think of suggestions to help us, but every time I would voice my suggestion, she would make a comment to deliberately hurt my feelings. For example, I made a suggestion that someone should walk around and find out how many people were waiting for food, but when I'd go to do it, a random person was already doing it. My roommate would then ridicule me in front of Santa Clara students and she said something like why would you think that you were the first one to think of that. I ended up getting so angry that we totally started brawling while we were wearing formal dresses.

I had a dream that I woke up from a dream and my teeth had shifted so much that I couldn’t close my mouth. Then my teeth started falling out and I would keep handing them to my boyfriend. I figured that the evil queen of the kingdom cast a spell on me because I was the princess and she wanted to take the kingdom from me. So me and a bunch of others went to look for her. She made these plants come to life to hunt us. They were green and we called them weepuls. They liked to hunt in the dark and they glowed in the dark too. The queen was hunting them as well, but she had a three year-old boy with her so that we wouldn’t hurt her.

I had a dream that I was asked to take this guy out on a date, but it was really uncomfortable because I have a boyfriend. I did it anyway, and we went to the movies together. I think I was supposed to get some kind of information out of him, like a secret love for a certain girl, but nothing happened. We came back to Swig, and I told my boyfriend what I did,, and he got kind of mad but forgave me since it was a favor for a friend.

I had a dream last night that my friend from Indiana called me. I was in the condo I used to live at getting ready to go someplace. When the phone rang I was getting shoes out of my closet.. My friend that called (Andy) was trying to smooth things over between us by telling me he was joking when he said that it was too hard to be friends and stuff. I yelled at him for being [a] jerk and he kind of mocked me, so I yelled at him some more.

The dream I woke up in the middle of was about U-turns. I think I was doing some sort of research project on them or something. I was having a conversation with someone about them, and then we were debating about the fastest ways to get somewhere. The other dream had something to do with attitude. As I was up in the air on that thing, I was in fear that I was going to fall off and smash into the water deathly hard. Next thing I knew I was in the Leavy gym.

They managed to and pulled themselves up under a huge tree with many types of fruit on the grass around it. I thought to myself, I didn't know that Paradise existed. I got up to my feet because some of them were towering over me and they didn't look too friendly. I was trying to get their names, the one I can recall now was Dude for a bull dog. The other dogs were big, like Irish Setters and the kind of dogs with a white coat and brown spots. My dream ended with a preview ad for upcoming WWF matches. There was a dramatic story (but I couldn't hear the words) with The Rock and a brown-haired woman kissing and they are later forced to face each other in the ring

I was at my house the whole time. I remember I could sense tension in the air. There was a threat outside, a criminal of some sort. Whoever he was, I didn't see him but I knew he was out there and could strike at any moment. I was terrified because our doors were unlocked, the garage door was open, and anyone could enter. My mom was teaching a piano student in her studio, but she stopped and called the police.

I was walking Fallenleaf Lane when I stopped and talked to a resident. She noticed that there were many girls walking around further up. Most of them were wearing black dresses, and she thought they were in drag. I saw them and I thought the same. When I walked back to my house, a man went with me. The next part I can remember was being in a dark room and there were these large spider-like creatures crawling around. They were orange and they were moving. I was yelling for my brother to come and get rid of them because I'm arachnid-phobic. Another part of the dream was being at my karate class and my instructor, Enrike, was congratulating me on my good work in class. Then, my friend Chad said he and Mel traded injuries the last two nights. He had a bad back one night and Mel had a bad knee, and they had switched that night. The last part I remember is being in my living room. My friend/crush, Scott was sitting on a couch and I was talking to him across the room about my mom's shoulder injury. He said that he knew about it and I was surprised because I never told him that. He said he heard me tell others in class. I sat down on the opposite couch and said he was very attentive, with a smile. All of a sudden, I was talking to my brother, Brian, instead of Scott. We were talking about martial arts.

I was at some big event, kind of like an amusement park I guess. There was a lot of activity going on. I was by myself but I ran into a friend from my karate class, Chad, and my dad. We hung out for a while before we left our separate ways. The next thing I remember, I was driving on 280 heading toward San Jose, and there were a lot of cars around. I felt confined by all the cars boxed in on the narrow lanes. It didn't feel safe to be there. I got off on a ramp somewhere and made a left turn at a signal. My car was so slow and I barely made it through before it turned red. I went Up a steep hill to a parking lot around a gas station area. Again, there were many cars, mostly old beat up ones. I didn't know what I was doing there in my dream. Right before I woke up, I was in my kitchen and I was seeing how many cereal boxes we had. There were many. We had to even put them in the family room because there was no more space.

I was in some kind of a house. It was disorderly. There was water spraying and big round paint splatters on the wall. There were a few people there. I think it was my mom briefly who was having trouble with her right shoulder. There was a boy from the drama department from high school. We were talking about how good he was at drama. Later on, a boy from my karate school came in with a chef hat. We were also going on about his many talents. My brother and I were driving to an amusement park and I made sure I was driving under 65 because there was a patrol car ahead of us. Also, I was with a group of people who were getting into a line. I don't know what for. Somehow, we appeared at a really weird place. There was snow and a pretty but eerie sunset sky and we were sledding. There were also these colorful creatures (dragons?) that were following us. They didn't scare us though. We just moved off of the trail to let them by. I was standing in my kitchen watching TV with my brother. They were playing the conclusion to the Superman episode Legacy that played Saturday morning. In my dream, part two was playing. It started out with a recap of what happened in part one, then played part two. Superman was still alive. He was in pain but got up quickly. Both my brother and I were saying C'mon! That can't happen! My mom and I were talking about one of her piano students and we both concurred that the student should have a 45 minute lesson instead of 30 minutes.

I dreamed that a huge truck and horse trailer flew out of the sky and crashed in the road in front of my house. I had seen it from in the house, falling out of the sky, and rushed out to see it after yelling to my mom to get my nephew into the house so they wouldn't have to see it. As I ran down our driveway (which goes down a hill and is long) an Arabian horse looking just like the one my family had long ago, came running up to me from out of the wreckage and tugged my shirt. I put him along with his two other horse friends that had survived the crashed into one of our pastures. Then neighbor kids came by and I told them to go home. Lots of neighbors then came by to see the accident but no one found (or really actually looked for) dead people or animals. The next thing I know, I noticed a huge nopales plant that is in full bloom right next door to my house. My mom is there and remarks as to how ripe the fruit looks. I pick some off and start eating this green and purple, candy-like fruit. (No spikes!) Then lots of neighbors start eating it, but the fruits on the cactus are now all beautiful, orchid-like flowers that you can just pull off and eat like candy. Then while we are talking and eating, someone comes by and quickly tows away the crashed horse trailer and truck. When I go over and start petting the horses left, I wake up.

I dreamt I was writing down my dreams. I remember that I was writing that I had had a dream about something (I can't remember what) regular in my life involving maybe two other friends. I then remembered dreaming that I was worrying about the day ahead - writing my dreams and not getting out of bed.

Dreamt that it was the second day of school or university. Stood up in class to introduce myself. My parents were accompanying me. Then we went to our house and some kids had gotten in and played. Then it was night and I ran into my roommate and her boyfriend and this tennis friend.

Dreamt for a moment with the tennis team (two good friends [from] tennis team). Then dreamt I bumped into two good high school friends in San Francisco. They showed me their living space which was full of people, mainly women or hookers.

There is the type of vacuum machine which had a tube sticking out. Inside the tube (it was transparent) there were beautiful blue butterflies which signified evil and a milky substance which represented the good. They were mixing. They butterflies seemed to slowly blend with the milky substance. They were few but effective and were transforming the white substance more evil.
It was my friend from high school, Nicole. She was standing in the shade in a park. Then I was in Japan on a tour visiting and it was all about the philosophy of being balanced, of the yin and yang.

I was on a seashore, actually on a boat. There were several docks. The boat was full. On the seashore, there were a lot of people. Pirates, traders, etc. People getting off the boats were forming lines on the dock and shore. I was going to join them when I realized there was danger on shore. They wanted something from me. I had my dream folder (this one) with me! I hugged it to my chest and just dove off the boat. Swam underwater and tried to get to shore without being caught and without damaging the dream journal. I made it and escaped. I know my family was with me and before jumping I was with the Fede, a friend of mine on the tennis team.

I was in this old, huge-like apartment complex. It was very colorful, almost as if homes of many colors were smooshed, broken up and recombined into one. It looked like this inside too. I lived here, just moved. It's my new dorm. Other students lived here as well, but so did families and people from the community. All nationalities. It was so crowded, people slept in all directions on hammocks, the floor, and other constructions. My roommate and I had our own room for some reason. We were moving in, once she left the room three men came in, one with a white suit. The other two started rummaging through my stuff. Finally, I realized that they were robbing me. So I yelled no. But the man in the white suit took out a gun and held it to my shoulder. I couldn't speak after that. They told me, if I wanted my stuff, all the clues to find them were in some pink labeled movies they gave me. One was Robin Hood. The next thing I knew they left and I ran to the door, finding my brother there, I hugged him.

I was in this cabin-like dorm. My roommate was packing up because she and her boyfriend separated, so since he was now with someone new, the new girl was to move in. She was to be my new roommate. Outside our room was a pond. In the middle of the pond was a dock tied to the bottom with a chain. When my normal roommate and I were talking, the new girl came in. Before I knew it, the entire place was empty, and my old roommate was gone while this new girl plotted out her things. Then I ran or fell or some way I got into the pond. The chain got wrapped around my legs, and I was slowly going under.

I was on a mountain. There was a new, small development of homes, similar to those you find in Switzerland. They were all of primary colors - one red, one yellow, one blue. My grandma's was red. She was standing outside on a porch waving like in the movies. They were many evergreen trees. My cousin flew by on a little moped thingy.

My host family from Belgium were at my beach cabin. We woke up, and I was cleaning up my clothes, which were everywhere. Then I decided to get dressed to go running. I wasn't even sleeping in my room, it was the guestroom. Then as I was getting dressed, in hot orange shorts, I questioned whether or not to wear a hot orange shirt too. I then went downstairs and out one door. An older man, one who I can familiarize with someone I love dearly in real life, was there waiting to say goodbye to me with his wife. She hugged me first, then he did. He even picked me up and walked me backwards as if we were dancing. I began to cry. They were leaving on a trip in a beautiful, new, old-fashioned, white Volkswagen or something. Somehow I knew I would never see them again. It was a good moment because my mom was there taking pictures of them and the car as they drove away, but I knew that that was it. They sold everything to get that car and just decided to leave. There was a dream where I did not exist at all. I think it was about a boy playing a sport, maybe basketball.

Last night I dreamt that I was getting married. I remember having my dress but nothing else. My family was there all ready for the ceremony but I wasn't ready. My aunts took me to the store to finish buying my shoes and veil, but we didn't get to the stores on time and they closed. I remember being mad because nothing was going right.

In my dream, I was working in Mexico as an office clerk. My boss was a friend of mine. My mom also worked there. We weren't really working because a bomb was going to be dropped in the city. I remember wanting to collect all the Tarzan posters, and my boss gave me a poster as a gift. My boyfriend also worked there, but nobody was really working, everybody was just talking and I was looking for posters.

I went shopping in my dream. I went shopping with my dad, sister, and boyfriend. I remember getting into the car with gift wrap. The car was leaking oil and so we had a hard time getting the car started.

Last night I had a dream about being on a boat with other people. I remember having servants helping me. I also remember being afraid to ride roller coasters that were on the boat. There was also a famous person on the boat, Julia Roberts. I walked around the boat riding the coasters.

I dreamt about going to Washington, DC. I went to Washington, DC twice. The first trip was with a club and the second was with my two sisters.
