I remember asking one of the guys where he was going, and he said Puerto Rico. The next thing I knew we were on the plant waiting to take off. I checked my seat belt several times, as well as my two sisters.

I dreamt that I was with a mixture of my friends from high school and my friends from college. We decided that we wanted to go swimming so we go to a pool where there are a bunch of old people sitting around the edges not talking to each other. Right as we are about to get in, one of my guy friends asks another one of my friends to a dance and she accepts right away. I didn't think this was fair at all because she already has a boyfriend. All of us proceed to get into the water and just sit and talk. The pool is out in the middle of nowhere, totally flat, and there were lots of clouds with sun shining through. We all just sat and talked and it was like all my friends from high school knew all my college friends and everyone was talking to each other like we had to know each other forever.

I dreamt that my mom and my sister came to visit me at school and we had to go take our picture in front of the mission. But by the time I had changed, everyone was gone and we couldn't get our picture taken and it made me really upset.

I dreamt that my whole family was going on vacation and we were supposed to take a cruise, but when we got to the ship it was a really old pirate ship that started to turn on its side as soon as people began to get on it. Instead of a huge rush to get off the boat, everyone was hurrying to get on. There were people all around us to help me and my sister to get on. Meanwhile, it gets really dark and it begins to storm. I remember my dad yelling at us to get on and that he would meet us there. So the captain took my hand and pulled me and my sister inside. Once in there, everything was quiet and dark, and everything seemed to be normal. My sister and I sat down and watched TV.

I dreamt that I was with my rugby team and we were going to drive to our game. All of us are waiting outside to go and all of us were there but the coaches never showed up. We were all sitting outside on the sidewalk and it got really hot and bright. We couldn't figure out what was going on and why the weather was changing so much. All these people started coming up to us and asking us why we were just sitting there and why we didn't go swimming with the rest of the school.

I am all dressed up with my basketball team from high school, but for some reason there are 35 of us, which is more than we ever had. We wandered around with pieces of paper that said what they wanted, but we can never seem to find any of them. I had to tell my coach what was going on but I couldn't do it because I was afraid that he would get mad at me. I was really scared and made one of the other girls come with me. Right as we were going up to him all the gifts appeared and I was so relieved.

I'm walking with my rugby team in order to get to our hotel. We are in San Francisco and as we are walking, every time I want to see a site, the city turns into a miniature version and I can go anywhere I want to. Every time that this happens I am no longer with the team but rather with one of my other friends. When we finally get to the hotel there's a big scramble for who gets to stay in what room with who. For some reason that had to do with the angle with which the sun was hitting the hotel, we all had to keep walking till we got to the other side of the hotel.

I dreamt that it was New Year's Eve and that I was spending it in a rented house in the middle of nowhere. I was there with my best friend. Staying in other houses in the same area were people from my high school, most of whom I was never really friends with. There were no lights on anywhere. So people were walking from house to house in the dark and stopping by our door to make sure they were going in the right direction. While my friend and I were in the house, we were able to watch TV and the only thing that was on was a talk show with Susan Lucci and she was talking about how disappointed she was that no other celebrities chose to perform on New Year's Eve. In another dream that I had I was helping to take care of orphans, but they soon turned into two of my cousins. I took them both to a school where we all had to take our shoes off and go into a room full of play-doh and we just got to play with it the entire time. All the kids were making whatever the popular toys of the time are. I was trying to get my older cousin to play with the younger one, but she didn't want anything to do with her.

I dreamt that I was hurrying in the morning in order to get ready for class. I have to write a postcard to one of my friends who left Santa Clara last quarter. I am going as fast as I can but I just can't seem to go fast enough. I end up giving the postcard to one of my other friends to take to the post office. The whole time that this was going on my roommate was just sitting at her desk watching me run around as if nothing was wrong.

I dreamt about having a date with my boyfriend (imaginary). The guy was actually someone I know. We were in San Francisco together and went to see a play that started and then got canceled. So we went to go see a movie but the movie wasn't playing anywhere. So we went to a friend's little garden cabin and talked and hung out. Later I dreamt about being in some kind of a forest or desert with a guy, but we were able to find food in the trees. Then I was with my girlfriends from Spain in a maze of hallways (almost like an obstacle course). Everyone was discussing which club they were in and eating various sweet breads and fruit. It was a semi-academic atmosphere but had an element of a contest as well.

My dream was partly about the forbidden. I was driving my neighbor's nice SUV and I caused a crash. Some different people were my neighbors but they lived in the same house as my real neighbors. There was a younger, floppy-haired guy and a woman with a little boy toddler and another little bit older man that all lived in the same house. Some friends and I were taking care of their house but it had leaks. We put cups underneath the leaks but the cups kept filling up with water. When someone opened the washer, the whole kitchen flooded. We were watching TV and then checked the refrigerator where we found tons of junk food.

Last night I dreamt I was at a gathering of friends in the mountain with my Spanish host brother, Juan, and all of his friends (girls and guys) were there. Everyone talked and ate ice cream and had to go on an obstacle-like course. We jumped between rocks, went through tunnels. Some of the friends were smarter than others, but all were pretty good-looking. I had a second dream in which my friend Scott and I were flirting. He was putting moves on me and we had a tickle war on his bed. Strangely, there was another girl in his room, busy doing something and only occasionally interacting with us.

Last night I was on EMT duty until really late because we had four alcohol-related calls. My dream was basically a reenactment of the night's events with a little more detail and embellishment. I thought about the calls we had and reviewed what I had done right and what I could have done differently. At one point during the night, a car sped across campus going about 40 miles per hour, hit a pole, and kept going. Public safety sent the police department on them, but in my dream they were going about 80 miles per hour. In the dream, the driver was an escaped convict, and he was never caught.

At first I was with my cousin Jeremy in a hotel suite and then we went to a basketball game. I was in Washington state so lots of water around ~ lakes. I was riding a bike/cart home, but I couldn't find my way. I was going fast around corners, down hills, over rocks and I thought I was going to fall off. Then I ran into a middle-aged woman and my sister. I later was near the woman's house and wading through sand, squishy from the water from the lake. There were lots of spiders but I escaped them. The woman had a son and a little baby (that she kept in her closet). She invited me and my sister into her house and we went in and ate and watched TV.

I remember hoping that it was just a dream and even asking people in the dream when I could wake up and escape from its awful reality. In the dream I was also an EMT. I had a physiology test I was studying for and so I was up all night studying for it in my car in a school parking lot. I got about one hour of sleep and then in the morning my friend Andrea woke me up by knocking on the car window. Then a bunch of people came over and jumped on my windshield and tried and did get into my car. I think they noticed that I had been sleeping and that I was pissed, so they got out. I drove away, thinking to get rid of them, to a different part of the parking lot. There [was] a gathering of people down one aisle of the lot but I turned down it anyway. They didn't move... most were standing but a little girl was standing on the pavement with them, arms outstretched into the aisle. I drove by quickly because I was perturbed by the previous incident and tried to avoid the group in the aisle. I thought I did, but then I heard screaming and crying. I had run over the girl's hand. I got to her and could not stop apologizing, but then I noticed it was gushing blood. I applied pressure and bandaged it, but the finger had been deeply cut into. I felt overwhelming guilt. The others were glaring at me. We took her inside the school to get to a nurse/doctor and they kept asking me how this happened, and I was crying, but the doctor assured me that it was an accident. I couldn't be calmed down. They took her to the hospital and I followed (somehow we had to drive through a desert to get there). At first, it looked as though everyone would be okay, and the family was beginning to forgive me. The doctors thought the finger could just be sewed up. So I went home and was in my room. An hour or so later, two female doctors from Cowell arrived in my room and said there was bad news - the girl would have to lose the finger - she had no pulse in it. I was incredulous. I felt so terrible - here I am, an EMT, supposed to help patients but instead injuring someone and creating new patients. This all felt so real that I was sure it was true. I asked my mom if it could be a dream, but she said no because I had the gash on my forehead from when I had slammed on the breaks.

I had a dream that I was killing a friend/acquaintance, Sam. We were in a university class and we, the students and especially me, hated it. Sam was cast in a play of what we were reading and he was the bad guy. There was a clearly defined protagonist and antagonist. Sam was evil, he set off a bomb in a train or bus, raped, killed, and humiliated people. We decided to give it back to him. There were various gods: the good stone god and the evil fire god. The stone god (protagonist) crushed Sam's head through the wall so everyone could throw things at him and get revenge. There was lots of swearing and violence. I was possessed by anger/violence/rage... almost built up into mass hysteria. We strapped Sam to the wall of the auditorium and made him catch a flying bomb. He did and it blew up and Sam died. For whatever reason, I felt joy when he died, almost exhilaration.

I was on EMT duty with my partner and we got a call in Nobili #5. I jumped in my partner, Christine's, truck and we made it there in time. There is a young woman in prison who escapes with the help of a man whom she's in love with. They sneak out onto the balcony (the prison is quite nice) and just sit together and hold each other looking out at the sunset. I am there too but somehow as an observer. I can feel a warm breeze on my face, see the colors of the desert and feel the intense fear inside my chest that the guards will find us. We keep saying hush, afraid that our voices will alert the guards. Somehow from the balcony, the couple is seeing a movie or a vision of how the girl can escape. They figure it out just in time before the guard finds them.

Today I dreamt that I was at a resort. It was somewhere in the forest. We all had to go to a meeting in the main log house. Then, I was walking back towards my room when there was a ball in front of me. I was going to pick it up but decided not to.

I saw myself at some day production, it was called Water Torsade. However only a few people were in it. So I sneaked into that side and was allowed entrance. So my best friend called her boyfriend to help me. And he took forever to come. And I kept on feeling weaker and weaker and loosened the grip.

He said alright and then it was my mom, she still wouldn't let me. So I asked my uncle to help. And I went to my room to pack hoping that my mom would change her mind.

Today I dreamt that I was at home. I had just gotten out of my shower and I had on my pajamas. They were blue. The whole set. Anyhow, I was standing in front of the garage drying my hair by running my fingers through it. Suddenly a red convertible car pulled up and in it was Bill Pullman. He asked me if I wanted to go somewhere so I said sure. We left and we headed to an Indian cuisine restaurant and in there we started to talk. Then I found myself in bed and dressed for the tomorrow night.

Today l saw myself at a store. I think Target. I was in there going grocery shopping. Today I dreamt that I was married to my ex. We were already married in my dream. I was sleeping when he came in and told me that he was going to work. I dreamt that I was going to school. I woke up and went to school. I then was walking to class with a girl from my English class and another one from economics. We all went together. I dreamt that I woke up. I was making the bed, but it didn't look right. There were too many pillows. And then I realized that my family is going to have a get together party. Suddenly I'm at the party talking to my cousin. He's talking and he said that he saw the movie The General. He wasn't talking to me but to my uncle. So I joined them and said that I saw Paul Newman and Elizabeth Taylor in another movie. However, my uncle's reply was that he doesn't remember anything and no such film. My dad went looking for him and I was let alone in the cafeteria. It was lunch time, however I didn't recognize anyone. Then my teacher, religion teacher from high school, came but didn't recognize me.

Walking down a hallway, black floors. I dropped a little box that I have. I saw it fall. I saw it and I didn't pick it up. I was definitely rushing and I was with my friend. Later when I need the box I said I didn't have it. Where was it. It was at the airport on the ground where I left it.

I had a dream about the beach. There was a lot of blue, and a very high tide. I dreamt about a boy that I have some issues with. We are talking. There's a lot of tension, especially sexual. Nothing is getting resolved. There were a lot of colors, blue, green, yellow, red, pink flowers. I remember being at one of my rooms in Cabo. Master bedroom.
I'm lying down on the floor of a room. There's an old thin man sitting next to me. He is saying something but I don't hear what he's saying. Then I know my boyfriend comes in the room and we leave.

I am on my high school campus. Seems like a jungle with trees and stuff everywhere. There are animals like elephants and tigers and men trying to keep a hold of them. I remember being scared. Towards the end it seems like an animal is chasing me. A tiger I think.

I am going around asking people for directions to get to Silver Creek High School. Some people are telling me go right, left, etc. I take one person's advice but we get lost. Then I take another's advice but we get lost. Finally I find it. We drive through residential streets, near malls. I remember asking myself why I am looking for the high school and I also remember something about a graduation ceremony taking place there but I'm not sure whose.

There is a group of people running down stairs. I am one of those people. We go down each group of stairs, then we go through a door, and then we go down another pair of stairs. There is always a leader of the group. We switch leaders. At the end out of no where the next leader turns out to be a dog. Then all of a sudden I am in a building. I enter a room, there are people coming into the room as if they are coming through an airport terminal. I lead them out the room. Then all of a sudden I am going down another pair of stairs with another girl. We go down the stairs and walk across a green field like on SCU campus.

I had a dream that I was back at my home and was having dinner with my family. All six of us were there and so were three other people that I didn't know. I don't remember there being food but I remember passing things around and it was kind of hectic and chaotic.

I remember being in a hospital-like atmosphere and seeing nurses but no doctors. Everything was moving quickly/fastly (almost out of control). There were no doctors and I don't remember being a part of the scene. I felt like there was pounding in my ears. It was kind of an overwhelming scene.

I dreamt I was out in some town with my friends and I was eating something and I went to the bathroom and noticed that two of my teeth had thinned, and when I touched them they began to chip and fall out! I was so upset and worried... my friends told me to go to this dentist that was especially for out of town people.

I was at a house. Not my own, and I'm not sure if it was supposed to be. There was a lot of white in the house, one big mirror, and a table. It was me and 3 of the girls that live on my floor standing in front of the mirror, and we were getting ready to go to Disneyland, and we wanted to leave at 4:30 but we didn't leave until an hour later because the three girls I was with were too worried about how they looked, so they kept fixing themselves (hair, make-up, clothes, etc). I remember watching, not participating in it, and being so annoyed at their vanity and also that we were late. The girls kept giving each other dirty looks and were bickering, and I remember feeling anxious and annoyed. We sat down at the table and were eating cake cut into rectangles with frosting and sprinkles until 5:30, we were finally able to leave. The girls ran out to the car one way and I tried to go another but the door was locked so I, panicking, had to find the other way out. I did.

My three best friends, my boyfriend Nate, and all of my uncles, brothers, and cousins came to visit me at school. Christina was really tired but she joined in on a game that was something like indoor soccer, but all the players were connected together with sheets and were barefoot. It was summer and nice weather, and all of us were sitting on a big grassy hill, watching the game. Christina got tired, so I joined the game and got tied to a gross boy that kept trying to get closer with me. I warned him that my boyfriend was watching and would be mad, then Nate came and picked me up and gave me a piggyback ride back to my family, but they were all gone. So we got into a car with my best friends and some boy friends from high school and drove around the town.

I dreamed that my grandma came to visit my mom and me at home, but I didn't get to talk to her because I was so busy. Then my mom and I went to our doctor's appointment at our new tribal clinic. The place was huge, though. It was also the Oaho Tribe offices and the little headstart. My mom and I kept wandering around, looking for the bathroom, and we kept finding more stuff. There was a kitchen where my cousins were working and making free breakfast of hash browns, ham, eggs, and blueberry muffins, and I got in line to eat next to some cute guys, but the food ran out so we all sat on the rug and watched a movie while we waited. Then we all piled into a car and drove around my reservation. They dropped me off at home and I finally had a chance to talk to my grandma.

I dreamed that I got to spend a lot of time with Christina. In my dream we just hung out, listening to music and talking about our boyfriends and school. It was nice weather, summer, and we put on roller blades and just went around everywhere. She told me how she missed me and our two other best friends since we all went away for college. We went back to her house and I noticed she had a baby blanket that looked very similar to mine. We were then at work at the beach (Sand Harbor at Lake Tahoe), both wearing ranger outfits and hanging out in the fee booth.

One nice dream was one with my good friend Christina; we were dyeing our hair. I then dreamed I was at my little brother's wrestling match, watching him wrestle. I was all nervous and excited. Then I dreamed I was playing with my sweet little cousin Roman. He lives in Nevada but I dreamed that he and I were walking around campus. My next dream I was with my boyfriend cross-country skiing in Tahoe.

I dreamed that I was at my best friend's house, but it was bigger, with stairs and tons of windows, and some crazy guy was trying to kill us. We were so scared, we kept running from him but couldn't ever get out of the house. I was able to run out and stop a car and go over to my friend's cousin's house, and I waited there, frightened for her and her sisters and cousins to come. Once we got there, we were still scared to death, but we started playing Nintendo or something like that.

I was pregnant with twin boys. I also dreamed that I was at a cross-country race cheering on two kids that I didn't recognize, and I had my little cousin Roman with me. We just ran up a big hill and splashed mud and water onto each other.

I was playing basketball with my two best friends at our high school, then we drove to our other best friend's house in Carson that she shares with her boyfriend. In my dream, Christina had a little baby girl that was walking around. I knew I was dreaming because she has no kids. We made spaghetti and sat around watching Dumb and Dumber. Then we started dancing in my friend Molly's dorm room to African jungle music, but Christina was ballet dancing.

I dreamed about school; it was already Tuesday and I hadn't studied for my psychology midterm or done anything for my English papers that were due that day. I was also in my psychology class taking notes on the women's movement. My other dream I was at a golf tournament and laughing at people who missed their putts because their ball rolled down the big hill and they had to chase it. I was interviewing players about how teenagers are today. Then I was watching American Pie with my friend Jake.

I was with my boyfriend in his hometown for a basketball tournament. There were kids and adults all around the parking lot outside of the gym because there were two tournaments going on. Nate and I were holding hands, walking to the gym, when we saw my ex-boyfriend Raul, who was also playing in the tournament. I let go of Nate's hand slowly walked up to Raul, except all of a sudden he looked like Nate, but I knew it was Raul. We hugged for a few seconds, where I felt my heart jump, and then Nate and I sat down with Raul and made sandwiches for lunch on top of his white car. I wanted to be closer to Raul, to talk to him, but couldn't because Nate was there. My next dream I was running with my high school coach on a pretty trail in Lake Tahoe. The scenery was beautiful and it was nice to run with my old coach, except there were steep hills that were scary because we couldn't run up them because they were so steep.

I dreamed I was at a basketball tournament at the gym on my reservation and my dad (who's been dead for four years) was announcing and making everybody laugh. I was laughing at his jokes as well, but was confused when he wouldn't talk to me and seemed like he didn't know me. My next dream I was at a friend's house and everything was very detailed. Her house was similar in my dream. My basketball team from high school was mostly there and we all laughed and made tacos. Next we were in a friend's car, speeding around town on our way to toilet paper somebody's house. I felt excited and happy to be with my high school friends again.

First, I would be in this world where my mind was being challenged by this spiral. It would chase me around and around. Another part when I fell back to sleep I was floating in all these balloons, all different colors, and all of sudden they all popped and I fell and right as I was about to hit the ground, I woke up.

I was pacing up and down my living room thinking about this book I had read the night before. I had my head down the whole time, when I came to the end of the room there was a window at the end, I looked up and I discovered a man's face was right there two feet away staring at me. I don't remember his face. I turned around, and as I walked away he shot me in the back. Everything before this was black and white, after this happened everything turned red.

I was on an airplane heading to Hawaii when all of sudden I hear singing. I recognize his voice, that I thought it was my boyfriend's. Instead this man comes from behind me and sneaks his face around. It turns out to be Brad Pitt. He sits down next to me and we began to talk. He is calling me Jennifer. I realize that all I want to do is get off the plane and get on him. It switches to where we are in the desert sweating together, riding camels. We are obviously lost.

We, meaning me and my friends from high school, were registering for classes. We called it arena. So we went to arena together and we were all going to try to get into this English class except the line was too long, so they waited in line while I went and signed up for another class. When I came back everyone was gone. All of sudden guys in all black jumped out and had guns put to my head. I tried to run but got shot down instead. When I fell I realized that my friends were on the ground in their blood. We were all looking at each other when they guys shot at us again
My boyfriend called me at 7:45 and woke me up. After we hung up the phone (I was dreaming but it felt so real), 15 minutes after, I dreamt that he called me back and he was telling me to get [up].

My family and I were going on a trip by car, who knows where. While on the freeway, we had seen cops on the freeway stopping everyone. Only one lane was open. We had some pictures on us (4) one of me and my uncle, me and my family, me and my dad, and I don't remember the fourth. My dad knew they wouldn't let the picture of me and my uncle pass, so we had to pull over to get rid of it. When we were getting rid of it, it happened in slow motion. When we stopped to show them the pictures, they marked the pictures in a certain area. The mark was turquoise and thick. I was mad because they ruined the pictures.

I had a dream that my friend Jennifer came over to visit me so we can go watch a baseball game, a girls' baseball game and Johnny was playing short stop. I was jealous because he wanted to play with the girls. I went back to my dorm and my little sister opened to door for me. When I got to my door my RA left an easel with a note that said if I wanted it. Along the way I [saw] other girls with better gifts. When I went into my room, Jennifer told me she would be right back. She went to Jamba Juice and only brought back samples and one sandwich back. My dad came goodbye and Jennifer got up. He was going to give her a hug goodbye but she walked right passed him so she can take down a baby fence. Someone gave me a diamond stud earring to put in my second hold but it wouldn't fit because the rod wasn't pointy.

My calculus professor was looking at all my work and was trying to figure out why I was getting good grades. He ended up finding out that it was my second time taking calculus, that I had taken it in high school. I felt worried in my dream. I didn't know why he was so determined to find out how I got my good grades. It was like he was hoping to find out something else, whatever that is.

I had a dream I was on a ferris wheel that [kept] moving around and around, ceasing to stop. Everyone was looking up at me and I was scared. Then I was with my mom, shopping in the mall and trying on shoes. We were eating in a Chinese restaurant with my aunt and uncle, and the food was spicy.
I had a dream where I was with my sisters and we were at our house playing board games and baking cookies. I was babysitting them.

I dreamt that my boyfriend and I were walking on a beach at sunset, holding hands and gazing at the waves. It was a very peaceful dream full of intense conversation. We were discussing things which we have talked about in real life, and the importance of fate in life and our feelings about each other.

Last night my dream took place in my old high school gym, and it seemed to bear recognition to my senior prom dance, although with different aspects involved. I was in my prom dress surrounded by my friends, and we were all eating birthday cake around a large, oblong table and singing happy birthday to my one friend Ashleigh. She was crying, and her sister was trying to comfort her as she blew her candles out. All the sudden, we were at this Mexican restaurant in my hometown taking tequila shots, except my family was there as well, even my dog. The restaurant changed settings and began to resemble my house, and I was walking down a hallway towards a fountain. My ex-boyfriend was standing behind the fountain, throwing pennies in it and making a wish.

I dreamt that I was on a farm moving very fast and I was looking out the window onto the landscape outside. I saw rolling hills and cars and farmhouses, but I was very confused at to where I was. My best friend was sitting next to me with her walkman on and a puzzled look on her face. We were singing along to one of our favorite Dave Matthews songs. All the sudden, the train jerked stop and I woke up very suddenly from the dream.

I had a dream that was set in South America at a place I had been to last summer with my family, in Machu Piccu. I was with my family and we were hiking up a mountain in the hot sun. My sisters were older, so the dream lacked realistic aspects. It was very vivid in detail, with lots of bright colors and sounds. No matter how far we climbed up the mountain, we never made it to the top. My parents kept arguing and it was very confusing.

It starts out with a scene of rain, which looks similar to my grandparents' bedroom, with a sofa and a bed, and it feels like there is a slow motion camera zooming in very slowly with eerie music. It shifts to a scene near an ice cream shop, outside where I am waiting on a bench. All the sudden I see a huge scary mechanical shark with huge jaws, and I am in his mouth as he snaps his teeth. I think I'm going to die being eaten by the shark.

It took place in a hotel, very reminiscent of a hotel I stayed in last spring in Mexico. I also identified the setting with this Mexico trip because the people in the dream were all friends and peers from high school that went to Mexico with me. One of which was an old crush of mine. I remember him being in the dream very vividly. We were all out on a patio hanging out, and I don't remember what was going on, but a lot of action/events were going on. Then, the dream shifted and my aunt and cousins were there, in the same setting.
I dreamt I was at Benson and I ate a huge dinner. First I had a huge hamburger and french fries and then I had a big Ed ice cream sandwich. After I ate it I remember feeling disgusted with myself.

Last night I dreamt that my good friend from high school was visiting us at Santa Clara and we showed she and her friend around our campus. We all loved our school. I had another dream that I was shopping for clothes with all my friends. I remember I didn't find anything I like.

I had a dream that I went to my house to have dinner with my family but I invited my ex-boyfriend, Chris. Chris brought his new girl to my house and hooked up with her right in front of me. At some point in the dream, my dad and I went to the grocery store. We ended up on a dirt road and we were four-wheeling. We hit a bump and flew ten feet in the air, right when I took my seatbelt off. I was fine and it was tons of fun. Later on in the dream I was back at my house and we were celebrating Christmas.

I had a dream my sister was telling me we were going to have to study all night and then go to practice early because we decided to go to Yumi Yogurt for a study break. It screwed everything up. I also remember that this one guy that I think is really cool was at Yumi Yogurt with a girlfriend.

I was at my friend Maritza's house. It was her brother's birthday party. I was helping him clean his room and my hair got muddy. Maritza helped me wash it in the sink. My friend Frank came over and we started kissing each other.

I was at school and after I was with my friends. Ricky, my boyfriend, was there and I saw him standing next to a girl holding her hand. I went up to him and he went with me to talk. Then I remember us being at a house were arguing about what happened. We also went to a pizza place and were playing video games. My uncle Sergio was there, he was drunk. My family got into a big argument and everyone left. I also remember someone standing in front of me forcing me to say I love you. That person forced my boyfriend to kiss.

I was looking through a window and saw my tata and wife sitting at a dinner party. They were about to kiss when she (tata's wife) fell from her chair. I asked if she had a heart attack and they told me it was my sister that was sick.

Me and three other people (can't remember who) had to clean up. I remember scrubbing the walls with a sponge. Me and Mo were talking about getting tickets (for game), someone came in, fought with Mo and killed him. Then that person drove himself off a cliff (with a car). I asked him why and he said he felt guilty.
All I remembered is dreaming about my best friend Mare. She told me her head hurt and when I looked at the back of her head there was a big hole in her skull.

I remember being with a group of friends (cheerleaders?) and it was raining. We kept on calling Judy, telling her to hurry. Then I remember being at my grandma's old house watching TV with Ricky in the washroom. My aunt was telling us we should help with something. My mom rushes out wearing black and gets into a limo with a for sale sign on it. I also was at work with Juan and Susie when I rang a customer up the computer charged him $99 to rent a movie. I got help from Juan to fix it. He asked which movie and I said Bowfinger.

I was in my home town and me and 3 friends went to a restaurant for dinner and I decided to leave and we had all brought our own cars. Some people came out of the restaurant too. It was dark and I was a little scared and got to my car as fast as I could but then couldn't figure out which key was it and when I finally did I was very surprised because it didn't seem like the right one but it worked. Then I drove to a friend's house and found her. She was having a party and we walked out the door to leave and a bunch of girls were on the porch and all said bye. Then one girl on the porch said something about the other, and the girl ran off crying and my friend and I wanted to figure out what was wrong, so we went to another party where she ran to and found our other friend, who was talking to the girl and another person, so we just kind of listened.

I remember being at home with my boyfriend and we were not getting along well. We were at my house and I was having a party and the lights were dark and there were white Christmas lights with music planning and every one having a good time. We were in a corner talking and I got very upset and told him how he was not treating me fairly and that he doesn't want to be together. I started crying and he got upset and every one was just ignoring us. But we ended up breaking up.

I am with two friends from Santa Clara and we are supposed to be walking around campus, but some of it looks like home, many hills, and some looks like school. We're lost because we went in the back entrance and lost all sense of direction and we are all arguing. We walk past a dorm that looks like ours but isn't and we cannot figure out where to go. I am so frustrated and I want to take charge but every turn that looks right ends up being wrong so we all continue to argue.

I am in this big toy store, it's almost like a warehouse and the aisles are so long and there are so many different choices. One thing that bothers me is that the walls must go up like 20 feet so it is impossible to reach. I am looking for a gift for my cousin and I have the hardest time deciding. So this one guy helps me with a question. I remember my cousin saying to make sure the toy was this specific one and there was another one that looked just like but didn't have as many features. In the middle of talking to the sales person he gets a phone call and he still tries to help me but is on the phone so I look myself and I keep coming to check with him and he's still on the phone, but it doesn't bother me. I am just afraid I won't be able to reach something, but I always do.

Me and a bunch of friends from Santa Clara were at my home town swimming pool where I used to practice and it was like we were a team and my coach Paul was there. At first we just swam laps like we wanted. By then Paul got upset because he thought we weren't working hard enough. Also I had this sweatshirt that I kept moving. I would get out of the water and move it. So Paul gave us a set and we swam for a while. We could do it in any order and for some reason I refused to do the same order as my friend's. All the sudden we were at this store that has this tank offish, and en eel. I hate the eel, it scares me so much. I think that it is going to jump out of the tank or something. So I am trying to show people this eel and that it is really vicious, but it is not moving, it just looks at me. Then I realize there are two, and that one won't move either. So I tap on the glass a little and nothing happens. All the sudden it moved and went into a hole right by the side of the glass and I thought it was going to slither out of the tank and get me. I screamed and asked my friend if he saw that and then I looked at the fish for a bit and woke up. Oh yeah and it was gross because the store smelled really fishy.

My family (Mom, Dad, brother) and I were driving in the car, an old car of ours that we sold a long time ago, and we had luggage like we're on a road trip. We get to a house, not one I recognize, but we will be staying there. There is no one else there. All the beds are very nicely made and it is very clean. As we are walking around, and beginning to like the place, my dad comes in and tells us we are leaving. Of course we don't want to, we just drove forever, but then my mom comes and in and - she is upset -says we have to go because they are getting a divorce. Now, as we are all upset, we pile into the car, without my dad and drive. All of a sudden we are in front of either a high school or middle school and I get out of the car to meet a friend of mine, who I don't know in real life, but she is a good friend I guess and we are both in dresses. We walk in and there are many others there in dresses, we are at a school dance. We have boas that we want to get rid of, but we saw 2 girls we hate go into the principal's office, the place we put our boas. She (my friend) is too afraid just to walk in there, but I don't care so I just walk in and she follows. The two girls don't say anything, but we glare at each other. My friend is very nervous and I just put my boa where I see fit and she follows. Then we walk out. Just as we are going to walk into the gym doors, where music is coming from, I wake up.

The dream started out in front of the graham living complex where I am with a bunch of my friends. I am getting tired and need to do work so I go inside. When I enter the door I am in my room and as soon as I come in my friend Brian appears. He is wearing a bathrobe and jeans and decides he is going to change and starts to put on a shirt when two girls throw the door open, which Brain is behind, and I don't remember who they were but I don't really like them. But they ask me if anything ever happened between me and my friend Aaron and I say no and they tell me what he said and then leave. Right after that I hear gun shots and look out the window, but it is dark. This happens 2 more times. Finally Brian hears it too and we see a guy in black with a neon gun. Before the first shot a big group had been forming a circle on the lawn and one of the men got shot in the leg. The gunman realizes he can't see anything and says Fine, I guess I will just have to wait until tomorrow when it gets light and waves his gun around. I try calling 911 - Brian has left - but all I get is an automated machine. Frustrated, and somehow knowing they (the gunmen) were after me. I jump out the window. It is now light and some how the girl (the gunman's helper) finds me and I try to run. The scenery turns into the country on a farm and we fight. No one really getting hurt. Some random postman comes around the corner with a gun and I tell him to shoot. Just as he aims the gunman comes and pushes him. The girl and I continue to fight, in which I am starting to win, but she is so strong. Then the two men fight.

I was at home surrounded by family. Suddenly there is a knock at the door, than a group of strangers walked in. My family seemed OK with these people, but I wasn't. One of these strangers (a woman) sat across from me. I was sure that I knew her from high school, and I hated her. At one point she excused herself to the bathroom, and when she came back I saw lines on her face, she was much older than what I had initially thought, we could not have attended high school together, now I hate her more. The guests invite us to go to the movies with them, I refuse, my family is shocked by my rudeness. Suddenly our dog starts to make the most horrifying sounds, his in pain. I start to cry and freak out and am surprise that the rest of my family doesn't react the same way. My uncle carries the dog to another room and everyone follows. There is another knock, this time the visitors are the friends of our guest. I don't know anyone of them, but of them knows my youngest brother. These people go to the living room, which is huge and empty, looking nothing like my real house. I go to check on the dog. I can clearly hear him but I can't see him. He's behind a curtain with the rest of my family. What are they doing?? All I can see are bumps behind the curtain. Then there is a strong earthquake, we shake a lot but there is no damage. This all happens at night. In the next scene it's morning. My uncle has been sleeping on the sofa. The dog is still whimpering, however my uncle tells me that he is doing fine he just whimpers more when others are around, he wants attention. The dog is no longer behind the curtain. The curtain blows by the wind and I can see nothing but light (very bright) though the sliding door behind it.

It was about a movie. It started when a group of people (I think they were 3) went to an exotic country with a primitive government. They became very good friends with the leader who ended up being a psychopath who was ordering their murder behind their backs. Even more bizarre was the fact he was always present and took pleasure in the murders. Although a made-up movie, the dream was so real that the actors/actresses are really actors/actresses.

I was on a movie scene. The whole dream was based on a few scenes, which seemed to be about the conflicts of two brothers. At one point one of the brothers gave me some flowers - to keep them fresh I put them in a Coke-water.

I was in the cafeteria at Santa Clara University, however in my dream was nothing like the real cafeteria. In fact at one point I had to pass through what appeared to be a clothing store to get where I could give my order. Once there, a woman just handed me a tray of food without asking me what I wanted. I said nothing, but once outside I shared the experience with a female student who was having her lunch. She told me that it was normal here to be handed a tray of food you did not ask for because the food service workers - who were also English instructors - picked for you.

I was riding in a small plane, but I was not the one controlling the plane. I couldn't really see the pilot although he was beside me. I don't know what he looked like, but I'm sure that the pilot was a man. In an unrelated dream I slapped a man. However, again I don't know who he was or what he looked like. All I know is that he had brown hair

In last night's dream a series of events happened. First an old woman was burned in her house. Second my friend Matt Lauren said he was running away. When I went to go help him this African-American man followed me and tried to hurt us. I called the police. Next, my two friends from home Pat and Mike came to see me at SCU, but they took off with my friends because they were mad at me that I was still with my boyfriend. All of a sudden I'm in a convenient store with my sister and her children are now puppies, they are my sister Stacey's actual dogs. Then a whole bunch of people I totally despise appear in my dream. This girl Marie from home is parked in the handicapped spot in front of the mission. I start screaming at her but she does not hear me. I find myself in my high school gym with this girl named Amy that I hated throughout high school and we are cheerleading together. She takes off her skirt and just wears her bloomers. My actual boyfriend is across the hall and he is smiling. Then I walk outside the gym and there is a fight and no one is breaking it up. These two kids are truly beating the crap out of one another and no one seems to care.

Last night's dream took place at a Volkswagen van dealership. Only the vans were decorated with material like carpets and rugs. I believe that they looked like a cowboy-ish like style. I knew that I was in competition with the car place, and at one point I was laying on one of the vans trying to seduce some guy, but I don't think I recognized the face. I also remember my boyfriend and maybe my roommate being there.

The first was me in a chem or bio lab, and I wanted to be partners with my two friends Erin and Natalie but they didn't want me to. So I ended up being partners with this weird guy and I've never even seen him at all before. Then he started telling us a story, when I looked around I saw my friend Paul from home and my high school chemistry teacher. The story he told became real and at times I was in it. It had to do with an old man leaving his enormous family of girls and all the girls were friends of mine, either from home or here at college. Then I was to marry this old man but he left me in the boat with my ugly wedding dress on and he was standing on a cliff. I was not that upset though. And then suddenly it became a different girl, not me in the dream.

Last night's dream had to do with me and a lot of random people that I know and all of us in some sort of school. The girl who was my teacher was younger than me and already did not like me because she was dating one of my ex-boyfriends. I believe she taught English and that I rarely went so my grades were terrible. I remember taking tests on the women's reproduction system and crazy things like that. My boyfriend was there, but he was dating someone else and I was extremely angry. I know that I hated that school and I never wanted to go, because I hate everyone there. I was in some kind of drama, but I can't remember.

Last night my dream was about me and my boyfriend. We were at his college and he and I were running around while he was introducing me to his friends. The day was sunny and I was really happy to be there. They only weird thing was this shirt I’ve had my eyes on from J. Crew was in my dream. Only it was on this guy that Chris introduced me to.

Last night's dream was based around my friend Collin and it took place in a school, but it wasn't SCU. I liked Collin a lot and he lived (lives) on a floor with a whole bunch of acquaintances of mine, which made it very awkward. My dream last night took place in a really old hotel, but it was beautiful. My friend Erin and her friend from home Travis were also there. I had to paint Valentines on the outside of the building. I know that it took place near the ocean and I was agitated most of the time. My friends Allison and (I think) my ex-boyfriend Joey were there. My first dream was one of me and my friend hiding from something, (I don't know), and we ended up in a drive way with dirt all around us. I felt scared. The next dream was of me and my friend (roommate) Morgan and we were stuck somewhere with people who I recognized but did not like. We were trying to eat or get money because the two of us were somewhat stranded in this grungy town. The only people we knew were our friends Jim and Travis and they were living in a bathroom, I think! The last dream I can remember is really weird. I wasn't in it, I was a either observing or was the middle-aged guy. It was a young couple, this neurotic women, and I think an older married couple and all in this house there was all sorts of psychic crap everywhere and the younger guy got mad at the neurotic women because she was invading their privacy and he pushed this glass container that became activated and started doing a whole bunch of weird stuff. But I only watched from a hole in the bathroom. I also had another dream about my parents having a dinner party and my best friend Allison, but then she just disappeared. At another part my boyfriend Chris was really sick and all he wanted to do was study and practice soccer until he almost died.

My dream was that I was at school and my (either my chem or calc) teacher thought that one of us was smoking pot before class. Everyone thought it was me because I had been at a house across the street from Swig until early morning hours and people had been smoking. Only my teacher was a male instead of my real women teachers I actually have and he flipped out. Even though I didn't smoke I lead my class to believing I had and we were going to take a test. My teacher was asking questions like Have you watched Alice in Wonderland? to see how we would respond and he was going to figure out who had been smoking marijuana.

Part of my dream last night had to do with killing this guy in self-defense. I was with one of my friends and we used her Swiss army knife and killed this guy by jabbing it in his leg and his throat. I remember that it was not really an actual murder, it was a test to see if I could actually do it. Another part of my dream was being on a diving board and trying to jump out of the water because the diving board was actually in the pool with the water covering it. It was like another test to see what I could do, but I cannot remember who was giving me these tests. The faces around me are blurry, so I cannot recall who else was in my dream.

First I was in school and ran into a guy that I was seeing and we decided to get together later that night. After talking to him for a while, I continued through my day. I went to classes and work but I don't remember that I just know I did it. Then later that night I went to my friends dorm room (guy #1) but it was not the dorms I ended up being at a house and as I was going to look for my friend I ran into another guy (#2) that I was talking to. There were other guys around him and they wanted to make him drink but he is not allowed to drink because he is pledging. So he stopped me and asked me to help him. When he started to talk to me he sounded completely wasted, so I was confused about the fact that he was drunk but he wanted me to help him. He started hugging me and had me sit by him. Then I remembered that I was supposed to go see guy #1 but guy #2 wouldn't let me go. The last thing I remember is trying to go look for guy #1.

I was dreaming I was with my ex-boyfriend. But in the dream my ex-boyfriend looked like my friend, the one who slept in the same bed as me. In the dream I knew he didn't look like my ex-boyfriend but I thought it was him. We were hanging out and talking about getting back together in my dream. The last thing I remember was the two of us hanging out at a basketball court.

I remember dreaming about the news, about a murder. I was not scared during my dream because I was watching the news in my dream and the murder was in a far city. I don't really recall what they were saying on the news but I remember that they were talking about a murder and that it seemed to be a different decade like back in the days.
The last dream I remember was about school. I just remember being in my class but I don't know what class it was.
Another dream was about my little brother, he was playing basketball against his friend outside our house and I was telling him to get inside and do his homework.

One of them involved me going to visit my cousin, but I was not going to her house, it was a house that was not very familiar to me but I don't remember how to get there or very many details of the house.
I had a dream about my roommate coming home and talking to me about what she did that day, but I don't remember what she was saying. Then I started to dream that I was reading for psychology.
I remember a dream with my cousin and her son. We were shopping. We all went shopping. Then my dream went into school. I was dreaming about being in my classes.
I had a dream that I was walking down a street in some city and a homeless midget man walked by, with kind of a baby face. Then he tried to take my purse and I wouldn't let him.

I had a dream that I was driving down to my house on a semi-country road, and everything was green and beautiful. Then I was at my Aunt Michelle's house and my Aunt Grace was there, and I was telling her about the drive.

The first dream I had I was a greeter for a really nice store, somewhere in LA. I was having a good time when my friends would visit me there, and I felt important. The second dream I had I was at this one beach area with my boyfriend and his friend. We were on a cliff watching some large fish or whale when the rough waters went over. We had to run really far back to avoid getting swallowed up in the water. It was scary but fun.

I had a dream I was with my boyfriend and his best friend. We were in downtown San Jose and I needed to get back to SCU. My boyfriend told me to go and take my friend Ali's car, so we went to the parking lot and I said she was very particular on who would drive her car, so my boyfriend drove me home, but we got out at the train station, and were walking around there.

I had a dream that I went to Park City to visit my cousins there for Christmas and we were going to a play. I was way overdressed in a maroon velvet dress because they were all wearing khakis. We met in a mall then we walked around it, talking about last week's episode of Dawson's Creek.

I had one dream where we were all switching dorm rooms in a big warehouse, and I got this huge open space as my room. I was very excited. There was another dream where I was back home, sitting in front of my house, talking with my friends at home. My friend Joy was telling me that one of my friends dropped out of Northwestern to meet boys. This made me angry and frustrated. Then my friends left to go to this one girl I don't like's house to listen to her sing and look at her hamsters. My final dream was I went shopping with Matt Damon, who later turned into some actress I can't remember, but it was a positive, bonding experience.

In my dream this morning I had just gotten some kittens to take home. After that I was listening to my radio and people were talking about plants. I was away at some retreat center, there were lots of Redwood trees.
I think a friend of mine was an elementary principal. Telling us not to do well because he wouldn't have anything to or his work would be too hard.
I was dreaming about doing something with my friend. I went to her house and sat with her friends trying to decide what we were going to do.
I dreamt that my boyfriend and his fraternity friends were arguing about whether I should be invited to dinner. I was already invited, they were trying to decide if it was fair.

The first part I can remember was me and a group of friends waiting outside on a sidewalk in an obscure location to go out to dinner. A bus showed up to take us and we got in. The driver asked for directions the whole way and no one knew what to tell him. Finally, we ended up where we were supposed to but it wasn't a restaurant, it was the house of a friend of mine from grade school who I haven't talked to since, and all of my boyfriend's family was inside - the only real difference was that his 14 year old sister was 2 or 3 in my dream. There was never actually a dinner, and the house turned into a store and everyone was going shopping for Christmas presents for each other. The last I remember was my boyfriend's cousin telling everyone to let the driver know if they needed a ride home.

I was at my house, in my parents' bedroom. I was laying on the floor on my back and so was my younger sister, and our parents were sitting on the floor in front of us. I had just gotten back from a vacation to some island, but when my parents asked which one I couldn't remember and got very frustrated and upset. I went into the basement and fell asleep on the floor there. My dad came down and I pretended to be asleep for awhile before sitting up and talking to him. I do not remember the conversation, and even while I was dreaming it, the words I said and heard were very indistinct.

I dreamt that a group of teachers were having meetings at a school, and some students - 5 or 6 - snuck into the building and started to build a forest with huge slides that led down to an imaginary place where the teachers couldn't go. This dream was so strange because I was in it, I just wasn't me. I was one of the kids, but was not even me at that age -1 was one of the little boys, but I was thinking my own thoughts.

My parents, younger sister and I were on vacation. We drove a blue station wagon to some lake which turned out to be the wrong destination, because a group of men came after us with guns. My dad drove the car through the lake to the other side and we found a cave, so we left the car, grabbed a bag full of money, left everything else and hid in the cave. The cave had two levels - the top one, which we were in, and the bottom, which is where the men with the guns lived, and which we could see through windows between the two levels. My parents left the cave to find a way to escape, and while they were gone, the men came up after me and my sister, so we left the cave running and when we lost them, we threw the bag of money into the lake.

I dreamt that I was home and that it was snowing in blizzard-like amounts. My boyfriend came and picked me up because we were going on a road trip and we drove despite the foot or so of snow on the ground. The only place we stopped was at a very small Blockbuster to get a movie, but they didn't have what we wanted. The rest of the dream was just us driving through snow. I remember there being some conversation, but I cannot remember details of it.

I dreamt that I went over to my boyfriend's house while he was still away at school and visited with his family. I was helping his mom make salad while his dad talked to me about football. His little sister came to get me and told me that he was on the phone, so I talked to my boyfriend until his mom yelled down the stairs that it was time for dinner. He told me to say hi to his family. I remember feeling like his family was actually my family as opposed to his.

I dreamt that I was in a forest all by myself. It was dark and lonely and I was completely alone. I remember running through the trees and crying. I was so scared because it was completely dark. Everything was really big and I was so small. I couldn't get out and I was so scared. The trees were black and the sky was gray.

I dreamt about the same girl who screwed me over with my ex-boyfriend. She was all dressed up in a gown with diamonds and I was yelling at her but she couldn't hear me. I was frustrated because I wasn't getting through to her. She was bigger than me. I just remember looking at myself as this sad and small person who was like running around and not getting anywhere.

I dreamt that my ex-boyfriend/best friend was sick with a disease and he was going to die within a few days. I was so sad and upset. I was frustrated too because there was nothing I could do to help him. Actually, he had 3 diseases and I specifically remember one being called GABA. They were sexually transmitted diseases and I remember doubting my own health. I was so sad he was going to die because I feel like he is my soul mate.

I dreamt that I saw this girl I used to be really good friends with before she screwed me over with my ex-boyfriend. She was all dressed up in a fancy red gown with lots of jewelry. She was wearing diamonds. I was really small and she was really big. I was yelling at her for the things she did. But she couldn't hear me. I kept yelling at her, but I couldn't get through. I was frustrated and she just kept prancing around.

I dreamt last night that I was fighting with my best friend. She was yelling at me and I was crying. But I don't really know what we were fighting about. I was just really angry. We were outside in a park and it was cold. The fight kept going on and it wouldn't stop. I kept yelling at her. She had on a white shirt and gray pants.

I dreamt that I was hanging out with my ex-boyfriend. But he was different. Everything was blurry and mixed-up. He looked different too but I still knew it was him. He was helping me through a problem. We were in a school cafeteria. But I didn't even feel close to him. I still felt alone even though he was with me.

It was about some sorority girls and they were mean to me. I was in this big house with lots of windows and my friend Molly in Delta Gamma was talking to me. I felt distant from her. All the sorority pledges lined up in a line and were given gifts. But they wouldn't give me a gift.

I dreamt about my date or me finding the right guy for me. I dreamt that we were going to a place. It's split to two groups going to two, far places. And because of my clumsiness that I made the other group late. I thought I couldn't find something, and making Jason and his group late because he helped me find it. I felt so bad that when I apologized, I cried. When we got there, I met a guy. He's a good guy, but I was afraid my dad won't approve
There were staircases. I remember someone helping me to move packages up an down the stairs to my new apartment. They were very helpful.

I dreamt about the church people again. Okay, this is with our youth group. We went to the beach, then I dreamt I was working with a couple of people, and Alice, my friend. We help each other, do each other's favors and so on. Then I remember playing this video game and we had to conquer this for us to get the job. I asked Alice for help, she told me to get her stuff and I did. As Alice was helping me, we talked and got caught up in each other's lives.

I dreamt about food. Not eating, but the process of eating. We went to a restaurant with Stephen (an old youth group fellowship counselor). And we were waiting in line for the food while talking about his son and so forth

I remember that I was being kidnapped, but I negotiated for the napper to take me a little later because I had other things or activities that I didn't want to miss out. So I did that and when I went back to the same place (it was the restrooms, BTW), he kidnapped me. Then I was sent to talking with Jason (one of the leaders of my fellowship) and we were talking about insignificant things - making chit-chat.

I dreamt about learning Physics and how math was so much easier than Physics because math doesn't need memorization. We were just discussing this in a classroom-based environment. Before that we were at the library and discussing books.

Something about technology. I was walking with a friend back to my dorm room. We were talking about BCF. Before that we were at BCF and had a Bible study and I felt awkward in there. During the entire time I was looking through a computer. Then, we were at a train station and I was seeing a friend off

I remembered dreaming of my roommate and my friend. We were at BCF (Bronco Christian Fellowship) at one of our community dinners and one of the leaders was just telling us stories from China. It was very interesting. Before that, we were ice-skating or maybe it was boxing. Maybe both. But we had [to] pass the ice-skating test in order to box. Before that, we were in UC Dams, in a convention of some sort and I saw my high school piano teacher there and a boxing tournament/rink in the middle of the convention. Everyone was watching it, including me, but I kept walking around trying to find people.

Last night I dreamt that I called in sick to work because I was visiting my dad in the hospital (in Sacramento). But when I called my manager he didn't believe me. He was accusing me of just not wanting to come in. I was frustrated. I started yelling at him. He told me that I had to bring a doctor's note if I wanted to keep my job. I was sad and mad and frustrated all at the same time.
Last night I dreamt that my grandfather was getting more and more sick (unhealthy). In my dream the Alzheimer's was very advanced. I went to see him and he didn't know who I was. I started to cry.

I dreamt that my sisters and I went shopping, we drove my car. The shopping mall was exactly as it appears in real life. When we came out of the store, my car was gone. It had been stolen. We notified the police and then later they said they had found it. It was all vandalized when I saw it. The tires were gone, it was propped up on bricks. The windows were broken and whoever did this spray painted all over the white paint.

Last night I dreamt that my father passed away. We were on a plane to take his body back to Guam, his home. We had to stop over in San Francisco to switch flights so we went shopping to look for clothes to dress him in. This store was very strange. It was built on a hill so in order to shop you had to climb the hill inside the store. I found myself very exhausted. I was having trouble breathing because of climbing up this hill to shop.

I dreamt that four or five Asian men broke into our home at night. They had guns but they didn't want to hurt anybody. They were looking for someone or something. I snuck out of the house but couldn't find anywhere to hide. One of the men found me and told me it was ok to go back home. I did and the men were gone.

I dreamt my boyfriend and I were looking at my cousin's house that is for sale. We were thinking of buying it. When we got there, the house was a disaster. There was still items of theirs in the house. The carpets and walls were filthy. We decided against buying it. Then as we were leaving, some lady came and wanted to buy it. She didn't care that it looked like a pig sty. She looked like she was right out of the 70 's (flower child). We left and went back home. Where my mom and my sisters were playing a game. They said that it was Scrabble but the game had game markers/pieces so I don't know what it was. During this time I was making smoothies for everyone. Even the neighbors stopped by to have some.

Today I dreamt that I was at home and enjoying my favorite home cooked dish (a Indian chicken curry dish with basil). I remember the dish being very hot (steaming) and the creamy taste of the coconut sauce. It tasted great and the dish bowl was the tradition.

I had a dream of attending a Cure concert. Anyway, the concert was at the Filmore. There was a lot of smoke and it was really hot and sweaty. I don't remember seeing The Cure perform, but I could picture Robert Smith in the stage with his crazy hair.

Again I had a rather odd dream of my frog. I kept seeing my frog in a larger and larger aquarium. My frog also seemed to get more frantic as each aquarium size increased. I recall feeling very sympathetic of my poor frog.

I had a very unusual dream about my pet frog who kept uprooting the plant in its aquarium. There were moments when my frog looked normal and then I would turn around and look at him and he would look sort of like a cartoon frog with a grin on its face. Then he would use his two front limbs (which turned into semi-hands) and pulled up the plant.

I do recall one particular dream in which two of my older, female cousins stopped by for a visit. I was at home, in the kitchen when my two cousins walked in. They had brought some green tea ice cream as a gift and both my sister (12 years old) and I quickly started to devour the ice cream. Oddly enough, the bowl in which I received my ice cream was very tube-like in shape where as my sister received hers in a normal bowl. I can remember the condensation that accumulated on the outside of my bowl because it was so cold, furthermore, I could recall tasting the ice cream as well.

I was waiting in a house that I thought was my Grandparents' old house for what I thought was supposed to be my birthday party. Turned out I was not going to get a birthday party. Then I was in a swimming pool during the day, even though it was just nighttime. Then I was talking to a TV actor, I know he is really 20-something, but in the dream he was telling me he was forty. I ran into some cousins. Ended up at the same Aunt's house I always end up at. Then I was at school where everyone was dressing up fancy and rich, like in a movie about prep school kids.

I was escaping harm. Somehow someone was cutting my face up. So I went running out into the street from this house that seemed to be my first boyfriend's house from high school. I saw a well-lit payphone in the darkness. I went there and called for help. Then I was in a mall with a bunch of tall skinny beauty queens but was one of them. Like in a bad ? & A film, we walked around in tight little T-shirts and short shorts. Then I ended up at a party given by an old high school friend where there was a lot of people there from high school. It was weird and awkward. Half the people were running around naked.

I was in an old west scene where there was a screen advertising gross graphic science fiction horror films. Then I was in a place that was a restaurant/general store where there was a red-colored cat that talked and weird people. Bad-vibe place. I went there with my boyfriend but he ended up missing half-way through the dream.

I'm moving into a big house with wood floors and lots of wood cabinetry and carvings. Apparently that was where my parents were living so wondered where they would end up. The floor of house had hinges so it could be folded up the middle. My father's mother was there acting like she was 25 when she is really 95.

I'm in my psych class and I'm upset. My friend is there with me even though she does not go to this school. I tell my teacher he has to be nicer and get out his new knee medicine because for some reason I am upset by him during class. Then, while I am still tense, I end up at one of the cabins at my Grandmother's place, though it is not hers. It is Christmas and I am still mad. Shoes keep appearing in the toilet. Everything is miserable. Then I glimpse a haunted house where Leonardo DiCaprio is one of the ghosts. Then my sister and I are at a video game arcade playing because we found a bunch of tokens.

My friend who lives in Santa Cruz apparently now lived in San Francisco in a Victorian home. A guy comes by and asks us to work in this gross club. My friend says yes, I say no. I leave on my bike and go get food when there are other people I think I know, kind of like a college town place. But I am uncomfortable. So I go back to another person's house which is also Victorian. I don't know whose house it is but I am now happy.

There was a river type thing in the middle of my old room I shared with my sister when we were kids. It was between our bunk beds. My old friend put it there. My sister and I were upset. Then my present friend got a new house, a Victorian one. There was a party there. Then I was with that friend at a club where a man was bothering us for cigarettes. We don't smoke. I ended up at my Aunt's house again where she was not home so I took her trash to the curb for her.

There was a big fancy Beverly Hills house, with a lot of cherry wood furniture and cabinetry inside. The house even had its own elevator. The whole time I was there trying to keep a group of kids out. Then I was at a bar that was supposed to be the bar on Cheers. Then I'm in a tall building where the elevator is falling. But I escape somehow. I end up at the McDonald's in that building where Bill Cosby is eating with some kids.

I was younger playing in my Aunt's front yard. There were toys and hula hoops. There was a teddy bear that was alive. Then there was a dull red corvette in the driveway that I decided to rent for the day. I think one of my uncles went with me who happened to be visiting my Aunt.

I was at a carnival where a skinny guy in red, white, and blue clothes was showing how high he could jump and land back on his trampoline. He dies because he misses. Then he shows up at my high school alive and famous. We go out. Then a new scene. I'm in a sort of video game. Like Tron but without bright lights and funny suits. I'm there with a few other people and we are going from room to room through doors and little hatches and things to keep escaping the big monster guy of the game. Then it ended with some cafeteria scene with the guys pretending to come on to one another.

Bumped into first boyfriend. Then I'm showing the house where I live to people. This time I knew I was dreaming because the house was clearly not the same. Then the house changes again to a big chalet type home. A man and woman come to see it. My boyfriend and I are there following these people around as they do weird things to our house. Then my friends and I area alone and want to take pictures of ourselves in new swimsuits. We were unusually happy about this.

I am shoe shopping. I am studying the shoes seriously. I actually manage to solve a shoe decision problem I have been having! Right when I hid the shoes I want, some man comes up and disturbs me. Then I'm driving in my old car I got from my aunt with two strange guys I don't know. We go to the beach to somewhat similar surroundings because I think it is supposed to be Pajaro Dunes. A place I used to go to. In the end one is retarded and the other isn't. But the normal mean guy is in the body of the nice retarded boy and vice versa.

A cabin high on a mountain. Then a flood, heard the water rushing down the mountain. I was then at the center of the cabins called up-top. I know this place because it really exists at my grandmother's cabin. Then I'm in a store where I'm jealous of the kids getting toys bought for them, bright blocks. I guess it was my mother buying them the toys. Then the dream takes on an Asian theme, with a detailed sushi bar, and a woman massaging people, and also an Asian photographer I know. Then it gets disturbing because I'm to do pictures for him.

I was fishing with my dad at the old stream we used to go to when I was a child. He turned and asked if I'd caught anything and I said no. I walked back to camp and my boyfriend was there waiting in this room that looked like the hotel room we stayed in a few weeks ago. He asked me about fishing too and then I asked him how he got here. It made no sense. I was confused and thought it must be impossible that he was here. I decided I must be dreaming. I was able to make us float in the air and when I poked him in the stomach my finger went through it with great ease

I was at my old house from childhood and there were random people who I didn't know. They were arranging flowers in the living room. They were all colors of roses even blue and black. It became so that I couldn't see the floor. I fell into the flowers and was suffocating but then I just sat up.

I was on a sideways pier and there were many tents lining the pier. Each tent contained a pair of teams of people from my floor. The contest was about flying over this great body of water. It wasn't an ocean but more sparkling and crystalline. My roommate and I were on a team but we had real wings and everyone else had fake ones, motorized. It was this big secret we'd been keeping and so we won with ease. My boyfriend came out from behind what looked like a building but was a cardboard rendition like on movie sets. He and I drove away in his car.

I had a dream about a loaf of bread. The steam was piercing my skin and it kept getting my arm wetter and wetter. I rubbed my arm against my pants which were this bright blue color and then put my inner arms together and they stuck together. I couldn't pull them apart and I kept thinking what if they never came apart.

My boyfriend from back home in San Diego was driving my car and dropped me off on the side of a deserted road. It was dusty and just as I turned around after seeing my boyfriend drive away his brother drove up in my boyfriend's car. He picked me up and as if by plan he was taking me to another drop off spot, where this girl who I had assumed to be my boyfriend's sister even though he doesn't have one, was waiting for me. She was very mean and cruel to me in the car saying hateful things. She would poke me with her pointer finger in my shoulder and it hurt a lot like she was stabbing me with a knife. I yelled and screamed but she wouldn't stop.
I had a vague dream about fish. There were tropical yellow fish surrounding a big blue one. They were swimming for a while and then they just left. The blue one came closer to me.

Last night I dreamed about the same friend I dreamed about the night before. This time we were in her dorm at Duke and she had this huge room. In the middle of the room was a huge fish tank with tropical fish. The image stuck in the TV was a picture of our friends at home. It wouldn't leave the TV.

My dream involved me going to visit my best friend in North Carolina. My dream seemed to move through many days because the scene kept changing, we were in her dorm and then at the beach. I remember her singing karaoke one night.

I was looking to take a shower and couldn't find one that worked. Suddenly, the bathroom just appeared with marble floors and gold fixtures and the person who hands out towels. I wanted to take a shower but there was no room to hang my towel. This deeply troubled me, I couldn't take a shower unless I hung up my robe. I left the bathroom contused.

Last night I dreamed I was grabbing a rope and suddenly I found all these staples in my hand. The pain was so excruciating, the dream seemed so clear and real. I couldn't get to the doctor and my RA wouldn't take me so I walked around with these staples in my hand. I ended up going to class and remember sitting there with excruciating pain.

My spring break plans and I stressed out about a paper I had to write. Those happened to be the two dreams I remember. First of all, is regarding my spring break, I went to my intended destination like today. I traveled across the country but I had no school.
