My driver had told me where an old friend was staying, and I was on my way to his house when the dream stopped. His name was the only clear one (Lt. John Nagle) and he had been a close buddy through some bitter combat days.

This dream seemed to be in a forest, although I do not know exactly where. I was sitting on a log apparently waiting for a squirrel to come into sight. The birds were singing, and I felt very sleepy and warm. The squirrel came out on a branch high up in a tree, and I took careful aim but could not fire. I must have said "run and play little fella" rather loud because it woke my wife up who in turn woke me. I was conscious of the green moss and little red flowers in the woods as well as the beautiful reddish coat of the squirrel.

I was hunting, all alone in what seemed to be a thick wooded area. I was carefully following deer tracks in the snow. They were fresh, as ice had not yet formed in the print, and I was very excited. All of a sudden, there it was, at least an eight pointer. I took aim and fired. He fell, but scrambled up at once and hurried off. I gave him a good half hour start and then followed. In an hour or so, I found him bleeding in a little gully. But now as I looked at him trying so desperately to get up and run away, I became sick to my stomach and ashamed of what I had done. Just then some other hunters came up, praised me for my prize, and made quite a fuss over the buck. I gave the kill to them and left.

This dream seems to have taken place in a hotel ball room. It was graduation night, and my wife and I were celebrating by having our big night out. The room and people were very real and colorful. The one impression I had upon awakening was that everything seemed so real and alive. The women's formals I remember as bright red's, greens, and blues. The good was just as tasty as it is real, and I remember how satisfied I felt after we ate.

This dream was unusual for me as the time and place seem to be absent. I seem to have been walking along a quiet street, and suddenly coming upon a woman screaming at her neighbor because smoke from his fire was getting her wash dirty. The persons were not clear, so I can not identify them. The black smoke and white wash seem to stand out. The thing I remember most is how funny it seemed to me at the time to see the woman yelling at the man and pointing to her ruined wash.

I was walking all alone down what must have been a quiet street, as I remember no traffic noise of any sort. As I passed one rather large house, music floated out to me, and I became quite angry because I could not think of the name of the piece. It began to rain then, but instead of hurrying on my way I stood and listened to the music. I was just about ready to give up when a low soft voice said "don't you remember that, my dear." I turned, but no one was in sight. Then the voice said, "that is Beethoven's 4th. How could you ever forget." I looked frantically around but could see no more. Something made me look at the house for a moment, and for a second I saw a lovely face watching me. She seemed to be crying, yet I wasn't sure. The rain came down harder, the music ceased, and I walked on alone.

I was in a gym with several fellows, including an instructor at reserve who said his name was La Rien. Actually his name is quite different. We were all running around the track above the gym. Suddenly a girl my age who is now married and is also a model is seen swinging on one of the ropes which are suspended from the ceiling. She swings back and forth and occasionally grabs onto the rail next to the track.

There were three men in our recreation room whom I recognized but could not remember when I woke up. I went down the stairs and was greeted by a burst of pistol fire. Three slugs ripped the lower right part of my stomach. I was wiping the blood on my shirt as I walked back up the stairs. I then seem to remember being with a dog who was in a similar condition. It seemed very realistic, and I was in great pain until I woke up feeling my right side and was relieved when I found myself in good shape.

I was talking to my friend MB, 22, at my house. He said something about his uncle getting a new British car for $8000. The next thing I know, I was outside heading for the car when I saw a little puppy who had been and was throwing up. I seemed to shake my head and say, too bad. I guess he's got distemper. I then proceeded to inspect this super streamlined car which was a convertible and was parked across the street.

I was a large reception room which was given by some people that I know. I seemed to be busily at work gorging myself with all types of foods. I noticed a huge display of drinks which was actually amazing in that the containers which were orange and red and yellow were piled on top of each other in a pyramid fashion. I believe a friend of mine entered the picture, and then I woke up.

I was in professor Teimes' classroom in Corp. Finance. The room was larger than usual. We had several women in the class, which is not as it is. The professor was asking the class questions on our work. Being unprepared, I feared the time when I would be asked a question. Finally I was asked a question, which evidently I answered all right, since there were none of the repercussions I had feared due to my unpreparedness.
I am diving in the clearest possible water with my old Bhutanese friend Tshewang Dendup. The feeling is...Peace!

Martin and I were in a building, I think we just finished attending a workshop or something similar. I needed to go to pee and so did Martin. He went to the men, I went to the ladies.... but there was such a long cue for the ladies toilet that a man came and told us to follow him to another toilet. A bunch of us went with him. He took us to a bus and claimed that he would take us to the other toilet by bus. (like in some airports to change terminals). On the bus, the trip was taking so long!... and I started to notice that we were passing through the same places over and over again. I told the girl next to me (the women in the bus were all young) that I was getting upset about this going around and she said she didn't mind. Actually, no one in the bus seemed to have noticed, just me. I wanted to go out of the bus, so I pressed the "stop" button but the driver didn't care and kept on driving. So, I went to tell him to stop and I realized that he didn't have any window in front so he didn't know where he was going!! When I told him to stop, he replied that I shouldn't be angry, that it was fun! For a moment I thought he was right, but then I insisted that he stopped and opened the door for me. He didn't, so I started to kick the door until he stopped and let me go. I was the only one leaving the bus. I didn't know the place where he left me. I think it was Barcelona. It was at dusk, the streets were deserted and the place didn't look very nice. But I was happy to be free. It was when I took out my mobile to phone Martin and check the GPS that I woke up

It's night. Dark. I am on my bicycle happily riding on a small road surrounded by fields. I am happy, singing... it's fun to ride at night alone on the road. And then!!! tanukis start appearing and running in front of me crossing the road...like a fun game.

There was a discussion about how to observe a phenomenon. One group supported the idea of observing using technology because that's the way one can objectively measure. The other group (where I was included) said that the fact of measuring already changes the phenomenon that is being measured and therefore the best way to observe it is to directly watch. But we should then watch without watching because that would as well distort the phenomenon. So, we would need to watch without being there.....in a sort of meditation state. This dream is so difficult to verbalize!

I am on the shore of my lake in Northen Italy (Lago di Caldonazzo). I am looking at the lake and at some stones on the shore. There is someone with me but I do not know who. I raise the question: how do we know where the lake ends and the stone starts if both need each other to exist (and set their limit)?

I was travelling from Russia to US crossing the Bering Strait by bus. When we arrived in Alaska, everything was covered with snow and Anchorage (in my dream that was the border town) was a big shopping area full full full of shops!!... it disappointed me ...

My palm hurt. I checked and a ladybug was coming out, I scratched and it came out completely. I think there was an ant, too. It was not pleasant at all. I woke up. My throat was itching, I had a feeling of fever.

I was in a sort of yoga retreat. There was a 4 meters deep very narrow swimming pool with a 4 meters jump. We had to jump but with the head first. I was not scared but a bit worried (can't explain the feeling). Everyone was telling me that it was easy, so I felt confident but still I was not 100% convinced. I first jumped but with feet first (no problem), felt how I entered the water, touched very smoothly the bottom and came up again. I liked it. But then I had to jump with the head first... and it still worried me a bit. I woke up before I did jump...what a pity!!

I was photographing a cat from Vilaritg, the one that stayed locked up at home for 10 days while Marius was in Munich!!! I was using the DX lens on my film camera. Because of the size of the film camera sensor (it is bigger than in digital camera to which the lens belongs to), only the snout of the cat was visible!!! So cute!! Kawaiiiii!!! The cat was looking at me like what are you doing??? Very funny!

In a quite dark but colorful room (basement?), someone is being tested on a bed. The test consists in measuring how the feet move according to some brain stimulation. Finally they found someone with the appropriate feet movement. They tell her what is her mission: she must stay behind when the Earth will be destroyed while the others will leave. She must stay to try to make it again a place to live. The girl is scared, but she must approve the decision. She looks Bhutanese to me. There were a lot of clothes to dry, very colorful. And we all needed to drink lots of water.

We are in a house with 3 floors. It looked like Vilaritg. Peck is there. She is leaving and must go get a train. But I am very busy and do not have time to take her to the station. I am doing my own things. Peck is very stressed but I do not care too much because I am busy and I think that there is no sense in being stressed.

It seemed to me that you and I were two of a vast company of men and women, upon all of whom, with the exception of myself--for I was there voluntarily--sentence of death had been passed. I was sensible of the knowledge--how obtained I know not--that this terrible doom had been pronounced by the official agents of some new reign of terror. Certain I was that none of the party had really been guilty of any crime deserving of death; but that the penalty had been incurred through their connection with some regime, political, social or religious, which was doomed to utter destruction. It became known among us that the sentence was about to be carried out on a colossal scale; but we remained in absolute ignorance as to the place and method of the intended execution. Thus far my dream gave me no intimation of the horrible scene which next burst on me,--a scene which strained to their utmost tension every sense of sight, hearing and touch, in a manner unprecedented in any dream I have previously had. It was night, dark and starless, and I found myself, together with the whole company of doomed men and women who knew that they were soon to die, but not how or where, in a railway train hurrying through the darkness to some unknown destination. I sat in a carriage quite at the rear end of the train, in a corner seat, and was leaning out of the open window, peering into the darkness, when, suddenly, a voice, which seemed to speak out of the air, said to me in a low, distinct, in-tense tone, the mere recollection of which makes me shudder,--'The sentence is being carried out even now. You are all of you lost. Ahead of the train is a frightful

At the beginning of my dream I am with my two best friends at a party. My boyfriend comes in and I am talking to him although I don’t know about what then my ex-boyfriend comes in and says hi to me and I felt very awkward then ran over to my friend. As I was hurrying over to her, the house became Marine World and when I got to her she was petting a walrus and I got scared she was going to get into trouble so I pulled her away and we left. That’s all I remember.

I dreamt I was in a dance studio and my instructor was making me do turns and leaps over and over and over again. I was exhausted and kept trying to tell my instructor to stop, but each time I opened my mouth she shouted “again!” and the music turned back on and off I was spinning and leaping across the floor again.

I dreamt that I was back on my high school volleyball team and we were about to play the league championship game. However, I had suddenly become extremely rusty and couldn’t play as well as I normally could and didn’t have my uniform or shoes. I panicked a little because I had to run across the street to buy shoes but I couldn’t find the right store and I was missing warm-ups which I desperately needed because I was so rusty. I tried talking to the saleswoman, but instead she tried reading me a children’s book. Then I woke up because my alarm went off.

I looked around in what I thought was my house but when I looked closer it was my friend’s house. I went down the stairs to discover my family but everyone’s faces were on someone else’s body. I was very confused. I went to play with my dog but he had the face of my dad. I talked to him and asked him he wanted to play fetch. We placed fetch but then my arm hurt.

I was walking through campus and no one else was around; I was scared. I did not know what to do, I saw a bird fly by. Then I heard a noise. I looked around to see what it was. I did not see anything, I continued walking. I heard another noise this time it was louder. I looked again this time I saw a man in black. I could not make out his face. I started to run.

In my dream, I wanted to go to the mall. I asked my roommate if she wanted to go with me, but she said she was already going with one of her teammates. I then asked some of my friends if they would go with me; however, they all responded that they were busy or had something else they needed to do. After not finding anyone who would accompany me, I felt sad and lonely. I was also a bit angry and confused as to why no one would spend some time with me.

In my dream, I was in a large house that I was unfamiliar with. The house was modern, white, and had very green plants. Throughout the dream, I was trying to get away from someone or something that was following and coming after me. I made my way through and around the inside and outside of the house in attempts to escape what was chasing me. However, the house seemed like a maze and I felt scared, anxious, and stressed as I tried to figure out which way to go.

I dreamt that I was traveling to Fiji but I did not realize that I would be going by myself. I only realized this once I got to the airport. When I got to the airport I was with 2 other friends. They were going to the beach and they just came to drop me off. When they dropped me off, I burst into tears. I was so scared to go to Fiji alone. I knew I would have no phone or any form of protection. I called my parents to see if I could cancel my trip and just stay there with my friends. They tried to cancel it but they couldn’t. I was so scared but I checked in despite that. When I checked in and got my ticket, I was even more confused because my flights had all these layovers. Then I woke up.

I was dreaming about the movie, The Family Stone. All I can really remember is seeing the main character run in the snow after the bus. Right before then, I dreamt about my friend John and he had written me a poem for Valentines Day. I woke up with a sharp pain in my head. During my dream I felt happy.

When I first fell asleep, I fell into a really deep sleep. I woke up at 2am and from that time until 6:40am I dreamt I was with my best friend at an old Victorian House in the South. I remember being confused as to what exactly I was doing there but since I was with my best friend I didn’t think much of it. All of a sudden my older cousin came in and started talking in Spanish. I don’t speak Spanish well so I had no idea what he was saying to my best friend. Then he left and my friend and I started cleaning up the house. Whenever I tried to bring up the Spanish convo she had with my cousin, she ignored me and changed the subject. I started to get annoyed w/her and just began doing my own thing. Then we decided to go get some dinner in town but realized we didn’t have a car so we began to walk. As we were walking by some of the houses, I noticed a girl in a tire swing. I asked her her name and she said, “Follow me.” I got creeped out but my friend ran after her. We ran into her backyard & onto her back porch and up to her door. As we peeked in the screen, my cousin came up behind me and asked what I was doing there. I remember jumping when he touched me and got freaked and that’s when I woke up.

In my dream I was on a plane w/my family & at the time I didn’t know where we were flying to. I was sitting in the middle seat w/my sister sitting next to the window. At first I couldn’t see my parents but then my sister pointed them out. The man sitting next to me asked why my sister and I were flying to New York. I didn’t respond and let my sister answer. She said we were going to see family. When the plane landed a flight crew member announced we were in Albany. The when I was walking off the plane a stranger told me my dog was waiting at the gate. When my sister and I made it to the gate my mom was already petting our dog. The next scene I remember is driving in an SUV to my grandparents summer house. I woke up just before we got off the highway.

I was at an Awards Ceremony for the Indian Movie (Bollywood). And an actor, who is really old now but a classic in movies, was talking. He was giving a speech about something. Then he sees this kid and gets off the stage and starts running after him and begins to play w/him. Then I was in India with my cousins and I had just got there and I was saying hi to everyone. My cousin asked me for pictures and I told him that I finally brought them.

I walked up to my friend Jasniel. I needed to talk to him about our performance for this show. I went up to and started talking about costumes, the mix, and choreographing. Our meeting is tonight at 7pm and the SJSU guys are coming. I’m really afraid and nervous about how it’s going to be. But I’m excited at the same time.

My family and I were taking a vacation to an exotic Buddhist country because my aunt was with this extremely religious Buddhist man. We took a tiny plane to get to wherever we were going. Some people older than 21 were talking about going sky diving while we were visiting, and I said that I wanted to go but I couldn’t because I was under 21. We eventually landed, and me and my sister got stuck in this weird library that had been turned into a hostel, while the rest of my family went to a spa. We had to find which bed we were going to use based on which movie we were going to watch in that bed. I finally found my bed, which was tiny, and I was going to watch “The Beach” w/Leonardo DiCaprio. We were going to stay there for 3 nights.

I was shopping in a Gap store with my friend, Grady. The store was very dark, and somewhat gloomy. I was looking at zip-up fleece jackets, but I wanted a white one, but they didn’t have it. He bought a purse for his mom. As we were leaving the store, there were about three puppies rolling around at the entrance. One looked like a chiwawa, and one looked like a chocolate lab. After petting the puppies, we went back to his house. We started making a bed that was outside by his pool. We put a lot of pillows on it, and even some stuffed animals. His family came outside. It was very sunny outside. There was a Tweety Bird stuffed animal on the bed.

I was in a room that I didn’t recognize but everyone in the room I was friends with. There was tons of people but no furnature. The people’s voices were kind of blurry and I was pay attention to anyone. Then one of my good friends entered the room yelling. Two of my friends began screaming at each other, but what they said didn’t make any sence. Everybody was standing in a group starring at the two of them fight. While everyone was watering, I walked out of the room and I was outside on the street. It was night and there was nobody on the street. As I was walking my cell phone began to ring, but I couldn’t find it. I woke up to my alarm that I thought was my cell phone.

My roommate and I were in our room talking when she suddenly started coughing up blood. I was running back and forth to the bathroom to try and get her water, but I didn’t have a glass so I had to cup it in my hands and it kept spilling. Finally I stopped and just stood there & stared at her while she coughed. Finally when she fell asleep, I picked her up in my arms and carried her down the elevator and across campus to Cowell Medical Center. I wanted to tell the people what has happening to her, but I was so winded that I couldn’t tell them what was happening. Then I woke up.

I don’t remember much of my dream. I remember seeing a bunch of my friends faces & we were shopping & then we were at a house that we spend a lot of time at. I remember thinking how comfortable I was before my alarm went off & then how I really did not want to get up.

I was going to the 10PM Student Mass w/my friend Meggan. It was quite dark outside. We walked over to the church around 9:45PM. When we got inside, there must have only been 10 ppl scattered throughout. I walked in, & sitting near the alter was my friend Chris. I was so excited to see him—he’s abroad this whole year at Oxford. I gave him a huge hug. I didn’t know that he was back @ SCU, but he explained that he was back for about a week, then he’d fly back to Oxford for the last 2 or 3 weeks of the Spring term & then fly back. I was envisioning this calendar in my head & remember thinking how crazy & frivolous it seemed to make trips like this so close together. I figured he must be homesick. He showed me the book he was reading—something about grace—the print on the cover was in Green cursive & the cover was tan/beige. He said he loves reading w/Jesus in the Church because it makes the reading less overwhelming. I sat down next to Chris, waiting for Mass to start & Meggan sat next to me. Soon his girlfriend showed up & sat a couple seats away from Chris since the seats next to him were already taken. I was so happy to get to sit next to him & remember wondering why I hadn’t found him attractive last year—he was so good looking now. I was frustrated that I hadn’t jumped on this opportunity while I had the chance. I had forgotten my sweater & the church was a little cold, so I left to go back to my room & get it. I was wearing my Boy Scout shirt & needed my black sweater before Mass started. On my way back to the Church, I saw Meggan’s roommate, Stephanie, walking towards the Church. I was surprised b/c Steph is an atheist & has never come to Mass before. I was glad at first, until she explained that she brought “materials to work on” since she was sure to get bored w/all of the “religious magic.” I took a deep breath & tried to explain that it would be really disrespectful & distracting to others if she did this & that she should just absorb everything—but she was rather flippant about my concern. I felt v. irritated. When we got back into church, it was packed. I looked where Chris was sitting & found that his girlfriend had taken my seat. I felt a twinge of jealousy, but figured she had taken it b/c she probably thought I had really left & wasn’t going to reclaim it. So Meggan, Steph, I, & my friend Dianna, ended up sitting in the very back now. I remember thinking how I’d never sat back there before, but since I had the aisle seat, it wasn’t as bad as I though. A few minutes into Mass, Steph brought out her materials to work on & I felt v. frustrated.

I was in modern day Jerusalem, but I can remember thinking how the landscape looked more like Ireland to me. Let me back up though—The dream started off in either my aunts or Grandma’s house. We were getting ready to go on a trip & there were a couple suitcases open in the large bathroom. I vaguely remember something about the power going out for a little while…My aunt is a rather flighty person, & I recall wanting to pack up and get on our trip but not being too agitated either. At one point, things were just slow to get going & my aunt playfully ran into the large bathroom where the suitcases were—there was someone else sitting in there, but I can’t remember who it was. Auntie sat next to them, on the ground & I looked over at the jeans she was wearing. I thought to myself how weird it was that she had cut the length off the back of them so the leg wouldn’t drag on the ground but had left the front the same length. Auntie had previously stepped on the scale & it registered something like 70 kilograms. I ran over to the scale & it registered around 80 kilos: I was trying to convert that over to pounds & she asked me what the scale said. Even though it had registered as more than her, I was quite carefree about the whole thing & told her & I think she helped me figure it out. Sometime after this, we were on our trip & in a small, charming Western town. There was a fairly large group of us, but I can only identify my friend Rochelle as being with us. We went into the restaurant that was well lit, had a couple walls missing so the breeze from the outside circulated through (it was a beautiful, sunny day), and the benches and tables were made of sturdy wood. For some reason, not everyone in our group was there & so we were ordering in spurts. Rochelle was one of the 1st to order. Her order came about an hour later—waffles, some type of meats & 2 delicious looking poached eggs. But I remember thinking that w/a wait like that, it would take at least another hour & a half for everyone to get their food! I was both amused & irritated by this. Then, somehow, we ended up in this castle-like structure in Jerusalem. I was with a couple other ppl, but I can only distinctly remember my Grandma—Lolita—commenting on how King David, who had lived in this castle, had been this horrible tyrant & was spurting off some narrative about him. This didn’t seem quite right to me. As I looked out one of the castle’s windows on the landscape of the green city, I remembered that King David had been a “man after God’s own heart.” I couldn’t believe that Lolita was so grossly mistaken & tried to go & say something to argue w/her but she brushed me off & went down the castle steps.

Wow, right before waking up I was crying in my sleep! I was exclaiming something emotionally to my friend and current suitemate, that “Even though you look much different now, you’ve always been beautiful to me.” Before that I said, “I know I’m a girl and everything, but you’ve always been beautiful.” I said this to her, honestly meaning them & looking into her eyes and holding her two hands. (In real life I really do cherish her as one of my best friends too). The setting I can’t quite remember now…perhaps a living room environment. I was sitting or lying down to the left of my friend, and we were both facing my boyfriend. He was telling her, sincerely & kindly yet was brutally honest that “…I thought you were unattractive,” but when he saw her another time or at another place, he thought she was attractive. The point he goes on to say is a piece of advice: that you should find someone who doesn’t look at how you look, that cares about the person you are. The faces of my friend and my boyfriend were distinct & pretty clear. I remember seeing color (normal tones I think, not too bright etc) and I remember feeling a lot of emotion, and thinking too.

All I can recall right now is me being with my older brother. The last words I said to him before waking up dealt with me commenting on how he had my dream job. We were standing alone before I woke up (I think our mom was present sometime in the dream too though, or near). A few minutes before I woke up though, there were other people in my dream/in the scene too. These people were strangers to me but friends to my brother. My brother worked in his residency (the next step after graduating from medical school and the step before official license to practice medicine or certification). The people were co-workers/fellow students doing residency w/my brother, and they seemed very friendly and outgoing and said a few things. There were only a few of them (2-3?) and one of them was a Caucasian girl. My brother was cooking/preparing this huge oven pan or dish of fried rice. The fried rice had texture and was somewhat colorful (the yellow/brown of the rice, and with some orange from some of the scattered carrots and some green from some of the scattered peas. I remember feeling hungry looking at the rice J and my brother smushing it and stirring it with some kind of spoon or spatula. He told me it was his turn to do what he was doing (prepare the rice or food). I remember feeling a bit jealous of his job or whatever he was doing, I think. He also seemed somewhat distanced & doing his own thing—not necessarily ignoring me, but being the big brother who was in a different stage in life than me. I believe I felt like a little kid too during the dream, and like we were in a somewhat unfamiliar place for some reason (The closest description I can come up with is that it’s like one of those parking garages?)

I’m staying in a hotel for some reason and I keep telling the person I’m with that I really need to take a bath & shave my legs. I’m pretty insistent about it. So they finally get me a room (it’s a pretty lavish hotel room) but I get in the tub and can’t bring myself to shave my legs. I’m afraid someone (more specifically—Big & Rich—a country music group) will walk in. I can hear them out in the hall. Somehow I finally get over it, get dressed and go downstairs to the lobby. There is a HUGE stage there and the lighting is dimmed. Someone is putting on a concert but I can’t remember who. It wasn’t Big & Rich, it was someone a little more rockish. I walk through the crowd into a room a little off to the side and my entire 8th grade graduating class is there. I sit down next to Joey, my best friend from 8th grade, and start talking to some people. Joey starts to hold my hand. Every time I turn to my left, the person sitting next to me changes. They’re all boys I was good friends with in middle school, though. That’s all I can remember.

I only remember the last couple of scenes. I’m in college. I’m attending St Louis University but the campus looks more like the public library and the quad in front of the public library than the SCU campus. I’m walking out of a bio class with a blond haired girl and I decide I want to get lunch. The blond hair girl stops and gets in line of students lining a stairwell. She says “have fun.” And since we were talking about the student body president elections she says to watch out for campaigners. I walk out of building and am bombarded by tshirts with an African American girls face on them. She’s pretty much gorgeous. And someone says “Wow. I wanna run now.” I continue walking across campus and see the Santa Clara student body president selling campaign tshirts. There are two other girls with her. She goes over to a kiosk and starts buying St. Louis clothing (hat, tshirts) because she’s getting ready to go to a baseball game. At some point during the dream I remember thinking I had woken up. I thought my uncle came in and threw a towel on my bed and told me to wake up. I looked at the time on my cellphone and it said it was 12:00pm. I remember feeling awful because I slept so late and there was so much to do. After, I felt bad though, I dreamt I went back to sleep and had the dream previously recorded.

I was in a store shopping for clothes. I was looking at a shelf of jeans and there were T-shirts hanging from the ceiling. The best shirts were really high up and I had to jump really high to get them. There was one shirt that EVERYONE knew was the coolest (can’t remember what it looks like). So I went for it with a running start & got it. Employees were all cheering for me because they had never seen anyone jump so high. I don’t remember anymore.

I am at a school which is basically a combination of my high school campus & Santa Clara. I was walking back to my dorm room with a large group of people and I didn’t know any of them. We were coming from a lecture or some sort of activity. I started to walk really fast because I had an extreme urge to poop when all of the sudden a tall blonde guy who seemed to be a fellow freshman challenged me to a contest. The content was like “your momma” from MTV but it turned out to be a rapping contest about yourself. I felt nervous because I definitely can’t rap & didn’t know what I was going to rap about. I started coming up with lines in my head about owning 2 Ferraris and a motorcycle. (I can’t remember the lines). As I was thinking about the lines I realized that I still had to go diahria really bad. But right then, the tall blond kid came up to me with a written description of the contest and I looked over it. By this point a large group of people had circled around us and I definitely couldn’t go back on the contest but I was really nervous about whether or not I would come up with funny lines and I really had to poo! That is how the dream ended.

I dreamt it was parent’s weekend again and my dad was coming around with me to all my classes. He was really angry at me for my study habits and with how I was doing in my classes. He came back with me to my dorm and was shocked because there were hundreds of beer cans sitting all over my room. He was screaming at me for a while and then he just started laughing uncontrollably. Later that night he came around with my friends and I to different parties. He complained about the bad beer at college parties and about how I was spending my time. After that my memory is blank.

I dreamt I was back home in Portland. I was in front of my fireplace at home playing with my cat Buzzer. I got up and got in my car and began driving. I started the drive alone, but at some point a passenger appeared in the car. I didn’t recognize them, but it was apparent that we knew each other and were fairly close. It started raining and while I was driving down Scholls Ferry I spun out and crashed into a “Slow Down” sign. At this point I woke up, when I fell back to sleep I know I was in Portland again but I don’t remember what I did.

I’m running down my street at home in MD, dressed in running clothes, except that I’m wearing high heels. My calf (the left one) is burning so I look down and the high heel on my left leg had straps that crossed up my calf. I stopped runningà more like jogging because it didn’t feel like I was going fast. I tried to take the heels off, but the strap on my left calf had tiny thorns that were stuck on my leg. I thought that if I could get to my house, someone could help me. My driveway is long, but every step I took, my house moved farther away, and my leg hurt more and more. I tried running again, but wouldn’t move. I tried yelling for help, but had no voice. When I realized I would never get to my house I sat down in the middle of my street. I looked around and noticed that the sky was greenish-black—like it was about to storm. The leaves were turned upwards & the wind was picking up.

I was at a lake with my cousin Carlyn. The lake was more like a desert with a big body of water in the middle. There were big sand dunes everywhere. The sand was tan colored and the grains of sand were big, like in Hawaii (oahu). Me & Carlyn were planning on going surfing; our boards were huge & hard to carry over the big sand dunes. We finally reached the water. The beach looked like sunset beach in Oahu. The waves were perfect, double overhead and glassy. I said that to Carlyn in my dream. It was easy to paddle out & take off on waves. I could feel the water & the friction of the wave & board under my feet. After I caught my wave I paddled back out, but I couldn’t find Carlyn. I looked around frantically and finally spotted her on shore. She was yelling something to me, but I couldn’t hear what she was saying. I tried to yell back to her but no sound came out of my mouth. I was trying to yell back to her and was frustrated and scared because I couldn’t. Then, a huge wave—over 100 feet—pounded on top of me and sent me flying back to the beach. I wasn’t hurt. On the beach, my Aunt Liz was sitting under the umbrella. She had to keep moving her stuff back up the dunes because the ride was coming up. The tide wasn’t normal though. The waves were crashing right on top of people and they just kept crashing. I wanted to get back in the water, but no one would let me. I saw the big waves and 3 enormous shark fins, but I didn’t understand why they wouldn’t let me. I tried to yell at my aunt Liz for not letting me go back in. I wanted to tell her that I could handle myself & I knew what I was doing, but she wouldn’t hear me. Again, no sound was coming out of my mouth and she was trying to make sure her beach stuff didn’t get wet. I walked away & ended up on a cliff. I was looking over the cliff at the water, which was dark and frothy.

It took 10 minutes to go down four floors. I got off before the floor I wanted and took an escalator that was running way too fast. I found myself on a balcony with people I knew but didn't know each other. It was at night and we were watching a Christmas cheerleading rehearsal that involved people in giant bear costumes. During rehearsal, the sun came on, like someone had flicked on a switch. Then, they flicked it off and it was night again.

I remember myself and a few people from work had closed the store early one evening. We each stole about two items, put it in a bag and tried to close up the store before anyone noticed. Then we had to plan a getaway. People paired up but I don't remember being paired with anyone. I just remember watching everyone leave. I was feeling nervous about getting caught and where to go. I was also concerned about another employee who drove what looked like two trailers hooked together with a hitch. One was a little marshmallow type trailer, the kind families tow behind little cars, and the other was the trailer from an 18-wheeler. There no windows or windshields and was puzzled as to how he was going to drive. Suddenly, we ended up at a very rocky cliff side, kind of like the edge of a waste dump. There was a waterfall that shot over the edge. Over time I guess the pressure of the waterfall had churned up the dirty brown water below and created a foam that sat on top. As we moved closer to the waterfall I kept getting hit with foam. I think we were trying to get behind the waterfall to hide. I kept getting water in my bag and then suddenly noticed that policemen were climbing next to me. We spoke briefly but I don't remember what was said. The next things I remember were being in a kitchen at the end of sunset with my mother, a friend, and my mother's friends. I can only assume the kitchen was behind the waterfall. She was hosting a party and I remember looking out the window and far-stretched hilly country-side of light brown grass. the sky was purple and yellow, the kind it is right at sunset. My mother was telling me not to go into the hills anymore because she thought it was dangerous. Of course, I went anyway and the last thing I remember is a man with a set of both female and male genital organs and what looked like his pool boy attendee.

I was the host for a variety show going on at my house. There were tons of chairs set everywhere and the performer took me aside and asked me for a yo-yo. Anty kind of yo-yo would do. I thought to myself I have that self-winding yo-yo, but it wasn't ordinary enough for the performer. I look around and there are pockets of pitch black in the audience and I can't see anything.

I was coming home and I see a red van creeping outside near my house. I sneak past it and make my way into my house. It's nighttime. I call the police and then I run out of the house again. After this, I'm running on the freeway and I'm telling people to stop for me, I wave my hands in front of an SUV and they stop. Their 100% tinted windows drop down and they ask me what the problem is. They have two babies but I can't remember clearly if it was three men or two men and one woman. In any event, I tell them about the red van in front of my house and they tell me they will call the police. I thank them.

The only dream I remember is that I was at a farm and I was eating persimmon. I’ve never had one before so I did not know what it tasted like but I eat a number of them. Because I have never had one before I imagined what they might taste like, very sweet and juicy.

I was talking to one of my co-workers and then my supervisor came and started to gossip with us about drama at work and stuff. There was this dog running around the playground for some reason and she kept taking things off her desk and throwing them for the dog to pick up. Then someone all of the sudden my little brother was there, he was riding a plastic horse around. There was lots of these toy soldier things scattered everywhere and I was sitting there watching them all get shot down. And at first it was really funny because they were toys and they would explode when they were hit. Then I realized that they were real somehow. I became really upset because all these people were getting blown up and I was just sitting there watching. Then my brother was riding that stupid plastic horse around in the field and I was yelling at him because I didn't want him to get hit like all the soldiers were. And I started running towards him but somehow I never really got that close when I saw him and right before I could reach him I heard this loud siren and then he disappeared.

I can't remember how exactly it started, but somehow I was with my family in some city. I'm not sure where, and we were all walking downtown and I saw this girl who I actually only met a few weeks ago, but she was walking towards me and at first I was excited to see her, then I realized somehow that she was a boy, like she had facial hair. I just remember being so confused because when I met her I thought she was cute (I'm gay) but in my dream she was like male and it confused me so much. I wanted to go ask her what happened and I was trying to follow her but she went into a building and I tried to go follow her but my sister was telling me how we had to leave for our trip. Somehow, we got to this house on a hill with a big balcony and everyone was running around and moving things around. I didn't know that I was supposed to be doing or even why they all were in such a hurry. I felt really bad because they were acting like I was in there way, but I didn't know what was going on. then my mom was like, OK well, it's time to. And I was following them all down this path and there was a house and she was like we can't go in yet, we'll have to sleep outside and I was really annoyed because my brother tried to take the nice soft looking spot and I wanted to sleep there. We started arguing.

I dreamt of rowing. I had a dream about my upcoming indoor Regatta that is coming up on this Sunday (the 1). But mainly I dreamt of using the ergometer or as most of us call it the “erg”. I dreamt I was in Leavy behind the bleachers in our little erg room and I was erging. I started erging just to warm up and I then it just did that for a while as a light row. After that I started to do the hard piece. I did a 2K, and the setting I had on the erg was that it would beep every 15 sec and that would be my score (add up all the beeps at the end and the lowest wins) but about 500m in I quit. I got off the erg and stopped rowing! I did this because I was tired and then I remembered hearing the beep of the erg. I ignored it for a while and then when it wouldn’t stop then I press the off button on my erg. When that didn’t work I press all the buttons on the monitor. Finally after all those didn’t work I woke up and realized that the beep was my alarm clock.

I was with my crew team and we were just hanging out and talking. The tip of conversation was parties and we were all sharing about or favorite parties and such. One of the guys on my team got to explaining his whole night of his favorite party starting from him “preparing” (drinking before the party) in his room in which he had eight shots in a very small amount of time. I think it was in an hour actually. And then the guy began to tell all the details of the party. He told us all about the friends he saw there both girls and guys. Then he proceeded to tell us about how much more he had to drink and such and then I remember wanting to talk to Bala and then I woke up.

I went back to my dorm room and there were 2 squirrels in there which was a surprise! So I went in the hall and my roommate was out there and asked if I had seen them. Then my dog came and chased the squirrels out and Meg and I went and locked ourselves in our room and that’s all I can remember.

Fifteen minutes ago my alarm that I had set to wake up to went off. It plays a favorite song of mine, so it took a couple seconds for me to realize it was an alarm. I woke up, looked at my phone (which has the alarm on it) and turned off the alarm. I was so exhausted, warm and comfortable that I laid back down for a few minutes. I remember dreaming about Halloween. I was walking down palm drive and I kept seeing all my friends from Santa Clara friends dressed up, as my from home. My best friend here, Emily, was dressed as my best friend from home, and she ran up to me as I walked down the street and gave me a hug. I miss her so I was elated to see her (even though I knew it was a costume)- suddenly I woke up again and realized I had slightly overslept!

For the majority of the night I do not remember any dreams. I remember falling asleep and feeling extremely content, but after that there were no specific dreams. I woke up before my alarm this morning and checked the clock it was about 3:38am. With a sigh of relief, I was able to roll over and fall back asleep. I awoke a second time around 5:10am and said hello to my roommate, who had gotten up to go to the bathroom. After I fell asleep a third time I had a pretty restless sleep, tossing and turning a lot. This is the only time I remember dreaming. I remember feeling as if there were a man in the room walking around. In my dream I was talking to him as he hung out in my actual dorm room. He made me feel slightly uncomfortable, and so I asked him to leave and he did. After that I don’t remember anything else except waking (unhappily) to my alarm.

I was in a train station with my mom and two of my guy friends in New York. There was an express train/ subway that I think was the way to get to Yankee Stadium. Mom and I missed the first train but the boys made it. I heard an announcement that it changed tracks so I was trying to rush my mom over to the other tracks and there was a huge ravine-type gap between one platform and the next. I jumped and told her to also, but when she did, she barely made it and slipped a little. She dropped her purse on the platform and everything spilled out. She also hurt her ankle. The boys were on the train that had just arrived so I told her to go with them while I picked up her purse and everything in it. The train left just as I was running for it. Then, my friend/ex-boyfriend, Danny, called me to give me directions on how to get from one train to the other and still get to the Yankees game even if I was late.

My dream involved a boy who I was kind of seeing for a little while. He wanted me back and we were somewhere where there were a lot of people, probably a party, but I wasn't having any of it. It made me feel confident and strong because I felt like I had the upper hand. I remember him begging in front of all these people as I just snubbed him. I was happy about what I was doing and didn't feel guilty. I felt good.

I dreamt I was late for class while talking on to my grandmother who was hassling me for not calling her as often as she wanted. That’s pretty much all I remember-- packing my bags while getting yelled at.

I dreamt I had an affair with the escaped Hannibal Lector’s wife. The only thing really remembered is running away from him after he noticed I had his wife’s scarf in my suitcase. I was running down the stairs that kind of spiral down and he had a cross bow that he was shooting at me. Then I woke up.

I was a spy. I was exiting a warehouse with my partner when a car of bad guys pulled up in front of us. I thought we were toast but my partner told me not to worry. Then he told me about a similar situation he had gotten out of and I saw what he was describing, as if it were on tv. He described how he and another person had leapt over the car and gotten away. The next moment we were back in the warehouse again and the car with the bad guys pulled up again, yet this time it bumped into a tree and they were so distracted that my partner and I were able to break into the other car that was sitting there and drive off. Next thing, we were trying to cross the border and I was in this room with a woman who was asking me my name. I couldn't remember what my real name was supposed to be but I remembered it was supposed to be Dutch so I made up the name "Danisk" I was let through but the I found out that the CIA had a special room to let their spies through and that's where I had been so they would have let me through no matter what. Then I had to go back over the border again so I went back into the same room and the same woman tossed a huge stack of what looked like different passport sleeves. I opened one and it was blank inside. The woman told me I just needed to pick a name and write it in and they would put my picture in. I grabbed the sleeves and followed her out the door.

There was a flat-top roof and I was standing on it. It was at night. I and some other people had to run down this sloping ramp from the roof and match picture cards to the cards hanging off the ceiling in the garage below. We rand down and tried to do this. These women with purple hair rand down after us to try to stop us. They worked for Tyra Banks who was now filming her show from the rooftop. They worked for her secretly but she was pretending to be normal even though they were weird and doing bad things. This deceit irritated me but I didn't do anything about it. Next thing I remember, I was in a lab classroom sitting at a lab table with three other people. We were eating chips and salsa ad there were flower pots with huge sunflowers in them ion the middle of our lab table. Another student in the class, a girl, came up to me and asked if I had finished a certain assignment that was due the next day. I was kind of irritated that she was butting into my business and I replied that I had finished it yesterday. When I left the classroom there were a bunch of puppies running up to me and I had to pick one but I just couldn't do it.

I was walking on the beach with my boyfriend when we came across a trailer—a big trailer. When we got on, I realized it was a wedding party. All the boys are in tuxedos and the girls are in purple and blue formal dresses. Everyone was drinking out of small brightly colored glasses. They kept urging me to drink too, but I didn't want to. They kept telling me to hurry up, saying it was almost time. They pushed me into a bathroom so I could do my make-up, but there were no mirrors. All my makeup was liquid, the same color of my drink. I was confused because I couldn't put on my make-up without a mirror. I was not conscious of what I looked like. They came to get me from the bathroom and kept saying that it was time. I was confused. When I looked out the window I saw two large groups in uniform squares like soldiers. The boys were on the left and the girls were on the right. They were all dancing in unison. They wanted me to go outside, but I wouldn't go.

A big group of us were in a really big house. For some reason, I did not want to be found. I was running from room to room trying to avoid the people chasing me, eventually I found a room with lots of blue blankets. I covered up with those and shut my eyes. I don't recall anyone ever coming in after me. When I opened my eyes again I was tangled in the blankets. I had to tear them apart in order to run away. As I ran back through the house I saw a lot of people I knew. But I was no longer running from the bad guys. This time I walked down a long corridor and ended up at s BBQ with people I knew in high school. I sat at a table with old friends. They asked me about my ex-boyfriend, Chris. I told them I didn't think about him much except when I saw people with his eyes. When I went to pick up food from the line, Chris was right behind me. We hugged and started chatting and I couldn't help but notice how small his feet were.

I'm standing on a gazebo at the beach with my friends Lisa and Ana and they start talking about our friend Kristin and her old boyfriend John who just broke up. Kristin walks up to the gazebo in a bathing suit, tank top and shouts. Her hair is longer in the front than the back. Lisa and Ana start asking her questions about the break up, John, and her new boyfriend. They don't think they'll see John anymore. Kristin starts tearing up a little bit, upset by their questioning. The tone of the questioning isn't very sensitive. After a few more questions she walks away.

I'm at a wedding reception, the groom is Aaron, the guy I've been dating on and off for a long time. He's wearing casual clothes, jeans, a blue t-shirt, backwards hat, but has on a vest. He just married a tall blonde, she's also dressed casual. The reception is outdoors on a boardwalk. They call down the bride and groom to the center of the wooden deck and everyone clears out for the couple's first dance. People are joking about if the deck/boardwalk were to break. They start dancing and the deck breaks and they fall into the water, so do I and a few other people. It's only the center of the deck that breaks so there are still a lot of people above us on the deck looking down at us. Then Kate Hudson with two or three friends walks in. She's in a yellow floral dress. And someone says "Mairead's here." People in the water start talking about it and asking Aaron questions and why he and Mairead aren't together. I can't hear everything being said but I can hear him saying it was a mistake and he doesn't know why we're not together. He's getting a little upset, kind of flustered and frustrated while he's talking about it. Then I go to get out of the water, I'm wearing a black bikini, I'm trying to pull myself out of the water onto the deck but I feel embarrassed that people are watching me get out of the water from the back, in the bathing suit. I feel very self conscious. I swim to the side and start to climb out of the water on a ladder. At the top it starts wobbling, and begins to fall back, losing balance. Then I'm back on the deck. I turn around, go inside a beachy looking house where other guests are. There's a platter of cheese, crackers, very green grapes.

I was driving alone in my green CRV at night past my current house, but my friend lived in it instead of me. She had a different set up, I could see through the window. She had placed a desk where my couch was and I could see she was on her computer at it when I passed. She was hunched over so far with her mouth gaping open and her face very close to the computer screen. I wondered what she could be looking at that she's so enthralled. I laughed out loud to myself in my car because she looked so stupid and kept driving, who knows where.

I woke up in my dream in an abandoned sandy dirt area after having spent a night hanging out with two older men, in about their forties, who I recognized then but don't know in waking life. I didn't remember what had happened the night before or how I ended up on a sandy ground alone, so I was confused and lost. I walked around trying to find something familiar and found a fort-like circle of benches and wood panels tucked under some sand. When I started to walk down to it for shelter/rest, the two older men walked up and I felt relieved. They led me out of the sand field and brought me to a swim meet I apparently had scheduled. [I don’t remember how we were transported to it.] All of a sudden I was in my swim suit and the race started. I was an awful swimmer and finished far behind my opponents. I was very nervous the whole time and exhausted when I finished. After I finished, I took off my goggles and felt some bumps in my mouth. I realized I had two silver tongue piercings, only on the sides of my tongue instead of in the middle. I got out of the pool and asked the two men what had happened the night before and how I got these ugly piercings. They told me we had all gotten extremely intoxicated and when I blacked out they talked me into going to the piercing salon. The piercings started to throb so they took me to the doctor, who gave me a lecture about not taking care of my piercings. He told me they were infected, applied some gel, and sent me home. I was upset with the older men for letting this happen while I was so drunk.

I was in a room—there was a newspaper clipping on the wall about the terms "her" and "she" and something about gender neutrality. The room was an old wooden cabin. I think I was laying on a cot in the room and someone else was reading the newspaper. [ANOTHER DREAM] took place in the house I lived in when I was 2-5 years old. Someone else lived there now and had re-designed the backyard. They took out the cement steps and made a grassy hill. I was there with my family and cousins. We were all getting dressed up to go somewhere and my cousins—two girls-were looking at photos of my friends from home, telling me which one I should bring to the party with us. [ANOTHER DREAM] I was in a car full of girls and we were on our way to a party in San Francisco-I think. There had been an issue over who was going to what party-we all wanted to have a party together or go to the same one, but it turned out we were going to three different ones. In the car, someone asked if we could stop and buy lotion and the person driving the car said that every store had run out of lotion. We laughed, thinking that was absurd-but luckily we had our own bottle of lotion with us.

We were in the library but all the books weren't there yet-we didn't know where they were. [THEN] I was going to class-met my teacher in office hours and walked upstairs with her-building was same as in high school. I went with her to make copies before class just to keep her company. Later, same building. We took the elevator to the lowest level-I think we were supposed to be giving a tour of the school. [THEN] Some sort of party on the beach. I was standing by my car- putting sunscreen on. A family friend named Sally C. came up and said hi with her daughter-we caught up for awhile. It was really fun to talk with her. Later all my friends started showing up with their parents, sitting at tables on the water. My brother, my dad and I were all dressed pretty preppy and the table of guys next to us wanted to guess where we were from. Finally we told him Idaho, but he got it confused with Iowa. A group of girls had to move tables toward the light- next to our table-when it got dark.

I was at a party with people at SCU. I ran into a guy who I’m solely interested in in a platonic way. We were talking and having fun, then he went out the doorway to sketch a portrait of my face. Then the party turned into a girly slumber party- type thing. We were all dressing up and talking about clothes. Then all of a sudden my friend and I were overlooking one of the dorms from out balcony. My platonic guy friend and his friend came out the door. We yelled to them and asked what they were doing, and they held up a handle and said we should come hang out at a small party they were throwing. Then all of a sudden I was at a fairground- type thing and right away ran into my ex-boyfriend and his sleazy best friend and some other guys. Then somehow I was in the bathroom of the house I lived in before my current house, and my cell phone was on the counter turned off. Then I realized my ex-boyfriend had taken it and left a message on it for my parents. He said, “I’m with your daughter and she’s drinking a ton and throwing up everywhere. Bye.” So my parents were furious and told me I had to cut up my credit card because I was three payments late. Then I found my ex-boyfriend and screamed at him because I was so furious.

Went home, everyone’s in the kitchen, went up to my bedroom. It was different; small twin bed against the wall with green covers. Went to sleep in it. My little sister was waiting for me in it. Was going to go to sleep.
If I concentrated hard enough I realized that I could fly for short periods. Whenever I became scared I would start to fall, then I would concentrate again and fly.

First I was at a comedy show in the audience listening to the comedian tell jokes. I was having a great time. Then I was the comedian trying to make the audience laugh, and doing a good job. I was content.

I’m walking down a beach in the middle of the afternoon in Malibu with my ex-girlfriend. I’m wearing a pair of white pinstripe board shorts and she wearing a bikini with pink floral patterns. The sand is soft and white. WE sop and sit on some rocks and talk for hours about nothing. The rocks are dark and cold. WE get up and go swimming for a minute. The water is perfect. Everything feels right. I go back to the back and lay down on my towel. The sun coming through my eyelids turns everything a shade of pink then white and then its morning.

Starts with me waking up at my house. I’m not tired or sick at all when I get up. Then I’m driving down I-70 with the windows down. I’m going 85, its snowing and 36 degrees outside. I love life. The next thing I knew I’m hiking up the back country of Vail. From the top of the peak I can see for what seems like forever. Its not snowing anymore. As I click into my skis everything is exactly as should be. I take two of the best turns of my life.
I just remember looking off my bed (I am on the top bunk) and seeing a girly with her body parts all in different places, her frontal region was on her back and her legs were on her arms.

There was a large like building with only bathrooms in it. Lots of showers with foggy-clear shower doors, like the ones in on my hall. I walked in and was afraid seeing men and women in stalls, some together, so I got in a stall myself. I was suddenly afraid and saw a large shadow form with heavy breathing pass by the foggy shower door. Suddenly I had a flashlight, a ‘maglight’ specifically, blue, like mine, and I left and told everyone there were students standing around talking/gossiping, I told them there was a killer running loose in the bathrooms. I remember them telling me to calm down, it’s not a big deal, stop worrying. So I ran from the killer the rest of my dream.

My husband’s father has purchased this little house in Ark City. It looks like a fairly tale house. Cody and I start to get married there but the person marrying use won’t let him do his vows after I do mine. But we make them go back and we finish up the vows and complete the ceremony. Then somehow we are with a bunch of the people he goes to school with at Berkeley, and he is all concerned about this one class or something. Then I’m wearing a bathing suit and we’re all in this place where there is a big tank of water and his friend Randall has to do this somersault in the air thing and I can feel all the sensations of being plunged in the water and then doing the backwards flip, straightening out the legs, and then plunging back into theater. My feelings throughout all of this are annoyance that no one in the audience noticed that the official didn’t do the complete ceremony ( and there was practically no on in the audience anyway), then it was anticlimactic once we were. Then when Cody was coneren about th course or something. I was irritated that he was so concerned about something I knew would be fine. Then at the end of the somersault thing, I felt accomplish because everyone was very impressed (there were lost of people watching.)

I was with my husband and my friend Celia in some buildings none of us were familiar with. We had to go through the maze of sorts through the building, and we could choose a path that had bulls (the animals) or a path without. WE chose to walk down the path (really just a hallway) with the bulls. We made it to the end very easily – we encountered a couple of bulls but they didn’t hurt us- and then we had to sing out name to get some sort of certificate for walking through the hallway with the bulls successfully. There was another list where people could sign their names if they completed walking through the hallway without the bulls. This list had some sort of Christian influence. I signed my name first and then signed my husbands name for him, 2 lines down from my name. (There was a name already in between ours) He didn’t want me to sign his name for him. I felt very successful and proud that we chose the hallway with the bulls instead of the hallway without them. I felt like if I weren’t with my husband and my friend, I would have chosen the hallway without and I would not have been satisfied with that accomplishment.

I woke up and gout out of bed. AS I was changing out of my pJ’s and into clothes I noticed my belly button was pierced. I freaked out because I didn’t remember getting anything pierced. I got really scared about what my parents would say. I ran to the kitchen and told my mom and started crying and apologizing. I told her I had no idea when and how it happened. My mom started laughing and told me not to worry. She then told me that she pierced it for me while I was asleep. I was shocked and asked if my dad knows about this and I said “Dad is going to kill me if he see this”. Then my mom told me it’s ok and that he’s the one who picked out the belly button ring. I felt a little relieved but I was weirded out by the change in my parent’s behavior. I went back to my room and finished getting ready. I went out with my friends and told them about what happened. They weren’t surprised and told me my parents already told them about the surprise. They had planned for me. I was totally weirded out but really happy at the same time.

I was at a party with some friends. I was bored and insisted on leaving when one of my friends informed that the current guy I like was on his way there. SO I became really nervous. I quickly ran to the bathroom to fix my hair and make up . Time passed and it was almost time for me to go home. I began to feel hopeless. He finally showed up with a couple of friends. He briefly said hi to me. I was really disappointed because I had waited all night for him and now he wasn’t paying any attention to me. I was then in a bad mood and being rude to all my friends. I told everyone I was leaving and left without saying by to my crush. As I was about to driver off he came and sat in my car and said, ‘Why didn’t you say bye to me” and we proceeded o talk for a few hours it seemed.
I had a bad headache. Various people in blue shirts and red capes ran around campus. I was one of them. It was the finished product for a video made by a club I’m in.
An actor uses members of the opposite sex as objects.

I was in Oxford, England, and I was attending school at Pembroke College with my friend Natalie. We were taking a creative writing class and we had to go to the marketplace and observe people. I was observing a woman who worked in a flower store. The woman would alternate between arranging a bouquet of flowers and helping customers. It was like she was doing some sort of dance the way she would move around doing what she needed to. When we were done with our assignment, Natalie and I went to get a cookie from Ben’s Cookies. As we got closer to the store, we could smell the scent of freshly baked cookies. We each got a chocolate chip cookie and it was still warm so it was slightly gooey in the center. While we were enjoying our cookies, we decided to walk over to the park. It was very bright outside so we put on our sunglasses and continued on our way. We passed some local street vendors, who were selling jewelry and CDs. When we finally got to the park, we decided to sit under a tree and write poetry.

I was with my friend Katie, and we were trapped inside one of our other friends’ house. Our friend and someone else were after us. Katie and I were running around the house trying to escape. There were a lot of trap doors and secret passageways, and we were using them to get around. At one point, we were watching TV and we saw our friend Michelle in one of the passageways and she was trying to contact us. We went to go meet up with her hoping that she could help us escape. When we found her, she showed us another passageway. It was really dark and hard to see, so Michelle took out a flashlight which cast a yellow glow on everything. We went through a trap door in the floor that led to a tunnel. We had to get down on our hands and knees because it was only big enough to crawl through. The tunnel smelled like cake, so we knew we were over the kitchen. We went through another door that led back to a similar passageway. This kept happening, so we were basically going around in circles. Finally, we got out of the house where we apparently entered Disneyland. This whole running around the house thing was some sort of new attraction. We decided to go on Space Mountain and stick to the regular rides.

My friend Alli, her dad, and I were going to the movies and were planning on seeing the new Jennifer Lopez film but when we got to the theater realized it was not playing there, and the only thing playing was high school musical. We decide to go see that but there was a huge line of people waiting to get in, so Alli finds a secret door into the theater and I follow her, but once inside can’t find her. I end up leaving and when I go outside I am in a videogame type setting and there are long tubes on the floor that I have to connect to other tubes, but then there are people who are trying to disconnect my tubes and everyone else who are also in this game. Finally I find the person who is disconnecting my tubes and we have some interaction.

I was at the gym with two friends and they decided they were going to leave when I was not finished. Once they left I got really angry and yelled about them being awful. A big white dog comes in the room ad I am very scared of him. I then leave the class because I remember that I am not even enrolled in it, and I am going to be late to English. I go to the usual room but the class has been switched to somewhere else. I go wandering around and find a girl passed out on a couch who knows where it is. So I was running underground and being chased by someone but I couldn’t see them but I knew they were there. The ceiling was really low, I shouldn’t have been able to stand up straight but I could.
